text.body:
śrīḥ śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapādaḥ prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ
āsīnam āśrame kaṇvaṃ kaṇvāśramanivāsinaḥ | niḥśreyasakaraṃ karma praṣṭum ārebhire munim || 1.1 ṛṣayaḥ adhītāḥ kaṇva bhagavan sāṅgopāṅgāḥ savistarāḥ | vedās tvattas tadarthāni śāstrāṇi ca yathātatham || 1.2 eteṣu yad adhīteṣu kaivalyāya na kalpate | kāraṇaṃ tad api tvattaḥ śrotavyaṃ nānyathā gatiḥ || 1.3 kaṇvaḥ śrūyatāṃ munayaḥ sarve yathāpūrvaṃ mayā śrutam | upasaṅgamya saṃvartam ṛṣim arkam ivāparam || 1.4 pradīptam etam evārthaṃ pṛṣṭavān abhivādya tam | śṛṇvatāṃ sa maharṣīṇāṃ saṃvartaḥ sarvavit svayam || 1.5 mahyaṃ śuśrūṣamāṇāya pratyuvāca yathātatham saṃvartaḥ adhītāḥ sakalā vedāḥ sāṅgopāṅgāḥ savistarāḥ | itihāsapurāṇāni vākovākyayutāni ca || 1.6 śrutāni teṣu sarveṣu dṛśyante sarvadevatāḥ | svatantrāḥ phalam anyeṣu svargād anyan na dṛśyate || 1.7 vividhāni ca śāstrāṇi na tarkāś ca pratiṣṭhitāḥ | apavargaphalopāyaṃ na ca paśyāmi kutracit || 1.8 śrutir eva ca tasyāpi pramāṇam iti śuśruma | niścayaṃ nādhigacchāmi manasā vimṛśann api || 1.9 tato 'haṃ bhṛśanirviṇṇaḥ santaptahṛdayas tathā | siddhāśramaṃ samāsādya druhiṇaṃ samapūjayam || 1.10 atyugraṃ tapa ātiṣṭhaṃ tataḥ prītaḥ prajāpatiḥ | ṛṣibhir daivataiḥ sārddhaṃ svayam āgān madantikam || 1.11 brahmā varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yat te manasi vartate | varārthināṃ dvijaśreṣṭha darśanaṃ varadaṃ mama || 1.12 saṃvartaḥ ity ukto 'haṃ bhagavatā pratyavocaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ | jñānaṃ bhavatu me śuddhaṃ niḥsaṃśayam anākulam || 1.13 yena sāṃsārikaṃ duḥkhaṃ tarāmi jñānavartmanā | ity ukto devadevas tu prahasann idam abravīt || 1.14 brahmā śṛṇu vipra pravakṣyāmi siddhyupāyam anāmayam | śrutir eva dvijātīnāṃ niḥśreyasakarī parā || 1.15 yato vai śrutimantreṇa nityam ārādhayan harim | kaivalyaṃ paramaṃ prāpto na bhūyaḥ saṃsared iha || 1.16 saṃvartaḥ bhagavan kena śāstreṇa deva ārādhyate paraḥ | kīdṛśas tu paro devo vidhiḥ ko vā tad arcane || 1.17 brahmā vaiṣṇavaṃ śāsanaṃ śuddham acchidraṃ pāpanāśanam | hitārthaṃ sarvadevānām ādidevena coditam || 1.18 catuṣpādasamāyuktaṃ caturvargaphalapradam | tena śāstravidhānena samārādhaya keśavam || 1.19 tacchāstraṃ śrutavān mattaḥ kapilo munipuṅgavaḥ | macchāsanāt tu pātālaṃ tatsamīpam ito vraja || 1.20 saṃvartaḥ ity uktvā bhagavān brahmā tatraivāntaradhīyata | pātālagamanārthāya punas taptaṃ tapo mayā || 1.21 tapobalena pātālaṃ praviśan nāgapālitam | tatrāpaśyaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ nāgeśaiḥ parivāritam || 1.22 avocaṃ kapilaṃ viṣṇuṃ daṇḍavat praṇataḥ kṣitau | jambūdvīpād upāvṛttaḥ saṃvarto 'haṃ prasīda me || 1.23 viddhi māṃ bhagavan viṣṇo prāptaṃ druhiṇaśāsanāt | jñānayogakriyācaryā mṛgyate yan maharṣibhiḥ || 1.24 tad aśeṣeṇa viditaṃ bhavavidhvaṃsanaṃ tava | saṃsārāpārapāthodhimagnaṃ māṃ bhṛśaduḥkhitam || 1.25 trāyasva bhagavan nārtaṃ kṛpayā parayā vibho | tv adṛte 'nyo na vettāsya mokṣopāyasya vartmanaḥ || 1.26 ity uktaḥ kapilo devaḥ prasādāt padmajanmanaḥ | pārśvasthaṃ padmam ālokya prasīdann idam abravīt || 1.27 kapilaḥ he padma nāgarājendra janmavidhvaṃsahetukam | mahopaniṣadaṃ sarvaṃ śrutavān asi manmukhāt || 1.28 śrāvyatāṃ sakalaṃ cāyaṃ saṃvarto vedapāragaḥ | jñānānāṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ sākṣād devasamāśritam || 1.29 sātvikaṃ devadevasya samārādhanakarmajam | mokṣyamāṇaiś ca satataṃ mṛgyamāṇaṃ durāsadam || 1.30 saṃvartaḥ uktena kapilenaivaṃ padmākhyena mahātmanā | uditaṃ yan mahacchāstraṃ tat sarvaṃ prabravīmi te || 1.31 sārdhakoṭipramāṇena brahmaṇā keśavāc chrutam | kapilāya dadau brahmā lakṣāṇāṃ pañcakaṃ punaḥ || 1.32 kapilo 'pi ca padmāya pradadau lakṣamātrayā | padmo 'pi dattavān mahyam ayutagranthasaṃkhyayā || 1.33 yasmāt padmopadiṣṭeyaṃ tasmāt sā pādmasaṃhitā | mokṣaikaphaladaṃ dharmam ādyam asmin prajāpate || 1.34 tavaivādyena dharmeṇa brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | ārādhayan mahādevaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ param || 1.35 yajñena yajñaṃ yaṣṭavyaṃ yajanta iti ca śrutiḥ | ādyaṃ dharmaṃ samāsthāya ye yajante vicakṣaṇāḥ || 1.36 te yānti vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ punar āvṛttivarjitam | evaṃ sarveṣu kurvatsu mānaveṣu mumukṣuṣu || 1.37 sṛṣṭikṣayo mahānāsīn nārakī bhūstṛṇāvṛtā | pañcakālaparāḥ sarve sarve ca bhagavanmayāḥ || 1.38 nānyaṃ yajante dhyāyanti ṛte nārāyaṇān narāḥ | evaṃ kārtayuge dharme vartamāne mahāmune || 1.39 lokakartā svayaṃ brahmā nārāyaṇam upāgamat | tuṣṭāva ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣavidyayā || 1.40 bhūmau daṇḍapraṇāmaṃ ca kṛtvā tūṣṇīṃ vyatiṣṭhata| śrībhagavān lokāḥ kiṃ nānuvartante śāsanaṃ tava śāśvatam | brahman tavādhikāro vā prāpyate kiṃ nu rākṣasaiḥ || 1.41 tadīyaṃ vā padaṃ prāptaṃ na tapasyanti kiṃ surāḥ | ity ukto devadevena pratyabhāṣata padmabhūḥ || 1.42 brahmā bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa mama śreyasi jāgrati | tvayi sarvatra kuśalaṃ vartate sārvakālikam || 1.43 kiṃ tu vakṣyāmi deveśa śraddadhānā jitendriyāḥ | mahārahasyamasthāya yajante sarvamānavāḥ || 1.44 te yānti vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ punar āvṛttivarjitam | na svargo nāpi narako na janmamaraṇe ubhe || 1.45 saṃvartaḥ ity ukto brahmaṇā devaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ | pārśvasthaṃ rudram ālokya vyājahāra svayaṃ hariḥ || 1.46 śrībhagavān ṣaṭprakārāṇi tantrāṇi tvad daivatyāni śaṅkara | parasparaviruddhāni kuruṣva tvaṃ yathātatham || 1.47 avatāraiś ca bahubhir matsyādibhir ahaṃ punaḥ | tvatpraṇītāni śāstrāṇi sthāpayāmi mahītale || 1.48 alpāyāsena sulabhaṃ bhūyiṣṭhaṃ phalam adbhutam | ṣaṭprakāre ca śāstre 'smin darśaya sthemakāraṇam || 1.49 yogaśāstrasya kartṛtve viriñco 'dhikariṣyate | sāṃkhyasya cāpi nirmāṇe kapilo 'dhikariṣyati || 1.50 buddhamūrtiṃ samāsthāya buddhaśāstraṃ sṛjāmy aham | jñānāpahnavaniṣṇātaṃ jñātṛjñeyaphalāni ca || 1.51 ārhatīṃ mūrtim āsthāya śāstraṃ śāsmi tadārhataḥ | pāñcarātrābhidhaṃ śāstraṃ mayā pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ kila || 1.52 kāpālaṃ śuddhaśaivaṃ ca tathā pāśupataṃ trayaṃ | kuruṣva trīṇi śāstrāṇi lokānāṃ mohanāya vai || 1.53 śāstrāṇi matpraṇītāni bhavadbhir vyākṛtāni ca | ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ loke sthāsyanti mama śāsanāt || 1.54 bāḍham ity eva te sarve praṇipatyābruvan harim | kṛtakṛtyas tadā brahmā sārdhaṃ devaiḥ svamālayam || 1.55 jagāma siddhagandharvacāraṇādibhir arcitaḥ saṃvartaḥ pañcarātreṇa tulyāni tadāprabhṛti vai mune | śaivādīni ca śāstrāṇi prathante śāsanād dhareḥ || 1.56 vaiṣṇavyā māyayā loke pracaranti niraṅkuśāḥ | śaivādayo 'pi samayās tatra tatra pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 1.57 pañcetare pañcarātram adūṣitam api svayam | dūṣayanty eva sṛṣṭatvāt tad dūṣayitum īśvaraiḥ || 1.58 pāṣaṇḍeṣu nirasteṣu hetuvādānukūlatā | jāyate viṣṇumāyābhiḥ patitānāṃ durātmanām || 1.59 nāstikā nindakā jātāḥ vyādhibhiḥ paripīḍitāḥ | jāyante ca mriyante ca pacyante nirayeṣv api || 1.60 svargeṣu ca vasanty anye māyāmalinacetasaḥ | taranti ca bhavāmbodhiṃ māyayā ye bahiṣkṛtāḥ || 1.61 āloḍya sarvaśāstrāṇi vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ | nārāyaṇāmṛtadhyānamuśanti brahmavādinaḥ || 1.62 brāhmaṇaḥ sarvavarṇeṣu yatiś cāśramiṣūttamaḥ | yadvad gaṅgā ca tīrtheṣu daivateṣv api cācyutaḥ || 1.63 tadvat sarveṣu śāstreṣu pañcarātraṃ praśasyate | pañcarātroktavidhinā yaḥ samārādhayed dharim || 1.64 kaivalyaṃ paramaṃ prāpto na bhūyaḥ saṃsared iha | akṣayyaṃ phalam āpnoti sa pumān nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1.65 kalyāṇakāriṇas tasya pitaraḥ svargavāsinaḥ | brahmaloke 'pi pūjyante kā kathā narakārṇave || 1.66 mantraiś ca vaiṣṇavair dattaṃ havyaṃ vā kavyam eva vā | tad akṣayyaṃ bhavet tena tṛpyanti pitṛdevatāḥ || 1.67 āsphoṭayanti pitaraḥ pranṛtyanti pitāmahāḥ | vaiṣṇavo jāyate yeṣām anvayeṣu mahāmatiḥ || 1.68 pāñcarātroktavidhinā vāsudevaṃ samāśritaḥ | nārāyaṇāmṛtadhyānanirastāśeṣa vipluvaḥ || 1.69 etac chāstraṃ ca dātavyaṃ śiṣyāyānabhyasūyave | mokṣamāṇāya nānyasmai kasmaicana yadṛcchayā || 1.70 trayīniṣṭhāya dātavyam adhyetavyaṃ ca vedavat | kaṇvaḥ [mahopaniṣadākhyasya śāstrasyāsya mahāmate] | pañcarātrasamākhyāsau kathaṃ loke pravartate || 1.71 saṃvartaḥ pañcetarāṇi śāstrāṇi rātrīyante (nādriyante) mahānty api | tatsannidhau samākhyāsau tena loke pravartate || 1.72 candratārāgaṇaṃ yadvac chobhate naiva vāsare | tathetarāṇi śobhante pañca naivāsya sannidhau || 1.73 pañcatvam athavā yadvad dīpyamāne divākare | ṛcchanti rātrayas tadvad itarāṇi tadantike || 1.74 idaṃ pavitraṃ pāpaghnaṃ śāstraṃ bhavavināśanam | saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ karmapāśān upeyuṣām || 1.75 mahāpotena sadṛśaṃ tārakaṃ bhavasāgarāt | ṛgādibhedavat, tantracāturvidhyam ṛgādisaṃjñayā vedaś caturdhā bhidyate yathā || 1.76 tadvat siddhāntabhedena pañcarātraṃ caturvidham | ṛgādayo yathā caikaṃ bhidyate bahuśākhayā || 1.77 tathā siddhāntam ekaikaṃ vaktṛbhedena bhidyate | siddhāntaṃ nāma cānvarthaṃ nirāhur iti paṇḍitāḥ || 1.78 mīmāṃsādiṣu śāstreṣu ye siddhārthā manīṣiṇaḥ | teṣām ante 'dhikāro 'smin iti siddhāntasaṃjñitam || 1.79 siddhāntabhedanirūpaṇam ekamūrtipradhānaṃ tu mantrasiddhāntam ucyate | caturmūrtipradhānaṃ tu yat tad āgamasaṃjñitam || 1.80 siddhāntam ucyate sadbhir dvitīyaṃ lokaviśrutam | navamūrtipradhānaṃ ca tantrasiddhāntam ucyate || 1.81 caturvaktre trivaktre vā deve yatrārcanāvidhiḥ | tat tantrāntaram iṣṭaṃ syāt tantram etac caturvidham || 1.82 catasraḥ kathitāḥ pūrvaṃ vāsudevādayas tathā | nārāyaṇo hayagrīvo viṣṇur nṛharisūkarau || 1.83 tantrasāṅkarye doṣaḥ sāṅkaryaṃ na tu kurvīta siddhānteṣu parasparam | yadi saṃkarato mohāt rājā rāṣṭraṃ ca naśyati || 1.84 yena siddhāntamārgeṇa karṣaṇādikriyā kṛtā | tenaiva sakalaṃ karma kuryāt tantravibhāgavit || 1.85 tat tantrāntaram iṣṭaṃ syāt sarve sarvaphalapradāḥ | teṣv ayaṃ mantrasiddhāntaḥ pādmasaṃjño 'bhidhīyate || 1.86 ekaikavaktṛbhedena siddhāntā bahudhā smṛtāḥ | saṅgraho vistaraś caiva tantrāṇāṃ prakaṭīkṛtāḥ || 1.87 siddhānte mantrasaṃsiddhaiḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā | tantrāṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ vaktā nārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 1.88 anugrahārthaṃ bhaktānāṃ śrāvayāmāsa ca svayam | śrotāro mūrtibhedāś ca munayaś ca pitāmahaḥ || 1.89 prayojanaṃ ca śāstrasya mokṣaḥ prakṛtidurlabhaḥ | abhidheyaṃ bhagavataḥ samārādhanam uttamam || 1.90 saṃbandho 'pīṣyate sadbhiḥ sādhyasādhanalakṣaṇaḥ | śrutimūlam idaṃ tantraṃ pramāṇaṃ kalpasūtravat || 1.91 sarge sarge 'py avicchinnaṃ devadevasya śāsanāt | cintāmaṇir yathā loke śabalā kalpakadrumaḥ || 1.92 arthibhyo vāñchitaṃ sarvaṃ prayacchati gatiṃ vinā | pañcarātrākhyaśāstraṃ tu caturvargaphalapradam || 1.93 śāstrāntaravyasaninām abhyāsaḥ kālayāpanam | phalaṃ vā kiñcid evānyat yat tat sādhubahiṣkṛtam || 1.94 vāsudevaṃ parityajya ye 'nyaṃ devam upāsate | narakāya bhavanty ete nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 1.95 satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ uddhṛtya bhujam ucyate | vedaśāstrāt paraṃ nāsti na daivaṃ keśavāt param || 1.96 tasmād bhajasva deveśaṃ vidhinānena vai mune || kaṇvaḥ kati bhedāni tantrāṇāṃ nāmadheyāni kāni vā | śrotum icchāmi viprendra paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 1.97 saṃvartaḥ śatam ekam athāṣṭau ca purāṇe kaṇva śuśruma | nāmadheyāni caiteṣāṃ śrūyatāṃ kathyate mayā || 1.98 pādmaṃ padmodbhavaṃ māyāvaibhavaṃ nalakūbaram | trailokyamohanaṃ viṣṇutilakaṃ paramāhvayam || 1.99 nāradīyaṃ dhanadīyaṃ vāsiṣṭhaṃ pauṣkarāhvayam | sanatkumāraṃ sanakaṃ satyākhyaṃ viśvasaṃhitā || 1.100 anantākhyaṃ mahīpraśnaṃ śrīpraśnaṃ puruṣottamam | māhendrasaṃhitā pañcapraśnākhyaṃ tatvasāgaram || 1.101 vāgīśaṃ sātvataṃ caiva draviṇaṃ śrīkarāhvayam | sāṃvartaṃ viṣṇusadbhāvaṃ siddhāntaṃ viṣṇupūrvakam || 1.102 viṣṇutantraṃ ca kaumāraṃ tathā 'hirbudhnyasaṃhitā | viṣṇuvaibhavikaṃ sauraṃ saumyam īśvarasaṃhitā || 1.103 anantākhyaṃ bhāgavataṃ jayākhyaṃ mūlasaṃhitā | puṣṭitantraṃ śaunakīyaṃ mārīcaṃ dakṣasaṃhitā || 1.104 aupendraṃ yogahṛdayaṃ hārītaṃ pārameśvaram | ātreyaṃ māndaraṃ viṣvaksenam auśanasāhvayam || 1.105 vaikhānasaṃ vihaṅgendraṃ bhārgavaṃ parapūruṣam | yājñavalkyaṃ gautamīyaṃ paulastyaṃ śākalāhvayam || 1.106 jñānārṇavaṃ jāmadagnyaṃ yāmyaṃ nārāyaṇākhyakam | pārāśaryaṃ ca jābālaṃ kapilaṃ vāmanāhvayam || 1.107 jayottaraṃ bārhaspatyaṃ jaiminaṃ sātvatāhvayam | kātyāyanīyaṃ vālmīkaṃ aupagāyanasaṃhitā || 1.108 hairaṇyagarbham āgastyaṃ kāṇvaṃ bodhāyanāhvayam | bhāradvājaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ gārgyam uttarapūrvakam || 1.109 śātātapaṃ cāṅgirasaṃ kāśyapaṃ paiṅgalāhvayam | trailokyavijayaṃ yogaṃ vāyavīyaṃ ca vāruṇam || 1.110 kṛṣṇaṃ cāmbaram āgneyaṃ mārkaṇḍeyasya saṃgrahaḥ | mahāsanatkumārākhyaṃ vyāsākhyaṃ viṣṇusaṃhitā || 1.111 mārkaṇḍeyaṃ pāriṣadaṃ brahmanāradasaṃhitā | saṃvādaṃ śukarudrābhyām umāmāheśvarāhvayam || 1.112 dattātreyaṃ ca śarvākhyaṃ vārāhamihirāhvayam | saṅkarṣaṇākhyaṃ pradyumnaṃ vāmanaṃ kalki rāghavam || 1.113 prācetasākhyam ity ete śatam aṣṭottaraṃ smṛtam | etāni tantranāmāni mayoktāni mahāmate || 1.114 tantrās tv aneke bodhyante muktyupāyāḥ pṛthak pṛthak | iti tantraṃ samākhyātaṃ śāstram evaṃ manīṣibhiḥ || 1.115 tantrāṇāṃ nāmadheyāni yo nityaṃ paṭhate naraḥ | sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti brahma sanātanam || 1.116
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde śāstrāvatārakaṃ nāma prathamo 'dhāyaḥ
dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
saṃvartaḥ he padma nāgarājendra śrutavān asi yat purā | tantraṃ tad aham adhyāpyo mayi ced asty anugrahaḥ || 2.1 śrīpadma uvāca tat pravakṣyāmi viprarṣe tantraṃ vai lokaviśrutam | jñānayogakriyācaryācatuṣpādasamanvitam || 2.2 rahasyam adbhutaṃ divyaṃ yan mayā kapilāc chrutam | saṃkṣiptaṃ ca mahārthaṃ ca sarvasiddhiprasādanam || 2.3 sārdhakoṭipramāṇena brahmaṇā keśavāc chrutam | tasmāt samuddhṛtaṃ tantraṃ vāridher amṛtaṃ yathā || 2.4 vijñānam ādau sakalaṃ sṛṣṭyupodghātam ucyate | tato yogaḥ kriyā paścāc caryā ca tadanantaram || 2.5 vijñānaśabdārthaḥ vijñānaṃ bhagavajjñānaṃ taj jñānān muktir ucyate | bhagavataḥ ādyaṃ rūpam ādimadhyāntarahitam avṛddhikṣayam acyutam || 2.6 nityaṃ nirupamaṃ jyotir nityatṛptaṃ nirañjanam | sarvākāraṃ nirākāraṃ tamasaḥ param avyayam || 2.7 tatkāraṇavaśāt tasmād āvirāsīt sanātanāt | dvihastam ekavaktraṃ ca śuddhasphaṭikasannibham || 2.8 sahasravivahnīndulakṣakoṭisamaprabham | marīcicakramadhyasthaṃ cakrādyāyudhalāñchitam || 2.9 śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ vanamālāvirājitam | kirīṭahārakeyūravalayādivibhūṣitam || 2.10 pītāmbaradharaṃ saumyaṃ rūpam ādyaṃ sanātanam | sa vāsudevo vijñeyaḥ sṛjyaṃ sarvaṃ ca tanmukhāt || 2.11 dhyeyaś ca yogibhir nityaṃ hṛtpadmāhvayaviṣṭare | paśyanti sūrayaḥ śaśvat tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 2.12 vāsudevāt tato jāto vāsudevāhvayo 'paraḥ | ekavaktraś caturbāhuś cakrādyāyudhalakṣaṇaḥ || 2.13 sthityai cakraṃ sarasijaṃ dadhānaṃ sṛṣṭaye punaḥ | muktaye pāñcajanyaṃ ca gadāṃ saṃhṛtaye tathā || 2.14 śrīvatsakaustubhorasko vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ | mayūrakaṇṭhavacchyāmaḥ pītanaisargikāmbaraḥ || 2.15 sa vāsudevo bhagavān sṛṣṭisthityantamuktidaḥ | ātmānaṃ sa dvidhā cakre punaḥ kenā 'pi hetunā || 2.16 tayor eko vāsudevaḥ śuddhasphaṭikasannibhaḥ | nārāyaṇo dvitīyas tu nīlāmbudasamaprabhaḥ || 2.17 saṅkarṣaṇo vāsudevāt tasmāt pradyumnasaṃjñitaḥ | pradyumnād aniruddho 'bhūt sarva ete caturbhujāḥ || 2.18 jñānādiguṇasāmānye vāsudevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | ṣaṇṇāṃ guṇānāṃ vaiṣamye vakṣyante mūrtayaḥ kramāt || 2.19 jñāne 'dhiko bhaved brahman saṅkarṣaṇasamāhvayaḥ | bale 'dhikas tu pradyumnaḥ syād aiśvarye 'niruddhakaḥ || 2.20 mūrtibhyaś ca caturbhyaś ca caturviṃśatimūrtayaḥ | jāyante kramaśo brahman dīpād dīpāntaraṃ yathā || 2.21 sarve caturbhujāḥ padmaśaṅkhacakragadādharāḥ | vāsudevād ādidevāt prathamāt keśavas tathā || 2.22 nārāyaṇo mādhavaś ca jajñire bhūsurottama | saṅkarṣaṇāc ca govindo viṣṇuś ca madhusūdanaḥ || 2.23 trayas te samajāyanta pradyumnāc ca trivikramaḥ | vāmanaḥ śrīdharaś caite jajñire munisattama || 2.24 aniruddhād dhṛṣīkeśaḥ padmanābhaś ca suvrata | dāmodaraś ca tenetthaṃ dvādaśāṃśāḥ prajajñire || 2.25 vāsudevāc ca tannāmnā tathā saṅkarṣaṇād api | pradyumnād api tannāmnā tannāmnaivāniruddhakāt || 2.26 abhūvan kramaśas tebhyaś caturbhyaḥ puruṣottamāḥ | adhokṣajo nṛsiṃhaś ca caturthaś cācyuto mataḥ || 2.27 caturbhya eva tebhyo 'mī jajñire ca yathākramam | janārdanas tathopendro hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samākhyayā || 2.28 vāsudevād ādidevān mūrtyaṣṭakam ajāyata | brāhmī ca mūrtiḥ prathamā prājāpatyā ca vaiṣṇavī || 2.29 divyā cārṣī mānuṣī ca saptamī cāsurī matā | paiśācī caramā tāsāṃ mūrtīnām aparā daśa || 2.30 mīnādyā jajñire vipra caturvyūhād yathākramam | matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaś ca vāsudevād ajāyata || 2.31 nṛsiṃho vāmano rāmo jāmadagnyo 'py ajāyata | saṅkarṣaṇāt tathā jajñe pradyumnād rāghavo balī || 2.32 aniruddhād abhūt kṛṣṇaḥ kalkīti daśa mūrtayaḥ | saṅkarṣaṇāc ca puruṣaḥ satyaḥ pradyumnasambhavaḥ || 2.33 jāto 'cyuto 'niruddhāc ca buddhas trailokyamohanaḥ | daśārhaḥ śaurir anneśo vāsudevād ajāyata || 2.34 saṅkarṣaṇād dhayagrīvaḥ śaṅkhodaranṛkesarī | vaikuṇṭhamūrtir ādyā tu mukundaś ca vṛṣākapiḥ || 2.35 tatraivādivarāhaś ca tataḥ saṅkarṣaṇād api | anantaḥ pannago jātaḥ sahasraphaṇavān balī || 2.36 sudarśanādyāyudhāni kirīṭādivibhūṣaṇam | mūrtyāvirbhāvasamaye sahaivaitāni jajñire || 2.37 devyaḥ śriyādayas tadvat mūrtibhedaṃ samāśritāḥ | śrīvatsād eva sakalāj jajñire divyalāñchanāt || 2.38 garuḍaḥ pakṣiṇām indro vāhanaṃ balināṃ varaḥ | vāsudevādimūrtibhyaś chandomūrtir ajāyata || 2.39 kumudādyāś ca bhūteśāḥ sarve pāriṣadaiḥ saha | pādataś cāniruddhasya samabhūvan sahasraśaḥ || 2.40 sahasraśīrṣacaraṇahastanetrādbhutākṛteḥ | aniruddhāj jagaj jajñe svāṅgād eva yathākramam || 2.41 mukhād indraś ca vahniś ca chandāṃsy aṅgāni ṣaṭ tathā | dyaur mūrdhno nayanāt sūryo manasaś candramā api || 2.42 śrotrād diśo nabho nābheḥ padbhyāṃ bhūmir ajāyata | prāṇād vāyus tathāpānān mṛtyuḥ keśāt tathāmbudaḥ || 2.43 truṭyādikālabhedāś ca kālaś cābhūt tathā dhiyaḥ | vanaspataya oṣadhyo romakūpād vinissṛtāḥ || 2.44 yajñāś ca jajñire tasmād bahavo bahudakṣiṇāḥ | cāturvarṇyaṃ kramād vaktrabāhūrucaraṇodbhavam || 2.45 evaṃ sṛṣṭvā jagat sarvaṃ viśvarūpadharo hariḥ | āste 'nantāsane devaḥ śrībhūmibhyāṃ saha prabhuḥ || 2.46 madhye kṣīrārṇave śvetadvīpākhye hemanirmite | prāsāde sevyamānaś ca yogibhir vividhair api || 2.47 caṇḍādidvārapālaiś ca kumudādyanujīvibhiḥ | pakṣīndraviṣvaksenābhyāṃ sevyamāno mudānvitaḥ || 2.48 śrīvatsavakṣā nityaśrīr ajeyaḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ | aniruddho jagat svāṃśair indrādyaiḥ paripālayan || 2.49
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde mūrtyutpattibhedo nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
padmaḥ brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭir adhunā vakṣyate dvijasattama | nārāyaṇo 'sṛjat toyaṃ tatraivāsīn mahārṇavaḥ || 3.1 aniruddhāṃśajā durgā māyārūpā sumohinī | nyagrodham asṛjat tasmin māyārūpe mahādrume || 3.2 aniruddhāṃśajaḥ śrīmān padmanābhaḥ purātanaḥ | saṃhṛtya lokān puruṣaḥ parṇaparyaṅkameyivān || 3.3 vaṭapatraśāyino nābhīpadme caturmukhasṛṣṭiḥ tatra puṃsaḥ śayānasya nāgaparyaṅkabhūṣite | hiraṇmayaṃ padmagarbhaṃ nābher aṇḍam ajāyata || 3.4 tad aṇḍaṃ pañcabhūtātmabhūtaṃ śuddham atarkitam | aṇḍasya vardhamānasya madhye padmaṃ sitaprabham || 3.5 sahasradalaparyantam antaḥkesaramaṇḍitam | madhye karṇikayā yuktam adbhutaṃ sṛṣṭikāraṇam || 3.6 sraṣṭāram asṛjat tasmin padmanābhaś caturmukham | padmāsanam āsanaṃ brahmaṇo yasmāt padmam ādāv abhūt tataḥ || 3.7 anyeṣām api devānām āsanaṃ padmam iṣyate | sanandanādīnāṃ sṛṣṭikāryavimukhatā sanandanādīn asṛjat sṛṣṭyarthaṃ padmabhūḥ svayam || 3.8 sraṣṭuṃ mano na dadhire te ca svāyaṃbhuvās tadā | sarve te yogino jātā vītarāgā vimatsarāḥ || 3.9 brahmaṇaḥ krodhād rudrasṛṣṭiḥ teṣv evaṃ nirapekṣeṣu lokasṛṣṭau mahātmasu | brahmaṇo 'bhūn mahān krodhas trailokyadahanakṣamaḥ || 3.10 bhrukuṭīkuṭilāt tasya lalāṭāt krodhadīpitāt | samutpannas tadā rudro yugāntāgnisamaprabhaḥ || 3.11 ardhanārīnaravapur mahākāyaḥ pratāpavān | saṃvibhajyātmano dehaṃ naraṃ nārīṃ ca nirmame || 3.12 mithunāj jajñire tasmād rudrāṇāṃ koṭayas tathā | sarve caturbhujāḥ krūrāḥ trinetrāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ || 3.13 teṣu pradhānā viprendra rudrā ekādaśa smṛtāḥ | marīcyādibhir jagatsṛṣṭiḥ rudrasṛṣṭim api brahmā vyartham ālokya lokakṛt || 3.14 marīcyādīn ṣaḍaparāṇ manasā nirmame punaḥ | tair etad akhilaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 3.15 brahmaṇaḥ paramapuruṣadarśanam evaṃ sṛṣṭvā jagad idaṃ padmayoniś caturmukhaḥ | dhyānaṃ paramamātasthau kāraṇaṃ svasya cintayan || 3.16 dhyāyatas tasya purataḥ tejaḥpuñjam ivābhavat | divākarasahasrābhaṃ vidyutsaṅghātasannibham || 3.17 tanmadhye puruṣaśreṣṭhaṃ pītanirmalavāsasam | śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaṃ dhārayantaṃ caturbhujam || 3.18 śrīvatsāṅkaṃ prasannāsya kaustubhena virājitam | sphuratkirīṭahārādyair bhūṣaṇair upaśobhitam || 3.19 taṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣaśreṣṭhaṃ padmayonir acintayat | eṣa eva paro devaḥ sarvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ || 3.20 nāsmāt parataraḥ kaścid dṛśyate puruṣaḥ sthitaḥ | tam eva saṃśayān praṣṭuṃ vividhān upacakrame || 3.21 brahmā kas tvam atyadbhutākāraḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣottama | mahyaṃ jijñāsamānāya ātmānaṃ darśayasva me || 3.22 śrībhagavān sraṣṭāraṃ sarvalokānāṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ param | anādimadhyanidhanaṃ viddhi mām acalaṃ dhruvam || 3.23 kāraṇaṃ sarvalokasya mā ca bhūt saṃśayas tava | saṃśayasya tvadīyasya chettāraṃ mām upasthitam || 3.24 brahmā dhanyo 'smy anugṛhīto 'smi pūrṇakāmo 'smi śāśvata | ajñātaṃ nāsti te jñeyaṃ kartavyaṃ nāsti cākṛtam || 3.25 nānavāptam avāptavyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate | kasya hetor jagat sraṣṭuṃ janān prerayase vada || 3.26 śrībhagavān krīḍāmi kevalaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārapālanaiḥ | lokānām api sarveṣām ahaṃ kenāpi hetunā || 3.27
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde brahmādisṛṣṭiprakāro nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā vidhatse kena rūpeṇa kena rūpeṇa pāsi vā | saṃhartuṃ yatase kena śuśrūṣā me vijṛmbhate || 4.1 sṛṣṭyarthāsu anantāsu śaktiṣu catasro mukhyāḥ śrībhagavān anantāḥ śaktayaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ manasaiva caturmukha | catasras tāsu nirdiṣṭāḥ mukhyā viṣṇvādimūrtayaḥ || 4.2 tatra tisraḥ saṃsāragocarāḥ, caturthī mokṣadāyinī rajassatvatamomayyas tisraḥ saṃsāragocarāḥ | ānandākhyā caturthī tu bhuktimuktipradāyinī || 4.3 sṛṣṭyādyupayogino guṇāḥ rajoguṇena bhuvanaṃ sṛjāmi sacarācaram | pālayāmi ca satvena tamasā saṃharāmi ca || 4.4 ānandātmānam āsthāya vāsudevāhvayaḥ svayam | vipāśayāmi saṃsārāt ye mām eva bhajanti tān || 4.5 sṛjāmi pāmi hanmy etad rūpair brahmādibhis tribhiḥ | niṣkāmānāṃ bandhamokṣaḥ vāsudevātmarūpeṇa pareṇa bhavasāgarāt || 4.6 vipāśayāmi niṣkāmān ye mām ārādhayanti tān | viṣṇvādiṣu catasṛṣu vāsudevamūrtir apavargapradā mukhyaś caturṇām eteṣām ucyate paramaḥ pumān || 4.7 apavargakaratvena vāsudevaḥ sa īritaḥ | brahmādayas tato 'nye tu saṃsārāhitadṛṣṭayaḥ || 4.8 (saṃsārisvarūpaṃ tanmātrā ca) brahmā saṃsārī puruṣaḥ ko 'sya mātre ke vā parāvare | muktaḥ ko yasya mātre dve na vidyete parāvare || 4.9 śrībhagavān puṇyapāpanimitte yaḥ sukhaduḥkhe niṣevate | saṃsārī sā parā mātrā brahmabhūyam itīryate || 4.10 mātrā parā bhavet tasya sthāvaratvam asatsamam | muktasvarūpam saṃsāravāsanātītaṃ vimuktaṃ karmabandhanaiḥ || 4.11 ātmatṛptam udāsīnaṃ muktam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ | sadaikarūparūpasya mātrā kāpi na vidyate || 4.12 brahmā ke saṃsāraṃ prapadyante ke ca gacchanti nirvṛtim | kautūhalaṃ hi bhagavan brūhi tatvaṃ yathātatham || 4.13 saṃsārabandhamokṣau śrībhagavān phalakāmanayā karma vihitaṃ vaidikaṃ bhajan | badhyate niḥspṛhaḥ karma bhajamāno na badhyate || 4.14 jñānaṃ vaiṣayikaṃ yasya cakṣurādinibandhanam | badhyate sa pare deve yasya jñānaṃ sa mucyate || 4.15 brahmā muktātmanaś ca bhavato bhedaḥ kaḥ puruṣottama | etad ācakṣva bhagavan nātiguhyaṃ yadi prabho || 4.16 muktātmanaḥ paramapuruṣasya ca bhedaḥ śrībhagavān aham eva bhavanty ete na bhedas tatra kaścana | yathāhaṃ viharāmy evaṃ tathā muktāś ca dehinaḥ || 4.17 brahmā badhnanti puruṣaṃ ke te hetavaḥ karmahetavaḥ | karmapāśair nigalitān puruṣān bhrāmayanti ye || 4.18 bandhahetavaḥ śrībhagavān tribhir eva guṇair vyastaiḥ samastaiḥ pūrvam īritaiḥ | satvādibhiḥ kriyā cāpi trividhā saṃpravartate || 4.19 tayā saṃsāram ṛcchanti puruṣāḥ pūrvavṛttayaḥ | evam eva suraśreṣṭha yan māṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi || 4.20 brahmā katham ebhir guṇair yogaḥ puruṣasyopajāyate | karmapāśair vimucyeta mokṣyamāṇaś ca pūruṣaḥ (sic! puruṣaḥ) || 4.21 viṣayavaśād guṇatrayayogaviyogau śrībhagavān puruṣasya guṇā ye te dehadharmānuvartinaḥ | viṣayasya vaśād ete bhavanti na bhavanti ca || 4.22 viṣayasvarūpapraśnaḥ brahmā ko 'sau viṣaya ity uktaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ maheśvara | yasya yogād bhavanty ete na bhavanti ca te guṇāḥ || 4.23 viṣayanirūpaṇam śrībhagavān triguṇā prakṛtir brahman viṣayo dehinaḥ smṛtaḥ | tadyogād badhyate jantus tadayogād vimucyate || 4.24 jānāti puruṣo nityaṃ prakṛtiṃ triguṇātmikām | sā ca prasūte satataṃ nidrālasyaṃ pṛthagvidham || 4.25 svarūpaṃ vismaraty eṣa nidrayā vivaśaḥ svayam | sa bandha iṣyate puṃsāṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi || 4.26
iti śrī pāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde mumukṣusaṃsāramocanaṃ nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ
pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā prakṛtyā tasya saṃyogo jāyate kena hetunā | etad ācakṣva bhagavan rahasyaṃ durlabhaṃ mama || 5.1 prakṛtyā puruṣasya saṃyoge hetuḥ śrībhagavān yanmāyā kāraṇaṃ brahmann anādir avināśinī | yunakti puruṣaṃ saiṣā prakṛtyā guṇarūpayā || 5.2 bhagavataḥ prasādāt prakṛtyā viyogaḥ matprasādaṃ vinā tasya na virāmo 'sti kasyacit | yāvan nāhaṃ prasīdāmi tāvan māyā duratyayā || 5.3 pūrṇakāmasya bhagavataḥ prasāde nibandhanam bramā pūrṇakāmasya devasya prasāde kiṃ nibandhanam | na jāne kāraṇaṃ tasya tan me brūhi nibandhanam || 5.4 śrībhagavān varṇānām āśramāṇāṃ ca maryādā yā mayā kṛtā | tāṃ ye samanuvartante prasādas teṣu me mahān || 5.5 tasmāt saṃsāriṇāṃ puṃsāṃ matprasādaṃ vinā kvacit | niḥśreyasakaraṃ nānyad budhyasva kamalāsana || 5.6 brahmā bhagavan devadeveśa jānāmi puruṣottama | tvām eva jagatāṃ manye sraṣṭāraṃ kamalekṣaṇa || 5.7 prabhavanti yato lokāḥ pralayaṃ yānti yatra ca | bhagavan tad aśeṣeṇa jñātum icchāmi śāṃsa me || 5.8 sṛṣṭyādinirūpaṇam prakṛtiḥ puruṣaś cobhe mama rūpe duratyaye | anupraviśya dvitayaṃ kṣobhayāmy aham icchayā || 5.9 prakṛtis triguṇā brahman anādir avināśinī | puruṣādhiṣṭhitā sūte sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca || 5.10 guṇasāmyātmanas tasmāt puruṣādhiṣṭhitāt punaḥ | ajāyata mahattatvaṃ trividhaṃ trividhair guṇaiḥ || 5.11 ahaṅkāras tato jātas tasya tisro vidhāḥ smṛtāḥ | vaikārikas taijasaś ca bhūtādiś ceti tat tridhā || 5.12 vaikārikād ahaṅkārāt sātvikāt pañca jajñire | jñānendriyāṇi pañcaiva rājasāt taijasāt punaḥ || 5.13 karmendriyāṇi jātāni bhūtādes tāmasād atha | śabdatanmātram abhavat tac cākāśam ajījanat || 5.14 sparśamātraṃ tathākāśāt tasmād vāyur ajāyata | rūpamātraṃ tato vāyos tasmād agnir ajāyata || 5.15 rasamātram ajany agnes tasmād āpaḥ prajajñire | gandhatanmātram adbhyo 'pi gandhamātrāt tathā mahī || 5.16 śabdaikaguṇam ākāśaṃ śabdasparśaguṇo 'nilaḥ | śabdasparśau tathā rūpaṃ tadvad agner udāhṛtāḥ || 5.17 śabdasparśau raso rūpaṃ cāturguṇyam apāṃ smṛtam | śabdasparśau rūparasau gandhaḥ pañcaguṇā mahī || 5.18 nānāvīryāḥ pṛthagbhūtās te sṛṣṭāḥ saṃhatiṃ vinā | nāśaknuvan prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ tatas te saṃhatāḥ svayam || 5.19 mahadādiviśeṣās tāḥ pradhānapuruṣeritāḥ | aṇḍaṃ mamāṃśabhūtasya padmanābhasya padmaja || 5.20 nābher ajāyata tato jagadyonir abhūd bhavān | sargādau prakṛter evam udbhūtam akhilaṃ jagat || 5.21 līyate prakṛtāv eva kalpānte kamalāsana || brahmā manye tvayā jagat sṛṣṭaṃ vidhṛtaṃ ca tvayā vibho | kālarūpas tvam evaikaḥ kalpānte sañjahartha ca || 5.22 idānīṃ vada me jñānaṃ brahmasiddhidam acyuta | yaj jñātvā na punarjanma maraṇam bhavabandhanam || 5.23 brahmajñānadvaividhyam śrībhagavān "jñānaṃ dvividham ākhyātaṃ satvākhyaṃ ca kriyātmakam |" satvākhyasya kriyākhyena siddhir avyabhicāriṇī || 5.24 brahmā jñānaṃ kriyātmakaṃ tāvat vada kīdṛgvidhaṃ prabho | yenābhyastena satvākhyaṃ yāsyāmi brahmasiddhidam || 5.25 satvakriyātmakajñānalakṣaṇam śrībhagavān yamaś ca niyamaś caiva kriyākhyā dvividhā smṛtā | tābhyāṃ jñānaṃ ca satvākhyaṃ prāpnoty eva na saṃśayaḥ || 5.26 brahmaṇy abhinnaṃ satvākhyaṃ jñānāj jñeyam avāpyate | jñānān muktiḥ parānande paramātmani padmaja || 5.27 brahmā brahmaprāptau tvayā samyag upāyaḥ kathitaḥ purā | idānīṃ devadeveśa brūhi me brahmalakṣaṇam || 5.28 brahmalakṣaṇam śrībhagavān ānandalakṣaṇaṃ brahma nādarūpam avikriyam | kleśādibhir asaṃspṛṣṭaṃ niṣkriyaṃ nirvikalpakam || 5.29 advandvam anavacchinnaṃ svasaṃvedyaṃ nirañjanam | susūkṣmaṃ svavaśaṃ svairaṃ svayaṃjyotir anādimat || 5.30 anantam akṣayaṃ śāntaṃ adṛṣṭāntam avṛddhimat | dhruvam ekaṃ sadānandaṃ cidrūpaṃ sarvagaṃ param || 5.31 gatāgatavinirmuktaṃ vāsudevāhvayaṃ vibhum | prabhavaṃ sarvabhūtānām īśvaraṃ puruṣottamam || 5.32 svabhāvanirmalaṃ nityaṃ nistaraṅgaṃ nirākulam | nirmaryādaṃ guṇatītaṃ saguṇaṃ sarvakāmadam || 5.33 hīnavarṇair asaṃsevyaṃ mokṣamāṇair atarkitam adhyeyaṃ dhyeyam āścaryam avāṅmanasagocaram || 5.34 ṣāḍguṇyavigrahaṃ sarvaśakti svāśrayam āśritam | bhūteśaṃ bhūtakṛd bhūtaṃ tamasaḥ parataḥ sthitam || 5.35 pradhānaṃ prakṛter anyad bhogyaṃ bhoktṛniraṅkuśam | pramāṇapratyayātītaṃ sarvato 'kṣiśiromukham || 5.36 sarvataḥ pāṇicaraṇaṃ sarvam āvṛtya viṣṭhitam | bahirantaḥsthitaṃ vyāpi sarvatantrātiśāsanam || 5.37 ajam oṅkāram avyaktaṃ mūlamantrātmakaṃ śivam | māyārūpaṃ ca māyābhinnityatṛptaṃ aṇor aṇum || 5.38 mahato 'pi mahāsthūlam atulaṃ mṛdu dīptimat | amūrtaṃ mūrtam ojasvi cidghanaṃ nirupadravam || 5.39 paśyann itthaṃ paraṃ brahma pareṇa jñānacakṣuṣā | yogayuktaḥ sadā martyaḥ prāpnoti ca paraṃ padam || 5.40
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde brahmalakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ
ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā sarvataḥ pāṇipādādi brahmaṇo rūpam īritam | arūpasyā 'pi tat sarvaṃ kathayasva yathātatham || 6.1 bhagavataḥ sarvataḥpāṇipādaditvanirvacanam śrībhagavān carācaram idaṃ kṛtsnam ākṣiptaṃ paramātmanā | yatas tat sarvapāṇitvaṃ tasya lakṣaṇam ucyate || 6.2 deśakālaviśeṣeṇa saṃyuktaṃ parameṣṭhinā | yaugapadyena satataṃ sarvataḥ pāt prabhuḥ smṛtaḥ || 6.3 tiryagūrdhvamadhaś coccair gatvā bhāsayate jagat | ravir yathā tathā kṛtvā viśvataś cakṣur ucyate || 6.4 sarvaṃ puraḥsthitaṃ tasya vastujātaṃ yatas tataḥ | viśvatomukhatā tasya brahmaṇaḥ kamalāsana || 6.5 jñānendriyāṇi sarvāṇi śrayante śira uttamam | tathā jñānāśrayatvena jñeyaḥ sarvaśirāḥ prabhuḥ || 6.6 vidūram avidūrasthaṃ tathā vyavahitetare | śṛṇoti śabdasaṅghātaṃ tenāsau sarvataḥ śravāḥ || 6.7 bhinno vahnir ayaḥpiṇḍād abhinna iva dṛśyate | tadvad vyaktād bahir bhūto vyaktam āvṛtya tiṣṭhati || 6.8 ādarśe nirmale yadvad antasthā pratiyātanā | dṛśyate tatra tadvat syād vibhor avyaktarūpatā || 6.9 sendriyādhīnavijñāno rūpādiṣu caturmukha | bhagavān amuto hetoḥ sarvajñaḥ kathito budhaiḥ || 6.10 parameṇa mahatvena saṃyogāt paramātmanaḥ | vyāpitvam ucyate viṣṇor īśvarasya manīṣibhiḥ || 6.11 anāditvam ajatvena tathaivānantatā vibhoḥ | parokṣatvena sarveṣām asad ity ucyate nṛbhiḥ || 6.12 asaṃvidviṣayo brahman gandhaḥ puṣpādike yathā | tribhir guṇair abaddho 'pi baddhavat teṣu tiṣṭhati || 6.13 yathā puṣkaraparṇeṣu svaccham ambhaḥ pratiṣṭhitam | antarbahir abhivyāpya tiṣṭhaty eko mahārṇave || 6.14 nimagnasyeva kumbhasya bahir antarapāṃ sthitiḥ | parakṣetrajñayor aikyam ātmanoḥ śruticoditam || 6.15 kṣetrajñasyāsya bāhulyaṃ dehabhedāt pratīyate | ekasyaiva hi bimbasya darpaṇeṣu yathā tathā || 6.16 bhūtādipañcasaṅghātaṃ kṣetraṃ tatra vyavasthitaḥ | jīvo yas taṃ viduḥ prājñāḥ kṣetrajñaṃ parasaṃjñitam || 6.17 abuddhibodhyam aspaṣṭaṃ vyaktasyopari viṣṭhitam parāt parataraṃ viṣṇuṃ sūrayo jñānacakṣuṣā || 6.18 vidanti na tam ajñānāt jñānagocaram akṣaram | parasya vyāpino dehacalanādyā na vibhramam || 6.19 yathā ghaṭastham ākāśaṃ nīyamāne ghaṭe matiḥ | yātīti vastuto naiva bhedo 'sti parajīvayoḥ || 6.20 padmapatrasahasreṣu sūcibhinneṣv anukramāt | sūkṣmatvāt kālabhedas tu yathā naivopalabhyate || 6.21 tathaiva paramātmāyaṃ nāmnāṇuḥ parikīrtitaḥ | dūrastham ajñāḥ paśyanti hṛtpadme viṣṭhitaṃ sadā || 6.22 vitatya vāyur ākāśaṃ yathaikas tiṣṭhati prabhuḥ | tathā carācaraṃ viśvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhaty ajaḥ svayam || 6.23 sraṣṭuṃ saṃhartum īśāno raśmīn abhyudito raviḥ | yathā tathā jagat sarvaṃ sraṣṭuṃ hartuṃ prabhur hariḥ || 6.24 svaṃ paraṃ cāpi viṣayaṃ prakāśayati cidghanaḥ | yathā pradīpaḥ svasyāpi paṭādeś ca prakāśakṛt || 6.25 varṇaiḥ sitādibhir hīnas tadvad bhāsayate hariḥ | ṣaḍbhir guṇair anvitatvāt jñānādibhir ananyagaiḥ || 6.26 bhagavān kathitaḥ sadbhiḥ paramātmā jaganmayaḥ | dadhni sarpis tile tailaṃ mādhuryaṃ ca guḍādiṣu || 6.27 abhinnaṃ tatvato dravyād amūrtaṃ tatra ca sthitaṃ | upalambhana sāmārthyād dṛśyate na tad īkṣyate || 6.28 ajo 'py amūrtiḥ sarveṣām antarātmā paraḥ pumān | jñānināṃ bhāvanā yogād upalabdhipathaṃ gataḥ || 6.29 brahmā carācareṣu sarveṣu yadvastu vyāpya viṣṭhitam| amūrtam apṛthagbhūtaṃ svasaṃvedyaṃ vidanti ke ? || 6.30 vidyayā bhagavan mahyaṃ tānācakṣva yathātatham | pañcarātravidhidīkṣitānāṃ viṣṇumāyottaraṇam śrībhagavān pañcarātroktamārgeṇa ye dīkṣāṃ cakramaṇḍale | kṛtvā samarcanaṃ viṣṇoḥ dviṣaṭkākṣaravidyayā || 6.31 ārādhayanti śāstroktavidhinā deśikottamāḥ | teṣāṃ hṛdambuje sākṣād āvirāste paraḥ pumān || 6.32 taranti viṣṇumāyāṃ te na tarantītare janāḥ || brahmā vastu sākṣātkṛtaṃ kīdṛg lakṣaṇaṃ tasya kīdṛśam | bhagavan kathyatāṃ sarvaṃ mayi ced asty anugrahaḥ || 6.33 nididhyāsitavastusvarūpam śrībhagavān vālāgraśatabhāgasthaṃ pradhānapuruṣātmakam | gamanāgamanair hīnam aṇiṣṭhaṃ tadaṇor api || 6.34 mahiṣṭhaṃ mahito vastu paramānandavigraham | vṛddhikṣayavinirmuktaṃ sarvagaṃ saṃvidātmakam || 6.35 sadrūpaṃ praṇavādvedyaṃ apratarkyaṃ pramāṇavat | evaṃ vastu ca kāṃkṣante hṛdaye yoginaḥ sadā || 6.36 tasya sthūlādirūpeṇa traividhyam sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ tasya trividhaṃ rūpam īritam | sthūlādīnāṃ lakṣaṇam sthūlaṃ tatsakalaṃ jñeyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sakalaniṣkalam || 6.37 paraṃ niṣkalam eva syād rūpaṃ kamalasambhava | rūpaṃ sahasraśīrṣādi sakalaṃ paramātmanaḥ || 6.38 tejaḥ puñjam ivābhāti rūpaṃ sakalaniṣkalam | saccidānandarūpādirūpaṃ niṣkalasaṃjñitam || 6.39 prakṛtivikṛtinirūpaṇam prakṛtir vikṛtiś cobhe svarūpe paramātmanaḥ | satyādiguṇasaṅghātaḥ <�saṃghātaḥ> prakṛtir vikṛtiḥ punaḥ || 6.40 puruṣaḥ paramātmākhyaḥ teneyaṃ triguṇātmikā | paramātmādhiṣṭhitāyāḥ prakṛter jagatsargādiḥ adhiṣṭhitā jagatsarvaṃ prasūte cetanātmakam || 6.41 saṃharaty api tat sarvaṃ niyogād eva tasya sā || sa paramātmā nārāyaṇaḥ eka eva paro devo nānāśaktisamanvitaḥ || 6.42 karoti sargasaṃharau sa ca nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | nānādikkaiḥ puradvārair yathā puranivāsinaḥ || 6.43 antarviśanti yadvac ca puruṣāḥ puruṣaṃ param | upāsakā viśanty antar vidyayā parayā sadā || 6.44 brahmarandhrādiṣu rukmābhatvādiguṇaviśiṣṭabrahmasvarūpadhyātuḥ dagdhakalmaṣasya brahmaprāptiḥ jyotir maṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rukmābhaṃ puruṣaṃ param | hṛtpadmakarṇikārūḍhaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 6.45 caturbhujaṃ bhāvayanti sthāneṣv eteṣu yoginaḥ | brahmarandhre bhruvor madhye nābhicakre galāvaṭe || 6.46 jihvāgre tālumadhye ca bhāvayanto yatendriyāḥ| pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ karma dagdhvā yānti sanātanam || 6.47 niṣkāmakarmiṇām anyeṣām api brahmaprāptikathanam viṣṇor ārādhanaparāḥ pañcakālaparāyaṇāḥ | aṣṭāṅgayogasiddhāś ca dvādaśākṣaracintakāḥ || 6.48 vāsudevāśrayā martyā vāsudevaparāyaṇāḥ | sarvapāpaviśuddhāś ca yānti brahmasanātanam || 6.49 muktātmaparamātmanoḥ sadṛṣṭāntaṃ bhedagarbhābhedanirūpaṇam varṣadhārāḥ pṛthagbhūtāḥ patantyo divi meghataḥ | bhūmāv aikyaṃ yathā yānti tadvad brahmaṇi yoginaḥ || 6.50 arṇo nadīnāṃ bahudhā tatsvarūpādi bhedavat | praviṣṭaṃ vāridher vāri nodakād vyatiricyate || 6.51 tathaiva brahmaṇi pare muktātmānaś caturmukha | ekībhāvena tiṣṭhanti tatsālokyaṃ yathā bhavet || 6.52 etad rahasyam uditaṃ niṣatsūpaniṣatsu ca | yogaḥ prakāśitas tubhyaṃ mayā kamalasambhava || 6.53
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde brahmaprāptyupāyakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ ||
saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ
brahmaprāptisādhanajñānotpattikāraṇapraśnaḥ brahmā brahmaṇaḥ prāptyupāyasya jñānasyotpattikāraṇam | ucyatāṃ tad aśeṣeṇa prasādo mayi cet tava || 7.1 niṣkāmakarmabhir nirmalīkṛtacittasya brahmajñānotpattinirūpaṇam śrībhagavān bāhyoparāgarahitaṃ nirmalaṃ tasya jāyate | vijñānaṃ yasya bhagavatsamārādhanakarmabhiḥ || 7.2 anādyavidyāvilayo yogāṅgaiś ca yamādibhiḥ | śaucam ijyā tapaścaryā svādhyāyābhyasanaṃ tathā || 7.3 brahmacaryāḥ mitāhāro maunam indriyanigrahaḥ | ahiṃsā copavāsaś ca snānaṃ tīrthaniṣevaṇam || 7.4 vairāgyaṃ putradāreṣu duṣṭāhāravivarjanam | a ratā vṛddhasevā kṣamā maitryanṛśaṃsatā || 7.5 paradāraparasveṣu vaimukhyaṃ śāstrasevanam | asaktatā bhogyavastuṣv etaiś cittaprasādhanaiḥ || 7.6 jñānaṃ pratyaṅmukhaṃ jātaṃ tena jānanti tatpadam | yat prāpya na nivartante janmamṛtyuvivarjitāḥ || 7.7 puruṣāḥ karmaniratā jñānaviñānajanmani | jīvasya saṃsārahetunirūpaṇam saṃsārahetum adhunā kathayāmi caturmukha || 7.8 śubhāśubhātmakaṃ karma kṛtvā māyāvaśaṃ gatāḥ | bhogāyatanam āsthāya tattatkarma pravāhajam || 7.9 mokṣasaṃsārau prati jñānādhikyakarmādikyayor hetutā duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ va puruṣā bhuñjate niyatendriyāḥ | saṃsṛtiḥ sā caturvaktra tasyāḥ karmaiva kāraṇam || 7.10 muktir jñānādhike tasyāḥ saṃsṛter ātmano bhavet | karmādhike punaḥ saiva jāyate niravagrahā || 7.11 saṃsārahetubhūtaṃ tat karmajñānena naśyati | kṣīṇe karmaṇi saṃsārahetau muktir anantaram || 7.12 kalpate saṃsṛtiḥ karmahetur uktā viniścitā | karoti karma cāvidyāvivaśaḥ puruṣaḥ svayam || 7.13 satvarajastamasāṃ śubhāśubhakarmahetutvam gaṇā eva trayo vidyā samāsavyāsavṛttayaḥ | tair eva kurute karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vā 'śubham || 7.14 tais tribhir vividhā nidrā jāyate karmakāraṇam | saiṣā 'vidyā ca māyā ca kathyate kovidottamaiḥ || 7.15 satvāt sukhamayī nidrā rajasaḥ karmasaṅkulā | tamaso mohinī nāma tābhir nirgalitaḥ pumān || 7.16 saṃsārato 'vaśaḥ karma karoti janikāraṇam | uktārthaprapañcanam satvādiguṇasaṃyuktaṃ mano bhūteṣu pañcasu | 7.17 prayuktaṃ pañcadhā bhinnaṃ prasūte bahudhā kriyāḥ | manaḥ satvaguṇopetaṃ pṛthivīsthaṃ yadā bhavet || 7.18 tadā karoti pṛthivīkhananādikriyāṃ naraḥ | ārādhayet pratīcchāyāṃ pālanāya nṛṇāṃ tathā | 7.19 rajasisthe prāṇihiṃsāṃ mṛgayābuddhim eva ca | tamasisthe tu hṛdaye cchedanaṃ bhedanaṃ tathā || 7.20 abhicāravaśīkāraparasvaharaṇādikam | satvasthe 'psu jalakrīḍā jalapānaṃ caturmukha || 7.21 nadītaraṇam ityādi karoti vivaśaḥ pumān | rajasā ca jaladroṇyām avagāho nimajjanam | 7.22 setubandhaṃ samudrādau bāhubhyāṃ taraṇaṃ tathā | tamasisthe tu manasi jalatīre vimocanam || 7.23 kūpe vā patanaṃ śvabhre karoti puruṣaḥ sadā | manastejasi satvasthe sūryacandādidarśanam || 7.24 paṭutvam uṣṇabhāvaś ca ratnahemādidarśanam | karoti rajasi prāpte khaḍgahastaḥ samutthitaḥ || 7.25 mṛgān hanti tathā muṣṭidaṇḍaiś ca bhṛśatāḍanam | tamasisthe manasy agnau raktapuṣpādiṣu spṛhā || 7.26 śvasanasthe guṇe satve śīghrayānaṃ ca nartanam | gānaṃ pralāpanaṃ karma karoti rajasi sthite || 7.27 citte gajāśvarohādi tathordhvagamanādikam | tamoguṇasthe manasi prāsādārohaṇādikam || 7.28 citte vyomani satvasthe nirābhāsaṃ nirāśrayam | gamanaṃ rājase citte dṛṣṭaṃ jāgarti yat punaḥ || 7.29 svāpe tadīkṣitaṃ sarvaṃ mānase tamasi sthite | sarpadaṣṭa padātmāyaṃ sukha duḥkhaṃ na budhyate || 7.30 evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ karma pumān māyā vaśaṅgataḥ | karoti triguṇair yuktaḥ karmabhis taiḥ pumālayam || 7.31 saṃsāre 'pi gato janmanāśaṃ ca pratipadyate | yadā prasādasumukhaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ || 7.32 tadā māyā vimuktaś ca yogayukto jitendriyaḥ | vijñānena paraṃ brahma prāpnoti sukhalakṣaṇam | 7.33 jīvasya guṇatrayayogāyogakāraṇanirūpaṇam brahmā ebhir guṇais tathā yogo viyogo vā kathaṃ bhavet | śrībhagavān puruṣasya guṇā ete trayo 'pi kamalāsana || 7.34 māyāyogaviyogābhyāṃ bhavanti na bhavanti ca | māyānapāyinī nityā mayi tiṣṭhati śāśvatī || 7.35 māyāvaśaṃ gatāḥ sarve bhramanty ajñānamohitāḥ | brahmādayo 'pi kimuta devādyāḥ kamalāsana || 7.36 bhagavatprasādān māyānivṛttiḥ matprasādāvasānā yā madadhīnā vinaśyati | māyāyogena badhyante mucyate tāṃ jayanti ye || 7.37 bhagavatprasādakāraṇanirūpaṇam brahmā paripūrṇasya bhagavan prasādas tava kiṃkṛtaḥ | na vedmi kāraṇaṃ tatra tan me brūhi yathātatham || 7.38 śrībhagavān śraddhā bhaktiḥ samādhiś ca mayi samyak samarpitā | kāraṇaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā nānyathā bhavet || 7.39 sarveṣāṃ mokṣyamāṇānāṃ kāraṇatrayam īritam | tair vinā saṃsaranty anye māyāparavaśā janāḥ || 7.40 śraddhābhaktisamādhīnāṃ viṣayaviśeṣanaiyatyam mamāvatārarūpāṇi budhvā sṛṣṭāni manmukhāt | adharmasyopaśānty arthaṃ dharmakāmapravṛddhaye || 7.41 bahūni boddhuṃ yogyāni trayaṃ tatra samācaret | sarvākāravinirmuktaṃ rūpaṃ yat paramātmanaḥ || 7.42 durvijñānaṃ tad eteṣāṃ śraddhādīnām agocaram | muktikāraṇam uddiṣṭaṃ brahman bhūyaḥ kim iṣyate || 7.43 cetanācetanayor abhinnakāraṇatvanirūpaṇam brahmā acetanaṃ cetanaṃ ca rūpaṃ sraṣṭuṃ samīkṣyate | kim ekayoniḥ sā sṛṣṭir yonibhedaḥ kim etayoḥ || 7.44 śrībhagavān abhinnam ekam avyaktaṃ rūpaṃ tat paramātmanaḥ | avibhaktaṃ vibhaktaṃ ca dadhni sarpir iva sthitam || 7.45 avyaktaṃ vyaktam āpannaṃ kadācit puruṣecchayā | mahān jātas tato 'vyaktād ahaṅkāras < ahaṃkāras> tato 'jani || 7.46 ahaṅkārān < ahaṃkārān > mano jātaṃ tanmātrāpañcakaṃ tataḥ | indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca samajāyata padmaja || 7.47 mahābhūtaṃ pṛthivyādipañcakaṃ tadanantaram | acetanāc cetanāc ca sṛṣṭir evam udāhṛtā || 7.48 guṇatrayavaśād uttamādhamamadhyamabhāvotpattiḥ tribhir evaṃ guṇair etair uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ | jāyante kāraṇavaśāt tān bravīmi kramād aham || 7. 49 teṣāṃ svarūpam bhāveṣu teṣu bhūyiṣṭhaṃ satvaṃ śreyāṃś caturmukha | bhūyiṣṭharājaso madhyo jaghanyas tamasādhikaḥ || 7.50 uttamasatvabhāvārcanāyāḥ bhogamokṣasādhanatvam tatra satvādhikair bhāvair arcanā mama toṣiṇī | bhogo vāpy apavargo vā phalaṃ teṣāṃ yathepsitam || 7.51 rajastamobhāvathoḥ kṣayiphalatvam rajasādhikabhāvena yajante ye dvijātayaḥ | teṣāṃ triviṣṭape vāsaḥ punar āvṛttilakṣaṇaḥ || 7.52 saṃsṛtiś ca kṣayet tasya yajante ye tamodhikāḥ | teṣāṃ bhuvaḥsthale vāsaḥ kṣaye bhūlokasaṃsṛtiḥ || 7.53 yakṣabhūtapiśācādi yajante tamasādhikāḥ | uṣitvā narake ghore janma syāj jaṅgamādiṣu || 7.54 bhagavadyājināmevā 'punarāvṛttilakṣaṇaphalāvāptiḥ gatvā gatvā nivartante yajñadharmaparāyaṇāḥ | adyāpi na nivartante ye mamārādhane sthitāḥ || 7.55 ābrahmasadanāllokāḥ jāyante 'rvāg avasthitāḥ | mallokavāsino bhūyaḥ saṃsaranti na kutracit || 7.56 tasmād bhajasva māṃ brahman satvabhāvasthitaḥ sadā | āhāratraividhyam satvādiguṇayuktānām āhāras trividhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 7.57 snigdhāś ca madhurā hṛdyās tiṣṭhataḥ prathame guṇe | kaṭvāmlalavaṇaprāyāḥ madhyame tiṣṭhataḥ priyāḥ || 7.58 rasahīnaṃ yātayāmaṃ pūtigandhaṃ ciroṣitam | ucchiṣṭaṃ prītijananaṃ jaghanyaguṇavartinaḥ || 7.59 satvāt sukhamayī nidrā rajasaḥ karmasaṅkulā | nidrā divāniśaṃ tasya tamo yasyādhiko guṇaḥ || 7.60 satvādiniṣṭhānāṃ gatis traividhyam satvasthasyordhvagamanaṃ sthitir madhye rajodhike | adhogatis tāmasānāṃ trividhānāṃ tridhā gatiḥ || 7.61 satvajñānādayaḥ satvaniṣṭhasya guṇāḥ tatra satvaṃ nirmalatvāt prakāśakam anāvṛtam | satyaṃ jñānaṃ tapo maunaṃ dhṛtiḥ śaucaṃ śamaḥ kṣamā || 7.62 ityādayaḥ satvaniṣṭhe guṇāḥ kalyāṇakāriṇaḥ | ahaṅkārādayo < ahaṃkārādayo > rajoniṣṭhasya guṇāḥ ahaṅkāras < ahaṃkāras > tridhā darpaḥ krodho dambha itīritaḥ || 7.63 guṇā rajoguṇasyaite tāmasasya tu kathyate | paiśunyādayas tamoniṣṭhasya guṇāḥ paiśunyaṃ paranindā ca nidrālasyaṃ nṛśaṃsatā || 7.64 ityādayas tamodhīnā guṇāḥ proktāś caturmukha | rajastamasor vilaye satvavivṛdhyā jñānādiprāptiḥ pralīnayor itarayor guṇayoś ca jaghanyayoḥ || 7.65 satve pravṛddhe vijñānam utkuṣṭaṃ jāyate 'dhikam | tena prāpnoti paramaṃ sthānaṃ prakṛtidurlabham || 7.66 yat prāpya na nivartante saṃsāre duḥkhasambhave | dehaṃ tyajantaḥ satvasthāḥ lokān yānti sanātanān || 7.67 rajassthasya pralīnasya janmamātraṃ mahākule | pralaye tamasisthasya puruṣasya caturmukha || 7.68 mūḍhayoniṣu janma syān nikṛṣṭāsu punaḥ punaḥ | tyajato 'nte smṛtir yeṣu dehasambandham ātmanaḥ || 7.69 bhāveṣu taṃ tamāpnoti puruṣo bhāvanāvaśāt | puṃsām evaṃ bahuvidhāḥ gatayaḥ samudāhṛtāḥ || 7.70
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde gativiśeṣakathanaṃ nāma saptamo 'dhāyaḥ
aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ
vijñānopāyatapaścaryāsvarūpapraśnaḥ brahmā vijñānopāyarūpeṇa tapaścaryā ca kīrtitā | bhagavan tattapaḥ kīdṛk kiṃ vā tatkathyatāṃ mama || 8.1 vācikādi tapastraividhyam śrībhagavān vāṅmanaḥkāyajatvena tapas tat trividhaṃ matam | devadvijaguruprājñapūjanaṃ śaucam ārjavam || 8.2 ahiṃsanaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tapaḥ śārīram īritam | anugrahaparaṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ bhūtopakārakam || 8.3 svādhyāyābhyasanaṃ ceti vācikaṃ kathikaṃ tapaḥ | santoṣaḥ satataṃ brahmacintayā 'tmavinigrahaḥ || 8.4 bhāvaśuddhiḥ saumyatā ca tapomānasam īritam | sātvikādibhedena punas traividhyam śraddadhānaiḥ kṛtaṃ samyak aphalākāṃkṣibhir naraiḥ || 8.5 sātvikaṃ tattapo jñeyaṃ taddhi vijñānakārakam | satkāramānapūjādisidhyarthaṃ rājasaṃ tapaḥ || 8.6 tāmasaṃ tu tapas tat syāt yat parotsādanādikam | karma tad dvividhaṃ naiva vijñānotpattikāraṇam || 8.7 sṛṣṭikāraṇalayādhiṣṭhānasthitikālānāṃ nirūpaṇam brahmā kutaḥ prasūtir jagatāṃ teṣāṃ nāśaḥ kva saṃmataḥ | kiyantaṃ kālam eteṣāṃ sthitir me bhagavan vada || 8.8 śrībhagavān āpannā prakṛtir vyaktiṃ sūte sarvaṃ carācaram | tatraiva līyate sarvaṃ brāhme āyuṣi ca sthitiḥ || 8.9 caturmukhāyuḥ parimāṇam kālo yugasahasrākhyaḥ divārātriś ca tāvatī | brahmaṇas tena mānena śatam āyuś ca vatsarāḥ || 8.10 brahmaṇa ekasmin dine caturdaśa manavaḥ bhavanti manavas tasya dine tatra caturdaśa | ekonasaptatiḥ kālo manor ekasya kīrtitaḥ || 8.11 parasmin brahmaṇi brahman arvācīne layaṃ gate | pralayo mahadākhyo 'yaṃ caturānana kīrtitaḥ || 8.12 avāntaralayo dainandinaḥ avāntarāś ca pralayāḥ dinānām avasānajāḥ | sṛṣṭisthitilayānām aviśrāntiḥ bhavanti dhātṛbhis tais tair mahāṃś ca pralayaḥ punaḥ || 8.13 cakravad vartate kālo na virāmo 'sti karhicit | brahmā kiṃ rūpā prakṛtir deva sūte katham idaṃ jagat | brūhi sarvam aśeṣeṇa bhagavan bhūtabhāvana || 8.14 prakṛtisvarūpanirūpaṇam śrībhagavān anyūnādhikarūpāṇāṃ satvādīnāṃ caturmukha | guṇānāṃ saṃhṛtir yā sā prakṛtiḥ sadbhir ucyate || 8.15 bhagavadadhiṣṭhitāyās tasyā jagadyonitvam acetanā sā viśvasya yonir avyākṛtā svayam | nityā sūte jagat sarvaṃ niyogāt paramātmanaḥ || 8.16 avibhaktā vibhaktā ca dadhni sarpir iva sthitā | saṅkarṣaṇākhyo < saṃkarṣaṇākhyo > bhagavān prakṛtāv eva tāḥ prajāḥ || 8.17 rudraḥ saṃharati svairaṃ brahmaṇo divasakṣaye | divasādau jagat sarvaṃ punar evāsṛjat prajāḥ || 8.18 lokakartā svayaṃ brahmā yathāpūrvaṃ yathākramam | ity evaṃ sargasaṃhārau mayā samyag udīritau || 8.19 brahmā aiśvaryam aṣṭaguṇavat kiṃ tad yad bhaktimān pumān | āpnoti kīdṛk sāyujyaṃ yuñjānasya sumedhasaḥ || 8.20 labdhvā caiśvaryam akhilaṃ kena pratinivartate | aṇimādyaiśvaryanirūpaṇam śrībhagavān aṇimā mahimā cāpi yāvān evāsya kāmyate | tāvantīmiṣṭam āpnoti garimā laghimā 'pi vā || 8.21 iṣyamāṇam avāpnoti laghimnā tena pūruṣaḥ | deśaṃ vidūram apy eṣa kṣaṇamātreṇa gacchati || 8.22 yathā śālmalitūlasya tathā dehasya laghavam | garimṇā tena dehasya parvatasyeva noddhṛtiḥ || 8.23 āhāreṣu vihāreṣu yathākāmaṃ pravartate | saṅkalpenaiva < saṃkalpenaiva > bhūtāni vaśyāni kamalāsana || 8.24 parakāyapraveśaṃ ca yatheṣṭaṃ pratipadyate | ebhir aṣṭabhir evaite viharanti yathepsitam || 8.25 yadi māṃ vismareyus te sukhanidrāvimohitāḥ | madbhaktikṣaraṇād eva pratisrotovahā janāḥ || 8.26 jāyante punar utkṛṣṭavaṃśeṣu mahatāṃ satām | punar bhajeyur mām eva yajante siddhikāmyayā || 8.27 mucyante matprasādena janmano 'smād vigarhitāt | sāyujyādibhedena muktes traividhyam bhedena cāpy abhedena miśreṇa caturmukha || 8.28 tridhaiva muktir uditā bhede kaiṅkaryalakṣaṇā | muktir yatheha lokeṣu haricaryā parā narāḥ || 8.29 devasya tadvad evaite vaikuṇṭhe paramātmanaḥ | loke tasya samīpasthā muktātmānaḥ samāhitāḥ || 8.30 vasanti kiṅkarāḥ santaḥ tatprasādaparāḥ sadā | abhedamuktir atyantam aikyaṃ syāt parajīvayoḥ || 8.31 *ātmano bhāvanā caikye so 'ham ity evamātmikā | yasya tasyaikatāpattir muktir jīvaparātmanoḥ || 8.32 siddhānte miśrarūpe tu bhede sthitvā 'rcanādibhiḥ | toṣayitvā paraṃ devaṃ tato yuktaḥ samāhitaḥ || 8.33 vijñānenaikatānena paramātmani cidghane | aikyaṃ prāpnoti sā muktir uktā sāyujyalakṣaṇā || 8.34 aiśvaryam aṇimādyaṣṭaguṇāv āptiḥ sudurlabhā | muktir vā paramānandaprāptirūpā yadīpsitam || 8.35 puṃsāṃ tadubhayaṃ muktiḥ prasūte paramātmani | tattvapraśnaḥ brahmā bahūni tattvān yuktāni śāstrair bahubhir acyuta || 8.36 teṣu tattveṣu sarveṣu bhāvanā vihitā kramāt | samādhir ekatānaiva śāstravijñānam uttamam || 8.37 prasūte yena tadbrahma tattebhyaḥ paramaṃ matam | prāpnuvanti narāḥ sarve tattvāni kathayasva me || 8.38 ekapañcāśattattvāni śrībhagavān catvāriṃśaddaśaikaṃ ca tattvāni paramātmanaḥ | rūpāṇy eva caturvaktra saṃkṣepāt kathayāmy aham || 8.39 bhāvanā teṣv avikṛtā siddhaye kalpate parā | vaktavyāni tatas tāni hetos tāny avadhāraya || 8.40 avyaktaṃ buddhir anvak ca tataḥ param ahaṅkṛtiḥ < ahaṃkṛtiḥ > | tanmātrā pañcakāny ekādaśa coktāny anukramāt || 8.41 pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni pañcaiva kamalāsana | māyā kālakalārāgavidyā dīni yataḥ kramāt || 8.42 nandaś caiva mahānando mahāvidyā samīritā | kṣetrajñaś ca śivo brahmā puruṣas tadanantaram || 8.43 satyācyutau tathā 'nanto viṣṇuḥ sarvaś ca nirvṛtiḥ | viśvaś ca puruṣaś ca dvau parameṣṭhī samīritaḥ | 8.44 nāmnā 'niruddhaḥ pradyumnaḥ saṅkarṣaṇasamāhvayaḥ < saṃkarṣaṇa� > | vāsudevaś ca catvāriṃśaddaśacaikaṃ caturmukha || 8.45 *tataḥ proktam idaṃ sarvaṃ yatrotpannaṃ carācaram | tasya prapañco rūpāṇi teṣāṃ nāmāni kaḥ kṣamaḥ || 8.46 iha sarvāṇy aśeṣāṇi vaktuṃ vācāmapīśvaraḥ | ity eṣā kathitā tubhyaṃ tattvānāṃ nāmapaddhatiḥ || 8.47 saṃjñā vikalpais tattvāni bhāvayantaḥ samādhibhiḥ | yuñjānā yoginaḥ śaśvat prāpnuvanti paraṃ padam || 8.48
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde tapoviśeṣakathanaṃ nāma aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ
navamo 'dhyāyaḥ
bhuvanakośasvarūpanirūpaṇam brahmā ajñānasāgaraṃ tīrtvā vidyāpāram upeyivān | ucyatāṃ sāṃprataṃ mahyaṃ bhuvanāni caturdaśa || 9.1 rūpato nāmataś cāpi jijñāsā parameśvara | śrībhagavān yatra pratiṣṭhitaṃ yac ca mānaṃ rūpaṃ ca yādṛśam || 9.2 bhuvanānāṃ tadakhilaṃ caturmukha mukhaiḥ śataiḥ | vaktuṃ niravaśeṣeṇa kaḥ kṣameta prapañcataḥ || 9.3 boddhuṃ vā nikhilaṃ śaktaḥ ko vā dhārayituṃ kṣamaḥ | tadbravīmi samāsena sarvaṃ tvaṃ budhyase yathā || 9.4 pṛthivyāḥ parimāṇam caturaśrā bhavati bhūḥ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanaiḥ | vistīrṇā sarvato dikṣu ghanaṃ vai koṭiyojanam || 9.5 dvīpāni saptasanty atra tāvantastoyarāśayaḥ | aṅgulīyakavatsarve bhūmer upariviṣṭhitāḥ || 9.6 saptadvīpāḥ dvīpāni nāmabhis tāvat kathyante kramaśaḥ śṛṇu | jambūplakṣakuśakrauñcāḥ śākadvīpas tathā paraḥ || 9.7 śālmalī puṣkaro nāma saptamaś caturānana || saptasamudrāḥ ānupūrvyāt samudrāṃś ca kathayāmi yathātatham || 9.8 lavaṇekṣurasau paścāt maireyas tadanantaram | sarpir dadhi payas tv anyat tataḥ śuddhodakaṃ param || 9.9 dvīpasamudraparimāṇam bhūbhāge madhyame jambūdvīpamānaṃ ca kathyate | lakṣayojanavistāraṃ sarvatas tadanantaram || 9.10 vistāraṃ vāridhiḥ kṣāras tādṛgdvīpam anantaram | uttarottaram ekaikaṃ dviguṇāyāmavistaram || 9.11 dvīpāni ṣaṭ samudrāś ca pariśiṣṭāś caturmukha | dvīpaṃ jambūsamākhyātaṃ vibhajennavadhā punaḥ || 9.12 meroḥ sanniveśaviśeṣaḥ < saṃniveśa� > bhāge tu madhyame meroḥ ucchrāyo lakṣasaṃmitāḥ | yojanānāṃ kṣiter antarmagnaḥ ṣoḍaśa saṃkhyayā || 9.13 sahasrāṇāṃ yojanānāṃ śiṣṭobhāgaḥ prakāśate | kṣiter ūrdhvaṃ remayaś ca parvato mūrdhni vistṛtaḥ || 9.14 dvātriṃśac ca sahasrāṇāṃ yojanānām ayaṃ punaḥ | karṇikāvac ca bhūpadmamadhye samyagavasthitaḥ || 9.15 śṛṅgaiḥ śatasahasreṇa śatayojanavistṛtaiḥ | tatsaṃkhyāpariṇāhaiś ca tasya pārśvamahīdharān || 9.16 vakṣyāmi cānupūrvyeṇa yathā tadavadhāraya | meror dakṣiṇatastrayo varṣācalāḥ himavān hemakūṭaś ca niṣadaś cāsya dakṣiṇe || 9.17 ete varṣācalāḥ proktās trayaḥ kamalasambhava | trīṇi varṣāṇi varṣaṃ bhāratamākhyātaṃ prathamaṃ tadanantaram || 9.18 nāmnā kiṃ puruṣaṃ tasmāt harivarṣam anantaram | uttaratastrayo varṣācalāḥ uttare meruśailasya kramād varṣamahīdharāḥ | nīlaḥ śvetāhvayaḥ śṛṅgī nāmnā varṣatrayaṃ punaḥ || 9.19 trīṇi varṣāṇi ramyaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ varṣam uttarāḥ kuravas tathā | uktāni ṣaṭ ca varṣāṇi pratyekaṃ parimāṇataḥ || 9.20 yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi nava varṣaṃ tu madhyamam | ilāvṛtaṃ samākhyātaṃ tanmadhye merur īritaḥ || 9.21 meroś caturdiśaṃ tatra vistīrṇaṃ yojanāni ṣaṭ | trīṇi caiva sahasrāṇi catvāras tatra parvatāḥ || 9.22 viṣkambharūpairacitā yojanāyutam ucchritāḥ | diśācalānāṃ nāmāni mandaro diśi pūrvasyāṃ yāmyāyāṃ gandhamādanaḥ | pratīcyāṃ vipulo nāmnā kauberīm adhitiṣṭhati ( supārśvaḥ ) || 9.23 caturdikṣu catvāro vṛkṣāḥ diśāsu tāsu catvāro vṛkṣāḥ ketuvadunnatāḥ | kadambabhūruho jambūḥ pippalo viṭapī vaṭaḥ || 9.24 śatāni daśa caikaṃ ca teṣāṃ pratyekamāyatiḥ || 9.25 jambūvṛkṣaprabhāvaḥ jambvā tayā samākhyā syāt dvīpasya kamalāsana | phalāni gajamānāni patitāni śilātale || 9.26 śīryante śatadhā teṣāṃ rasavāhā saridvarā | jāmbūnadīti kathitā tattaṭorvīnivāsinaḥ || 9.27 pītvā rasaṃ jarāmṛtyu valīpalitavarjitāḥ | * jāmbūnadākhyāṃ kalpante sauvarṇā kalpasaṃpadaḥ || 9.28 bhadraketumālelāvṛtavarṣāṇāṃ sthānaviśeṣaḥ bhadrāśvavarṣamākhyātaṃ meroḥ prācyāṃ caturmukha | paścimaṃ ketumālākhyaṃ etayor varṣayoḥ punaḥ || 9.29 ilāvṛtaṃ samākhyātaṃ madhyamaṃ tatpuroditam | caturdikṣu catvāryudyānāni vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ pūrvaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ gandhamādanam || 9.30 vaibhrājaṃ paścimaṃ meror vanaṃ nandanam uttaram || 9.31 catvāri sarāṃsi aruṇodaṃ saraḥ pūrvaṃ mahābhadraṃ tataḥ param || 9.32 śītodakaṃ pratīcīnaṃ udīcīnaṃ tu mānasam | devopabhogayogyāni sarāṃsi kathitāni te || 9.33 meroś caturdikṣu pratyekaṃ pañcapañcakesarācalāḥ śītātaś ca mukundaś ca kurarī mālyavānatha | vaikaṅko nāma pañcaite paurastyāḥ kesarācalāḥ || 9.34 * trikūṭoṅgirasaś cobhau pannagaḥ kūṭalāhvayaḥ | niṣadho dakṣiṇe tasya tāvantaḥ kesarācalāḥ || 9.35 śikhivāso 'tha vaidūryaḥ kapilo gandhamādhanaḥ | jāruthiḥ pañcamo brahman kesarāḥ pañcabhūdharāḥ || 9.36 śaṅkhakūṭaḥ samākhyātaḥ sāmākhyātastatharṣabha | haṃsaḥ samākhyayā nāgaḥ tathā kālājjanaprabhaḥ || 9.37 udīcyāṃ kesarāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ kesarācalāḥ | meruśṛṅgamadhye brahmapurīsanniveśaḥ < saṃniveśaḥ > yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ dvātriṃśanmānasaṃmite || 9.38 vistāro mūrdhni śailasya meror bhāge 'tha madhyame | caturbhir daśabhiś caiva sahasrair nirmitā purī || 9.39 yojanaiḥ saṃmito dhātuḥ karṇikevācalāmbuje | vidikṣu dikṣu cāṣṭāsu parito brahmaṇaḥ purī || 9.40 pūrvādidikṣu lokapālanagaryaḥ indrādilokapālānāṃ puraḥ pūrvādiṣu sthitāḥ | vistārāyāmamānena śatayojanasaṃmitāḥ || 9.41 purī bhavati mādhonī nāmnā caivāmarāvatī | sahasragopuradvāraprākāraparighākulā || 9.42 tejovatī puryāgneyī yāmyāṃ saṃyamanī purī | rakṣovatī rākṣasī pūḥ śuddhavatyatha vāruṇī || 9.43 vāyor gandhavatī khyātā nāmnā saumyā mahodayā | yaśasvinī bhavasyoktā kesarācalabhūmiṣu || 9.44 bhagavanmūrtibhedānāṃ puraḥ santi pariṣkṛtāḥ | caturdikṣu gaṅgāvibhāgaḥ bhitvendumaṇḍalaṃ gaṅgā bhagavatpādajanmabhūḥ || 9.45 divaḥ patantī pratyāśam abhyāśaṃ brahmaṇaḥ puraḥ | caturdikṣu vahantī sā caturdhā bhavati svayam || 9.46 sitā cālakanandā ca sucakṣur bhadrayā saha | catasro nāmabhedāś ca digbhedāś ca caturmukha || 9.47 sītāntarikṣagā pūrvaśailān niṣkramya nimnagā | yāti pūrveṇa varṣeṇa bhadrāśvena ca saṃjñayā || 9.48 praviṣṭā sāgaramukhaṃ dakṣiṇena tathādhvanā | bhārataṃ varṣamanyeti śailāt saptamukhā tatā || 9.49 praviṣṭā 'laka nandā sā nadī trailokyapāvanī | sucakṣuḥ paścimāc chailāt ketumālāt svayaṃ punaḥ || 9.50 atītya varṣamambhodhimeti yoṣidyathā patim | bhadrā girir udīcīnāṃ deśān uttarataḥ kurūn || 9.51 atītya vāridhiṃ yāti nimnagā saritāṃ patim | lokapadmaprakārakalpanam ānīlaniṣadhāyāmau mālyavān gandhamādanaḥ || 9.52 madhye tayor meruśailaḥ karṇikā paṅkaje yathā | bhārataṃ ketumālaṃ ca bhadrāśvaṃ kurusaṃjñakam || 9.53 patrāṇi lokapadmasya maryādā śailato bahiḥ | hemakūṭaś ca niṣadho dakṣiṇottaramāyatau || 9.54 maryādāparvatau jñeyau kailāso gandhamādanaḥ | aśītiyojanāyāmau pūrvāparamahodadhī || 9.55 saṃspṛśantau pāriyātraniṣadhāvadhi bhūbhṛtau | meroḥ paścimabhūbhāge pūrvottaram athāśritau || 9.56 triśṛṅgo jārudhir varṣaparvatau merubhūbhṛtaḥ | uttareṇa sthitau prāpya pūrvāparamahodadhī || 9.57 parvatānām avasthānamānantyān na prapañcyate | śailānām antaradroṇyaḥ sevyante siddhacāraṇaiḥ || 9.58 anyaiś ca puṇyakṛdbhis tā daityadānavakinnaraiḥ | bhaumā hy ete kṛtāḥ svargāḥ durlabhāḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ || 9.59 lokarakṣārthaṃ bhadrāśvādiṣu bhagavato vāsaḥ jñānamūrtir hayagrīvo bhadrāśve vasati svayam | varṣeṣu mūrtayo viṣṇoḥ maryādā parvateṣu ca || 9.60 vasanti lokarakṣāyai nānārūpaviśeṣitāḥ | kiṃ puruṣādīnāṃ bhogabhūmitvopapādanam yāni kiṃ puruṣādīni varṣāṇy eteṣu padmaja || 9.61 nirātaṅkāḥ prajāḥ śaśvanna śoko na bhayaṃ tathā | nodanyā na bubhukṣā ca na dveṣo nāyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ || 9.62 santi teṣāṃ sahasrāṇi varṣāṇi dvau ca viṃśati | āyur na teṣu deśeṣu bhaumamambho na varṣati || 9.63 devo na ca ṛtubhedo 'sti na kālo yugabhedavān | sadā kṛtayugaḥ kālo vartate caturānana || 9.64 dharmaś catuṣpātsakalo dhyānam evārcanaṃ hareḥ | parvatāḥ saritaś cāpi yatra yatra purāṇi ca || 9.65 grāmāś ca santi bahavaḥ svadharmaniratāḥ sadā | brāhmaṇā bhūmipāś cāpi prajāpālanatatparāḥ || 9.66 sve sve karmany abhiratāś cāturvarṇyam avasthitāḥ | cāturāśramyam apy evaṃ yathoktam avatiṣṭhate || 9.67
iti pāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde jambūdvīpādipramāṇavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ
daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ
(bhāratavarṣavarṇanam)
śrībhagavān ādākṣiṇātyādambhodherāśailāc ca himālayāt | deśo 'yaṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ bhūr eṣā karmiṇāṃ nṛṇām || 10.1 yojanāni sahasrāṇi vistāraś caiva kathyate | svargāpavargaphaladaṃ karma kāryaṃ nṛṇām iha || 10.2 sahyo mahendro malayaḥ śuktimānṛkṣanāmavān | vindhyaś ca pāriyātraś ca saptaite kulaparvatāḥ || 10.3 ihaiva kriyamāṇasya karmaṇo narakaṃ phalam | varṣeṣv anyeṣu sarveṣu kevalaṃ bhujyate phalam || 10.4 ihaiva cāturāśramyaṃ cāturvarṇyam avasthitam | kṛtādiyugabhedānāṃ caturṇām iha saṃbhavaḥ || 10.5 dānaṃ yajñaṃ tapo martyāḥ paralokaphalārthinaḥ | iha kurvanti yajñeśaṃ yajante puruṣottamam || 10.6 śreṣṭhaṃ tadbhārataṃ varṣaṃ sarvavarṣeṣu sammatam | phalārthinaḥ kāmayante karmabhūṣu janiṃ budhāḥ || 10.7 sahasrāṇi tathaivāsmin divyāni puruṣaḥ paraḥ | āste dhāmāni nadyaś ca puṇyāḥ santi sahasraśaḥ || 10.8 grāmāḥ puraḥ pattanāni bhavanti ca paraḥśatam | dvīpeṣu ṣaṭsu cānyeṣu santi varṣāṇi sapta vai || 10.9 pratyekaṃ sapta ca brahman bhavanti kulaparvatāḥ | varṇānām āśramāṇāṃ ca bhedās tatra vyavasthitāḥ || 10.10 puṣkaradvīpavarṇanam antime puṣkaradvīpe mānasottaraparvataḥ | madhye valayavadbhāti tasyocchrāyo 'bhidhīyate || 10.11 yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi pañcāśattatsamunnatiḥ | tāvān evāsya vistāro dvīpaṃ tadvibhajann iva || 10.12 sthitaḥ śailavaro brahman dve varṣe parimaṇḍale | śailasyāntarmānasya bahiś ca sadṛśe ubhe || 10.13 tanmūrdhni lokapālānāṃ indrādīnāṃ yathā punaḥ | puraḥ santi punas tāsāṃ nāmāny api yathāpuram || 10.14 devānām api cānyeṣāṃ tatra santi puraḥ pṛthak | asaṅkhyātā brāhmaṇaś ca purī bhavati puṣkare || 10.15 svāduḥ svacchodakaiḥ pūrṇo vāridhiḥ puṣkarād bahiḥ | tena tadveṣṭitaṃ dvīpaṃ yathānyāny arṇavottaraiḥ || 10.16 lokālokācalavarṇanam svādūdakād bahir bhūmiḥ sarvā caiva hiraṇmayī | tapanīyamayo brahman lokālokācalo bahiḥ || 10.17 bhūlokasya samastasya sālavaccaturaśrakam | āvṛtya tiṣṭhatas tasya yojanāyatam unnatiḥ || 10.18 vistāraś ca sa evāsya mūrdhni sarvatra ca svayam | mūrtibhedair aparyantaiḥ paramaḥ puruṣaḥ sthitaḥ | kumudādigaṇāś cātra cakrādīny āyudhāni ca || 10.19 devyau mahīca lakṣmīś ca viṣvaksenaḥ patatrirāṭ | sthānāni mūrtibhedānāṃ viṣṇoḥ parijanasya ca || 10.20 santi bhūyāṃsi ramyāṇi tatra tatra caturmukha | paraṃ pārśvaṃ ravis tasya na dyotayati bhānubhiḥ || 10.21 āvṛtya taṃ tamaḥ śailabhāgaṃ bāhyam avasthitam | lokālokaḥ sa ca punaḥ samantādveṣṭito giriḥ || 10.22 bahir aṇḍakaṭāhena mahatā samanantaram | yojanānām iyaṃ pṛthvī pañcāśatkoṭibhir mitā || 10.23 sahaivāṇḍakaṭāhena sadvīpābdhimahīdharā | anayā dhriyate sarvaṃ jagaddhātrī tataḥ smṛtā || 10.24
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde bhūlokavistārakathanaṃ nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ
ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
uktānuvādapūrvakamatalādivarṇanam śrībhagavān eṣa bhūlokavistāraḥ kathitaḥ kamalāsana | lokān adhastād adhunā sapta vacmi yathātatham | 11.1 atalaṃ prathamo loko dvitīyaṃ vitalāhvayam | tṛtīyaṃ nitalaṃ viddhi jñeyaṃ turyaṃ gabhastimat || 11.2 pañcamaṃ mahadāhvānaṃ sutalaṃ ṣaṣṭham īritam | pātālaṃ saptamaṃ vidyāttecaikaikaṃ samucchritāḥ || 11.3 yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi daśaiteṣv atalādiṣu | vasanti dānavā daityāḥ kāleyāḥ phaṇinas tathā || 11.4 svarge 'pi na bhavanty eva ye bhogās tv atalādiṣu | bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ tathā peyaṃ svādiṣṭhaṃ guṇavattaram || 11.5 prāsādabhūmayo ramyāḥ kānanāni ca nimnagāḥ | nāgakanyāś ca śataśaḥ santi sarvāṅgaśobhanāḥ || 11.6 ratnānāṃ dīptajālena dhvānte dhvaste divāniśam | nārko na candramās tatra janair ākāṃkṣyate kvacit || 11.7 yā prītir vasatāṃ tatra na sā muktātmanām api | yad bhoktum iṣyante vastu dṛśyate tad upasthitam || 11.8 na mṛgyate kvacid vāpi vastu tadbhogatatparaiḥ | svargād aṣṭaguṇaṃ bhogam atalādiṣu saptasu || 11.9 bhuñjate bhoganiratāḥ rakṣodaiteya dānavāḥ | na daridrā na rogārtā na kṛśā na ca duḥkhitāḥ || 11.10 bilāni śataśaḥ santi vipulāni samantataḥ | sahasraphaṇavān viṣṇuḥ kapilo nāma saptame || 11.11 pātālākhye talādīnām āste rakṣaṃś ca kevalam | sarvaiḥ pāripadaiḥ sārthaṃ pure mahati śobhite || 11.12 tāmasīṃ tanum āsthāya viṣṇur eṣām avasthitaḥ | saptānām atalādīnāṃ śeṣākhyo balavattaraḥ || 11.13 phaṇāsahasrasubhago maṇibhir dīpayan diśaḥ | antanta iti ca prājñaiḥ khyāto loke maharṣibhiḥ || 11.14 tasya mūrdhani māleva dhriyate sakalā mahī | kurvan surādidaiteyānabalānātmatejasā || 11.15 kirīṭī sragdharaḥ subhrarmadaghūrṇitalocanaḥ | nīlavāsāḥ sitatanuḥ kailāsa iva bhūdharaḥ || 11.16 lāṅgalaṃ musalaṃ bibhradāyudhaṃ daityadāraṇam | upāsyamāno vāruṇyā śaśvatyannidadhānayā || 11.17 kalpāvasāne vaktremyo yasya saṅkarṣaṇaḥ śivaḥ | niṣkrāmati jagat sarvaṃ saṃhartuṃ biṣapāvakaḥ || 11.18 āste saṃpūjitaḥ sarvaiḥ pātālatalavāsibhiḥ | nāsya varṇayituṃ śaktā guṇā vaktraśatair api || 11.19 yadā madena mūrdhānaṃ kampayann avatiṣṭhate | tadā mahītalaṃ sarvaṃ sādrivāridhikānanam || 11.20 kampate kaḥ kṣametāsya balaṃ vaktum aśeṣataḥ | adhastāc cheṣaphaṇinaḥ kūrmaḥ kālānalasthitiḥ || 11.21 śikhāsahasrajaṭilo duḥsahaḥ kamalāsana | ādhāraśaktir etasyād adhastād vaiṣṇavī tanuḥ || 11.22 anantaram athaitasyāḥ bhavaty aṇḍakaṭāhakaḥ | karmaṇaḥ puṇyarūpasya kathitāḥ phalabhūmayaḥ || 11.23 adhunā pāparūpasya kathyante phalabhūmayaḥ | bhuvo jalasya cādhastān narakākhyā bhuvaḥ smṛtāḥ || 11.24 rauravā prathamaṃ tac ca mahatpūrvam anantaram | taptaputtalikā kumbhī śūlāropaṇam īritam || 11.25 sūcyagraṃ ca kṣuraṃ caiva khaḍgakṛntam anyataḥ | sūkaraṃ tailakumbhaṃ ca mahājvālā ca tāpanam || 11.26 asipatraṃ pūtivahaṃ vyāghrasiṃhavṛkādikam | taptastambhaṃ śunā bhakṣyaṃ śālmalī hemapuṣpitā || 11.27 lālodakaṃ raktasindhuḥ śaktibhiś chedanaṃ tathā | evamādīni cānyāni phalāny āhur vikarmaṇām || 11.28 narakāṇām asaṃkhyānām eṣā dik kathitā mayā | patitās teṣu pāpiṣṭhā jantavo bhuñjate phalam || 11.29 na karmaṇāṃ kṣayo brahman vinā bhogaiḥ pṛthag vidhaiḥ | jñānāgniḥ sarvakarmāṇi bhasmasāt kurute dṛḍham || 11.30 na svargo nāpi narako yogavidyām upeyuṣām ||
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahaupaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde atalādiloka parimāṇaṃ nāma ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
bhuvarādilokasvarūpanirūpaṇam brahmā vistāraḥ kathito bhūmeḥ lokāḥ saptatalādikāḥ | narakāṇi tathoktāni sāṃprataṃ bhagavan mama || 12.1 bhuvaḥprabhṛtilokānāṃ rūpaṃ mānaṃ ca kathyatām | śrībhagavān yāvat pramāṇā pṛthivī vistīrṇā parimaṇḍalā || 12.2 tāvad bhuvaḥsthalaṃ brahman vistīrṇaṃ parimaṇḍalam | bhūsūryayor antaramānādi upariṣṭāt kṣiter vyomni lakṣayojanasaṃkhyayā || 12.3 ravistiṣṭhati tigmaiḥ svairaṃśubhir bhāsayan jagat | ratham āsthāya bhagavān bahuyojanavistṛtam || 12.4 vāmapārśve rathasyaikaṃ cakraṃ divyaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | vahanti saptayaḥ sapta chandāṃsi syandanaṃ mahat || 12.5 sārathiś cāruṇaḥ sarvānaśvānvāhayati svayam | mānasottaraśailasya mūrdhni syandanapaddhatiḥ || 12.6 vibhāgahetur uṣasām ahnām api gatikramāt | yogināṃ paramaḥ panthāḥ smṛtaḥ kleśaparikṣaye || 12.7 mokṣamāṇāḥ pathānena yānti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam | udayāstamayo naiva bhānuḥ sarvatra saṃmukhaḥ || 12.8 darśanādarśane bhānor udayāstamayau matā | yair yatra dṛśyate bhānuḥ sa teṣām udayaḥ smṛtaḥ || 12.9 yāti yatra tiro bhāvaṃ tatrāstamayadhīr nṛṇām | sphītā bhavanti pūrvāhṇe raśmayo 'rkasya santatāḥ || 12.10 hasvī bhavanti paścāt tu yāvat teṣām adarśanam | varjayitvā purīṃ dhātuḥ sarvato merubhūdhare || 12.11 patanti bhānavo bhānoḥ tiryag ūrdhvam adhastathā | sabhāṃ tu brahmaṇo gatvā prasthitaṃ pānti ye punaḥ || 12.12 brahmaṇas tejasā tena nānyatra skhalanaṃ kvacit | bhuvarlokaḥ * bhūsūryayor antarālam bhuvaḥsthalam udāhṛtam | vidyādharāś ca gandharvāḥ siddhāś ca saha dānavaiḥ || 12.13 vamanti muditāḥ sveṣu pureṣv eva pṛthak pṛthak | sūryadhruvayor antarāle itaragrahāṇāṃ sthitiḥ lakṣe divākarasthānāc chaśinaḥ sthānam īritam || 12.14 tasyopariṣṭhāt tiṣṭhanti nakṣatrāṇi yathāyatham | lakṣatrayam atītyordhvaṃ budhasya sthitir ucyate || 12.15 uśanā tu sthito lakṣadvayam uttīrya tiṣṭhati | tadyojanāny atikramya bhaumis tiṣṭhati sarvadā || 12.16 tāvat pramāṇo 'vasthānaṃ guros tasyopari sthitiḥ | śanaiś caras tatpramāṇam atītyordhvaṃ raveḥ sutaḥ || 12.17 lakṣalakṣakramād ūrdhvaṃ nakṣatraṃ munayaḥ pare | paraḥ sahasram ṛṣayaḥ santy uparyūrdhvagāminaḥ || 12.18 tato dhruvaḥ sthitaḥ sthāne durārohe maharṣibhiḥ | dvādaśāraṃ mahācakraṃ nemī dve tasya nābhayaḥ || 12.19 tisraḥsanti vasanty asya māsapānteṣv areṣu te | meṣādayo 'py areṣv evaṃ mīnāntā dvādaśa sthitāḥ || 12.20 māsā dvādaśa caitrādyā vasantapramukhās tathā | ṛtavaḥ ṣaṭsaṅkramāś ca viṣuvadyayanadvayam || 12.21 sitāsitau ca pakṣau dvau yugabhedāś ca vatsarāḥ | truṭyādayaḥ kālabhedāḥ cakradhārās suniṣṭhitāḥ || 12.22 dhruvaḥ sthito nābhimadhye prādakṣiṇyena rāśayaḥ | prasavyena grahāḥ sarve caranti gatir īdṛśī || 12.23 kulālacakramadhyasthamṛtpiṇḍasadṛśo dhruvaḥ | bhramanti paritaḥ sarve dhruvaṃ jyotir gaṇāḥ sadā || 12.24 suvarlokaḥ ādityadhruvayor madhye deśaḥ svargasamāhvayaḥ | vasanti tasmin gīrvāṇā vimāneṣu pṛthak pṛthak ||12.25 asaṃkhyātā nityatṛptāḥ jyotir mayavapurdharāḥ | teṣāṃ gaṅgājalaṃ sevyaṃ puṣpāṇi surabhūruhām || 12.26 dhanaṃ ca cintāmaṇayaḥ striyaś cāpsarasaḥ smṛtāḥ | siddhādayo vasanti sma pureṣu nirupadravāḥ || 12.27 upendramūrtir bhagavān āsīnas tatra sarvadā | rakṣati svarganilayān devādīn svena tejasā || 12.28 bhūr bhuvaḥsvastrayo lokāḥ laksāḥ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ | tataḥ paraṃ maharlokaḥ koṭiyojanam āyataḥ || 12.29 sanandanād yā munayo vasanti daśakoṭayaḥ | janolokādinirūpaṇam tataḥ paraṃ janolokaḥ koṭidvayasamāyataḥ || 12.30 anantaraṃ tapolokaḥ sthitaḥ koṭibhir aṣṭabhiḥ | yojanānāṃ satyalokaḥ punas triguṇam āyataḥ || 12.31 koṭitrayāyataṃ tasmād ūrdhvaṃ dhātuḥ puraṃ sthitam | tadbrahmalokaṃ munayaḥ gṛṇanti kamalāsana || 12.32 lakṣayojanavistāraṃ sālaprāsādagopuram || 12.33 prakṛtimaṇḍalasthaviṣṇulokaḥ uttareṇa brahmalokād viṣṇulokaṃ vidurbudhāḥ | anantaraṃ lokayor uktaṃ lakṣayojanasaṃmitam || 12.34 śivalokaḥ tāvaty evāntarāle 'sya dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi sthitaḥ | śivalokaś caturvaktra tasminn āste śivaḥ svayam || 12.35 ūrdhvakrameṇa bhagavataḥ pañcalokāḥ yojanānāṃ koṭir ūrdhve ullaṅghya purataḥ sthite | sarvātmā bhagavān ūrdhvaṃ tasmāt koṭitrayāyate || 12.36 nivṛtyātmā nivasati bhagavān avyayaḥ svayam | tāvaty eva sthito māne viśvātmā viśvakṛddhariḥ || 12.37 puruṣātmā purastāt tu catuṣkoṭipramāṇake | sthitaḥ koṭir atītyordhvaṃ pañca paścād avasthitaḥ || 12.38 parameṣṭhī sa bhagavān pañcakaṃ viṣṇuviṣṭaram | adhyāste bhagavān nityaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ || 12.39 pañcaśaktimayo viṣṇuḥ koṭiyojanasaṃmite | āste śrībhūmisahito vainateyena sevitaḥ || 12.40 aṇḍabhittiḥ aṇḍabhittir uparyasya syitordhve koṭiyojane | ghanaṃ ca tasyāḥ koṭyā tu saṃmitaṃ kamalāsana || 12.41 śuddhaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ jñeyaṃ aṇḍaṃ tadvismayāvaham | āvaraṇasaptakam etenāṇḍakaṭāhena lokāḥ sarve samāvṛtāḥ || 12.42 uparyuparyamī lokāḥ kapitthaphalavatsthitāḥ | tādṛśottarasaṃkhyena vāriṇā pariveṣṭitam || 12.43 āvṛtyāṇḍaṃ yathā vāristhitaṃ tadvattadagninā | sa vāyunā tadvad eva sa vyomnā ca samāvṛtaḥ || 12.44 sarvaṃ daśottaraṃ vidyāt tadvyoma mahatāvṛtam | mahāṃś ca sa pradhānena pradhānaṃ tamasāvṛtam || 12.45 tadanantaraparyantaṃ na saṃkhyā tatra vidyate | hetubhūtam aśeṣasya tamasaḥ prakṛtiḥ parā || 12.46 aṇḍānām saṃkhyātatvam aṇḍānām īdṛśaṃ brahman sahasrāṇy ayutāni ca | bahunāpi kim uktena saṃkhyā vaktuṃ na śakyate || 12.47 nārāyaṇenāntarbahirvyāptiḥ aṇḍāni tāni sarvāṇi vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ | antaś ca teṣāṃ bhagavān sarvavyāpī paraḥ pumān || 12.48 bahiś ca sākṣivat sarvam īkṣamāṇo 'vatiṣṭhate | catvāro vyūhalokāḥ mahatas tamaso bāhye lokāḥ subahuyojanāḥ || 12.49 catvāraḥ kramaśaḥ santi caturbhiḥ samadhiṣṭhatāḥ | vyūhaiḥ krameṇa vakṣye tānaniruddhaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ || 12.50 pradyumno 'nantaraṃ teṣāṃ saṅkarṣaṇasamāhvayaḥ < saṃkarṣaṇa�> | vāsudevas tataḥ paścād vyūhākhyaḥ kamalāsana || 12.51 vibhavākhyo vāsudevas tadanantaram īritaḥ | anādir vāsudevaś ca tayor lokāv anukramāt || 12.52 tato nārāyaṇasyāpi lokas tannikaṭe sthitaḥ | ekaikasyāntaraṃ koṭir yojanānām udīritā || 12.53 tāvāneva ca vistāraḥ teṣām atimanoharaḥ | vaikuṇṭhalokaḥ tebhyo bahiḥsthito loke yatrāste bhagavān ajaḥ || 12.54 anādir vāsudevākhyaḥ śobhate maṇimaṇḍape | śeṣabhogāsane divye śrībhūbhyāṃ samamāsthitaḥ || 12.55 vyāptyādibhis tayāṣṭābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritaḥ | bālavyajanahastābhiḥ sevyamānābhir antike || 12.56 seneśādyaiḥ pāriṣadaiś cakrādyair āyudhair api | praṇamadbhiḥ sevyamānaḥ sāmīpyādi padasthitaiḥ || 12.57 muktaiś ca pañcakālajñaiḥ siddhaiḥ kiṅkaratāṃ gataiḥ | upāsyamānaḥ satataṃ dvādaśākṣaracintakaiḥ || 12.58 aṣṭāṅgayogasaṃsiddhair bahubhir bhagavanmayaiḥ | pañcarātrārthatatvajñair nityatṛptaiḥ samīpagaiḥ || 12.59 yathārhaṃ bhagavaccheṣakarmaniṣṭhair mahātmabhiḥ | digeṣā kathitā brahman dhanyānāṃ tatra tiṣṭhatām || 12.60 antargatānāṃ lokānāṃ aṇḍeṣu bahir apy atha | vistāraḥ kathyate naiva durgnahatvād bhavādṛśaiḥ || 12.61 parārthanigamanam sāramātraṃ samuddhṛtya sarvataḥ samudāhṛtam | brahmaṇā kṛtajñatāprakāśanam brahmā jñānaṃ bhagavataḥ kiñcid ajñānaṃ yena hanyate || 12.62 naṣṭham ajñānatimiraṃ jñānaṃ taddarśitaṃ mahat | sarve ca saṃśayā naṣṭhāḥ prasādād bhagavan mama || 12.63 yathoktajñānasya saṃpradāyaśuddhiḥ padmaḥ iti guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ bhagavān brahmaṇe dadau | brahmā 'pi tadyathātatvaṃ kapilāyāvatārayat || 12.64 kapilo 'pi maharṣis tat jñānaṃ mama yathātatham | dadau tubhyaṃ tadity evaṃ pāramparyakramāgatam || 12. 65 siddhāntajñānam utkṛṣṭaṃ tvayy anugrahakāmyayā | bhagavanmayam ākhyātaṃ rahasyataram adbhutam || 12.66 bhagavajjñānasya apātre anākhyeyatvam naitad guhyataraṃ jñānam ākhyeyam atimānine | nābhaktāya na hīnāya na cāśuśrūṣave punaḥ || 12.67 nādīkṣitāya dātavyaṃ na kṛtaghnāya pāpine | na nāstikāya cākhyeyaṃ na ca pāṣaṇḍine tathā || 12.68 na hīnavarṇine naiva piśunāya durātmane | naiva cānupanītāya na bāhyāgamasaṅgine || 12.69 na cābhyasūyave cāpi tyaktācārāya karhicit | yogyapātranirūpaṇam vaktavyaṃ ca vinītāya śuddhāya brahmacāriṇe || 12.70 śuśrūṣave prasannāya vratine vaśine tathā | āśramasthāya saṃsāravimukhāya mumukṣave || 12.71 jijñāsamānāya tathā pāñcarātroditāṃ kriyām | suśīlāya kṛtajñāya ṛjave ṛjubuddhaye || 12.72 chandāṃsyadhītine sāṅgaṃ kulīnāya tapasvine | traivarṇikāya saṃvartam aharṣe saṃhitāmimām || 12.73 nādhyāpayen nopadiśen na vidyāmaraye vadet | uktānuvādapūrvaṃ saṃhitādhyayanaphalanirūpaṇam kaṇvaḥ he śiṣyāḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yat saṃvartamukhāc chrutam || 12.74 vijñānaṃ tadaśeṣeṇa bhavadbhyaḥ kathitaṃ mayā | yogaṃ cāpy upadekṣyāmi śuśrūṣā yadi tatra vaḥ || 12.75 yaḥ saṃhitām imāṃ pādmīṃ adhīte niyamasthitaḥ | sa brahmalokam abhyeti neha bhūyo 'pi jāyate || 12.76 ślokam ekaṃ tadardhaṃ vā pādam ekaṃ suyantritaḥ | pratyahaṃ paṭhamānasya phalam iṣṭaṃ kare sthitam || 12.77 jñānāṃśo dvādaśādhyāyaḥ tantre pādme samīritaḥ | saṃkṣipya sāram uddhṛtya vistīrṇāt tantrasāgarāt || 12.78 śuśrūṣavo 'pi śiṣyāḥ prasannenāntarātmanā ||
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ jñānapāde bhuvarlokādivistārakathanaṃ nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
jñānapādaḥ samāptaḥ
śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ yogapādaḥ
prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā bhagavan yogayuktasya niḥśreyasam udīritam / puruṣasya dayāsindho jñāninaḥ puruṣottama // 1.1 sa yogaḥ kathyatāṃ bhūyaḥ śrotavyaṃ yadi madvidhaiḥ / yadi vānugraho 'smāsu bhajamāneṣu vidyate // 1.2 yogadvaividhyam śrībhagavān avyākulasya cittasya bandhanaṃ viṣaye kvacit / yat saṃyogaś caturvaktra sa ca dvaividhyam aśnute // 1.3 vibhaktayoḥ prayekaṃ lakṣaṇam karma kartavyam ity evaṃ vihiteṣv eva karmasu / bandhanaṃ manaso nityaṃ karmayogaḥ sa ucyate // 1.4 yat tu cittasya satataṃ arthe śreyasi bandhanam / jñānayogaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvasiddhikaraḥ śubhaḥ // 1.5 samuccitayos tayor mokṣasādhanatvam yasyoktalakṣaṇe yoge dvividhe 'vasthitaṃ manaḥ / sa yāti paramaṃ śreyo mokṣalakṣaṇam añjasā // 1.6 yogāṅganirūpaṇam yamādiraṅgaṃ pūrvasya vairāgyādi parasya tu / aṣṭau yamādayo yogāḥ yamo 'hiṃsādilakṣaṇaḥ // 1.7 ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ dayārjavam / kṣamā dhṛtir mitāhāro śaucaṃ ceti yamā daśa // 1.8 tapaḥprabhṛtirūpas tu niyamaḥ kathyate punaḥ / tapas sa tuṣṭir āstikyaṃ dānam ārādhanaṃ hareḥ // 1.9 siddhāntaśravaṇaṃ hrīś ca japa ityādilakṣaṇaḥ / āsanādīni sarvāṇi khastikādīni saṃprati // 1.10 varṇyante svastikaṃ pādatalayor ubhayor api / pūrvottare jānunī dve kṛtvāsanam udīritam // 1.11 sīvanyā dakṣiṇe pārśve savyaṃ savye tu dakṣiṇam / gulphaṃ kṛtvāsanaṃ tac ca svastikaṃ kathyate budhaiḥ // 1.12 āropya corvoścaraṇau tadaṅguṣṭhadvayaṃ punaḥ / vyutkrameṇaiva hastābhyāṃ gṛhṇīyāt tattadāsanam // 1.13 baddhapadmāsanaṃ jñeyamāsaneṣu supūjitam / ekaṃ caraṇam anyasminn ūrāv āropya niścalaḥ // 1.14 āste yadidamenoghnaṃ vīrāsanam udāhṛtam / sīvanīṃ gulphadeśābhyāṃ nipīḍya vyutkrameṇa tu // 1.15 prasārya jānunor hastāv āsanaṃ siṃhapūrvakam / gulphau ca vṛṣaṇasyādhaḥ sīvanyubhayapārśvayoḥ // 1.16 niveśya pādau hastābhyāṃ dṛḍhaṃ badhvā yadāsanam / bhadrāsanaṃ tadvijñeyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam // 1.17 gulphaṃ savyetaraṃ savye pṛṣṭhapārśve nidhāya ca / gulphaṃ tathetaraṃ pṛṣṭhapārśve 'nyasmin nidhāya ca // 1.18 āsanaṃ gomukhaṃ yadvat gomukhāsanam iṣyate / sīvanīpārśvam ubhayaṃ gulphābhyāṃ vyutkrameṇa tu // 1.19 nipīḍyāsanam etac ca muktāsanam udāhṛtam / meḍhrasyopari nikṣipya savyaṃ gulphaṃ tathetaram // 1.20 niveśyopari gulphasya yadvā muktāsanaṃ bhavet / avaṣṭabhya dharāṃ samyak talābhyāṃ hastayor dvayoḥ // 1.21 kūrparau nābhipārśve ca sthāpayitvā mayūravat / samunnamya śiraḥpādau mayūrāsanam iṣyate // 1.22
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopanisadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ yogapāde āsanabhedalakṣaṇaṃ nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ
dvitīiyo 'dhyāyaḥ
nāḍīśuddhiḥ śrībhagavān yamaiś ca niyamaiś caiva yogāṅgair āsanair api / susaṃyato nāḍiśuddhau prāṇāyāmo vidhīyate // 2.1 dehamānaṃ svāṅgulībhiḥ ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulāyatam / prāṇaḥ śarīrād adhiko dvādaśāṅgulamānataḥ // 2.2 dehastham anilaṃ dehasamudbhūtena vahninā / nyūnaṃ samaṃ va yogena kurvan brahmavid iṣyate // 2.3 dehamadhye śikhisthānaṃ taptajāmbūnadaprabham / trikoṇaṃ dvipadām anyac caturaśraṃ catuṣpadām // 2.4 vṛttaṃ vihaṅgamānāṃ tu ṣaḍaśraṃ jalajanmanām / aṣṭāśraṃ svedajānāṃ tu tasmin dīpavad ujjvalaḥ // 2.5 vaiśvānaro 'gniḥ pacati prāṇāpānasamāyutaḥ / catuṣprakāram aśanaṃ dehamadhye 'bhidhīyate // 2.6 apānāt dvyaṅgulād ūrdhvaṃ adho meḍhrasya vāmataḥ / dehamadhyaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ meḍhramadhyaṃ catuṣpadām // 2.7 * itareṣāṃ tundamadhyaṃ sarveṣām eva padmaja / kandasthānaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ dehamadhye navāṅgulam // 2.8 caturaṅgulam utsedhaṃ caturaṅgulam āyatam / aṇḍākṛtistiraścāṃ ca dvipadāṃ ca catuṣpadām // 2.9 tundamadhyaṃ tadiṣṭaṃ vai tanmadhyaṃ nābhir iṣyate / tatra cakraṃ dvādaśāraṃ āhur māsānarāṇi tu // 2.10 viṣṇvādimūrtayas teṣu dvādaśa dvādaśasv api / ahaṃ tatra sthitaṃ cakraṃ bhrāmayāmi svamāyayā // 2.11 areṣu bhramate jīvaḥ krameṇa kamalāsana / tantuḥ pañjaramadhyasthā yathā bhramati lūtikā // 2.12 prāṇārūḍhaś carati yaḥ jīvas tena vinā na hi / tasyordhve kuṇḍalīsthānaṃ nābhes tiryag athordhvataḥ // 2.13 aṣṭaprakṛtirūpā sā cāṣṭadhā kuṇḍalīkṛtā / yathāvad vāyucāraṃ ca jvalanādi ca nityaśaḥ // 2.14 paritaḥ kandapārśve tu nirudhyaiva sadā sthitaḥ / mukhenaiva samāvekṣya brahmarandhramukhaṃ tathā // 2.15 yogakāle ca marutā sāgninā coditā satī / sphuritā hṛdayākāśe nāgarūpā mahojvalā // 2.16 vāyur vāyumukhenaiva tato yāti suṣumnayā / kandamadhye sthitā nāḍī suṣamnā supratiṣṭhitā // 2.17 padmasūtrapratīkāśā ṛjur ūrdhvapravartinī / brahmaṇo vivaraṃ yāvat vidyudābhā sanālikā // 2.18 vaiṣṇavī brahmanāḍīṃ ca nirvāṇaprāptipaddhatiḥ / iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva tasyāḥ savyetare sthite // 2.19 iḍā samutthitā kandād vāmanāsāpuṭāvadhi / piṅgalā cotthitā tasmād anyanāsāpuṭāvadhi // 2.20 gāndhārī hastijihvā ca dve cānye nāḍike sthite / purataḥ pṛṣṭhatas tasyā vāmetaradṛśau prati // 2.21 pūṣā yaśasvinī nāḍyau tasmād eva samutthite / savyetaraśrutyavadhi pāyumūlātvalambusā // 2.22 adhomukhā kuhūnāḍī meḍhrāntāvadhirāyatā / pādāṅguṣṭhāvadhiḥ kandād yathāyātā ca keśinī // 2.23 daśapradhānabhūtās tāḥ kathitāḥ kandasambhavāḥ / tanmūlā bahavo nāḍyaḥ sthūlāḥ sūkṣmās tu nāḍikāḥ // 2.24 dvisaptati sahasrāṇi sthūlāḥ sūkṣmās tu padmaja / saṃkhyātuṃ naiva śakyante sthūlamūlāḥ pṛthag vidhāḥ // 2.25 yathāśvatthadale sūkṣmāḥ sthūlāś ca vitatās tathā / prāṇo 'pānaḥ samānaś ca udāno vyāna eva ca // 2.26 nāgaḥ kūrmaś ca kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥ / caranti daśa nāḍīṣu daśapraṇādivāyavaḥ // 2.27 prāṇādipañcakaṃ teṣu pradhānaṃ tatra ca dvayam / prāṇa evāthavā śreṣṭho jīvātmānaṃ bibharti yaḥ // 2.28 āsyanāsikayor madhyaṃ hṛdayaṃ nābhimaṇḍalam / pādāṅguṣṭham iti prāṇasthānāni kamalāsana // 2.29 apānaś carati brahman gudameḍhrorujānuṣu / samānaḥ sarvagātreṣu sarvavyāpī vyavasthitaḥ // 2.30 udānaḥ sarvasandhisthaḥ pādayor hastayor api / vyānah śrotror ukaṭyāṃ ca gulphaskandhagaleṣu ca // 2.31 nāgādivāyavaḥ pañca tvagasthyādiṣu saṃsthitāḥ / tundasthaṃ jalam annaṃ ca rasanāgnisamīkṛtā // 2.32 tundamadhyagataḥ prāṇas tāni kuryāt pṛthak pṛthak / ityādi ceṣṭayā prāṇaḥ karoti vapuṣi sthitim // 2.33 apānavāyur mūtrādeḥ karoti ca visarjanam / prāṇāpānādi ceṣṭādi kriyate vyānavāyunā // 2.34 ujjīryate śarīrastham udānena nabhasvatā / poṣaṇādi śarīrasya samānaḥ kurute sadā // 2.35 udgārādikriyā nāgaḥ kūrmo 'kṣyādinimīlanam / kṛkaras tu kṣutaḥ kartā datto nidrādikarmakṛt // 2.36 mṛtagātrasya śobhādi dhanañjaya udāhṛtaḥ / nāḍībhedaṃ marudbhedaṃ marutāṃ sthānam eva ca // 2.37 ceṣṭāś ca vividhās teṣāṃ jñātvaivaṃ kamalāsana / śuddhau yateta nāḍīnāṃ vakṣyamāṇena vartmanā // 2.38
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ yogapāde nāḍīsvarūpakathanaṃ nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
prāṇāyāmavidhiḥ śrībhagavān traivarṇikaḥ svavarṇoktair āśramānuguṇais tathā / ācārair ācaran yuktair vāsudevārcane rataḥ // 3.1 viviktaṃ deśam āsādya sarvasaṃbādhavarjitam / yogāṅgadravyasaṃpūrṇaṃ tatra dārumaye śubhe // 3.2 āsane kalpite darbhavāsaḥ kṛṣṇājinādibhiḥ / tālamātrasamutsedhe tāladvayasamāyute // 3.3 upaviśyāsane vaśye svastikādi yathāruci / badhvā prāgāsanaḥ samyak ṛjukāyaḥ samāhitaḥ // 3.4 nāsāgranyastanayano dantair dantānasaṃspṛśan / rasanāṃ tāluni nyasya ślathabāhudvayānvitaḥ // 3.5 ākuñcitaśirāḥ kiñcit nibadhnan yogamudrayā / hastau yathoktavidhinā prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret // 3.6 prāṇāyāmalakṣaṇam recanaṃ pūraṇaṃ vāyoḥ rodhanaṃ recanaṃ tathā / caturbhiḥ kleśanaṃ vāyoḥ prāṇāyāma udīritaḥ // 3.7 hastena dakṣiṇenaiva pīḍayen nāsikāpuṭam / * iḍayā pūrayed antarvāyum ātmani kumbhayet // 3.8 śanaiḥ śanair atha bahiḥ kṣipet piṅgalayānilam / dvātriṃśan mātrayā kukṣau pūrayed iḍayānilam // 3.9 bhūyaḥ ṣoḍaśamātrābhiḥ catuḥṣaṣṭyā tu mātrayā / saṃpūrṇakumbhavaddehaṃ pūrayen mātariśvanā // 3.10 pūraṇān nāḍayaḥ sarvāḥ pūryante mātariśvanā / prāṇāyāmaphalam evaṃ kṛte sati brahman caranti daśa vāyavaḥ / hṛdayāmbhoruhaṃ cāpi vyākocaṃ bhavati sphuṭam // 3.11 pūraṇena tathā kumbhīkaraṇād unmukhaṃ sthitam / galakūpavirūḍhaṃ tu tadadhomukham ambujam // 3.12 nālaṃ tālanibhaṃ tasya dalāṣṭakasamanvitam / kadalīpuṣpasaṅkāśaṃ <�saṃkāśaṃ> candrakāntasamaprabham // 3.13 sandhyayor madhyarātre ca prāṇāyāmāṃs tu ṣoḍaśa / ekāhamātraṃ kurvāṇaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate // 3.14 kim anyair bahubhiḥ proktaiḥ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇāḥ / nirdhūtasarvapāpmāno vatsaratrayapūraṇe / 3.15 paśyanti mām api brahman hṛdayāmbhoruhe sthitam / saṃvatsaratrayād ūrdhvaṃ prāṇāyāmaparo naraḥ // 3.16 yogasiddho bhaved yogī vāyujidvijitendriyaḥ / alpāśī khalpanidraś ca tejasvī balavān bhavet // 3.17 apamṛtyum atikramya dīrgham āyur avāpnuyāt / prasvedajananaṃ yasya prāṇāyāmeṣu so 'dhamaḥ // 3.18 kampanaṃ vapuṣo yasya prāṇāyāmeṣu madhyamaḥ / utthānaṃ vapuṣo yasya sa uttama udāhṛtaḥ // 3.19 adhame vyādhipāpānāṃ nāśaḥ syān madhyame punaḥ / pāparogamahāvyādhināśaḥ syād uttame punaḥ // 3.20 alpamūtro 'lpaviṣṭhaś ca laghudeho mitāśanaḥ / vaśyendriyaḥ paṭumatiḥ kālatrayavidātmavān // 3.21 recakaṃ pūrakaṃ muktvā kumbhīkaraṇam eva yaḥ / karoti triṣu lokeṣu naiva tasyāsti durlabham // 3.22 nābhikande ca nāsāgre pādāṅguṣṭhe ca yatnavān / dhārayan manasā prāṇān sandhyākāleṣu sarvadā // 3.23 sarvaroga vinirmukto bhaved yogī gataklamaḥ / kukṣirogavināśaḥ syāt nābhikandeṣu dhāraṇāt // 3.24 nāsāgre dhāraṇād dīrgham āyur vai dehalādhavam / pādāṅguṣṭhe bhaved dhṛtyā vāyoḥ kamalasaṃbhava // 3.25 vāyum ākṛṣya jihvāgre pibannaśramadāhabhāk / brāhme muhūrte saṃprāpte vāyum ākṛṣya jihvayā // 3.26 pibatastriṣu māseṣu vāksiddhir mahatī bhavet / abhyasyataś ca ṣaṇmāsān mahārogavināśanam // 3.27 yatra yatra dhṛto vāyur aṅge rogādidūṣite / dhāraṇād eva marutaḥ tattadārogyam aśnute // 3.28 manaso dhāraṇād eva śvasano dhārito bhavet / manasaḥ sthairyanirūpaṇam manasaḥ sthāpanāhetur ucyate kamalāsana // 3.29 karaṇāni samāhṛtya viṣayebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ / apānam ūrdhvam ākṛṣya vaster upari dhārayet // 3.30 badhnan karābhyāṃ śrotrādi karaṇāni yathātatham / yuñjānasya yathoktena vartmanā svavaśaṃ manaḥ // 3.31 vāyujayaḥ manaḥ spṛṣṭaḥ sa vai vāyuḥ svavaśe sthāpyate sadā / nāsikāpuṭayoḥ prāṇaḥ paryāyeṇa pravartate // 3.32 tisraś ca nāḍikāḥ prāṇastāvatyaś ca caraty ayam / śaṅkhinī vivare yāmye prāṇaḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ sa tām // 3.33 tāvantaś ca punaḥ kālaṃ saumye carati santatam / itthaṃ krameṇa caratā vāyunā vāyujinnaraḥ // 3.34 ahaś ca
