cordhvapaṭṭikā // 8.80 maṇḍūkair dhārikābhāsādāsane parikalpya ca / koṣṭhair dvādaśabhir yuktaṃ sauṣṭikābhir athāṣṭakaiḥ // 8.81 vyaktaiḥ pañjaraśālābhir dvārāgraśikharair galam / aṣṭordhvaṃ pañjaraṃ viṃśacchatais tu vimaledaham // 8.82 suvṛttaṃ śikharagrīvaṃ kapotenāṣṭanāsikam / ardhādhike catuṣkoṇe maṅgalākārakuṭṭimam // 8.83 etad dhi vimalaṃ dhāma tridheyaṃ vimalākṛtiḥ / śrīdharam viṃśattrayodaśāṃśaṃ vā aṣṭāṃśaṃ dvādaśāṃśake // 8.84 dvātriṃśat triṃśatir vāpi garbhaṃ syāc caturāyatam / ardhādhikādhikaṃ dvyaṅgaṃ karkarīkṛtanāsikam // 8.85 tathā vinyastasarbāṅgaṃ śālākṛti śironvitam / śikharāṣṭaṃ mahānāsi śālāpañjarasaṃyutam // 8.86 etac chrīdharam ity uktaṃ śriyaṃ dadati dehinām / candrakāntam evadvṛttāyatākāraṃ karkarīkṛtanāsikam // 8.87 śeṣaṃ pūrvoktavat sarvaṃ candrakāntam idaṃ smṛtam / śrīpratiṣṭhatam mukhe mukhe sabhāvaktraṃ śirasas tad dvinetravat // 8.88 saumukhyaṃ karkarībhūtaṃ vṛttagarbhagṛhānvitam / vṛttāyatavimāneṣu mukhe mahati nāsikā // 8.89 nāsikāpṛṣṭhataś cāpi stūpītrayasamanvitam / caturaśratalacchandaṃ vṛttagarbhagṛhānvitam // 8.90 suvṛttaṃ śikharākāraṃ nāsībhiḥ pañcabhir yutam / navāṃśaṃ vā 'ṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ śrīpratiṣṭhitam ucyate // 8.91 śuddhasvastikam mahānāsyāṃ catasraḥ syuḥ śālāpañjarasaṃyutam / tac catuś cārdhasaṃyuktaṃ vṛttam ūrdhvaśirodharam // 8.91 sañcitaṃ sañcitāṅgaṃ ca sopānānāṃ catuṣṭayaiḥ / kapota mūlayā yuktaṃ dvāreṇaiva patākayā // 8.93 antaḥ prastarasaṃyuktam unnatāṅgasamanvitam / prāsādamadhya karṇasthaiḥ nīlīkṛtaviśālakaiḥ // 8.94 śālāpañjarakūṭaiś ca yuktaṃ prāsādamastakam / adhiṣṭānādibhir vargair ūhapratyūhamaṇḍanaiḥ // 8.9 nandyāvartākṛtiṃ prāptaiḥ sopānānāṃ catuṣṭayaiḥ / yuktaṃ bahutalopetaṃ śuddhasvastikam ucyate // 9.96
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde prāsādabhedo nāma aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ
navamo 'dhyāyaḥ
prāsādavidhiḥ vesaram śrībhagavān nāgaraṃ drāmiḍaṃ caiva vesaraṃ ceti tat tridhā / nāgaram āstūpīkarṇam ārabhya caturaśraṃ prakalpitam // 9.1 dhāmāyatāśram athavā nāgaraṃ tad uāhṛtam / drāmiḍam vasvaśramāyataṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ ṣaḍaśram athavāyatam // 9.2 uktaṃ tad drāmiḍāhvānaṃ vṛttaṃ vṛttāyataṃ punaḥ / vesaram vesarākhyaṃ tadākhyātam evaṃ trividham iṣyate // 9.3 mūrdheṣṭakāvidhiḥ mūrdheṣṭakāvidhiṃ brahman śṛṇu vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam / bhavanasya puraḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvavat kārayet prapām // 9.4 tanmadhye vedikāṃ kuryāt sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutām / yanmayyo yādṛśāḥ pūrvaṃ kalpitāḥ prathameṣṭakāḥ // 9.5 mūrdheṣṭhakāś ca tanmayyaś catasras tādṛśāḥ smṛtāḥ / snapanārthaṃ kalaśapratiṣṭhā snāpayet pūrvavat tāś ca dhānyarāśiṣu nikṣipet // 9.6 dvārakumbhān dhvajān samyak toraṇāni samarcayet / saṃsthāpayen mahākumbhaṃ tasminn āvāhya pūjayet // 9.7 vedikāyāś caturdikṣu homaḥ pūrvavad iṣyate / dikṣv aṣṭāsu tathā dhāmnaḥ śāntihomaṃ prakalpayet // 9.8 pūrvavac ceṣṭakāḥ sūtraiḥ veṣṭayet prayato 'bjaja / dhānyarāśiṣu saṃsthāpya kalaśān pañcaviṃśatiḥ // 9.9 maṇihemādisaṃyuktān sūtravastrādiveṣṭitān / arcayet gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ ācāryaḥ śāstracakṣuṣā // 9.10 ācāryaniyamāḥ upoṣitaḥ śuciḥ snāto navavastrāṅgulīyakaḥ / tatraiva darbhānāstīrya śayīta vijitendriyaḥ // 9.11 mūrdheṣṭakānāmādhātā tathaiva guruṇā saha / yajamānena śuddhātmā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ // 9.12 vaset tatraiva darbheṣu dhyāyan paramapūruṣam / evaṃ rātrau prākurvīta yathoktaṃ sarvam akṣatam // 9.13 iṣṭakāsnāpanādhāne śvobhūte vimale śuddhe muhūrte gurur ātmavān / uddhṛtya kalaśān sarvān snāpayen mūlavidyayā // 9.14 mahākumbhasthatoyena bhūyas tān snāpayet guruḥ / abhyarcya mūlamantreṇa veṣṭayen navavāsasā // 9.15 ādāya ceṣṭakāḥ sarvā ṛtvijaḥ samalaṅkṛtāḥ / dhāma pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tūryaghoṣasamanvitam // 9.16 āropayeyus tān sarvān vimānasyopari sthale / puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra ṛtvigbhiḥ sahito guruḥ // 9.17 mūrdheṣṭakānāmādhātā prāṅmukhaḥ susamāhitaḥ / dhyāyan nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ hṛtpadme praṇavaṃ japet // 9.18 ādadhyādiṣṭakāḥ sarvāḥ pūrvādikramamāśritaḥ / strīśūdrādīnām amantrakam ādhānam strīśūdrāḥ sānulomāś ca tūṣṇīm ādhānam ācaret // 9.19 iṣṭakāvidhau varjyā janāḥ pāparogayutān brahman patitān pratilomajān / varjayed yatnam āsthāya martyān mūrdheṣṭakāvidhau // 9.20 guroḥ satkāraḥ praṇamya śirasā bhūmau yajamāno guruṃ punaḥ / vastraiś ca dhanadhānyaiś ca gobhūmikanakais tathā // 9.21 pañcāṅgabhūṣaṇaṃ dadyāt dāsīdāsāṃs tathaiva ca / vāhanaṃ hastituragaṃ chatropānaham eva ca // 9.22 tasmai ca guruve sarvaṃ prayacched aviśaṅkitaḥ / rathakāratoṣaṇam toṣayed rathakārāṃś ca vastrānnadhanadhānyakaiḥ // 9.23 stūpikākīlavidhiḥ stūpikā kīlam adhunā vakṣyāmi kamalāsana / lohajaṃ dārujaṃ vāpi stūpikākīlam iṣyate // 9.24 ūrdhvabhūmyaṅghritulitaṃ vistārāyāmasaṃmitam / stūpikā kīlam etat syād agram aṅgulasaṃyutam // 9.25 vimānakaṇṭhatulitam adhyardhaṃ dviguṇaṃ tu vā / kīlasyākārabhedāḥ evaṃ caturvidhaṃ proktaṃ stūpikākīlam uttamam // 9.26 udvṛttaṃ caturaśraṃ vā pañcāśraṃ vā prakalpayet / vimānabhedena kīlakasaṃkhyā vṛttāyate vimāne tu caturaśrāyate 'pi ca // 9.27 yugmaṃ syāt stūpikākīlam apunarbhavakāṃkṣiṇām / itareṣām ayugmaṃ syāt stūpikākīlakalpanam // 9.28 yāvad viṃśati yugmaṃ syāt ayugmaikonaviṃśatiḥ / caturaśre ṣaḍaśre ca aṣṭāśre samavṛttake // 9.29 stūpikākīlam evaṃ syāt sarvakāmasamṛddhidam / kīlādhivāse viśeṣaḥ kṛṭvaivaṃ stūpikākīlaṃ adhivāsaṃ prakalpayet // 9.30 snāpanādikriyāḥ sarvā yāvad āropaṇakriyā / mūrdheṣṭakāvat kartavyā viśeṣas tu vidhīyate // 9.31 āropite tataḥ kīle vimānāgre sthitaḥ sudhīḥ / puṇyāhaṃ vācayed garte navaratnaṃ vinikṣipet // 9.32 pūrvādimadhyamāntaṃ syāt dhātubījaṃ salohakam / kṣiptvā garte tataḥ stūpīṃ prāṅmukho mūlavidyayā // 9.33 ācāryālaṅkāraḥ <ācāryālaṃkāraḥ> ācāryaḥ sthāpayet stūpīṃ pañcāṅgākalpabhūṣitaḥ / hāropavītakaṭakaiḥ keyūrair aṅgulīyakaiḥ // 9.34 pañcāṅgabhūṣaṇair etair bhūṣitaḥ sottarīyakaḥ / sudhayā stūpikāgartaṃ dṛḍhī kuryād anantaram // 9.35 stūpyāḥ vakrabhāve doṣaḥ sthāpanīyā ṛjustūpī vakrā ced bahudoṣadā / stūpyāḥ lohabhedena phalam sauvarṇī rājatī tāmrā stūpī dārumayī tathā // 9.36 pūrvapūrvā bahuphalā paścimā paścimālpadā / gurave dakṣiṇā deyā hemasaṃkhyā ca pūrvavat // 9.37 śikhākumbhaṃ suvarṇaṃ vā rājataṃ tāmram eva vā / paittalaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi sthāpayet tatkṣaṇe śubhe // 9.38 dhāmānuguṇyena stūpyākāraḥ vṛtte dhāmani vṛttaṃ syāt aśrayukte 'śrayuk ca tat / nānāratnaiś ca lohaiś ca śikhākumbhaṃ ca pūrayet // 9.39 ghaṭāgraṃ mukulākāraṃ dīpākāram athāpi vā / kuryān manoharaṃ hṛdyam adhastāt tasya paṅkajam // 9.40 śūlabhedaḥ mahānāsyottamāṅgeṣu cakraṃ vā śūlam eva vā / sthāpayel lohajaṃ vāpi dārujaṃ vā tathā bhavet // 9.41 vimānatale kalpanīyānāṃ devatānāṃ vikalpaḥ tale tale vimānānāṃ dikṣu devān prakalpayet / indram aindryāṃ kumāraṃ vā dakṣiṇasyām umāpatim // 9.42 dakṣiṇāmūrtim athavā pratīcyāṃ nṛhariṃ harim / śrīdharaṃ vā tathodīcyāṃ brahmāṇaṃ vā dhanādhipam // 9.43 athavā ''divarāhaḥ syāt prācyāṃ naraharis tathā / tato nu śrīdharo devaḥ tato hayaśirāḥ smṛtaḥ // 9.44 prācyādiṣv athavā dikṣu naro nārāyaṇo hariḥ / kṛṣṇaś catvāra ete syuḥ athavā puruṣaḥ paraḥ // 9.45 satyo dakṣiṇataḥ paścād acyuto 'nanta uttare / vāsudevādayo vā syur dikṣu pūrvādiṣu kramāt // 9.46 śrīdharaṃ pūrvadigbhāge varāhaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā / nṛsiṃhaṃ paścime bhāge anantaṃ cottare tathā // 9.47 vimānadevatānāṃ dhruvaberasamasaṃsthānatā dhruvabere sthite dikṣu mūrtayo 'pi sthitās tathā / āsīne tadvad āsīnāḥ śayāne tūbhayaṃ bhavet // 9.48 yānārūḍhe pradhāne tu yānārūḍhāḥ sthitāś ca te / viśvarūpe tu tadvat syāt sthitā vā syuś caturbhujāḥ // 9.49 indrādayaś ca digdevāḥ āsīnā eva te sadā / śailādivimāne tadupādānā eva devatāḥ vimāne śailaje dikṣu śailajā eva devatāḥ // 9.50 toyādhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍape cādhivāsya ca / muhūrte sthāpayed dikṣu varṇālepaṃ samācaret // 9.51 śūlāni sthāpayed dikṣu vimāne tv iṣṭakāmaye / toyādhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā adhivāsya nyaset kramāt // 9.52 varṇālepavidhiḥ trivastu kamayaṃ kṛtvā varṇālepaṃ samācaret / yo varṇo yasya śāstroktaḥ tenaivālepanaṃ bhavet // 9.53 vyatyāse brāhmaṇādīnāṃ varṇānāṃ saṅkaro bhavet / bhittibhāge devatānāṃ ardhacitrādivikalpaḥ sarve ca bhittibhāgasthāḥ padmaviṣṭaram āsthitāḥ // 9.54 ardhacitrāḥ kṛtāḥ sarve citrābhāsena vā bhavet / ekanāsāsamāyukte ekā diṅmūrtir iṣyate // 9.55 caturbhujo vā dvibhujaḥ saumyavaktrah smitānanaḥ / nāsikāhīnavimāne diṅmūrtiniṣedhaḥ vimāne nāsikāhīne diṅmūrtir api neṣyate // 9.56 vimānabhedena diṅmūrtibhedaḥ caturaśrāyate vṛtte dhāmni vṛttāyate 'pi ca / vīrasenaḥ suṣeṇaś ca vīranāthaḥ subhadrakaḥ // 9.57 āgneyādividikṣv ete bāhubhiḥ sadmadhāriṇaḥ / viṣṇupāriṣadāḥ sthāpyāḥ karālavadanānvitāḥ // 9.58 caturaśrāyate dhāmni nāsikādvayasaṃyute / dakṣiṇottaratas tasya puruṣau pūrṇapuṣkarau // 9.59 śaṅkhavakradharau sthāpyau hastau yavanikāspṛśau / tale tale vimānasya surā vidyādharāḥ smṛtāḥ // 9.60 nṛtyanto bahudhā veṇuvīṇāpaṇavadhāriṇaḥ / kalpanīyās tathānye ca kinnaroragajātayaḥ // 9.61 mamāvatārāḥ sarvatra kalpyās tac ceṣṭitāni ca / kapoteṣu haṃsamālādikalpanam kapoteṣu kapoteṣu taleṣu ca taleṣu ca // 9.62 haṃsamālāṃ prakalpeta bhūtamālāṃ tathaiva ca / anyonyamukhamālokya sthitā gaganayāyinaḥ // 9.63 bhūtāni nānā nṛtyanti vikṛtānanabhāñji ca / prater upari kaṇṭhasyāpy adhastāt koṇabhūmiṣu // 9.64 garuḍān kalpayet siṃhān saṃviṣṭān athavā sthitān / uktānām ucchrāyamānam tadunnataṃ kaṇṭhamātraṃ pādamātram athāpi vā // 9.65 adhyardhaṃ vā tripādaṃ vā nānyathocchrāyam iṣyate / adhiṣṭhānādhasthāḥ devatāḥ adhastāt tadadhiṣṭhāne kalpayed devatāḥ kramāt // 9.66 āgneye hastivadanam īśaṃ dakṣiṇato 'thavā / dakṣiṇāmūrtim ṛṣibhiḥ sevitaṃ vaṭam āśritam // 9.67 viśvarūpaṃ pratīcīne kamalāsanam uttare / aiśānyāṃ vasudhāṃ devīṃ sthāpayet tu vicakṣaṇaḥ // 9.68 athavā pūrvavat sarvā diṅmūrtīḥ parikalpayet / adhastād upapīṭhe 'pi pūrvoktā dikṣu devatāḥ // 9.69 athavā tatkathopetān prādurbhāvān prakalpayet / sudhākalpanaprakāraḥ pāṣāṇaśarkarātakrasudhayā triḥprakārayā // 9.70 piṣṭayā triphalāmbhobhiḥ sakṛd dviḥstriś ca yatnataḥ / khadirārjunajais toyaiḥ śālmalyā kṣīraśākhinaḥ // 9.71 miśrīkṛtyāvaṭe samyak toyabhāvitayā tathā / abhiṣicya parikvāthaṃ saṃmiśrībhūtayā punaḥ // 9.72 guḍapākarasais taiś ca punaḥ kvathitayā bhṛśam / dhāma limpet krameṇaiva sthūlāditrividhātmanā // 9.73 cirasthāyi bhaved evaṃ kalpite mandiraṃ tu tat / lepanatraividhyam pāṣāṇaśarkarātakrasugandhaṃ cūrṇayet purā // 9.74 taccūrṇe piṣṭamāne taddviguṇāṃ vālukāṃ kṣipet / piṣṭaṃ tad ekavāraṃ cet sthūlaṃ dviḥ piṣṭam ucyate // 9.75 sūkṣmaṃ triś cet parijñeyaḥ sthūlādyālepanakramaḥ / pañcavarṇakalpanam pañcavarṇais tataḥ kuryāc chobhitaṃ śāstracakṣuṣā // 9.76 upānahādi stūpyantaṃ bhūṣayet kanakādibhiḥ / muktā maṇi hiraṇyasrak kiṅkiṇījālahetubhiḥ // 9.77 bhūṣayet sadanaṃ viṣṇoḥ yathāvittānusārataḥ /
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde mūrdheṣṭakāvidhivimānadevatākalpanaṃ nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ
daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ
parivāradevatāsthānādikalpanam śrībhagavān parivāraniveśārthaṃ śobhārthaṃ mandirasya ca / rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca paritaḥ prākāraṃ parikalpayet // 10.1 antarmaṇḍalādiprākāranirūpaṇam antarmaṇḍalanāmānaṃ prākāraṃ prathamaṃ viduḥ / antarhāraṃ tato vapraṃ madhyahāram anantaram // 10.2 anantaraṃ ca maryādā mahatī nāma pañcamam / pañcaite caturaśrāḥ syuḥ samupetakhalūrikāḥ // 10.3 pañcabhedāś ca tantreṣu candrikā bhūmir antimā / ekāntaṃ bhūvalī kalpyā dvayī vā kamalāsana // 10.4 upānadādi pañcāṅgam adhiṣṭhānaṃ prakalpayet / daṇḍaṃ tadardhaṃ pādonaṃ tasyotsedhaḥ samīritaḥ // 10.5 adhiṣṭhāne kṛte tasmiṃstambhamālā vidhīyate / antarālaṃ mahīmāhurdhāmāntarmaṇḍalākhyayā // 10.6 pañcahastāṃ caturhastāṃ dvihastāṃ vā yathecchayā / antarāvarāṇasyāsya pañcaprāsādagumbhitaḥ // 10.7 sālāntarālocchrāyayormānam vicchinne cāntareṣāṃ tu sālānāmantarālabhūḥ / ekadvitricaturhastaiḥ kramaśo vardhito bhavet // 10.8 mandirasya mahānāsāsamaḥ sālasam ucchrayaḥ / grīvāgratulito vā syāt pratisaṃmita eva vā // 10.9 upapīṭhasamā yukto sālo daṇḍastrir ucchrayaḥ / catuḥpañca dvidaṇḍo vā sālānām ucchrayaṃ viduḥ // 10.10 sālopari garuḍādividhānam upariṣṭāc ca sālānāṃ siṃho garuḍa eva vā / kalpanīyaḥ prayatnena dhvajayaṣṭiḥ samantataḥ // 10.11 ardhamaṇḍapavidhiḥ prāsādāgre prakartavyas tadaṅgaś cārdhamaṇḍapaḥ / caturdhā dhāmani kṛte pādo vārdham athāpi vā // 10.12 tripādo dhāmatulyaṃ vā ardhārdhaṃ vā yathāruci / dviguṇaṃ vā caturvaktraṃ yadvā harmyapramāṇataḥ // 10.13 ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā trihastaṃ vā samāyatam / caturhastaṃ pañcahastaṃ kārayed ardhamaṇḍapam // 10.14 antarālaṃ tayoḥ kāryaṃ tālaṃ yadvā karāyatam / daṇḍam adhyardham athavā dviguṇaṃ vā vināpi vā // 10.15 hīne 'rdhamaṇḍape nirgamasthalanirdeśaḥ hīne 'rdhamaṇḍape dhāmni pārśvābhyāṃ nirgamaḥ smṛtaḥ / aprataḥ pṛṣṭhataś cāpi bhavetāṃ pārśvavartmanī // 10.16 sopapīṭhasya dhāmnaḥ gopuracatuṣṭayam catvāri gopurāṇi syur dhāma cet sopapīṭhakam / agre tu maṇḍapasyārdhe vipulo vṛttamaṇḍapaḥ // 10.17 samucchritaṃ pratisamam adhikaṃ vā yathecchayā / vṛttamaṇḍapārdhaṃ maṇḍapayor āyāmamānam ekadvitricatuḥpañcahastau vṛttārdhamaṇḍapau / antarālaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ pārśvābhyāṃ nirgamaḥ smṛtaḥ // 10.18 sopānapaṅktayaḥ kāryāḥ pārśvayor ubhayor api // 10.19 devālayeṣu yugmāḥ syuḥ ṣaḍaṅgulasamucchrayāḥ / tāvad vistārayuktāś ca dvayaṅgulaṃ vobhayaṃ bhavet // 10.20 sopānapārśvayor hastir athāṅgādinyāsaḥ sopānapārśvayor hastihastaṃ kuryāt sthavīyasaḥ / yadvā rathāṅgaṃ kurvīta dviradaṃ pārśvavāhikam // 10.21 dvāravātāyanayor bhittibandhaniṣedhaḥ dvāraṃ vātāyanaṃ vāpi bhittibandhaṃ na jātucit / kulakṣayo vināśaś ca vyādhir vābhittibandhane // 10.22 vātāyanāntarālatālabandhalāṅgalādinirūpaṇam yadvārdhamaṇḍapād ardhaṃ tripādaṃ pādam eva vā / tattulyaṃ vāntarālaṃ tu antarālāntaraṃ bhavet // 10.23 vistāro hrāsayet tasya antarālasya pārśvayoḥ / hastaṃ tālaṃ tadardhaṃ vā hrāsayet pārśvayor api // 10.24 yugmastambhasamopetaṃ tālabandham athāpi vā / lāṅgalaṃ vā prakurvīta ubhayaṃ vā vinā bhavet // 10.25 caturaśrāyataṃ vā syāc caturdvāraṃ caturdiśam / vātāyanaṃ vā yugme tu na kuryād bhittibandhanam // 10.26 antarāvaraṇasyāntarbahir nobhayato 'pi vā / maṇḍapāyāmavistārau āyāmo maṇḍapasya syād ayugmaṃ tu pramāṇataḥ // 10.27 āṣoḍaśāntaṃ yugme syād athāyugme trayodaśa / maṇḍapāyāmam uddiṣṭaṃ hastaiḥ kamalasambhava // 10.28 yadvā mūlālayasamam ardhamaṇḍapasaṃmitam / tadardhaṃ pādam evātha yadvā ''layasamaṃ bhavet // 10.29 adhyardhaṃ dviguṇaṃ vātha sapādaṃ vā ''layasya ca / maṇḍapāyāmam uddiṣṭaṃ vistāre kamalāsana // 10.30 mūlālayasamaṃ vāpi tālahastaṃ ca vādhikam / upānādyaṅgasaṃyuktaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutam <�alaṃkāra�> // 10.31 nānānāṭakasaṃyuktaṃ antastambhavivarjitam / utsedhaṃ maṇḍapasyāhur ardhamaṇḍapasaṃmitam // 10.32 adhikaṃ vā tadutsedhaṃ maṇḍapasya caturmukha / yadvā prāg yāmyasopānaṃ pārśve tannirgamo bhavet // 10.33 kalpayec chilpaśāstrajño bhittayaḥ koṇabhūmiṣu / sthalabandhaṃ tadūrdhve tu lāṅgalaṃ vā prakalpayet // 10.34 koṇeṣu garuḍasiṃhayor nyāsavikalpaḥ koṇeṣu garuḍaṃ kuryāt siṃhaṃ vā kamalāsana / sabhāṃ vā tat prakurvīta yathāvittānusārataḥ // 10.35 prākārasya caturdikṣu gopuracatuṣṭayabandhavikalpaḥ prākārasya caturdikṣu gopurāṇi prakalpayet / dhāmāgrapṛṣṭhayor vā syāt agre caikaṃ prakalpayet // 10.36 dvitalādidhāmanirūpaṇam talair dvādaśabhir yuktam uttamaṃ dvitalādiṣu / mūrdheṣṭakāṃ stūpikāṃ ca pūrvavat kalpayet kramāt // 10.37 diṅmūrtayaḥ pūrvavat syuḥ pūrvavad garuḍādikam / maṇḍapasya uttamādimānabhedabhittibandhau prākāreṣu ca sarveṣu maṇḍapāḥ syuḥ samantataḥ // 10.38 ṣaḍviṃśatidhanurmānaṃ maṇḍapaṃ cottamaṃ viduḥ / aṣṭādaśadhanurmānaṃ maṇḍapaṃ madhyamaṃ viduḥ // 10.39 adhamaṃ dvādaśadhanur maṇḍapaṃ saṃpracakṣate / pūrvoktahastasaṃkhyaṃ vā kuryād āsthānamaṇḍapam // 10.40 uttamaṃ daśabhir hastair madhyamaṃ cāṣṭahastakam / ṣaḍhastam adhamaṃ vidyāt kṣudraṃ hastatrayīyutam // 10.41 dakṣiṇottarataḥ pṛṣṭhe bhittiṃ tasya prakalpayet / stambhāṣṭakayutaṃ tatra sopānaṃ parikalpayet // 10.42 dīrghaśālām adhaḥ kuryād yūpācchādanasaṃyutām / maṇḍapāḥ prāṅmukhāḥ sarve sarvāvaraṇasaṃsthitāḥ // 10.43 āsthānamaṇḍapāṇ sarvān prakuryāt sarvatomukhān / prāsādārambhavat sarvaṃ bhūmisaṃśodhanādikam // 10.44 kṛtvā hastinakhaṃ caiva maṇḍapaṃ caiva kalpayet / maṇḍapagarbhanyāsaprakāraḥ garbhanyāsas tu koṇe syād agner maṇḍapakarmaṇi // 10.45 gopure kriyamāṇe tu dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi smṛtaḥ / dvārasya kavāṭayugmādivinyāsaḥ kavāṭayugmaṃ saṃsthāpya dvāre dvāre dṛḍhaṃ yathā // 10.46 lohajaṃ dārujaṃ vāpi vicitraṃ turagādibhiḥ / uttarāṅgaṃ śilādāru vā harec chilpibhiḥ saha // 10.47 rathakṛttakṣayitvā tu sarveṇa kṣālayed drutaḥ / puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātha muhūrte śobhane guruḥ // 10.48 rathakṛc chilpibhiḥ sārdhaṃ dvārasyopari nikṣipet / śākhācatuṣkaṃ kurvīta tathaiva śilayāpi vā // 10.49 śākhākavāṭau prakṣālya pañcopaniṣadā jalaiḥ / navavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya dhānyarāśiṣu nikṣipet // 10.50 mahākumbhārcanaṃ kuryāt pūrvavac chāstracoditam / kṛtvā prabhāte vimale muhūrte śobhane guruḥ // 10.51 khāte lohādi vinyasya kārayec chilpinā saha / puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā ca pañcagavyair vilepayet // 10.52 mahākumbhajalair devān nyaset kūrcena tatkṣaṇāt // kavāṭopari kalpanīyadevatāḥ adhaḥśāntiṃ dakṣiṇato vāgdevīm upari śriyam // 10.53 ratim uttarataḥ śākhāsv evaṃ catasṛṣu kramāt / kavāṭe dakṣiṇe sthāpyo biśvadhṛgbhūtanāyakaḥ // 10.54 kavāṭe cottare sthāpyo viśvavaktraḥ pratāpavān / avatārāṃś ca tatrasthān prokṣayet svasya vidyayā // 10.55 vedaśāstrapurāṇāni vetreṣu nivasanti ca / nārāceṣu trayas triṃśad devāḥ kīleṣu carṣayaḥ // 10.56 kavāṭapaṭṭikāyāṃ ca bhūtanāthaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ / kavāṭakandapaṭṭe syāt saṃsthāpyo viśvabhāvanaḥ // 10.57 evaṃ kumbhajale dhyātvā vinyaset sarvadevatāḥ / ācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt niṣkasaṃkhyā tu pūrvavat // 10.58 kavāṭasya sauvarṇatāvidhikalpaḥ sauvarṇo rājatas tāmraḥ kavāṭo dārujaḥ smṛtaḥ / pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ phalāya syāt bhūyase kalpate nṛṇām // 10.59 kavāṭaṃ dārujaṃ svarṇaiḥ rañjayan pūjyate suraiḥ / stambhapotikādividhānam stambhān pādaśilāsv eva ratnanyāsādi pūrvavat // 10.60 na sthāpyā brahmaṇaḥ sthāne teṣām upari potikāḥ / kalpyās tāḥ sūttarāropo vājanādisamanvitāḥ // 10.61 tulām āropayet paścāt bandhayec ceṣṭakādibhiḥ / talabandhaṃ tataḥ kuryāt brahman vittānusārataḥ // 10.62 yūpācchādanakaṃ vāpi kuryāc chāstrānusārataḥ / digbhedena caṇḍādidvārapālanirūpaṇam caṇḍapracaṇḍau kartavyau dvāre garbhagṛhasya tu // 10.63 dakṣiṇottarapārśvasthau muniveṣau sahastriyau / daṃṣṭrākarālavadanau bhīmau vā daṇḍadhāriṇau // 10.64 kāntāviyuktau vikaṭau karaṇḍamukuṭojvalau / ardhamaṇḍapakadvāre śaṅkhacakrottamāṅginau // 10.65 antarmaṇḍalasaṃjñasya sālasya dvārapārśvayoḥ / jayaś ca vijayaś caiva kartavyau tasya gopure // 10.66 evam eveṣyate 'nyeṣāṃ caturdikṣu ca gopuram / antarhārasya pūrvasyāṃ dvāri padmagadādharau // 10.67 khaḍgaśārṅgadharau dvāri dakṣiṇasyāṃ prakalpayet / pratīcyāṃ vajramusaladhāriṇau diśi kalpayet // 10.68 pāśāṅkuśadharau brahmann uttarasyāṃ diśi sthitau / madhyāntarhārasālasya prācyādiṣu yathākramam // 10.69 dikṣu dhātṛvidhātārau tato bhadrasubhadrakau / kṛtāntāsuravidhvaṃsau kuberākṣakuberakau // 10.70 prācyādiṣu tathā dikṣu maryādāsālagopurau / durjayaprabalau kāryau viśvabhāvanapuṣkarau // 10.71 saṃbhavaprabhavau syātāṃ suśobhanasubhadrakau / jaghanyāvaraṇadvāre prācyādau kumudādayaḥ // 10.72 kumudaḥ kumudākṣaś ca puṇḍarīko 'tha vāmanaḥ / śaṅkukarṇaḥ sarvanetraḥ sumukhaḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ // 10.73 aṣṭau dvau dvau pratidvāraṃ kalpanīyau yathāvidhi / viṣṇupāriṣadāḥ sarve senābhiḥ koṭibhir vṛtāḥ // 10.74 daṇḍahastā virūpākṣāḥ karaṇḍamukuṭānvitāḥ / phaṇikaṅkaṇamālāḍhyāḥ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇāḥ // 10.75 vyatyastahastacaraṇāḥ rakṣanti dvāramāśritāḥ / caturthāvaraṇe kuryāt pākasthānaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ // 10.76 prathamāvaraṇe vā 'pi dvitīyāvaraṇe 'pi vā / tṛtīyāvaraṇe vā 'pi yathā deśānukūlataḥ // 10.77 khalūrikāsthānanirdeśaḥ indrāgnimadhye vā ''gneye tasya sthānaṃ vidhīyate / khalūrikā samāyuktaṃ madhye cāṅkaṇasaṃyutam // 10.78 caturaśrāyate bhāge prācīnasyāśmakāntakam / yugmair hastapramāṇaiś ca dīrghaculyena vā yutam // 10.79 madhye 'gniyamayoḥ kuṇḍaṃ nityahomāya kalpayet / apūpapacanasthānam apūpapacanasthānaṃ madhye nairṛtayāmyayoḥ // 10.80 phalamarīcyādinidhānasthānam phalāni nikṣipen madhye nirṛter varuṇasya ca / dvāraṃ prakalpayet pratyak madhye vāyujaleśayoḥ // 10.81 marīcyādi nidhānaṃ syād vāyusomāntare bhavet / sarpirādi dravasthānaṃ madhye śarvaśacīśayoḥ // 10.82 taṇḍulakṣālanakūpadhūmanirgamamārgasthānanirūpaṇam kṣālanaṃ taṇḍulādīnāṃ kūpo 'ntarbahir eva vā / dhūmanirgamamārgāś ca yugmāḥ syuḥ kuṭilāḥ sadā // 10.83 majjanatāmbūlavastrapuṣpaniveśanapradeṣāḥ, ekāntināṃ bhuktisthānaṃ ca majjanāmbhor gṛhaṃ yāmye tāmbūlī dhāma nairṛte / vāruṇe vāsasāṃ sthānaṃ māruteḥ puṣpamaṇḍapaḥ // 10.84 saumye caikāntināṃ bhuktisthānam īśe dhanālayaḥ / dhānyasaṅgrahachatrādiniveśadeśaḥ <�saṃgraha�> bahir āvaraṇe kuryād āgneye dhānyasaṅgraham <�saṃgraham> // 10.85 avaghātagṛhaṃ yāmye gośālā syād umāpatau / tṛtīyāvaraṇe sthānaṃ chatrādīnāṃ vibhāvasau // 10.86 śibikādisthitiś caindre pānīyaṃ vāruṇe bhavet / utsave devayajanaṃ someśānāntare bhavet // 10.87 indreśānāntare vāpi madhye vāgnisureśayoḥ / yamāgnimadhye vā kuryād utsave yāgamaṇḍapam // 10.88 sthānam īśe sarasvatyāḥ vādyasthānaṃ tu vāyave / sthānasaṅkoce racanāprakāraḥ yathoktāvaraṇābhāve vidyamāne kvacid bhavet // 10.89 kūpataṭākādijalāśayavidhiḥ vāruṇe vā bhavet saumye kūpaṃ śārve 'pi vā bhavet / yatra vā 'pāṃ sirāḥ santi tatra kūpaṃ prakalpayet // 10.90 aṣṭadikṣu yathāyogaṃ taṭakaṃ kārayen mahat / prākārasya bahir dīrdhikā yatyādīnāṃ maṭhādiś ca prākārāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bahiṣṭhā dīrdhakā bhavet // 10.91 śāstraśravaṇayuktānāṃ vedādhyayanaśālinām / yatīnām itareṣāṃ ca maṭhaḥ kāryo bahir bhavet // 10.92 sadanāni ca kāryāṇi devamāśritya tiṣṭhatām / udyānādinirdeśaḥ udyānaṃ puṣpavāṭīṃ ca parito dhāma kalpayet // 10.93 ekāvaraṇaparivāranirūpaṇam ekāvaraṇayuktasya parivārānimān śṛṇu / pradhānaberābhimukhaḥ kalpanīyo vihaṅgarāṭ // 10.94 nṛttārdhamaṇḍapasyāgre tasya dhāma ca kalpayet / gopurasyottare sāle mandirābhimukho raviḥ // 10.95 tasyaiva dakṣiṇe sāle sudhāṃśuṃ parikalpayet / vahnau kāmo yame brahmā nairṛte syād gajānanaḥ // 10.96 vāruṇe ṣaṇmukho durgā vāyau saumye dhanādhipaḥ / īśāne śaṅkaras tatra kṣetrapālas tathā bhavet // 10.97 someśayor antarāle viṣvaksenaṃ prakalpayet / aṅkaṇe dakṣiṇe saptamātaraḥ śrīs tu nairṛte // 10.98 indrādayo lokapālāḥ pūjyāḥ svāśāsu cāṅkaṇe / gopurasya bhaved antarbahir vā balipīṭhakam // 10.99 antarhārāhvayopete viśeṣo dhāmni kathyate / sūryācandramasau sthāne saṃsthāpyau puruṣācyutau // 10.100 sūryācandramasau kalpyau dvitīyāvaraṇe tathā / hayagrīvaḥ smarasthāne sthāne saṅkarṣaṇo vidheḥ // 10.101 varāho vighnarāṭsthāne pradyumnaḥ śarajanmanaḥ / kātyāyanyāmanantaḥ syād aniruddho narāsane // 10.102 nṛkesarī śāṅkare syād aṅkaṇe pīṭhikāsu cet / indrādayaḥ samabhyarcyās teṣāṃ sthāne yathākramam // 10.103 cakrī musalavān śaṅkhī khaḍgī caiva gadādharaḥ / sārṅgī padmī tathā vajrī pūjyā divyāstradhāriṇaḥ // 10.104 parivāradevatānām avasthānādi prathamāvaraṇe yeṣāṃ sthāne 'nye samudīritāḥ / jñeyā dvitīye te sarve parivārā yathoktayā // 10.105 madhyāntarhārasāle tu gopurobhayapārśvayoḥ / ādityā dvādaśārādhyāḥ madhye manmathavedhasoḥ // 10.106 vasavaḥ pūjanīyāḥ syur vidhir vignakṛteḥ puraḥ / madhye pitṛgaṇāḥ pūjyāḥ ṣaḍānanagaṇeśayoḥ // 10.107 viśve devāḥ samārādhyāḥ maruto guhadurgayoḥ / saptarṣayaḥ pūjanīyāḥ madhye durgākuberayoḥ // 10.108 kubereśānayor madhye rudrā ekādaśa smṛtāḥ / tatraiva ca kṣetrapālāḥ prāṅkaṇe kumudādayaḥ // 10.109 indrādipīṭhikāsthāne sabhājyāḥ kamalāsana / maryādāvaraṇe sthāpyā aṣṭādaśa ganeṣu ye // 10.110 uttamāḥ parivārās te prāṅkaṇorvītale punaḥ / upendrapramukhāḥ pūjyā dikṣu prācyādiṣu kramāt / 10.111 upendraḥ prākṛtaḥ puṇyaḥ puṣkaro viśvabhāvanaḥ / asuragnaḥ kṛtāntaś ca bhūtanātho 'ṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ // 10.112 maryādāyāṃ mahatyāṃ tu madhyamā ye gaṇeṣu te / parivārāḥ prakartavyāḥ viśvādyā vāsavādiṣu // 10.113 aṅkaṇe samarcanīyā devatāḥ aṅkaṇeṣu samarcyā ye vakṣye tān anupūrvaśaḥ / viśveṣī viśvakṛd viśvo viśvātmā viśvalocanaḥ // 10.114 viśvapādo viśvabhujas tathā vai viśvakarmakṛt / ādityādyaṣṭādaśa gaṇāḥ aṣṭādaśagaṇān vakṣye tān budhyasva kramoditān // 10.115 ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyāś ca marutas tathā / viśve devāś ca pitaro mātaro gṛhadevatāḥ // 10.116 aṅgirāś cāśvinīdevau tathā strīdevatāgaṇāḥ / lokeśā vāstudevāś ca nakṣatrāṇi ca pārṣadāḥ // 10.117 tatvānāṃ patayaś caiva uttamāḥ parikīrtitāḥ / siddhāś ca ṛṣayo nāgāḥ asurā rākṣasā api // 10.118 yakṣavidyādharāś caiva saurabheyāś ca guhyakāḥ / gandharvāpsarasaś caiva prajānāṃ patayas tathā // 10.119 martyāś caivātha rohiṇyo gaṇās te madhyamāḥ smṛtāḥ / bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāś ca kūśmāṇḍāḥ pramathā api // 10.120 skando bālagrahāś caiva taitalāś caiva bhairavāḥ / kinnarāś caiva vetālā apasmārās tathaiva ca // 10.121 yoginyaś caiva ḍākinyaḥ śākinyaś caiva cārikāḥ / mohinyaś caiva sarveṣu jaghanyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ // 10.122 dhātā 'ryamā vidhātā ca mitraś ca varuṇas tathā / bhago vivasvān pūṣā ca savitā ca ravis tathā // 10.123 tvaṣṭā viṣṇur iti proktāḥ dvādaśaite 'diteḥ sutāḥ / dharo dhruvaś ca somaś ca āpaś caivānilo 'nalaḥ // 10.124 pratyūṣaś ca prabhāsaś ca vasavaḥ śāntavarcasaḥ / mṛgavyādhaś ca śarvaś ca nirṛtir dhvaja ekapāt // 10.125 ahirbudhnyaḥ pinākī ca yavaṣaś ca tathaiva ca / sthāṇur bhavaḥ kapālī ca rudrāś caikādaśa smṛtāḥ // 10.126 triṇetrā rudrasadṛśāḥ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇaḥ / āvaho vivahaś caiva udvahaḥ saṃvahas tathā // 10.127 nivaho 'nuvahaś caiva pravahaś ca tathaiva ca / saptaite marutaḥ proktāḥ sapta saptādribhedinaḥ // 10.128 kālo raviś ca rudraś ca agnir āpas tathaiva ca / pañcaite tu samākhyātāḥ gaṇāḥ sādhyasamāhvayāḥ // 10.129 rudro 'gniḥ savitā viṣṇur viśve devagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ / kavyabāḍanalaḥ somo yama evāryamā tathā // 10.130 agniṣvāttāḥ somapāś ca tathā barhiṣado 'pi ca / ete pitṛgaṇāḥ proktāḥ saptaite lokapūjitāḥ // 10.131 kratur dakṣaḥ kālakākhyo vasuḥsatyaḥ śucī ruciḥ / purūravārdhruvaś caiva viśve devā ime smṛtāḥ // 10.132 nāsatyadasram ubhayam aśvinau parikīrtitau / anyonyasadṛśau devau pīyūṣakalaśodbhavau // 10.133 ravisomāṅgārabudhaguruśukraśanaiś carāḥ / rāhuketū tathāśliṣṭau kīrtitās tu navagrahāḥ // 10.134 śakrāgniyamarakṣāṃsi varuṇo vāyur eva ca / soma īśāna ity aṣṭau lokapālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ // 10.135 brahmā marīciratriś ca vivasvān pṛthivīśvaraḥ / āpaś caivāpavatsaś ca savitā ca savitrakaḥ // 10.136 rudro rudrajayaś caiva indra indrajayas tathā / īśaś caivātha parjanyo jayantaś ca mahendrakaḥ // 10.137 bhānuḥ satyo bhṛguś caiva antarikṣaś ca pūrvataḥ / agniḥ pūṣā kṛśobhānur bṛhatkṣatro yamas tathā // 10.138 gandharvī bhṛṅgarājaś ca mṛgaś caiva tu yāmyataḥ / pitṛdauvārikāś caiva sugrīvaḥ puṣpadantakaḥ // 10.139 varuṇaś ca bhṛśaś cāpo cakṣumaś ca manojavaḥ / roganāthaś ca mṛtyanto bhallāṭaḥ soma eva ca // 10.140 aditir vāstunāthaś ca vāsudevagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ / agnir vāyuḥ prajāsaktaś catvāro 'ṅgirasaḥ smṛtāḥ // 10.141 tiṣṭhanti munirūpeṇa devarūpeṇa ca dvidhā / lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī vighnā tisras tu gṛhadevatāḥ // 10.142 ity ete 'ṣṭādaśa proktāḥ gaṇā madhyottamādhamāḥ / uttamā madhyamāś cāpi parivāreṣu saṃmatāḥ // 10.143 rudrālayādiṣv adhamāḥ parivārāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde parivārādi devatākalpanaṃ nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ

pratimādravyādividhiḥ śrībhagavān ataḥ paraṃ pratikṛter dravyasya vidhir ucyate | yanmayaṃ pratimādravyaṃ tad anekaṃ pracakṣate || 11.1 ratnādiṣaḍdravyanirdeśaḥ ratnaṃ lohaṃ śilā mṛc ca dāru sphaṭika eva ca | ṣaḍ dravyāṇi prakṛtayo yanmayyaḥ pratimāḥ smṛtāḥ || 11.2 māṇikyapramukhai ratnair arcām avayavair yutāṃ | vidadhyād ardhacitraṃ vā kevalaṃ vā samarcayet || 11.3 uktadravyaphalanirdeśaḥ nirdoṣā ratnajāḥ sarvāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ | suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ trividhaṃ loham iṣyate || 11.4 hiraṇmayī pratikṛtiḥ sarvasaṃpatkarī bhavet | vittaṃ yaśaś ca vijayo vijñānaṃ rājatīphalam || 11.5 buddhiḥ śāntiś ca saubhāgyaṃ audumbaryārcayā bhavet | śilāyāś cāturvidhyam śilā caturvidhā brahman varṇabhedaiḥ sitādibhiḥ || 11.6 śubhrā śilā brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyasya tu pāṭalā | vaiśyasya pītā śūdrasya kṛṣṇā mukhyā yathoditā || 11.7 brāhmaṇasya catasraḥ syuḥ tisro rājño viśo dvayī | ekaiva syāc caturthasya gauṇo 'yaṃ vidhir īritaḥ || 11.8 uttamā śilā śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaśakti candanamālikāḥ | siṃhamātaṅgasāraṅgavarāhakuśakuṇḍikā || 11.9 śrīvatsacāmaracchatradhvajamatsyavihaṅgamāḥ | śilāsu yatra dṛśyante tilataṇḍulavālukāḥ || 11.10 tāḥ śubhā yajamānasya śubhadāḥ pārthivasya ca | śilādārvādīnāṃ garbhadoṣaparīkṣopāyaḥ garbhavatyaḥ śilā varjyāḥ garbhā hy antaravasthitāḥ || 11.11 yathopalabdhuṃ śakyante taṃ prakāram imaṃ śṛṇu | navanītaṃ māhiṣajaṃ śṛṅgaṃ meṣasya cūrṇitam || 11.12 cūrṇaṃ ca kuruvindasya saṃpeṣya payasā gavām | limpec chilāṃ tathā dāru garbhavyaktis tato bhavet || 11.13 vīthikā yadi dṛśyante maṇḍalāvartakāni ca | dhvaniś ca śithilo yāsu sparśecauṣṇyam athāpi vā || 11.14 tāsu garbhāḥ sphuṭaṃ santi yatnenotpāṭayet tu tāḥ | pāṭale maṇḍale pāṃsūn pāṭalān śvetapaṅkaje || 11.15 śvetapāṃsūn sthitāv antargarbharūpeṇa saṃsthitān | nirdiśet kapile varṇe snigdhe ca kamaṭhaṃ sthitam || 11.16 gaulīṃ kapote māñjiṣṭhe varṇe lohitadarduram | śuklaṃ ḍiṇḍīravarṇe tu raktapīte tu kacchapam || 11.17 kusumbhapītavarṇe tu pītaṃ barṣābhuvaṃ sthitam | śuklahemanibhe varṇe garbhe kṣudravihaṅgamam || 11.18 kālāyasasame varṇe godhām antaravasthitām | guḍavarṇe tu pāṣāṇakhadyotaṃ madhusannibhe <�saṃnibhe> || 11.19 sāraṅgasadṛśe varṇe vṛścikaṃ khaḍgasannibhe <�saṃnibhe> | salīlaṃ śalabhaṃ nīlerūkṣe phenakam eva ca || 11.20 mūṣikaṃ kapile kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇāhiṃ śaṣpasannibhe <śaṣpasaṃnibhe> | matsyam evaṃ vidhaṃ garbhaṃ maṇḍale varṇabhedataḥ || 11.21 budho niścunuyāt sarvam uddharec ca prayatnataḥ | garbhavad dāruśilayā pratimāṃ kurute yadi || 11.22 ajñānād vātha lobhād vā yajamānas tvarānvitaḥ | samūlaghātaṃ hanyāc ca sa kulānyātmanāmaja || 11.23 rājā ca rāṣṭram acirāt sthāpakaś ca vinaśyati | garbhāgāre kṛte paścāt juhuyāc chāntaye guruḥ || 11.24 bhojayed dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād brāhmaṇebhyaḥ svaśaktitaḥ | strīpunnapuṃsakaśilānāṃ pratimādau viniyogaḥ bimbaṃ śītalayā kuryāc chilayā yadi sādaram || 11.25 devasya sannidhiḥ sākṣāt saṃpac ca varado hariḥ | strīpuṃnapuṃsakaṃ ceti śailaṃ trividham ucyate || 11.26 kāṃsyaghaṇṭādhvaniprakhyaśchedane jāyate dhvaniḥ | śiraḥpradeśe madhye tu kāṃsyadhvanisamo bhavet || 11.27 mūle tāladhvanisamo yatra sā ssyāc chilā pumān | nyūnas tasmād dhvaniḥ kiñcic chidrato yatra sādhama || 11.28 śilā nādavihīnā tu napuṃsakam udāhṛtam | bimbaṃ puṃśilayā kāryaṃ pīṭhaṃ strīśilayā bhavet || 11.29 ratnanyāsas tu kartavyo na śilāyām iti kramāt | devīnāṃ ca śriyādīnāṃ nirmāṇe strīśilā varā || 11.30 puṃśilā pādapīṭhe syād ratnanyāso napuṃsake | saumyā śilā śītalā syād vaiṣṇavī sā mahāphalā || 11.31 uṣṇāgneyī śilā raudrī sā rogasyāspadā bhavet | saumyā jñeyā 'bhayātmā tu brāhmī sṛṣṭikarī bhavet || 11.32 śitalā gharmakāle yā mahoṣṇā jaladāgame | ekavarṇā śilā śuddhā sā bhavet pratimāvidhau || 11.33 saṅkīrṇānekavarṇā tu sā śilā rogadā sadā | śilāgrahaṇasthānaphalādīni parvateṣu prasiddheṣu gṛhṇīyāt pratimāśilām || 11.34 bhūgatā vā śilā śastā ninditā na kadācana | yā puṣpavanasaṅkīrṇā <�saṃkīrṇā> jalāśayasamāvṛtā || 11.35 sā bhūmir vāruṇī jñeyā tatratyāḥ kāmadāḥ śilāḥ | toyam uttarato yasyāḥ kṣetraṃ dakṣiṇato mahat || 11.36 pratyak ca kṣīriṇo vṛkṣāḥ sā māhendrī kṣamā matā | tatratyā puṣṭidā nityaṃ śilā bahumatā tataḥ || 11.37 pūrvadakṣiṇato yasyāḥ kāśmaryaḥ khadirādayaḥ | jhallikā ṭiṭṭibhā gṛdhravarāhaśvāpadādayaḥ || 11.38 toyam antargataṃ svalpaṃ yatrāgneyī bhaved iyam | śilā tatrodbhavā svalpavibhavā tadasaṃmatā || 11.39 vibhītakādayo vṛkṣā mṛgā hiṃsrāś ca santatam | yatra tyaktodakatṛṇā kaṇṭakadrumasaṃvṛtā || 11.40 yā ca sā vāyavī bhūmis tasyāṃ śūnyapradā śilā | varjyaśilāsthānāni nadītaṭe hradataṭe bhūtibhūmau catuṣpathe || 11.41 grāme śmaśāne valmīke lavaṇodakapīḍite | amedhyabhūmau śabaracaṇḍālādiniṣevite || 11.42 śarkarotkarasaṃbādhe nistṛṇe jalavarjite | devālayasamīpe ca tapte vātātapāgnibhiḥ || 11.43 deśe varjyāḥ śilāḥ sarvā gṛhītāś ced anarthadāḥ | upādeyaśilāpradeśau puṇyakṣetre śubhe deśe brahmavṛkṣanirantare || 11.44 kuśakāśodakayute mṛgaiḥ kṛṣṇair niṣevite | padmotpalasamākīrṇe vrīhikṣetranirantare || 11.45 hintālapūgapunnāganālikeranirantare | tapasvijanasaṃbādhe deśe grāhyā śilā bhavet || 11.46 varjyāvarjyaṃ viditvaivaṃ guṇadoṣau nirūpya ca | deśabhedāṃś ca bhūbhedān jñātvā liṅgabhidās tathā || 11.47 sitādivarṇabhedāṃś ca gṛhṇīyāc chubhadāṃ śilām | śilāgrahaṇasamayaḥ puṇyarkṣatithivāreṣu yajamānānukūliṣu || 11.48 śakunādinimittānāmānukūlyena cānvitaḥ | yajamāno guruś caiva śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ || 11.49 rathakāreṇa sahitaḥ sthapatīnāṃ gaṇaiḥ saha | brāhmaṇān bhojayitvādau taiś ca svastyādi vācitaḥ || 11.50 śilāsaṃgrahaṇe deśe kārayen mahatīṃ prapām | kṛtvāṅkurārpaṇaṃ tatra brahmacārī haviṣyabhuk || 11.51 ācāryo yajamānena sārdhaṃ tatra vasec chuciḥ | śālibhāraṃ kṣipet tasmin prapāmadhye savedike || 11.52 tasmin nyasen mahākumbhaṃ sūtravastrādiveṣṭitam | nyastakūrcaṃ praticchannamaśvatthanavapallavaiḥ || 11.53 vinyasta ratnalohāḍhyaṃ vidyayā parameṣṭhinaḥ | tasyāṣṭadikṣu ca nyasyet kumbhān sūtreṇa veṣṭitān || 11.54 mahākumbhasya tasyaiva pārśve nyasyec ca vardhanīm | astramantreṇa saṃsiddhān siddhārthān dikṣu pātayet || 11.55 puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu cakramudrāṃ pradarśayet | mahāmudrāṃ pradarśyātha praṇamyāñjalimudrayā || 11. 56 āvāhayet tato devaṃ mūrtimantreṇa sarvagam | mahākumbhe pratiṣṭhāpya pūjayed deśikaḥ kramāt || 11.57 vardhanyā mantrarājānaṃ kumbheṣv aṣṭasu pūjayet | viṣṇvādimūrtīs tadanu paramānnaṃ nivedayet || 11.58 homaṃ kuryāc caturdikṣu kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile 'pi vā | pālāśasamidhaḥ puṣpaṃ phalamājyaṃ sapallavam || 11.59 juhuyān mūlamantreṇa pṛthag aṣṭottaraṃ śatam | caruṇā ca nṛsūktena pṛthak kuṇḍacatuṣṭaye || 11.60 prācīnakuṇḍe juhuyāt sarpiṣā vanadevatāḥ | parvatān gaṇḍaśailāṃś ca tatra śṛṅgāṇi nirjharān || 11.61 samudrāṃś ca tathā vṛkṣānopadhīś ca vanaspatīn | jarāyujānaṇḍajāṃś ca svedajān udbhijāṃs tathā || 11.62 tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni mantrais taddevatāparaiḥ | svāhāntais tair vyāhṛtibhiḥ pūrṇāhutyantam abjaja || 11.63 palalaṃ rajanīcūrṇaṃ lājāpūpāḥ karambhiṇaḥ | caravastair baliṃ dravyair bhūtebhyo nikṣiped guruḥ || 11.64 hotavyaṃ svapnapataye sarpiṣā 'ṣṭottaraṃ śatam | vādyais tathā brahmaghoṣaiḥ sarvato ghoṣayen niśi || 11.65 upoṣya darbhaśayyāyāṃ śucir niyatamānasaḥ | japann aṣṭottaraśataṃ svapnādhipatimātmavān || 11.66 svapet svapne tataḥ śailaṃ yadi paśyet samujvalam | prātar eva śilā grāhyā śāntiṃ kuryād adarśane || 11.67 durdarśane vā pūrvoktadurnimittodaye tathā | śilāṃ muhūrte saṃpaśyec chobhane deśikottamaḥ || 11.68 yakṣāḥ piśācā nāgādyā yatra tiṣṭhanti nityaśaḥ | sarve te hy apagacchantu sannidhattāṃ sadā hariḥ || 11.69 ity uktvā mantrasaṃsiddhān siddhārthāṃs tatra nikṣipet | baliṃ dadyāc ca bhūtebhyaḥ pratyāśaṃ sarvamantrataḥ || 11.70 puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā ca pauruṣeṇa śilāḥ spṛśet | mūlamantreṇa datvārdhyaṃ japed aṣṭottaram śatam || 11.71 prāsādasyā 'nurūpeṇa pātayet sūtramañjasā | śilāṃsthapatayaś chindhyuḥ rathakārasya śāsanāt || 11.72 sirāvaiṣamyeṇa varjyāvarjyaśilānirūpaṇam śāntidā dakṣiṇaśirāḥ prākśirā jayadāyinī | śrīkarī paścimaśirāḥ puṣṭiṃ dadyād udakśirā || 11.73 varjayet koṇaśirasaṃ yadi kuryāt kulakṣayam | śilā ''nayananiyamaḥ yasyāṃ diśi mukhaṃ dhāmnaḥ tasyāḥ pratikṛteḥ śiraḥ || 11.74 vyatyāse yajamānasya rājño rāṣṭrasya vāstutaḥ | ālayasya ca sarveṣām acirāt kalpate vipat || 11.75 mūlabhāgaḥ śilānāṃ cet upariṣṭād bhavet tathā | adhastāc cec chiro bhāgo vipat syād rājarāṣṭrayoḥ || 11.76 mahākumbhasthatoyena snāpayed uddhṛtāṃ śilām | viṣṇvādikumbhatoyaiś ca pauruṣaṃ sūktam uccaran || 11.77 pariṣiñcec chilāṃ bhūyo vardhanīsthena vāriṇā | śriyādidevīpratimārhaśilāvidhiḥ devīnāṃ bimbaśudhyarthaṃ pṛthag evādhivāsayet || 11.78 madhyakumbhe 'rcayed devīṃ śriyaṃ trailokyamātaram | aṣṭakumbheṣu saṃpūjya devyaśrāṣṭau yathākramam || 11.79 homādi pūrvavat kṛtvā bimbārthā strīśilā bhavet | astriyā śilayā devyo vihitāś cet pramādataḥ | 11.80 lobhena mahatā yuktā hanyuḥ svaviṣayāḥ prajāḥ | tasminn eva kṣaṇe grāhyāḥ parivāraśilāḥ śubhāḥ || 11.81 śilāsaṅgrahaṇaṃ <�saṃgrahaṇaṃ> kuryāt teṣāṃ mantrair yathākramam | śilāṃ gṛhītvā tāṃ samyak āropya śakaṭādiṣu || 11.82 nītvā dhāmni sthapatayo rathakāramatānugāḥ | kuryur arcāṃ yathāśāstraṃ coditair lakṣaṇair yutām || 11.83 śilāsaṅgrahaṇe <�saṃgrahaṇe> karma yad uktaṃ bahir ālayāt | tat sarvam athavā kuryād aṅkurādikamālaye || 11.84 anyārthaṃ gṛhītam uktāyāḥ punar adhivāsena grahaṇānujñā śilāṃ gṛhītvā vidhivat tyaktāṃ kartum aśaktitaḥ | anyārtham api tāṃ viddhi śuddhāṃ bhūyo 'dhivāsanāt || 11.85 dārusaṅgrahaṇakālaḥ <�saṃgrahaṇa�> kārtikādyaṣṭamāseṣu praśasto dārusaṅgrahaḥ | praśastaṃ sarvamāseṣu śilāsaṅgrahaṇam <śilāsaṃgrahaṇam> matam || 11.86 upādeyadārunirdeśaḥ candanaś cāguruś caiva kāśmaryo haricandanam | kesaraḥ khadiraś caiva kuravaś cāsanas tathā || 11.87 madhuko devadāruś ca jātir bilvaḥ śamī tathā | śākaś ca panasaś caiva kadambas tilakas tathā || 11.88 nameruḥ phalinī caiva surabhiś campakas tathā | śiṃśupā kṣīrikā sālo bījakaḥ kuruvindakaḥ || 11.89 tiniśaś candanaś cūtas tamālaḥ saralo 'rjunaḥ | kuṭajaḥ karakelī ca saptaparṇo madhuṣṭhilaḥ || 11.90 varaṇo niculaś caiva punnāgaḥ khadiras tathā | rājavṛkṣaś ca ity ete pratimārtham udāhṛtāḥ || 11.91 sāravanto ghanopetāḥ sarvadoṣavivarjitāḥ | etaiḥ kāryā pratikṛtir varjitair na kadācana || 11.92 varjanīyāni dārūṇi varjanīyān api tarūn abhidhāsyāmi tān śṛṇu | svayaṃ śuṣkāś ca dagdhāś ca svayaṃ bhagnā hatatvacaḥ || 11.93 vakrā ghuṇakṣatāś caiva koṭarāḥ pakṣisevitāḥ | caṇḍālādyadhamaiḥ śaśvat sevitāḥ pratilomajaiḥ || 11.94 nivāsavṛkṣāś caityasthāḥ devatādhiṣṭhitās tathā | śmaśānasthāś ca mārgasthā devālayasamīpagāḥ || 11.95 kūpasthāś ca taṭākasthā vikṛtāś caiva varjitāḥ | varjitais tarubhiḥ kuryāt pratimāṃ cet pramādataḥ || 11.96 kartā kārayitā cobhau sānvavāyau vinaśyataḥ | dārusaṅgrahaṇe 'pi śilāgrahaṇavad eva vidhiḥ dārusaṅgrahaṇe deśe pūrvavac cādhivāsanam || 11.97 śilāgrahaṇavad dhomaḥ sarvaḥ kāryo yathāvidhi | anokahānām aṅgāni pravālādīni pūrvavat || 11.98 juhuyād agnikuṇḍe ca prācīne deśikottamaḥ | prakṣālayed vṛkṣamūlaṃ vāsasā taṃ prakoṇakam || 11.99 ācchādayet sadarbheṇa mūlamantraṃ samuccaran | mūrtibhiś ca dvādaśabhiḥ matsyādibhir anukramāt || 11.100 vṛkṣopasthānam hutvā vyāhṛtibhiḥ paścād upatiṣṭheta bhūruham | karmaṇā pūrvavṛttena sthāvarākāram āśritam || 11.101 vṛṇomi viṣṇor bimbārthaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ tava | sthāvaratvādito gaccha divyaṃ rūpam anuttamam || 11.102 bhuṃkṣva bhogāṃś ca vipulān vāsudevaprasādataḥ | hinasmi nāhaṃ vṛkṣa tvāṃ kintu muñcāmi janmataḥ || 11.103 ity upasthāya mantreṇa rakṣāsūtreṇa veṣṭayet | anuktam anyat kartavyaṃ śilāgrahaṇavanniśi || 11.104 vṛkṣacchedane kāladigādinirdeśaḥ prabhāte deśikaḥ snātvā muhūrte śobhane śuciḥ | chindyād vṛkṣaṃ kuṭhāreṇa prāṅmukhaḥ puruṣātmanā || 11.105 rathakāras tato vṛkṣaṃ chedayed gurvanujñayā | chinnavṛkṣapatane digbhedena phalabhedaḥ prācyām udīcyāṃ patitas tarur abhyudayāvahaḥ || 11.106 prakāṇḍena śākhayā bimbanirmāṇaṃ tatsaṃskāraś ca kuryād bimbe prakāṇḍena śākhayā cānurūpayā | kumbhodakena taṃ siñced dhyātvā tatra sthitaṃ harim || 11.107 mūlamantreṇa paritaḥ siñcet karakavāriṇā | gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt pūrvavat kamalāsana || 11.108 rathakārasya bimbanirmāṇānujñā devālaye drumaṃ nītvā rathakāreṇa kārayet | bimbam atyadbhutākāraṃ dhāmamānānusārataḥ || 11.109 ālaye cādhivāsādi sthāpayitvā drumaṃ bhuvi | kuryād bahir vane yadvat sarvaṃ tadvad yathāvidhi || 11.110 asaṃskṛtataruṇā bimbanirmāṇe doṣaḥ asaṃskṛtena taruṇā yathoktavidhinā yadi | kuryāt pratikṛtiṃ mohāt tadanarthāya kevalam || 11.111 tasmād yathoktataruṇā kṛtam abhyudayāvaham || iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde śilādārusaṅgrahavidhānaṃ <śilādārusaṃgrahavidhānaṃ> nāma ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
śrībhagavān mūlaberapramāṇādividhiḥ athaitat saṃpravakṣyāmi mūlaberasamucchrayam | garbhavistāramānaṃ vā dvāradairghyam athā 'pi vā || 12.1 prāsādapādamānaṃ vā hastamānam athāpi vā | yajamānapramāṇaṃ vā stambhamānam athāpi vā || 12.2 kuryād dhruvapratikṛtiṃ grāmāder anukūlikām | pratimāyā mānaṃ uttamādibhedāś ca pratimā garbhavistāratulyā śreṣṭhā caturmukha || 12.3 navabhāgaikahīnā tu pratimā madhyamā bhavet | pañcabhāgaikahīnā tu jaghanyā parikīrtitā || 12.4 saptadhā garbhavistāraṃ vibhajya dvau vivarjayet | śiṣṭabhāgasamucchrāyā śreṣṭhā syād athavābjaja || 12.5 madhyamā pañcasūtryaṃśais tribhir dvābhyāṃ kanīyasī | dvārādhyardhasamucchrāyā śreṣṭhā pādādhikā punaḥ || 12.6 madhyamā dvāramātrā tu kaniṣṭhā madhyamā bhavet | dvāraṃ ṣoḍaśadhā kṛtvā nyūnaikadvitribhiḥ kramāt || 12.7 śreṣṭhā madhyā kaniṣṭhā syād itthaṃ pādādiṣu kramāt | uttamā pañcabhir hastaiḥ tribhir ekena cetare || 12.8 sthitasya kautukasyāyam ucchrāyaḥ samudīritaḥ | āsīnamūrtimānam garbhagehasya vistāraṃ tridhā bhaṅktvā dvayī bhavet || 12.9 uttamā pañcadhā tryaṃśair madhyamārdhakanīyasī | āsīnā cāthavā śreṣṭhā garbhavistārasaṃmitā || 12.10 navabhāgaikahīnā tu madhyamā pañcadhā kṛte | ekonā caramā proktā saptadhā ṣaḍbhir uttamā || 12.11 saptadhaiva tribhir madhyā tridhā dvābhyāṃ kanīyasī | dvārādiṣu sthitasyaiva samāsīnonnati kramāt || 12.12 hastaiḥ saptabhir āsīnā śreṣṭhā madhyā tu pañcabhiḥ | śayanamūrtimānam tribhir jaghanyā vakṣyāmi śayanasyāpi connatim || 12.13 āyāmaṃ garbhagehasya bhaṅktvā ṣoḍaśadhā punaḥ | caturo mūrdhni saṃtyajya bhāgau dvau pādatas tathā || 12.14 avaśiṣṭadaśāṃśena śayitasyottamonnatiḥ | āyāmam aṣṭadhā kṛtvā hitvā dvau mūrdhni pārśvataḥ || 12.15 ekam aṃśaṃ caraṇataḥ śiṣṭāṃśenaiva madhyamā | āyāmaṃ saptadhā kṛtvā mūrdhni dvāv ekam aṅghritaḥ || 12.16 hitvā kaniṣṭhā śeṣeṇa śayānasyākṛtir bhavet | vistāre vā caturdhā tu kṛte teṣv ekam uddharet || 12.17 śiṣṭena dviguṇena syāc chayānasyottamonnatiḥ | kṛtvaivaṃ pañcabhāgena syāc chayānasya madhyamā || 12.18 garbhavistāramānena śayānasyādhamā bhavet | dviguṇā dvāramānena śayānasyottamonnatiḥ || 12.19 adhyardhamānair madhyā syāt sapādā caramā bhavet | uttamādikramo yādṛg dvāramāśritya kīrtitaḥ || 12.20 dhruvaberasya yādṛk syāt stambhādyāśrayaṇe 'pi ca | saptabhiḥ pañcabhir hastais tribhiḥ śreṣṭhā yathākramam || 12.21 yāne 'py āsanavanmānaṃ viśvarūpaṃ sthitaṃ yathā | garbhagehaṃ tridhā kṛtvā dvibhāgaṃ cottamaṃ bhavet || 12.22 pañcadhā tu kṛte tasmin tribhāgo madhyamo bhavet | garbārdhamadhamaṃ dhāmnā sarvasādhāraṇo vidhiḥ || 12.23 yajamānānuguṇyena mūrtimānam yajamānādyanuguṇo vidhir adyābhidhīyate | labdhāṃśam aṅgulī kuryāt prāsādasya caturmukha || 12.24 aṅgulividhiḥ tatrāṅgulividhiṃ vakṣye yathā tadavadhāraya | pañcadhāṅgulir ākhyātā ucyante tā vidhāḥ kramāt || 12.25 mānaṃ mānāntaraṃ mātrā muṣṭir dehas tathaiva ca | vakṣyamāṇakrameṇaiṣāṃ bhedānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu || 12.26 vātāyanapathaṃ prāpya ye yānti raviraśmayaḥ | teṣu sūkṣmā visarpanti reṇavaḥ paramāṇavaḥ || 12.27 te 'ṣṭau keśāhvayāste 'ṣṭau līkṣo yūkas tadaṣṭakam | tadaṣṭakaṃ yavās te 'ṣṭāv aṅguliḥ samudāhṛtā || 12.28 taduttamāṅguliḥ sapta yavās tv eva tu madhyamā | yavāḥ ṣaḍadhamā proktā mānāṅgulam idaṃ bhavet || 12.29 vinyastais tiryag aṣṭābhir yavair mānāntarāṅgulam | śālībhir vā ṛjunyastais tribhir mānāntaraṃ bhavet || 12.30 ācāryadakṣiṇakare madhyamāṅgulimadhyame | parvaṇor antaraṃ dīrghaṃ mātrāṅgulam udāhṛtam || 12.31 caturdhā vibhajed eko bhāgo muṣṭyaṅguliḥ smṛtā | kautukāyāmamānam yat kiñcit kautukāyāmaṃ vibhajya daśadhā punaḥ || 12.32 ekaṃ dvādaśadhā bhāgaṃ kṛtvā teṣv ekam aṅgulam | ucchrāyaḥ pratimāyāḥ syān mahāmānāṅgulāśrayaḥ || 12.33 prāsādavedikādīnām aṅgulanirdeśaḥ prāsādādīṃś ca tenaiva kuryān mānāntareṇa vā | vedikāpīṭhaśibikārathādīnāṃ vidhiḥ punaḥ || 12.34 mānāntarāṅgulenaiva bhaven nānyena kenacit | yāgopakaraṇānāṃ ca kuryān mātrāṅgulena ca || 12.35 homāṅgāni sruvādīni kuṇamuṣṭyaṅgulāśrayaḥ | dehalabdhāṅgulena pratimāṅgamānam dehalabdhāṅgulenaiva pratimāṅgāni kalpayet || 12.36 yair yāvadbhir vibhāgāṃśair arcyamānam udāhṛtam | grāmādīnāṃ mānāṅgulenaivāyavibhāgaḥ mānāṅgulena tanmānam aṅgulīkṛtya tat punaḥ || 12.37 āyavyayādau saṃyojya grāmāder yac chubhaṃ bhavet | tat tathā vakṣyate brahman idānīm avadhāryatām || 12.38 labdhāṃśam aṅgulīkṛtya tad aṅgulam athāṣṭabhiḥ | vardhayed drāvayec caiva punar dvādaśasaṃkhyayā || 12.39 āyaṃ śiṣṭāṅgulaṃ jñeyaṃ vyayair navabhir edhayet | daśabhiḥ kṣapayec chiṣṭam aṅgulaṃ vyayasaṃjñitam || 12.40 āyaḥ samagraśubhado vyayaḥ svalpaśubhāvahaḥ | pratikūle viparyāse grāmādeḥ kamalāsana || 12.41 tribhir vṛddhau kṣayo 'ṣṭābhiḥ śiṣṭaṃ yonir udāhṛtā | dhvajādyaṣṭau āyāḥ dhvajo dhūmas tathā siṃhaḥ śvā vṛṣo gardabhaḥ karī || 12.42 kāka ity ucyate yoniḥ sā śubhā śubhalakṣaṇā | dhvajaḥ siṃho gajo 'naḍvān śubhayoniḥ śubhāvahaḥ || 12.43 dhūmadhvajakharaśvānaḥ pratikūlā hi yonayaḥ | nakṣatrādikalpanaprakāraḥ aṣṭābhir vardhate hānau saptviṃśatisaṃkhyayā || 12.44 śiṣṭamṛkṣam iti proktaṃ grāmādes tac chubhaṃ bhavet | navabhir vardhate hānau saptabhiḥ śiṣṭam aṅgulam || 12.45 vārās te śubhadāḥ saumyāḥ krūrāḥ syur bhayadāyinaḥ | vṛddhau caturbhir navabhiḥ śiṣṭaṃ hānāv adhāṃśakam || 12.46 taskaro bhuktiśaktiś ca dhanyo narapatiḥ klibaḥ | sunītiḥ prītir āyuṣmān eteṃśāḥ samudīritāḥ || 12.47 tāladhanuḥkrośādinirūpaṇam mānāṅgulair dvādaśabhir mānaṃ tālāhvayaṃ matam | dvau tālau kathito hastas te hy aṣṭau dhanur ucyate || 12.48 sa eva daṇḍaḥ sayugaḥ krośas taiḥ pañcabhiḥ śataiḥ | krośaiś caturbhiḥ gopānaṃ yojanaṃ tac caturguṇam || 12.49 grāmasya yajamānasya rājño janapadasya ca | āyādir anukūlaś cet pratimāḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ || 12.50 āyādir eṣa vijñeyo mūlaberasamāśrayaḥ | na tadaṅgeṣu bimbeṣu lohajeṣv itareṣu vā || 12.51 śraddhā bimbeṣu vijñeyas tathā bhavanakautuke | prasthādimānabhedāḥ prasthādīnāṃ tu maryādā prasaṅgād ucyate 'dhunā || 12.52 catvāro vrīhayaḥ kuñjās te 'ṣṭau mañjiṣṭha ucyate | te śataṃ ṣaṣṭir adhikaṃ niṣkaṃ niṣkāṣṭakaṃ phalam || 12.53 phalāni pañca kuḍupaṃ prasthaṃ syāt tu caturguṇam | tac caturguṇakaṃ vidyād āḍhakaṃ tad dvayaṃ śivam || 12.54 tad dvayaṃ droṇam uditaṃ khārī tad dvitayaṃ bhavet | tatkhārī tritayaṃ bhāraṃ parimāṇam udīritam || 12.55 etena parimāṇena paricchedyaṃ ghṛtādikam || 12.56
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde dhruvaberapramāṇānukūlyanirṇayo nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
śūlasthāpanavidhiḥ śrībhagavān athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śūlasya sthāpanādikam | sajātīyavijātīyaśūlākārapramāṇādividhiḥ sthirāṇi candanādīni dārūṇi ghanavanti ca || 13.1 adhivāsya yathāpūrvaṃ gṛhṇīyād deśikottamaḥ | vṛkṣajātīyayā vyaktyā śūlaṃ yady ekayā bhavet || 13.2 uttamaṃ tad vijānīyāt parvabhir yadi madhyamam | nānājātīyayā tac ced adhamaṃ kamalāsana || 13.3 śilpibhis takṣayitvā tu asāraṃ vyapanīya tu | sāreṇa kārayec chūlaṃ pramāṇaṃ tasya kathyate || 13.4 aṅgulīnāṃ caturviṃśac chataṃ kautukam unnatam | dvyadhikā ṣaṣṭir āyāmo vaṃśadaṇḍasya kathyate || 13.5 tasya mūlāgramadhyāni vistīrṇāni yathākramam | catvāryaṅgulamānāni sārdhāni trīṇi tāni ca || 13.6 yavāḥ ṣaṭ ca tathā nāhāḥ ṣoḍaśāṅgulasaṃmitaḥ | mūlasya syāt tathā madhye nāhaḥ pañcadaśāṅgulaḥ || 13.7 caturdaśāṅgulo nāhas tadagre kamalāsana | vakṣodaṇḍaś catustriṃśadaṅgulaḥ syāt samāyataḥ || 13.8 caturaṅgulavistāraḥ ṣoḍaśāṅgulamānataḥ | dviśikhā triśikhā vāpi śikhā kiṃśukakuḍmalaḥ || 13.9 āyāmo bāhudaṇḍasya pañcaviṃśāṅgulo bhavet | sārdhatryagulakaṃ mūlaṃ vistīrṇaṃ tasya madhyamam || 13.10 dvyaṅgulaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ sārdham agraṃ tasya caturmukha | prakoṣṭhamāyataṃ viṃśatyaṅgulaṃ dviyavādhikam || 13.11 mūlamadhyāgravistāraḥ dvyaṅgulas tryaṅgulo 'pi vā | sārdhas tathāṅgulāni syus trīṇi vidyād yathākramam || 13.12 suṣiraṃ bāhumūlaṃ syād agraṃ bāhuprakoṣṭhayoḥ | mithunaṃ kalpanīyaṃ syān nīcabāhur apīdṛśaḥ || 13.13 āyāmaḥ kalpadaṇḍasya ṣoḍaśāṅgulasaṃmitaḥ | vistāras tasya madhye syāc caturaṅgulasaṃmitaḥ || 13.14 ṣoḍaśāṅgulanāhaś ca tasya madhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | āyāmaḥ pārśvadaṇḍasya kāryo dvātriṃśadaṅgulaḥ || 13.15 pārśvadaṇḍaparīṇāhaś caturaṅgulasaṃmitaḥ | dviśikhaś ca kaṭīdaṇḍo vakṣodaṇḍo niyogataḥ || 13.16 daṇḍayoḥ pārśvayoḥ samyak ūrdhvadaṇḍasya cāyatiḥ | ekaviṃśāṅgulo daṇḍo jaṅghādaṇḍasamo bhavet || 13.17 madhyāgramūlavistāraḥ krameṇa paripaṭhyate | tryaṅgulo 'rdhādhikaḥ sārdho dvyaṅgulaś caturaṅgulaḥ || 13.18 jaṅghāyās tryaṅgula mūlaṃ sārdhadvyaṅgulam antaram | ardhaṃ ca dvyaṅgulaṃ tatra triguṇaṃ sahanaṃ matam || 13.19 ūrumūlaṃ ca suṣiraṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ ṣaḍyavādhikam | ūrujaṅghāgrayor ante mithunaṃ parikalpayet || 13.20 vaṃśadaṇḍamuraḥ kaṭyāḥ madhye nimne niveśayet | śūlapramāṇam uditaṃ śūlasaṃkhyādhunocyate || 13.21 śūlānāṃ saṃkhyā vaṃśadaṇḍaḥ kaṭīdaṇḍo vakṣodaṇḍas tathaiva ca | bāhudaṇḍāś ca catvāraḥ prakoṣṭhena tathāvidhaḥ || 13.22 jaṅghādaṇḍaś ca ity ete śūladaṇḍās trayodaśa | śleṣayet tad yathāyogaṃ suṣiraṃ naiva kārayet || 13.23 na ca kīlaṃ vidhātavyaṃ śilpibhiḥ śūlakarmaṇi | vaṃśadaṇḍaṃ kirīṭāntaṃ mūrdhāntaṃ vā pracakṣate || 13.24 pādāntaṃ vā yathā sthairyaṃ tathā kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ | lohapaṭṭena śūlānāṃ bandhanaṃ dṛḍham ācaret || 13.25 śūladaṇḍasya lohādibhedaḥ lohajāḥ śūladaṇḍāḥ syur athavā vibhave sati | vaṃśamūlaṃ catuṣkoṇam aṣṭāśraṃ madhyam iṣyate || 13.26 agraṃ suvṛttaṃ śūlāni vṛttāny anyāni vā 'nyathā | vaṃśadaṇḍajamānasya galād arvāg ṛjur bhavet || 13.27 upariṣṭhād yathāyogaṃ kiñcid bhugnaṃ caturmukha | pratimānāṃ yathābhāgaṃ vaṃśadaṇḍasthitir bhavet || 13.28 vakṣodaṇḍaḥ kaṭīdaṇḍaḥ kiñcid bhugnaśikho bhavet | bhujorudaṇḍayor mūlaṃ nimnaṃ kṛtvā yathāśikham || 13.29 mukhaṃ sārdhaṃ kirīṭasya śūladviguṇam eva vā | maulimūlasya vistāras tryaṅgulaṃ vā yavatrayam || 13.30 triyavaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ madhyaṃ sārdhatryaṅgulasaṃmitam | bāhvantamūlaberasya devīnāṃ śayane sati || 13.31 śūlam anyatra yānādau nāsikāntam athāpi vā | cibukāntaṃ yathocchrāyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śayane sati || 13.32 śūlaṃ jānvantam anyatra bāhusīmāntam iṣyate | bhṛgvādiparivārāṇāṃ bāhusīmāntam ucyate || 13.33 śūlānāṃ jalādhivāsādi jalādhivāsanaṃ caiva sthāpanaṃ maṇḍape tathā | homaṃ kumbhārcanaṃ dvārapūjā brāhmaṇatarpaṇam || 13.34 śuddhiś ca śoṣaṇādīni śūlānāṃ bimbavat smṛtam | na divā piṇḍikāṃ rātrau adhivāsya samāhitaḥ || 13.35 śvobhūte vāstuno homaṃ dadyād vāstubaliṃ tathā | garbhagehaśodhanam śodhayed garbhagehaṃ ca mārjanālepanādibhiḥ || 13.36 sūtraṃ candanatoyena siktam āsphālayet kramāt | sūtrāṇy udaṅmukhāny aṣṭau prāṅmukhāni tathaiva ca || 13.37 koṣṭhāny ekonapañcāśan nyūnādhika vivarjitā | brāhmaṇādisaṃjñakabhāgavidhiḥ brāhmaṇo madhyamo bhāgaḥ daivikas tu tadantaraḥ || 13.38 tṛtīye mānuṣas turyaḥ paiśāco bhāga iṣyate | arcanā pīṭhikā brāhme bhāge daive sthitir bhavet || 13.39 mānuṣe parivārāḥ syur āyudhāni caturthake | kiñcin mānuṣam āśritya daive syād āsanaṃ bhavet || 13.40 divyamānuṣayoḥ śayyā paiśāce yānam iṣyate | daive devyaḥ sthitā vā syur āsane tasya pārśvataḥ || 13.41 śayane 'pi yathāyogaṃ yānārūḍhe 'pi vai tathā | sūtrāṇām udaṅmukhatā udaṅmukhāni sūtrāṇi daśa tāvan nipātayet || 13.42 prāṅmukhāny api koṣṭhānām ekāśītir bhavet tataḥ | madhyamo brāhmaṇo bhāgo daivaḥ syāt tadanantaraḥ || 13.43 tṛtīyaḥ paitṛkas turyo mānuṣaḥ pañcamaḥ punaḥ | paiśāca iti vā bhāgān kalpayed garbhamandire || 13.44 ekaberabahuberādīnāṃ brāhmādibhāgabhedaḥ ekaberavidhir brāhme bahuberaṃ tu daivike | daive ca mānuṣe bhāge dvayor āsanam iṣyate || 13.45 daivamānuṣapitryeṣu śayanaṃ triṣu kārayet | paiśāce mānuṣe caiva dvayor yānaṃ vidhīyate || 13.46 uktasthānaviparyāse aniṣṭaphalam uktasthānaviparyāse rājā rāṣṭraṃ ca naśyati | tasmād yathoktabhāge syuḥ sthāpyā ṛddhim abhīpsubhiḥ || 13.47 kāmanānuguṇasthāpanābhūmiḥ catasraḥ sthāpanābhūmiṃ kṛtvā madhye pade punaḥ | muktikāmo 'rcayed devaṃ pade tu tadanantare || 13.48 divye bhogābhilāṣaś cet santānārthī tu mānuṣe | paśvādikāmaḥ paiśāce padeṣv evaṃ yathākramam || 13.49 prāsādadvāravistāramānam prāsādadvāravistāraṃ tribhāgīkṛtya madhyamam | bhāgaṃ tu saptadhā kṛtvā pañcabhāgāṃs tu dakṣiṇe || 13.50 apohyānantare bhāge brāhme sūtram udāhṛtam | brāhmabhāge bhittistambhādiniṣedhaḥ na kuryād brahmaṇaḥ sūtre bhittistambhādikaṃ sudhīḥ || 13.51 ajñānād yadi kurvīta pratyavāyo mahān bhavet | ekaberaṃ bhavet tatra brahmasūtre śilāmayam || 13.52 ratnalohaśilākāṣṭhamṛdbhis tadvā trivastubhiḥ | bahuberaṃ bhaved ardhācitraṃ sābhāsam iṣyate || 13.53 sthitāsīnaśayānānāṃ dravyaiḥ ratnādibhir bhavet | nirmāṇaṃ sarvamūrtīnāṃ ṛddhikṛn naiva doṣakṛt || 13.54 garbhagehe khāte garbhanyāsavidhiḥ garbhagehe tato bhāge yathoktadharaṇīṃ khanet | hastamātreṇa tatraiva napuṃsakaśilāṃ kṣipet || 13.55 śilāyāṃ tatra ratnāni lohair bījaiś ca dhātubhiḥ | saha vā tair vinā vā 'pi nikṣipec coditaḥ kramāt || 13.56 vidhāya yoṣicchilayā dṛḍhaṃ kuryāt sudhādibhiḥ | mañjūṣāṃ lohajāṃ kṛtvā yadvā ratnāni nikṣipet || 13.57 ratnanyāsaḥ sthitaḥ saiṣaḥ pādamūle vidhīyate | anyeṣāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kuryāt ratnanyāsavicakṣaṇaḥ || 13.58 pādapīṭhasyākārabhedaḥ vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā pādapīṭhaṃ tu tad bhavet | pratimāyāṃ śilāmayyāṃ śilāyāṃ ca sthitir bhavet || 13.59 sthāne pādaśilāyāṃ ca śūlārdhaṃ suṣiradvayam | iṣṭakābhis tathā kuryāt pīṭhikāṃ śilopari || 13.60 utsedhaś cāpi cāyāmo bhūmibhāgapramāṇataḥ | dvārāṣṭabhāgam athavā pādāṣṭakam athāpi vā || 13.61 pratimāṣṭāṃśam athavā pādapīṭhapramāṇakam | vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā pādapīṭhaṃ yathā bhavet || 13.62 vṛtte ca caturaśre ca padmaṃ copari kalpayet | sthānakeṣu vidhir hy eṣa āsīne dviguṇaṃ bhavet || 13.63 śayane tāvad utsedhaṃ pratimāyāmasaṃmitam | padmādipīṭham athavā dehalabdhāṅgulaiḥ punaḥ || 13.64 kuryād dvādaśabhiḥ prāṃśuṃ vistīrṇaṃ dviguṇāṅgulaiḥ | pañcaviṃśaddalayutaṃ yadvā ṣoḍaśabhir yutam || 13.65 dalair dvādaśabhir yadvā yuktam aṣṭabhir eva vā | aṅghrimānavaśenaiva dalānāṃ drāghimā bhavet || 13.66 ūrdhvac chadanasaṃyuktaṃ tato 'lpadalasaṃyutam | madhye karṇikayā yuktaṃ kiñcit phullāmbujākṛtim || 13.67 divye bhāge sthitasyaiṣa viṣṭaraḥ samudīritaḥ | ekaberādibhedena vedikāmānam ekabere tathāyāmaṃ tridhā kṛtvāikabhāgikām || 13.68 vediṃ kuryāc caturdhā vā turyāṃśena prakalpayet | utsedho 'yaṃ snānaveder vṛttā vṛttāyatā tu vā || 13.69 caturaśrāyatā vāpi ṣaḍaśrāṣṭāśrakāpi vā | upānakaṭisaṃyuktā kartavyā dvādaśāṅgulā || 13.70 āyataṃ nālam etasya caturbhir athavāṅgulaiḥ | viṃśatyā cāyataṃ tasya mukhaṃ makaravaktravat || 13.71 kiñcin nimnaṃ yathā tasmān nālaṃ tiryag athotthitam | upariṣṭāc ca tadveder valayaṃ caturaṅgulam || 13.72 unnataṃ kārayet tāvad vistāraṃ kamalāsana | vedikānuguṇaṃ yadvā padmam evākhilaṃ bhavet || 13.73 devamukhādibhedena jalapraṇālībhedaḥ pratyaṅmukhasya devasya prāṅmukhasya tathā bhavet | praṇālyudaṅmukhā kuryād dakṣiṇodaṅmukhasya tu || 13.74 praṇālī prāṅmukhā kāryā nānyatra vidhir iṣyate | dhārākulyāvidhiḥ dhārākulyā ca kartavyā yāvac chidraṃ bahiḥsthitam || 13.75 hastihastādibhiḥ śvabhre jaladhārāṃ nipātayet | vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā śvabhraṃ kuryāc chilādibhiḥ || 13.76 manoharam agādhaṃ ca bahis taddevatālayāt | āsīnamūrtividhiḥ āsīnasyābhidhāsyāmi pramāṇaṃ siṃhaviṣṭare || 13.77 dehalabdhāṅgulaiḥ ṣaḍbhir utsedhaṃ triṃśatāpi ca | dviguṇair āyataṃ tasya siṃhair aṣṭābhir āsanam || 13.78 dhriyamāṇaṃ caturbhir vā teṣāṃ vaktrāṇi siṃhavat | śiṣṭaṃ vapuḥ puruṣavac caturbhir bāhubhir yutam || 13.79 bibhrāṇo viṣṭaraṃ dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ badhvāṃjaliṃ hṛdi | ratneḥ pariṣkṛtaṃ pīṭhaṃ siṃhair vā kevalair yutam || 13.80 gajāṅghribhir vā tadyuktaṃ kuryān naivānyathā vidhiḥ | bhogaśayyāvidhiḥ bhogaśayyā śayānasya vakṣyāmi kamalāsana || 13.81 vṛttāyataṃ yathāyogaṃ tathā trir maṇḍalīkṛtam | prādakṣiṇyena valayaiḥ pañcabhir vātha saptabhiḥ || 13.82 dehāṅgulaiś catustālam utsedhaṃ bhogamaṇḍalam madhyataḥ pādataḥ proktaṃ mūrdhany adhikam aṅgulaiḥ || 13.83 tribhir dviguṇitair yadvā valayāste yathoditāh | paścāt prabhṛti caikaikaṃ kiñcit kiñcit samunnatam || 13.84 phaṇair ayugmair navabhiḥ saptabhir vātha pañcabhiḥ | upetam uttamaṃ madhyam adhamaṃ saṃpracakṣate || 13.85 tritālam unnataṃ ṣaḍbhir aṅgulair madhyamaṃ phalam | aṣṭāṅgulaṃ phaṇānāṃ syur antarālaṃ phaṇāstu te || 13.86 nimnāḥ krameṇa kartavyā nyūnāḥ pañcacatustribhiḥ | aṅgulaiḥ kramaśas teṣāṃ vistāro madhyamaṃ phaṇam || 13.87 dvātriṃśadaṅgulās tasya phaṇāḥ pārśveḥ caturmukha | viṃśatpañcacaturbhiś ca vistīrṇaṃ dvyaṅgulair api || 13.88 viṃśatyaṅgulavistārau śeṣau dvau phaṇinaḥ phaṇau | itareṣv api sarveṣu hānirūhyā yathākramam || 13.89 biḍālavaktravad vaktraṃ daṃṣṭrayā pariśobhitam | mūrdhni nyastamahāratnaṃ tīkṣṇaśṛṅgasamanvitam || 13.90 śanaiḥ śanair adho vaktraṃ yāvan maulyagramānanam | sarvakaṇṭhāt phaṇotsedhaṃ catustālaṃ daśāṅgulam || 13.91 athavā śayanotsedhaṃ tādṛśaṃ saṃpracakṣate | kautukadvāracaraṇasamutsedhe tridhā kṛte || 13.92 ekāṃśena samutsedhaṃ bhogamaṇḍalam iṣyate | caturthāṃśena vā kuryād bhogino bhogamaṇḍalam || 13.93 bhogāsanasamutsedho bhogaśayyāvad iṣyate | suvṛttaṃ devadevasya pṛṣṭhabhāge samunnatam || 13.94 phaṇānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ yadvac chatraṃ tadvac ca śobhanam | devasya mauler upari viṃśatyaṅgulam unnatam || 13.95 caturaśrāyataṃ pīṭham athavā śayanaṃ bhavet | prāg uktaiś caraṇair yuktam upadhānādisaṃmitam || 13.96 āsanaṃ padmamātraṃ tu viśvamūrter vidhīyate | yānāsanamūrtinirūpaṇam yāne garutmato 'dhastāt padmam āsanam iṣyate || 13.97 tasmin vidadhyāt pakṣīndraṃ devāyāmārdha saṃyutam | bṛhadbhujaṃ garutmantam āruhya sthitam acyutam || 13.98 kuryād devaṃ sthitādīnām āsanāni prakalpayet | adhivāsitaśūlasthāpanavidhiḥ ato muhūrte saṃprāpte śobhane deśikottamaḥ || 13.99 adhivāsitaśūlāni hy uddhṛtyādhvaryubhiḥ saha | dhāma pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tūryaghoṣam udīrya ca || 13.100 śūlāni sthāpayec chvabhre ratnanyāso yathodite | pratiṣṭhāpañcakavidhiḥ sthāpanāsthāpane caiva tathā saṃsthāpanā 'pi ca || 13.101 prasthāpanā pratiṣṭheti pratiṣṭhāpañcakaṃ smṛtam | yā pratiṣṭhā bhavet sthāne sthāpanā sā prakīrtitā || 13.102 yā pratiṣṭhāsane proktā sā cāsthāpanasaṃmitā | śayane yā pratiṣṭhā ca sāca saṃsthāpanā bhavet || 13.103 yāne ca yā pratiṣṭhā sā nāmnā prasthāpanā bhavet | pratimā yārcanāpīṭhe karmārceti prakīrtitā || 13.104 tasyāṃ yā ca kriyā proktā sā pratiṣṭheti kīrtitā | parameṣṭhyādibhedena āsānādiśūlasthāpanam ācāryaḥ sthāpayec chūlaṃ sthānakaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ | āsīnaṃ sthāpayet puṃsā viśvena śayitaṃ tathā || 13.105 sarveṇa viśvarūpaṃ tu nivṛtyā yānakaṃ bhavet | devīśūlaṃ tathā sthāpya ratnanyāsopari kramāt || 13.106 brahmādidevatānāṃ tu śūlāny ātmīyavidyayā | bhittiśūlasthāpanam evaṃ saṃsthāpya śūlāni bhittiśūlaṃ vinikṣipet || 13.107 kakude pṛṣṭhapārśve tu sthānakasya samācaret | āsīnasya tathā kṛtvā śayānasyocyate 'dhunā || 13.108 śayānādhāraśūle vai kuryād ūrdhvamukhe sthite | divyamānuṣayor madhye vaṃśadaṇḍaṃ nidhāpayet || 13.109 pṛṣṭhapārśve tu kakude śayānādhāraśūlakam | śayānādhāra śūle dve kuryād ūrdhvamukhe sthite || 13.110 divyamānuṣayor madhye śayitādhāraśūlakam | ādhāraśūlaṃ śayane sthale kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ || 13.111 ādhāraśūlam anyeṣām bhittisaṃsthaṃ ca kārayet | ādhāraśūlarahite devasya sānnidhyātiśayaḥ ādhāraśūlarahite sarvatra sthāpane kṛte || 13.112 varapradānaṃ sānnidhyam adhikaṃ bhavati dhruvam | mahākumbhādiprokṣaṇam mahākumbhādikumbhānāṃ vāribhir mūlavidyayā || 13.113 prokṣayed darbhakūrcena śūlāni sthāpitāny atha | gurudakṣiṇā dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyād yathā tuṣṭir bhaved guroḥ || 13.114 daśaniṣkaṃ suvarṇaṃ tu tasyārdhaṃ vā pradāpayet | ṛtvijām api sarveṣāṃ daśaniṣkaṃ pradāpayet || 13.115 kāle tasmin samāhūya rathakāraṃ dvijottamaḥ | preṣayet toṣayec cāpi yajamāno dhanair bhṛśam || 13.116 kulālaniyogaḥ kulālaṃ kuśālaṃ śāntaṃ vyādhihīnam adūṣitam | rathakāro niyuñjīta śāstrokte sarvakarmaṇi || 13.117 tadabhāve pāraśavaṃ yāvan nayanamokṣaṇam | rathakāroktavidhinā kuśalaḥ sarvam ācaret || 13.118 sthāpitaśūloddhāre doṣaḥ sthāpitaṃ noddharec chūlaṃ samuddhāre mahadbhayam | kartuḥ kārayituś cāpi bhavaty eva na saṃśayaḥ || 13.119 aṅgabhede 'ṅgahāniḥ syād yajamānasya niścitam | śūlasthāpane śubhaphalam śūlasthāpanamātreṇa yajamāno mahatphalam || 13.120 aśnute mānuṣān daivān athavā na samāpitam |
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde śūlasthāpanavidhir nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
bimbanirmāṇavidhiḥ śrībhagavān bimbanirmāṇam adhunā vakṣyāmi kamalāsana | lohapaṭṭena śūlānāṃ sandhiṃ baddhā dṛḍhaṃ yathā || 14.1 aṣṭabandhena śūlāni limpet sarvāṇi sarvataḥ | rajjubhir veṣṭayet tāni dṛḍhāni cchidravarjitam || 14.2 yathā sirābhir bahubhiḥ śarīraṃ badhyate tathā | śūlarajvādīnāṃ asthisirāprakṛtitā śūlāny asthīni mṛṇmāṃsaṃ śirāḥ pāśās tvacaḥ paṭāḥ || 14.3 apakvamṛdālepane śubhaphalam mṛdbhir ālepanaṃ kuryād apakvābhiś caturmukha | pakvābhir varjayed bimbaṃ gṛhe devālaye 'pi vā || 14.4 apakvāḥ sarvaphaladāḥ pakvās tu bahudoṣadāḥ | kevalamṛdā bimbanirmāṇam mṛdā kevalayā bimbaṃ kuryād yadvā trivastubhiḥ || 14.5 mṛṇmaye kautuke pūrṇe sāṅgopāṅgaṃ yathāvidhi | trivastuke mṛdālipte kaṅkaśarkarayā tathā || 14.6 paṭenācchādya sarvāṅgaṃ varṇalepaṃ samācaret | praśastamṛttikāsthānāni puṇyakṣetre nadītīre kāntāre parvate 'pi vā || 14.7 mṛdaṃ samagrāṃ gṛhṇīyāt sarvadoṣavivarjitām | nīcair adhyāsitāṃ caityaśmaśānādivivarjitām || 14.8 kalkopayoginyastvacaḥ khadirodumbarāśvatthanyagrodhārjunabhūruhām | samuddhṛtya tvacaḥ sarvā māsaṃ vāriṣu nikṣipet || 14.9 toyair māsoṣitair mṛtsnāṃ miśrayet pīḍayec ca tām | tāṃ nūtaneṣu bhāṇḍeṣu nikṣipyācchādya yatnataḥ || 14.10 chāyāyāṃ nikṣiped bhāṇḍāny athā vātādi na spṛśet | kalkaprativāpadravyavidhiḥ dhātukīyās trayo bhāgāḥ ṣaḍguṇā ca harītakī || 14.11 dhātrī ca dvādaśavidhā bhāgāṃs tān ekaviṃśatiḥ | adhivāsakālamānam adhivāsyaikamāsaṃ tu bhāṇḍeṣu kamalāsana | triphalena punar vārā tāṃ mṛdaṃ miśrayet sudhīḥ || 14.12 chāyāyāṃ nātiśuṣkāṃ tāṃ viṃśatyekonayā mṛdā | miśrayed vakṣyamāṇānāṃ puṇyakṣetrādijanmanām || 14.13 ekonaviṃśatimṛdaḥ puṇyakṣetre nadītīre parvate puline hrade | nirjhare saṅgame goṣṭhe devike tīrayos tathā || 14.14 śālikṣetre devakhāte śṛṅge ca vṛṣahastinoḥ | varāhakṛṣṭe valmīke kulīravasatau tathā || 14.15 nalinyāṃ dīrghikāyāṃ ca mṛtsnām ekonaviṃśatim | mṛdaḥ pramāṇaṃ cūrṇavibhāgaś ca mṛtsnābhir muṣṭimātrābhiḥ pūrvoktāṃ miśrayen mṛdam || 14.16 pūrvoktamānais triphalaiḥ cūrṇais tāṃ miśrayet punaḥ | tat tribhāgaikabhāgaiś ca kaṭaśarkaracūrṇiteḥ || 14.17 nādeyaiḥ ślakṣṇapāṣāṇaiḥ mṛttaryāṃśaiś ca cūrṇitaiḥ | yojanīyasurabhidravyāṇi candanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ koṣṭhaṃ śrīveṣṭaṃ haricandanam || 14.18 gugguluṃ ca niśāṃ śuṣkāṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilām | tamālapatrāṇy etāni candanādīni cūrṇayet || 14.19 mṛdviṃśatyekabhāgais taiś cūrṇais tat tulyasaikataiḥ | sūkṣmaiś ca miśrayen mṛtsnāṃ kapittharasaturyakaiḥ || 14.20 cūrṇitair loharatnaiś ca miśrayitvā tu mṛttikām | saṃmiśraṇīyasnehadravadravyāṇi madhutailadadhikṣīraghṛtaiḥ śuktipramāṇakaiḥ || 14.21 atasītaila saṃmiśraiḥ punaḥ saṃmiśrayen mṛdam | saṃskṛtamṛdaḥ adhivāsaḥ itthaṃ tu saṃskṛtāṃ mṛtsnāṃ nikṣipya navabhājane || 14.22 ācchādya navavastreṇa bhāṇḍaṃ dhānyeṣu nikṣipet | arcayen mūlamantreṇa mṛdbhāṇḍān deśikottamaḥ || 14.23 sarpiṣā juhuyād agnau mūlenāṣṭottaraṃ śatam | caruṃ puruṣasūktena pratyṛcaṃ juhuyād budhaḥ || 14.24 saṃpātājyena siñcet tāṃ mṛdaṃ bhājanasaṃsthitām | adhivāsavelā sadyo vā niśi vā mṛtsnām adhivāsya yathāvidhi || 14.25 lepanakramas tadvidyā ca muhūrte śobhane bimbe pralimpen mṛttikāṃ guruḥ | āmaulikaṇṭhaparyantam ālimped vyomavidyayā || 14.26 ākaṇṭhanābhiparyantaṃ vilimped vāyuvidyayā | ānābhi kaṭiparyantaṃ lepayed vahnividyayā || 14.27 ākaṭerjānuparyantam ālimped vārividyayā | ājānukaṭiparyantaṃ pralimped bhūmividyayā || 14.28 ānābhikaṇṭham ālimpet punaḥ śvasanavidyayā | nābhyādiguhyaparyantam ālimpec chikhividyayā || 14.29 guhyādijānuparyantam ālimped vārividyayā | jānuprabhṛti pādāntam ālimpet kṣitividyayā || 14.30 devyādīnāṃ mṛdālepe vidyānirdeśaḥ devīnāṃ ca śriyādīnāṃ brahmādīnāṃ tathaiva ca | ālepanaṃ prakurvīta kāle 'smin bhūtavidyayā | 14.31 gurave dakṣiṇā deyā sa yathā tuṣṭim āpnuyāt | rajvādiveṣṭanam bimbasya nāhamānaṃ yac chūlamānam apohya tat || 14.32 aṣṭadhākṛtya teṣu trīn rajvā cāveṣṭayed guṇān | mṛdbhir ālepayet tryaṃśaṃ dvau vastrakaṭuśarkaraiḥ || 14.33 nārikelatvacā mṛtsnāṃ dvitīyāṃ miśrayet punaḥ | krameṇa parimāṇaṃ ca mukhabāhūruvakṣasām || 14.34 nāḍīkalpanam nāḍīmiḍāṃ piṅgalāṃ ca suṣumnāṃ tantubhiḥ kṛtām | sitapītāruṇais tābhir veṣṭayed viṣṇuvigraham || 14.35 nalikeratvacaṃ sūkṣmaṃ chitvā chitvā ca mṛttikām | tṛtīyāṃ miśrayet tāṃ ca lepayet pūrvaśoṣaṇe || 14.36 hastaṃ ca sāṅgulopetaṃ kṛtvā lohena bandhayet | karṇāvartaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā lohena parivinyaset || 14.37 śarīrapoṣaṇaṃ kuryād bhedarandhravivarjitam | mṛttikākaṭaśarkarayor lepane vidhiḥ hastena mṛttikāṃ dadyāt kūrcena kaṭuśarkarām || 14.38 kaṭuśarkaracūrṇāni triphalā kṛṣitāmbhasā | piṣṭvā 'pūpākṛtiṃ kṛtvā śoṣayed ātapena tāḥ || 14.39 punaḥ saṃpeṣayet piṇḍān kapittharasavāriṇā | catustriḥ pañcakṛtvo vā kṛtvaivaṃ peṣayet punaḥ || 14.40 kārpāsatūlamilitān kapittharasavāriṇā | tāvat saṃpeṣayed yāvad bāhubhyāṃ bāhumātrakam || 14.41 piṣṭakalpanam putrikāyāḥ samuddhāre peṣaṇena pated yadi | kalpaṃ supiṣṭaṃ kūrcena śanair eva parāmṛśet || 14.42 tataḥ karaṇḍikāgreṇa liptāṅgāni ca lepayet | pūrṇeṣv aṅgeṣu sarveṣu paṭenācchādayed dṛḍham || 14.43 kārpāsajaṃ dṛḍhaṃ celaṃ lomādibhir adūṣitam | dhānyarāśiṣu saṃsthāpya vācayitvāśiṣaṃ punaḥ || 14.44 dhānyena śuddhiṃ saṃpādya pūjayed vāyuvidyayā | mūlamantreṇa juhuyāt samidājyena vai śatam || 14.45 caruṃ puruṣasūktena juhuyāt ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ | muhūrte śobhane prāpte paṭenācchādya lepayet || 14.46 yā śarkarā paṭe tasmin tayaivākalpayet tataḥ | śuklamṛttikayālepaḥ kapittharasamiśrayā || 14.47 varṇalepavidhiḥ varṇalepaṃ tataḥ kuryāc chilpiśāstravicakṣaṇaiḥ | śvetaṃ pītaṃ tathā raktaṃ haritaṃ kṛṣṇam eva ca || 14.48 pañcavarṇaṃ pṛthivyādivarṇānām adhidevatāḥ | uttamā dhātavaḥ proktā madhyamā vṛkṣasambhavāḥ || 14.49 saṃyogajāḥ syur adhamās traividyam aparaṃ śṛṇu | varṇaṃ cāpy asuvarṇaṃ ca saṃskāraṃ ca tathaiva ca || 14.50 trividho varṇasaṃyogaḥ śāstreṣu samudīritaḥ | varṇa ity ucyate śuddho rājavat tāni kārayet || 14.51 anukāre ca ye varṇāḥ prāyaśaḥ śuddhivarjitāḥ | anuvarṇā ime proktāḥ saṅkīrṇān kathayāmi te || 14.52 śuklo raktaś ca pītaś ca kṛṣṇaś caiva caturvidhaḥ | saṅkarās tvaiva catvāraḥ pratyekaṃ dvividhāḥ smṛtāḥ || 14.53 śuklaś caiva valarkṣaś ca śveto dvividha ucyate | śaṅkhagokṣīrakundābhaḥ śukla ity abhisaṃjñitaḥ || 14.54 muktāsphaṭika candrābho valarkṣa iti saṃjñitaḥ | raktaś cāpy aruṇaḥ śoṇa iti bhedena kathyate || 14.55 japāśoṇitasaṅkāśo <�saṃkāśo> raktavarṇo 'ruṇo mataḥ | kiṃśukāśokasaṃkāśaḥ śoṇa ity abhidhīyate || 14.56 haritaś caiva pītaś ca pītavarṇo dvidhā bhavet | manaḥśilāharītālanibho harita ucyate || 14.57 haridrākuṅkumābhas tu pīta ity abhisaṃjñitaḥ | śyāmaś ca kṛṣṇavarṇaś ca kṛṣṇavarṇo dvidhā bhavet || 14.58 dūrvāmarakatābhaś ca śyāma ity abhisaṃjñitaḥ | indranīlanibhaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 14.59 śuklena miśrito rakto babhrar ity abhidhīyate | śuklena miśritaḥ kṛṣṇo karālaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 14.60 pītena miśritaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kāla ity abhidhīyate | pītakṛṣṇayutaḥ śuklaḥ karburaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ || 14.61 evaṃ saṅkarajān varṇānūhāpohena yojayet | ukto 'yaṃ varṇasaṃkṣepas taiḥ kuryāc coditaiḥ kramāt || 14.62 mūrtikalpanaparipāṭī prathamo dārusaṅghāto dvitīyo rajjuveṣṭanam | mṛdālepastṛtīyas tu turīyaṃ nāḍibandhanam || 14.63 pañcamo rajjuveṣṭaḥ syān nālikeratvacā punaḥ | miśritā mṛttikā ṣaṣṭhī saptamaṃ rajjuveṣṭanam || 14.64 aṣṭamaḥ śarkarālepo navamaṃ paṭayojanam | bhūṣaṇaṃ daśamaṃ proktaṃ ekādaśamataḥ param || 14.65 śuklālepanam uddiṣṭaṃ dvādaśaṃ varṇayojanam | dvādaśais te ca nirdiṣṭāḥ pratim ākaraṇe 'mbuja || 14.66 lepanaśoṣaṇāvadhiḥ kālena varṣamātreṇa vastu śuṣyati nānyathā | vidhyanusāraśuṣkamūrter āyuḥ sahasraṃ vatsarān yāti sthitādimūrtinirdeśaḥ śrībhagavān bhedān athāto vakṣyāmi pratimāsu sthitādiṣu | sthitāmūrtis tathāsīnā yānārūḍhā tathaiva ca || 15.1 tās tisro dvividhāḥ proktā bhogayogaprabhedataḥ | śayānasya tu sahitas tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ || 15.61 arcanāpīṭhikāpārśve śrībhūmī tu kṛtāñjalī | adhamaṃ yogaśayanaṃ saṃhāraśayanaṃ śṛṇu || 15.62 saṃhāraśayane uttamam anantabhogaśayane anantaphaṇamaṇḍite | śayito saṃhāraśayanaṃ śreṣṭham idam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 15.65 saṃhāraśayane madhyamam daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam | caturbhujaṃ gadākhaḍgaśaṅkhapadmavibhūṣitam || 15.66 arcanāpīṭhikāpārśve śrīkhagendrau kṛtāñjalī | madhyamā saṃhṛtau śayyā kaniṣṭhaṃ śayanaṃ śṛṇu || 15.67 kaniṣṭhaṃ saṃhāraśayanam keśair alakasaṅghaiś <�saṃghaiś> ca virājitaśubhānanam | nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśaṃ <�saṃkāśaṃ> madhye haritapaṅkajam || 15.68 uttamā sargaśayyā sargaśayyā caturdikṣu bhittau vārinidhiṃ likhet | brahmāṇaṃ ca catustāle śayanād bhittipārśvataḥ || 15.69 upariṣṭād abhimukhaṃ nābher nārāyaṇasya ca | caturmukhaṃ caturbāhuṃ jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyutam || 15.70 dvābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ mukhyābhyāṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ sthitam | darśayantaṃ karābhyāṃ vā yogamudrāṃ caturmukha || 15.71 uttarābhyām udastābhyām akṣamālāṃ sakuṇḍikām | dhārayantaṃ sarasije svastikāsanabandhanam || 15.72 devasya śirasaḥ pṛṣṭhe śriyaṃ tasyākṣilakṣitām | vāmajānuṃ samunnamya dakṣiṇena pratiṣṭhitām || 15.73 dakṣiṇaṃ puṣpahastaṃ tu vāmahastaṃ vasupradam | anantaśayane 'dhastāt pūjāpīṭhasya pārśvayoḥ || 15.74 nāradaṃ sanakaṃ caiva mānuṣe tu kṛtāñjalī | pādapārśve mahīṃ devīṃ pādaspṛṣṭāṃ tu kārayet || 15.75 upariṣṭāt samudrāṇāṃ śaṅkhādīn dehasaṃyutān | devasya pṛṣṭhabhittau tu dehalabdhāṅgulena ca || 15.76 caturviṃśāṅgulotsedhān śaṅkhādyāyudhadhāriṇaḥ | śaṅkhacakragadākhaḍgadhanuḥpañcāyudhāni ca || 15.77 dvihastān puruṣākārān svacihnāṅkitamastakān | śaṅkhādhāraṃ prakurvīta lambakukṣiṃ sitaprabham || 15.78 raktavarṇaṃ vivṛttākṣaṃ kuryāc cakradharaṃ param | gadādharaṃ mahākāyaṃ vṛttākṣaṃ pītalaprabham || 15.79 strīveṣā khaḍgadhārī tu sustanā śyāmalaprabhā | śārṅgadhṛgghemavarṇābhaḥ mahākāyo mahodaraḥ || 15.80 vainateyaḥ suvarṇābhaḥ pakṣamaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ | nānākañcukasaṃyuktāḥ nānāmbaradharā ime || 15.81 daṃṣṭrākarālavadanāḥ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇāḥ | karaṇḍikā mukuṭinaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 15.82 vāmaiḥ karais tarjayanta itarair badvamuṣṭayaḥ | dhāvanto 'bhimukhaṃ sarve madhukaiṭabhayor dvayoḥ || 15.83 adhastāt pādayoḥ pārśve kārayen madhukaiṭabhau | madhuśyāmau mahākāyau karaṇḍimukuṭojvalau || 15.84 jānumātraṃ samudrasthau khaḍgadaṇḍāyudhodyatau | daṃṣṭrākarālavadanau bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇau || 15.85 anantaphaṇivaktrāgnijvālābhiḥ paritāpitau | bhītau palāyitau vajrakalpair muṣṭibhir āhatau || 15.86 devasya pūrvabhittau tu prādurbhāvān prakalpayet | puṣṭis tuṣṭis tathā kīrtī ratiḥ śāntiḥ sarasvatī || 15.87 prasūnamañjarīhastāḥ sitacāmaravījanāḥ | sarveṣām upariṣṭāt tu kuryāj jaladapaddhatim || 15.88 upariṣṭāc ca meghānāṃ devāś ca ṛṣayas tathā | indrādayaś ca dikpālāḥ ṛṣayaḥ sapta daṇḍinaḥ || 15.89 sottarīyāś ca sarve te racitāñjalayaḥ sthitāḥ | mūrdhni pārśve ca viṣṇuś ca rudraś caiva caturbhujau || 15.90 devasya purato bhittau kuryān meghapathopari | hāhā hūhūś ca gandharvau kinnarastumburus tathā || 15.91 sarve cāpsarasaṅghātā <�saṃghātā> nṛttagītaratāḥ sadā | anantaśayane ramye pūrvavat tatra kalpite || 15.92 caturbhujaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ | pītāmbaradharaḥ saumyaḥ karṇāntāyatalocanaḥ || 15.93 dakṣiṇe ca bhuje mauliṃ prasāritatalāṅgulau | nidhāya maulipaṭṭāntaṃ prasāritabhujetaraḥ || 15.94 śayito rājavad devaḥ kiñcid dvāranirīkṣakaḥ | sarve citreṇa rūpeṇa bhittisthāḥ pūrvam īritāḥ || 15.95 uttamaṃ sṛṣṭiśayanam etad āhur manīṣiṇaḥ | madhyamā sṛṣṭiśayyā bāhudvayasamopetaḥ śyāmalaḥ komalākṛtiḥ || 15.96 pṛṣṭhataḥ skandhapārśve tu prāk ca padmā pratiṣṭhitā | brahmāṇaṃ bhittipārśve tu citreṇaiva prakalpayet || 15.97 sanakaṃ ca mahīṃ caiva pūjāpīṭhasya pārśvayoḥ | ardhacitreṇa śeṣāḥ syuḥ sṛṣṭiśayyā tu madhyamā || 15.98 kanīyasī sargaśayyā śriyaṃ mahīm adhastāc ca bhūtale pīṭhapārśvayoḥ | brahmāṇaṃ bhittipārśve tu citrābhāsena kalpayet || 15.99 bhujadvayasamopetaḥ padmanābhaś caturmukha | pralayodadhimadhyasthaḥ śayitā viśvakāraṇam || 15.100 ābhāsenaiva kuḍyasthā sargaśayyā kanīyasī ||
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde sthityāsanādibhedanirṇayo nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
yānārūḍhamūrtilakṣaṇaṃ tatra uttamam śrībhagavān yānārūḍhasya bhedo 'yaṃ adhunā saṃpradarśyate | vainateyaṃ suvarṇābhaṃ pakṣamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam || 16.1 nīlāgranāsāsaṃyuktaṃ nāgendrābharaṇair yutam | skandhe cāruhya caraṇaṃ vāmamākuñcya dakṣiṇam || 16.2 prasārya caraṇaṃ devo bhujāṣṭakasamanvitaḥ | cakrapadmāsiviśikhān dhārayan dakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥ || 16.3 śaṅkhaṃ kaumodakīṃ carma cāpam anyaiḥ karair dadhat | pṛṣṭhato bhittipārśve tu ātapatraṃ suradrumam || 16.4 sanandasanakau bhittau pārśvayoś candrabhāskarau | yathā svavāhane devāḥ samāruhya sthitā yadi || 16.5 arcanāpīṭhikāpārśve śrīmahyau tu kṛtāñjalī | surāsuramunīn nāgān siddhavidyādharāṃs tathā || 16.6 gandharvāpsaraso meghān kārayed bhittibhūmiṣu | sarve citreṇa saṃyuktā yānārohaṇam uttamam || 16.7 madhyamā mūrtiḥ devaṃ caturbhujaṃ kṛtvā śaṅkhacakragadādharam | vāmotsaṅge samāropya ratiṃ dāḍimasannibhām <�saṃnibhām> || 16.8 pāśāṅkuśadharāṃ devīṃ kāmavihvalalocanām | arcanāpīṭhikāpārśve śriyaṃ bhūmiṃ ca kārayet || 16.9 nāradaś ca bhṛguś caiva kuḍye cāmaradhāriṇau | prītiṃ sarasvatīṃ śāntiṃ kalpayed yāmya bhūmiṣu || 16.10 puṣṭiṃ tuṣṭiṃ ca kīrtiṃ ca kuḍye vāme tu kārayet | puṣpamañjarihastāś ca sitacāmaravījanāḥ || 16.11 ardhacitreṇa vā sarve ābhāsenaiva vā vidhiḥ | madhyamo vāhanārohaḥ śṛṇu nīcaṃ caturmukha || 16.12 jaghanyā mūrtiḥ caturbhujaṃ viśālākṣaṃ bhinnāñjana samaprabham | mukhyābhyāṃ caiva hastābhyāṃ śārṅgapañcaśarān api || 16.13 ūrdhvābhyām itarābhyāṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ ca dhārayan | niṣṭaptakanakaprakhyāṃ vāmotsaṅgasamarpitām || 16.14 lāvaṇyāmṛtatoyena siñcantīm iva sarvataḥ | dakṣiṇaṃ puṣpahastaṃ vā vāmahastaṃ vasupradam || 16.15 arcanāpīṭhikāpārśve ratiṃ śāntiṃ ca kārayet | citrābhāsena kuḍyasthāḥ nīcaṃ yānādhirohaṇam || 16.16 viśvarūpamūrtiḥ tatra uttamā viśvarūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu paṅkajasambhava | dvipādam ekakaṇṭhaṃ ca caturdikṣu caturmukham || 16.17 vāsudevamukhād ūrdhvaṃ sarvadevamukhāni tu | saṅkarṣaṇamukhād ūrdhvaṃ sarvarṣīṇāṃ mukhāni ca || 16.18 pradyumnasya mūkhād ūrdhvaṃ daityadānavarakṣasām | aniruddhamukhād ūrdhvaṃ nāgagandharvakinnarāḥ <�kiṃnarāḥ> || 16.19 mukhāny etāni cānyāni yathāvibhavamādarāt | kartavyāni caturvaktra samarthāni vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 16.20 upariṣṭāc ca vaktrāṇāṃ kirīṭam atiśobhanam | kuryād yugapadudbhūtaṃ sahasrādityavarcasam || 16.21 anekabhujasaṃyuktam anekāyudhabhūṣitam | arcitaṃ brahmarudrābhyāṃ bhittibhūmiṣu devatāḥ || 16.22 citreṇa sarve vihitāḥ viśvarūpaḥ sa uttamaḥ | madhyamā mūrtiḥ sarve yathoktāḥ kuḍyastāḥ ardhacitreṇa cetkṛtāḥ || 16.23 sanandasanakau kuryāt pūjāpīṭhasya pārśvayoḥ | madhyamā viśvamūrtiḥ syāt jaghanyām api saṃśṛṇu || 16.24 jaghanyā viśvamūrtiḥ ābhāsenaiva kuḍyasthāḥ devyau pūjāsane sthite | caturbhir bāhubhir yuktaḥ vāsudevaś ca śāśvataḥ || 16.25 mukhyābhyāṃ dhārayan savyadakṣiṇābhyāṃ gadāmbuje | ūrdhvābhyām itarābhyāṃ tu śaṅkhacakre yathātatham || 16.26 athavā dakṣiṇo hastaḥ varado 'bhayado 'pi vā | gadāṃ vinā vāmahastaḥ kaṭideśāvalambitaḥ || 16.27 dvibhujo vā bahubhujo yukto 'nekais tathānanaiḥ | ekena vā sito varṇo vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ || 16.28 evaṃ nārāyaṇo 'nādirnīlanīradasannibhaḥ <�saṃnibhaḥ> | caturviṃśatimūrtilakṣaṇam caturviṃśatimūrtīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate 'dhunā || 16.29 keśavasyāmbujaṃ śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ daṇḍas tathāyudham | prādakṣiṇyena bāhūnāṃ anyeṣām ucyate kramāt || 16.30 nārāyaṇaḥ śaṅkhapadmagadācakradharaḥ smṛtaḥ | mādhavo gadayā sārdhaṃ cakraśaṅkhāmbujāyudhaḥ || 16.31 govindaś cakradaṇḍāmjaśaṅkhāyudhadharo bhavet | viṣṇur gadābjaśaṅkhāridharaḥ syān madhusūdanaḥ || 16.32 cakraśaṅkhābjadaṇḍāstradharaḥ kāryas trivikramaḥ | padmadaṇḍāriśaṅkhāstro vāmanaḥ śaṅkhacakradhṛk || 16.33 gadābjapāṇiś ca tathā śrīdharo dhṛtavārijaḥ | sārdhaṃ cakragadāśaṅkhaiḥ hṛṣīkeśamataḥ śṛṇu || 16.34 gadācakrābjaśaṅkhāstradharaḥ paṅkaja nābhakaḥ | padmacakrāmbujagadādharo dāmodaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 16.35 abjaśaṅkhagadācakradharo dvādaśamūrtayaḥ | etāḥ kaumodakīśaṅkhacakrāmbhojadharāḥ smṛtāḥ || 16.36 vāsudevo jagadyoniḥ saṅkarṣaṇamataḥ śṛṇu | gadāśaṅkhābjacakrāṇi dhārayantaṃ caturbhujam || 16.37 pradyumnaḥ cakraśaṅkhābhyāṃ saha daṇḍasarojavān | aniruddho 'ridaṇḍābjapadmapāṇiś caturbhujaḥ || 16.38 cakrapadmāmbujaiḥ sārdhaṃ gadāvān puruṣottamaḥ | adhokṣajaḥ padmadaṇḍaśaṅkhacakradharaḥ smṛtaḥ || 16.39 nṛsiṃhaś cakrajalajagadāśaṅkhadharaḥ smṛtaḥ | acyuto daṇḍapadmāriśaṅkhahastaś caturbhujaḥ || 16.40 janārdanaḥ padmacakraśaṅkhadaṇḍaś caturbhujaḥ | upendraḥ śaṅkhadaṇḍāripadmāyudhavibhūṣitaḥ || 16.41 śaṅkhacakrābjadaṇḍāstraḥ hariḥ syāt kamalāsana | kṛṣṇaḥ śaṅkhagadāpadmacakrapāṇiś caturbhujaḥ || 16.42 dakṣiṇaṃ hastam ārabhya prādakṣiṇyena kārayet | mūrticihnāni śaṅkhādīny āyudhāni vicakṣaṇaḥ || 16.43 vāsudevaḥ padmanābhaḥ nārāyaṇajanārdanau | eteṣāṃ varṇabhedo 'sti na viśeṣo 'sti cāyudhaiḥ || 16.44 pītāmbaradharāḥ sarvāś caturviṃśatimūrtayaḥ | śrīvatsakaustubhākalpavanamālāvibhūṣitāḥ || 16.45 bhogārthinaś ced bhittisthān devībhyāṃ sthāpayet saha | vinā tābhyāṃ mokṣakāmāḥ sthāpayeyur yathāvidhi || 16.46 āsanasthānaśayanayānādiṣu yathāvidhi | brahmādimūrtyaṣṭakam aṣṭau vakṣye parā mūrtistāsu brāhmī praśasyate || 16.47 prājāpatyā dvitīyā tu tṛtīyā vaiṣṇavī matā | daivī caturthī tadanu mūrtirārṣī caturmukha || 16.48 ṣaṣṭhī tu mānuṣī jñeyā saptamī mūrtirāsurī | paiśācī mūrtir anyā syāt tāsāṃ lakṣaṇam ucyate || 16.49 brāhmī prathamāṣṭabhujā taptatapanīyasamadyutiḥ | bhujeṣu mukhyo varado dakṣiṇeṣv itare trayaḥ || 16.50 cakrāsibāṇaiḥ saṃyukto vāme hastacatuṣṭaye | śaṅkhaṃ gadāṃ tathā carma śārṅgaṃ kuryāc caturmukha || 16.51 pītāmbaradharo devo vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ | marīcinā ca bhṛguṇā pūjitaś ca maharṣiṇā || 16.52 prājāpatyā śaṅkhakundenduvarṇābhaḥ pītavāsāś caturbhujaḥ | śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇirabhayena virājitaḥ || 16.53 vanamālādharaḥ saumyaḥ sanakena supūjitaḥ | sanatkumāreṇa ca tathā mūrtir eṣā prajāpateḥ || 16.54 vaiṣṇavī bhinnāñjanacayaḥ saumyaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ | pītāmbaradharo devo vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || 16.55 varado dakṣiṇo hastaḥ svāgatā 'bhayado 'pi vā | vāmena spṛṣṭakaṭibhūḥ śrībhūmibhyāṃ saha sthitaḥ || 16.56 nāradenā 'pi bhṛguṇā vaiṣṇavī mūrtir arcitā | daivī śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaṃ dhārayantaṃ caturbhujam || 16.57 śyāmalaṃ pītavasanaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam | arcitaṃ brahmarudrābhyāṃ daivī mūrtir asau bhavet || 16.58 ārṣī śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśā <śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśā> pītavastrā caturbhujā | dakṣiṇe jñānamudrā ca śaṅkhacakragadādharā || 16.59 śrīvatsāṅkā prasannāsyā vanamālāvibhūṣitā | sanandasanakābhyāṃ ca pūjitā mūrtir āruṣī || 16.60 mānuṣī mūrtiḥ mānuṣī mūrtir adhunā kathyate kamalāsana | caturaśrāyate dhāmni divye bhāge bhujadvayam || 16.61 śaṅkhacakradharaṃ saumyaṃ sthāpayen makuṭojvalam | devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve śriyaṃ devīṃ prakalpayet || 16.62 tasya dakṣiṇato bhāge balabhadraṃ tu kārayet | dakṣiṇe balabhadrasya pradyumnam api kārayet || 16.63 devasya vāmapārśve tu aniruddhaṃ prakalpayet | tasya pārśve tu vāme tu sāmbaṃ kuryāc caturmukha || 16.64 brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe kuḍye savye tu vinatātmajam | sthānake sthānakāḥ proktā āsīne 'pi tathā bhavet || 16.65 caturbhujā tu karmārcā dvibhujā vāpi sā bhavet | utsavārcā pratikṛtiḥ sarvā caiva caturbhujāḥ || 16.66 mānuṣaṃ vāsudevasya proktaṃ saṃkṣepato vidhiḥ | āsurī āsurī mūrtir asitā ekavaktrā caturbhujā || 16.67 daṃṣṭrākarālavadanā bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇā | mukhye karadvaye bāṇaṃ dhanur ūrdhve 'riśaṅkhakam || 16.68 śārṅgahastaṃ lalāṭāntam uddhared bāṇahastakam | nābhyantaṃ kaṭisūtrāntaṃ bhaṅgatrayasamanvitam || 16.69 peśācī paiśācī mūrtir ādyā tu khaḍgakaumodakī tathā | varadābhayadaṃ mukhyaṃ kālavarṇaṃ karadvayam || 16.70 daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam | aṣṭau ca mūrtayaḥ sarvāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 16.71 śrīvatsakaustubhoraskāḥ vanamālāvibhūṣitāḥ | āsāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāḥ phalam sthāpitā brahmaṇo mūrtiḥ brahmabhūyāya kalpate || 16.72 prājāpatyapratiṣṭhāyāṃ prajābhir vardhate bhṛśam | ante prajāpatipadaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 16.73 sthāpitā vaiṣṇavī mūrtir acirān mokṣadā bhavet | daivī devatvaphaladā sarvakāmasamṛddhidā || 16.74 ārṣī mūrtir maharṣitvaprāptaye bhavati dhruvam | śāpānugrahasāmarthyam api tasya bhaviṣyati || 16.75 mānuṣī mūrtir acirād yaśase mahate bhavet | trailokyaiśvaryasampac ca sarvakālaṃ bhaviṣyati || 16.76 āsurīṃ mūrtim ārādhya rakṣasāṃ ditijanmanām | bhūtādīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ adhipatyaṃ samaśnate || 16.77 paiśācamūrtiyajane piśācāsurarākṣasāḥ | vaśyā bhavanti sarve ca sarvakāmasamṛddhidāḥ || 16.78
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde yānārūḍhaviśvarūpādilakṣaṇaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
matsyādimūrtinirūpaṇam śrībhagavān matsyādidaśamūrtīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kathyate 'dhunā | īṣadvai sthūlacitrāṇi tais tair vaktrair yutāni ca || 17.1 matsyamūrtiḥ tatra matsyasya kāyaś ca dairdhyādvai ṣoḍaśāṅgulam | daśāṅgulaṃ tu vaipulyānmīnākhyaṃ parikalpayet || 17.2 śūlaṃ matsyākṛtiṃ kṛtvā śilābhṛtkāṣṭhajaṃ tu vā | ardhacitreṇa vā kuryāc citrābhāsena vā punaḥ || 17.3 samudraṃ tu likhed bhittau citrādīn parikalpayet | pañcāyudhān likhed bhittau chatrādīn parikalpayet || 17.4 nāradenāpi manunā samabhyarcitamādarāt | karmārcādīni bimbāni saumyavaktrāś caturbhujāḥ || 17.5 āsīnā vā sthitā vāpi śaṅkhacakragadādharāḥ | kūrmamūrtiḥ kūrmavatkūrmamūrtiṃ tu kalpayet kamalāsana || 17.6 tapanīyanibhaṃ kūrmaṃ vistāraṃ dvādaśāṅgulam | śilāmṛtkāṣṭhajaṃ padmapīṭhe saṃsthāpayet prabhum || 17.7 ābhāse vārdhacitre vā kṣīrodamathanaṃ likhet | kacchapendrasya pṛṣṭhe tu mandaraṃ parvatottamam || 17.8 tasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu vāsudevaṃ sanātanam | mandarasya girer agre nyastahastaṃ jagadgurum || 17.9 vāmapārśve gires tasya brahmāṇaṃ saha śaṅkaram | vāsukeḥ pūrvabhāgaṃ tu gṛhṇanty asurarākṣasāḥ || 17.10 pucchabhāgaṃ tu gṛhṇanti vāsuker devatāgaṇāḥ | karmārcādīni bimbāni saumyavaktrāścarbhujāḥ || 17.11 varāhamūrtiḥ viṣṇor mahāvarāhasya nirmāṇam adhunocyate | naravatkaṇṭhaparyantaṃ vaktrasṛṣṭir varāhavat || 17.12 caturbhujaṃ śaṅkhacakradhāriṇaṃ sphaṭikaprabham | pītavastraṃ mukuṭinaṃ
