śyāmalākṛtim eva vā || 17.13 sa tiryak saṃsthitaṃ sūtre daivike sthāpayet pade | śayanaṃ yānakaṃ caiva varāhasya tu neṣyate || 17.14 sthāpayed ekaberaṃ tu śaṅkhacakragadādharam | āsane 'pi tathā rūpaṃ brahmasthāne ṛjur bhavet || 17.15 divye tu sthānake caiva ṛjvaṅgaṃ naiva kārayet | uddhṛtya dharaṇīṃ devīṃ vāmahastasya kūrpare || 17.16 kaṭipradeśamālambya pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu | jighran devyāḥ stanaṃ devaḥ śrīvatsāṅkaḥ kirīṭavān || 17.17 kṛtāñjalipuṭā devīṃ śyāmavarṇā sumadhyamā | kalpanīyā mahī devī deve tiṣṭhati padmaja || 17.18 āsīne tu tathāsīnā puṣpahastā vasundharā | vāme pārśve pratiṣṭhāpya varāhavapuṣo hareḥ || 17.19 āropitavyā devasya vāmotsaṅge vasundharā | āliṅgitā ca hastena vāmena prekṣitānanā || 17.20 karmārcanādipratimā āsīnā vā sthitā 'pi vā | devyā saha kroḍavaktrās saumyavaktrāś caturbhujāḥ || 17.21 nṛsiṃhamūrtiḥ nṛsiṃhamūrtir bahudhā tatra kācit pradarśyate | vaktraṃ kesariṇo vaktraṃ vyāttāsyaṃ daṃṣṭrayā yutam || 17.22 bhrukuṭīkuṭilaṃ bhīmaṃ triṇetraṃ mukuṭojvalam | aṅgāntaraṃ narasyeva caturbhujam udāyudham || 17.23 raktakañcukasaṃyuktaṃ śrīvatsāṅkavirājitam | śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ śaṅkhacakravirājitam || 17.24 paryaṅkabandhasaṃyuktam āsīnaṃ samyag āsane | prasārya jānunor hastau mukhyau vistāritāṅgulī || 17.25 dambholibhīmanakhinau bhāge divye pratiṣṭhitam | ekaberavidhānaṃ ced āsīno vā sthito 'pi vā || 17.26 śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ sthitaś cet kamalāsana | athavā daivike bhāge siṃhaviṣṭaraviṣṭhitam || 17.27 śrībhūmībhyāṃ sahāsīnaṃ bandhaparyaṅkabandhanam | yadvā bhūmitale pādam ekaṃ saṃsthāpya dakṣiṇam || 17.28 apareṇa sukhāsīno viṣṭare vipule dṛḍham | yadvā prasārya jānūrdhvam utkṣipyopari jānunaḥ || 17.29 vāmahastaṃ prasāryānyahastaṃ kṛtvā 'bhayapradam | dakṣiṇaṃ jānuno 'dhastāt sthāpayitvā tathāsane || 17.30 śrībhūmīsahito divye tiṣṭhan bhāge yathāpuram | yadvāṣṭabhujasaṃyuktaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ parikalpayet || 17.31 cakraṃ khaḍgaṃ ca bāṇaṃ ca abhayaṃ dakṣiṇe bhuje | pāñcajanyaṃ gadāṃ śārṅgaṃ vāmabāhuṣu kārayet || 17.32 jānūpari tathā vāmaṃ hastam ekaṃ prasārayet | yadvā bhujayugaṃ jānudvayasyopari kalpayet || 17.33 athavā ṣoḍaśabhujo narasiṃhaḥ praśasyate | cakraṃ khaḍgaṃ saparaśuṃ śūlaṃ bāṇaṃ tathā 'ṅkuśam || 17.34 vajraṃ ca dakṣiṇabhujapradeśeṣv itareṣv api | śaṅkhaṃ carma gadāṃ śaktiṃ śārṅgaṃ pāśaṃ ca tomaram || 17.35 śiṣṭau karau yathāpūrvaṃ sthāpayej jānunor dvayoḥ | vāmajānūrdhvakaṃ kuryād adhastād itaraṃ punaḥ || 17.36 utsaṅge devadevasya hiraṇyakaśipuṃ ripum | nakhair vidāritoraskaṃ sravadrudhirapiṅgalam || 17.37 rudhiraṃstomasaṃbhūtasirāṇāṃ grāmasaṅkulam <�saṃkulam> | kuryāc ca dakṣiṇe pārśve vidhim anyatra śaṅkaram || 17.38 prahlādaṃ garuḍaṃ cāpi pārśvayos tatra kārayet | svatantre narasiṃhe tu karmabimbāni kārayet || 17.39 caturbhujaṃ vā sarvatra cāsīnaṃ susthitaṃ tu vā | śrībhūmīsahitaṃ vāpi rahitaṃ vāpi kārayet || 17.40 karmārcanādipratimāṃ saumyavaktrāṃ caturbhujām | vāmanamūrtiḥ vāmanasya harer mūrtiṃ bahudhā saṃpracakṣate || 17.41 vāmanaṃ vāmanākāraṃ śyāmalaṃ daṇḍadhāriṇam | dvibhujaṃ mekhalādāmaśobhitaṃ śobhanākṛtim || 17.42 kaupīnācchādanadharaṃ mṛgājinadharaṃ vibhum | yajñopavītinaṃ kākapakṣasaṃyutakuntalam || 17.43 īṣatkuñcitasavyāṅghriṃ dakṣiṇena ṛju sthitam | dakṣiṇena tu hastena yācamānaṃ vasundharām || 17.44 śobhitaṃ śobhanākāraṃ sthitaṃ vā śayanāsanam | athavā garuḍārūḍhaṃ kalpayet kamalāsana || 17.45 ekaberavidhānaṃ cet sthāpayed brahmaṇaḥ pade | bahuberavidhānaṃ tu trailokyakramaṇodyatam || 17.46 viṣṇuṃ prakalpayed divye bhāge 'ṣṭabhujasaṃyutam | caturbhujaṃ vā bahubhir bāhubhir vā samanvitam || 17.47 tasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu vāmanaṃ vāmanākṛtim | tasyāpasavye daityendraṃ baliṃ karakadhāriṇam || 17.48 bhuvanatrayadātāraṃ sabhāyāṃ sapurohitam | vāmapārśve tu pakṣīndraṃ muṣṭinā śukraghātinam || 17.49 vāmabhittau vidhātāram upariṣṭādavasthitam | kramamāṇasya devasya savyāṅghrikṣālanodyatam || 17.50 pādodakasamudbhūtāṃ gaṅgāmākāśagāminīm | tarjanyā vāmayā cāpi nirdiśantaṃ samuddhṛtam || 17.51 caraṇaṃ savyamatyuccaśyāmalaṃ pītavāsasam | śaṅkhacakragadākhaḍgadhanuḥpāśādidhāriṇam || 17.52 jāmbavantaṃ ca bhittau tu bherītāḍanatatparam | devarṣigaṇasaṅghātān kṛtāñjalipuṭān sthitān || 17.53 bhittau kṛtvā tataḥ karmādyarcāṃ caiva caturbhujām || 17.54 bhārgavarāmamūrtiḥ kuryād bhārgavarāmasya nirmāṇam adhunocyate | āsīnaṃ dvibhujaṃ śāntaṃ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam || 17.55 paraśuṃ saśaraṃ cāpaṃ dakṣiṇetarahastayoḥ | dhārayantaṃ suvarṇābhaṃ brāhmyā lakṣmyā virājitam || 17.56 śrīvatsenāṅkitoraskaṃ sopavītottarīyakam | sthitaṃ vā kalpayed devam ekaberaṃ vidheḥ pade || 17.57 bahubere pade divye devīṃ vāme prakalpayet | caturbhujā ca karmārcā jāmadagnyena vā samā || 17.58 bhaṅgatrayasamopetaṃ trayas triṃśatsulakṣaṇam | yadvā caturbhujaṃ kuryāj jāmadagnyaṃ caturmukha || 17.59 śaṅkhacakradharaṃ śārṅgaśarahastaṃ yathāpuram | śrīrāmamūrtiḥ rāmasya rāghavasyā 'tha lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate 'dhunā || 17.60 tribhaṅgaṃ dvibhujaṃ ramyaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ kirīṭinam | śrīvatsāṅkaṃ prasannābhaṃ yadvā rāmaṃ caturbhujam || 17.61 ṛju sthitaṃ dakṣiṇena caraṇenetareṇa tu | kañcitenā 'ṅghriṇā stokaṃ śarasārṅgadhanurdharam || 17.62 uddharec ca lalāṭāntaṃ vāmahastaṃ dhanurdharam | antarālaṃ mukhamitaṃ śarahastaṃ tu dakṣiṇam || 17.63 kaṭisūtrasamaṃ kuryān mukhamānaṃ sagolakam | antarālaṃ bhaven muṣṭeḥ kaṭisūtrasya ca dvayoḥ || 17.64 aparābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ ca dhārayet | mukhaṃ dakṣiṇato bhaṅgaṃ madhyakāyaṃ tu vāmataḥ || 17.65 kaṭyāṃ dakṣiṇato bhaṅgaḥ kiñcid bhaṅgatrayaṃ matam | kambugrīvaṃ mahoraskaṃ trayas triṃśatsulakṣaṇam || 17.66 pañcadīrghaṃ caturhrasvaṃ pañcasūkṣmaṃ ṣaḍunnatam | saptaraktaṃ trigambhīraṃ trivistīrṇaṃ praśasyate || 17.67 bāhū netrāntaraṃ caiva hanurnāsā tathaiva ca | stanayor antaraṃ caiva pañcadīrghaṃ praśasyate || 17.68 grīvā prajananaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ hrasve jaṅghe praśasyate | sūkṣmāṇy aṅguliparvāṇi keśadantanakhatvacaḥ || 17.69 imāni pañca sūkṣmāṇi kathitāni mayā 'nagha | kakṣaḥ kukṣiś ca vakṣaś ca ghrāṇaṃ skandho lalāṭikā || 17.70 ṣaḍunnatam idaṃ proktaṃ saptaraktam ataḥ śṛṇu | pāṇipādatalaṃ raktaṃ netrādyantaṃ nakhāni ca || 17.71 tālujihvādharoṣṭhaṃ ca saptaraktā ime smṛtāḥ | svaraḥ satvaṃ ca nābhiś ca trigambhīraṃ praśasyate || 17.72 uraḥ śiro lalāṭaś ca trivistīrṇaṃ prakīrtitam | evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham | 17.73 kuryād dāśarathiṃ rāmaṃ mānāditrayasaṃyutam | lakṣmaṇādīnāṃ sthitiḥ lakṣmaṇaṃ kārayed vāme tathā lakṣaṇalakṣitam || 17.74 jānakīṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve devīṃ vedisamutthitām | bharataṃ dakṣiṇe bhittau samugrīvavibhīṣaṇam || 17.75 śatrughnaṃ cāṅgadaṃ caiva hanūmantaṃ ca vāmataḥ | divye bhāge sthitasyaivaṃ parivārādikalpanam || 17.76 bhadrāsane samāsīnaṃ tyaktvā tatsaśaraṃ dhanuḥ | abhayo dakṣiṇo hasto vāmas tu varado bhavet || 17.77 jānakī tu sukhāsīnā bhaved dakṣiṇapārśvataḥ | lakṣmaṇo vāmapārśve tu sthitaś ca racitāñjaliḥ || 17.78 yadvā mahārhaśayane śayānaṃ parikalpayet | pṛṣṭhato maulipārśve tu jānakī syāt sukhāsanā || 17.79 kuḍyasthāḥ pūrvavat sarve kartavyā lakṣmaṇādayaḥ | pavanātmajamārūḍho yānaṃ vā saśarāsanaḥ || 17.80 ekaberavidhāne tu rāghavo brahmaṇaḥ pade | śaracāpadharaṃ kuryāt sthitaṃ lakṣaṇalakṣitam || 17.81 athavā 'bhayadaṃ hastaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇetaram | kaṭispṛśaṃ karaṃ kuryāt varadaṃ vā yathāruci || 17.82 dakṣiṇottarayor bhityoḥ parivārā yathāpuram | rāmasya bhūpradeśāntaṃ bharataṃ parikalpayet || 17.83 lakṣmaṇaṃ ca kapolāntaṃ cubukāntam athāpi vā | śatrughnaṃ kaṇṭhamadhyāntaṃ sarve cāpaśarānvitāḥ || 17.84 bhaṅgādayaś ca tadvat syuḥ keśabandhasamanvitāḥ | mukhadviguṇamāyāmamadhyardhaṃ vā samunnatam || 17.85 keśabandho bhaved eṣāṃ śrīvatsarahitās tathā | vāmaṃ yaṣṭidharaṃ hastaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ bharatasya vā || 17.86 vāmaṃ devyā bhuje nyastaṃ svātantrye parikalpayet | śatrughno lakṣmaṇaś cāpi svātantrye bharato yathā || 17.87 bharataḥ śyāmalākāro lakṣmaṇaḥ kanakaprabhaḥ | śatrughno raktavarṇābhaḥ śrīmallakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥ || 17.88 māṇḍavī bharatasya syād ūrmilā lakṣmaṇasya tu | śrutakīrtir bhaved devī śatrughnasyāmbujāsana || 17.89 sītā śrīr iva kartavyā kalyāṇabahulakṣaṇā | karaṇḍikā maulidharā kaberī bālakair yutā || 17.90 bibhrāṇā vāmahastena sarasīruhakuḍmalam | ūrupradeśaviśrāntavāmetarabhujā 'thavā || 17.91 ūrupradeśaviśrāntasavyahastasaroruhā | savyetareṇa bibhrāṇā raktakañcukabandhanā || 17.92 hiraṇyavarṇā sītā syān māṇḍavī pāṭalaprabhā | ūrmilā śyāmavarṇābhā śrutakīrtiḥ sitaprabhā || 17.93 dhammillasaṃyutā devyo bharatādeś caturmukha | hanūmānvā narākāraḥ kartavyo hemasannibhaḥ <�saṃnibhaḥ> || 17.94 kuñcitāgramahāvālaṃ prahvakāyam avasthitam | āsyaṃ pidhāya hastena dakṣiṇe netareṇa tu || 17.95 vastrapradeśamācchādya vinītavad avasthitam | keśabandhayutaṃ kuryād ucchrāyastasya vakṣyate || 17.96 rāmasya bāhuparyantam unmānaṃ tryaṃśam eva vā | ardhaṃ vā pādam athavā yathāvibhavam unnatiḥ || 17.97 sugrīvaṃ vānarākāraṃ rāmabāhusamucchrayam | prāñjaliṃ vetrasahitaṃ sthitaṃ mukuṭadhāriṇam || 17.98 hārādibhūṣaṇair yuktaṃ kuryāt kanakapiṅgalam | aṅgadaṃ vānarākāraṃ rāmamānārdham unnatam || 17.99 kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ vetrakṣurikāmaulidhāriṇam | keśabandhayutaṃ vāpi bandhujīvasamadyutim || 17.100 vibhīṣaṇaṃ mahākāyaṃ ghoraṃ kālāyasaprabham | daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam || 17.101 raktākṣaṃ mukuṭopetaṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ sthitam | rāmasya bāhuparyantaṃ samucchrāyaṃ prakalpayet || 17.102 kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ saumyaṃ niṣādādhipatiṃ guham | nīlanīrada saṃkāśaṃ rāmamānārdham unnatam || 17.103 svātantryaṃ pāratantryaṃ rāghavasyobhayaṃ bhavet | divye bhoge 'thavā brāhme garbhagehe sthito yadi || 17.104 svatantro rāghavaḥ proktaḥ pade pūrvodite yadi | caturbhujo garbhagehe kalpitaḥ kamalāsana || 17.105 paścād vimānaśobhārthaṃ kalpitaḥ paravānayam | svatantro rāghave bimbān karmādyarthaṃ prakalpayet || 17.106 anyāṃs tatsadṛśaṃ rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ janakātmajām | siṃhāsane sahaikasmin prabhayā ca pariṣkṛtān || 17.107 yadvā caturbhujān kuryāt karmādyarcāṃ caturmukha | dauvārikāṃś ca svātantrye kalpayed dvārapārśvayoḥ || 17.108 nalaṃ ca dakṣiṇe pārśve jāmbavantaṃ tathottare | jāmbavān svarṇavarṇābho nalaḥ śuklasamaprabhaḥ || 17.109 kṣurikāvetrahastau ca baddhakalyāṇakañcukau | nīlaṃ senāpatiṃ kṛtvā viṣvaksenapade nyaset || 17.110 guho vā tatra saṃsthāpyo viṣvakseno 'thavā svayam | rāmasya purataḥ kalpyaḥ mārutir mukhamaṇḍape || 17.111 garuḍo vā yathāpūrvaṃ parivārān prakalpayet | balarāmamūrtiḥ rāmasya balabhadrasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate 'dhunā || 17.112 dvibhujaṃ dhavalaṃ divye bhāge 'tha parikalpayet | musalaṃ lāṅgalaṃ caiva prasavyetarahastayoḥ || 17.113 bibhrāṇam athavā nyastavāmahastaṃ kaṭisthale | dakṣiṇābhayadaṃ yadvā caturbhujam udāyudham || 17.114 halaṃ ca dakṣiṇe haste vāme ca musalāyudham | dhārayantaṃ vibhuṃ nīlavasanaṃ śaṅkhacakriṇam || 17.115 kirīṭinaṃ baddhakeśam athavā vāmapārśvataḥ | revatīṃ kalpayed devīṃ dakṣiṇe vā yathāruci || 17.116 karaṇḍikāmakuṭinīm athavā kabarīdharām | asitāṃ pāratantrye ca svātantrye ca yathāpuram || 17.117
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde matsyādimūrtilakṣaṇaṃ nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
aṣṭādaso 'dhyāyaḥ
śrīkṛṣṇamūrtiḥ śrībhagavān yādavasyā 'tha kṛṣṇasya nirmāṇam adhunocyate | kalyāṇalakṣaṇayutaṃ tribhaṅgaṃ siṃhaviṣṭare || 18.1 tiṣṭhantaṃ rukmiṇīsatyabhāmābhyāṃ sahitaṃ prabhum | īṣatkuñcitavāmāṅghriṃ susthitetaram adbhutam || 18.2 meghaśyāmaṃ viśālākṣaṃ pītavastraṃ caturbhujam | devīsavyabhujanyastavāmahastasaroruham || 18.3 adhomukhaṃ tu hastāgraṃ nābhisūtrasamanvitam | vāmetarakaraspṛṣṭakrīḍāmuṣṭimanoharam || 18.4 tatkaraṃ kaṭisūtrāntam udaste tu karadvayam | śaṅkhacakradharaṃ kuryād dvibhujaṃ vā yathoditam || 18.5 śrīvatsāṅkaṃ prasannābhaṃ vareṇyaṃ makuṭojvalam | baddhālakadharaṃ vāpi bhāge divye prakalpayet || 18.6 rukmiṇīṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve satyabhāmām athottare | vinatānandanaṃ vāpi satyāsthāne prakalpayet || 18.7 āsīnaṃ vā sukhaṃ sārdhaṃ devībhyāṃ saha viṣṭare | vāmahastena varadaṃ dakṣiṇenābhayapradam || 18.8 yadvā śayīta nṛpavatparyaṅke śobhite bhṛśam | bhogīndraśayane vāpi mahāparyaṅkamaṇḍite || 18.9 pṛṣṭhato maulipārśve tu rukmiṇīṃ kārayet sudhīḥ | satyabhāmā bhavet pādasaṃvāhanasamudyatā || 18.10 saṃvāhayantyau vā devyau hastābhyāṃ pādapaṅkajam | tārkṣyārūḍhaṃ caturbāhuṃ bibhrāṇaṃ śarakārmukam || 18.11 mukhyābhyām aparābhyāṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ caturmukha | āropya satyabhāmāṃ vā vāmotsaṅge caturbhujam || 18.12 āruhya yāntaṃ pakṣīndraṃ dvibhujaṃ vā yathāruci | yadvārjunasya sārathyaṃ kurvāṇaṃ parikalpayet || 18.13 rathasthitaṃ caturbāhuṃ pratodapragrahau dadhat | vāmahastena mukhyena dakṣiṇena kareṇa tu || 18.14 kapidhvajāya prahvāya paravidyām udīrayan | aparābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ śaṅkhacakradharaṃ prabhum || 18.15 kirīṭinaṃ viśālākṣaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam | dvibhujaṃ baddhakeśaṃ vā kuryāt kamalasaṃbhava || 18.16 pārthaṃ ca prāñjaliṃ prahvaṃ seṣuṃ seṣudhikārmukam | kirīṭinaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ kalpayet syandanasthitam || 18.17 viśvarūpaṃ tu vā kuryāt keśavaṃ keśisūdanam | bṛndāvanagataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gavām anucaraṃ prabhum || 18.18 īṣatkuñcitavāmāṅghrimitareṇa ṛju sthitam | gacchantam api gāyantaṃ vaṃśena paramādbhutam || 18.19 īkṣamāṇaṃ manāk savye pārśve puṣpāvataṃsitam | vicitrapuṣpagrathitaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam || 18.20 barhibarhaiś ca rucirair vatsadāmavibhūṣaṇaiḥ | bhūṣitaṃ devagandharvasiddhacāraṇasevitam || 18.21 kadambamāle vā madhyaṃ dine kṛtvā pratiṣṭhitam | vyatyāsena sthitaṃ padbhyāṃ vāmena ṛjunāsthitam || 18.22 dakṣiṇaprapadenānyapṛṣṭhabhāgaspṛśā sthitam | gobhiḥ savatsair hariṇaiḥ pakṣibhiś ca samāvṛtam || 18.23 ṛṣibhir devagandharvaiḥ kinnarādyaiś ca sevitam | phaṇīndraṃ kāliyaṃ yadvā phaṇāpañcakasaṃyutam || 18.24 purataḥ puruṣākāraṃ nāgākāraṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ | kṛtāñjaliṃ durādharṣamākramya śirasi sthitam || 18.25 vāmapādena gṛhṇantaṃ pucchaṃ vāmena pāṇinā | dakṣiṇābhayadaṃ hastaṃ nṛtyantaṃ kārayed budhaḥ || 18.26 athavā kṛtatāṭaṅkaṃ kurvāṇaṃ nāṭyam adbhutam | mahiṣīṃ nāgarājasya bhikṣamāṇāṃ svakaṃ patim || 18.27 kṛtāñjalipuṭāṃ devīṃ tatpārśve vepitāṃ sthitām | rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ yadvā kuryāj jagadgurum || 18.28 devyor gṛhītvā hastābhyāṃ karāgraṃ madhyataḥ sthitam | nṛtyantaṃ bahusāhasragopakanyābhir āvṛtam || 18.29 navanītāya nṛtyantaṃ savyena ṛjunā sthitam | uddhṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ viparītam athāpi vā || 18.30 kārayed vāmahastaṃ tu cibukāntasamucchrayam | abhītidaṃ dakṣiṇena varadaṃ vā yathāruci || 18.31 madhyataḥ stananābhyoś ca varado hasta iṣyate | yādavendreṇa kṛṣṇena krīḍayā yady athāśritam || 18.32 kalpayitvā vapus tattadārādhyaṃ vibhavārthibhiḥ | ekaberavidhānaṃ cet sthāpayed brahmaṇaḥ pade || 18.33 karmārcādīni bimbāni kalpayed raghuvīravat | rukmiṇīsatyabhāmābhyāṃ saha pīṭhe prakalpayet || 18.34 rukmiṇī kanakaprakhyā satyānyā śyāmalā bhavet | karaṇḍikā mukuṭinī yadvā dhammilladhāriṇī || 18.35 satyabhāmā kare padmaṃ dhārayed dakṣiṇe param | ūrau viśrāmayed anyau dhārayed anyathā 'thavā || 18.36 yathokataravinyāsakalpanaṃ kamalāsana | bālye 'pi yāyā devī syāt sā sā kalpyā yathāvidhi || 18.37 kalkimūrtiḥ nirmāṇam adhunā vakṣye kalkiviṣṇor mahātmanaḥ | piṅgaśmaśruṃ vivṛttākṣaṃ raktābhaṃ hayavāhanam || 18.38 dvibhujaṃ carmavasanaṃ khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇam | jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyuktaṃ brāhmalakṣmyā virājitam || 18.39 paiśāce yānakaṃ kuryāt divye bhāge sthitir bhavet | yadvā caturbhujaṃ kuryān mukhyābhyāṃ khaḍgakheṭakau || 18.40 aparābhyāṃ śaṅkhacakre hastābhyāṃ dadhataṃ harim | āsane kheṭakaṃ khaḍgaṃ na kurvīta kadācana || 18.41 abhayaṃ varadaṃ caiva karayugmaṃ prakalpayet | śayanaṃ neṣyate tasya kalkiviṣṇor mahātmanaḥ || 18.42 ekaberavidhānaṃ cet kalpayed brahmaṇaḥ pade | āsīnaṃ sthānakaṃ caiva bhāge divye prakalpayet || 18.43 tasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu yājñavalkyaṃ purohitam | nāradaṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve bhittibhūmiṣu devatāḥ || 18.44 kalpayej jaṅgamān bimbān dvijanmānaś caturbhujān | abhayaṃ varadaṃ caiva dvau bhujau parikalpayet || 18.45 caturbhuje śaṅkhacakre dvayor aparayor bhavet | karmabimbasāmānyalakṣaṇam śrīvatsenāṅkitoraskān jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyutān || 18.46 kirīṭino vā kurvīta karmabimbāṃś ca lohajān | viṣṇor aṃśāvatārāṇāṃ karmārcādyāstu kautukāḥ || 18.47 kalpanīyāś caturhastā dvibhujā vā yathāruci | daśatālena mīyante varāhādyāś ca mūrtayaḥ || 18.48 bāhyāṃś cābhyantarāṃś caiva parivārān prakalpayet | ādimūrter yathā tadvan na viśeṣo 'sti kaścana || 18.49 lakṣmīnārāyaṇamūrtiḥ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ kuryād bhujāṣṭakasamanvitam | yadvā caturbhujaṃ śaṅkhacakrādyāyudhabhūṣitam || 18.50 vāmabhāge tu hastābhyāṃ varadaṃ paṅkajaṃ tu vā | itarābhyāṃ ca hastābhyām abhayaṃ cakram eva vā || 18.51 abhinnā lakṣmīnārāyaṇamūrtiḥ vapuṣo dakṣiṇe bhāge viṣṇur vāme saroruhā | pīnastanataṭo vāmaḥ śrīvatsāṅkastathetaraḥ || 18.52 vāme hemanibhaḥśyāmo dakṣiṇo bhāga iṣyate | āsīnaṃ vā śayānaṃ vā garuḍārūḍham eva vā || 18.53 yajñamūrtiḥ sthitaṃ vā kalpayed devaṃ yajñamūrtitamataḥ śṛṇu | triśīrṣaṃ ca tripādaṃ ca catuḥśṛṅgaṃ caturmukha || 18.54 saptahastaṃ japātulyaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam | abhītido mukhyahasto dakṣiṇo 'nyo varapradaḥ || 18.55 pañcaitarakarāś ca sruksruvādyāyudhabhūṣitāḥ | ekadvitryādimūrtibhedaḥ ekamūrtir vāsudevo yadvā nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ || 18.56 tau dvimūrtis trimūrtis tu satyaś cācyutapūruṣau | caturmurtir vāsudevo bhavet saṅkarṣaṇas tathā || 18.57 pradyumnaś cāniruddhaś ca pañcamūrtimataḥ śṛṇu | satyācyutau tathānantaḥ vāsudevaś ca pūruṣaḥ || 18.58 ṣaṇmūrtir annādhipatiḥ śaktīśaḥ kālanemijit | trailokyamohano yajñavarāhaś ceti pañcamaḥ || 18.59 śaṅkhodaro nṛsiṃhaś ca saptamūrtir athocyate | catasro vāsudevādimūrtayaḥ pūrvam īritāḥ || 18.60 pūṣādayas tathā tisraḥ saptamūrtir udāhṛtā | hayagrīvo mukundaś ca babhraś caiva vṛṣākapiḥ || 18.61 śauriś ca dāśārhaś caiva vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣas tathā | aṣṭamūrtir iti prokto navamūrtir athocyate || 18.62 catasraḥ kathitāḥ pūrvaṃ vāsudevādayas tathā | nārāyaṇo hayagrīvo viṣṇur nṛharisūkarau || 18.63 ṣaḍanneśādayaḥ proktāḥ vāsudevādimūrtayaḥ | catasro daśamūrtiḥ syād ādimūrtir imā daśa || 18.64 syād ekādaśamūrtiḥ syāt proktā dvādaśamūrtayaḥ | catasro viṃśatiś caiva mūrtayaḥ pūrvam īritāḥ || 18.65 pañcamūrtipratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ pañcamūrtipratiṣṭhānam adhunā samudīryate | sthāpayed vāsudevābhyāṃ mūrtiṃ garbhagṛhe sudhīḥ || 18.66 divye bhāge 'thavā brāhme bahiḥ prāg diśi pūruṣam | satyamūrtiṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ pratīcyām acyutaṃ tathā || 18.67 anantākhyam udīcīne calāṃ vā yadi vā 'calām | dhāmno 'ntarvāsudevaḥ syāc caturmūrtiṣu pūrvavat || 18.68 saṅkarṣaṇaṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ bahir diśi niveśayet | pradyumnaṃ ca pratīcīne kauberyām aniruddhakam || 18.69 yāṃ yāṃ diśam adhiṣṭhāya sthitāḥ pūrvoktamūrtayaḥ | tattaddigābhimukhyena kalpayet kamalāsana || 18.70 dvāraṃ vātāyanaṃ vāpi kuryād bhittiṃ na kalpayet | śaṅkhacakragadāyuktā mukhyair abhayadā karaiḥ || 18.71
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde mūrtibhedakathanaṃ nāma aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
ekonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
karmādyarcāmūrtimānavidhiḥ
tatra bahuberamānam śrībhagavān karmārcādipratikṛteḥprakāraḥ kathyate 'dhunā | karmārcā cotsavārcā ca balyarcā ca tathaiva ca || 19.1 snānatīrthobhayārcā ca svāpotthānārcayā saha | pratimāḥ ṣaḍ vidhātavyāḥ pūjāyām uttamā bhavet || 19.2 tisṛbhir madhyamā jñeyā ādyayā caramā bhavet | bahubere vidhirayaṃ kathitaḥ kamalāsana || 19.3 ekaberamānam ekabere tu karmārcā snapanārcā ca neṣyate | dhruvaberasamucchrāye vibhakte daśadhā sati || 19.4 ekāṃśena pratikṛteḥ karmārcāyāḥ samucchrayaḥ | dvādaśāṃśena yadvā syāt ṣoḍaśāṃśena vā bhavet || 19.5 yadvāṣṭādaśabhāgena caturviṃśāṃśam eva vā | mahāberāṅgulāpekṣā yadvā tasyāḥ samunnatiḥ || 19.6 caturviṃśāṅgulā yadvā bhaved aṣṭādaśāṅgulā | ṣoḍaśāṅgulamānā vā yadvā syād dvādaśāṅgulā || 19.7 aṣṭāṅgulā 'thavā yadvā ṣaḍaṅgulasamucchrayā | caturaṅgulamānā vā yadvā mānāṅgulena tu || 19.8 pūrvoktāṅgulamānāni kartavyāni yathāruci | balyādimūrtimānam balitīrthapratikṛtiḥ śayanotthānakautukam || 19.9 karmārcāsaṃmitotsedhaḥ kathitaḥ kamalāsana | karmabimbasamutsedhas triguṇaḥ pariśiṣṭayoḥ || 19.10 snapanotsavakāryārthaṃ bimbayor ubhayor api | bhaṅktvā tridhā caturdha vā dhruvaberasamucchrayam || 19.11 ekabhāge nalotsedhaṃ kuryād utsavakautuke | utsavārcātṛtīyāṃśaṃ turyāṃśaṃ vā 'mbujāsana || 19.12 karmakautukamānaṃ syād brahmārcāderayaṃ kramaḥ | ekabere tadarthā tu tatturyāṃśakam eva vā || 19.13 utsavārcātṛtīyāṃśasamutsedho 'thavā bhavet | sthānayānāsanabimbavadeva karmārcā sthānayānāsanavidhau dhruvabimbaṃ yathā kṛtam || 19.14 karmārcādīni tadvat syāt dhruve tu śayite punaḥ | tiṣṭhed vāsīta vā kāyaṃ karmādyarcā caturmukha || 19.15 nityotsavabimbaṃ tiṣṭhadrūpam eva nityotsavapratikṛtiḥ sarvatraiva sthitā bhavet | sthitabimbapīṭhamānam arcāyāmaṃ tridhā kṛtvā padmam ekena kalpayet || 19.16 upānahādipañcāṅgayuktaṃ vṛttaṃ sukhāvaham | caturaśraṃ manohāri vistāratulitāyati || 19.17 tṛtīyabhāgavihitaṃ prabhāśaṅkadvayāṅkitam | pīṭhotsedhaṃ tridhā kṛtvā padmam ekena kalpayet || 19.18 dalair dvādaśabhir yuktam aṣṭābhir vā yathāruci | tāvad ūrdhvadalopetaṃ madhye vipulakarṇikam || 19.19 upacchadasamāyuktam īṣatphullāmbujākṛti | pādamānaṃ dalāyāmaṃ kevalaṃ vā saroruham || 19.20 pīṭhaṃ vā kevalaṃ vāpi suṣiraṃ naiva kārayet | sthitasya kautukasyedaṃ pīṭhanirmāṇam īritam || 19.21 āsīnapīṭhamānam āsīnasyāyataṃ vṛttaṃ caturaśraṃ yadāyatam | pratimārdhasamutsedhaṃ tattṛtīyāṃśam eva vā || 19.22 padmaṃ bahudalopetaṃ madhye vipulakarṇikam | na kuñcitaprasavyāṅghrir adhastāl lambitetaraḥ || 19.23 adhyāsītāsanaṃ devo yathoktaṃ kamalāsana | lambamānapadādhāraṃ kamalaṃ parikalpayet || 19.24 śrībhūmyoḥ sanniveśaḥ śrīr dakṣiṇe dharā vāme devyau devasya kalpayet | karmādibimbaṣaṭkaṃ syāc chrībhūmisahitaṃ sadā || 19.25 śrīdharādevyorāsanasthitivikalpaḥ ekasmin viṣṭare syātāṃ pṛthag vā vallabhe ubhe | vāmaṃ saṃkṣipya caraṇam itaraṃ lambayed adhaḥ || 19.26 śrīr dharā tv anyathāsīnā sthite deve tathā sthitā | prabhāyā mānādi vṛttāṃ vṛttāyatāṃ vāpi prabhāṃ bimbānusārataḥ || 19.27 kuryān manoharāṃ yasmāt tejorāśiḥ prabhā matā | dvyaṅgulaṃ kāṇḍamānaṃ syāt puṣpakṣetraṃ tadardhakam || 19.28 ardhāṅgulaṃ bhavet kṣetraṃ kāṇḍaṃ tadanupūrvavat | vetraṃ tadanu bhūyo 'pi jvālāmālopari sthitāḥ || 19.29 ardhāṅgulāntarālāḥ syur jvālāḥ pañcaśikhās tathā | triśikhā vā yathāyogaṃ dakṣiṇāvartaśobhitāḥ || 19.30 prabhāyāṃ mīnādimūrtikalpanam yugmā vā syur ayugmā vā kāṇḍe kāṇḍe prakalpayet | daśāvatāramūrtīr vā mīnādyāḥ keśavādikāḥ || 19.31 prabhāyāḥ pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhe śaṅkunālaṃ prakalpayet | toraṇaprabhā bimbe yānādirūḍhe tu kartavyā toraṇaprabhā | antarbahiś ca dārḍhyārthamāyanaṃ tu niveśayet || 19.32 bimbaprabhāsanāni lohajāny eva bimbaṃ prabhāmāsanaṃ vā lohajaṃ parikalpayet || 19.33 lohamūrtinirmāṇakramaḥ drāvayitvā madhūcchiṣṭaṃ pratimāṃ tena kalpayet | dhānyarāśiṃ vinikṣipya tad ūrdhve tilataṇḍulam || 19.34 cakrābjaṃ tu likhet tasmin prāg agrān nikṣipet kuśān | vastraṃ ca nūtanaṃ tasmin vistīrya pratimāṃ kṣipet || 19.35 prācīnaśirasaṃ paścāt juhuyād anale guruḥ | puṣpaiḥ samidbhirlājaiś ca sarpiṣāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 19.36 juhuyān mūlamantreṇa nṛsūktena caruṃ punaḥ | hutvaivaṃ vidhinācāryaḥ sragvī kanakabhūṣaṇaḥ || 19.37 saṃpātājyena saṃsiñcet pratimāṃ tatvapaddhatim | dhyāyet tatra śubhe lagne pūjayen mūlavidyayā || 19.38 yujamāno guruṃ pūjya bahubhis toṣayed dhanaiḥ | brāhmaṇān viduṣo vittair bahubhiḥ paritoṣayet || 19.39 sthapatiḥ pratimāṃ kuryāt rathakārābhyanujñayā | mānonmānapramāṇais tāṃ pratimāṃ kārayec chubhām || 19.40 mṛdālepaṃ tataḥ kuryāc chilpaśāstrānusārataḥ | lohavikalpaḥ suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ viśuddhaṃ loham uttamam || 19.41 ādāya dhānyarāśyāṃ tu pūrvavan nyāsakalpanam | pūrvavac caiva juhuyād ācāryaś coditakramāt || 19.42 drāghayitvā tataḥ śuddhaṃ lohaṃ nyāyasamārjitam | sthapatiḥ pratimāṃ tena kuryāc chāstroktavartmanā || 19.43 lohajāṃ pratimāṃ caivaṃ kalpayet paramātmanaḥ | sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ punar āvṛttivarjitam || 19.44 pratimāyāṃ hastādivaikalye śāntiḥ pratimāhastapādādivaikalye śāntim ācaret | ācāryo dānahomādyais tataḥ śāntir bhaviṣyati || 19.45 samādadhyādavayavān vikalān sthapatiḥ punaḥ | citrārdhacitracitrābhāsādinirūpaṇam citraṃ cāpy ardhacitraṃ ca citrābhāsam iti tridhā || 19.46 kautukaṃ tatra dṛśyante yasminn avayavāḥ sphuṭam | sarve samantāc citraṃ tu tadvijñeyaṃ caturmukha || 19.47 hastādyavayavā yasmin urobhāge samīkṣitum | śakyaṃ nāparabhāge tu tadardhaṃ citram iṣyate || 19.48 rūpitā pratimā yā tu varṇair eva sitādibhiḥ | kuḍyādau citramābhāsaṃ tatkautukam udāhṛtam || 19.49 citram utkṛṣṭam ity uktam ardhaṃ madhyamam ucyate | ābhāsamadhamaṃ viddhi mandire vātha veśmani || 19.50 sthāpayed dhruvabimbārthaṃ pūrvālābhe yathottaram | pratimānāṃ tālādimānam ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pratimāmānalakṣaṇam || 19.51 ekādidaśaparyantaṃ saṃkhyayopeyuṣāṃ bhidām | tālānām uttamādīnāṃ rūpāviṣkṛtipūrvakam || 19.52 yat kiñcit pratimāmānaṃ vibhajya daśadhā punaḥ | ekaṃ dvādaśadhā bhaṅktvā tatraikāṃśo 'ṅgulaḥ smṛtaḥ || 19.53 aṅgulaṃ cāṣṭadhā kṛtvā tatraikāṃśo yavaḥ smṛtaḥ | tenaivāṅgulamānena aṅgapratyaṅgakalpanā || 19.54 dvādaśāṅgulakaṃ mānaṃ tālākhyam iha kathyate | dvādaśāṅgulakastālo mukhyaś ceti prakīrtitaḥ || 19.55 dvyaṅgulaṃ golakaṃ jñeyaṃ kaleti vyapadiśyate | ekāṅgulaṃ bhaven mātrā bhāgo mātrācatuṣṭayam || 19.56 uttamādhamamadhyāni tālāni kamalāsana | ekādidaśaparyantaṃ saṃkhyayāc chedayanti ca || 19.57 mīyate daśatālena vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ | navārdhatālau brahmeśau navatālena devatāḥ || 19.58 aṣṭārdhatālau dvārasthāḥ kumudādiguṇās tathā | aṣṭatālāṃś ca manujān piśācādīṃś ca saptakān || 19.59 ṣaṭtālān kubjakān viddhi pañcatālāṃs tu vāmanān | catustālāni bhūtāni tritālāḥ kinnarās tathā || 19.60 matsyā dvitālakā jñeyās tālenaikena pannagān | daśatālaṃ caturviṃśadaṅgulīnāṃ śataṃ bhavet || 19.61 uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ viṃśatkaniṣṭhaṃ ṣoḍaśa smṛtam | navatālaṃ tu tacchreṣṭhaṃ yacchataṃ dvādaśādhikam || 19.62 aṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ madhyaṃ kanīyaś catur uttamam | aṣṭatālaṃ śataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ madhyamaṃ ṣaṇṇavaty api || 19.63 caturthahīnamadhamam aṣṭatālaṃ prakīrtitam | uttamādikramo 'nyeṣu saptatālādiṣūhyate || 19. 64 catuś caturvihīnaṃ cet kramād aṅgulibhir bhavet | pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ yathoktaṃ tattraividhyam avagamyatām || 19.65 trayodaśārdhāṅgulikaṃ daśatālottame mukham | ardhenāṅgulinā hīnaṃ madhyamaṃ saṃpracakṣate || 19.66 ardhenāṅgulinā hīnam ekaikam itareṣv api | dhruvāyām uttamaṃ tālam arcāyāṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet || 19.67 adhamaṃ parivārāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ kamalāsana ||
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde lohajapratimānirmāṇatālavibhāgo nāma ekonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
pratimāmānavidhiḥ śrībhagavān ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pratimāmānam uttamam | mānaṃ pramāṇam unmānaṃ iti mānaṃ tridhā bhavet || 20.1 mānam utsedhamānaṃ syād unmānaṃ sahanaṃ matam | mānaṃ ca tiryag ūrdhvaṃ yattat pramāṇam ihocyate || 20.2 tatra pratikṛtes tāvat tadaṅgānāṃ ca kathyate | utsedhamānaṃ mūrdhādi pādāntam anupūrvaśaḥ || 20.3 labdhānāṃ dehatas tāvad aṅgulīnāṃ śatena tu | caturviṃśatimānena pratimāṃ parikalpayet || 20.4 uṣṇīṣam aṅgulimitaṃ keśāntaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ matam | dṛksūtrāntaṃ tad ārabhya ṣaṭtriṃśadyavasaṃmitam || 20.5 tadvannāsāpuṭāntaṃ syāt tadvac ca cibukāvadhi | tena keśāntam ārabhya mukhamānaṃ caturmukha || 20.6 aṣṭottarayavaśataṃ cibukāvayavāvadhi | galamardhāṅgulaṃ sārdhaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ kaṇṭham iṣyate || 20.7 hikkāsūtraṃ samārabhya hṛdayāntaṃ mukhe sthitam | tataḥ prabhṛti nābhyantaṃ sārdhaṃ satridaśāṅgulam || 20.8 tataḥ prabhṛti meḍhrāntaṃ tadvad utsedham iṣyate | tanmūlāj jānuparyantaṃ trinyūnaṃ tridaśāṅgulam || 20.9 caturaṅgulam utsedhaṃ jānumaṇḍalam iṣyate | akṣāntaṃ jānuno 'dhastād ūrutulyam itīritam || 20.10 tatas tālāntam utsedhaṃ caturaṅgulasaṃmitam | dehāṅgulāni yāvanti daśa tāle 'bhipūjite || 20.11 vibhajya tāvanty uktāni madhyame śrūyatāṃ kramaḥ | trayodaśāṅgulaṃ vaktraṃ tristhānaṃ ca tadaṅgulam || 20.12 ṣaḍviṃśatyaṅgulotsedham ūrumānam udāhṛtam | tadvaj jaṅghāsam utsedham uttareṇetaratsamam || 20.13 adhame daśatāle tu mukhaṃ śatayavaṃ matam | tristhānaṃ tāvad eva syād ūruryavaśatadvayam || 20.14 jaṅghā ca tatsamotsedhā mukhyenānyatsamaṃ matam | viṃśadyavaśataṃ pādadrāghimā kamalāsana || 20.15 aṅguṣṭhaṃ vedamātraṃ syāt tadāyāmā ca tarjanī | ekatriṃśadyavāyāmā madhyamāṅgulir iṣyate || 20.16 triṃśadyavā 'nāmikā syāt kaniṣṭhā tryaṅgulā 'pi ca | yavaiś ca pañcabhir yuktā pārṣṇī ca caturaṅgulā || 20.17 hikkā tayor adhobāhur aṅgulī saptaviṃśatiḥ | tataś ca maṇibandhāntaṃ ṣaḍviṃśatyaṅgulāyatam || 20.18 yavad vayena ca yutaṃ maṇibandhāt talaṃ punaḥ | madhyamāṅgulimūlāntaṃ pañcāśadyavasaṃmitam || 20.19 pañcāṅgulam athāṅguṣṭhaṃ tarjanī tadvadāyatā | ṣaḍyavaiś cādhikāyāmā madhyamā tu ṣaḍaṅgulā || 20.20 āyatā ṣaḍyavaiś cāpi tatsamā 'nāmikā matā | kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhatulitā māṃsalagnanakhāvadhi || 20.21 ekāṅgulā nakhāyāmā śiṣṭā ṣaḍyavasaṃmitā | bāhuvac copabāhuḥ syāc caturaṅgulam āyataḥ || 20.22 caturyavaṃ cordhvakaṇṭhaṃ nālaṃ pañcāṅgulāyatam | liṅgaṃ pañcāṅgulāyāmaṃ muṣkaṃ tu caturaṅgulam || 20.23 sārdhāṣṭāṅgulivistāraṃ lalāṭaṃ tadanantaram | dvādaśāṅgulavistāraṃ bālacandrasamākṛti || 20.24 tatas tu karṇayor madhyaṃ sārdhaṃ satridaśāṅgulam | daśāṅgulam adhastasya vistāraṃ cibukasya tu || 20.25 sapādaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ pūrṇaṃ cāpatulyākṛtir bhavet | mūlamadhyāgravistāro grīvāyāḥ kramaśo bhavet || 20.26 navāṅgulaṃ tathaikonaṃ sārdhaṃ saptāṅgulis tathā | hikkāstator adho bāhumūlayor antaraṃ bhavet || 20.27 yavaiś caturbhir vistīrṇaṃ sacatvāriṃśadaṅgulam | kakṣayor madhyavistāras tryaṅgulaḥ sārdhaviṃśatiḥ || 20.28 aṣṭādaśāṅgulaṃ mānaṃ stanayor api cāntaram | ṣoḍaśāṅgulavistāraṃ tundamadhyam udāhṛtam || 20.29 aṣṭādaśāṅgulā śroṇīradharodaram iṣyate | kaṭipradeśavistāras tryaṅgulaḥ sārdhaviṃśatiḥ || 20.30 ūrumūlasya vistāraḥ sārdhaṃ satridaśāṅgulam | agram ekāṅgulaṃ sārdhadvyaṅgulaṃ madhyam iṣyate || 20.31 dvyaṅgulo mūlavistāro liṅgasya samudāhṛtaḥ | vistīrṇaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ mūlaṃ madhyam ardhādhikaṃ punaḥ || 20.32 vistīrṇam agramuṣkasya dvātriṃśadyavasaṃmitam | vistīrṇam ekādaśabhir aṅgulair ūrumadhyamam || 20.33 agraṃ daśabhir etasya vistīrṇaṃ kamalāsana | navāṅgulaṃ jānucakraṃ pārśvamardhendusannibham <�saṃnibham> || 20.34 mūlaṃ navāṣṭau madhyaṃ syāj jaṅghāgraṃ sārdhasaptakam | vistīrṇo nalakābhāgaḥ sārdhaiś ca caturaṅgulaiḥ || 20.35 aṅghrimūlasya vistāras tryaṅgulaḥ sacaturyavaḥ | sārdhapañcāṅgulaṃ madhyam agraṃ sārdhaṣaḍaṅgulam || 20.36 sārdham aṣṭāṅgulaṃ mūlaṃ bāhū saptāṅgulau punaḥ | madhyāgre tulyavistāre prakoṣṭhāvayavaḥ punaḥ || 20.37 sārdhena saptabhir mūle vistīrṇaṃ sārdhapañcabhiḥ | madhye caturbhir agre syān maṇibandhasya tūcyate || 20.38 pañcāṅgulārdhasahitaḥ tadvat karatalaṃ smṛtam | aṅguṣṭhe mūlavistāro dvyaṅgulo madhyamāṅguliḥ || 20.39 saṣaḍyavaṃ tu muṣṭyagraṃ aṅgulenaiva saṃmitam | tarjanyā mūlavistāro navabhiḥ saṃmito yavaiḥ || 20.40 madhyam ekāṅgulaṃ saptayavam agram udāhṛtam | mūlaṃ daśayavaṃ madhyaṃ madhyamāyā yavā nava || 20.41 agram ekāṅgulaṃ proktam itarā tarjanīsamā | mūlam aṣṭau kaniṣṭhāyā yavāḥ saptaikamadhyamā || 20.42 ṣaḍyavāṅgulam agrebhyaḥ pādonā nakhavistṛtiḥ | madhye karatale rekhā madhyamāmūlam utthitā || 20.43 kaniṣṭhāmūlam ārabhya rekhā madhyamagā bhavet | madhyamāṅgulitarjanyonirmātavyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 20.44 aṅguṣṭhamūlam ārabhya tarjanyantaś ca madhyamā | tayoś ca rekhayor madhye tarjanīmūlagāminī || 20.45 rekhā kalpyā yathāśāstraṃ śāstrābhijñena śilpinā | lalāṭasya ca vistāraḥ sapādadvyaṅgulo bhavet || 20.46 tasyādhastād bhruvau kalpyau catvāriṃśadyavāyutau | madhye yavena vistīrṇe yūkāgre cāpasannibhe <�saṃnibhe> || 20.47 tayor madhyaṃ navayavaṃ aṣṭādaśayavāyatam | cakṣuḥkanīnikāyāmo vistāraś ca yavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 20.48 aṅgulaṃ śvetabimbasya vistāraṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam | yavonam aṅgulaṃ jyotis tanmadhye yavasaṃmitam || 20.49 yūkamānā tu tanmadhye dṛṣṭiḥ pakṣamāvalī punaḥ | ūrdhvā samanvitā sārdhatryaṅgulā daśabhir yavaiḥ || 20.50 vistīrṇā tu yavāyāmā vistāras tu tadardhakaḥ | aśītiḥ pakṣmaromāṇi vakrāgrāṇy asitāni ca || 20.51 dvyaṅgulaṃ cakṣuṣor madhyaṃ madhyaṃ ca śrutyapāṅgayoḥ | catvāriṃśadyavaṃ karṇavistāro dvyaṅgulo bhavet || 20.52 ūrdhvaṃ karṇasya cāyāmaḥ sahārdhacaturaṅgulaḥ | nālaṃ pañcāṅgulamitaṃ vistāraḥ ṣaḍyavaḥ punaḥ || 20.53 paścāc caturyavā nālī nālatulyaṃ caturmukha | śravaṇasya ca pippalyāḥ madhyagartaṃ caturyavam || 20.54 trivaktrakarṇapippalyā gallapātram iva sthitam | bandhanaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ randhraṃ netrasūtrasamunnatam || 20.55 nāsikāmūlamadhyāgravistāraḥ kathyate kramāt | aṅgulaṃ cāṅgulaṃ sārdhadvyaṅgulaṃ sacaturyavam || 20.56 aṅgulenonnataṃ mūlaṃ tena sārdhena madhyamam | dvābhyāṃ yavābhyāṃ mūlena dvyaṅgulenāgram unnatam || 20.57 ṣaḍyavaṃ suṣiraṃ tasya puṭamadhyaṃ caturyavam | puṭapārśvasya vistāro dviyavaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 20.58 utsedho 'rdhāṅgulastasya nāsikā tilapuṣpavat | uttaroṣṭhāyataṃ sārdhaṃ caturaṅgulam iṣyate || 20.59 vistāro 'rdhāṅgulastasya paraṃ sārdhāṅgulāyatam | vistīrṇam aṅgulaṃ tasya pālī caikayavā matā || 20.60 cibukoṣṭhau daśayavau vistārāyāmasaṃmitau | gulphaṃ pādāṅgulotsedhaṃ darpaṇodarasannibham || 20.61 vistīrṇāvayavau tulyau rājadantau caturyavau | dvātriṃśaddaśanāḥ kalpyāḥ yathā śāstroktavartmanā || 20.62 jihvā ṣaḍaṅgulāyāmā vistīrṇā tryaṅgulā bhavet | rekhātrayāṅkitā grīvā hikkāsūtrātstanasthitiḥ || 20.63 ekādaśāṅgulaṃ vṛttaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ stanamaṇḍalam | caturyavaṃ cūcukaṃ syāt stanamaṇḍalamadhyagam || 20.64 caturyavaṃ nābhigartaṃ dakṣiṇāvartam iṣyate | adhyardham aṅgulaṃ vṛttamakṣamardhāṅgulonnatam || 20.65 uṣṇīṣāt pṛṣṭhakeśāntam ekādhikadaśāṅgulam | uṣṇīṣāt pārśvakeśāntaṃ dvādaśāṅgulamānakam || 20.66 karṇayor antaraṃ vidyāt sārdhaṃ satridaśāṅgulam | mūlamadhyāgrabhāgeṣu pṛṣṭhagrīvā yathākramam || 20.67 vistīrṇā navabhiḥ sārdhair aṅgulair navabhis tathā | aṣṭābhiś ca bhavet tasyā adhastāt kakudasthitiḥ || 20.68 āyāmotsedhavistāraiḥ kakudaṃ tac caturyavam | ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ bāhvor madhyaṃ vistārapṛṣṭhataḥ || 20.69 ṣaḍviṃśatiś cāṅgulānāṃ kakṣayor antaraṃ bhavet | pṛṣṭhamadhyasya vistāro brahman saptadaśāṅgulaḥ || 20.70 vistīrṇā pañcaviṃśatyā śroṇīpārśvau tathāṅgulaiḥ | kaṭipradeśavistāraḥ ṣaḍviṃśatyaṅgulo bhavet || 20.71 ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ madhye kakudasya kaṭes tathā | dvyaṅgulonnatam etasya sphicau tanmadhyam aṅgulam || 20.72 aṅgulaṃ stanayor mūlaṃ madhyaṃ saptāṅgulaṃ bhavet | agraṃ tryaṅgulavistāram ūrvor mūlādiṣu triṣu || 20.73 bhavet krameṇa vistāraḥ sārdhaḥ satridaśāṅgulaḥ | dvādaśāṅgulayuktaḥ syāt tathaiva dvādaśāṅgulaḥ || 20.74 jānvaṣṭāṅgulavistāraṃ sārdham aṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhavet | jaṅghāmadhyaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ nālikā caturaṅgulā || 20.75 caturyavādhikā caiva gulphaś ca caturaṅgulaḥ | vistāramānaṃ triguṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ sahanaṃ matam || 20.76 abhītido vā varado mukhyo vāmetaraḥ karaḥ | stanasūtrasamaṃ kāryaṃ aṅgulyagraṃ karasya tu || 20.77 tayor bhaved antarālaṃ dvādaśāṅgulam abjaja | aṅguṣṭhatarjanīmadhye sanālaṃ kamalaṃ bhavet || 20.78 varade kamalākāraṃ likhet karatalodare | adhomukhe vāmahaste mukhye kuryād gadāṃ śubhām || 20.79 catustālāyatāṃ mūle sthūlām agre kṛśāmṛjum | tryaṅgulaṃ mūlasahanam agre sahanam aṅgulam || 20.80 dvyaṅgulaṃ sārdham itarad gadāmadhyaṃ caturmukha | kaṭiprasavyaṃ karayor antaraṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ bhavet || 20.81 kaṭispṛśaṃ karaṃ kuryāt prasavyaṃ gadayā vinā | uddhared bahu sīmāntam ūrdhvahastau dhṛtāyudhau || 20.82 bāhuprakoṣṭhayor madhyaṃ mūlam aṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhavet | madhyaṃ daśāṅgulamitamagramānaṃ mukhaṃ smṛtam || 20.83 ūrdhve hastadvayāṅguṣṭhe sahānāmikayā natam | tarjanīmadhyamābhyāṃ tu dhārayantaṃ tathāmbujam || 20.84 cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ vṛttaṃ dvādaśāṅgulamānakam | aṣṭāṅgulamarakṣetraṃ dvyaṅgulā cakrapiṇḍikā || 20.85 tadvat syān nemivalayaṃ caturjvālāsamanvitam | nābhāvubhayato jvālā triśikhāvartaśobhitā || 20.86 adhyardhadvyaṅgulotsedhā vistīrṇārdhāṅgulādhikā | arāṇi yavatulyāni netratulyāni vā punaḥ || 20.87 aṣṭau dvādaśa vā ṣaḍvā ṣaḍjvālaṃ śaṅkham iṣyate | vistāro 'ṣṭāṅgulas tasya dvādaśāṅgulamāyatam || 20.88 pradakṣiṇāvartayutaṃ jvālāgraṃ śaṅkhacakrayoḥ | keśāntena samaṃ yadvā netrasūtreṇa tatsamam || 20.89 sārdhāṅgulāntarād ūrdhvaṃ jānunī dvyaṅgulāntare | jaṅghayor viṃśatiyavamantarālaṃ praśasyate || 20.90 akṣayos tryaṅgulaṃ madhyaṃ tayoḥ saptāṅgulaṃ bhavet | caraṇāṅguṣṭhayor madhyaṃ navāṅgulam udāhṛtam || 20.91 ṛjusthitasya caraṇaṃ śayyāyāṃ ṛjudakṣiṇam | itaratkuñcitaṃ saptaviṃśatyaṅgulamantaram || 20.92 aṅguṣṭhayor gulphamadhyaṃ caturaṅgulam iṣyate | jānvantarālam uditaṃ sārdhaṃ satridaśāṅgulam || 20.93 savyetarakaraṃ mauler agrāntaṃ viniveśayet | prasārayed vāmahastaṃ ājānu kamalāsana || 20.94 dakṣiṇe kamalaṃ vāme gadāṃ haste prakalpayet | bhidyate pratimā bhaṅgais tribhir etaiś caturmukha || 20.95 abhaṅgasamabhaṅgābhyāṃ atibhaṅgena caiva hi | śiromadhye nāsikāgre āsyamadhye galasya ca || 20.96 madhye ca hṛdaye nābhau madhye liṅgasya vāmataḥ | bhāge ṣaḍaṅgule corau vāme madhye ca gulphayoḥ || 20.97 lambayet sūtramābhaṅgaṃ bhinnā ca pratimā matā | ``yathokta pratimāmānādūnā vā tribhir aṅgulaiḥ || 20.98 śikhāmaṇigataṃ sūtraṃ vāmapūritamadhyagam | vāme lalāṭe makare vāme vāme ca cakṣuṣī || 20.99 nābhau madhye nalakayor madhye ca yadi lambayet | samabhaṅgaviśiṣṭā sā nyūnaiṣā caturaṅgulaiḥ " || 20.100 mūrdhni vāme lalāṭe ca vāmanetrasya madhyagam | āsyamadhye tathā nābhau dakṣiṇe gulphamadhyagam || 20.101 sūtraṃ pralambayed evaṃ atibhaṅgā tu sā matā | nyūnā pañcāṅgulair eṣā pratimā pūrvamānataḥ || 20.102 atibhaṅgaḥ śayānāyāḥ praśasto rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ | kirīṭādīnāṃ mānam sahajānāṃ bhūṣaṇādi kirīṭānāṃ caturmukha || 20.103 vakṣyāmi mānam adhunā yathātatham anukramāt | caturviṃśāṅgulāyāmaṃ yadvā pañcadaśāṅgulam || 20.104 mūlamadhyāgrasahanaṃ kirīṭasya yathākramam | triṃśatā saptabhir dvābhyāṃ ekenāpi tathāṅgulaiḥ || 20.105 tasya madhye caturdikṣu pūritāni tathāṅgulaiḥ | tasya madhye caturdikṣu pūritāni prakalpayet || 20.106 śobhayec ca mahāratnair agre caikaśikhāmaṇim | caturdaśāṅgulotsedhaṃ kalpayet keśabandhanam || 20.107 mūlapaṭṭaṃ kirīṭasya vistīrṇaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ bhavet | ekāṅgulam amuṣyāgraṃ tryaṅgulaṃ ca śikhāmaṇiḥ || 20.108 padmam aṣṭadalaṃ kuryād adhastāc ca śikhāmaṇeḥ | dvigolakāyataṃ citrair anyair api ca śobhayet || 20.109 śirasaḥ pṛṣṭhabhāge syāc chiraścakraṃ tu cakravat | vinākṛtaṃ tu jvālābhiḥ padmaṃ yadvā yathāruci || 20.110 prakalpyaṃ madhyato dāma cakre golakamāyatam | sahanaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ tasya nālaṃ syād golakāyatam || 20.111 makaraṃ golakotsedhaṃ kuryād aṣṭāṅgulāyatam | tadvaktrātsumano dāma niḥsṛtaṃ bālacandravat || 20.112 dvyaṅgulaṃ karṇasumanaḥ karṇadāma ca lambayet | hāraṃ tryaṅgulavistāram agrayor netrabandhanam || 20.113 muktāvibhūṣitaṃ madhye mahāratnapariṣkṛtam | kuryāc ca dakṣiṇe vakṣassthale śrīvatsamaṅgulam || 20.114 ardhādhikaṃ trikoṇaṃ ca tanmadhye kamalālayām | dvihastāmudyadambhojadhāriṇīṃ śriyamadbhutām || 20.115 aparābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ varābhayasamanvitām | kirīṭahārakeyūrasarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 20.116 kuryād dolakavistāraṃ mukhe pañcāṅgulāyatam | triguṇaṃ brahmasūtraṃ syān nābheś cāpi pradakṣiṇam || 20.117 ekāṅgulaṃ cottarīyaṃ netrabandhena bandhayet | vistīrṇaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ madhye tv agram ekāṅgulaṃ bhavet || 20.118 muktādāmapariṣkāraṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | kukṣibandhanamāścaryaṃ netrabandhena yojayet || 20.119 muktādāma ca keyūraṃ kuryāt pūritasannibham <�saṃnibham> | saptāṅgulaiś ca vistīrṇaṃ nānāratnapariṣkṛtam || 20.120 gulikāṅgulavistīrṇā āyatā dvyaṅgulena ca | gulikānāṃ trayaṃ kuryān netrabandhena bandhayet || 20.121 sarvaratnapariṣkārān valayāṃs trīn prakalpayet | ekāṅgulaparīṇāhān kaṭakaiś copaśobhitān || 20.122 sauvarṇasyāṅgulīyāni baddhān ekamaṇīni ca | pariṇāho bhavet teṣāṃ dviyavas triyavo 'pi vā || 20.123 madhyamām aṅguliṃ naiva maṇḍayed aṅgulīyakaiḥ | tryaṅgulaḥ kaṭisūtrasya vistāro ratnaśobhitaḥ || 20.124 tanmadhye makarī caiva pañcāṅgulasamāyatā | caturaṅgulavistārā daṃṣṭrākuṭilamānanam || 20.125 vṛttākṣaṃ bhrukuṭīyuktamāsyaniḥsṛtamauktikam | kuryān mauktikādāmāni trīṇyāgulphaṃ prakalpayet || 20.126 pādākalpaṃ trikaṭakaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ pariṇāhataḥ | nūpuraṃ ca tathā kuryāt kiṅkiṇījālamaṇḍitam || 20.127 vastraṃ ca pītapūrvaṃ tadāgulphaṃ pārśvalambitam | kalpayed vanamālāṃ tu nānāpuṣpasamujvalām || 20.128 nānāratnamayīṃ vāpi yadvā kevalapaṅkajām | karṇataścaraṇaṃ yāval lambayed adbhutākṛtim || 20.129 athavā vallikākārāṃ nāhataś caturaṅgulām | pradyotanasahasrābhaṃ dyotamānaṃ ca kaustubham || 20.130 lambayed urasi svacchamindirāsodaraṃ maṇim | rūpasyābharaṇānāṃ ca niyamaḥ saṃpradarśitaḥ || 20.131 na hy aśeṣeṇa rūpaṃ me prati karmāṇi vā punaḥ | nirmātuṃ bhavatā śakyaṃ kim utānyaiḥ kuśilpibhiḥ || 20.132 tathāpi śāstrāṇy ālocya tajjñaiḥ śāstraṃ vimṛśya ca | nyūnātirekarahitaṃ bimbaṃ kuryād yathātatham || 20.133
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde pratimāmānavidhir nāma viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
ekoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
śriyādidevīmūrtimānam śrībhagavān atha śriyādidevīnāṃ nirmāṇavidhir ucyate | daśatālādinā yena tālamānena kalpyate || 21.1 devo devyaḥ śriyādyāstu kalpanīyāś caturmukha | tadanantaratālena nādhikena samena vā || 21.2 yāvantyo yāś ca yanmānāḥ śriyādeḥ śūlayaṣṭayaḥ | tanmānās tāś ca tāvatyaḥ kathyante saṃprati kramāt || 21.3 pañcatālamitāyāmā vaṃśayaṣṭiś caturmukha | vistāras tryaṅgulo mūle saha ṣaḍbhir yavair api || 21.4 madhyatas tryaṅgulaḥ sārdhas tryaṅgulaḥ punar agrataḥ | caturdaśāṅgulo madhye mūle pañcadaśāṅgulaḥ || 21.5 nāhogre vaṃśayaṣṭeḥ syāt sārdhaṃ satridaśāṅgulam | caturaśraḥ suvṛtto vā daṇḍaḥ kalpyaś ca śilpibhiḥ || 21.6 aṅgulaiḥ saptaviṃśatyā vakṣodaṇḍaḥ samāyataḥ | vistāro madhyamas tasya tryaṅgulaḥ ṣaḍyavādhikaḥ || 21.7 aṅgulair daśabhir nāhaḥ saha pañcabhir aṅgulaiḥ | kiṃśukasyeva mukulaṃ tasyāgre dve prakalpayet || 21.8 bāhumūlaṃ caturviṃśatyaṅgulāyāmam iṣyate | tryaṅgulārdhādhikomūlavistāras tasya kalpyate || 21.9 tryaṅgulo madhyavistāraḥ tasyāgraṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ bhavet | aṣṭādaśāṅgulāyāmaḥ prakoṣṭhas tasya mūlataḥ || 21.10 vistāras tryaṅgulo madhye dvyaṅgulaḥ sa caturyavaḥ | dvyaṅgulo 'gre tayor mūlaśūlayoḥ suṣiraṃ bhavet || 21.11 āyāmaḥ kaṭidaṇḍasya bhavet pañcadaśāṅgulaḥ | vistāro madhyamas tasya tryaṅgulaḥ saha ṣaḍyavaḥ || 21.12 sahanaṃ madhyatas tasya bhavet pañcadaśāṅgulam | ṣaḍaṅgulaḥ pārśvayaṣṭeḥ pariṇāhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 21.13 pārśvadaṇḍau kaṭīvakṣaḥśūlayor viniyojayet | ṣaḍviṃśatyaṅgulāyāmamuraśśūlam udāhṛtam || 21.14 tryaṅgulo mūlavistāraḥ tasyāgraṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ bhavet | vistīrṇaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ madhyaṃ śūlasya ca caturyavam || 21.15 puruśūlasamāyāmaṃ jaṅghāśūlaṃ prakalpayet | suṣiraṃ ca tayor mūlam agraṃ mithunam etayoḥ || 21.16 anuktapariṇāhānāṃ triguṇaṃ sahanaṃ matam | trayodaśavidhaṃ śūlaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktamānakam || 21.17 jalādhivāsādyakhilaṃ kuryāc chrīsthāpane yathā | svātantrye pāratantrye ca ratnanyāsapuraḥsaram || 21.18 śūlādisthāpayed rajjuveṣṭanādi yathāpuram | kuryād āvarṇalepāntaṃ mānādyatha nidarśyate || 21.19 utsedham aṅgulaśataṃ viṃśam āsthāya kathyate | uṣṇīṣam aṅgulamitaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ ca śiro bhavet || 21.20 sārdhaṃ tribhir yavair akṣisūtrāntaṃ caturaṅgulam | saṅgamāt puṭasūtrāntaṃ tadvad ambhoruhāsana || 21.21 cibukāntaṃ puṭādarvāk sapādacaturaṅgulam | caturaṅgulamānā syād grīvā hikkāguṇāt tataḥ || 21.22 trayodaśāṅgulamitaṃ stanasūtrāntam īritam | ato nu nābhisīmāntaṃ bhavet pañcadaśāṅgulam || 21.23 śroṇī ṣaḍaṅgulāyāmā yoniḥ sārdhāṅgulitrayam | kaṭimānaṃ bhavet sārdhaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ corurāyatā || 21.24 aṅgulaiḥ pañcaviṃśatyā sārdhair jaṅghā ca tatsamā | sārdhaṃ ca tryaṅgulaṃ jānus tadvadakṣatalāvadhi || 21.25 ``vistāro 'ṣṭāṅgulas tasya dvādaśāṅgulamāyatam | pradakṣiṇāvartayutaṃ jvālāgraṃ śaṅkhacakrayoḥ || 21.26 keśāntena samā yadvā yadvā sūtreṇa tatsamam | sārdhāntarāṃśunāpūrvā guñjāni dvyaṅgulāntare || 21.27 jaṅghayor viṃśatiyavamantarālaṃ pracakṣate | akṣayos tryaṅgulaṃ madhyaṃ stanayoḥ saptamāṅgulam || 21.28 caraṇāṅguṣṭhayor madhyaṃ navāṅgulam udāhṛtam |" akṣāt parataraṃ tālam aṅguṣṭhaṃ tribhir aṅgulaiḥ || 21.29 ardhena cāyataṃ dve ca tarjanī syād yavādhikā | yavonā madhyamānye dve yavahīne yathākramam || 21.30 pārṣṇipārśvaparicchedo bhavec ca caturaṅgulaḥ | gulphaṃ tathā parimitaṃ tadviṃśatyaṅgulāyatam || 21.31 hikkāntayor adho bāhuḥ sahārdhaikonaviṃśatiḥ | aṅgulāni prakoṣṭhaṃ syāt tadāyāmaḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaḥ || 21.32 tadvac ca madhyamā śiṣṭā sārdhapañcadaśāṅgulā | daśāṅgulaṃ śiromānaṃ vistāro 'ṣṭāṅgulo bhavet || 21.33 lalāṭasya puronu syād aśītiyavasaṃmitam | aṣṭāśītiyavaṃ mānaṃ tadanantaram iṣyate || 21.34 āyāmaḥ śravaṇasya syād dvātriṃśadyavasaṃmitaḥ | nālāyāmas tathācordhvaṃ pippalyā dviyavo mataḥ || 21.35 nālasya mūlavistāraḥ ṣaḍyavais tulito bhavet | agraṃ caturyavaṃ grīvā mūlaṃ caiva ṣaḍaṅgulam || 21.36 sārdhaṃ pañcāṅgulārdhāgraṃ skandhaṃ ca dvyaṅgulaṃ bhavet | hikkāntayor adhor bāhvor mūlaṃ dvātriṃśadaṅgulam || 21.37 aṣṭādaśāṅgulam urastanayor api maṇḍalam | aṅgulaiḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ paricchinnaṃ yathātatham || 21.38 navāṅgulaṃ ca vistāraṃ utsedhaś cāpi tādṛśaḥ | dvādaśāṅgulavistāras stanayor madhyam iṣyate || 21.39 kṛṣṇamaṇḍalavistāro dvyaṅgulaṃ caturānana | nāhas tu kukṣimadhyasya syāt trayas triṃśadaṅgulaḥ || 21.40 śroṇīmadhyaparīṇāhaḥ saptapañcadaśāṅgulaḥ | kaṭimadhyaparīṇāho viṃśatyā saikayāṅgulaiḥ || 21.41 ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulo nāhas tathā syād ūrumūlayoḥ | triṃśadaṅgulanāhas tu bhaved ūrvos tu madhyamaḥ || 21.42 caturbhiḥ sahaviṃśatyā jānunāhas tathāṅgulaiḥ | sahanaṃ jaṅghayor ekaviṃśatyaṅgulam iṣyate || 21.43 dvāviṃśatyaṅgulaḥ sārdho nāhamadhye ca jaṅghayoḥ | sahanaṃ jaṅghayor agraṃ bhaved ekādaśāṅgulam || 21.44 ekādaśāṅgulaṃ cākṣavṛttamaṇḍalanāhanam | ekāṅgulaṃ cākṣavṛttaṃ madhyamaṃ sahanaṃ matam || 21.45 ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ talāgraṃ syād utsedhaś caturaṅgulaḥ | dvyaṅgulo 'ṅguṣṭhavistāras tarjanyekāṅgulā bhavet || 21.46 madhyamāditarāṅgulyo yavahīnāḥ kramāt punaḥ | aṅguṣṭhanakhavistāras tryaṅgulaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 21.47 tarjanī pādahīnā syāt kramād anyā yavonnatāḥ | aṣṭādaśāṅgulaṃ madhyaṃ mūlaṃ bāhvos trayādhikam || 21.48 prakoṣṭhamūlasahanaṃ bhavet pañcadaśāṅgulam | dvādaśāṅgulamadhyāntaṃ maṇibandho navāṅgulaḥ || 21.49 vistīrṇaṃ tālamadhyardhaṃ caturaṅgulam iṣyate | aṅguṣṭhamūlamadhyardham aṅgulaṃ nakham aṅgulam || 21.50 niḥsṛtaṃ triyavaṃ proktaṃ parvadvayasamanvitam | tarjanyaṅgulavistāraḥ sahāṣṭāṃśāṃgulo bhavet || 21.51 sapādāṅgulavistārā madhmāṅgulir iṣyate | aṣṭasaptayavaiḥ śiṣṭais triparvā ca catuṣṭayī || 21.52 pārśvakeśāntam uṣṇīṣād ārabhya syād daśāṅgulam | ārabhya pārśvakeśāntāt sapādadvyaṅgule bhruvau || 21.53 ṣaḍaṅgulā yathā bhrūḥ syād yavamadhyāgrayūkakā | antarālaṃ navayavaṃ bhruvos tryaṅgulam īkṣaṇam || 21.54 aṅgulāyāmavistārā veditavyā kanīnikā | yavonam aṅgulaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ jyotir yūkapramāṇakam || 21.55 paritaḥ kṛṣṇabimbasya aṅgulaṃ śvetamaṇḍalam | madhyato 'ṅgulavistāraṃ nayanaṃ śūrpamīnavat || 21.56 ūrdhvapakṣmāyatā sārdhatryaṅgulā pādavistarā | tryaṅgulāyāmam itarad vistāro yavasaṃmitaḥ || 21.57 aśītiḥ pakṣmaromāṇi śatāni kuṭilāni ca | dvyaṅgulaṃ cakṣuṣor madhyaṃ nāsikāmūlam aṅgulam || 21.58 vistīrṇam unnataṃ vāpi madhyam adhyardham aṅgulam | agraṃ dvyaṅgulamadhyardhaṃ ṣaḍyavaṃ suṣiraṃ bhavet || 21.59 caturyavaṃ tayor madhyaṃ puṭapārśvaṃ caturyavam | apāṅgātkarṇamūlāntaṃ catvāriṃśadyavaṃ matam || 21.60 dvyaṅgulaḥ karṇavistāro vivaraṃ ca caturyavam | caturaṅgulamadhyardham oṣṭham uttaram āyatam || 21.61 yavavistāramadharam ekāṅgulasamāyatam | dvyaṅgulaṃ caiva vistāraṃ cibukaṃ dvyaṅgulāyatam || 21.62 āpīḍā nāsikāyuktā karaṇḍamukuṭānvitā | karṇikā maṇikeyūrakaṭakatrayahāriṇī || 21.63 ratnakūrpāsaraśanāpuṣpāmbarapariṣkṛtāḥ | stanabandhatulākoṭī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā || 21.64 lajjābhaṅgena devasya pārśve vāmetare sthitā | hastena vārijaṃ phullaṃ vāmena kila bibhratī || 21.65 ūrupradeśaviśrāntasavyetarakarāmbujā | yadvānyathāhastayoḥ syān niṣṭaptakanakaprabhā || 21.66 āsane 'bhayado hasto dakṣiṇo varado 'paraḥ | dakṣiṇe padmam athavā savyaḥ kaṭakamudritaḥ || 21.67 pāratantrye vidhirayaṃ svātantrye tūcyate yathā | caturbhujāṃ jaghanyābhyāṃ hastābhyām abjadhāriṇīm || 21.68 śaṅkhacakradharāṃ vāpi mukhyābhyāṃ varadāyinīm | abhītidāṃ ca koṭīradhāriṇīṃ bhayavarjitām || 21.69 vasundharāhvayāṃ devīṃ dvihastāṃ kanakaprabhām | dakṣiṇābhayadāmanyahastena vasudāyinīm || 21.70 gṛhītadāḍimaphalāṃ yadvā vāmakareṇa vā | cintāratnaṃ dhārayantīṃ hemasiṃhāsane sthitām || 21.71 vāmapādena saṃspṛṣṭanidhikumbhāmalaṅkṛtām | kalpakānokahacchāyāṃ samāśritya sthitāṃ tathā || 21.72 vāme pārśve mahīṃ devīṃ dvihastāṃ śyāmalaprabhām | stanabandhavihīnāṃ vā kuṇḍalāpīḍavarjitām || 21.73 susthitām savyapādena cānyena stokakuñcitām | puṣpaṃ dakṣiṇahastena dhārayantīṃ śucismitām || 21.74 ūrupradeśaviśrāntavāmahastām alaṅkṛtām | sottarīyāṃ yathāyogaṃ svātantrye śrītanūṃ viduḥ || 21.75 yogalakṣmīs tu śrīvatsaṃ bhogalakṣmīr dvipārśvayoḥ | vīralakṣmīs tu vai śeṣaṃ pṛthag bhavanakalpanam || 21.76 ratiḥ sarasvatī tuṣṭir devyo devasya dakṣiṇe | ratiḥ sindūrasaṃkāśā sphaṭikābhā sarasvatī || 21.77 haritālanibhā tuṣṭiḥ śrīvadābharaṇādayaḥ | pāratantrye vidhir ayaṃ svātantrye tūcyate vidhiḥ || 21.78 ratyādayaś caturhastā mukhyau syātāṃ rateḥ karau | varadābhayadāv anyau pāśāṅkuśadharau punaḥ || 21.79 mukhyau hastau sarasvatyā dakṣiṇo jñānamudritaḥ | vijñānapustakaṃ vāme jaghanye dakṣiṇe kare || 21.80 akṣasūtradharaṃ vāme sarve vajrādayaḥ sthitāḥ | tuṣṭeś ca pūrvavanmukhyau jaghanyau śaṅkham ambujam || 21.81 kīrtiḥ prītiś ca śāntiś ca vāme devasya saṃsthitāḥ | vāmāṅghrayaḥ susthitāḥ syur īṣad anyena kuñcitāḥ || 21.82 ūrupradeśaviśrāntā vāmāḥ puṣpadharāḥ pare | kīrtiḥ sphaṭikavarṇābhā nīlābhā prītir iṣyate || 21.83 śāntiḥ śyāmanibhā caiva sarvālaṅkāraśobhitā <�alaṃkāra�> | pāratantrye vidhir ayaṃ svātantrye cāpi pūrvavat || 21.84 sthite deve sthitā devyaḥ āsīnā vā yathāruci | āsīne 'pi tathaiva syuḥ svātantrye siṃhaviṣṭare || 21.85 padmāsanasthāḥ sarvās tāḥ praśastāḥ svastikāsane | padmāsanā ca padmā syāt śrīs tu syāt siṃhaviṣṭare || 21.86 pūrvādau tu dale padye vāsudevādimūrtayaḥ | āgneyādau dale bhūyaḥ catvāraḥ śvetakuñjarāḥ || 21.87 śaṅkhapadmanidhīśānāv adhastāt pādapārśvayoḥ | anyonyamukhamālokya sthitau lambodarau tathā || 21.88 bhūmyādayo bahir devyo dikṣv aṣṭāv aṣṭasu sthitāḥ | indrādayo 'tha dikpālā devīnāṃ ca bahiḥ sthitāḥ || 21.89 valayeṣu caturṣu syuś catasro vetrapāṇayaḥ | striyaḥ sthitāḥ pariṣkāraiḥ sarvair eva pariṣkṛtāḥ || 21.90
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde bimbalakṣaṇaṃ nāma ekaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
parivārāṇāṃ rūpavarṇādinirūpaṇam śrībhagavān rūpaṃ varṇaṃ tathākalpaṃ hastamudrāṃ tathaiva ca | hastasaṃkhyāṃ yathāyogam anyac cāpi caturmukha || 22.1 athavā parivārāṇāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathātatham | hayagrīvaḥ hayagrīvaṃ caturvāhuṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibham <�saṃnibham> || 22.2 aśvavaktraṃ mukuṭinaṃ dhautavastrottarīyakam | mukhyenaikena varadaṃ dakṣiṇenetareṇa tu || 22.3 vijñānapustakadharaṃ jaghanye ca karadvaye | akṣasūtraṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ supariṣkṛtam || 22.4 kalpayet puruṣākāraṃ anantaṃ ca kirīṭinam | bhogibhoge sukhāsīnaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ phaṇamaṇḍalaiḥ || 22.5 unnamadbhiḥ kṛtacchāyaṃ caturhastaṃ sitaprabham | yadvā tu śyāmalo varṇaḥ anantasya prakīrtyate || 22.6 prakalpayen mukhyahastaṃ varadaṃ vāmahastakam | gadādharaṃ kaṭīdeśam avalambyāthavā sthitam || 22.7 jaghanyābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ śaṅkhacakradharo bhavet | garuḍaḥ garuḍaṃ kanakaprakhyaṃ nīlanāsāgrasaṃyutam || 22.8 dakṣiṇetaravistīrṇaṃ vicitrapṛthuvakṣasam | daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrakuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam || 22.9 karaṇḍikāmukuṭinaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | vicitrakañcukadharaṃ bhujagendrair alaṅkṛtam || 22.10 hṛdi puṣpāñjalidharaṃ sthitamāsīnam eva vā | dakṣiṇetarayor ekapādayoḥ kuñcitaṃ bhavet || 22.11 pṛṣṭhato 'nyo yathāyogaṃ yadvā padmāsanaṃ bhavet | sūryaḥ mārtāṇḍaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktaṃ raktāmbaradharaṃ sthitam || 22.12 pṛṣṭhabhāge śiraścakraṃ sthāne vipulamaṇḍalam | bibhrāṇaṃ kamaladvandvaṃ hastābhyāṃ ca kirīṭinam || 22.13 uraḥpradeśe vipule syamantakamahāmaṇim | āsīnaṃ vā sukhaṃ bimbe padme 'ṣṭadalasaṃyute || 22.14 somaḥ pūrvādau vārijadale meṣaprabhṛtirāśibhiḥ | sevitaṃ kalpayet somaṃ dvābhyāṃ kumudadhāriṇam || 22.15 kāmaḥ kāmaṃ raktanibhaṃ raktaprasavāmbaradhāriṇam | hastābhyām aikṣavaṃ cāpaṃ bibhrāṇaṃ sumanaḥśarān || 22.16 caturbhujaṃ caturvaktraṃ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam | varadābhayapradaṃ mukhyahastābhyām anyahastayoḥ || 22.17 kuṇḍikāmakṣasūtraṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ ca sukhāsanam | gajānanaḥ gajānanaṃ caturbāhuṃ lambakukṣiṃ sitaprabham || 22.18 karaṇḍikāmukuṭinaṃ lambayajñopavītinam | vāmahastena mukhyena saṅgṛhītamahāphalam || 22.19 itareṇa tu hastena bhagnadantaparigraham | aparābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ pāśāṅkuśadharaṃ prabhum || 22.20 ṣaṇmukhaḥ ṣaṇmukhaṃ ca caturbāhuṃ dāḍimīkusumaprabham | varābhayapradau mukhyau jaghanyau śaktitomarau || 22.21 kalpayec chayāmalaṃ kāntyāṃ caturbhir bāhubhiḥ kramāt | gadādharāmabhayadāṃ śaṅkhacakravarāyudhām || 22.22 hārakeyūramakuṭanūpurādivibhūṣitām | athavāṣṭabhujāṃ durgāṃ dakṣiṇe doścatuṣṭaye || 22.23 abhītiśaranis triṃśacakramaṇḍalamaṇḍitām | vāme gadādhanuḥkhaḍgaśaṅkhāyudhadharāṃ varām || 22.24 athavā dvādaśabhujāṃ viśeṣaḥ samudīryate | dakṣiṇe paraśuṃ śūlaṃ vāme pāśāṅkuśau tathā || 22.25 ghaṇṭeti pañcapūrvāṇi yadvā dvādaśabāhukām | anuktamāyudhaṃ kalpyaṃ bhuje 'nyasmiṃś catuṣṭaye || 22.26 dvātriṃśad api vā hastāḥ śastrāmūhyaṃ tu coditam | dhanadaḥ lambodaraṃ mahākāyaṃ kalpayed dhanadaṃ tataḥ || 22.27 niṣṭaptakanakaprakhyaṃ varadaṃ daṇḍinaṃ tathā | dhanadasya parivārāḥ tasya dakṣiṇataḥ pārśve jṛmbhalo maṇibhadrakaḥ || 22.28 kalpyaḥ śaṅkhanidhiṃ caiva vāme pārśve tu kalpayet | nalakūbaramambhojanidhiṃ ca śibikuṇḍalam || 22.29 jṛmbhalo hemavarṇābho maṇibhadro maṇiprabhaḥ | nalakūbaranāmāsau śyāmavarṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 22.30 śibiḥ kuṇḍalavān raktaḥ sarve 'bhītivarapradāḥ | rudraḥ rudraṃ trinetramaruṇaṃ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam || 22.31 caturbhujaṃ nīlakaṇṭham indurekhāvibhūṣitam | vaiyāghracarmavasanaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 22.32 karābhyām api mukhyābhyāṃ varadābhayadaṃ sthitam | aparābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ bibhrāṇaṃ paraśuṃ mṛgam || 22.33 kṣetrapālaḥ kṣetrapālaṃ caturbāhuṃ karaṇḍimukuṭojvalam | daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam || 22.34 vāme kare daṇḍadharaṃ mukhye vāmetare kare | dadhānaṃ tarjanīmudrāṃ pāśāṅkuśamamukhyayoḥ || 22.35 viṣvaksenaḥ viṣvaksenaṃ caturbāhuṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ kirīṭinam | lambodaraṃ ca mukhyena kareṇābhayadāyinam || 22.36 dakṣiṇena prasavyena samālambya kaṭiṃ sthitam | āsīnamaparābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ śaṅkhacakriṇam || 22.37 athavā pūrvakarayor gadāmekatra kalpayet | anyatra tarjanīmudrāṃ yadvā dakṣiṇahastayoḥ || 22.38 gadāṃ mukhye jaghanye tu śaṅkhaṃ ca parikalpayet | mukhye 'bhītiramukhye tu cakram anyatra hastayoḥ || 22.39 śaṅkhacakradharaṃ yadvā sthitaṃ mukhye karadvaye | bibhrāṇaṃ kṣurikāṃ vetraṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ sthitam || 22.40 viṣvaksenamahiṣī devīṃ ca viṣvaksenasya vāmapārśve pratiṣṭhitām | nāmnā puṣpadharāṃ kuryāt kamalām iva lakṣitām || 22.41 brāhmyādimūrtayaḥ brahmyādi mātaraḥ sarvā brahmādyātmīya śaktayaḥ | rūpavarṇāyudhādīni brahmādīnāṃ bhajanti tāḥ || 22.42 vīrabhadraḥ rudrarūpī vīrabhadras tāsāṃ paścāt sthito bhavet | vināyakaḥ prāgbhāge vighnarāṭ tāsām agraṃ cāpi bhujadvayam || 22.43 pārśvataḥ sthitayoḥ sakhyor nyasya skandhe sthitaṃ bhavet | ajomukhāḥ āsannaprasavā pārśve 'jāmukhāḥ puruṣāḥ sthitāḥ || 22.44 divyāyudhadharā hy aṣṭau svacihnāṅkitamastakāḥ | cakrī musalavān śaṅkhī khaḍgī caiva gadādharaḥ || 22.45 śārṅgī padmī tathā vajrī narākārā dvipāṇayaḥ | dakṣiṇe tarjanīmudrā vāmaḥ kaṭyavalambitaḥ || 22.46 ādityāḥ ādityā dvādaśa tathā tadrūpādi dineśavat | dvihastā vasavaḥ sarve karaṇḍamukuṭānvitāḥ || 22.47 pitaraḥ daṇḍinastomaradharāḥ pitaraś ca dvipāṇayaḥ | daṇḍāyudhā vāmahaste dakṣiṇā 'bhayadāś ca te || 22.48 viśvedevāḥ karaṇḍikāmukuṭino viśvedevāś ca tādṛśāḥ | saptarṣayaḥ ``atrirbhṛguś ca kutsaś ca vasiṣṭho gautamas tathā || 22.49 kāśyapaś cāṅgirāś caiva ete saptarṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ |" saptarṣayaḥ kare sarve bibhrāṇā jñānapustakam || 22.50 vijñānamudrām anyatra jaṭāmakuṭadhāriṇaḥ | lakṣmyā virājitā brāhmyā rudras tv ekādaśa smṛtāḥ || 22.51 viṣṇupāriṣadāḥ kumudādyās tu viṣṇupāriṣadeśvarāḥ | karaiś caturbhir bibhrāṇāḥ śaṅkhacakragadās tathā || 22.52 dakṣiṇe tarjanīmudrāḥ pītavastrāḥ kirīṭinaḥ | upendrādayaḥ upendrādyaṣṭakaṃ cāpi dvihastamariśaṅkhakam || 22.53 viśvādayaś ca dvibhujā gadākhaḍgāstradhāriṇaḥ | karaṇḍikāmukuṭinaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 22.54 aśvinau aśvinau sadṛśau raktau sudhākalaśadhāriṇau | karaṇḍikāmukuṭinau dvihastau bhūṣitau bhṛśam || 22.55 indrādidikpālāḥ śyāmaḥ kirīṭī dvibhujo vāsavo vajradakṣiṇaḥ | vāmāvalambitakaṭiḥ sarvākalpapariṣkṛtaḥ || 22.56 jvālāmaṇḍalamadhyastho jvalano dvibhujo bhavet | varadaḥ śaktihastaś ca karaṇḍimakuṭojvalaḥ || 22.57 vaivasvataś ca dvibhujaḥ kirīṭī mecakacchaviḥ | dakṣiṇābhayado daṇḍī nirṛtir bhīmadarśanaḥ || 22.58 daṃṣṭrākarālavadano bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇaḥ | dakṣiṇo 'bhītirutkhaḍgo karaṇḍimukuṭojvalaḥ || 22.59 varuṇaḥ śyāmalaḥ pāśahasto vāme 'bhayapradaḥ | karaṇḍimakuṭaś caiva vāyur dhūmro dvibāhukaḥ || 22.60 aṅkuśo dakṣiṇe haste vāmaḥ kaṭyavalambanaḥ | maruto vāyunā tulyāḥ somaḥ somavad iṣyate || 22.61 īśāno rudravatkalpyaḥ teṣāṃ vāhanam ucyate | brahmādīnāṃ vāhanāni haṃso vidhātā rudrasya vṛṣaḥ sūryasya ghoṭakaḥ || 22.62 makaraḥ śūrpakārāteḥ śaktipāṇeś ca barhiṇaḥ | durgāyāḥ kesarī prokto vighnarājasya mūṣikaḥ || 22.63 naro yakṣādhirājasya śunāsīrasya kuñjaraḥ | agner meṣaḥ kṛtāntasya lulāyo vāhanaṃ bhavet || 22.64 piśāco nirṛter yānaṃ makaro varūṇasya tu | prāṇasya hariṇaḥ proktaḥ sa eva marutām api || 22.65 mūlaparivāraberayormānabhedaḥ ucchrāyaṃ mūlaberasya caturdhā vibhajet tataḥ | tatraikabhāgam ucchrāyaṃ parivāreṣu kalpayet || 22.66 mānāṅgulena vā yadvā dehalabdhāṅgulena vā | aṣṭāṅgulasamucchrāyaṃ dvādaśāṅgulam eva vā || 22.67 dviguṇaṃ vā yathāyogam ucchrāyaṃ parikalpayet | sthāne mūlapratikṛteḥ parivārāś ca te sthitāḥ || 22.68 āsīnāś cāsane tasya śayyāyāṃ śayanaṃ vinā | āsīnā vā sthitā vāpi kāmacārāś caturmukha || 22.69 pralambaphalakāyāmaghanavistāranirṇayam | kathyate pañcatālaṃ syād āyāmo ghanam aṅgulam || 22.70 ardhāyāmaṃ ca vistāraṃ kuryāt tatsukṛtaṃ yathā | pratimāyās tadaṅgānāṃ kauṭilyārjavasiddhaye || 22.71 lambamānaṃ yad ucchiṣṭaṃ tadardhaṃ kamalāsana | śikhāmaṇyādisuṣiram anekaṃ tatra kalpayet || 22.72 sūtrāṇi suṣirais tais tair lambayec ca pṛthak svayam | jānīyādārjavaṃ tena pratyaṅgam avicārayan || 22.73
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde parivāravidhir nāma dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
pūjopakaraṇāni śrībhagavān ārādhanopakaraṇaṃ tasya lakṣaṇam eva vā | ucyate saṃprati brahman śrūyatāṃ tadaśeṣataḥ || 23.1 lohajān dīpikāstambhān caturhastasamucchrayān | trihastān ekahastān vā dvihastān vā yathābalam || 23.2 tāmrajān vā rājatīyānayugmaiḥ snehadhāraṇaiḥ | yugmair vā vṛttivistīrṇair bahvaśrair vā pariṣkṛtān || 23.3 snehadhārāgrataḥ kḷptapadmakośair alaṅkṛtān | kuryād ardhyādipātrāṇi sauvarṇānītarāṇi vā || 23.4 rājatāny ubhayābhāve śuddhatāmramayāni vā | paiśācalohavarjyāni yathāvittānusārataḥ || 23.5 vyākośapaṅkajābhāni cakrādyaṅgāni madhyataḥ | prasthamānāvaradravyapūrayogyāntarāṇi ca || 23.6 śaṅkhaśuktisvabhāvāni yadvā pātrāṇi kalpayet | naivedyapātrāṇi tathā sauvarṇānītarāṇi vā || 23.7 rajatasyobhayābhāve śuddhatāmramayāni vā | havirdravyapramāṇāni vṛttāni parikalpayet || 23.8 darvīṃ hastāyatāmagramūlayor maṇḍalākṛtim | pānīyapātraṃ sauvarṇam athavā kaladhautajam || 23.9 vṛttāyataṃ suvṛttaṃ vā bhaved āyatam eva vā | prasthamātrapramāṇāmbhaḥpūrayogyāntarāṃ śubhām || 23.10 pādamānānusāreṇa pāduke raimaye śubhe | yadvā raupyamaye tāmramaye vā pādasannibhe <�saṃnibhe> || 23.11 tadādhāraṃ ca tallohaṃ vṛttaṃ madhye kṛtāmbujam | pādāvanejana jalagrahaṇaṃ pātram adbhutam || 23.12 tripādvṛttaṃ sarojābhaṃ haimaṃ rājatam eva vā | tāmraṃ sacakracaraṇam api vā pāvanaṃ satām || 23.13 ācāmavārigrahaṇapātram uttamalohajam | sarojakarṇikākāraṃ kuryād adbhutadarśanam || 23.14 kaṅkataṃ kanakaṃ rūpyam api vāṣṭāṅgulāyatam | ṣaḍaṅgulāyataṃ yadvā tadardhāṅgulavistṛtam || 23.15 viṃśatyā daśanair yuktaṃ bhaved ubhayato mukham | yadvā ṣoḍaśabhir dantair aṣṭābhir vā triyaṅgulam || 23.16 sauvarṇamañjanakṣodabhājanaṃ puṃmṛgākṛti | siṃhākāraṃ bhaved yadvā haṃsākāram athāpi vā || 23.17 śirobilaṃ śalākā ca dvādaśāṅgulamāyatā | aṣṭāṅgulā vā sauvarṇī bhaved ubhayatomukhā || 23.18 mukhaṃ ca kesaraphalapratimaṃ saṃhataṃ bhavet | darpaṇaṃ pratimāyānaṃ tadardhaṃ vā suśobhanam || 23.19 vṛttaṃ kāṃsyaṃ mahāratnakhacitaṃ vā yathāvasu | pādayuktam ayuktaṃ vā mukhamānam athāpi vā || 23.20 kārtasvaramayī vṛttā rājatī vātha pāvanī | aratnimānavistārā madhye 'ṣṭadalasaṃyutā || 23.21 pratipadmadalaṃ madhye suṣirāṇi śataṃ bhavet | karṇikāyāṃ kesareṣu viṣṭareṣu śataṃ bhavet || 23.22 aṣṭottaraśataṃ bhūyaḥ paryantadalamadhyataḥ | khacitaṃ ca mahāratnair evaṃ dhārāsahasrakam || 23.23 dhārāṣṭakena saṃyuktam abhiṣekāya kalpayet | bimbānuguṇamānaṃ vā tālamānāvarāntakam || 23.24 atha vakṣyāmi saṃkṣepāt patākālakṣaṇaṃ dvija | aṣṭatālāyataṃ vastraṃ daśatālāyataṃ tu vā || 23.25 āyāmasamavistīrṇakṣaumaṃ kārpāsajaṃ tu vā | suślakṣṇaṃ śobhanākāraṃ nānāvarṇavicitritam || 23.26 vidhāya sūtramārgeṇa caturaśraṃ purā samam | vibhajya koṇasūtrābhyāṃ pūrvabhāgaṃ tu lopayet || 23.27 dakṣiṇottarapāścāt yair bhāgair ekasitāṃ nayet | tasyāḥ paścimapārśve tu yaṣṭiṃ saṃskṛtya yojayet || 23.28 vyākocapaṅkajākāraṃ śuddham uttamalohajam | āḍhakāpūramānāmbhaḥ pūrayogyamahābilam || 23.29 hastadīrghajalasrāvī pārśvamānopaśobhitam | kalpayed aparaṃ snānapātraṃ muktāpariṣkṛtam || 23.30 yadvā śaṅkhanibhākāram agrato jalanālakam | dhūpapātraṃ sarojābhaṃ suvarṇādivinirmitam || 23.31 hastamānāntarālaṃ syān nālayuktaṃ tripād dvipāt | pādayor api tattat syād utsedhaś caturaṅgulaḥ || 23.32 anekasuṣiraṃ tasya vidhānaṃ sahajaṃ bhavet | athavā vikasatpadmasadṛśākāraśobhitam || 23.33 indunālaṃ tathā 'ṅghrau ca daṇḍāgre supratiṣṭhitam | dīpapātraṃ tathā nālamadhye kumudakuḍmalam || 23.34 vartyādhāraiḥ śatenāpi yuktam aṣṭabhir eva vā | viṃśatyā vāṣṭabhiś caiva dvābhyāṃ vā daśabhiś ca tat || 23.35 aṣṭabhir vā yathāśakti kalpayec chilpavittamaḥ | śabdabrahmamayī ghaṇṭā hastotsedhapramāṇikā || 23.36 brahmāṇḍagolakākāraḥ saurāṣṭrā vayavo bhavet | adhomukhastālamānavistārotsedhasaṃmitaḥ || 23.37 pradīpatulyasaṃsthānastīkṣṇābhyāntaratālukaḥ | tālonadaṇḍamūle syād agre susthitapakṣirāṭ || 23.38 cakrāgraṃ paṅkajāgraṃ vā ghaṇṭaiṣā parikīrtitā | nālabandhāś catasro 'nyā ghaṇṭāḥ pratidiśaṃ kṛtāḥ || 23.39 etasyām eva ghaṇṭāyāṃ yadvā vittānusārataḥ | nīrājanakriyā pātraṃ hemādidravyanirmitam || 23.40 tritālāyatavistīrṇā vṛttā madhyasaroruhā | nava vā sapta vā pañca tisraś caikāpi vā bhavet || 23.41 balipātraṃ catustālaṃ hemādidravyanirmitam | vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā bahvaśraṃ vā yathāruci || 23.42 madhyato 'ṣṭadalāmbhojam athavā ṣoḍaśacchadam | dvādaśacchadasaṃyuktam api vā parikalpayet || 23.43 muktātapatraṃ dhavalaṃ śaśibimbasamaprabham | sitātapatrāṇi tathā barhipatramayāni ca || 23.44 ātapatrāṇy anekāni haimadaṇḍāni padmaja | vyajanāni ca bhūyāṃsi kalyāṇāni mahānti ca || 23.45 cāmarāṇi ca śubhrāṇi ratnakalpamayāni ca | catuṣkam ekadambhāni pūjāṅgāni yathāyatham || 23.46 kalpayen nāgatilakā dalapātraṃ ca raimayam | aratnimānavistīrṇaṃ tanmānotsedhadaṇḍakam || 23.47 saparyāviṣṭaraṃ brahman hastamānonnataṃ śubham | yadvā nyūnasamutsedhaṃ yadvā vittānusārataḥ || 23.48 aratnimātravistāraṃ tanmānāyāmakalpanam | siṃhapādayutaṃ yadvā hastipādacatuṣṭayam || 23.49 śārdūlapādam athavā hemaratnapariṣkṛtam | caturaśraṃ madhyakḷptasarasīruhacitritam || 23.50 sa cakraṃ pīṭhasahitaṃ mārgayuktaṃ sagātrakam | yadvā cakravinirmuktaṃ mārge hastaiḥ pariṣkṛtam || 23.51 tapanīyamayaṃ yadvā rajatādivinirmitam | dārujaṃ vā maṇicchinnaṃ svarṇapaṭṭair vinirmitam || 23.52 snānāsanaṃ ca pūrvoktavistārotsedhasaṃmitam | dviguṇaṃ cāyataṃ kḷptaṃ makarāsyāmbunālakam || 23.53 caturaṅgulaparyantaṃ tālotsedhavirājitam | kuryāc ca pūrvavat tasya darśanīyam anuttamam || 23.54 alaṅkārāsanaṃ cāpi pūrvoktacaraṇair yutam | dviguṇāyāmavistāraṃ hemaratnavibhūṣitam || 23.55 pādahīnaṃ catustālavistāraṃ dviguṇāyatam | ghanaṃ ca dvyaṅgulaṃ tasya bhojanāsanam īritam || 23.56 yātrāsanaṃ ca vistīrṇaṃ dvihastaṃ hrasvapādakam | dviguṇaṃ cāyataṃ tasya nālaṃ tālonnataṃ bhavet || 23.57 yānaviṣṭaranālasya madhye dvāraṃ prakalpayet | avatārakathopetaṃ hemaratnapariṣkṛtam || 23.58 āsanāni yathoktāni lohajāni caturmukha | dārujāni yathālābhaṃ kalpayec chilpavittamaḥ || 23.59 yadvāsanānāmāyāmo vistāraś connatis tathā | arcāpramāṇānuguṇaṃ kalpayed iti nirṇayaḥ || 23.60 yātrāsanaṃ rathaṃ vāpi kuryād vittānusārataḥ | sitāsitāruṇā miśrān dukūlaparikalpitān || 23.61 dhvajān kārtasvaramayair daṇḍaiś cāpi virājitān | vāhanāni ca devānāṃ daṇḍāgre parikalpayet || 23.62 plākṣān vā vaiṇavān daṇḍān kevalān parikalpayet | jaladroṇīṃ kaṭāhaṃ ca hemādidravyanirmitam || 23.63 agādham abhiṣekārthaṃ devasya parikalpayet | nānāvidhāni vādyāni vīṇādīni ca kalpayet || 23.64 ardhyapādyādipātrāṇāṃ pātramānānusārataḥ | caraṇāni suvarṇādidravyakḷptāni kārayet || 23.65
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde pūjopakaraṇalakṣaṇaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
ācāryalakṣaṇāṅkurārpaṇādi śrībhagavān ācāryalakṣaṇaṃ brahman kathayāmi yathātatham | ādau tu brāhmaṇo vidvān pañcarātraparāyaṇaḥ || 24.1 sarvadoṣavinirmuktam aśeṣaguṇabhājanam | ācāryaṃ varayet pūrvaṃ tadadhīnā hi siddhayaḥ || 24.2 nyūnātirekanirmuktakalyāṇāvayavaḥ śuciḥ | kalyāṇahastaḥ śrutavān vṛttavān śīlavān api || 24.3 āmnāye chandasi tathā brāhmaṇo dharmavatsalaḥ | pañcakālavidhānajñaḥ tatkarmaniyataḥ kṣamī || 24.4 jitendriyaḥ prabhuḥ śrīmān ūhāpohavicakṣaṇaḥ | ṣaṭkarmakṛt ṣaḍadhvajñaḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidalolupaḥ || 24.5 ṣoḍaśanyāsacaturaḥ saumyaḥ siddhāntabhedavit | ṛjur dayāvān brahmajñaḥ satyavāk śiṣṭasaṃmitaḥ || 24.6 vyākhyātā dhṛtimānāryaḥ pūrvabhāṣī priyaṃvadaḥ | smitapūrvābhibhāṣī ca sātviko nyāyavittamaḥ || 24.7 darśanīyo yuvā vādī vādeṣu ca vicakṣaṇaḥ | kuśāgrīyamatiḥ śāntaḥ nītijño deśakālavit || 24.8 anasūyo jitadvandvaḥ samaḥ sarveṣu jantuṣu | vyasanābhyudaye śaśvad ekarūpaḥ sadanvayaḥ || 24.9 mitabhāṣī dhyānaparo dvādaśākṣaracintakaḥ | mānasārādhanaparaḥ pañcarātraparāyaṇaḥ || 24.10 svatantro vṛddhasevī ca rūpavān api cāstikaḥ | abrahmanindakaḥ sarvasmṛtimān kīrtimān api || 24.11 sarvāpavādanirmuktaḥ sarvakalyāṇalakṣaṇaḥ | sarvaśāstrārthavettā ca dīkṣitaścakramaṇḍale || 24.12 gṛhastho brahmacārī vā vānaprastho 'thavā bhavet | adhikārī bhaved eṣu yathoktaguṇabhājanam || 24.13 ācāryatve tathārtvijye tādṛśān eva bhūsurān | guṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samuditān karmanirvahaṇakṣamān || 24.14 varayed guruṇā sārdhaṃ yajamānaḥ prayatnavān | vaṭuryuvā samo vṛddhaścaturdhā parikathyate || 24.15 dvayor vibhāgitaḥ samyak savibhāgaś ca kathyate | varṣāt ṣoḍaśakādarvāk vaṭurity abhidhīyate || 24.16 vaṭuryuvā samo vṛddho yogyo nityārcanāvidhau | naimittike sāṅkure tu samaḥ śreṣṭhatamena vā || 24.17 samaye yajamānas tu gāṃ bhuvaṃ kāñcanaṃ tathā | nālikeraṃ ca karmādāv ācāryāya pradāpayet || 24.18 ṛtvijaḥ ṣoḍaśa brahman yadvāṣṭau caturo 'pi vā | ācāryeṇa yathoktena ṛtvigbhiś ca yathoditaiḥ || 24.19 sthāpayen mandire viṣṇuṃ yajamānaḥ prayatnavān | sarvān kāmān avāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 24.20 anyathā ceddhariṃ dhāmni sthāpayen mūḍhacetanaḥ | naiveṣṭaṃ phalam āpnoti mriyate cācirāt svayam || 24.21 na ca dhāma cirasthāyi na ca rāṣṭraṃ narādhipaḥ | na sannidhatte bhagavān na ca prīṇāti cejyayā || 24.22 naivādhikārī sanyāsī brāhmaṇo 'py uktalakṣaṇaḥ | itare 'pi trayo varṇāḥ yajane vādhikāriṇaḥ || 24.23 na kuṇḍagolau naivānye bhaveyur anulomajāḥ | karmādhikāriṇo naiva vrātyā vai brahmayonayaḥ || 24.24 naiteṣām adhikāro 'sti sūtādīnāṃ caturmukha | aṅkurārpaṇam pratiṣṭhākarmaṇaḥ pūrvam aṅkurāropaṇaṃ bhavet || 24.25 na karma phaladaṃ brahman aṅkurāropaṇaṃ vinā | tasmād ārabhyamāṇeṣu pratiṣṭhādiṣu karmasu || 24.26 prāg eva vāpayed bījān aṅkurārthaṃ yathāvidhi | dvādaśāhe navāhe vā saptāhe pañcame 'hani || 24.27 tṛtīye 'hani vā kuryāt karmārambhadinaṃ prati | pālikāsu śarāveṣu ghaṭikāsu ca vāpayet || 24.28 aṅkurāṇi praśastāni pātreṣu trividheṣv api | sāṅgulaṃ hastam utsedhaṃ pālikānāmathānanam || 24.29 ṣoḍaśāṅgulavistāraṃ bilaṃ saptāṅgulaṃ bhavet | pādapīṭhasya vistāramadhaś caivāṅgulaṃ bhavet || 24.30 unmattakusumākāraṃ vaktramambhojasannibham <�saṃnibham> | dvāviṃśāṅgulamāyāmo ghaṭikānāṃ prakīrtitaḥ || 24.31 ghaṭikāḥ pañcavaktrāḥ syus tanmadhye tu ghaṭākṛtiḥ | ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ ca vistīrṇaṃ eteṣāṃ madhyamaṃ mukham || 24.32 catuṣṭayaṃ caturdikṣu caturaṅgulamānanam | viṃśatyaṅgulam utsedhaṃ vistāraṃ dvādaśāṅgulam || 24.33 śarāveṣu vijānīyāt yadvā mānaṃ yathāvasu | hemādilohajāḥ sarvāḥ mṛṇmayā vā yathāvasu || 24.34 ṣaṭtriṃśatpālikāś caiva ṣaṭtriṃśadghaṭikās tathā | śarāvāś cāpi ṣaṭtriṃśad evam aṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 24.35 uttamā kḷptir uditā jaghanyā kḷptir ucyate | pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśa grāhyā bhaveyur dvādaśāpi vā || 24.36 aṣṭau vā syuś catasro vā śarāvaghaṭapālikāḥ | sarvārthe pālikā yadvā ṣoḍaśāṣṭau yathābalam || 24.37 catasro vā tatas tāsu maṅgalāṅkurakalpanā | ayugmā mānuṣe kāryā daive yugmās tu pālikāḥ || 24.38 aṅkurāvāpanasthāne maṇḍapaṃ parikalpayet | śubhe vivikte 'bhimate deśe vai deśikottamaḥ || 24.39 caturdikṣu caturdvāraṃ caturvadanamālikam | darbhamālāparikṣiptaṃ muktādāmavirājitam || 24.40 vitānakṣaumavistāraṃ gomayāliptabhūtalam | pradīpamālāvitatamakṣataiś cāpi sarvataḥ || 24.41 sudhācūrṇaiś ca dhavalaiś citritābhyantarasthalam | maṇḍapaṃ kalpayitvaivaṃ gṛhṇīyāt tatra mṛttikām || 24.42 khanitraṃ kṣālayitvādbhirācchādya navavāsasā | viṣvaksenam atho vāpi vainateyam athāpi vā || 24.43 sumanobhir alaṅkṛtya ṛtvigbhir vāhayed guruḥ | gajaskandhaṃ rathaṃ vāśvamārūḍho vāhako nayet || 24.44 chatradhvajapatākābhiḥ sārdhamaṅkurabhājanaiḥ | trividhair maṅgalais tūryair api coddhoṣya sarvataḥ || 24.45 bhaktair bhāgavataiḥ sārdhaṃ yatibhir munibhis tathā | niṣkramya śākunaṃ sūktaṃ pāṭhayan bahvṛcān api || 24.46 prācīm udīcīṃ vā dūrāṃ diśaṃ gatvā manohare | śucau deśe mṛdaṃ śudvāṃ khanitreṇa samuddharet || 24.47 astramantreṇa dharaṇīṃ saṃprokṣya prathamaṃ guruḥ | mahīsūktena saṃspṛśya dhyāyannekāgracetasā || 24.48 mūrtiṃ devasya vārāhīṃ abhyarcya kusumair bhuvam | astrāmbunā prokṣitena puṣpair abhyarcitena ca || 24.49 khanitreṇa khaned bhūmiṃ prāṅmukhaḥ kroḍavidyayā | lohaje bhājane mṛtsnāṃ vetraje vātha bhājane || 24.50 gṛhītvā mūlamantreṇa veṣṭayitvā ca vāsasā | pratyagreṇa tathā nadyā vālukān gomayāṃs tathā || 24.51 gokulāt pūrvavatpātre gṛhītvācchādya cāṃśukaiḥ | yāne gaje haye vāpi samāropya guruḥ svayam || 24.52 ṛtvigbhiḥ sahitaiḥ sūktamadhīyānaiś ca śākunam | śrīsūktaṃ bhūmisūktaṃ ca tūryāṇy api ca ghoṣayet || 24.53 gatvā pradakṣiṇaṃ grāmaṃ praviśen maṇḍapaṃ tataḥ | ācāryo mūrtipāś caiva nūtanakṣaumavāsasaḥ || 24.54 sottarīyāḥ svalaṅkārāḥ soṣṇīṣāḥ sāṅgulīyakāḥ | surabhīkṛtasarvāṅgāḥ sragviṇo mṛṣṭakuṇḍalāḥ || 24.55 śvetayā mṛtsnayā samyak parikṣiptordhvapuṇḍakāḥ | pavitrapāṇayaḥ snātāḥ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇāḥ || 24.56 kṛtācāmāḥ kṛtanyāsāḥ japtamantrā yathātatham | tadartham arthayitvā tu yajamānasamanvitāḥ || 24.57 bhagavantaṃ jagadyoniṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | saṃprokṣya pālikākṣetramadbhiḥ śuddhābhirañjasā || 24.58 candanārdrāṇi sūtrāṇi sphālayeyur anukramāt | prāg āyatāni prathamaṃ ṛjūni dvādaśa sphuṭam || 24.59 tathodagāyatāgrāṇi daśa pañca ca kalpayet | āśāsv aṣṭāsu madhye ca śarāvaghaṭapālikāḥ || 24.60 dvādaśa dvādaśa sthāpyāḥ śatam aṣṭottaraṃ tathā | āgneye nairṛte bhāge tathā yāmye ca pālikāḥ || 24.61 ghaṭikā vāruṇe brāhme tathā paurandare 'pi ca | śarāvā mārute saumye raudre cāpi yathāvidhi || 24.62 prāgāyatāni nava vā sūtrāṇi parikalpayet | dvādaśaivetarāṇi syuḥ śarāvaghaṭapālikāḥ || 24.63 aṣṭau ca catvāriṃśac ca yadvā sūtrāṇi kalpayet | navaiva dviprakārāṇi ṣaṭtriṃśatpālikādayaḥ || 24.64 prāgāyatāni nava vā udīcīnāyatāni ṣaṭ | caturviṃśatipātrāṇi yadvā prāgāyatāni ca || 24.65 catvāri sūtrāṇy anyāni pañca dvādaśakalpane | sarvārthapakṣe prathame pañcaiva dvividhāny api || 24.66 yadvendukumbhaparitaḥ pālikāḥ ṣoḍaśa sthitāḥ | dvādaśāpi tathaivāṣṭau catasro vā diśaṃ prati || 24.67 sūtrapātreṣu sarvatra pratyak somaghaṭasthitiḥ | śaktyapekṣaṃ pālikānāṃ pakṣabhedaḥ pradarśitaḥ || 24.68 prakṣālya viṣṇugāyatryā śarāvaghaṭapālikāḥ | sahadevī ca dūrvā ca sārdhamaśvatthapallavaiḥ || 24.69 kaṇṭheṣu pālikādīnāṃ bandhanīyāś caturmukha | kuśakāśatṛṇais teṣāṃ bilamūlāni pūrayet || 24.70 bilāni prathamaṃ mṛdbhiḥ vālukābhir anantaram | karīṣacūrṇair upari samṛddhaṃ pūrayed vilam || 24.71 pādeṣu pālikādīnāṃ śālīn vrīhīn athāpi vā | āḍhakaṃ vā prasthaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tilataṇḍulān || 24.72 pratipādaṃ vinikṣipya caturaśram athāpi vā | vṛttaṃ vistārayet pūrvaṃ pālikādīn tataḥ kramāt || 24.73 nyaset pādeṣu dhānyeṣu mantrair etair yathākramam | sthāne yathokte ghaṭikāḥ pārameṣṭhyā tu vidyayā || 24.74 puruṣākhyena mantreṇa pālikās tadanantaram | śarāvān viśvamantreṇa prāṅmukho vāpy udaṅmukhaḥ || 24.75 brahmādīśānaparyantaṃ nyāsas teṣām anukramāt | vāsobhir veṣṭayet sarvān pratyekaṃ mūlavidyayā || 24.76 prativyūhaṃ tu vā śaktau chādayed vāsasopari | sthāne pāścāt tu sarveṣāṃ somakumbhaṃ niveśayet || 24.77 dhānyarāśau yathāpūrvamāveṣṭya navavāsasā | gandhodakena saṃpūrṇe tasmin ratnāni vinyaset || 24.78 nīvārāḥ śālayo mudgāḥ śyāmākāś ca priyaṅgavaḥ | yavāstilāś ca godhūmāḥ ye cānye yājñikā matāḥ || 24.79 teṣāṃ bījāni nikṣipya pātre mahati nūtane | tatpātraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya tūryaghoṣapuraḥsaram || 24.80 parītya mandiraṃ pātraṃ śālidroṇārdhaśobhite | prāgdeśe pālikādīnāṃ niveśya susamāhitaḥ || 24.81 payobhiḥ kṣālayed dhānyabījāni vividhāni ca | pracchādya navavastreṇa puṇyāhaṃ kārayet punaḥ || 24.82 śaṅkhabheryādinādena vādayitvā diśo daśa | dhyātvā ca pālikādīnāmadhidevān anukramāt || 24.83 ghaṭikānāṃ vidhātāraṃ pālikānāṃ janārdanam | īśānaṃ ca śarāvāṇāṃ dhyātvā 'bhyarcya yathāvidhi || 24.84 toraṇāni dhvajāṃś caiva dvārakumbhāṃś ca deśikaḥ | kumudādigaṇāṃś caiva samabhyarcya yathāvidhi || 24.85 arcayet pālikādīnāmadhidevān anukramāt | somakumbhe tataḥ somaṃ yajed āvāhya ca svayam || 24.86 nivedya pāyasaṃ havyaṃ juhuyāt sarpiṣā śatam | catasraḥ samidhaś caiva mūlamantreṇa mantravit || 24.87 caruṃ puruṣasūktena pūrṇāhutyantamācaret | ghṛtena somamantreṇa juhuyāc chatamāhutīḥ || 24.88 saṃpātājyena saṃspṛśya sparśamantreṇa pālikāḥ | saṃpātājyāvaśeṣaṃ ca bījapātre vinikṣipet || 24.89 somamantraṃ śataṃ vāraṃ japtvā viprābhyanujñayā | muhūrte śobhane bījān vāpayet pālikādiṣu || 24.90 brahmādīśānaparyantaṃ dvādaśākṣaravidyayā | ācāryānumatāś cānye vaiṣṇavā dhyānamāsthitāḥ || 24.91 āvapeyuramī tūṣṇīṃ siñcet kumbhasthavāribhiḥ | pidhānaiśchādayet sarvaṃ dadyād dikṣu baliṃ tataḥ || 24.92 rakṣibhyaḥ kumudādibhyo baliṃ dadyād divāniśam | yajeta somaṃ tatkumbhe pāyasena divāniśam || 24.93 dīpāṃś cāropitān rakṣed anirvāṇān yathā tathā | dvijendrān toṣayed iṣṭaiḥ tāmbūlaiḥ sumanaḥphalaiḥ || 24.94 guruṃ ca toṣayed vittaiḥ yajamānaḥ prayatnavān | sadyo vā dhānyabījāni yathoktavidhinā vapet || 24.95 haridrāvāribhiḥ siñced aṅkurāṇy abhivṛddhaye | somakumbhajalenāpi nityaṃ siñceta pālikāḥ || 24.96 aṅkureṣu ca pīteṣu śukleṣu ca tathā śubham | vidyād ṛjuṃ prarūḍheṣu viparīteṣu cāśubham || 24.97 karmārtham aṅkurāṇyādau yaḥ samāropayed guruḥ | sa eva karma kārtsnyena kuryāt prājño 'pi netaraḥ || 24.98 anujñayā vā tatputraḥ śiṣyo vā tatsamācaret | ṛtvijo vāpi tatkarma yadyaśakto gurur bhavet || 24.99
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde ācāryalakṣaṇāṅkurārpaṇavidhir nāma caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
