pratiṣṭhopakaraṇāni śrībhagavān athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi pratiṣṭhāvidhim uttamam | mukhyakālanirūpaṇam ayanaṃ cottaraṃ mukhyaṃ jaghanyaṃ dakṣiṇāyanam || 25.1 sthāpanaṃ dhruvaberasya mukhya eva sadeṣyate | jaṅgamasthāpane mukhye jaghanye cāpi vā bhavet || 25.2 māghamāse bhādrapade pratiṣṭhāṃ māsi varjayet | gurāvastaṃgate śukre vyatipāte ca varjayet || 25.3 saṅkrāntau durdine caiva grahaṇe somasūryayoḥ | parastāś ca purastāś ca ṣoḍaśāhani varjayet || 25.4 aticāre tathā māne parvayugmayute tathā | apraśasteṣu yogeṣu kāṇasthūṇāndhabheṣu ca || 25.5 evamādiṣu cānyeṣu garhiteṣu na kalpayet | rājño rāṣṭrasya cānyasya grāmasya ca guros tathā || 25.6 yajamānasya dhiṣṇyasya śubheṣv anuguṇeṣu ca | tithinakṣatravāreṣu muhūrteṣu śubheṣu ca || 25.7 prathamā ca dvitīyā ca pañcamī ca trayodaśī | tṛtīyā saptamī ṣaṣṭhī dvādaśyekādaśī tathā || 25.8 daśamī pūrṇamāsī ca śuklapakṣe śubhās tv imāḥ | kṛṣṇe tu pañcamī yāvat tithayaḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥ || 25.9 triṣūttareṣu revatyāmaśvinyāṃ rohiṇīṣu ca | puṣye punarvasau cāpi haste ca śravaṇe tathā || 25.10 devasya sthāpanaṃ kuryād viṣṇor abhyudayāvaham | somo bṛhaspatiś caiva bhārgavo 'tha budhas tathā || 25.11 ete saumyagrahāḥ proktāḥ praśastāḥ sthāpanaṃprati | saiṃhikeyārkavārāś ca rakto vā sthāpane pare || 25.12 rāśau tṛtīye ṣaṣṭhe vā sthitāś cet śubhaśaṃsinaḥ | dvitīye ca tṛtīye ca tathā pañcamaṣaṣṭhayoḥ || 25.13 saptame navame caiva rāśau caikādaśe punaḥ | sthitaḥ sukhakaraścandraḥ ṣaṭsaptadaśamasthitaḥ || 25.14 bhayakṛd bhārgavo jñeyaś candraḥ krūrair nirīkṣitaḥ | atithau vānyakāleṣu na praśastaś caturmukha || 25.15 bahunātra kim uktena saha mauhūrtikair guruḥ | sthāpanaṃ devadevasya kuryāt kāle 'bhipūjite || 25.16 adhivāsamaṇḍapasthānam prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryād adhivāsanamaṇḍapam | prathamāvaraṇe kuryāt dvitīyāvaraṇe 'pi vā || 25.17 tṛtīyāvaraṇe vāpi deśe yogyāvakāśake | āśāsv aṣṭāsv abhimate deśe maṇḍapakalpanam || 25.18 vistīrṇaṃ daśabhir hastais tāvadbhiś cāyataṃ karaiḥ | caturdikṣu caturdvāraṃ maṇḍapaṃ parikalpayet || 25.19 kuṇḍakalpanam tanmadhye pañcahastā syād vedī hastasamucchṛtā | caturaśreṣṭakacitā kuṇḍāni paritas tataḥ || 25.20 vedikāyāstritāle tu samāni viṣamāṇi vā | caturaśraṃ caturviṃśadaṅgulaṃ bhūtalaṃ khanet || 25.21 vistārāyāmasadṛśaṃ paritaḥ khātabhūtalam | dvyaṅgulaṃ tadbahiḥ kalpyaṃ mekhalātrayamaiṣṭakam || 25.22 kuṇḍasya prakṛterarvāk catvāro mekhalās tu vā | kuṇḍaprakṛtir ucchrāyam aṅgulānāṃ ca viṃśatiḥ || 25.23 adhastād unnatā tasya ṣoḍaśāṅgulamekhalā | tālotsedhamitā pūrvā madhyamāṣṭāṅgulonnatā || 25.24 tadardhenocchritācānyā vistāraś caturaṅgulaḥ | sarvāsāṃ sātvikīcādyā madhyamā rājasī matā || 25.25 anyā ca tāmasī jñeyā tadanyā triguṇātmikā | paścime prakṛter ūrdhve yoniḥ pañcadaśāṅgulā || 25.26 āyatā mūlam ārabhya vistīrṇā kramaśo bhavet | aṅgulair daśabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ caturbhir dvyaṅgulena ca || 25.27 ekena cāgre kalpyaiva mekhalopari śobhanā | yonivatsanniveśena <�saṃniveśena> pippalacchadavad bhavet || 25.28 krameṇa nimnā pratyaksthā kuṇḍasyāgre niveśitā | agre ca yoner nālaṃ syāc caturaṅgulamāyatam || 25.29 tryaṅgalaṃ sahanaṃ mūle mukhe caiva ṣaḍaṅgulam | kāhalākāravat kuryāt yamasya diśi vā bhavet || 25.30 yonir hotā yadi bhaved udīcīnamukhaḥ svayam | vinā vā juhuyād yoniṃ mokṣāya tvarate yadi || 25.31 kuṇḍamāne dvihastādau mekhalādi ca tādṛśam | yadvaikamekhalaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kartā sa tvarito yadi || 25.32 kuṇḍārdhaṃ koṇabhāgārdhaṃ dvayaṃ tenaiva saṃmitam | sūtram ārabhya kuṇḍasya madhyaṃ dakṣiṇato diśi || 25.33 sthāpayitvā puraḥ paścāt sūtrārdhaṃ bhrāmayet tataḥ | ardhacandravadetena kuṇḍamāviṣkṛtaṃ bhavet || 25.34 kuṇḍārdhādavaśiṣṭaṃ yatkoṇe tasyārdham eva ca | kuṇḍārdhaṃ ca dvayaṃ tena saṃmitaṃ sūtramāyatam || 25.35 tatkuṇḍamadhye saṃsthāpya sthāpayed dikṣu sarvataḥ | vṛttakuṇḍaṃ bhavet tena sanniviṣṭaṃ sarojavat || 25.36 dalāni mekhalāsthāne kalpayed dvādaśāṣṭa vā | vibhajya pañcadhā kuṇḍaṃ bahirbhāgaṃ dvayāyatam || 25.37 sūtraṃ kuṇḍasya madhye tu sthāpayitvātha pārśvayoḥ | gamayet sūtrapātāntaṃ trikoṇaṃ tena kalpayet || 25.38 saṃvibhajyāṣṭadhā kuṇḍaṃ bhāgenaikena vardhayet | ubhābhyām api bhāgābhyāṃ tasmān madhyaṃ pragṛhya ca || 25.39 lāñchayet ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu tatra ṣaṭsūtrapātanam | kṛtvā tatra bhavet kuṇḍaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ kamalāsana || 25.40 caturviṃśatibhāgaṃ tu kṛtvā kṣetraṃ puroditam | ekabhāgaṃ bahiḥ paścāt sarvatraiva niveśayet || 25.41 madhyāt koṇād gṛhītvaivaṃ pascāt taddikṣu lāñchayet | tatas tatsūtrasaṃyogāt aṣṭakoṇaṃ bhavet sphuṭam || 25.42 pañcakoṇavibhāgena sūtrapāto vidhīyate | pañcādaśāṅgulaṃ sūtraṃ koṇe koṇe tu pātayet || 25.43 koṇāntarāṇi kurvīta aṣṭādaśabhir aṅgulaiḥ | sūtrayet pūrvadiksūtraṃ pañcakoṇeṣu pātayet || 25.44 daśāṅgulaṃ madhyamaṃ tu bhrāmayet samasūtrakam | daśāṅgulaṃ tathā yoniṃ kuryād aśvatthapatravat || 25.45 yādṛgvidhaṃ bhavet kuṇḍaṃ tādṛg eva tu mekhalā | yoniṃ sarveṣu kuṇḍeṣu kalpayet kamalāsana || 25.46 yonikuṇḍena yoniḥ syāt padmakuṇḍena paṅkajam | padmaṃ kuṇḍeṣu sarveṣu khātamadhye prakalpayet || 25.47 pūrvokte tu dalasthāne arāṇi parikalpayet | cakrakuṇḍaṃ bhavet tena padmakuṇḍaṃ tad eva tu || 25.48 tato 'ṅgulivaśād yadvā kuryāt kuṇḍāni padmaja | pūrvadikcāpakuṇḍaṃ ca paścime jyāṃ prakalpayet || 25.49 caturviṃśāṅgulaṃ sūtraṃ vistārāyāmasaṃyutam | caturaśrasamāyuktaṃ caturaśraṃ vidhīyate || 25.50 ṣaṣṭyaṅgulaṃ bhavec cāpaṃ jyā tu ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulā | cāpakuṇḍaṃ bhaved evaṃ dvātriṃśatyaṅgulaṃ punaḥ || 25.51 pātayet triguṇenaiva trikoṇaṃ vidyate sphuṭam | pañcādaśāṅgulaṃ sūtraṃ madhyato bhrāmayet tataḥ || 25.52 vṛttakuṇḍaṃ bhaved evaṃ padmakuṇḍaṃ tad eva tu | padmaṃ padmasamākāraṃ karṇikādalasaṃyutam || 25.53 yathāvṛttapramāṇaṃ hi tathā padmasya lakṣaṇam | catuṣkuṇḍādividhiḥ caturaśraṃ bhavet kūṇḍaṃ vedyāḥ prācīnabhūtale || 25.54 kuṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇato vidyād ardhacandrasamākṛti | vṛttaṃ tu paścime deśe uttare kamalākṛti || 25.55 yadvā trikoṇaṃ tatra syāt catuṣkuṇḍaṃ prakalpayet | indreśānāntare padmaṃ yadvā ca caturaśrakam || 25.56 prāk pratyak kamalaṃ kuṇḍaṃ pañcakuṇḍavidhau bhavet | diśy agner yonikuṇḍaṃ syāt trikoṇaṃ tu tricakṣuṣaḥ || 25.57 saptakuṇḍavidhāno 'yaṃ prakāraḥ kamalāsana | caturaśraṃ bhavet prācyāṃ agner diśi bhagākṛti || 25.58 cāpākṛti yamasya syāt ṣaḍaśraṃ nirṛter bhavet | varuṇasya bhaved vṛtta pañcāśraṃ mātariśvanaḥ || 25.59 trikoṇaṃ naravāhasya īśānasyāṣṭakoṇakam | caturaśrasya kuṇḍasya prāg deśe kamalākṛti || 25.60 navakuṇḍavidhau kḷptir iyaṃ viṣayavahniṣu | samavahniṣu pūrvādidikṣu kuṇḍaṃ kramād bhavet || 25.61 caturaśraṃ tataś cāpaṃ vṛttaṃ koṇatrayānvitam | catuṣkuṇḍavidhāne syāt ṣaṭkuṇḍe tūcyate vidhiḥ || 25.62 catvāri pūrvavat kṛtvā diśy agner yonikalpanam | ṣaḍaśraṃ diśi kuṇḍaṃ syāt ṣaḍardhanayanasya tu || 25.63 aṣṭakuṇḍe tv aṣṭadikṣu kuṇḍānyaṣṭau yathākramam | caturaśraṃ bhagākāraṃ cāpākāraṃ ṣaḍaśrakam || 25.64 vṛttaṃ pañcāśram uditaṃ trikoṇaṃ cāṣṭakoṇakam | trīṇi trīṇi ca kuṇḍāni yadvā dikṣu prakalpayet || 25.65 kamalaṃ ca trikoṇaṃ ca dikṣu kuṇḍasya pārśvayoḥ | kalpayec ca caturdikṣu dviṣaṭko 'gnividhir bhavet || 25.66 mūrtisaṃkhyānuguṇam agnikalpanam pañcamūrtipratiṣṭhāyāṃ navāgniṃ parikalpayet | pañca vā sapta vā vahniṃ caturmūrtau tu kalpayet || 25.67 aṣṭa ṣaḍvā 'tha caturaḥ kalpayej jātavedasaḥ | athavā dvādaśāpy agnīn kalpayet kamalāsana || 25.68 ekamūrtau vītihotrāḥ yugmāḥ syur atha vetare | prapānirmāṇam prapāyāṃ vedim athavā mahatyāṃ kamalāsana || 25.69 ṣoḍaśastambhaparamāṃ prapāṃ yadvā prakalpayet | tiraskariṇyā paritaśchādayen maṇḍapāntaram || 25.70 dvārāṇi dikṣu catvāri prapāyāḥ parikalpayet | snānamaṇḍapamaiśānyāṃ diśi tasya prakalpayet || 25.71 snānavedī ca tatra syāt prāgbhāge hastasaṃmitā | dvihastā vā trihastā vā hastamātrasamucchrayā || 25.72 yadvā tālasamutsedhā caturaśrā manoharā | digbhāge jalakulyā tu saumye nimnā manoharā || 25.73 homasādhanāni sruksruvau lakṣaṇopetau homārthaṃ parikalpayet | pālāśīṃ khādirīṃ vāpi srucaṃ yadvā 'nyavṛkṣajam || 25.74 yājñīyāṃ kalpayec chilpī juhūdaṇḍasamāyatām | hemādilohajāṃ vāpi dārujāṃ vāpi bhūṣitām || 25.75 dvitālasaṃmitāṃ vāpi sāṅgulāṃ kamalāsana | tridhā vidhāya tāṃ bhūyastṛtīye 'ṃśe dvidhā kṛte || 25.76 uparyaṃśaṃ punaḥ kuryāt pañcadhā caturaṃśakaiḥ | bhavet sruco 'graṃ tanmūlaṃ vistāreṇa ṣaḍaṅgulam || 25.77 agram ekāṅgulaṃ kroḍavaktravat parikalpayet | pañcāṃśenāvaśiṣṭena bhāgena galakalpanam || 25.78 galaṃ dvyaṅgulavistāram ubhayos tasya pārśvayoḥ | ardhāṅgulaṃ bhaven nimnaṃ vistārāyāmatatsamam || 25.79 tyajed aṃśam aśeṣeṇa sūtrapātād bahiḥ sthitam | galasyādho 'vaśiṣṭāṃśo vṛtto vā caturaśrakaḥ || 25.80 vistārāyāmasadṛśaṃ syād gartaṃ tasya madhyataḥ | vṛttaṃ tṛtīyabhāgena saṃmitaṃ śobhanākṛti || 25.81 gādhaṃ vistārasadṛśaṃ gartasya parikīrtyate | gartabāhyaṃ tridhā kṛtvā prathame 'ṣṭadalasthitiḥ || 25.82 madhyameṃśe caturdhā tu vibhajen nābhimaṇḍalam | prathame parikalpyaṃ syād ambhoruhaniketanam || 25.83 dvābhyāṃ tu madhyamāṃśābhyāṃ ṣaḍaraṃ dviguṇaṃ tu vā | avaśiṣṭena bhāgena nemimaṇḍalakalpanam || 25.84 śaṅkhāś caturṣu koṇeṣu caturaśraprakalpane | yavonnatā bahiḥ kāryā mekhalā ca caturyavā || 25.85 ārabhya gartam agrāntaṃ vivaraṃ sarpiṣo bhavet | sarojapṛṣṭhasadṛśaṃ pṛṣṭhabhāgaṃ prakalpayet || 25.86 kūrmapṛṣṭhasamaṃ yadvā caturaśraṃ sapīṭhikā | adhastād dviguṇas tasya daṇḍāyāmaṃ pracakṣate || 25.87 taddaṇḍam aṣṭadhā kṛtvā mūlabhāgena kalpayet | adhastāt kumbham ardhena śiṣṭenopari paṅkajam || 25.88 mūlaṃ prakalpayed evaṃ padme daṇḍaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ | ādhāraṃ vā vinā daṇḍo valayais tribhir aṅkitaḥ || 25.89 vṛtto 'thavā tadardhāśras tadagram api paṅkajam | tribhir vā valayair yuktaṃ nāhanaṃ cāṅgulaṃ bhavet || 25.90 sruvaṃ ca hastamānaṃ syāt tadagraṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ bhavet | vāsikāpuṭavad gartadvayayuktaṃ suvṛttakam || 25.91 gartam ardhāṅgulaṃ nimnaṃ vistīrṇaṃ cārdham aṅgulam | aṅgulenāvaśiṣṭena parito golakalpanam || 25.92 bilayoḥ pṛṣṭhabhāge tu madhyarekhā yavonnatā | ayugmavalayaṃ kaṇṭhe yavamātronnataṃ śubham || 25.93 daṇḍaṃ ca pariśiṣṭena golāṅgūlākṛtir bhavet | mūlaṃ dvyaṅgulavistīrṇaṃ lohato dārujo 'pi vā || 25.94 sraksruvādyarthe varjyaṃ dāru sphuṭitaṃ sakrimiṃ bhinnaṃ ūrdhvaśuṣkaṃ sakoṭaram | svayaṃ nipatitaṃ vṛkṣaṃ sraksruvārthe parityajet || 25.95 svīkuryāc cet pramādena bhūyān doṣaḥ prasajyate | maṇḍapadvārādyalaṅkāraḥ <�alaṃkāraḥ> dvāreṣu maṇḍapasya syāt toraṇānāṃ catuṣṭayam || 25.96 aśvatthodumbaravaṭaplakṣaiḥ prāgāditoraṇaiḥ | ekena vā yathoktena alābhe candanadrumaḥ || 25.97 saptahastāyatāḥ pādāḥ pañcahastāyatāpi vā | ayugmair āyatāḥ pādāḥ hastenārdhena paṭṭikā || 25.98 trīṇi trīṇi ca śūlāni toraṇaṃ toraṇaṃ prati | śūlāni ca dvitālāni nāhaś cāṣṭāṅgulo bhavet || 25.99 paṭṭikāpādanahanaṃ dvāviṃśatyaṅgulaṃ bhavet | vṛttān vā caturaśrān vā pādāṃś ca parikalpayet || 25.100 kalaśaṃ dakṣiṇāvartaṃ śaṅkhacakraṃ dhvajaṃ tathā | paṭahaṃ kārmukaṃ nāgaṃ teṣu pādeṣu kalpayet || 25.101 kārayen maṅgalānyaṣṭau phalakeṣu yathātatham | lohajeṣv athavā yajñavṛkṣajeṣu yathāvasu || 25.102 dvāviṃśatyaṅgulāyāmaṃ tadardhena ca vistṛtam | phalakaṃ dvyaṅgulaghanaṃ pīṭhe pīṭhe pratiṣṭhitam || 25.103 phalakeṣu likhet tatra śrīvatsādyaṣṭam aṅgulam | śrīvatsaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca bherīṃ darpaṇamaṇḍalam || 25.104 matsyayugmaṃ ca śaṅghaṃ ca cakraṃ kāśyapanandanam | padmāsanasthitaṃ saumyaṃ dvādaśāṅgulamāyatam || 25.105 tattadrūpānusāreṇa vistīrṇaṃ pārśvayor dvayoḥ | pradīpaṃ cāmaraṃ mūrdhni chatraṃ ca parikalpayet || 25.106 bimbapramāṇānuguṇaṃ snānapīṭham udumbaram | dṛṅmokṣapīṭhaṃ ca tathā jalādhipavanasya ca || 25.107 pīṭhaṃ bimbānuguṇyena kalpayed avicārayan | ṛtvijāṃ ca tathā pīṭham ācāryasya ca kalpayet || 25.108 pāduke pādasadṛśau yajñavṛkṣeṇa kalpayet | upakumbhaṃ ca kalaśaṃ karakaṃ maṇikaṃ tathā || 25.109 dīpastambhān ghṛtādīni snānadravyāṇy aśeṣataḥ | candanāni sugandhāni vastrāṇi vividhāni ca || 25.110 samitpuṣpakuśādīni dhānyāni vividhāni ca | suvarṇaratnalohāni gāḥ savatsā manoharāḥ || 25.111 saṃbhārān evam anyāṃś ca saṃbhṛtyāvyagramānasaḥ | ārabheta yathāśāstraṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ deśikottamaḥ || 25.112
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde pratiṣṭhopakaraṇaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ brahmā vyāpino devadevasya pratiṣṭhā kīdṛśī matā | bhagavan saṃśayānasya mama niścayato vada || 26.1 śrībhagavān sarvasya bhūtajātasya harir ātmā sthito 'pi san | mantravīryāc ca māhātmyāt sthāpakasya guros tathā || 26.2 pratimāyāṃ prakarṣeṇa sannidhatte hariḥ svayam | kāmānaśeṣāṃs tatraiva harim arthayate janaḥ || 26.3 tena pratiṣṭhānāmedaṃ avyarthaṃ vartate bhuvi | yathā ca vahnir dahano na dahanvyāpya tiṣṭhati || 26.4 araṇīmathanād bhūyo jāyamānaḥ pradṛśyate | dahanādīni karmāṇi karoti ca yathātatham || 26.5 tathā sarvagato viṣṇur adṛśyaḥ prākṛtair janaiḥ | dṛśyate ca pratikṛtau mantriṇo mantragauravāt || 26.6 tasmāt sarvātmanā viṣṇuṃ pratiṣṭhāpyābhipūjayet | śilpibhir nirmite bimbe śāstradṛṣṭena vartmanā || 26.7 karmārcā pīṭhikāyāṃ ca ratnādivyasane kṛte | udghāṭite ca nayane yathārhaṃ sarvaśāntide || 26.8 sthūlasūkṣmeṣu cānyeṣu pratimāṅgeṣu sarvataḥ | sukṛteṣu yathāśāstraṃ karmānte deśikottamaḥ || 26.9 rathakāreṇa viduṣā sunirūpya nirūpakaḥ | dhanaiś ca karmānuguṇaṃ sthapatīn paritoṣya ca || 26.10 rathakāraṃ ca vividhair manaḥprītivivardhanaiḥ | gateṣu śilpiṣu tathā rathakāre ca nirgate || 26.11 antarbahiś ca sadane śodhite mārjanādinā | prajvālitair darbhapuñjaiḥ paryagnikaraṇe kṛte || 26.12 prākāre maṇḍape dhāmni gopure mārjanādinā | śuddhīkṛte tathā gavyaiḥ pañcabhiḥ prokṣite sati || 26.13 puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātha brāhmaṇair mantravittamaiḥ | abliṅgābhiś ca bhūyopi garbhagehaṃ bahis tathā || 26.14 ṛgbhiḥ saṃprokṣayet sarvamācāryaḥ sarvabhūsureḥ | pradīpitair goghṛtaiś ca pradīptair bahubhis tathā || 26.15 sarvato dīpite dhāmni kālāgurumukhais tathā | gandhadravyair dhūpayitvā sudhācūrṇais tathākṣataiḥ || 26.16 puṣpair dūrvāṅkuraiś cāpi sarvato dhāmni bhūṣite | tato 'parāhṇasamaye śāntihomaṃ samācaret || 26.17 mānonmānapramāṇāder hānir vā vṛddhir eva vā | durvijñeyāṃ tadakhilaṃ homācchāmyati niścayam || 26.18 śamīpallavasaṃyuktānakṣatān deśikaḥ svayam | saptavyāhṛtibhiś caiva pratyekaṃ juhuyāc chatam || 26.19 caruṃ nṛsūktena tathā juhuyāt ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ | pañcopaniṣadā caiva sarpiṣā juhuyāc chatam || 26.20 pratimāsannidhāv evaṃ hutvā pūrṇāvasānikam | upatiṣṭheta tadanu mantreṇānena deśikaḥ || 26.21 namastubhyaṃ bhagavate jātavedas svarūpiṇe | nārāyaṇāya havyasya kavyasya ca yathātatham || 26.22 hartre yaṣṭavyadevānām ātmane paramātmane | sannidhatsva ciraṃ deva pratimāyāṃ hitāya naḥ || 26.23 vijñāpyādhokṣajaṃ devam evaṃ prāñjalirānataḥ | sadarbhaṃ navavastreṇa pratimāṃ mūlavidyayā || 26.24 ācchādayed uttarīyam api dadhyāt tathā guruḥ | ardhyaṃ pādyaṃ tathācāmaṃ gandhaṃ dhūpaṃ tathaiva ca || 26.25 dīpaṃ sumanasaḥ sarvaṃ gāyatryā viṣṇupūrvayā | dadyāc chriyādidevīnām uktaṃ sarvaṃ svavidyayā || 26.26 brahmādiparivārāṇām anyeṣāṃ svasvavidyayā | kautukaṃ dakṣiṇe haste badhnīyān mūlavidyayā || 26.27 tathaiva vidyayā saptavārān kṛtvā 'bhimantraṇam | badhvā samarcayed devaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣavidyayā || 26.28 chāyādhivāsasiddhyarthaṃ devasya puratas tataḥ | jaladroṇīṃ kaṭāhaṃ vā sthāpayel lohanirmitam || 26.29 mṛṇmayaṃ vā yathālābhaṃ bhājanaṃ dhānyasañcaye | pūrayed gandhatoyena śuddhasphaṭikavarcasā || 26.30 jale ca nikṣipet kūrcamaṣṭāviṃśatidarbhakam | arcayec ca hariṃ kūrce bhāvayen mūlavidyayā || 26.31 saṃhārakramam ācāryaḥ smṛtvā kūrcaṃ jale svayam | śāyayitvā prāk chirasaṃ cakramudrāṃ pradarśayet || 26.32 kūrcaṃ śrīdharayor darbhais tribhiḥ syād rudravedhasoḥ | pañcaviṃśatibhiḥ kāryaṃ dvābhyām anyāmṛtāśinām || 26.33 rakṣākumbhaṃ ca tatraiva yamasya diśi kalpayet | saṃveṣṭya navavastrābhyām ekena karakaṃ tathā || 26.34 brahmāṇaṃ pūjayet kumbhe karake ca sudarśanam | paritaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau nidadhyād vastraveṣṭitān || 26.35 sāpidhānān savastrāṃś ca saratnān kūrcasaṃyutān | indrādidikpatīn teṣu pūjayed aṣṭa cāṣṭasu || 26.36 sarvāṅgīṇena vastreṇa navena pratimāṃ tadā | chādayitvā samantāc ca siddhārthān vikiret kṣitau || 26.37 rakṣohaṇeti mantreṇa rakṣāṃ kuryāt samantataḥ | āropayed anirvāṇān pradīpān bahuvarcasaḥ || 26.38 pravartayet trayīghoṣaṃ brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ | cakramantraṃ ca valaje vinyasyābhyarcayed guruḥ || 26.39 prādakṣiṇyena sadanāt niṣkramet sahamūrtipaiḥ | yasyāḥ pratikṛteḥ sākṣān nādhivāso jale bhavet || 26.40 tasyāś chāyādhivāso 'yaṃ kathitaḥ kamalāsana | dārulohaśilāmayyāḥ pratimāyāḥ pṛthag vidhāḥ || 26.41 tāsāṃ jalādhivasanaṃ sākṣād evaṃ vidhīyate | lohajapratimānāṃ tu pūrvaṃ vāryadhivāsanāt || 26.42 kṛtvā sarojasaṃghātam adhivāsaṃ samācaret | vṛttākāraṃ śālibhāraṃ nidhāyopari taṇḍulān || 26.43 tadardham upariṣṭāc ca taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilān kṣipet | tileṣu padmavinyāsaṃ kṛtvāstīrya kuśān punaḥ || 26.44 prāg agraṃ nūtanapaṭaṃ teṣām upari nikṣipet | sapadmaṃ kevalaṃ vāpi pīṭhaṃ vinyasya tatra tu || 26.45 ratnāny api ca lohāni gāyatryā viṣṇupūrvayā | vinyasya juhuyād agnau sarpiṣāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 26.46 nṛsūktena caruṃ caiva puṇyāhaṃ caiva vācayet | devam āropayet tasmin pīṭhe mantram udīrayet || 26.47 supratiṣṭheti manasā gurur dhyājej jagadgurum | pratiṣṭhito 'sīti sāma paṭhec ca tadanantaram || 26.48 dṛḍhabandhaṃ sthapatinā kārayet kamalāsana | udghāṭayec ca nayane pratimāyā yathāvidhi || 26.49 toṣayed rathakārādīn dhanena mahatā punaḥ | śamīpatrākṣatair homaṃ kṛtvābhyajya ca sarpiṣā || 26.50 ghṛtasnāteti mantreṇa cūrṇaiś coddhṛtya sarvataḥ | prakṣālya vāribhiś coṣṇaiḥ kuśair nūtanavāsasā || 26.51 saṃveṣṭayet pratikṛtiṃ yathāpūrvam anukramāt | upavītottarīyādi pradānāniyathāpuram || 26.52 ācamya ca pratisaraṃ bandhayitvā ca maṅgalam | tato rathādike yāne samāropya ca mūrtipāḥ || 26.53 paṭheyuḥ sāmagānajñaiḥ sārdham anyaiś ca bhūsuraiḥ | rathantarādikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktam uttamam || 26.54 nārāyaṇānuvākaṃ ca sūktaṃ śākunam eva ca | āmaneyuḥ pratidiśaṃ sūktaṃ rakṣoghnam eva ca || 26.55 pāṇḍareṇātapatreṇa cāmareṇa sitena ca | cīnāṃśukamayaiś chatraiḥ dhvajair barhamayais tathā || 26.56 vyajanair api kalyāṇair dhvajair nānāvidhair api | tūryair bahuvidhainṛttair geyaiś cāpi samantataḥ || 26.57 mahatā janasaṅghena brāhmaṇānāmitas tataḥ | nṛpopacārair aparair upacarya yathāvidhi || 26.58 pratimāṃ grāmadhāmādiprādakṣiṇyena cānayet | jalādhivāsavidhiḥ jalādhivāsadeśāntamāsādya śibikādikāt || 26.59 avaropya jalābhyarṇe prapāyāṃ siṃhaviṣṭare | prāṅmukhaṃ samavasthāpya yadvā sthāpya udaṅmukham || 26.60 nadīṣu dīrghikāyāṃ vā taṭāke nirjhare 'pi vā | jalādhivāsanaṃ kuryāt prasanne salile 'pi vā || 26.61 alpatoye śmaśānānte lavaṇodakadūṣite | kaṣāye kaṭuke caiva tikte phenaiś ca dūṣite || 26.62 caityavṛkṣasamīpe ca nīcair adhyāsite tathā | ūṣare śaivalayute varṇāntarayute tathā || 26.63 evamādiṣu duṣṭeṣu pratimāṃ nādhivāsayet | jalamadhye prapāṃ kuryād bahustambhasamanvitām || 26.64 caturdvārasamopetāṃ catustoraṇabhūṣitām | vitānadhvajasaṃyuktāṃ darbhamālāpariṣkṛtām || 26.65 muktādāmasamāyuktāṃ sragviṇīṃ dīpadīpitām | phalair nānāvidhair yuktāṃ tatrādhivasanaṃ caret || 26.66 puṇyāhavācanaṃ pūrvaṃ punar nadyādiṣu sthitāḥ | āpaḥ puruṣamantreṇa saṃśoṣya gurur ātmavān || 26.67 agnimantreṇa dagdhvā ca candrakoṭisamaprabham | nivṛttimantraṃ tad dhyāyet tasmād dhyānād vinirgataiḥ || 26.68 jalair amṛtakalpaiś ca punar nadyādi pūrayet | tasmin jale mahāpīṭhaṃ caturaśraṃ samāyatam || 26.69 vinyasyāstaraṇopetaṃ sopadhānaṃ navaṃ śubham | prakalpayed yogapīṭhaṃ tasyopari yathākramam || 26.70 gandhapuṣpādinā pīṭham arcayitvā samāhitaḥ | dvāratoraṇakumbhādi yaṣṭavyaṃ tadanantaram || 26.71 paṭhadbhiḥ śākunaṃ sūktaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha mūrtipaiḥ | ādāya pratimāṃ paścād ācāryastīradeśataḥ || 26.72 saṃhārakramam ācāryaḥ smṛtvā toye praveśayet | udaṅmukhaṃ prāk chirasaṃ pratimāṃ śāyayet tataḥ || 26.73 veṣṭitāṃ navavastreṇa āpādatalamastakam | sthāpitān pūrvavat tīre kumbhādīn api pūjitān || 26.74 jale niveśayet tadvat tīre tadvad yathākramam | darśayec cakramudrāṃ ca rakṣāmudrāṃ ca darśayet || 26.75 tīre caturvidhaṃ vādyaṃ vādayet sarvatoditam | ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni purāṇāni ca bhūsurāḥ || 26.76 āmaneyur anirvāṇān pradīpān api kārayet | snānapānādikaṃ sarvaṃ tataḥprabhṛti nācaret || 26.77 ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā jalamadhye 'dhivāsayet | yāmaṃ yāmārdhakaṃ vāpi jalavāsaṃ samācaret || 26.78 gṛhārcāsthāpane kāle sadya eva samācaret | jalādhivasane caiva tathā nayanamokṣaṇe || 26.79 śayane vedikāyāṃ ca na kālaḥ kamalāsana | pradoṣeṣv adhivāsaḥ syāc chayanaṃ ca mahāniśi || 26.80 pratiṣṭhāṃ ca divā kuryān muhūrte śāstracodite | nadyādyabhāve bimbasya jalādhivasanaṃ bhavet || 26.81 jaladroṇyāṃ kaṭāhe vā samuddhṛtya mahajjalam | yathāsaṃbhavam anyasmin mṛṇmayādau vidhīyate || 26.82 sadyo vā toyavāsaṃ syāt purastād adhivāsanāt |
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi śrīpādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde jalādhivāsavidhir nāma ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
pratiṣṭhāvidhiśeṣaḥ śrībhagavān pratimām adhivāsyaivam apsu pūrvoktavartmanā | aparedyuḥ prabhātāyāṃ śarvaryāṃ maṇḍapādike || 27.1 śodhite rathakāreṇa śobhite ca yathātatham | toṣite rathakāre tu manaḥprahlādanair dhaneḥ || 27.2 ācāryo mūrtipāś caiva kṛtakṛtyā jitendriyāḥ | navāmbaradharāḥ sarve dhṛtapañcāṅgabhūṣaṇāḥ || 27.3 gandhamālyadharā bhadrāḥ sottarīya paricchadāḥ | dhṛtordhvapuṇḍraracanāḥ soṣṇīṣā mṛṣṭakuṇḍalāḥ || 27.4 ādiṣṭā yajamānena jīvājīvātmakair dhanaiḥ | vāstupuruṣanirūpaṇam vāstuhomaṃ prakurvīran karma daivaṃ yathā bhavet || 27.5 vāstur nāma caturvaktra bhārgavasvedasaṃbhavaḥ | abhyadravatsurān hantum ātmano baladarpitaḥ || 27.6 sa devais tāḍitastūrṇam api tadbhuvi vihvalaḥ | visrastāṅgaḥ sa ca prāṇān dhārayaty eva vāstukaḥ || 27.7 adhomukhaṃ prākchirasaṃ vinyased vāstupūruṣam | prasārya pāṇipādau dvau koṇabhūmiprakalpitau || 27.8 tam arcayet prayatnena karma daivaṃ yathā bhavet | anarcite vāstudeve kṛtaṃ karmāsuraṃ bhavet || 27.9 maṇḍape dakṣiṇe pārśve vāstudevaṃ likhed bhuvi | saptadarbhayutaṃ kūrcaṃ kṛtvā tatra vinikṣipet || 27.10 tatrārcayed vāstunāthaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt | vāstudevasya śirasi pūjayed aṃśumālinam || 27.11 jhaṣadhvajaṃ bāhumūle kumāraṃ kūrpare tathā | haste vināyakaṃ pādayugale cāśvidevate || 27.12 madhye candraṃ tathā pārṣṇyoḥ durgāṃ mātrś ca kūrpare | bāhumūle tathā sthāṇuṃ hṛdaye māmavasthitam || 27.13 brāhmaṇaṃ nābhideśe ca dikpālān svāsu dikṣu ca | kṣetreśam uttare pārśve vāstudevasya pūjayet || 27.14 paścime vāstunāthasya deśe ca juhuyād guruḥ | pañcopaniṣadā sarpiḥ sahasraṃ śatam eva vā || 27.15 śamyapāmārgakhadirasamidbhir juhuyāt tataḥ | mūlamantreṇa tanmantravarṇasaṃkhyābhir ātmavān || 27.16 caruṃ puruṣasūktena juhuyāt ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ | caruṇā vāstudevānāṃ juhuyāc ca sakṛt sakṛt || 27.17 baliṃ ca datvā devobhyo kṣetrādhipataye tathā | karmārambhe pratiṣṭhāyāṃ maṇḍape sadane tathā || 27.18 vāstuyāgakramaḥ proktaḥ sarvatra kamalāsana | mārjanaṃ gomayālepaḥ prokṣaṇaṃ maṇḍape bhavet || 27.19 sudhācūrṇair akṣataiś ca maṇḍayitvā bhuvaḥ sthalam | siddhārthān vikired dikṣu astramantrābhimantritān || 27.20 sānnidhyānarhāḥ janāḥ nāstikān bhinnamaryādān devabrāhmaṇanindakān | pāparogayutān martyān ninditān piśunāṃs tathā || 27.21 pāṣaṇḍino hīnavṛttīn pratilomān samatsarān | lubdhān mūrkhān aviduṣo bahir nirvāsayet tataḥ || 27.22 sthūṇāṃś ca maṇḍape tasmin vāsobhir veṣṭayen navaiḥ | vitānayec chubhair vastraiḥ patākābhiś ca bhūṣayet || 27.23 muktādāmabhir anyaiś ca phalaiḥ puṣpaiś ca pallavaiḥ | parito darbhamūlābhir maṇikāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 27.24 śobhayen maṇḍapaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvittānusārataḥ | khātvā dvitālamavaṭaṃ toraṇāni caturdiśam || 27.25 sthāpayed dvāradeśeṣu pūrvādiṣu yathākramam | aśvatthatoraṇaṃ prācyāṃ audumbaram anantaram || 27.26 naiyagrodhaṃ ca pāścātyaṃ plākṣaṃ ca tadanantaram | nartakair gāyakaiś caiva vaiṇikair vaṃśakais tathā || 27.27 vāditrakuśalaiś cānyaiḥ tathā vādavicakṣaṇaiḥ | śobhitaṃ sarvato dikṣu brahmaghoṣaiś ca nāditam || 27.28 dīpas tathā pālikābhiḥ sāṅkurābhiś ca sarvataḥ | candanāgarukarpūradhūpaiḥ parimalīkṛtam || 27.29 kṛtvāivaṃ maṇḍapaṃ samyak aparāhṇe guruḥ svayam | utthāpya bimbam udakāt kumbhaṃ ca kalaśān api || 27.30 udvāsya devatās tasmāt tadbimbaṃ tīraviṣṭare | prāṅmukhaṃ samavasthāpya vāribhiḥ kṣālayet tathā || 27.31 lohajaṃ ced viśudhyarthaṃ tintriṇīphalavāriṇā | vastrābharaṇapuṣpādyair alaṅkṛtya manoharaiḥ || 27.32 yānam āropya tadbimbaṃ yathāpūrvam aśeṣataḥ | kṛtvā maṅgalatūryādi gamayed yāgamaṇḍapam || 27.33 maṇḍapasyottare bhāge viṣṭare viniveśayet | ācāryo mūrtipaiḥ sārdhaṃ praviśed garbhamandiram || 27.34 bahuberavidhānaṃ ced vidhireṣa vidhīyate | prāk cādhivāsitaṃ kūrcaṃ bilāt tasmāt samuddharet || 27.35 bimbāc ca vastrābharaṇamālyāny apanayed guruḥ | nayanonmīlanaṃ kṛtvā dhruvaberasya śāstrataḥ || 27.36 darśayed aṣṭadhānyāni gāś ca kanyāḥ salakṣaṇāḥ | unmīlanaṃ śriyādīnām evaṃ śāstroktavartmanā || 27.37 kalaśaiḥ saptadaśabhiḥ mṛdādidravyasaṃyutaiḥ | chāyāsnapanamādarśe sakūrce kalpayed guruḥ || 27.38 pṛthak chriyādidevīnāṃ snapanaṃ navabhir ghaṭaiḥ | brahmeśau saptakalaśaiḥ ṛṣīṇām api pañcabhiḥ || 27.39 tribhiś ca devatānāṃ syād ekena kalaśena vā | nīrājanāntair vastrādyair upacāraiḥ samarcayet || 27.40 dhruvaberasya hṛdaye tasya dīpamaṇiprabham | vinyasya mantram ācāryo dvādaśākṣarasaṃmitam || 27.41 bimbam ācchādayed vastraiḥ kambalair vā samantataḥ | evaṃ kuryāc chriyādīnāṃ tato nirgatya mandirāt || 27.42 maṇḍapasthāṃ pratikṛtiṃ chādayet kambalādibhiḥ | raimayaṃ rājataṃ vāpi pātramāḍhakapūritam || 27.43 dhānyarāśau nidhāyāgre pūrayet tad yathākramam | madhunā sarpiṣā caiva pūrayec chādayet tataḥ || 27.44 vāsasā pariśuddhena pātrayoś ca tayoḥ punaḥ | arcayed bhāskaraṃ pūrve paścime śaśinaṃ tathā || 27.45 mantreṇa madhuvāteti sarpirādy abhimantrayet | aṣṭāṅgulā śalākā syād raimayī cātha rājatī || 27.46 aṣṭadhānyāni paritaḥ pātreṣu viniveśayet | gāḥ kanyakāś ca rucirāḥ bhūṣaṇaiś cāpi bhūṣitāḥ || 27.47 ānīya sthāpayet pārśve brahmaghoṣaiś ca ghoṣayet | madhvaktamukhayā netraṃ raimayyā ca śalākayā || 27.48 dakṣiṇaṃ prollikhed vāmaṃ sarpiṣāktaśalākayā | rājatyā vilikhen netraṃ taccakṣur iti saṃpaṭhan || 27.49 vyapohyācchādanapaṭaṃ darśayen madhusarpiṣī | aṣṭadhānyāni gāś caiva kanyakāḥ purataḥ sthitāḥ || 27.50 gurave gāḥ prayaccheta govindaḥ prīyatām iti | pātrayugmaṃ śalāke ca dadyād dhānyāṣṭakaṃ tathā || 27.51 netronmīlanavelāyāṃ vādyaghoṣeṇā goṣayet | gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāj jīvājīvadhanātmikām || 27.52 kautukaṃ bandhayed bimbe snapanārthaṃ yathāvidhi | mūlamantreṇa tadbimbaṃ samutthāpya nayet tataḥ || 27.53 ṛtvigbhiḥ śakunaṃ sūktaṃ adhīyānaiś ca bhūsuraiḥ | snānamaṇḍapabhūbhāge tatrodumbaraviṣṭare || 27.54 kṣaumāstaraṇasaṃyukte sthāpayet pratyagānanam | bhadrādimantram ācāryaḥ svayam uccārya mantravit || 27.55 viṃśatyekonamṛdbhis tu puṇyakṣetrādijanmabhiḥ | udaṅmukhaḥ sthito mṛdbhiḥ ālipya pratimāṃ tataḥ || 27.56 ``mūrdhānaṃ diva" ity etāmṛcamuccārayec chubhaiḥ | jalair ``imaṃ me varuṇa" ity uccārya samūrtipaḥ || 27.57 kṣālayet kautukaṃ sarvaṃ kalaśaiḥ snāpayed guruḥ | devasya purataḥ sthāpya sūtravastrādiveṣṭitāt || 27.58 sakūrcaiḥ pallavair yuktān kalaśān dhānyarāśiṣu | pādyābhiṣecanaṃ kuryād ``idaṃ viṣṇur" itīrayan || 27.59 ``āpo hiṣṭheti" mantreṇa tathā 'rdhyeṇābhiṣecanam | ``imaṃ me varuṇa" ity eva tathā ''camanavāriṇā || 27.60 ``pavitraṃ teti" mantreṇa pañcagavyābhiṣecanam | ``ghṛtasnāte"ti sāmnā ca ghṛtenaivābhiṣecayet || 27.61 `` dadhi krāvṇe" ti mantreṇa dadhisnapanam ācaret | payovratena sāmnā ca payasā snapanaṃ bhavet || 27.62 ``madhuvāte" ti mantreṇa madhunā snapayed guruḥ | ``yajñāyajñe" ti mantreṇa kaṣāyāmbho 'bhiṣecanam || 27.63 ``mānastoke" ty ṛcā toyair uṣṇaiś caivābhiṣecanam | ``vaṣaṭ te viṣṇave" tyādimantreṇa maṇivāriṇā || 27.64 ``phalinī"ty anuvākena snāpayet tu phalāmbhasā | ``hiraṇyagarbha"mantreṇa snāpayel lohavāriṇā || 27.65 ``śanno devīr" iti snānaṃ mantritair mārjanāmbubhiḥ | ``gandhadvāre"ti mantreṇa gandhāmbukalaśena tu || 27.66 ``trātāram" iti sāmnā ca bhaved akṣatavāriṇā | yavāmbukalaśena syād ``idaṃ viṣṇur" iti tryṛcā || 27.67 ``nṛsūktena" ca śuddhābhir adbhir ante 'bhiṣecayet | upacāraiś ca vastrādipradānādyaiḥ samarcayet || 27.68 pūrve vā dakṣiṇe bhāge śayyāṃ vedyāṃ prakalpayet | prokṣayed vedikāṃ pūrvaṃ dvādaśākṣaravidyayā || 27.69 prāg agrānudagagrān vā darbhān saṃstīrya puṣkalān | śālīnāṃ pañcabhārāṇi taṇḍulānarvasaṃmitān || 27.70 upariṣṭāt kṣipet teṣāṃ tilān upari nikṣipet | tadardhān caturaśrān vā vṛttān vā tān vikīrya ca || 27.71 carma vaiyāghram upari tilānām api nikṣipet | tūlikāṃ nikṣipet tasmin mṛdvāstaraṇabhūṣitām || 27.72 kambalān upariṣṭāc ca kṣaumaṃ tadupari kṣipet | citrāṇi vastrāṇi tathā śuklāni ca tathopari || 27.73 kāṣṭhajaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ snigdhaṃ caturhastasamanvitam | catuṣpādasamāyuktaṃ caturaśrāyataṃ tataḥ || 27.74 khaṭvāsaṃjñitaparyaṅkaṃ tadūrdhve sthāpayet tataḥ | dukūlaṃ mṛdutalpaṃ ca vinyaset soparicchadam || 27.75 upadhānāni citrāṇi śayanāṅgāni kalpayet | kastūrikādigandhaiś ca sugandhair adhivāsitām || 27.76 sugandhapuṣpāstaraṇāṃ nānālaṅkāraśobhitām <�alaṃkāra�> | śayyāṃ kṛtvaivam etasyāṃ devamānīya śāyayet || 27.77 sūktāni ``pauruṣādīni" praśastāni yathātatham | adhīyānair vipravaryaiḥ sārdhamanyaiś ca maṅgalaiḥ || 27.78 tūryaśabdair yathāpūrvaṃ mūrtipāś ca guruḥ svayam | ``uttiṣṭhe"tyādimantreṇa samutthāpya ca kautukam || 27.79 śayyāvedibhuvaṃ ninyurbahiḥkuṇḍaṃ yathātatham | prādakṣiṇyena śanakaiḥ śayyāyāṃ śāyayed guruḥ || 27.80 ``idaṃ viṣṇur" iti procya ``viśvataś cakṣur" ity api | prāk chiro dakṣiṇāvaktraṃ yadvā syān mandirānanam || 27.81 śiro vā dakṣiṇāśāyāmitthaṃ śayanakalpanam | kambalenā 'thavā vastraiḥ chādayet pratimām api || 27.82 ``yuvā suvāsā" ityādi van viṣvak caturmukha | aśvatthatoraṇaṃ prācyāṃ yajeta tadanantaram || 27.83 ṛgrūpam indradaivatyaṃ suśobhanasamāhvayam | yāmye tvaudumbaraṃ syāt tu yājuṣaṃ yamadaivatam || 27.84 nāmnā subhadraṃ vāruṇyāṃ nyagrodhaṃ somavāruṇam | subandhasaṃjñaṃ kauberyāṃ plakṣaṃ nāmnā suhotrakam || 27.85 somadaivatyam uddiṣṭaṃ yajetātharvaṇaṃ guruḥ | dhvajadvayaṃ dvārapārśvasthitaṃ ratnasamāhvayam || 27.86 dauvārikān mahābhāgān yajeta kamalāsana | kumudaḥ kumudākṣaś ca dvārapālau puraḥ smṛtau || 27.87 dakṣiṇasyāṃ dhvajau pītau puṇḍarīkākṣavāmanau | dvāḥsthau pratīcyāṃ nīlābhau dhvajau dauvārikau punaḥ || 27.88 śaṅkukarṇaḥ sarvanetraḥ tathodak pāṇḍarau dhvajau | sumukhaṃ supratiṣṭhaṃ ca dvāssthau dhyāyed dhvajāṃśuke || 27.89 aṣṭau kumbhāṃś ca pūrvādidvāreṣu viniveśayet | dvaudvau savastrān sāśvatthapallavān sapidhānakān || 27.90 dhānyarāśiṣu mantreṇa ``idaṃ viṣṇur" iti svayam | nāmāni teṣāṃ kramaśaḥ kathyante tāni saṃśṛṇu || 27.91 pūrṇaś ca puṣkaraś caiva syātām ānandanandanau | vīrasenaḥ suṣeṇaś ca sambhavaḥ prabhavas tathā || 27.92 ratnāna cāṣṭau kramaśaḥ kumbheṣu viniveśayet | padmarāgaṃ pravālaṃ ca vajraṃ vaiḍūryam eva ca || 27.93 puṣyarāgaṃ tathā nīlamaṇiṃ marakataṃ tathā | muktāsphaṭikam uddiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ mantreṇa nikṣipet || 27.94 toraṇadhvajakumbhādīn pūrvoktān pṛthag arcayet | toraṇāni ca vāsobhiḥ navair ācchādayet pṛthak || 27.95 pūrvādau valaje viprān bahvṛcādhvaryusāmagān | atharvāṅgirasābhijñān aparān vedapāragān || 27.96 tattadvedān adhīyānān tattaddikṣu niveśayet | ācāryo hṛdaye devam acyutaṃ susamāhitaḥ || 27.97 dhyāyet tūryādighoṣaiś ca paritaḥ parighoṣayet | mūrtikumbhāṃś ca paritaḥ sapidhānān savastrakān || 27.98 aṣṭau prāgādikāṣṭhāsu dhānyarāśiṣu pūritān | adbhiḥ śuddhābhir aśvatthapatrayuktān saratnakān || 27.99 teṣu śaṅkhaṃ ca cakraṃ ca gadāṃ padmaṃ dhvajaṃ tathā | śrīvatsaṃ garuḍaṃ kūrmaṃ jāmbūnadamayaṃ kṣipet || 27.100 madhye madhye ca kumbhānāṃ śrīvatsādyaṣṭamaṅgalam | pālikāḥ sāṅkurā vediṃ paritaḥ sthāpayet tataḥ || 27.101 viṣṇvādimūrtir aṣṭau ca kumbheṣv āvāhya pūjayet | mahākumbhasthadevasya nikṣipet paścimottare || 27.102 dhānyarāśau sāpidhānaṃ droṇaṃ gandhāmbupūritam | hemaratnādikaṃ yugmavastreṇācchāditaṃ punaḥ || 27.103 sakūrcapippaladalāṃ pārśve tasya galantikām | sasūtravastrasaṃchannāṃ kūrcayuktāṃ niveśayet || 27.104 sāpidhānāṃ śivāmbhobhiḥ pūritāṃ nigamādinā | pāyasānnena ca tathā brāhmaṇān bhagavanmayān || 27.105 bhojayed dvādaśamitān adhikān vā yathāvasu | tilān vāsāṃsi sūkṣmāṇi suvarṇaṃ gāś ca dakṣiṇāḥ || 27.106 tebhyo dadyād bhuktavadbhyo yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ | ārabheyus tato homaṃ ṛtvijo gurvanujñayā || 27.107 aśvatthāc ca śamīgarbhādaraṇīm āharet tataḥ | mathitvāgnim upādāya sūryakāntāśmano 'pi vā || 27.108 laukikaṃ vāgnim ādāya dvādaśākṣaravidyayā | prokṣya dhyātvā ca divyāgniṃ pratyakkuṇḍe samindhayet || 27.109 paryagnikaraṇaṃ kuryāt kuṇḍānāṃ darbhamuṣṭibhiḥ | kuṇḍeṣv anyeṣu dahanaṃ pratyakkuṇḍāt samuddharet || 27.110 agre saṃskṛtya dahanam anyakuṇḍe vihāya ca | agnimadhyasthapadmasthaṃ taṃ taṃ devam anusmaret || 27.111 vāsudevaṃ catuṣkoṇe cāpe saṅkarṣaṇaṃ tathā | vṛtte pradyumnanāmānam aniruddhaṃ trikoṇake || 27.112 ito 'dhikeṣu kuṇḍeṣu kalpiteṣu yathātatham | yugmeṣv ayugmeṣu tathā devatāḥ pūrvam īritāḥ || 27.113 prāgādiṣu ca kuṇḍeṣu krameṇa samidhaḥ smṛtāḥ | pālāśadūrvakhadirabilvaudumbarabhūruhām || 27.114 āgneyādividikṣu syuḥ pippalaplakṣasaṃbhavāḥ | nyagrodhaprabhavāś caiva kāśmaryaprabhavās tathā || 27.115 pālāśasamidho 'nyatra bhūyasāṃ parikalpane | uktābhāve tu sarvatra pālāśasamidho matāḥ || 27.116 catasro dhenavaḥ sthāpyāḥ dakṣiṇadvāryudaṅmukhāḥ | gaṅgā sarasvatī godā yamunārūpadhāriṇī || 27.117 dughais tadīyaiḥ śrapaṇaṃ carūṇāṃ āhutīs tathā | śrapayet payasā pūrvaṃ śālitāṇḍulamāḍhakam || 27.118 kṛsarair dākṣiṇātyāgnau pāścāt ye guḍamiśritam | udīcyāgnau haridrānnaṃ dugdhānnamitarāgniṣu || 27.119 samidbhir ājyaiś carubhir bījair homaḥ kramāt smṛtaḥ | pratyekaṃ śatam aṣṭau ca homaḥ syāt samidādibhiḥ || 27.120 tilaśāliyavāveṇuhomabījāny anukramāt | tilair itarakuṇḍeṣu tair vā sarvatra padmaja || 27.121 hotāraś ca samāsīnāḥ sottarīyāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ | prāṅmukhā juhuyuḥ sarve gurvādiṣṭena vartmanā || 27.122 teṣu juhvatsu ṛtvikṣu yajeta gurur ātmavān | mahākumbhe paraṃjyotiś caitasya ghanam akṣaram || 27.123 sarvagaṃ mūlamantreṇa samāvāhyācyutaṃ harim | sakalīkṛtya cārdhyādyair arcayen nigamādinā || 27.124 sudarśanaṃ ca karake sahasrādityasannibham <�saṃnibham> | sahasrāraṃ sahasreṇa jvālābhir abhiveṣṭitam || 27.125 āvāhya svena mantreṇa pūjayet kamalāsana | svastikāsanamābadhya śayānāṃ pratimāmanu || 27.126 āsīta deśikaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakramavittamaḥ | arcāṃ ca tāṃ bhūtamayīṃ saṃhārakramamāsthitaḥ || 27.127 punaḥ sṛṣṭikrameṇaiva sṛjet taddhyānam āsthitaḥ | prācīnakuṇḍe juhuyāt tatvāni kapitāghṛtaiḥ || 27.128 pratyekam aṣṭottaraśataṃ tatveṣv āhutayaḥ smṛtāḥ | aṣṭottarā viṃśatir vā yadvāṣṭau śaktyapekṣayā || 27.129 jīvādikas tatvahomaḥ svāhāntaiḥ svasya nāmabhiḥ | makāraṃ sphaṭikābhāsaṃ jīvaṃ vyāpakamāditaḥ || 27.130 āhutyante pratikṛtau vinyaset praṇavaṃ tataḥ | jīvopādhiṃ bhakāraṃ tu sitaṃ nyasyed yathāpuram || 27.131 bakāraṃ sphaṭikābhāsaṃ buddhitatvam anantaram | ahaṅkāraṃ pāṭalābhaṃ phakāraṃ hṛdi vinyaset || 27.132 manaḥ sitāsitanibhaṃ pakāraṃ hṛdaye tathā | nakāraṃ śabdatanmātraṃ śrotre śuklanibhaṃ tathā || 27.133 dhakāraṃ lohitaṃ sparśatanmātraṃ pratimātvaci || 27.134 takāraṃ gandhatanmātraṃ nāsikāyāṃ tathāsitam | ṇakāraṃ pāṭalanibhaṃ śrotrātmānaṃ ca karṇayoḥ || 27.135 ḍhakāraṃ hematulyābhaṃ tvagātmānaṃ tathā tvaci | ḍakāraṃ netrayoḥ kṛṣṇaṃ netrātmānam anantaram || 27.136 gauraṃ ṭhakāraṃ jihvāyā jihvātmānam caturmukha || 27.137 ṭakāram asitaṃ ghrāṇarūpaṃ ghāṇendriyaṃ tathā | sitaṃ ñakāraṃ vāgrūpaṃ vāgādhāre niveśayet || 27.138 raktaṃ jhakāraṃ karayoḥ karmātmānaṃ niveśayet | raktaṃ jakāraṃ padayoḥ padātmānaṃ niveśayet || 27.139 chakārasya ca raktasya nyāsaḥ pāyau tadātmanaḥ | cakāraṃ mehane hemavarṇaṃ mohanarūpiṇam || 27.140 ṅakāraṃ pṛthivītatvaṃ pītābhaṃ caturaśrakam | pāde ca jānuparyante hutvānte viniveśayet || 27.141 ghakāram ardhaśītāṃśuṃ tulyākāraṃ jalātmakam | sphaṭikābhaṃ tadūrdhve tu guhyānte viniveśayet || 27.142 gakāraṃ lohitaṃ koṇais tribhir yuktam uṣarbudham | guhyātprabhṛti nābhyantam vinyased deśikottamaḥ || 27.143 khakāraṃ vedikākāraṃ dhūmrābhaṃ śvasanātmakam | nābher upari ghoṇāntaṃ hutvānte viniveśayet || 27.144 nirākāraṃ kakāraṃ ca nabhoñjanaśilāmayam | nāsikoparimūrdhāntamāhutyante niveśayet || 27.145 tatvahomaṃ ca tannyāsaṃ kṛtvaivaṃ tadanantaram | prāṇādidaśavāyūnāṃ nyasanaṃ syād iḍādiṣu || 27.146 brahmādiparivāreṣu devīṣu kamalādiṣu | tattvanyāso yathoktena mārgeṇa syāc caturmukha || 27.147 sudarśanādyāyudhāni vanamālādikāny api | nyased yathāyathaṃ mantraiḥ pratikāryeṣu śārṅgiṇaḥ || 27.148 na jaṅgameṣu bimbeṣū ṣoḍaśanyāsam ācaret | praṇavasya vyāhṛtīnām akārādyakṣarasya ca || 27.149 ṛkṣāṇām api kālasya vāsarādyayanasya ca | brāhmaṇādeś ca varṇasya hoyasya nigamasya ca || 27.150 devatānāṃ virājaś ca ṛtūnāṃ ca guṇasya ca | satvādeś caiva mūrtīnāṃ śaktīnāṃ ṣaḍguṇasya ca || 27.151 lokānāṃ nyasanaṃ kuryāt ṣoḍaśānām iti kramāt | akārādyātmakaṃ hutvā praṇavaṃ tadanantaram || 27.152 akāraṃ hṛdaye viṣṇoḥ nyased bhāge tu dakṣiṇe | ukāraṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ vāme 'ntyaṃ śaṅkarātmakam || 27.153 homena tarpayitvānte praṇavaṃ viniveśayet | vyāhṛtīnāṃ ca timrṇāṃ pāde hṛdi śirasy api || 27.154 nyāsaṃ kuryād akārādisvarān nyasyet kramād guruḥ | rasanāyāṃ mukhe dṛṣṭyoḥ śrotrayor nāsikāpuṭe || 27.155 dantapaṅktau tathā coṣṭhadvaye cāsye lalāṭake | tālunyatha yakārāder nyāsaṃ kuryād atandritaḥ || 27.156 tvaci dṛṣṭyor nāsikāyāṃ daśanāgre tathā śrutau | udare ca tathā kaṭyāṃ hṛdaye nābhimaṇḍale || 27.157 mehane tarpayitvānte homena nyāsa iṣyate | pañcavārān kakārādīn aṅgulīṣu ca jaṅghayoḥ || 27.158 bhujayor nyasanaṃ kuryād akṣaranyāsa īdṛśaḥ | suṣumnā piṅgalā pūṣā hastijihvā yaśasvinī || 27.159 alambusaiva gāndhārī kāśinī ca kuhūr api | prāṇāpānasamānāś ca vyānodānau ca vāyavaḥ || 27.160 nāgaḥ kūrmaś ca kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥ | athavā mātṛkānyāsam evam eva samācaret || 27.161 akāraṃ tāluni nyasya mukhe cākāram eva ca | i ī locanayor nyasya u ū śravaṇayos tathā || 27.162 e ai daśanapaṅktau ca o au auṣṭhagatau smaret | amityeva lalāṭe tu aḥ kāraṃ rasane tathā || 27.163 yakāraṃ tvaggataṃ nyasya rephaṃ cakṣuṣi vinyaset | lakāraṃ nāsikāyāṃ tu vakāraṃ daśanāgrataḥ || 27.164 śrotre śakāraṃ vinyasya ṣakāram udare tathā | sakāraṃ kaṭideśe tu hakāraṃ hṛdaye tathā || 27.165 kṣakāraṃ nābhideśe tu vinyased dvijasattamaḥ | pavargo bāhur ekas tu tavargas tu dvitīyakaḥ || 27.166 ṭavargaś ca cavargaś ca jaṅghādvayam udāhṛtam | kavargo 'ṅgulayaḥ sarvā vijñātavyā dvijottama || 27.167 ṛkṣāṇi rohiṇyādīni nyasedeṣu yathākramam | hṛdaye mūrdhnikeśeṣu lalāṭe vadane tathā || 27.168 nāsikāyāṃ ca danteṣu śrotre bāhvoḥ karadvaye | stanayor udare kaṭyāṃ mehane vṛṣaṇe tathā || 27.169 pāyāv ūrvor jaṅghayoś ca pādayor agrapādayoḥ | sūryādayo grahāś cānye tathā saptarṣayo dhruvaḥ || 27.170 etāś ca vyomani yathā tathā deve niveśayet | truṭyādikalpaparyantāḥ kālabhedāś caturmukha || 27.171 sthūlasūkṣmā yathāyogaṃ nyasanīyāḥ sumedhasā | mukhabāhūrupādeṣu devasya brāhmaṇādayaḥ || 27.172 nyasanīyāḥ saritkūpavāpītoyādinirjharāḥ | niveśanīyā devasya dehe vedā ṛgādayaḥ || 27.173 aṅgāni ca tadarthāni śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca | daivatāni tathānyāni caturmukha mukhāni ca || 27.174 ṛṣīn api tathā mukhyān anyac cāpi vibhūtimat | deve niveśayet sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 27.175 svarlokaṃ śirasi nyasen netrayoś candrabhāskarau | nāsikāyāṃ tathā vāyuṃ diśo bāhuṣu hṛdgatān || 27.176 ṛṣīṃś ca vyoma ca vapuṣyantarātmani devatāḥ | meghāś ca keśā vijñeyāḥ nakṣatrāṇi ca bhūṣaṇam || 27.177 mukham agnis tathā vāṇī śuddhavarṇā sarasvatī | vairājanyāsa ity eṣaḥ kathitaḥ kamalāsana || 27.178 aśvamedhādayaḥ sarve kratavaś ca yathātatham | sarvāṅgeṣu vidhātavyās tasmin ṛtumaye 'cyute || 27.179 satvaṃ rajas tamaś ceti nyasanīyaṃ guṇatrayam | matsyādidaśamūrtīnāṃ nyasanaṃ tadanantaram || 27.180 devīnāṃ ca śriyādīnāṃ nyāsaḥ kāryo yathākramam | vijñānādiguṇāḥ ṣaṭ ca viniveśyāḥ samādhinā || 27.181 lokāś caturdaśa tathā pādādiṣu yathākramam | mūrdhaparyantam aṅgeṣu devadehe yathāvidhi || 27.182 nyasanīyāś caturvaktra guruṇā śāstracakṣuṣā | kṛtvaivaṃ ṣoḍaśanyāsaṃ śāntihomaṃ samācaret || 27.183 ``madhunā bhūr iti" prācye kuṇḍe hutvā śatāhutīḥ | saṃpātena spṛśet pādau ``devasya bhuva" ity ataḥ || 27.184 dakṣiṇāgnau tathā hutvā payasā jaṭharaṃ spṛśet | dadhnā tu paścime kuṇḍe hutvā svariti saṃspṛśet || 27.185 vaktraṃ samastenājyena hutvodīcī pāvake | śiraḥ spṛśec ca saṃpātair aṅgaṃ ca sakalaṃ hareḥ || 27.186 guḍenājyena madhunā kuṇḍe tasmin guruḥ svayam | hutvā ca viṣṇugāyatryā saṃpātena mukhaṃ spṛśet || 27.187 pālāśakhādirāśvatthabilvaśākhābhir ambubhiḥ | siñceyur mūrtipāḥ samyag vedīdikkalaśasthitaiḥ || 27.188 abliṅgaiḥ pāvanair mantraiḥ vaitasyā śākhayā guruḥ | vedikā koṇakumbhasthaiḥ siñced gāyatriyā tathā || 27.189 lohaje dāruje śaile vidhir eṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | bahubere tu sadane saṃhārotpādanādikam || 27.190 kuryād antaḥ praviśyaivaṃ śāntihomāvasānikam | śriyādiparivāreṣu saṃhārotpādanādikam || 27.191 evam eva bhaved brahman brahmādiṣv api tattathā | sañjīvakaraṇaṃ caiva kṣetrajñanyasanaṃ tathā || 27.192 kṛtvārdhyādyupacāreṇa pūjayet puruṣottamam | tataś caturvidhānaṃ ca praṇavena nivedayet || 27.193 brahmādīnāṃ śriyādīnāṃ devīnāṃ caitad iṣyate | āsīne ca śayāne ca bhogibhogapariṣkṛte || 27.194 anantam asitaṃ nāgamuktena vidhinā guruḥ | kalpayet kautukaṃ cāpi badhnīyān mūlakautuke || 27.195 kambalādyair abhinavaiḥ pratimāṃ chādayet tataḥ | astramantraṃ ca vinyasya dvāri tatra baliṃ kṣipet || 27.196 indrādiparivāreṣu sthāpyeṣv ātmīyadikṣu ca | pratyāvaraṇabhūbhāge sthāne sthāne yathākramam || 27.197 samidbhir juhuyād agnau kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile 'pi vā | palāśakhadirāśvatthaplakṣanyagrothabilvajāḥ || 27.198 audumbaryaś ca kāśmaryaḥ samidhaḥ syur yathākramam | samidbhir ājyaiś carubhiḥ aṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ || 27.199 kuryād yathākramaṃ mantraiḥ brāhmaṇāḥ prayatavratāḥ | trātāramityathāścāgne yadulūka iti kramāt || 27.200 āsanasteti ca tathā imaṃ metyādivāruṇaiḥ | ā no niyadbhir iti ca mantreṣv ante payāṃsi ca || 27.201 tamīśānam iti tais tair mantrair indrādidevatāḥ | juhuyuḥ parivārārthaṃ brāhmaṇāṃś cāpi toṣayet || 27.202 piṇḍikāmadhivāsyātha veṣṭayen navavāsasā | nikṣipya bhājane lohān saratnān dhātubījakān || 27.203 bhājanaṃ vāsasā veṣṭya dhānyarāśiṣu nikṣipet | bimbāni garuḍādīnāṃ snāpayen navavāsasā || 27.204 ācchādayed dhānyarāśau śāyayec ca yathāpuram | digdevatānāṃ pīṭhāni balyarthāny adhivāsayet || 27.205 śayānāṃ pratimāṃ vedyāṃ utthāpyādhiniketanam | arcayet pāyasādyannaṃ sannivedya caturvidham || 27.206 nivedya ca mahākumbhe dikṣu dadyād baliṃ tataḥ | palalaṃ rajanīcūrṇaṃ salājaṃ dadhi saktukam || 27.207 balyannam etaiḥ saṃyojya baligāthā imāḥ paṭhet | ādyaś ca karmajāś caiva ye bhūtāḥ prāgdiśi sthitāḥ || 27.208 prasannāḥ parituṣṭās te gṛhṇantu balikāṃkṣiṇaḥ | vṛkṣeṣu parvatāgreṣu ye vidikṣu ca saṃsthitāḥ || 27.209 bhūmau vyomni sthitā ye ca baliṃ gṛhṇantu te 'pi ca | vaināyakāḥ kṣetrapālāḥ ye cānye balikāṃkṣiṇaḥ || 27.210 pūṣādyāḥ pārṣadāś caiva pratigṛhṇantv imaṃ balim | caṇḍādyāḥ kumudādyāś ca ye bhūtāḥ sarvadiksthitāḥ || 27.211 āgacchantu pade sarve gṛhṇantu ta ime balim | svapnādhipatimantreṇa hutvā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 27.212 hemasūtraṃ pratisaraṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhisiddhaye | puṇyāhapūrvaṃ badhnīyāddhaste devasya dakṣiṇe || 27.213 bālibimbaṃ tu saṃpūjya tacchaktim api deśikaḥ | samāvāhya mahākumbhe dhānyarāśiṣu nikṣipet || 27.214 pūrṇāhutiṃ ca juhuyuḥ kuṇḍe kuṇḍe ca mūrtipāḥ | padmotpalavadāmodo dhūmo hutabhujo yadi || 27.215 raktaśvetas tathā pīto dhūmaḥ syāc chubhado bhavet | jvālāś ca dakṣiṇāvartāḥ śubhaṃ śaṃsanti niścitam || 27.216 tūryamaṅgalasannādaiḥ <�saṃnādaiḥ> brahmaghoṣaiś ca ghoṣitaiḥ | svāpayet tāṃ niśāṃ sarvāṃ yajamāno guruś ca tau || 27.217 svapnārthaṃ darbhaśayyāyāṃ śayīran mūrtipāś ca te |
