pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ śrībhagavān tataḥ prabhāte vimale dṛṣṭe ca ravimaṇḍale | puṇye muhūrte puṇyarkṣe puṇyavāre tathā tithau || 28.1 kalyāṇadarśane rātrāvārabhetā 'vicārayan | pratiṣṭhāṃ devadevasya duḥsvapne śāntim ācaret || 28.2 ekabere vāstuhomaṃ kuryād dvārasya dakṣiṇe | pārśve ca sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā praviśed garbhamandiram || 28.3 tanmadhye caturaśrāṃ vā vṛttāṃ vā tacchilāṃ kṣipet | hastamātrāyatāṃ śuddhāṃ tāvad vistārasaṃyutām || 28.4 caturāvaraṇāṃ nimnāṃ gāyatryā viṣṇur pūrvayā | tayaiva vāstuhomāgnau carusarpiḥsamucchritaiḥ || 28.5 juhuyād ratnavinyāsasidhyarthaṃ deśikottamaḥ | prathamāvaraṇe bījānaṣṭau garteṣu nikṣipet || 28.6 yavāś ca vrīhayaś caiva niṣpāvāś ca priyaṅgavaḥ | tilāś ca māṣāś ca tathā nīvārāḥ śālayas tathā || 28.7 vajrādīni ca ratnāni dvitīyāvaraṇe tathā | vajraṃ ca mauktikaṃ caiva vaiḍūryaṃ jalajaṃ tathā || 28.8 sphaṭikaṃ puṣyakaṃ caiva candrakāntaṃ tathā param | indranīlaṃ ca pūrvādiṣv āśāsu viniveśayet || 28.9 dhātūn tṛtīyāvaraṇe tathaiva viniveśayet | manaḥśilāṃ harītālamañjanaṃ tadanantaram || 28.10 śyāmaṃ ca sīsakaṃ caiva saurāṣṭraṃ rocanaṃ tathā | gairikaṃ cāṣṭakaṃ lohān caturthāvaraṇe punaḥ || 28.11 garteṣu nikṣipet svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ tāmraṃ tathaiva ca | ayaś ca trapukaṃ caiva kūrmaṃ kanakanirmitam || 28.12 śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ lohanyāso 'yam īritaḥ | śālibījaṃ pāradaṃ ca brahmarāgaṃ ca kāñcanam || 28.13 madhye nyasyed gartabhāge tataḥ strīśilayā dṛḍham | śrīsūktena pidhātavyaṃ sudhayā dārḍhyam ācaret || 28.14 puṇyāhaṃ vācayet paścāt vaiṣṇavair mantravittamaiḥ | strīśilāpadmamadhye tu praṇavanyasanaṃ bhavet || 28.15 karṇikāyāṃ svaranyāsaṃ vyañjananyasanaṃ dale | daleṣu śaktayaś cāṣṭau navamī karṇikābhuvi || 28.16 vimalādiśaktayaḥ vimalotkarṣiṇī jñānā kriyā yogeti śaktayaḥ | prahvī satyā tatheśānā 'nugrahā navamī smṛtā || 28.17 piṇḍikāpūjanam piṇḍakāṃ pūjayet paścād gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt | ahataiś caiva vāsobhir lakṣmīrūpāṃ ca piṇḍikām || 28.18 pracchādya dvāri cāstrasya nyāsaṃ kṛtvā bahir guruḥ | nirgatya śayyāvedyarthaṃ pūjayed ratnavāriṇā || 28.19 dhvajatoraṇakumbhasthā devatā visṛjet tataḥ | āropya cāgniṃ hṛdaye mahākumbhaṃ samuddharet || 28.20 mūrtikumbhāṃs tathā cāṣṭau maṅgalānyastra karkarīm | gṛhītvā mūrtipāḥ sarve gaccheyur mandiraṃ prati || 28.21 galantīnirgaladvāri dhārayā santatotthayā | agrataḥ secayen mārgaṃ brāhmaṇānām anujñayā || 28.22 devam utthāpya hastyādau prādakṣiṇyena mandiram | ācāryapramukhāḥ sarve viśeyur mūrtipās tathā || 28.23 chatradhvajapatākādyair maṅgalair akhilaiḥ saha | tūryavāditranirghoṣair brahmaghoṣaiś ca ghoṣitaiḥ || 28.24 brāhmaṇaiś cāpy anūcānair adhīyānaiś ca mūrtipaiḥ | sārdhaṃ guruḥ spṛśan nyāsaṃ praviśen mūlamandiram || 28.25 ardhyapādyādibhir devam arcayed dvāri deśikaḥ | antaḥ praveśayed devaṃ pīṭhikāṃ ca pradakṣiṇam || 28.26 gatvā muhūrte saṃprāpte sthāpayed viṣṇum avyayam | ``pratiṣṭhāsīti" vai sāmnā deśiko brāhmaṇaiḥ saha || 28.27 ``ātvāhārṣam" ity etat sūktaṃ ca saha mūrtipāḥ | ``dhruvā dyaur" iti mantreṇa paṭheyur gurvanujñayā || 28.28 ācāryaḥ purataḥ sthitvā sarveṇa sthāpayed harim | pīṭhamadhyagate garte bimbaśaṅkuṃ niveśayet || 28.29 ūrdhvalambitasūtreṇa paśyec ca samatāṃ sthiteḥ | pīṭhikānālarandhraṃ ca aṣṭabandhena pūrayet || 28.30 aṣṭabandhanadravyāṇi lākṣā sajjarasaṃ caiva guggulaṃ ca gulaṃ tathā | sarveṣām ardhatastailaṃ pācayen mṛduvahninā || 28.31 ghanacūrṇaṃ madhūcchiṣṭaṃ kuruvindaṃ ca gairikam | ekaikaṃ ca samāṃśena grāhyaṃ sajjarasaṃ tathā || 28.32 tailena pācitaṃ sārdham aṣṭabandhanam iṣyate | sthāpayitvā dṛḍhaṃ tena puṇyāham api vācayet || 28.33 āvāhanam āvāhayet tato devaṃ tamasaḥ param avyayam | ānandaṃ sarvagaṃ nityaṃ vyomātītaṃ parātparam || 28.34 marīcicakramadhyasthaṃ vāsudevam ajaṃ vibhum | mūlamantreṇa viśveśam āvāhya gurur ātmavān || 28.35 brahmarandhreṇa bimbāntaḥ praviṣṭaṃ paricintayet | kumbhasthaṃ paramātmānaṃ pratimāyāṃ niveśayet || 28.36 mantranyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryān mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ | yāceta devaṃ sānnidhyaṃ parivārān prakalpayet || 28.37 samārādhya tato devaṃ pāyasānnaṃ nivedayet | tryahaṃ kavāṭabandhanakāraṇam pracchādya nūtanair vastraiḥ pratimāṃ kambalena vā || 28.38 triyahaṃ bandhayed dvāraṃ kavāṭena susaṃskṛtam | devarṣipitaraḥ siddhāḥ tathānye devayonayaḥ || 28.39 arcanti devaṃ triyahaṃ trirātrānte tu mānavāḥ | brāhmaṇāṃs toṣayed vittaiḥ bhojanaiś ca gavādibhiḥ || 28.40 caturthe 'hani saṃprāpte snapanaṃ prātar iṣyate | taddine dhvajam utthāpya prārabheta mahotsavam || 28.41 ekabere vidhir ayaṃ kathitaḥ kamalāsana | bahuberavidhiḥ bahuberavidhānaṃ cet karmādyarcāṃ samuddharet || 28.42 mahākumbhaṃ ca tatkāle maṅgalānyaṣṭa deśikaḥ | ṛtvigbhiḥ saha vidvadbhir bhaktair bhāgavatair api || 28.43 uddhṛtya cāstrakarakam agre gacched guruḥ svayam | anudhārāpathenaiva devāgāraṃ praveśayet || 28.44 pratimācāryayoḥ kaścinna gacched antarā pathi | dvāradeśe tu saṃprāpte dadyāt pādyaṃ ca kautuke || 28.45 karmārcādīnāṃ sthānanirdeśaḥ karmārcām arcanāpīṭhe nṛsūktena niveśayet | utsavādyarthabimbāni pārśvayor viniveśayet || 28.46 karmārcāṃ sthāpayed brāhme vāme tu mukhakautukam | tīrthaṃ snapanabimbaṃ vā uttare sthāpayed guruḥ || 28.47 śayanotthānabimbaṃ ca balibimbaṃ ca dakṣiṇe | lauhikīṃ lohajaṃ bimbaṃ sthāpayed iṣṭabhūmiṣu || 28.48 dhārāvaśiṣṭaṃ yattoyaṃ taccharāve vinikṣipet | śalakāmātrayā caiva dhārayā 'cchidrayā punaḥ || 28.49 paritaḥ pariṣekaṃ ca vidadhyān mūlavidyayā | dhānyarāśiṣu kumbhāṃś ca vinyasyāvāhayed dharim || 28.50 āvāhanaṃ mūlaberātkarmādyarcāsu kalpayet | muhūrte śobhane prāpte deśikaḥ kamalāsana || 28.51 purato mūlaberasya baddhapadmāsanasthitaḥ | prāṇānāyamya śuddhātmā dhyāyed brahma sanātanam || 28.52 dhyānaprakāraḥ vāsudevam ajaṃ śāntam ujvalaṃ santatoditam | anādimadhyanidhanam ekaṃ cāpy acalaṃ sthiram || 28.53 cidghanaṃ paramānandaṃ tamasaḥ param avyayam | jñānaśaktibalaiśvaryavīryatejaḥsamanvitam || 28.54 āpādapāṇim aspṛśyam acakṣuḥśravaṇādikam | sarvatra karavākpādaṃ sarvato 'kṣiśiromukham || 28.55 gatāgatavinirmuktaṃ ravikoṭisamaprabham | caitanyaṃ sarvagaṃ nityaṃ vyomātītaṃ tadadbhutam || 28.56 citsāmānyaṃ jagat yasmin mūlamantrātmakaṃ param | evaṃ vidhaṃ sadā viṣṇum āhlādaṃ praṇavātmakam || 28.57 taṃ niyujya mahāviṣṇuṃ mataṃ viṣṇau niveśayet | viṣṇuṃ ca hṛdaye padme samāvāhyārcayet kramāt || 28.58 samāvāhya sriyā paścān maṃtreṇa puruṣātmanā | ajjalisthe tataḥ pīṭhe dhyāyed viśvātmanā guruḥ || 28.59 tejonidānamadhyeyaṃ nārāyaṇam ajaṃ vibhum | nivṛttimantram uccārya pratimāyāṃ niveśayet || 28.60 brahmarandhreṇa mārgeṇa praviṣṭaṃ pratimākṛtau | vyāpya sthitaṃ smaret sarvaṃ mantreṇa kamalāsana || 28.61 kumbhagataśaktīnāṃ deve yojanam mahākumbhagatāṃ śaktiṃ devena saha yojayet | mūrtikumbhagatāṃś cāpi tathā bāle ca kautuke || 28.62 yā śaktis tāṃ ca devena yojayet pratimātmanā | brahmarandhraṃ ca tāreṇa pidadhyāt pratimātmanaḥ || 28.63 ātmano 'bhimukhaṃ kuryāt puṇḍarīkākṣavidyayā | praṇamya kiñcid utthāya darśayet svāgataṃ guruḥ || 28.64 nyāsavibhedaḥ mantranyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryān mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ | sthitinyāsaḥ sthitau kāryaḥ sṛṣṭinyāsas tathāsane || 28.65 śayyāyāṃ saṃhṛtinyāsaḥ saṃhāraśayanaṃ yadi | sṛṣṭinyāso bhavet sṛṣṭiśayane kamalāsana || 28.66 bhoge yoge ca śayane sthitinyāsaḥ praśasyate | viśvarūpe sthitinyāsaḥ thānārūḍhe trayaṃ bhavet || 28.67 sthitinyāso 'thavā kāryaḥ sarvatraivāsanādiṣu | śriyādīnāṃ ca devīnāṃ brahmādīnāṃ tathaiva ca || 28.68 mahākumbhajalenaiva prokṣayet svapnavidyayā | sṛṣṭiś ca sarganyasanaṃ nyāso rudrasya saṃhṛtiḥ || 28.69 śriyādīnāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsam ācaret | mahākumbhaṃ samuddhṛtya deśiko mūrtipaiḥ saha || 28.70 prokṣaṇaṃ tajjalaiḥ kuryāc caṇḍāder api tatkṣaṇe | balipīṭhe kṣipet toyaṃ avaśiṣṭaṃ guruḥ svayam || 28.71 mahānasāgnikuṇḍe ca tathādhiśravaṇeṣu ca | tathā ca gārhapatyāgniṃ sthāpayec chāstravartmanā || 28.72 sānnidhyaprārthanā devapārśvaṃ samāsādya daṇḍavatpraṇamet kṣitau | gāthām udīrayed enāṃ racitāñjalisaṃpuṭaḥ || 28.73 yajamānena sahitaḥ prahvastiṣṭhan guruḥ svayam | bhaktavatsala bhaktānām abhipretārthasādhaka || 28.74 prārthaye tvām ahaṃ deva madanugrahakāmyayā | sannidhatsva ciraṃ sthāne kalpite śraddhayā mayā || 28.75 prasīda deva deveśa pūjām api gṛhāṇa me | grāmasya rājño rāṣṭrasya prajānām indirāvara || 28.76 dehi puṣṭiṃ ca tuṣṭiṃ ca gatiṃ ca paramāṃ tathā | iti vijñāpya devāya deśikastantrapāragaḥ || 28.77 yajamānena bhagavate sarvasvasamarpaṇam madhuparkopacārānte gurvanujñāpuraḥsaram | dadyād gobhūsuvarṇādi yathā vittānusārataḥ | 28.78 devasya dakṣiṇe haste toyapūrvaṃ yathāvidhi | bhaktinamreṇa śirasā pūjopakaraṇāni ca || 28.79 ātmānaṃ putrapautrādi dārān hastyādi vāhanam | dāsīdāsaṃ ca sarvasvaṃ dadyād devasya pādayoḥ || 28.80 jīvājīvadhanair devo dattair ārādhyate yathā | yajamānena sarvasvaiḥ bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ || 28.81 tathā bhāgavataṃ sarvair dhanair ārādhayet sadā | sthāpako devadevasya yaḥ pūrvo deśikottamaḥ || 28.82 tenaivārādhanaṃ kāryaṃ tadvaṃśair api nirguṇaiḥ | pūjā prītikarī saiva devasya kamalāsana || 28.83 vittānusārato vidvān kalpayed dhāmasaṃpadam | athavā vibhavenaiva yajamānaḥ prakalpayet || 28.84 ādau vibhūtivistāro yādṛśaḥ parikalpitaḥ | saṅkocam antareṇaiva kuryāt tādṛśasaṃpadam || 28.85 devabhūtyanusāreṇa rakṣed devopajīvinaḥ | na kleśayed bhāgavatān tathaiva paricārakān || 28.86 pratiṣṭhānte ca devasya tūryair nānāvidhair api | ghoṣayet sarvato dikṣu brahmaghoṣaiś ca ghoṣayet || 28.87 nṛttair geyaiś ca vividhaiḥ stotrair nānāvidhair api | toṣayed devadeveśam upacāraiḥ pṛthag vidhaiḥ || 28.88 caturvidhaṃ tathā vānnaṃ nivedya vidhipūrvakam | nityāgniṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya kuṇḍe ca caturaśrake || 28.89 hutvāgnau samidājyānnaiḥ mūlena praṇavādinā | pūrṇāhutiṃ tato hutvā tattadāvaraṇeṣu ca || 28.90 balipīṭhāni saṃskṛtya pratiṣṭhāpya yathākramam | teṣu nityaṃ baliṃ dadyād bhūtānāṃ ca yathākramam || 28.91 bahuberavidhāne kavāṭabandhananiṣedhaḥ bahuberavidhāne tu kavāṭaṃ na ca bandhayet | devarṣipitaraḥ siddhās stuvānā devayonayaḥ || 28.92 arcanti devaṃ triyahaṃ trirātrānte tu mānavāḥ | brāhmaṇāṃs toṣayed vittaiḥ bhojanaiś ca gavādibhiḥ || 28.93 caturthe divase prāpte snapanaṃ parikalpayet | uttamatritaye vāpi madhyamatritayena vā || 28.94 kalaśaiḥ snāpayed devaṃ catuḥsthānārcanaṃ bhavet | utsavaṃ kārayed ante dhvajārohaṇapūrvakam || 28.95 ācāryaṃ pūjayet tasmin pratiṣṭhādivase prabhuḥ | suvarṇakusumair vastrair nūtanair aṅgulīyakaiḥ || 28.96 keyūrahāravalayaiḥ upavītottarīyakaiḥ | kṣetrārāmagṛhair vittaiḥ jīvājīvadhanais tathā || 28.97 dāsīdāsena ca tathā hastyaśvaśibikādibhiḥ | evaṃ prakārair anyaiś ca toṣayed gurum ātmavān || 28.98 ātmānaṃ putrapautrāṃś ca deve tadvan nivedayet | mātṛtvena pitṛtvena bandhutvena gurūttamam || 28.99 sakhātmatvena saṃbhāvya praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ | sahasraṃ dhenavo deyāḥ dakṣiṇā gurave tadā || 28.100 sahasraniṣkam athavā dakṣiṇā cottamottamā | tadardhā madhyamā jñeyā tadardhā cādhamā matā || 28.101 athavā dakṣiṇā deyā śataṃ hemnāmanuttamam | daśaniṣkamaśaktas tu tadardhaṃ pādam eva vā || 28.102 yathāvittānusāreṇa dakṣiṇā parikīrtitā | karmaṇāṃ karṣaṇādīnām aṅgatvena yadāhṛtam || 28.103 tadiṣṭasiṣṭaṃ sakalaṃ guror eva dhanaṃ bhavet | ṛtvijām api sarveṣāṃ tathāmnāyeṣv adhītinām || 28.104 brāhmaṇānāṃ ca viduṣāṃ bhaktānāṃ puruṣottame | tathaikāyananiṣṭhānāṃ dviṣaṭka niyatātmanām || 28.105 vāsudevaikaniṣṭhānāṃ niṣanmārgavidām api | yatīnāṃ brahmacārīṇāṃ vanasthāśramavāsinām || 28.106 anyeṣāṃ viṣṇubhaktānāṃ asminn arthe 'nuyāyinām | viṣṇvarkṣaniyatānāṃ ca sadasyānāṃ ca dakṣiṇā || 28.107 deyā gobhūhiraṇyādirūpā vittānusārataḥ | kālajñānāṃ tathā nṛttagītavādyādi kurvatām || 28.108 yathārhaṃ vittavāsobhiḥ kuryāt tṛptiṃ yatheppitām | guruḥ pātraṃ samānīya hemādidravyanirmitam || 28.109 prakṣālya viṣṇugāyatryā dhānyarāśau svamantrataḥ | devasya purataḥ sthāpya pūrayed gandhavāriṇā || 28.110 aṣṭākṣareṇābhimantrya ṣaḍarṇena dviraṣṭakam | pañcopaniṣadair mantrair āvāhyātmagataṃ vibhum || 28.111 praṇavena samabhyarcya gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ | tataḥ kartāramāhūya viśuddhaṃ devasannidhau <�saṃnidhau> || 28.112 taṃ devābhimukhaṃ sthāpya praṇataṃ vinayānvitam | sārdhitārdhyajalāt tasmāt sārdhyatoyaṃ prasūnakam || 28.113 tasya haste prapūryātha imāṃ gāthām udīrayet | tvayā vinā na me kiñcin māṃ vinā tava kas tathā || 28.114 tasmān māmātmasātkartuṃ prasīda parameśvara | bhūmau skhalitapādānāṃ bhūmir evā 'valambanam || 28.115 tvayy eva pratipannānāṃ tvam eva śaraṇaṃ vibho | iti vijñāpya deveśam ācāryaḥ svasthamānasam || 28.116 dvādaśākṣaram uccārya bhagavatpādapaṅkaje | nivedya kartur ātmānaṃ sārdhyapūṣpapuraḥsaram || 28.117 trikṛtvaḥ praṇamed devaṃ nivedyātmānam avyaye | sa tenā 'nugṛhītaḥ san saṃyāyād guruṇā bahiḥ || 28.118 gurupūjā namaskṛtvā guruṃ devaṃ kṛtakṛtyena cetasā | taṃ guruṃ yānam āropya tūryaghoṣapuraḥsaram || 28.119 nītvā pradakṣiṇaṃ grāmaṃ svagṛhe sanniveśayet | devapratiṣṭhāyāḥ phalam ya itthaṃ sthāpanaṃ kuryād devadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ || 28.120 sa yāti paramaṃ sthānam akṣayaṃ kamalāsana | punāti vaṃśajāṃś caiva puruṣānekaviṃśatim || 28.121 niṣkāmā ye tu sadane puruṣāḥ puruṣottamam | sthāpayanti phalaṃ teṣām apunar bhavalakṣaṇam || 28.122 sakāmānāṃ tu martyānāṃ punar āvṛttilakṣaṇam | svargādi tattad bhoktavyam ārambhe tattad iṣyate || 28.123 brahmahatyādipāpānām anyeṣāṃ niṣkṛtir matā | upakurvanti ye martyāḥ vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ || 28.124 āvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ phalaṃ svargādir iṣyate | śriyādīnāṃ ca devīnāṃ devena saha kalpane || 28.125 nodvāhakarma kartavyaṃ pṛthak cet sthāpanaṃ tayoḥ | udvāhakarma śāstroktaṃ kuryād aṅkurapūrvakam || 28.126 bhaktiśaktivaśād devaṃ yathāvittānusārataḥ | yathā ca sthāpanā bhaktaiḥ sā smṛtā 'sugrahā iti || 28.127
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde pratiṣṭhāvidhir nāma aṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
mīnādi daśamūrtipratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ
śrībhagavān mīnādi daśamūrtīnāṃ adhunā sthāpanaṃ prati | viśeṣaḥ kathyate brahman upasthānādilakṣaṇaḥ || 29.1 mīnamūrtiḥ sāmnā ca vāruṇenaiva sūktena puruṣātmanā | sthāpayen mīnavapuṣaṃ vāsudevamanāmayam || 29.2 āvāhya tasmin deveśaṃ upatiṣṭheta mantravit | mīnātmane namastubhyaṃ vedarakṣāvidhāyine || 29.3 pralayārṇavadurvāravāripūravihāriṇe | vāruṇenaiva sūktena tathāṣṭākṣaravidyayā || 29.4 sthāpayitvā mahākumbhaṃ tasminn āvāhayed dharim | upatiṣṭheta karmānte gāthayā vakṣyamāṇayā || 29.5 tubhyaṃ namaskriyāṃ kurmaḥ kūrmarūpāya vedhase | dhāriṇe mandarasyādreḥ vibudhānandadāyine || 29.6 varāhamūrtiḥ sthāpayitvā ca vārāhīṃ mūrtim āvāhayed dharim | kroḍātmane namastubhyaṃ yajñarūpāya vedhase || 29.7 daṃṣṭrāgravidhṛtāśeṣadhāriṇe dharaṇīdhara | nṛsiṃhaḥ nṛsiṃharūpiṇaṃ devaṃ sthāpayed deśikottamaḥ || 29.8 yuñjītetyanuvākena samāvāhya janārdanam | gādhām udīrayed enāṃ karmānte deśikottamaḥ || 29.9 niśātanakhadambholidalitāsuravakṣase | darśitāśritavātsalyanṛsiṃhavapuṣe namaḥ || 20.10 vāmanaḥ yuñjantītyanuvākena sthāpayitvā ca vāmanam | tasminn āvāhya deveśam upatiṣṭheta deśikaḥ || 20.11 balidviṣe namastubhyaṃ yajñarūpāya vedhase | vāmanāya mahāmāyāvañcitāśeṣamānava || 20.12 jāmadagnyaḥ jāmadagnyaṃ nṛsūktena sthāpayitvā janārdanam | gāthayā copatiṣṭheta prāñjaliḥ praṇataḥ sthitaḥ || 20.13 triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ kṣatrāṇāṃ nihantre tigmatejase | namastubhyaṃ bhagavate paraśvathavidhāriṇe || 20.14 śrīrāmaḥ rāmaṃ ca saha vaidehyā sahitaṃ lakṣmaṇādibhiḥ | sthāpayet kālabhedena yadvā sthāpanam ācaret || 29.15 rāmaṃ puruṣasūktena sthāpayitvā yathāvidhi | gāthayā copatiṣṭheta rāmaṃ raghukulodbhavam || 29.16 namastubhyaṃ bhagavate rāghavāya mahātmane | rāvaṇādijagadvairinibarhaṇamahaujase || 29.17 rāmamūrtiṃ pratiṣṭhāpya parivārātmanā tataḥ | vāyvādidevatanayān hanūmatpramukhān punaḥ || 29.18 tattaddevāḥ samabhyarcya sthāpayet tadvad eva tān | vibhīṣaṇaṃ guhaṃ caiva pṛthag eva hi devatāḥ || 29.19 sthāpayed viśvamantreṇa rāmaprītikarāv ubhau | bharataṃ kalpayet prācyāṃ dakṣiṇe jānakīṃ punaḥ || 29.20 pratīcyāṃ jāmbavantaṃ ca uttare lakṣmaṇaṃ tathā | sugrīvaṃ cāgnikoṇe tu nairṛtyāṃ tu vibhīṣaṇam || 29.21 vāyavye tu nalaṃ nyasyet aiśānye śatrumardanam | vasiṣṭhādyṛṣimukhyānāṃ dvitīyāvaraṇesthitiḥ || 29.22 tṛtīyāvaraṇe paścāl lokapālān prakalpayet | viṣvaksenapade nīlaṃ guhaṃ vā tatra kalpayet || 29.23 sthāne khagādhirājasya hanūmantaṃ prakalpayet | rāghavasyārcanāyāṃ tu viśeṣo 'yaṃ prakīrtitaḥ || 29.24 khageśaṃ mārutiṃ vāpi likhitvā dhvajam uddharet | utsave tu viśeṣo 'yam īritaḥ kamalāsana || 29.25 balarāmaḥ rāmasya rauhiṇeyasya pratiṣṭhā ca yathāpuram | upasthāne viśeṣo 'sti śrūyatāṃ sa ca kathyate || 29.26 baline balabhadrāya halasphuritabāhave | tubhyaṃ mūleva mahatī bhūmir yena śiroddhṛtā || 29.27 śrīkṛṣṇaḥ vasudevasutasyāpi sthāpanaṃ vāsudevavat | vṛṣṇivaryāya kṛṣṇāya namastubhyaṃ madhudviṣe || 29.28 bhūbhārabhūtakaṃsādimahāsuranighātine | satyabhāmādidevīnāṃ sthāpanodvahanādikam || 29.29 śrībhūmyor iva kartavyaṃ viśeṣo 'sti na kaścana | kalkiḥ kalkiviṣṇupratiṣṭhāpi yathāpuram udīritā || 29.30 upatiṣṭheta karmānte gāthayā stutirūpayā | mlecchānām api saṃhartre sādhūnāṃ sthitihetave | namastubhyaṃ bhagavate bhūsurānvayajanmane || 29.31 mīnādimūrtīnāṃ ṣoḍaśanyāsaniṣedhaḥ neṣyate ṣoḍaśanyāso mīnādidaśamūrtiṣu || 29.32 śilāmayādimūrtīnāṃ varṇaiś citravidhir yadi | jalādhivāsanādyuktaṃ kṛtvā sarvam aśeṣataḥ || 29.33 nirmite citrakaraṇe kuryād āvāhanādikam | dhruvabimbasthiteḥ paścāt karmādyarcāsthitir yadi || 29.34 siddhāntabhedabimbānāṃ pṛthak chayanam iṣyate | abhede vedikā śayyā sahaiva syāc caturmukha || 29.35 neṣyate ṣoḍaśanyāso lohaje jaṅgame punaḥ | āvāhanaṃ mūlaberān karmādyarcāsu kalpayet || 29.36 karmārcāṃ sthāpayed brahman yāmye tu mama kautukam | tīrthasnānādibimbaṃ vā uttare sthāpayed guruḥ || 29.37 śayanotthānabimbaṃ ca balibimbaṃ ca dakṣiṇe | laukikaṃ lohajaṃ bimbaṃ sthāpayed iṣṭabhūmiṣu || 29.38 yadvodvahanabimbāni sthāpayed dvārapārśvayoḥ | maṇḍape vā 'bhiṣekārthe dakṣiṇābhimukhāni ca || 29.39 jalādhivāsane sākṣād ayogyānāṃ caturmukha | citrābhāsārdhacitrādipratimānāṃ yathāyatham || 29.40 chāyādhivāsanaṃ kuryāt snānaṃ cādarśamaṇḍale | vedyāṃ śayanam anyeṣāṃ kūrcadvāreṇa kalpayet || 29.41 avaśiṣṭaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ sakalaṃ parikalpayet | neṣyate ṣoḍaśanyāsaś caturthasnapanaṃ tathā || 29.42 vaṭapatraśāyī māyāmayamahāvṛkṣanyagrodhadalaśāyinaḥ | devasya sthāpanavidhau viśeṣaḥ kathyate 'dhunā || 29.43 garbhodavasitadvāri likhitvopari vāridhim | tatra nyagrodhavṛkṣasya dale komalarūpiṇam || 29.44 śayānaṃ bālavapuṣaṃ śyāmalaṃ kamalekṣaṇam | mārkaṇḍeyaṃ mahīṃ devīṃ kārayet pādapārśvayoḥ || 29.45 evaṃ vilikhite bāle bālaparyaṅkaśāyini | citrābhāsoktavidhinā sthāpayed gurur ātmavān || 29.46 devena devyau yugapat pratiṣṭhāyāṃ yathāpuram | sahaiva śayanaṃ vedyāṃ kālabhede tu tatpṛthak || 29.47 kuṇḍabhedāḥ kuṇḍaṃ sarasijākāraṃ prācyāṃ cāpaṃ tu dakṣiṇe | vṛttaṃ tu paścime bhāge yonyākāramudak tathā || 29.48 kuṇḍe viśeṣaḥ kathitaḥ snapanaṃ ca tayoḥ punaḥ | śriyādayaḥ śrīsūktena śriyaṃ devīṃ bhūsūktena bhuvaṃ tathā || 29.49 snāpayed arcanaṃ cāpi tayos tābhyāṃ ca śāyayet | prāgāditoraṇe pūjyā balākinyadhidevatā || 29.50 vanamālinyatho tatra samārādhya vibhīṣikām | śāṅkarī devatā paścāt dvārakumbheṣv anukramāt || 29.51 devatādvāndvayajanaṃ pratiṣṭhādīn samarcayet | prathamaṃ tadanu śraddhāṃ kāntiṃ ca tadanantaram || 29.52 kriyāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ ca paścāt tu kṣamāṃ vṛddhiṃ ca devatām | prācyādiṣu patākāsu devatādvandvam arcayet || 29.53 dhṛtiṃ ca lajjāṃ ca puro jayā māyādvayaṃ tataḥ | sāvitrīṃ ca kṣamāṃ ca dve śuddhāṃ śraddhām anantaram || 29.54 lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī caiva puṣṭis tuṣṭiś ca śaktayaḥ | prāgādihomakuṇḍeṣu hotavyāḥ proktavartmanā || 29.55 vāgīśvarī kriyā kīrtir lakṣmīḥ sṛṣṭis tathaiva ca | prahvī satyā tathā brāhmī yaṣṭavyāḥ kalaśeṣv imāḥ || 29.56 mahākumbhe śriyaṃ devīṃ yajeta kamalāsana | ṣoḍaśanyāsarahitaṃ śeṣaṃ prāgvatsam ācaret || 29.57 asvātantrye vidhir hy eṣa svātantrye tv abhidhīyate | grāme vā nagare vāpi paṭṭaṇe vālaye 'pi vā || 29.58 śriyaḥ sthānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ grāmādyabhimukhaṃ yathā | tuṣṭiṃ puṣṭiṃ ca sāvitrīṃ vāgdevīṃ ca caturmukha || 29.59 vimānasya catudiṃkṣu diṅmūrtīḥ parikalpayet | koṇeṣu vainateyaṃ vā siṃhaṃ vāpi yathāruci || 29.60 divye bhāge 'thavā brāhme praticchāyāṃ śilādibhiḥ | sthāpayet parivārāṃś ca dvārapārśve yathākramam || 29.61 caṇḍīṃ caiva pracaṇḍīṃ ca prathamadvārapārśvayoḥ | tato 'rdhamaṇḍapadvāre dakṣiṇe ca balākinīm || 29.62 vanamālām udīcīne gopure prathame punaḥ | vibhīṣikāṃ śāṅkarīṃ ca dakṣiṇottarapārśvayoḥ || 29.63 dvitīyagopuradvāre śaṅkhapadmanidhī ubhe | tṛtīye gopuradvāre nalakūbarajṛmbhalau || 29.64 caturthe gopuradvāre dakṣiṇe śibikuṇḍalau | uttare māṇibhadraṃ ca kalpayet kamalāsana || 29.65 jayā ca vijayā caiva paścimadvārapālike | sumukhīṃ sthāpayed viṣvaksenasthāne caturbhujām || 29.66 vetrahastāṃ dakṣīṇena tarjanīṃ cāpi kurvatīm | aparābhyāṃ dhārayantīṃ padmaṃ pītanibhaṃ tathā || 29.67 sthāpayed vainateyaṃ ca prāsādamukhamaṇḍape | ādimūrter iva bhavet parivāraprakalpanam || 29.68 anyāsām api devīnāṃ svātantrye vidhir īdṛśaḥ | caturthasnapanaṃ kuryād utsavaṃ cāpi devavat || 29.69 devīnāṃ ca śriyādīnāṃ itthaṃ yaḥ sthāpako naraḥ | sarvān kāmān avāpnoti paratreha ca modate || 29.70
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde mīnādipratiṣṭhāvidhir nāma ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
śriyādīnāṃ pāṇigrahaṇāvidhiḥ śrībhagavān atha śriyādidevīnāṃ pāṇigrahaṇam ucyate | sarvakalyāṇajananaṃ sarvaduḥkha vināśanam || 30.1 āyurvṛddhikaraṃ nrṇāṃ abhipretārthasādhakam | yathoktadivase kuryād aṅkurāṇāṃ samarpaṇam || 30.2 udvāhadivase prāpte muhūrte deśikottamaḥ | pṛthak devasya devyāś ca badhnīyāt karmakautukam || 30.3 ācchādyānāhatakṣaumaṃ sottarīyaṃ prasādhitam | āropya śibikāṃ grāmaṃ prādakṣiṇyena tāṃ nayet || 30.4 vaivāhikaṃ ca sadanamālayaṃ vā praveśayet | ārādhya devam ardhyādyair ānīya sthaṇḍile 'nalam || 30.5 praveśyāntargṛhe devam āsane viniveśayet | abhyarcya ca hariṃ tatra devīṃ nūtanavāsasā || 30.6 ``yuvā su" iti mantreṇa paridhāya pradakṣiṇam | bhūṣayec ca śriyaṃ devīṃ puṣpair ābharaṇais tathā || 30.7 devīṃ devena yuñjīta praṇavena guruḥ svayam | dadyāc ca devīṃ devāya vāripūrvaṃ yathāvidhi || 30.8 yajamānaḥ suvarṇorvīṃ gavādisahitāṃ tathā | svagotranāmnā kathitāṃ imāṃ śriyam anuttamām || 30.9 tataḥ pāṇigṛhītāṃ tāṃ devīṃ devaṃ ca mandirāt | nītvā vaivāhikaṃ sthānam uttarāśāmukho guruḥ || 30.10 krameṇādhārahomādīn kuryād vidhyuktavartmanā | samidhaṃ ca nṛsūktena juhuyāt ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ || 30.11 caruṇā viṣṇugāyatryā caturviṃśāhutir bhavet | śrīsūktena ghṛtaṃ hutvā bhūmyāś ca yugapad yadi || 30.12 ubhayoś ca vidhātavyaṃ pṛthag evāṅkurādikam | ubhayor ekakartṛtve prāpte paṅkajasaṃbhava || 30.13 tatrāpi pṛthag evābhyāṃ vaivāhikam athācaret | ekakāle kriyāṃ tiṣṭhet paryāyād bhinnam ācaret || 30.14 ānupūrvyavaśenaiva vibhaktaṃ syād yathā tathā | yadvā muhūrtabhinne tu bhinnaṃ vaivāhikaṃ bhavet || 30.15 muhūrte yaugapadye cedānupūrvyāt kriyāṃ nayet | śrībhūmyor bhinnakartṛtve yaugapadyodvaho yadi || 30.16 tatrāpi vidhir evaṃ syād ubhābhyāṃ vidhir eva hi | yaugapadyodvahe deve sakṛtpratisaraṃ bhavet || 30.17 ekāgnau vā prakartavyaṃ bhinnāgnau vā yathāruci | ullekhanādi prāktantraṃ prākkḷptam akṛtaṃ na ca || 30.18 prativyakti kriyāṃ sarvāṃ pṛthag eva samācaret | pūrvaṃ śriyai tato bhūmyai paryāyeṇa kriyāṃ nayet || 30.19 samidho mūlamantreṇa juhuyāt ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ | caruṇā viṣṇugāyatryā caturviṃśāhutir bhavet || 30.20 ghṛta puruṣasūktena bhūmisūktena vā punaḥ | lājahomaṃ tathā vahneḥ pradakṣiṇam anukramāt || 30.21 kṛtvā sarvam aśeṣeṇa lājaśeṣaṃ guruḥ svayam | praṇavena sakṛdhutvā pañcavāruṇikais tataḥ || 30.22 pañcopaniṣadair mantrair dvādaśākṣaravidyayā | pūrṇāhutyantam akhilaṃ kṛtvā viprāṃś ca toṣayet || 30.23 ardhyādyair arcayed devaṃ ghṛtāropaṇam ācaret | ghṛtaṃ dūrvāṅkuraṃ pātre candanaṃ śālitaṇḍulam || 30.24 karābhyāṃ sarvam ādāya sarve caiva sabhāsadaḥ | devasya devyāś cāṅgeṣu kṣipeyur iti maṅgalam || 30.25 ghṛtaṃ suśobhanam iti siñceyuḥ pādayos tataḥ | kaṭyāṃ subhadram ity uktvā mūrdhni caiva sumaṅgalam || 30.26 evaṃ dūrvādisakalaṃ kṣipeyur anupūrvaśaḥ | madhuparkaṃ pradadyāc ca rasenāsmīti coccaret || 30.27 lakṣmīpatiṃ ca hārādyair alaṅkāraiḥ prasādhayet | mālyānulepanaiś cāpi yathārhair api pūjayet || 30.28 dhenuṃ ca dadyād dharaye yajamānaḥ praṇāmavān | ācāryāya yathāvittaṃ pradadyād ātmanaḥ priyam || 30.29 nīrājanavidhāvante nikṣiped dikṣu piṇḍikāḥ | anyac ca maṅgalaṃ sarvaṃ kuryāl laukikavartmanā || 30.30 śrībhūmisahitaṃ devaṃ kuryād grāmapradakṣiṇam | āropya maṇḍape devyau devaṃ rājavad ācaret || 30.31 mahāhavir nivedyānte brāhmaṇān api bhojayet | divase divase kuryāt snānapūrvakam utsavam || 30.32 caturthyāpararātre tu śeṣahomaṃ samācaret | samidājyacaruprāyair aṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ || 30.33 juhuyān mūlamantrābhyāṃ pañcopaniṣadair api | dine tu pañcame devaṃ tailenābhyañjayed dharim || 30.34 śrībhūmisahitaṃ devaṃ snāpayed vidhipūrvakam | mahāhavirnivedyānte grāme kuryān mahotsavam || 30.35 tatra śrībhūmisahitaṃ pratyahaṃ mandire 'rcayet | devīnām itarāsāṃ ca vivāhavidhir īdṛśaḥ || 30.36 jāmadagnyādidevīnāṃ vivāhaḥ smārtavartmanā | maṇḍapādipratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ vivāhamaṇḍapādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhir ucyate || 30.37 prāsādasyāgrataḥ pṛṣṭhe pārśvayor vā yathāruci | vediṃ kuryāc caturhastāṃ hastocchrāyāṃ manoharām || 30.38 kuṇḍāni parito vedyā aṣṭau catvāri vā punaḥ | toraṇadvārakalaśadhvajādīni yathāpuram || 30.39 kṛtvā diṅmūrtinayanānyunmīlya ca yathāvidhi | āśāmūrtiṃ vimānaṃ ca darpaṇe snāpayed guruḥ || 30.40 rājā ced yajamānaḥ syāt pātrāṇi kalaśāni ca | haimarājatatāmrāṇi yadvā kāryāṇi nānyathā || 30.41 brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu yajamāneṣu padmaja | mṛṇmayāny api pātrāṇi yathāvibhavavistaram || 30.42 vāsobhiḥ śobhanair dhāmacchādayed ahastais tataḥ | vedimadhye vinikṣipya śālibhārān yathoditān || 30.43 taṇḍulāṃś ca tilān sarvān pūrvoktaparimāṇakān | upariṣṭāc ca vinyasya mahākumbhaṃ hiraṇmayam || 30.44 mūrtikumbhāṃś ca paritastanmayānaṣṭa nikṣipet | hemaniṣkapramāṇaṃ ca pratikumbhaṃ vinikṣipet || 30.45 navaratnaṃ ca sūtrādiveṣṭiteṣu yathāyatham | arcayitvā ca tānaṣṭamaṅgalāni vinikṣipet || 30.46 mūrtihomaṃ ca juhuyān mahākumbhe nivedanam | caturvidhasya haviṣaḥ tathānyad api pūrvavat || 30.47 mandirāṅgānāṃ dhyānaprakāraḥ śodhite sadane tasmin śoṣaṇālepanādibhiḥ | dhyāyed ratnasthalaṃ dhāma taptahemavinirmitam || 30.48 tatra jīvam api dhyāyed vyāpakaṃ tadupādhikam | buddhiṃ ca piṇḍikāṃ pādān ahaṅkāraṃ tathaiva ca || 30.49 pādau pādaśilājaṅghe garbhagehaṃ tathodaram | stambhān bāhūn kaṭiṃ cāpi tathaiva kaṭimekhalām || 30.50 jihvā karṇaṃ tathā netraṃ pratīpadyāś ca mehanam | apānaṃ jalaniryāṇaṃ nāsikā nāsikā matā || 30.51 gavākṣamakṣi grīvā ca grīvān skandhān kapolakau | śiraś ca kalaśaṃ māṃsaṃ pralepaṃ sparśanaṃ sudhām || 30.52 asthīni ca śilāntasthāḥ snāyur dāruśikhādhvajān | keśarīmāṇi kūrcaṃ ca dhyāyed dhāma pumākṛtim || 30.53 hutvā hutvā ca śaktīnāṃ nyasanaṃ sadane hareḥ | pūrṇaśaktiṃ prakṛtyākhyāmupāne hi vinikṣipet || 30.54 śāntiṃ jagatyāṃ kumude pṛthivīṃ tadanantaram | vāgīśvarīṃ gale caiva paṭṭikāyāṃ matiṃ tathā || 30.55 pañcāṅgakalpane śaktinyasanaṃ samudāhṛtam | dvādaśāṅge tu sadane śaktiṃ kīrtyabhisaṃjñitām || 30.56 mahatyāṃ paṭṭikāyāṃ ca gale puṣṭim anantaram | mahīṃ ca vājane vedyāṃ tuṣṭiṃ sṛṣṭiṃ tathā 'ṅghriṣu || 30.57 māyātmikāṃ kapoteṣu bhūtamālāsu mohinīm | dvādaśāṅge vimāne tu śaktinyāsa udāhṛtaḥ || 30.58 aṣṭādaśāṅgasadane hareḥ saṃprati kathyate | kūṭe nyasen mahālakṣmīm apare vasudhāṃ tathā || 30.59 śilāyāṃ ca mahīśaktiṃ prastare cātimohinīm | svāhāṃ vedyāṃ śriyaṃ dhāmni śaktinyāse 'yam īritaḥ || 30.60 śāntihomādisakalaṃ karma kāryaṃ yathāpuram | diṅmūrtīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ tatvanyāsādi pūrvavat || 30.61 brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi śataṃ vā 'pi yathā balam | bhojayed bhuktavadbhyo 'pi tebhyo dadyād dhanādikam || 30.62 vimānapaṭṭikāyāṃ tu pañcaviṃśatitantubhiḥ | badhnīyāt kautukaṃ dikṣu dhāmnaḥ catasṛṣu kṣipet || 30.63 mahākumbhaprokṣaṇam baliṃ yathāpuraṃ brahmaghoṣair dikṣu ca ghoṣayet | tataḥ prabhātasamaye muhūrte śobhane guruḥ || 30.64 mahākumbhaṃ samuddhṛtya prādakṣiṇyena mandiram | nītvā dakṣiṇataḥ kumbhaṃ sthāpayitvā samāhitaḥ || 30.65 udaṅmukho gurur bhūtvā śaktiṃ kumbhajale sthitām | vimāne mūlamantreṇa viniveśya caturmukha || 30.66 diṅmūrtīḥ svasvamantraiś ca prokṣayet kumbhavāribhiḥ | anyeṣām api devānāṃ dhāma sthānaṃ yathāvidhi || 30.67 prokṣayet kumbhatoyaiś ca vidyayā ca svayā svayā | prāsādaṃ pūjayet pūrvaṃ diṅmūrtīś ca yathātatham || 30.68 niṣṭhitāyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ prāsādasya yathāvidhi | ācāryāya śataṃ niṣkaṃ tadardhaṃ pādam eva vā || 30.69 dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām ante yathāvittānusārataḥ | yajamāno mahīṃ paścāt sahasraṃ svarṇadakṣiṇāṃ || 30.70 uttamāṃ gurave dadyān madhyamāṃ tu tadardhakām | adhamāṃ pādamātraṃ tu mūrtipān api toṣayet || 30.71 dhanair vastrādibhiś caiva manaḥ prahlādakāraṇaiḥ | bhūsurānitarāṃś cāpi toṣayed bhojanādibhiḥ || 30.72 evaṃ yaḥ sthāpayed viṣṇoḥ vimānaṃ phalaniḥspṛhaḥ | tasya muktiḥ karatale sthitā naivātra saṃśayaḥ || 30.73 phalakāmanayā yas tu sthāpayed dhāma vaiṣṇavam | tasya saṃpattiratulā manorathapathātigā || 30.74 maṇḍapasthāpanāyāṃ tu vedinirmāṇapūrvakam | kriyāviśodhanādyantaṃ kṛtvā niravaśeṣataḥ || 30.75 prāsādasthāpanoktena vartmanā deśikottamaḥ | maṇḍapaṃ viśvakarmīyaṃ sarvaratnapariṣkṛtam || 30.76 sauvarṇair bahubhiḥ stambhaiḥ nānāratnapariṣkṛtaiḥ | uttambhitaṃ gurur dhyātvā śaktinyasanam ācaret || 30.77 upānaṃ prakṛtiḥ śaktiḥ jagatī ca vasundharā | vaprā caiva kriyā śaktiḥ grīvā vāgīśvarī matā || 30.78 prītiḥ kampaṃ tathā tuṣṭiḥ kumudaṃ paṭṭikā kṣamā | stambhapādaśilā brāhmī śaktiḥ stambhāś ca vaiṣṇavī || 30.79 potikā kamalā śaktiḥ uttarā śāntir iṣyate | ratiś ca vājanaṃ māyā madīyā kamalāsana || 30.80 kīrtir matā varṇapaṭṭiḥ tathā kampaś ca mohinī | tulā padmā tathā śāntiḥ śaktiḥ sopānapaṅktayaḥ || 30.81 caturṣu maṇḍapadvārṣu toraṇāni samarcayet | śāntihomādikaṃ sarvaṃ kathitaṃ kamalāsana || 30.82 tataḥ prabhāte kumbhasthāḥ śaktīs tanmaṇḍape guruḥ | nyasya vyāpakarūpeṇa maṇḍapaṃ cintayet tataḥ || 30.83 citrāṇi citrābhāsāni tatsthāni ghaṭavāriṇā | prokṣayet svena mantreṇa sarvanyasya yathāpuram || 30.84 gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād yajamāno yathāpuram | maṇḍapasthāpanaṃ yas tu karoti madhuvidviṣaḥ || 30.85 sa bhuktvā vipulān bhogān iha loke paratra ca | modate devadevasya prāsādamaṇimaṇḍape || 30.86 āsthānamaṇḍapādipratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ āsthānamaṇḍapādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhir ucyate | vāstuyāgo baliś caiva gavyaiḥ pañcabhir ukṣaṇam || 30.87 paryagnikaraṇaṃ caiva tathā puṇyāhavācanam | sthāpanaṃ caiva kumbhasya agnau caikatra cāhutiḥ || 30.88 muhūrte prokṣayet paścāt sadyo vā sakalaṃ caret | śataniṣkaṃ tadardhaṃ vā dakṣiṇā parikīrtitā || 30.89 phalaṃ ca pūrvavat kartuḥ kiñcin nyūnaṃ caturmukha | pratiṣṭhā gopurasyāpi mandirasyeva nā'nyathā || 30.90 prākārasya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ kṛtvā sarvaṃ yathāpuram | dharmamantreṇa kumbhasthavāriṇā prokṣayed guruḥ || 30.91 śataṃ tadardhaṃ pādaṃ vā svarṇaniṣkāṇi dakṣiṇā | balipīṭhasya nirmāṇaṃ sthāpanaṃ cādhunocyate || 30.92 garbhagehasamāyāmavistārā balipīṭhikā | tadardhā tatturīyā vā pañcasaṃkhyāṃśakā 'pi vā || 30.93 yadvā navasyaikabhāgā yadvā hastavaśād bhavet | ekahastā varā pañca paramā vā yathābalam || 30.94 vistāradviguṇotsedhā triguṇā 'rdhādhikā 'pi vā | vistāratulyocchrāyā vā pañcāṅgaparikalpanā || 30.95 kapotabhūtahaṃsādimālikābhir alaṅkṛtā | tridhā kṛtvāgravistāraṃ bhāgābhyāṃ paṅkajaṃ bhavet || 30.96 pīṭhakoṇeṣu guruḍān siṃhān vā parikalpayet | vighrarāṭ tasya janakaḥ pakṣirāṭ kanyakā 'pi ca || 30.97 yathākrameṇa bhāgādidikṣu tanmūrtayaḥ smṛtāḥ | sopānapaṅktayaḥ pārśve kalpanīyā yathonnatiḥ || 30.98 gopuradvāravistāras triguṇā vā caturguṇā | bahiḥ purastād dvārasya balipīṭhasya kalpanam || 30.99 vāstuhomādikaṃ sarvaṃ śāntihomāvasānikam | kriyākalāpam ācāryaḥ kuryān mandiravat kramāt || 30.100 prabhātasamaye prāpte muhūrte śobhane guruḥ | kumbhasthavāribhiḥ pīṭhaṃ prokṣayen mūlavidyayā || 30.101 devatāś caiva tatrasthāḥ prokṣayed ātmavidyayā | prokṣayet karṇikāṃ cāpi samastetyādividyayā || 30.102 aṣṭānāṃ kumudādīnāṃ svaiḥ svair anucaraiḥ saha | prārthayeta sadā tatra sannidhiṃ mantrapūrvakam || 30.103 pīṭham evaṃ pratiṣṭhātya kuryān nityotsavaṃ punaḥ | gurave dakṣiṇā deyā śataniṣkāvarātmikā || 30.104 evaṃ yaḥ sthāpayet pīṭhaṃ viṣṇubhūtālayaṃ param | sarvaduḥkhavinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam || 30.105 balipīṭhapratiṣṭhā balipīṭhapratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣyāmi kamalāsana | tasyotsedhaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ garbhāgāraṃ samantataḥ || 30.106 āyataṃ vistṛtaṃ vāpi garbhāgārasya madhyame | utsedhe daśabhāge tu saptāṃśaṃ samudāhṛtam || 30.107 saptaviṃśatibhāge tu vibhakte tu samucchraye | dviyaṃśaṃ pādukaṃ jñeyaṃ jagatī caturaṃśikā || 30.108 triyaṃśaṃ kumudaṃ jñeyaṃ ekāṃśaṃ paṭṭikā bhavet | ṣaḍbhāgaṃ karṇam ity uktaṃ dvyaṃśakaṃ galakampayoḥ || 30.109 caturaṃśair vibhāgaś ca vaṃśaiś caivātra vartikā | dvyaṃśārdhaṃ padmapuṣpantu ekārdhaṃ padmakarṇikā || 30.110 evaṃ samyag viditvā tu bhāge bhāge vinirdiśet | tryaśahastapramāṇena trihastā cādhikāpi vā || 30.111 pañcahastādhikaṃ vāpi gopurāt prāgvidhīyate | madhye bhūtaṃ ca kartavyaṃ catustālapramāṇataḥ || 30.112 sukhāsīnam idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ parāvṛttaṃ ca kārayet | aniruddhāya dṛṣade vatsarāyeti hūyatām || 30.113 tathāvakḷptahastāya cāmuṇḍāya tathaiva ca | na nyāyeti varāyeti codarāya tataḥ param || 30.114 tathaivodarabandhāya nāḍibhyām iti vai punaḥ | vasuś caiva ca vāstubhyo vāstumuṣkāya vai punaḥ || 30.115 prajanāya jaritribhyaḥ śroṇībhyām iti vai punaḥ | taṭākāya ca vaṃśāya vaṃśadhāribhya eva ca || 30.116 prajāpataya ity uktvā dhṛṣṇaveti ca bhūtayaḥ | śukāya śukavāsibhyaḥ ūrubhyām iti coccaran || 30.117 sirābhyaś cāsthibandhebhyo mukhebhyaś ceti hūyatām | sākṣibhyo jānumūlebhya jānumūlebhya ity api || 30.118 gulphebhyaś caiva pārṣṇibhyaḥ caraṇebhyas tale 'pi vā | pādāṅgulibhyaḥ pādebhyaḥ caraṇāgratalāya ca || 30.119 talāyordhvatalāyeti tvagbhyaḥ svāheti hūyatām | tvarāsibhyaś ca hutvā tu juhuyāc ca tataḥ param || 30.120 romakūpebha ity uktvā prasebhyo rasadāya ca | ratnāya ratnavāsibhyo medase ca tathā punaḥ || 30.121 jīvāya vāstune caiva asthimajjāya vai punaḥ | juhuyān mattavāsibhyo uttamāṅgāya vai punaḥ || 30.122 dhātā vai caiva dhātubhyo dhāturūpebhya ity api | juhuyād upadhātubhyaḥ paśvātvaca iti bruvan || 30.123 sarvarūpāya grīvāya dhanadāya tathā ''tmane | sarveśvarāya yajñāya puruṣāya ca hūyatām || 30.124 upapīṭhaṃ vinā pīṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ dvijasattama | āmodaṃ prākpṛthagyaṣṭvā tadbhūtaṃ bhuvanātmakam || 30.125 pramodaṃ yāmpadikpadme tadbhūtamanalātmake | pramukhaṃ paścime padme tadbhūtaṃ syāj jalātmake || 30.126 unmukhaṃ somadigbhāge vāyubhūtaṃ tad eva hi | avighnaṃ karaṇordhvaṃ tu vyomātmakam udāhṛtam || 30.127 bhūmyantarikṣasvargaṃ ca sarvabhūtaguṇāṃtmakam <�guṇātmakam> | mahāpīṭhaḥ tatsamātmakam ity uktaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ dvijottama | prāsādasya tu vistāraṃ yas tu daṇḍam ivocyate || 30.128 mūlaharmyaṃ samārabhya ṣaṣṭhadaṇḍasamānataḥ | daśa dvādaśadaṇḍair vā manudaṇḍāvasānakam || 30.129 ṣoḍaśair dvādaśair vāpi mahāpīṭhaṃ prakalpayet | athavānyaprakāreṇa pīṭhasthānaṃ vidhīyate || 30.130 tritisāle catuḥsāle pañcasāle 'śramadhyame | mahāpīṭhaṃ prakartavyaṃ tasya lakṣaṇam ucyate || 30.131 athavā vyomahastaṃ tu adhamaṃ pīṭhavistṛtam | dvihastaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ trihastaṃ śreṣṭham ucyate || 30.132 tadvistarasamaṃ tuṅgaṃ tuṅgaṃ saptāṣṭaviṃśatiḥ | upānoccaṃ dvibhāgaṃ syāt ṣaḍaṃśaṃ jagatī bhavet || 30.133 kumudoccaṃ tu bhūtāṃśaṃ kampam ekāṃśam ucyate | vedāṃśaṃ kaṇṭhamānaṃ tu ūrdhvakampaṃ śivāṃśakam || 30.134 mahāpaṭṭī guṇāṃśaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ | vedāṃśaṃ padmabhāgaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ karṇikodayam || 30.135 athavā karṇikotsedhaṃ guṇāṃśaṃ dvijasattama | padmoccaṃ padmabhāgaṃ tu mahāpaṭṭī dvibhāgikā || 30.136 upānoccaṃ śivāṃśena śeṣaṃ pūrvavad eva hi | yadvā pīṭhodayaṃ vipra dharātālaṃ yathā kuru || 30.137 tadūrdhvoparimānaṃ tu pīṭhoccānyaṃśam ucyate | adhiṣṭhānoktamārgeṇa veśaniṣkrāntam ācaret || 30.138 padmatāre yugāṃśaṃ vā bhūtāṃśaṃ karṇikāyatam | pīṭhākāraṃ yugāśraṃ vā kartavyaṃ maṅgalāmbujam || 30.139 lohajaṃ śailajaṃ vāpi iṣṭikāmayam eva vā | aṃśasyopari pīṭhoccam upapīṭhopānatkuru || 30.140 tadūrdhve tu mahāpīṭhaṃ uktavyaṃ sodayānvitam | upapīṭhe vināpīṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ syād dvijottama || 30.141 netraṃ rasaṃ ca bhūtaṃ ca ekaṃ vedaṃ ca bhāgikam | guṇaṃ vedaṃ ca netraṃ ca upānādipramāṇavat || 30.142 ekavedaguṇaṃ caiva karṇaṃ caikaṃ ca netravat | ekaṃ guṇagaṇaṃ caiva balipīṭhapramāṇataḥ || 30.143 prabhavasyāgrataḥ kuryāt prāsādātmapramāṇavat | dvārasthānaṃ tadagre tu tannipātraśivālayam || 30.144 ete vṛṣācalaṃ sarve śāntaṃ vāme tu gopurāt | balipīṭham atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa balipīṭhasya lakṣaṇam || 30.145 liṅgodayasamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tadardhaṃ kanyasaṃ bhavet | tayor madhyeṣṭa 'dhā kṛtvā navamānaṃ prakīrtitam || 30.146 athavā piṇḍikotsedhaṃ kanyasaṃ pīṭhavistṛtam | tattāramadhyamaṃ jñeyaṃ tannāstraṃ cottamaṃ smṛtam || 30.147 tadardham adhamaṃ jñeyaṃ tayor madhye 'ṣṭabhājite | navadhā pīṭhavistāraḥ utsedhas tatsamo bhavet || 30.148 athavā dvāravistāramadhamaṃ pīṭhavistṛtam | dviguṇaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ triguṇaṃ cottamaṃ bhavet || 30.149 athavā dvāratuṅgārdhaṃ kanyasaṃ pīṭhavistṛtam | tripādaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ tatsamaṃ cottamaṃ bhavet || 30.150 adhamottamayor madhye navamānaṃ prakīrtitam | dharātalasamotsedham adhamaṃ pīṭhavistṛtam || 30.151 triguṇaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ tayor madhye 'ṣṭabhājite | navadhā pīṭhatuṅgaṃ tu vistāraṃ tatsamaṃ bhavet || 30.152 trihastam uttamavyāsam ekahastaṃ tu kanyasam | dvikaraṃ madhyamaṃ jñeyaṃ pīṭhavyāsaṃ prakīrtitam || 30.153 pañcaviṃśāṅgulārabhya dvidvyaṅgulavivardhanāt | ekāśītyaṅgulāntaṃ yat pīṭhavyāsaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 30.154 upāna bāhye vistāraḥ uttamaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ | jagatībāhyavistāraḥ madhyamaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ || 30.155 kumudānte prakartavyaṃ vistāram adhamaṃ smṛtam | prāsādoktakrameṇaiva mahāpīṭhodayaṃ tu vā || 30.156 mahāpīṭhodayaṃ saptacatvāriṃśadvibhājite | parvatāṃśaṃ jagatyuccaṃ saptāṃśaṃ kumudoccayam || 30.157 śivāṃśaṃ kampamānaṃ syāt indrabhāgaṃ galodayam | kampatuṅgaṃ śivāṃśaṃ tatsamaṃ tv ambujodayam || 30.158 kapotocca tu vedāṃśaṃ dvibhāgaṃ prastarodayam | sārdhāṅgaṃ kampatuṅgaṃ syāt sārdhaṣaṭkamalodayam || 30.159 vedāṃśaṃ karṇikotsedhaṃ dviguṇaṃ tasya vistaram | athavā pīṭhatuṅgaṃ tu pañcabhāgavibhājite || 30.160 ekāṃśaṃ vedikotsedhaṃ ekāṃśaṃ kumudodayam | śivāṃśaṃ karṇatuṅgaḥ syād ardhāṃśaṃ paṭṭikodayam || 30.161 ekāṃśaṃ kamalotsedham ardhāṃśaṃ karṇikodayam | dviguṇaṃ tasya vistāraṃ sapādādhikam eva vā || 30.162 mahānasapratiṣṭhāyāṃ vāstuhomādike kṛte | kumbham ekaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya dhānyarāśiṣu pūrvavat || 30.163 samidājyacaruṃ prāgvaj juhuyān mūlavidyayā | tatrasthadevatānāṃ tu tatvanyāsaṃ samācaret || 30.164 brāhmaṇān bhojayec chaktyā dadyāc caiva tu dakṣiṇām | veṣaṇādyaṅgajātāni kṣālayitvā 'dhivāsayet || 30.165 tataḥ prabhātasamaye muhūrte śobhane guruḥ | agnimīḍeti mantreṇa cullīṣv agniṃ nidhāpayet || 30.166 paceyuḥ pācanādīni havīṃṣi paricārakāḥ | kuṇḍe ca nityahomārthaṃ sthāpayed agnim agnimān || 30.167 prāg uktenaiva mantreṇa purastān mantrapūrvakam | nyaset kumbhajalenaiva kramāc caṇḍādidevatāḥ || 30.168 dvāre caṇḍaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca kṣetrapālaṃ khageśvaram | dvārasya dakṣiṇe pārśve gaṇānāṃ api nāyakam || 30.169 jṛmbhalaṃ maṇibhadraṃ ca śibiṃ kuṇḍalam eva ca | dvārasya cottare pārśve pārśveṣv anyeṣu ca kramāt || 30.170 prāsāda dvāravaddvāre lakṣmyādiparikalpanam | culyāś ca vāmetarayor dharmādharmau ca pṛṣṭhataḥ || 30.171 vidhātāraṃ tathā dīrghaculyām ubhayapārśvayoḥ | dharmādharmadvayaṃ nyasyet pātrāṇi sakalāny api || 30.172 śrīsūktenābhyasā prokṣya maṅgalāny api kārayet | gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād yajamāno yathābalam || 30. 173 pākaśālādikalpane phalam yaḥ kalpayed rasavatīṃ bhaktimān viṣṇumandire | sa bhuktvā vipulān bhogān pretya svargam avāpnuyāt || 30.174 dhānyāgāraṃ dhanāgāraṃ sārasvatagṛhaṃ tathā | tathā majjanaśālā ca puṣpapānīyamandiram || 30.175 tāmbūlakalpanagṛhaṃ vādyasthānaṃ caturmukha | sthānaṃ ca yac ca dhāmāṅgaṃ kalpitaṃ śilpavittamaiḥ || 30.176 ācāryo vāstuhomādi śāstroktavidhipūrvakam | kriyākalāpam akhilaṃ kuryāt pūrvoktayā diśā || 30.177 ācāryadakṣiṇā caiva deyā vittānusārataḥ | vāpīkūpataṭākānāṃ pratiṣṭhāne cikīrṣite || 30.178 teṣāṃ paścimadigbhāge vediṃ kuryāc ca pūrvavat | jalādhidaivataṃ hṛdyam alpakāyavinirmitam || 30.179 lohajaiḥ kalaśais tatra snāpayed deśikottamaḥ | mantrair varuṇadaivatyaiḥ śayane śāyayet tataḥ || 30.180 tam arcayen mahākumbhe caturṣv ekatra vā punaḥ | kuṇḍeṣu juhuyān mantrais taddevatyair ghṛtādibhiḥ || 30.181 vāruṇāni ca sūktāni dikṣu pāṭhyāni bhūsuraiḥ | prabhāte śobhane lagne śobhite pūrvavaj jalaiḥ || 30.182 puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā 'nte dhvāyed amṛtavāribhiḥ | pūritaṃ tattaṭākādīn gurur ekāgramānasaḥ || 30.183 mahākumbhajalaṃ tatra vāruṇaṃ ca vinikṣipet | mīnādijalayonīṃś ca lohajaṃ tatra nikṣipet || 30.184 gaṅgādisaritas tatra mantrair āvāhayej jale | bhukteṣu brāhmaṇeṣv ardhais tarpiteṣu yathāvasu || 30.185 dakṣiṇā gurave deyā daśaniṣkāvarā tataḥ | karoti yastaṭākādi pratiṣṭhānaṃ jalāśaye || 30.186 sa nityatṛptaḥ suciraṃ loke vasati vāruṇe ||
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde lakṣmyādipāṇigrahaṇavimānādipratiṣṭhāvidhir nāma triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
ekatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
prabhādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ śrībhagavān kālāntare prabhādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhir ucyate | jalādhivāsādyakhilaṃ karma kṛtvā yathāpuram || 31.1 dhyānakāle tu saṃprāpte dhyāyed evaṃ guruḥ svayam | jvālāmālāsahasrāḍhyāṃ vidyutsaṅghātasannibhām <�saṃghātasaṃnibhām> || 31.2 prabhāṃ dhyātvā spṛśet śāntihomānte homasarpiṣā | prabhāte mūlamantreṇa prokṣayet kumbhavāriṇā || 31.3 muhūrte yojayec cāpi kārayec ca mahotsavam | dakṣiṇā gurave deyā yathāvibhavamānataḥ || 31.4 prabhāyāṃ devadevyādīn yojayed uktavartmanā | sa tu sāyujyam āpnoti kāmān api yathepsitān || 31.5 pīṭhaṃ saṃsthāpya tatraiva nyased yogāsanaṃ guruḥ | hutvā mantraiḥ kramāt padmasthāpane vidhir īdṛśaḥ || 31.6 yojayec cāpi pīṭhādīn tatrasthān samaye guruḥ | evaṃ pīṭhādidevārthaṃ yaḥ kalpayati mānavaḥ || 31.7 sa pratiṣṭhām avāpnoti paratreha ca śāśvatīm | ghaṇṭāpratiṣṭhādi ghanṭāṃ ca pañcagavyena snāpayitvā yathoditaiḥ || 31.8 pañcavāruṇikair mantrair navavastreṇa veṣṭayet | sthaṇḍile śālibhāraṃ ca nikṣipya tilataṇḍulān || 31.9 tadūrdhve navavastraṃ ca sadarbhaṃ nyasya tatra vai | śāyayitvā ca tāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ chādayen navavāsasā || 31.10 kumbham ekaṃ samabhyarcya kumbhe vā sthaṇḍile 'pi vā | ghaṇṭāmantreṇa juhuyād ācāryaḥ samidādibhiḥ || 31.11 śoṣaṇādīni kāryāṇi tāny athoktaṃ vicintayet | śāntihomāvasāne ca spṛśet tāṃ homarpiṣā || 31.12 prabhāte mantratoyena tāmukṣen mantrapūrvakam | evaṃ susaṃskṛtāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ cālayet sarvakarmasu || 31.13 udghāṭane kavāṭasya prastute pūjane tathā | āvāhane 'rdhye snapane puṣpe dhūpe ca dīpake || 31.14 nīrājane yavanikāsam uddhāre nivedane | homabhūtabalau karmaṇy udvāhe calanaṃ maṇeḥ || 31.15 utsādanaṃ piśācādeḥ prīṇanaṃ ca hareḥ param | sannidhānam amartyānāṃ ghaṇṭāyāś calanād bhavet || 31.16 asaṃskṛtāyāś calane grāmādeś calanaṃ bhavet | niṣphalā cāpi pūjā syāt parasya paramātmanaḥ || 31.17 ghaṇṭāṃ prayacched dharaye jāyate kīrtimān naraḥ | ghaṇṭāsaṃskāravad dhūpadīpapātrasya saṃskṛtiḥ || 31.18 bheryādīnāṃ ca saṃśuddhiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ praśasyate | rathādiyānajātasya saṃśuddhir iyam iṣyate || 31.19 mantreṇa prokṣaṇāc chuddhiś citrādīnām apīṣyate | sarvatra bhojayed viprān puṇyāhaṃ cāpi kārayet || 31.20 dakṣiṇā cāpi gurave deyā vittānusārataḥ || akṣamālāpratiṣṭhā akṣamālāpratiṣṭhāṃ ca tadbhedāṃś ca yathātatham || 31.21 jape phalaṃ ca sakalam adhunā kathyate 'bjaja | sarvaratnaiś ca lohaiś ca sphaṭikais trividhair api || 31.22 jalajaiḥ sthalajair vāpi kārayed akṣamālikāḥ | akṣāsthimātrā maṇayaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ syur japakarmaṇi || 31.23 dhātrīkalāsthimātrās tu madhyamā kamalāsana | badarāsthipramāṇās tu kaniṣṭhā maṇayaḥ smṛtāḥ || 31.24 aṣṭottaraśataṃ saṃkhyā maṇīnāṃ śreyasī bhavet | tadardhasaṃkhyā kathitā madhyamā caramā punaḥ || 31.25 saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyā ca tair bhaved akṣamālikā | svargāpavargadaṃ ratnaṃ sauvarṇaṃ vibhavapradam || 31.26 rājataṃ kīrtidhanadaṃ tāmraṃ śāntikaraṃ bhavet | trāpuṣair maṇibhir japyaṃ yakṣāṃś cāpi vaśaṃ nayet || 31.27 sīsākṣamālayā rakṣo vaśekuryāc caturmukha | pīḍayec ca tathā śatrūn kāṃsyaiḥ sarvān vaśaṃ nayet || 31.28 āyasaiś cāpi bhūtāni jāpakaḥ svavaśaṃ nayet | sphaṭikaṃ mokṣadaṃ japtuḥ sarvado dyumaṇer maṇiḥ || 31.29 indor maṇis tathaiva syād akṣāḥ syur jalajāḥ punaḥ | putradaḥ putradīpaḥ syāt indrākṣaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ || 31.30 vibhītakākṣarudrākṣanimbākṣāś cābhicārakāḥ | brahmavarcasakāmasya kuśagranthiḥ praśasyate || 31.31 rājyakāmasya padmākṣaiḥ japtuḥ sidhyati taddhruvam | sitāmbhojākṣamālā tu japtur niḥśreyasapradā || 31.32 bhuktimuktipradā śaṅkhā muktā muktiphalapradā | jalajair maṇibhir mālā japtur itthaṃ phalapradā || 31.33 akṣānyathoktān saṃgṛhya vṛttān doṣavivarjitān | prakṣālya pañcabhir gavyaiḥ pañcavedāntavidyayā || 31.34 āropayed dhemasūtre triguṇais triguṇīkṛte | sūtre vā rājate kṣaume śaṇakeśādivarjite || 31.35 kārpāse vā yathā lābhaṃ kṣālite pariśodhite | pṛṣṭhena pṛṣṭhabhāge ca mukhabhāge mukhena ca || 31.36 paraspareṇa saṃbaddhā maṇayaḥ sadṛśāḥ śubhāḥ | sūtreṇa vā suvarṇena madhye bandhe tathāntaram || 31.37 protasūtreṣu taiḥ kalpyā mālikā kaṭakākṛtiḥ | maṇim anyaṃ tu badhnīyān mālāgranthau mahattaram || 31.38 merusaṃjñā maṇes tasya bhaved dakṣiṇato gatiḥ | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvānte mālāṃ sthāpyāmbujodare || 31.39 vilipya kuṅkumādyais tām akṣamālāṃ caturmukha | śālibhāraṃ ca nikṣipya tilataṇḍulasaṃyutam || 31.40 likhitvā tatra cakrābjamāstīrya kuśavastrakam | tatrākṣamālāṃ vinyasya chādayen navavāsasā || 31.41 yajeta kumbhe tanmantraṃ hemavastrādisaṃyute | homam ekatra kurvīta kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile 'pi vā || 31.42 samiccarughṛtair aṣṭau śatam ca svasya vidyayā | dhyānena śoṣaṇādīni kṛtvā 'nyac ca yathāpuram || 31.43 tanmadhye puruṣaṃ dhyāyed baddhāñjalim avasthitam | caturbhujaṃ valarkṣābhaṃ varadābhayahastakam || 31.44 akṣamālāṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ śikhāgre kaṭakākṛtim | śāntihomāvasāne ca saṃspṛśed akṣamālikām || 31.45 prāpte muhūrte tatvāni nyasyet sṛṣṭikramād guruḥ | yā parā vaiṣṇavī śaktiḥ abhinnā paramātmanaḥ || 31.46 tejasā ''dityasaṅkāśāṃ <�saṃkāśāṃ> prāgvat smṛtvā hṛdambuje | dhyāyet tato brahmarandhrād udgacchantīṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 31.47 āvāhya cākṣamālāyā mantreṇa svena mantravit | mūlamantreṇa kumbhasthavāriṇā prokṣayed guruḥ || 31.48 sannidhiṃ cākṣamālāyāṃ yāceta paramātmanaḥ | sannidhattāṃ bhavān asmin bhaktānugrahakāmyayā || 31.49 japākṣamālāvalaye gādhām enāṃ samuccaran | tatrākṣamālāṃ bibhrāṇaṃ dhyātvā devaṃ janārdanam || 31.50 śiṣyasya yajamānasya haste dadyād guruḥ svayam | praṇamya pratigṛhṇīyāt śirasā tāṃ samāhitaḥ || 31.51 vidyām iva yathāvittaṃ dadyāc ca gurudakṣiṇām | tasmin muhūrte tāṃ vidyāṃ saṃjaped akṣamālayā || 31.52 ādau yamakṣamālāyāṃ mantraṃ sthāpitavān guruḥ | tam eva mantraṃ gaṇayen na kathañcana mālayā || 31.53 apratiṣṭhāpitā yā ca tayānte vākṣamālayā | japaṃ kurvan naro mohāt kurvan naivāśnute phalam || 31.54
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde prabhāghaṇṭākṣamālāpratiṣṭhāvidhir nāma ekatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ

gṛhārcāvidhiḥ
tatra lohadārvādibhedena phalam śrībhagavān gṛhārcāsthāpanaṃ vakṣye yathāvat kamalāsana | sauvarṇī rājatī vāpi pratimā syād dvijanmanām || 32.1 ārakūṭamayī yadvā yadvā tāmramayī bhavet | lohajāḥ pratimāḥ sarvāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ || 32.2 śilābimbaṃ dārubimbaṃ svagṛhe nārcayed budhaḥ | piśācādivaśīkāre pratimā cāyasī matā || 32.3 uccāṭanakarī kāṃsyā pratimā kamalāsana | trilohajā śatrujayī sīsakotthā ''mayapradā || 32.4 ratnajapratimāḥ sarvāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ | candrakāntasphaṭikajā saumyā pratikṛtir matā || 32.5 āgneyī mitramaṇijā anyā sphaṭikajā dvidhā | sālagrāmaśilā śvetā saumyā saumyaphalapradā || 32.6 śrīkarī pītavarṇā ca raktā kāmapradā matā | kṛṣṇā puṣṭipradā nityaṃ piṅgalā rogadā sadā || 32.7 śilāś cakraparijjātāḥ sarvā mokṣaphalapradāḥ | mūrtibhir garbhitāḥ sarvāḥ śilāś cakrasaridbhavāḥ || 32.8 prādurbhāvaiś ca mīnādyais tathā divyāyudhair api | lāñchitāḥ kaustubhādyaiś ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ kamalāsana || 32.9 aṅkitāḥ pūjanīyāś ca bhuktimuktiphalārthibhiḥ | sarvāḥ svāyāṃbhuvā jñeyāḥ śilāś cakrasaridbhavāḥ || 32.10 nityaṃ sannidhir etāsu parasya paramātmanaḥ | na pratiṣṭhā vidhātavyā na caivāvāhanādikam || 32.11 sālagrāmaśilā yatra pūjyate bhagavanmayaiḥ | taddeśe yojanādarvāṅ mṛto nirvāṇam aśnute || 32.12 dvāravatyāḥ śilāś cāpi sālagrāmaśilāsamāḥ | drumajātipratikṛtiḥ sabhājyā kāmanāvaśāt || 32.13 pratimā candanamayī pūjitā śriyam āvahet | pratimā cāgarumayī bhuktimuktiphalapradā || 32.14 devadārumayaṃ bimbaṃ sarvadaṃ bhavane 'rcitam | bilvajā pratimā lakṣmīmatulām āvahet sadā || 32.15 brahmavarcasakāmena brahmavṛkṣasamudbhavā | śamīpratikṛtiḥ svargyā nameruḥ sukhadā bhavet || 32.16 annādikāmaiḥ pratimā pūjyodumbaradārujā | aśvatthanirmitā pūjyā rājyakāmena dhāmani || 32.17 nyagrodhanirmitaṃ bimbaṃ sarvatra bhavane 'rcitam | plakṣajaṃ jīvadhanadaṃ sarvopakaraṇāvaham || 32.18 priyaṅgunirmitaṃ bimbaṃ śrīvaśyaṃ bhavane 'rcitam | putradīpamayaṃ putrakārakaṃ muktidaṃ tathā || 32.19 mantrādisādhane yuktāṃ saralārcāṃ samarcayet | tamālajātipratimā sarvalokasukhāvahā || 32.20 cūtajā ''rogyadā putravit tadā badarīkṛtā | panasapratimā brahman bahuputrā samarcitā || 32.21 kṣīriṇī dhanadā jñeyā saptalā duḥkhanāśinī | dhanadaṃ jātijaṃ bimbaṃ spandajaṃ sukhakāraṇam || 32.22 timijaṃ dhanadaṃ brahman kadambaṃ jñānakāraṇam | kuravaḥ puṣṭiphaladaḥ tilakaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ || 32.23 madhūkaḥ siddhidaś cāhur asanaḥ śrīkaraḥ sadā | puṣṭido jambuvṛkṣas tu punnāgaḥ puṣṭivardhanaḥ || 32.24 rogado rājavṛkṣaś ca khādiraś cākṣināśanaḥ | nimbavṛkṣapratikṛtiḥ vidveṣaṇakarī matā || 32.25 virbhītakā śālmalī ca kalpyate kamalāsana | gajotpāṭitagaurārkamūlakalpitakautukam || 32.26 vaināyakam abhipretasakalārthaprasādhakam | mātrāṅgulivaśenaiva gṛhārcāmānakalpanam || 32.27 nādhikaṃ hastamānāc ca na nyūnaṃ dvādaśāṅgulāt | kautukaṃ bhavane 'bhyarcyaṃ śilādārvādijaṃ dhruvam || 32.28 aṅgulaiḥ pratimāmānaṃ varṇānām ucyate kramāt | hastamānamitā 'rcā syād bhavane pūrvajanmanaḥ || 32.29 aṅgulair ekaviṃśatyā pratimā vasudhāpateḥ | viśām ekonaviṃśatyā dvābhyāṃ śūdrasya hīnayā || 32.30 ardhacitraṃ tathābhāsaṃ bhavane bhuktivardhanam | dvādaśāṅgulamānā 'rcā lohajā pūrvajanmanaḥ || 32.31 navāṅgulā kṣatriyasya viśaḥ saptāṅgulā bhavet | pañcāṅgulā caturthasya pratimā bhavane bhavet || 32.32 pratimā yanmayī kḷptā prabhāpīṭhādi tanmayam | yadvā sauvarṇabimbasya rājataṃ tāmram eva vā || 32.33 lohena ced uttamena pratimā nirmitā bhavet | tadanantaralohena prabhāpīṭhādi kalpayet || 32.34 trilohajāyām arcāyāṃ suvarṇaṃ vā prabhādikam | ratnasphaṭikajānāṃ tu pratimānāṃ prabhādikam || 32.35 gṛhe saṃhāraśayanam arcayen na kadācana | bhagavanmūrtayas tv anyāḥ sarvāḥ pūjyā yathātatham || 32.36 śrībhūmīsahitaṃ devaṃ śriyā kevalayā 'pi vā | sahitaṃ pūjayen nityaṃ bhaktyā padmaniketana || 32.37 gṛhe pūjāsthānanirdeśaḥ pūjāsthānaṃ gṛhasyoktaṃ mārutyāṃ diśi nānyathā | arcayed bhavaneṣv arcāṃ yajamāno yathoditām || 32.38 tatpratiṣṭhārtham ācāryam abhyarcyāgamayed gṛham | aṅkaṇe vā nadītīre kṣetre yadvā supūjite || 32.39 vedikāṃ paritaḥ kḷpte homakuṇḍacatuṣṭaye | ekasmin vā guruḥ kuryāt pratiṣṭhākarma pūrvavat || 32.40 aṅkurānarpayitvā 'gre jale caivādhivāsanam | nayanonmīlanaṃ cāpi kuryāt pūrvoktavartmanā || 32.41 pādyamardhyaṃ tathācāmaṃ pañcagavyaṃ tathā dadhi | payo madhu kaṣāyaṃ ca uṣṇāmbhaḥ phalavāri ca || 32.42 mārjanāmbhokṣatāmbhaś ca ratnāmbho lohavāri ca | gandhāmbhaś ca yavāmbhaś ca krameṇā 'nena padmaja || 32.43 snāpayec ca nṛsūktena tathedaṃ viṣṇur ity ṛcā | snapanaṃ kārayed vidvān mantraiḥ prāg uktavartmanā || 32.44 śayanādikam anyac ca kriyājātaṃ yathāpuram | mahāpratiṣṭhāvidhivat karma kuryād guruḥ svayam || 32.45 pratimāsthāpanasthāne ratnanyāsādipūrvakam | prāpte muhūrte pratimāṃ sthāvarāṃ ced abhīpsitām || 32.46 sthāne tāṃ sthāpayitvaivaṃ kuryād āvāhanādikam | jaṅgamā ced abhimatā vedyāmāvāhanādikam || 32.47 kuryāt tadanu tāṃ sthāne stāpayed vidhipūrvakam | caṇḍapracaṇḍau valaje kṣetrapālaṃ khageśvaram || 32.48 vighneśaṃ vāstunāthaṃ ca durgāṃ vā tatra kalpayet | guhaṃ ca viṣvaksenaṃ ca śaṅkhapadmanidhī tathā || 32.49 ācāryacodito bhūmau patitvā daṇḍavat svayam | yajamānaḥ prārthayet tam abhīpsitam aśeṣataḥ || 32.50 dāso 'smi tava deveśa saputragaṇabāndhavaḥ | sannidhatsva gṛhe yāvad anvavāyo mamācyuta || 32.51 pūjāṃ mayā yathāśakti vihitāṃ vikalām api | gṛhṇīṣva bhagavan bhaktajanānugrahakāmyayā || 32.52 yācitvā devadeveśamitthamācāryasannidhau <�saṃnidhau> | gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād yathāvibhavavistaram || 32.53 yathā ca tṛptirasya syāt ṛtvijām api pūrvavat | brāhmaṇān bhojayec chaktyā tebhyo dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām || 32.54 sthāpayitvā 'rcayed devaṃ bhaktimān bhaktavatsalam | bhuktvā bhogān suvistīrṇān pretya nehābhijāyate || 32.55 bhavane sthāpito viṣṇuḥ puṣṇāti kulamātmanaḥ | mandire tu jagatsarvaṃ puṣṇāti sthāpito hariḥ || 32.56 śrīvatsakaustubhoṣṇīṣavanamālācatuṣṭayam | pradhānabhūṣaṇaṃ viṣṇoḥ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi || 32.57 śrīvatsaṃ sthāpayitvāgre śālibhāre saśāṭake | niveśya pralayaṃ sargaṃ mahākumbhaṃ yajed guruḥ || 32.58 kuṇḍe śrīvatsamantreṇa nalinākārakalpite | juhuyāt samidādhāracarubhiḥ śatamaṣṭa ca || 32.59 vārān nyasec ca tatvāni śāntiṃ hutvā spṛśec catam | saṃprokṣya kumbhatoyena muhūrte harivakṣasi || 32.60 niveśayed dakṣiṇā ca deyā niṣkatrayā 'varā | gurave yajamānena manaḥprītivivardhitī || 32.61 bhagavataḥ alaṅgārakalpane phalam yo bhūṣayati deveśaṃ śrīvatsapratikarmaṇā | sa lakṣmīṃ labhate nityām uttamāṃ nā 'tra saṃśayaḥ || 32.62 kaustubhaṃ svena mantreṇa sthāpayitvā yathāpuram | harimākalpayet tena muhūrte deśikottamaḥ || 32.63 yajamānaś ca gurave prayacched dakṣiṇāṃ śubhām | yaḥ kaustubhena deveśaṃ maṇḍayed aśnute śriyam || 32.64 vanamālāṃ ca sauvarṇīṃ nānāratnapariṣkṛtām | sthāpayitvoktamārgeṇa muhūrte śobhane guruḥ || 32.65 kaṇṭhe pralambayed viṣṇoḥ sarvasaṃpatkarīṃ nṛṇām | dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyād yajamāno 'pi puṣkalām || 32.66 yaś ca bhūṣayati śrīśaṃ manujo vanamālayā | so 'śnute durlabhān kāmān sarvān eva na saṃśayaḥ || 32.67 pretya lokān suvipulān svargādīn so 'śnute 'kṣayān | śuddhajāmbūnadamayaṃ kirīṭaṃ maṇibhiścitam || 32.68 cetasā bhaktiyuktena yathārhaṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ | kalaśaiḥ saptadaśabhiḥ sthāpayitvā svavidyayā || 32.69 śālibhāreṣu vinyasya veṣṭayitvā ca vāsasā | ahatena punaḥ kumbhe yajed āvāhya vidyayā || 32.70 juhuyāc ca caturdikṣu vidyayā ca svayā guruḥ | spṛṣṭvā ca śāntihomānte prabhāte kumbhavāriṇā || 32.71 saṃprokṣya svena mantreṇa datvā ca gurudakṣiṇām | prāpte muhūrte deveśamāsīnaṃ bhūpraviṣṭare || 32.72 snāpayed rājavad devam ārādhya kalpabhūṣaṇaiḥ | brāhmaṇeṣu caturvedānadhīyāneṣu sarvataḥ || 32.73 nānāvidheṣu vādyeṣu caturdikṣu nadatsu ca | vandāruṣu ca deveśaṃ stotrair uccāvacair bhṛśam || 32.74 stuvatsu bhaktinamreṣu śrībhūmisahitaṃ harim | prastūyamāneṣv anyeṣu maṅgaleṣu samantataḥ || 32.75 kuṇḍeṣu purato hutvā pūrvavat samidādibhiḥ | caturdikṣu caturdvāriṃ ekāgneḥ koṇataḥ sthite || 32.76 pañcopaniṣadair mantraiḥ kirīṭaṃ devamūrdhani | āropayeyur ācāryāḥ mūrtipāś ca vicakṣaṇāḥ || 32.77 muñceyuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca tūryaghoṣapuraḥsaram | mahadbhir upacāraiś ca guruṇā 'bhyarcitaṃ harim || 32.78 brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ datvā sukhāsīnaṃ mahāsane | yānam āropya hastyādi śvetacchatravirājitam || 32.79 vījyamānaṃ ca gaureṇa cāmareṇa samantataḥ | grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ nītvā mandire viniveśayet || 32.80 yaḥ kirīṭena devaśamākalpena prasādhayet | trayāṇām api lokānāmādhipatyaṃ sa vindati || 32.81 hārādibhir nūpurāntaiḥ bhūṣaṇais tapanīyajaiḥ | kṣālitair gandhatoyena dvādaśākṣaravidyayā || 32.82 dhānyarāśiṣu saṃsthāpya homaṃ ca samidādibhiḥ | spṛṣṭavākalpaṃ japen mantraṃ deśiko dvādaśākṣaram || 32.83 muhūrte bhūṣayet tena deveśaṃ vidyayā tayā | yo bhūṣayati deveśaṃ so 'pi kāmān samaśnute || 32.84 pañcāyudhamānapratiṣṭhādi pañcāyudhānāṃ divyānāṃ pratiṣṭhā vakṣyate 'dhunā | cakrasya tāvat sarveṣu mukhyasya kamalāsana || 32.85 vakṣyate sthāpanaṃ tasya mānaṃ rūpaṃ ca yādṛśam | vistṛtaṃ hastamānena yadvā saptadaśāṅgulam || 32.86 aṣṭādasāṅgulaṃ yadvā viṃśatyaṅgulam eva vā | caturdaśāṅgulaṃ yadvā ṣoḍaśadvādaśāṅgulam || 32.87 mūlabimbānanasamaṃ sahasrāraṃ samujvalam | yadvā śatāram athavā caturviṃśatyarānvitam || 32.88 dvādaśāramathāṣṭāraṃ athavā ṣaḍaraṃ param | sahasrajvālam athavā ṣaḍjvālaṃ nābhimaṇḍitam || 32.89 trilohanirmitaṃ cakraṃ nālapīṭhasamanvitam | kṛtvā karaṇḍam akuṭaṃ bibhrāṇaṃ vā sudarśanam || 32.90 caturbhujadharaṃ kruddhaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanam | puruṣaṃ dvibhujaṃ yadvā dakṣiṇenāpi tarjanam || 32.91 spṛśantaṃ kaṭimanyena itarābhyāṃ kṛtāñjalim | mukhyābhyāṃ tu karābhyāṃ vai susthitaṃ padmaviṣṭare || 32.92 adhivāsya jale pūrvaṃ sthāpayitvā ca maṇḍape | śāyayitvā ca śayane iṣṭvā kumbhe svavidyayā || 32.93 dhyāyan puruṣam atyugraṃ dvibhujaṃ raktavāsasam | raktadaṃṣṭrāsanaṃ nābhau saṃsthitaṃ gurur īdṛśam || 32.94 caturdikṣu ca kuṇḍeṣu cakramantreṇa mūrtipāḥ | juhuyuḥ samidādhāraṃ carubhiḥ kamalāsana || 32.95 kuṇḍeṣv ekatra purataḥ toraṇādīni pūrvavat | arcayitvā tataś cakraṃ śoṣayec choṣaṇādibhiḥ || 32.96 spṛṣṭvā tu śāntihomānte nābhyādyavayavān kramāt | muhūrte kumbhatoyena siñced ātmīyavidyayā || 32.97 caturṇām itareṣāṃ ca śaṅkhādīnāṃ yathāpuram | pratiṣṭhāpanam ācāryaḥ svair mantroranupūrvaśaḥ || 32.98 gurave dakṣiṇā deyā daśaniṣkāvarā tataḥ | pañcāyudhāni nirmāya yaḥ sthāpayati mānavaḥ || 32.99 sa viṣṭapatraye dhīmān na bibheti kutaścana | bhuṅkte ca bhogān vistīrṇān modate ca triviṣṭape || 32.100 caṇḍādidvārapālānāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhir ucyate | jalādhivāsanaṃ pūrvaṃ maṇḍape snapanaṃ tathā || 32.101 śayyāyāṃ cāpi śayanaṃ kumbhe caikatra pūjanam | homaś caturṣu kuṇḍeṣū kuṇḍe vaikatra padmaja || 32.102 tatvanyāsaṃ tathā sāntihomāṅgasparśanaṃ tathā | prokṣaṇaṃ kumbhatoyena vidyayā ca svabījayā || 32.103 gurave dakṣiṇā cāpi deyā vittānusārataḥ | caṇḍādīn sthāpayen martyaś caitat sārūpyam aśnute || 32.104 vainateyādipratiṣṭhā vainateyapratiṣṭhāyāṃ viśeṣo vakṣyate 'dhunā | prācyāṃ juhvan bṛhatsāmnā satyaṃ dhyāyed gurus tataḥ || 32.105 dakṣiṇasyāṃ suparṇaṃ tu sauparṇyā vidyayā huvet | pratīcyāṃ garuḍaṃ kuṇḍe dhyāyed dhomo rathantaraiḥ || 32.106 tārkṣyadhyānam udīcīne gāyatryā ca svayā ''hutiḥ | purastād upariṣṭāc ca śubhaṃ karma yathāpuram || 32.107 sthāpako vainateyasya labhate tatsamīpatām | ādityasya pratiṣṭhā ca vidhātavyā yathāpuram || 32.108 viśeṣas tūcyate kaścid yathāvadavadhāraya | āvāhanaṃ svagāyatryā tayā kuṇḍeṣu cāhutiḥ || 32.109 bibhrāḍity anuvākena sāvitryā sthāpanaṃ tathā | sūryasya mūlamantreṇa kumbhatoyena secanam || 32.110 sthāpakas tasya talloke rājate muktakilbiṣaiḥ | brahmādīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ yathāpuram || 32.111 svātantrye pāratantrye ca svair mantraiḥ sthāpanaṃ bhavet | durgā ca mātaraḥ sapta yāḥ kāścid devatās triyaḥ || 32.112 pratiṣṭhā tāsu lakṣmīvanmantraiḥ svaiḥ svair viśiṣyate | viṣvaksenotpattisthāpanādi brahmā viṣvaksenasya bhagavan utpattiḥ kāraṇāt kutaḥ | sthāpanaṃ ca kathaṃ tasya kathyatāṃ yady anugrahaḥ || 32.113 śrībhagavān dauvārikeṣu sarveṣu yaś caṇḍaḥ prathamo bhavet | sa devāsurayor yuddhe balī daṇḍadharaḥ svayam || 32.114 jaghāna daityān devārthamātmanā 'bhipracoditaḥ | tasya tuṣṭo 'ham adadāṃ matsvarūpasarūpatām || 32.115 aiśvaryaṃ kumudādīnāṃ balaṃ cā 'prativāritam | viṣvaksenasamākhyāṃ ca sarvasenādhipocitām || 32.116 naivedyasya caturthāṃśaṃ sarvasyopahṛtasya me | caṇḍasya ca pade 'tyugram anyaṃ sthāpitavānaham || 32.117 itthaṃ brahman tadutpattiḥ sthāpyaś ca mama sannidhau | sthāpanaṃ ca svamantreṇa tasyeṣṭaṃ yadvadātmanaḥ || 32.118 dakṣiṇā gurave deyā sthāpakasya phalaṃ tathā | pratikāyaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ kṛtvā sthāpanam ācaret || 32.119 svatantraṃ vā 'svatantraṃ vā yathālābhaṃ śilādibhiḥ | kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ saumyaṃ sthitam āsīnam eva vā || 32.120 yathāvarṇaṃ yathārūpaṃ yathācāśramadharmiṇām | yathāvayorūpadharaṃ padmapīṭhe pratiṣṭhitam || 32.121 kṛtalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ śilpibhiḥ suparīkṣitam | yadvā karmānurūpeṇa pratikāyaṃ prakalpayet || 32.122 sthāpayed aṅkurānādau arpayitvā śubhe dine | ayugmāḥ pālikāḥ kāryāḥ śarāvaghaṭavarjitāḥ || 32.123 adhivāsanam ārabhya pūrvavat karmapaddhatiḥ | upacāras tathā homaḥ kumbhayāgaś ca secanam || 32.124 pareṇa brahmaṇā kāryaṃ mantraiś cānyaiḥ supūjitaiḥ | toraṇādīn yajet pūrvaṃ na vedikalaśān api || 32.125 muhūrte prokṣayet kumbhavāriṇā deśikottamaḥ | svātantrye mandiraṃ kalpyaṃ siṃhadiṅmūrtivarjitam || 32.126 dīkṣāguroś ca pratimāṃ sthāpayen mantrasiddhaye | dakṣiṇā gurave deyā tarpaṇīyāś ca bhūsurāḥ || 32.127 avarjanīyaṃ sarvatra dhanair brāhmaṇatoṣaṇam | puṇyāhavācanaṃ vipraiḥ svādhyāyādhyayanaṃ tathā || 32.128 dakṣiṇā ca guror gurvī yajamānadhanocitā | etair yathoditair yuktaṃ hīnam anyena dūṣyati || 32.129 sthāpanaṃ pratikāyānāṃ brahman naivātra saṃśayaḥ | pratyahaṃ cārcanaṃ teṣāṃ upacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 32.130 kartavyam utsavaṃ cāpi dhvajārohaṇavarjitam | na homo na balistīrthaṃ svātantrye vidhir īdṛśaḥ || 32.131 pāratantrye tu bhaktānām utsavaḥ kamalāsana | devasyotsavamadhye ca prakānte vātha nirmite || 32.132 tasmin kārye kṛte tasmin prīyate hi janārdanaḥ | rājño rāṣṭrasya sarvasya brāhmaṇānāṃ gavām api || 32.133 jāyate bhūyasī saṃpadutsave vihite sati | iti brahman kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kathitāḥ pṛcchatastavā || 32.134 dayayā parayā bhūyaḥ krimanyac chrotum icchasi | śāstropasaṃhāraḥ saṃvartaḥ mahopaniṣadaṃ śāstraṃ caturvedasamanvitam | saṃkṣipya ca śatādhyāyāpahmena kapilāc chrutam || 32.135 tad eva kaṇvaḥ saṃkṣipya śraddadhānasya te mayā | dvātriṃśadadhyāyayutaṃ śubhaṃ vai sāravattaram || 32.136 ``padmācchratam idaṃ śāstraṃ tathā padmāhvayaṃ matam" | idaṃ ca deyaṃ paramaṃ rahasyamanasūyave || 32.137 śraddadhānāya bhaktāya śucaye dīkṣitāya ca | brāhmaṇāya prapannāya śrotriyāya ca dhīmate || 32.138 yadvā jyeṣṭhāya putrāya na vidyāmaraye vadet || namo brahmaṇyadevāya śrīdharāyā 'vyayātmane | ṛgyajuḥ sāmarūpāya śatarūpāya viṣṇave || 32.139
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ kriyāpāde saṃvartaproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ gṛhārcāsthāpanavidhir nāma dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
kriyāpādaḥ samāptaḥ
pādmasaṃhitā
śrī pāñcarātre pādmasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthaḥ caryāpādaḥ
? prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
śrībrahmovāca karṣaṇādipratiṣṭhāntaṃ karma yasya prasiddhyate | taṃ samārādhanavidhiṃ śrotum icchāmi sāmpratam || 1.1 ārādhanavidhiḥ kīdṛg adhikāraś ca kīdṛśaḥ | bhagavaṃs tam aśeṣeṇa brūhi me bhaktavatsala || 1.2 śrībhagavān śrūyatām abhidhāsyāmi pṛṣṭaṃ niravaśeṣataḥ | ādyamekāyanaṃ vedaṃ sabrahmapratipādakam || 1.3 tenaiva saṃskṛtā viprā mukhyakalpādhikāriṇaḥ | anyeṣāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ varṇānāṃ dīkṣayā kramāt || 1.4 adhikāro 'nulomānām api nānyasya kasyacit | pūjāvidhau bhagavataḥ parasya paramātmanaḥ || 1.5 pratilomabhuvāṃ sūtaḥ prathamas tatra śasyate | trayāṇāṃ kṣatriyādīnām anulomabhuvām api || 1.6 sūtasya ca viśeṣeṇa dīkṣā cātmaparā 'niśam | parārthayajanaṃ kuryur viprā mukhyānukalpayoḥ || 1.7 naivādhikāriṇas te gauṇāḥ saṃskāravarjitāḥ | yathaiva dīkṣaṇīyebhyo jāyante brāhmaṇādayaḥ || 1.8 tathaiva dīkṣāvidhinā jāyamānā yathoditāḥ | pūjāvidhau bhagavataḥ prakalpyante 'dhikāriṇaḥ || 1.9 brahmā bhagavan brāhmaṇādīnāṃ janma karma ca bhāvikam | vinā taṃ ca vivāhaṃ ca yac ca yāvac ca yādṛśam || 1.10 mahyaṃ jijñāsamānāya bhaktāya parameśvara | tadaśeṣaṃ yathātattvam upadeṣṭuṃ tvam arhasi || 1.11 śrībhagavān sattvaṃ rajas tamaś ceti traiguṇyaṃ kamalāsana | tanmayīṃ tanum āsthāya sasarjāhaṃ purā prajāḥ || 1.12 sattve 'dhike mukhād viprānasṛjaṃ mithunātmakān | rajoguṇe 'tiśayite bāhubhyāṃ kṣatriyāṃs tathā || 12.13 ūrubhyāṃ guṇasābhyenāsṛjaṃ mithunaṃ viśām | ādhikye tamasaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdrān mithunarūpiṇaḥ || 1.14 ete ca varṇāḥ śreyāṃsaḥ pūrve pūrve yathoditāḥ | hetubhyāṃ janmakarmabhyāṃ śraiṣṭhyameṣu prakalpyate || 1.15 trayas teṣu dvijāḥ pūrve mauñjībandhanakarmaṇā | catvāraś cāśramā brahman sarva eva dvijanmanaḥ || 1.16 upanīya guroḥ pārśve vratānuṣṭhānapūrvakam | vedādhyayanamādau yat sa śreyān prathamāśramaḥ || 1.17 bhāryāsaṅgrahaṇaṃ snātvā prajāyai tadanantaram | tathā ca dharmācaraṇaṃ dvitīyaś cāśramas tathā || 1.18 gatvā sabhāryo vipinaṃ yathoktenaiva vartmanā | vane vanyaphalāhāro vihitendriyanigrahaḥ || 1.19 vane tṛtīyo vijñeyaś cāśramaḥ kamalāsana | putre dārān vinikṣipya śikhī muṇḍastridaṇḍavān || 1.20 yadvaikadaṇḍanirato brahmadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | nivṛttasarvakāmastu vaset turyāśrame dvijaḥ || 1.21 kṣatriyasyāśramāḥ pūrve saṃnyāsāśramavarjitāḥ | vihitā viśa ekasya dvau prāñcau na tu paścimau || 1.22 eka eva ca śūdrasya dārasaṅgrahaṇātmakaḥ | ṣaṭkarmā brāhmaṇo jñeyaḥ karmaṇā 'dhyāpanādinā || 1.23 adhyāpanaṃ cādhyayanaṃ yajanaṃ yājanaṃ tathā | dānaṃ pratigrahaś ceti ṣaṭkarmāṇy agrajanmanaḥ || 1.24 dānam adhyayanaṃ yajño vṛttistrayyeva bhūbhujaḥ | viśāṃ ca saiva śūdrasya śuśrūṣaivaikavartanam || 1.25 āstikyamārjavaṃ śaucaṃ tapo dāntiḥ śamaḥ kṣamā | jñānaṃ vijñānam ity ete viprasya sahajā guṇāḥ || 1.26 śauryaṃ tejo dhṛtir dhārṣṭyaṃ yuddhe cāpyapalāyanam | dānam īśvarabhāvaś ca kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam || 1.27 karṣaṇaṃ caiva vāṇijyaṃ gavāṃ rakṣaṇam eva ca | svābhāvikaṃ viśāṃ karma śuśrūṣā pādajanmanaḥ || 1.28 śūdasya bhāryā dāsī ca svā ca te ca viśaḥ smṛtāḥ | te ca svā ca kṣitīśasya tāś ca svāś cāgrajanmanaḥ || 1.29 svāsu prajāḥ svajātīyāś cāturvarṇyam iti smṛtam | apare jārajātī ca kūṇḍagolakasaṃjñite || 1.30 jārair utpāditā varṇāḥ svavarṇāsv eva bhīruṣu | sabhartṛkāsutaḥ kuṇḍo golako vidhavāsutaḥ || 1.31 na tayor viprayogyeṣu trayamadhyāpanādikam | savarṇā kṣatriyāyukte vipreṇoḍhaḥ cikitsakaḥ || 1.32 āyurvedam adhīyīta mantravaccopanīya saḥ | tatra cauryeṇa sambhūto jyotir vedābhijīvakaḥ || 1.33 jyotir vidyāṃ samabhyasyopanīya samantrakam | brāhmaṇādhyūḍhavaiśyāyāmambaṣṭhaśśalyakṛntakaḥ || 1.34 nāmer ūrdhvaṃ tu vapanaṃ vṛttirasya vidhīyate | cauryāt kulālaḥ kumbhādinirmāṇaṃ cāsya jīvikā || 1.35 mṛnmayī pratimā cāpi kāryā śāstroktavartmanā | brāhmaṇādūḍhaśūdrāyāṃ jātaḥ pāraśavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 1.36 arcanaṃ saptamātrṇāṃ vādyavādanam eva ca | tasya vṛttirniṣādastu cauryāt syān mṛgadhātakaḥ || 1.37 paṭṭabandhocitau cobhau nṛpajau kuṇḍagolakau | kṣatriyādvinnavaiśyāyāṃ goṣṭhīpaṇyopajīvanaḥ || 1.38 cauryeṇa jāto māhiṣyasturaṅgamavaṇig bhavet | śūdrāyāṃ kṣatriyādugro vinnāyāṃ karibandhakaḥ || 1.39 cauryeṇa śūliko jñeyaḥ śūlāropaṇavṛttikaḥ | maṇikāraśśaṃkhakāro vaṇijau kuṇḍagolakau || 1.40 kariṇo vinnaśūdrāyāṃ vaiśyād dyūtādijīvanaḥ | cauryāt kaṭakaras tatra vṛttis tasya kaṭikriyā || 1.41 mālavaścāśvapālaś ca śūdrajāvaśvapau sadā | gavādipālako 'mbaṣṭhyāmābhīro brāhmaṇād bhavet || 1.42 viloko rathakṛt kṣattā viprāt pāraśavastriyām | māhiṣyeṇa kariṇyāṃ tu rathakāro rathādikṛt || 1.43 śilpavit sarvaśilpānāmācāryaḥ sa ca ucyate | vrātyānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ vṛttir ucyate || 1.44 māraṇaṃ maṇḍanaṃ kṣemaṃ samudrataraṇaṃ tathā | brāhmaṇyāṃ kṣatriyāt sūto vivāhāt pratilomajaḥ || 1.45 sārathyaṃ vṛttir etasya dharmāṇāṃ cāvabodhanam | upavītopanayane prāpnoty eva samantrakam || 1.46 cauryāt tatraiva sūto 'nyas so 'nyasaṃskārakārakaḥ | tasyāṃ vaidehako vaiśyād vivāhād vastraśuddhikṛt || 1.47 māgadhas tatra cauryeṇa jaṅghākārakavṛttikaḥ | śūdrād brahmaṇayoṣāyāṃ vivāhāc cauryato 'pi vā || 1.48 caṇḍālo jhallarīkākṣo malanirharaṇādikṛt | āyogavastantuvāyo vaiśyādūḍhanṛpastriyām || 1.49 tatraiva cauryādāraṇyaḥ pulindo mṛgadhātukaḥ | śūdrān nṛpāyāṃ vinnāyāṃ pulkaso vārkṣamadyakṛt || 1.50 vaiśyena tatra cauryeṇa jṛmbhanṛttādivartanaḥ | vaiśyāyāṃ śūdravinnāyāṃ takṣā syāt takṣaṇādikṛt || 1.51 so 'yaṃ kāṃsyasvarṇakṛt syāt tvaṣṭā ca śramajīvanaḥ | nailyakṛc ca sa vijñeyo nīlavastrādicitrakṛt || 1.52 sa eva jātipālaḥ syāc cauryāc cakrī tu tailikaḥ | śūdrāt kariṇyāṃ vai jātaḥ kūṭakṛc chavadāhakaḥ || 1.53 brāhmaṇānnāpito 'mbaṣṭhyāmadhovapanavṛttikaḥ | pratilomānulomābhyāṃ prātilomyānulomataḥ || 1.54 bahavaḥ saṅkarā jātāḥ yathā ''bhīrādijātayaḥ | prakṛtānupayogāt te varṇyante na svarūpataḥ || 1.55
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde jātirnirṇayo nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ
? dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
dīkṣāvidhiḥ brahmā ye dīkṣāyām adhikṛtā ye ca tatra bahiṣkṛtāḥ | te yathāvadaśeṣeṇa kathitāḥ puruṣottama || 2.1 dīkṣāsvarūpaviyṣaye bubhutsā mama samprati | vijṛmbhate tatsvarūpam upadeṣṭuṃ tvam arhasi || 2.2 śrībhagavān pratiṣṭhāvidhivatsarvaṃ dīkṣāmaṇḍapamāditaḥ | kārayitvā śucau deśe tadvad eva caturmukha || 2.3 deśe ca paścime vedyāḥ kuṇḍaṃ tālatrayād bahiḥ | kārayitvā dvijendrādivarṇānāmānupūrvaśaḥ || 2.4 anukūlaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ tāladvayamitāntaram | vṛttaṃ gokarṇayugmena vistīrṇaṃ tadanantaram || 2.5 cāpākāraṃ vitastibhyāṃ vistārāyāmasaṃmitam | trikoṇam itarat kuṇḍaṃ prādeśadvayavistṛtam || 2.6 āyāmassruksruvādīnām īdṛśo brāhmaṇādiṣu | daśabhyāṃ yāgasambhārāḥ sambhāryās samidādayaḥ || 2.7 ekādaśyāṃ tu sāyāhne tithau syād adhivāsanam | maṇḍape ca yajane sthāpyaṃ dvārakumbhādipūrvakam || 2.8 dhāraṇāśodhitatanuścakrābjaṃ vartayed guruḥ | kumbhaṃ ca hemādimayaṃ karakaṃ cāpi tādṛśam || 2.9 grāhitodakasampūrṇaṃ nyastaratnasuvarṇakam | sūtraveṣṭitasarvāṅgaṃ srakcandanapariṣkṛtam || 2.10 ahatābhyāṃ ca vāsobhyāṃ chāditaṃ doṣavarjitam | astreṇa śatavāraṃ tu karakaṃ cābhimantrayet || 2.11 acchinnadhārayā siñced vedikāṃ parito guruḥ | prādakṣiṇyena karakaṃ nītvā kumbhaṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ || 2.12 aiśānye cakrapadmasya bhāge dhānye niveśayet | dakṣiṇe kalaśaṃ vāme karakaṃ mūlavidyayā || 2.13 kumbhe ca harim āvāhya pūjayec chāstravartmanā | yajeta devaṃ cakrābjamaṇḍale kamalāsana || 2.14 sāṅgaṃ saparivāraṃ ca yathāvidhi yathākramam | mathitvā 'ṣṭākṣareṇāgniṃ kuṇḍe taṃ viniveśayet || 2.15 tatra siddhaṃ caruṃ kṛtvā caturdhaikanniveśayet | maṇḍalasthāya haraye kumbhe bhāgamathetaram || 2.16 agnau caikaṃ svayaṃ caikam upayuñjīta deśikaḥ | samidhaś śatam aṣṭau ca juhuyād deśikottamaḥ || 2.17 ājyahomo 'pi tadvat syān mūlamantreṇa mantravit | caruṃ nṛsūktena tathā pūrṇāhutyantamanvitam || 2.18 śiṣyaṃ śāntaṃ jitakrodhaṃ madādyair varjitaṃ śucim | ahatakṣaumavasanaṃ sottarīyam alaṅkṛtam || 2.19 āhūya vāsasā badhvā gurur netre svavidyayā | ātmano dakṣiṇe pārśve niveśya prāṅmukhaṃ yathā || 2.20 tena darbhaiś ca saṃspṛṣṭaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣavidyayā | dvādaśāhutimājyena juhuyāc caruṇā tathā || 2.21 samitpuṣpatilaiś cāpi tataḥ prasṛtimudrayā | trirmūrdhni śiṣyam ālabhya prādakṣiṇyena deśikaḥ || 2.22 aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa tato bhasmasamudbhavam | pāṇḍaraṃ mūrdhni śiṣyasya viniveśyordhvapuṇḍrakam || 2.23 astramantreṇa badhnīyāt sūtraṃ pratisaraṃ kare | pītvā śiṣyaḥ pañcagavyaṃ praṇavena caruṃ tataḥ || 2.24 bhuñjīta kāyaśuddhyarthaṃ dantān kāṣṭhena dhāvayet | dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca bhūbhāge nipātyāgraṃ vilokayet || 2.25 naiṛte mārute yāmye yady agram aśubhaṃ bhavet | śubham anyatra digbhāge kāṣṭhāgre patite bhavet || 2.26 aśubhaṃ śāntihomena śāmyec chubhakaraś ca saḥ | nārasiṃhena mantreṇa tilair aṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 2.27 homaḥ kāryas tataś śiṣyamācāntaṃ devasannidhau | kare gṛhītvā deveśaṃ praṇamya gurur ātmavān || 2.28 vijñāpayed imāṃ gāthām uccārya kamalāsana | ``saṃsārapāśabaddhānāṃ paśūnāṃ pāśamokṣaṇe || 2.29 tvam eva śaraṇaṃ deva gatir anyā na vidyate | pāśamokṣaṇahetur yas tvatsamārādhanātmakaḥ || 2.30 tenemān janmapāśena pāśitān paśujanmanaḥ | vipāśayāmi deveśa tadanujñātum arhasi" || 2.31 iti vijñāpya śiṣyaṃ taṃ māyāsūtreṇa veṣṭayet | śuklaṃ raktaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca trivarṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtam || 2.32 sūtraṃ punaś ca triguṇaṃ kṛtvā sūtreṇa tādṛśam | śikhāṃ prakramya pādāntaṃ pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā || 2.33 veṣṭayen mūlamantreṇa kāyaṃ śiṣyasya sarvataḥ | juhuyāt tena mantreṇa śiṣyaṃ saṃspṛśya deśikaḥ || 2.34 sarpiṣā 'ṣṭottaraśataṃ vārān pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ | svapnādhipatimantreṇa sarpiṣā 'ṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 2.35 svapnadarśanasiddhyarthaṃ juhuyād deśikottamaḥ | māṣaudanena bhūtebhyo baliṃ dadyāt samāhitaḥ || 2.36 vimuktanetrabandhasya śiṣyasya tanubandhanam | māyāsūtraṃ samādāya śarāve 'nyasya nikṣipet || 2.37 kumbhapārśve śarāveṇa pidhāyānyena deśikaḥ | darbhānāstīrya tattalpe śiṣyassvāpaṃ samācaret || 2.38 maṇḍalasthaṃ ca kumbhasthaṃ devaṃ nodvāsayet tadā | tataḥ prabhāte śiṣyasya śubhaṃ cet svapnadarśanam || 2.39 dīkṣeta no ced aśubhaṃ śāntihomaṃ samācaret | snātvā śiṣyeṇa sahitaḥ praviśed yāgamaṇḍapam || 2.40 dhvajatoraṇakumbhādipūjā pūrvavad iṣyate | caturvidhaṃ nivedyānnaṃ namaskṛtya pradakṣiṇam || 2.41 śiṣyasya pūrvavan netre baddhvā nūtanavāsasā | niveśya pūrvavat pārśve juhuyāt samidādibhiḥ || 2.42 pratyekam aṣṭottaraśataṃ mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ | māyāsūtraṃ tataś chittvā saṃhārakramamāsthitaḥ || 2.43 tattvāny uddiśya juhuyāt pratyekaṃ tāni deśikaḥ | pratyekam aṣṭotaraśatam aṣṭakṛtvo 'thavā guruḥ || 2.44 svahṛtpadme paraṃ jyotir dhyātvā paramapūruṣam | tasmin jīvaṃ ca śiṣyasya saṃharet mantravittamaḥ || 2.45 śoṣaṇādīni dehasya śiṣyasambandhinas tathā | kṛtvā tatra smaredaṇḍaṃ tataḥ svahṛdayāmbujāt || 2.46 saṅkramayya punar jīvaṃ prakṛtyādikramāt sṛjet | sargakāle ca juhuyāt tattvāni kramam āsthitaḥ || 2.47 sṛṣṭvā sthūlaśarīrāntamaṇḍabhedaṃ ca cintayet | tanmadhye puruṣa dhyātvā jātam ātmānam ātmanā || 2.48 prokṣayen mūlamantreṇa netrabandhaṃ ca mocayet | śiṣyas tu paridhāyānyadvāsaḥ pādau pradhāvya ca || 2.49 ācamya vāsasā 'nyena baddhanetro nije gurau | āsīta prāṅmukhas tasmin śodhayeñ ca ṣaḍadhvanā || 2.50 kālādhvā bhuvanādhvā ca padatattvādhavanau tataḥ | mantrādhvā cātha varṇādhvā ṣaḍadhvānaḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 2.51 pūrvamājyāhutiṃ hutvā mahāvyāhṛtividyayā | hutaśeṣeṇa śiṣyasya pādau spṛṣṭvā tatas tilaiḥ || 2.52 hutvā nābhiṃ samālabhya tato hutvā kuśeśayaiḥ | spṛṣṭvā ca hṛdayaṃ hutvā caruṇā mūrdhni saṃspṛśet || 2.53 aṣṭottaraśataṃ homaḥ pratyekaṃ mūlavidyayā | homānte ca tataś śiṣyaṃ gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare || 2.54 nītvā pradakṣiṇaṃ kumbhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ ca yathoditam | dvāri tiṣṭhaṃś caturṇāṃ tu dvārāṇāṃ kamalāsana || 2.55 maṇimuktāpravālair vā puṣpair vā kevalair guruḥ | añjaliṃ pūrayed ante tatas tasya vikasvaraiḥ || 2.56 puṣpāṇi vikiret tasmin maṇḍale gurucoditaḥ | yasmin patati bhūbhāge puṣpāṇām utkaras svayam || 2.57 tadbhāgādhipamūrtīnāṃ nāmānyasya vinirdiśet | śiṣyasya keśavādīni padaṃ bhāgavateti ca || 2.58 nāmnām ante prayoktavyaṃ yadvā bhaṭṭāraketi ca | brāhmaṇaś cet kṣatriyasya devāntaṃ nāma nirdiśet || 2.59 vaiśyasya pālaśabdāntaṃ dāsāntaṃ pādajanmanaḥ | tato vimucya dṛgbandhaṃ darśayec cakramaṇḍalam || 2.60 śiṣyeṇa sahito vedyāṃ dhyāyen nārāyaṇaṃ guruḥ | dhyātvā ca dakṣiṇe karṇe śiṣyasya praṇavānvitam || 2.61 mantram dadyād ṛṣicchandodaivataṃ cāṅgam eva ca | dvādaśākṣaramādau tu paścād aṣṭākṣarātmakam || 2.62 mūrtimantraṃ ca tadanu samadhyāpya yathāvidhi | kevalaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ nāma namaḥpraṇavavarjitam || 2.63 humphaḍādivaṣaṭsvāhāvarjitaṃ keśavādikam | adhyāpyaṃ strīṣu śūdreṣu tadvad evānulomaje || 2.64 sāvitrīṃ ye 'nutiṣṭhanti teṣāṃ vipravad īritam | kumbhasthaṃ maṇḍalasthaṃ ca hariṃ śiṣyaḥ samarcayet || 2.65 ārādhya harim utthāya tasthuṣaḥ prāñjalis sadā | mūrdhnā śiṣyasya sa gurus tato dhyātvā ca maṇḍalam || 2.66 hastaṃ nyased viṣṇuhaste tataś śiṣyasya deśikaḥ | ācāraniyamān sarvān bodhayed agnisannidhau || 2.67 mantraḥ parasya nākhyeyo nākṣasūtraṃ prardaśayet | na ca mudrāṃ nāpi siddhiṃ mantraṃ na kathayet svayam || 2.68 ācāryanāma na vaden niyogaṃ nāsya laṅghayet | śayanādīṃś ca na guror ākramen na ca laṅghayet || 2.69 na guruṃ dūṣayed vācā nācaret tasya vipriyam | guruvad gurudāreṣu vartitavyamasannidhau || 2.70 ācāryam acyutaṃ śāstraṃ trayaṃ saṃmānayet sadā | nāstikān bhinnamaryādān devabrāhmaṇadūṣakān || 2.71 na spṛśen nātha tais sārdhaṃ saṃvaded durdaśāsv api | prasārayen naiva pādau gurudevāgnisannidhau || 2.72 veditavyaṃ jagatsarvaṃ vāsudevamayaṃ sadā | anarcayitvā deveśaṃ nātmapoṣaṇam ācaret || 2.73 jayastotrapraṇāmādīn sandhyākāle samācaret | bhagavaddhyānatatkarmakartavyeṣu sadā ramet || 2.74 vaiṣṇavaṃ ca yatiṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamed daṇḍavat kṣitau | putradāragṛhakṣetrapaśvādidhanam ātmanaḥ || 2.75 vyapadeśyamaśeṣeṇa nāmnā bhagavato bhavet | samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu kāmakrodhau vivarjayet || 2.76 śanaiś śanair indriyāṇi viṣayebhyo nivārayet | saṃsāravimukhais sārdhaṃ śāstrābhyāsaṃ samācaret || 2.77 śrautasmārtāni karmāṇi sadā seveta netarat | svasūtroktena vidhinā niṣekādikriyā bhavet || 2.78 kuryāt sarvāṇi karmāṇi bhagavaddhyānatatparaḥ | guhyaṃ nāma ca gotraṃ ca prākṛtān nānyad iṣyate || 2.79 āsīno vā śayāno vā gacchan bhuñjān eva ca | saṅkīrtayet smarec cāpi vāsudevaṃ sanātanam || 2.80 evaṃ sambodhya niyamān śāntihomaṃ samācaret | pūrṇāhutyantam akhilaṃ hutvā cāgniṃ visarjayet || 2.81 maṇḍalasthaṃ ca kumbhasthaṃ devam udvāsya deśikaḥ | vardhayedāśiṣā śiṣyaṃ śiṣyaś ca gurave tathā || 2.82 gāṃ ca bhūmiṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca bhūṣaṇaṃ yānam eva ca | dāsīdāsādi vitared ātmavittānusārataḥ || 2.83 brāhmaṇān bhojayed datvā vittaṃ vitteṣu niḥspṛhaḥ | tadahaś śeṣamāsīta tatraiva hutaśeṣabhuk || 2.84 astaṃ gate dinakare sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutam | guruṇānumato gehaṃ praviśed bandhubhis saha || 2.85 anena vidhinā yas tu dīkṣitaś cakramaṇḍale | brāhmaṇo vedavidvidvān sa sarvāśramiṇāṃ varaḥ || 2.86 ucyate nāmabhiś cet tair nākhyeyaḥ prākṛto yathā | sūriḥ suhṛdbhāgavataḥ sāttvataḥ pañcakālavit || 2.87 aikāntikas tanmayaś ca pāñcarātrika ity api | evam ādibhir ākhyābhir ākhyeyaḥ kamalāsana || 2.88 samayo 'gre sadācāras svādhyāyo dravyasaṅgrahaḥ | śuddhir tyāgas stutir dhyānam ity evaṃ vidhir aṣṭadhā || 2.89 vidhinānena yas tiṣṭhet sa bhāgavata ucyate | evaṃ na kurute yas tu sarvabhūteṣu pāpakṛt || 2.90 karmaṇā manasā vācā na sa bhāgavataḥ smṛtaḥ | jñānādiguṇasaṃghāto bhago yatra sa ucyate | bhagavadbhaktir asyeti sa bhāgavata ucyate || 2.91
iti śrīpāñcarātramahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde dīkṣāvidhir nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
? tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
nityayāgavidhiḥ bhagavān śrūyatām abhidhāsyāmi brahmannārādhanaṃ hareḥ | yena viṣṇoḥ padaṃ martyaḥ prāpnotītaradurlabham || 3.1 snānamūlāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ snānaṃ ca bahudhā smṛtam | vāruṇaṃ divyamāgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ pārthivaṃ tathā || 3.2 māntraṃ mānasam ity evaṃ snānaṃ saptavidhaṃ bhavet | nirīkṣya cātmanaś śaktiṃ samayaṃ deśam eva ca || 3.3 eteṣv ekatamaṃ kuryāt samārādhanatatparaḥ | avagāhanam apsvantarvāruṇaṃ snānam ucyate || 3.4 sahātapena varṣeṇa snānaṃ divyam anantaram | samidhāṃ dīpitānāṃ ca gomayasya hutasya ca || 3.5 sitena bhasmanāṅgeṣu lalāṭādiṣu ca kramāt | yad ūrdhvapuṇḍrakaraṇaṃ mantroccāraṇapūrvakam || 3.6 tadāgneyaṃ bhavet snānaṃ śodhanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam | gacchatsu goṣu pādotthai rajobhir bhuvisambhavaiḥ || 3.7 sparśanaṃ vapuṣas snānaṃ vāyavyaṃ tadudāhṛtam | praśaste parvatāgrādau jātayā śvetamṛtsnayā || 3.8 uccārya keśavādīni nāmāny aṅge yathākramam | lalāṭādau yadvidhānam ūrdhvapuṇḍrasya tad bhavet || 3.9 ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ mṛdā dhāryaṃ sāntarālaṃ triyaṅgulam | lakṣmyā sārdhaṃ sukhāsīno ramate tatra nirvṛtaḥ || 3.10 pārthivaṃ snānam abliṅgair mantrair vipravareritaiḥ | ambhobhiḥ prokṣaṇaṃ brahman tanmantrasnānam iṣyate || 3.11 dvirācamyāhataṃ vāsaḥ paridhāya sukhāsanaḥ | prāṇānāyamya māṃ dhyāyet hṛdayāmbhoruhe sthitam || 3.12 dhyānenānena nirdhūtakalmaṣo jāyate pumān | snānaṃ mānasam etat syāt snātaś ca harim arcayet || 3.13 ājānu pādau prakṣālya hastau cāmaṇibandhanāt | ācamya ca dvārapārśvaṃ gatvā 'ṅganyāsapūrvakam || 3.14 tālatrayaṃ ca hastābhyāṃ kṛtvābhivalajaṃ sthitaḥ | kavāṭam udghāṭya tato vāyumantreṇa padmaja || 3.15 sāmnā devavratenāntaḥ praviśed dakṣiṇāṅghriṇā | praṇamecchirasā devaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣavidyayā || 3.16 āropiteṣu dīpeṣu mālye cāpi nirāsite | vedyāṃ pātreṣu bimbeṣu śodhiteṣu yathātatham || 3.17 dvārapūjāṃ mukhe sarvaparivārasamarcane | kṛte śiṣyeṇa vānyena paricārakareṇa vā || 3.18 pūjako 'laṅkṛtaḥ <'laṃkṛtaḥ> stragvī śuklāmbaradharaśśuciḥ | dhṛtopavītottarīyaś candanādyanulepanaḥ || 3.19 candanaśvetamṛtsnāmbukalpitāgryordhvapuṇḍrakaḥ | devasya pārśvamāsādya pārśve savyetare svayam || 3.20 āsīno viṣṭare śuddhe bṛsyādau svastikāsane | baddhvā padmāsanaṃ vāpi tūryaghoṣe pravartite || 3.21 tiraskariṇyā catvāri niśchidraṃ chādite tataḥ | astramantreṇa kakubho baddhvā dhūmadhvajaṃ bahiḥ || 3.22 prākārāvasthitaṃ dhyāyet tejomantreṇa mantravit | cakramudrāṃ ca khe nyasya cakramantneṇa sādhakaḥ || 3.23 gopayannitthamātmānaṃ prāṇāyāmais tribhiḥ kramāt | yuktaḥ kṛtvā yogamudrāṃ nābhikande sthitaṃ punaḥ || 3.24 vedyākāraṃ vāyubījaṃ dhyātvā tajjena vāyunā | dhūmreṇa dehapāpmānaṃ śoṣayitvā niranvayam || 3.25 trikoṇam agnibījaṃ ca raktavarṇaṃ hṛdambuje | dhyātvā tadutthasaptārciśśikhābhiḥ kalmaṣaṃ dahet || 3.26 māhendrabīja vinyasya pītābhaṃ caturaśrakam | kaṇṭhe saha sparśanena stambhayed agnim utthitam || 3.27 vāyunā kumbhakenaiva vṛttaṃ sphaṭikasannibham | vinyasya vāruṇaṃ bījaṃ mūrdhni tajjāmṛtāmbhasā || 3.28 kṣālayet sarvato dehamāpādatalamastakam | pṛthivyādīni tattvāni samādhiparayā dhiyā || 3.29 paramātmani saṃhṛtya pralayakramamāsthitaḥ | pṛthivīṃ pañcaguṇakāṃ pītābhāṃ caturaśrikām || 3.30 ghrāṇopasthendriyayutāṃ tanmātrālakṣaṇe tataḥ | gandhe saṃhṛtya yogena gahanena vicakṣaṇaḥ || 3.31 rasanāpāyvindriyābhyāṃ [ca] sahāpāścaturguṇāḥ | ardhacandrākṛtiś caitās tanmātrā lakṣaṇe rase || 3.32 gandhaṃ ca tanmātrātmānaṃ tato 'gniṃ tryaśrapāṭalam | triguṇaṃ dṛṣṭicaraṇaṃ srotobhyāṃ susamāhitaḥ | 3.33 tanmātrālakṣaṇair etair antastanmātrayā saha | saṃhared dviguṇaṃ vāyuṃ sparśe tanmātralakṣaṇe || 3.34 dhūmraṃ vṛttaṃ tvakkarābhyāṃ rūpatanmātrayā saha | puñjānas saṃhared yogī khañcaśabdaguṇaṃ punaḥ || 3.35 tanmātrālakṣaṇe śabde nīlotpaladalaprabham | sparśaṃ ca tanmātrātmānaṃ [śrutivāk] sahitaṃ tataḥ || 3.36 saṃhṛtya śabdatanmātrāṃ svānte svāntam ahaṅkṛtau | ahaṅkṛtiṃ buddhitattve buddhiṃ ca prakṛtau punaḥ || 3.37 jīve ca prakṛtiṃ jīvaṃ vāsanāvivaśaṃ tataḥ | susūkṣme nābhicakre sve bhāskarābhamavasthitam || 3.38 suṣumnayā nāḍikayā padmasūtrasuksūkṣmayā | uparyārohayed dehe kumbhakena nabhasvatā || 3.39 bhittvā ca brahmaṇo randhraṃ bahir dehād vinirgatam | praviśya bhāskarasyāpi maṇḍalān nirgataṃ bahiḥ || 3.40 aśarīraṃ tadā jīvaṃ parasmin brahmaṇi dhruve | sthitaṃ dhyāyet sthitaṃ tatra svadehaṃ yonijaṃ dahet || 3.41 nyastena śikhibījena pādāgre jvalanatviṣā | pādādimūrdhaparyantaṃ dagdhe dehe nije tataḥ ||
