3.42 nivṛttibījaṃ khe dhyāyet pūrṇacandrāyutopamam | tadūrdhvapīyūṣanidhau jāte pāṇḍarapaṅkaje || 3.43 smarej jīvaṃ samutpannaṃ sakāśād brahmaṇas tadā | jīvāt pradhānaṃ tasmāc ca buddhiṃ buddher ahaṅkṛtim || 3.44 tato manas tataś śabdatanmātrāṃ khaṃ tatas saha | vākśrutibhyāṃ śabdaguṇaṃ tanmātrāṃ sparśalakṣaṇām || 3.45 vāyuṃ sparśaguṇaṃ sārdhaṃ tvacā hastena ca smaret | tataś ca rūpatanmātraṃ tato 'gniṃ saha cakṣuṣā || 3.46 padbhyāṃ rūpaguṇaṃ tābhyāṃ tanmātrāṃ ca rasaṃ tataḥ | āpo rasaguṇāḥ pāyūrasanābhyāṃ sahābjaja || 3.47 gandhaṃ ca tanmātrātmānaṃ tato gandhaguṇāṃ bhuvam | sumutpannāṃ smared vidvān ghrāṇopasthayutāṃ tathā || 3.48 itthaṃ śarīram ātmīyaṃ śuddhāśuddhādibhūtajam | vicintya paṅkajaṃ buddhyā prabuddhaṃ tadvinirgataiḥ || 3.49 śātakumbhamayaiḥ kumbhaiḥ pūrṇair amṛtavāribhiḥ | snāpitaṃ śuddham anaghaṃ cintayitvā nijaṃ vapuḥ || 3.50 ārādhane harer yogyaṃ parasya paramātmanaḥ | dhyāyann aṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ dvādaśākṣaram eva vā || 3.51 sṛṣṭisthitilayanyāsair hastanyāsapurassaram | nyased aṅgeṣu mūrdhādipādānteṣu yathātatham || 3.52 talaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ ca karayośśodhayitvā 'stravidyayā | aṅgulīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ parvasvādyantavartiṣu || 3.53 iṣyate praṇavanyāso madhyameṣu ca parvaṣu | mantrākṣarāṇi vinyasyen nyāsa eṣas sanātanaḥ || 3.54 parva dakṣiṇatarjanyāḥ prakramyāṅguṣṭhaparvaṣu | dakṣiṇetaratarjanyāḥ parvāntaṃ sādhakottamaḥ || 3.55 sṛṣṭinyāsam imaṃ kuryād vyatyāsena tu saṃhṛtiḥ | prakramya tarjanīparva kaniṣṭhāparva viśramaḥ || 3.56 sthitāvaṣṭākṣarasyaiṣa mantrasya nyāsa īritaḥ | dvādaśākṣaramantrasya nyāsassamprati kathyate || 3.57 nyāsastale madhyamayā tarjanyaṅguṣṭhaparvaṇi | kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ parvasvaṅguṣṭhenetareṣu tu || 3.58 savye tale tu viśrāntis sṛṣṭāvaparathā laye | talayoḥ prakramasthāne dakṣiṇetarayor dvayoḥ || 3.59 kaniṣṭhayoś ca viśrāntiḥ parvaṇor ubhayor api | dvādaśākṣaramantrasya nyāso 'yaṃ kamalāsana || 3.60 hṛdayādīni cāṅgāni dhyātvāṅguṣṭhādipañcasu | nyasennakhamukhe netre tale savye gadādharau || 3.61 savyetare padmacakre nyasen nyāsaḥ karadvaye | īritas talayor mantraṃ dhyātvā tejobhir ujjvalam || 3.62 tābhyāṃ mūrdhādipādāntaṃ dehe nyasyet samantataḥ | vyāpakaṃ kañcukaṃ yadvā mantraṃ tv akṣaraśas tataḥ || 3.63 mūrdhni netre mukhe citte nābhau guhye ca jānuni | caraṇau kramaśaḥ spṛṣṭvā nyāso mantras sa iṣyate || 3.64 viparītakramo jñeyaḥ saṃhṛtau pālane punaḥ | nābhyādihṛdayānteṣu nyāso 'ṅgeṣu prakīrtitaḥ || 3.65 aṣṭākṣarasya mantrasya sthānāny etāni tāni ca | śirasaḥ paścimaṃ pūrvaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ cottaraṃ tataḥ || 3.66 catvāri ca caturvaktrasthānāni dvādaśākṣare | mūrdhni madhyamayā 'ṅgulyā tarjanyā saha cakṣuṣoḥ || 3.67 nyasyen mukhe 'nāmikayā sāṅguṣṭhena ca mantravit | aṅguṣṭhatarjanībhyāṃ tu hṛdaye nyasanaṃ bhavet || 3.68 tathāṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhābhyāṃ nābhau nyāsaḥ praśasyate | vināṅguṣṭhena śeṣābhir guhye jānuni cobhayoḥ || 3.69 samastābhiś caraṇayor ity aṣṭākṣarabhūmayaḥ | prāgbhāge śiraso 'ṅgulyā nyāso 'ṅguṣṭhena dakṣiṇe || 3.70 tarjanyā paścime bhāge nyāso 'nāmikayottare | kaniṣṭhayā tadetāḥ syur dvādaśākṣarabhūmayaḥ || 3.71 rūpaṃ krameṇākṣarāṇāṃ nyāsakāle 'pi cintayet | śuklaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ raktaṃ kuṅkumasannibham || 3.72 padmakiñjalkasadṛśaṃ sarvavarṇakam aṣṭakam | sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca dhūmrābhaṃ śyāmaṃ tārānibhaṃ tathā || 3.73 sphaṭikābhaṃ ca śaṅkhābhaṃ raktaṃ śuklaṃ ca lohitam | tamorūpaṃ pītavarṇaṃ dhyātvā mantraṃ dvayākṣaram || 3.74 sthāne yathokte vinyasya paḍaṅganyāsam ācaret | hṛdayaṃ ca śiraś caiva śikhā kavacam eva ca || 3.75 astraṃ netraṃ ṣaḍetāni hṛdaye mastake tathā | śikhāyāmānupūrvyeṇa skandhasyobhayapārśvayoḥ || 3.76 netrayor dikṣu sarvāsu nyasanīyāni bhūmiṣu | rūpāṇi ṣaṇṇāṃ kumudaṃ bandhūkamasitotpalam || 3.77 abjakesaram ambhojamatasīsūnasannibham <�saṃnibham> | divyāyudhadharaṃ divyavastramālyānulepanam || 3.78 kaustubhaṃ vanamālāṃ ca śrīvatsaṃ divyalakṣaṇam | bibhrāṇaṃ bhāvayet sākṣād ātmānaṃ parameśvaram || 3.79 arcayen nyāsabījāni gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt | mānasair upacāraiś ca hṛdayāmbhoruhe sthitam || 3.80 homānte arcayet pūrvaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam | ātmaśuddhir iyaṃ proktā mantraśuddhis tu vakṣyate || 3.81 ṣaḍviṃśenārṇabījena mantrabījāni śoṣayet | saptaviṃśena bījena dahed etāni varṇaśaḥ || 3.82 aṣṭāviṃśena bījena teṣu stambhanam ācaret | ekonatriṃśabījena tāny eva kṣālayet punaḥ || 3.83 huṅkāreṇa prabuddhāni phaṭkāreṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ | kuryād abhimukhāny anyat praṇavena viśodhayet || 3.84 tamakṣamālayā śuddhaṃ japen mantraṃ samāhitaḥ | aṣṭottaraśataṃ vārān aṣṭāviṃśatim eva vā || 3.85 aṣṭau vā mantravin mantraṃ bījādyantaṃ puṭīkṛtam | pūjādravyāṇi sarvāṇi kṣālayec cāmbupūritām || 3.86 dakṣiṇe vāmapārśve tu viniveśya galantikām | ardhyādipātrāṇy ādāya gāyatryā viṣṇupūrvayā || 3.87 prakṣālya pādeṣv ādadyād devasyāgre 'tha padmaja | pādyaṃ madhye dakṣiṇe 'rdhyaṃ vāme cācamanīyakam || 3.88 tasya pātrasya pārśve tu vāme snānīyapātrakam | pūrṇāni cākṣatāmbhobhiḥ pātrāṇi nigamādinā || 3.89 saṃspṛśyārdhyādipātreṣu dravyāṇi viniveśayet | kuśāgramakṣataṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ malayajaṃ tathā || 3.90 tilān siddhārthasahitān nyāsed ardhyasya bhājane | tiladūrvāṃ viṣṇuparṇīṃ śyāmākaṃ padmam akṣatam || 3.91 pādyapātre ṣaḍetāni dravyāṇi viniveśayet | elālavaṅgakarpūrajātītakkolacandanam || 3.92 puṣpāṇy ācamanīye tu pātre dravyāṇi kalpayet | gandhaṃ sarvauṣadhīratnaphalabījakuśāni ca || 3.93 tilāni cākṣataṃ caiva dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā | rajanī dvādaśāṅgāni snānīye ca vinikṣipet || 3.94 koṣṭhaṃ māṃsī haridre dve murā śaileyacampakā | vacā kacoramustāś ca sarvauṣadhyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 3.95 tilāś ca tulasī caiva nikṣipec chāntivāriṇi | dvādaśāraṃ bhāsamānaṃ cakramadhye tu bhāskaram || 3.96 haste vāmetare dhyātvā dīptau tadraśmibhiḥ punaḥ | dravyāṇi dagdhvā niśśeṣaṃ bhasmībhūtāni tāni ca || 3.97 dakṣiṇetarahastasthe sitapadme vikasvare | dalaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir yukte candraṃ pīyūṣaraśmibhiḥ || 3.98 hlādayantaṃ sthitaṃ dhyātvā tadutthair amṛtāmbubhiḥ | siktāni jātāni punar yāgayogyāni bhāvayet || 3.99 hastayor ubhayor devaṃ dhyāyen nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | tābhyām ardhyādipātreṣu spṛṣṭvā dravyāṇi viśvataḥ || 3.100 sakṛt sakṛt sambhṛtāni gāyatryā viṣṇupūrvayā | abhimantrya tato mudrāṃ saurabheyīṃ pradarśayet || 3.101 taddugdhena ca pātrāṇi pūritāni vicintayet | omardhyam ity ādipūrvaṃ kalpayāmīti coccaran || 3.102 spṛśet pātrāṇi hastena pātre 'nyasminn anantaram | ardhyapātrājjalaṃ kiñcid gṛhītvā viniveśayet || 3.103 dakṣiṇetarahaste tat pātraṃ saṃsthāpya mantrayet | mantreṇa mūlabhūtena vārān sapta tadambunā || 3.104 phaṭantenāstramantreṇa dravyāṇy ātmānam eva ca | prokṣya kūrcena devasya yogapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet || 3.105 abhinne sahaje pīṭhe pratimāyāś caturmukha | ādhāraṃ prathamaṃ kūrmaṃ kālagniṃ tadanantaram || 3.106 upariṣṭāc ca bhogīndraṃ phaṇābhir bhūmimaṇḍalam | caturaśraṃ sahasreṇa bibhrāṇaṃ balavattaram || 3.107 bhuvaś copari dharmādyāḥ kalpyā yogāsanāṅghrayaḥ | āgneyādiṣu catvāraścatasṛṣv eva padmaja || 3.108 adharmādyāś ca tāvantaḥ prāgādiṣu yathākramam | āśāsu tāvatīṣv eva puruṣākṛtayas tathā || 3.109 caturbhujās siṃhavaktrās sitāḥ pūrve 'ruṇāḥ pare | hastābhyām abhimukhyābhyāṃ racitāñjalisampuṭāḥ || 3.110 aparābhyāṃ ca bibhrāṇā hastābhyāṃ yogapīṭhikām | madhye sadāśivo devas tadvad eva pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 3.111 adhastāt puruhūtādyā dikṣu prāgādiṣu kramāt | aṣṭāv aṣṭasu pīṭhasya pādarūpeṇa dhārakāḥ || 3.112 īṣāś catasraḥ pūrvādyāḥ tāsu vedacaduṣṭayam | ahaṅkārās trayaḥ pāśā guṇāḥ sattvādayo guṇāḥ || 3.113 tūlikā pañcabhūtātmā jīvātmā 'staraṇaṃ tathā | agnes somasya sūryasya maṇḍalāny upari kramāt || 3.114 ambhojam upariṣṭāc ca valakṣaṃ dvādaśacchadam | smaret kesarasampūrṇaṃ madhye vipulakarṇikam || 3.115 bhadrāsanaṃ kalpayitvā yathoktenaiva vartmanā | arcayed gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pīṭhapāśve tu dakṣiṇe || 3.116 brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇum īśaṃ ca samārādhya tathottare | sanatkumāraṃ sanakaṃ sanandaṃ ca sabhājayet || 3.117 pārśve tu paścime durgāṃ vighneśaṃ nāradaṃ tathā | ātmanaś ca guruṃ dhyātvā prārabhetācyutārcanam || 3.118 āvāhanapadaṃ pātraṃ prakṣālitam athāmbubhiḥ | pūrayen mūlamantreṇa hastābhyāṃ ca samuddharet || 3.119 lalāṭasamam etasminn antarāvāhya keśavam | mūlabimbādyathā dīpaṃ dīpādavikṛtaṃ tathā || 3.120 caturuccārayen mantramāgacchapadasaṃyutam | tena toyena karmārcāṃ siñcet kūrcena mūrdhani || 3.121 tatra saṃnihitaṃ devaṃ karmārcāyāṃ vicintayet | praṇamya kiñcid utthāya svāgatokter anantaram || 3.122 darśayet pratimāmudrāṃ kalpayitvā ca sannidhim | yāgāvasānikīṃ tatra prārthayeta hareḥ sthitim || 3.123 saṃmukhīkaraṇaṃ kuryāt puṇḍarīkākṣavidyayā | dadyāc ca mūlamantreṇa saparyāsanamāditaḥ || 3.124 yathā dehe tathā deve mantranyāsaṃ samācaret | hastanyāsaṃ vinā śaṃkhacakramudrāṃ prardaśayet || 3.125 nāvāhayed ekabere surasiddhāvatārite | ṛṣibhir manujair vāpi sthāpite niścite harau || 3.126 susthite 'bhimukhībhāvastadevāvāhanaṃ hareḥ | yathāgnimāhitaṃ kuṇḍe yathā vā puruṣaṃ svayam || 3.127 kāle prabodhayed devam arcane bodhayed dharim | kalpanaṃ yogapīṭhasya mantranyasanam eva ca || 3.128 bimbe sthire sadā kāryaṃ pūjārambhe caturmukha | ardhyavastrāmbarākalpaṃ puṣpagandhānulepanaiḥ || 3.129 pradikasthite sthitaṃ dhyāyet pādyācamanayoḥ punaḥ | āsīnaṃ snānakāle ca padmāsanasukhāsane || 3.130 naivedyadhūpadīpādāvāsīnaṃ svastikāsane | upacāreṣu cānyatra tattatkarmānusārataḥ || 3.131 sthitamāsīnam athavā devaṃ dhyāyīta pūjakaḥ | arcayāmīti sāmnā tu kṣipet puṣpāñjaliṃ hareḥ || 3.132 vibho sakalalokeśa viṣṇo jiṣṇo prabho hare | tvāṃ bhaktyā pūjayāmyadya bhogair ardhyādibhiḥ kramāt || 3.133 iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ yajed ardhyādibhiḥ kramāt | bhaktinamreṇa śirasā dadyād ardhyaṃ tu mūrdhani || 3.134 pādāravindayor dadyāt pādyaṃ pādyapratigrahe | dhyāyed ācamanīyasya dānakāle jagadgurum || 3.135 ācāmantamivāmbhobhis sākṣād ambhaḥ pratigrahe | upacaryopacāreṇa madhuparkādinā saha || 3.136 hastābhyāṃ śirasā padbhyāṃ manasā ca hṛdā tathā | ahaṅkāreṇa cātmānaṃ nipātya dharaṇītale || 3.137 anena praṇipātena praṇipatya janārdanam | dāso 'haṃ te jagan nātha saputrādiparigraham || 3.138 preṣyaṃ praśādhi kartavye māṃ niyuṅkṣva hite sadā | iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ paricārān prakalpayet || 3.139 yogāsanābjapatreṣu pūrvādiṣu yathākramam | dvādasa dvādaśasveva śaktīḥ śrīvatsapūrvikāḥ || 3.140 śrīvatsaṃ vanamālāṃ ca māyāṃ yogātmikāṃ tathā | vaiṣṇavīṃ vimalāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ śaktim utkarṣaṇīm api || 3.141 prajñāṃ satyāṃ tatheśānām anukampāṃ pitāmahīm | prathamāvaraṇe cāpi dikṣu prāgādiṣu kramāt || 3.142 vyāptiṃ kāntiṃ ca tṛptiṃ ca śraddhāṃ vidyāṃ jayāṃ kṣamām | śāntiṃ ca śaktim aṣṭaitāḥ dhyātvā cāmaradhāriṇīḥ || 3.143 tato dvitīyāvaraṇe śaṅkhādyāyudhadhāriṇaḥ | puruṣān aṣṭa pūrvādiṣv ānupūrvyeṇa kalpayet || 3.144 tṛtīyāvaraṇe svāsu dikṣv indrādīn prakalpayet | bahirāvaraṇe tārkṣyaṃ bhagavatpramukhaṃ tathā || 3.145 viṣvaksenaṃ tathaiśānyāṃ dvitīyāvaraṇād bahiḥ | parivārā nirīkṣeran sarve prāñjalayo harim || 3.146 dadyāc ca pāduke snātum utthānasamaye hareḥ | idaṃ viṣṇur iti dvābhyāṃ pādukārohaṇaṃ smaret || 3.147 uddharec ca hariṃ snātum uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate | iti mantreṇa deveśaṃ prāpayet snānapīṭhikām || 3.148 mantrais tu bhadraṃ karṇebhir iti snānāsanāsane | sāvitryā vitared ardhyaṃ pādyaṃ trīṇi padeti ca || 3.149 āpaḥ punantv ity etena mantreṇācamanakriyā | dantadhāvanakāṣṭhaṃ ca tadviṣṇor iti nirvapet || 3.150 jihvānirlepanaṃ tatra tadviprāsa iti prabhoḥ | mukhaprakṣālanaṃ dadyād viṣṇugāyatriyā punaḥ || 3.151 abhyaṅgaṃ vāmadevyena kuryād udvartanaṃ punaḥ | kāryaṃ viṣṇornukam iti mantreṇāmalakādinā || 3.152 na te viṣṇo iti dvābhyām abhiṣekavidhis tataḥ | āpohiṣṭheti tisṛbhir ato devā avantv iti || 3.153 kaṅkatena mṛjet keśān kalaśaiḥ snapanaṃ tathā | hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīm ity ālepo haridrayā || 3.154 hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvaketi catasṛbhiḥ | kṣālyo gandhāmbunā dehaḥ punas taṃ kuṅkumena tu || 3.155 ālipya viṣṇugāyatryā kṣālayet pāvamānibhiḥ | brahmajajñānam iti ca kayānaścitra ābhuvat || 3.156 ity evam ardhyapādyād yair yajetādyaṃ maheśvaram | pariṣicya tu sāvitryā sūktena puruṣātmanā || 3.157 sahasradhārayā snānaṃ yadvā kumbhena tad bhavet | agnir mūrdheti mantreṇa plotenāṅgāmbuniḥsṛtiḥ || 3.158 viṣṇugāyatriyā dadyād vastre dve dhautanirmale | praṇavena brahmasūtram uttarīyaṃ ca kalpayet || 3.159 ācāntam anvadhiṣṭhāya pāduke maṇḍanāsane | sukhāsīnāya devāya prāgvadardhyādi nirvapet || 3.160 dhūpenāgarujenārdrān mūrdhānaṃ diva ity ṛcā | keśān saṃśoṣya śucinā candanena sugandhinā || 3.161 idaṃ viṣṇur iti śrutyā lepanaṃ vapuṣas smṛtam | jitaṃ ta iti mantreṇa maṇḍanair api maṇḍayet || 3.162 puṣpāṇi dadyāt tadviṣṇor iti mantreṇa mantravit | irāvatīti mantreṇa pādayor akṣatān kṣipet || 3.163 añjanaṃ viṣṇugāyatryā vyāhṛtyā darpaṇekṣaṇam | jitaṃ ta iti dhūpaiś ca dhūpayed agarūtthitaiḥ || 3.164 uddīpyasveti mantreṇa dīpāropaṇam iṣyate | tilān vastraṃ tathā hema tāmbūlaṃ taṇḍulān api || 3.165 phalāni gavyamāhāraṃ gāś ca dhānyaṃ yathāvasu | gogrāsaṃ deśikāyaiva dadyād devasya sannidhau || 3.166 adhipasya tathā rājño rāṣṭrasya sakalasya ca | prajānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ dānam abhyudayāvaham || 3.167 apanīte yāvanike paṭe bhaktānukampayā | ghoṣayet tūryaghoṣeṇa nṛttaṃ geyaṃ tathācaret || 3.168 stotrāṇi ca kathāś citrā vedān aṅgāni ṣaṭ tathā | paṭheyur agre devasya sarvam anyac ca maṅgalam || 3.169 āsanāt pāduke dattvā gamayed bhojanāsanam | dattvārdhyaṃ pādyamācāmaṃ madhuparkaṃ nivedayet || 3.170 praṇavena tato dadyāt tāmbūlīmāsyaśodhanīm | havir nivedayet siddhaṃ bhojyabhakṣyādikaṃ tathā || 3.171 madhurādirasopetaṃ vidhyuktaṃ susamāhitam | susaṃskṛtaiś ca niṣpannair yuktamannaiḥ phalādibhiḥ || 3.172 apakvair atipakvaiś ca yathāyogaṃ prakalpayet | rājopacāravatsarvam upacāre prakalpite || 3.173 prokṣaṇaṃ cāstramantreṇa pariṣicya ca varmaṇā | praṇavenārhaṇe datte dahanāplāvanādike || 3.174 kṛte ca surabhīmudrāṃ darśayitvā ca deśikaḥ | nyaste 'rdhyapuṣpe saṃspṛṣṭe viṣṇuhaste samādhinā || 3.175 anvārabdhe na savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu | pragṛhītārdhyapuṣpeṇa darśitagrāsamudrayā || 3.176 devasya tveti mantreṇa naivedyaṃ tadyathoditam | devasya dakṣiṇe haste nirvapet sādhakaḥ svayam || 3.177 datte ca pānake haste pānīye ca susaṃskṛte | kṛte cācamane dadyāt tāmbūlīmāsyaśodhanīm || 3.178 kriyākalāpaṃ pūjādau karmārcāyāṃ yadīritam | tatsarvaṃ dhruvaberādau yathāsambhavam ācaret || 3.179 ardhyādiṣūpacāreṣu kartavyeṣu yathātatham | mantrapūrveṣu sarveṣu vācam enām udīrayet || 3.180 divyenārdhyopacāreṇa yathāśakti yathāvidhi | arcayiṣyāmi samaye bhagavantaṃ janārdanam || 3.181 ityādikāmavitathāṃ pūjakaḥ susamāhitaḥ | caturbhir eva gandhādyaiḥ parivārārcanaṃ matam || 3.182 sarvasminn upacāre ca stutyante 'nuṣṭhite punaḥ | japec ca pūjako mantraṃ yathodīritasaṃkhyayā || 3.183 dvādaśākṣaram anyaṃ vā tadante juhuyād bahiḥ | bhūtebhyo balidānaṃ ca kuryān nityaṃ mahotsavam || 3.184 vijñāpya devadeveśaṃ pūjakaḥ praṇamet svayam | ādadītāvaśiṣṭāni pūjāvastūni kṛtsnaśaḥ || 3.185 tair ātmapūjanaṃ kuryāt tuṣyet tenāpi keśavaḥ | mantrair yathoktair ārādhyassūktena puruṣeṇa vā || 3.186 athavā dvādaśārṇādyair mantrair bimbamukhe harim | prapadyate paraṃ śreyo niṣkāmo yadi pūjakaḥ || 3.187 kāmanāyāṃ tu kāmyāni phalāni pratipadyate || 3.188
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde nityayāgavidhir nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
? caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ ? agnikāryavidhiḥ brahmā bhagavann utsavo nityo homaś cāgnau puroditaḥ | sa kathaṃ pūjakaiḥ kāryaḥ kathayasva yathātatham || 4.1 śrībhagavān dvārasthānagnyagārasya caṇḍādīn arcayet kramāt | antaḥ praviśya śakṛdālipte kuṇḍe 'kṣatārcite || 4.2 upaviśyātmanaḥ pārśve dakṣiṇe puṣpabhājanam | anyāni homadravyāṇi vāmapārśve tu nikṣipet || 4.3 ājyapātraṃ carusthālīṃ prokṣaṇīṃ samidhaḥ kuśān | praṇītāṃ taṇḍulāṃstoyaṃ paridhīn sruksruvau tathā || 4.4 darvīm agner viharaṇaṃ vyajanāni ca mokṣaṇam | śuṣkaṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ gandhāṃś ca gandhadravyaṃ ca sākṣatam || 4.5 dvandvāni ca prayojyāni nyañci saty eva sambhave | kuṇḍamadhye tatas tisro rekhāḥ prāgāyatāḥ pṛthak || 4.6 tathodagāyatās tisro likhitvā mūlavidyayā | darbhastambadvayenādbhir abhyukṣyādāya pāvakam || 4.7 mathitaṃ laukikaṃ yadvā nidhāya ca vihṛtya ca | adbhiḥ parisamūhyāgniṃ paristīrya tribhis tribhiḥ || 4.8 prāgagrair udagagraiś ca darbhaiḥ pañcabhir eva vā | saptabhir navabhir vāpi yadvaikādaśasaṃmitaiḥ || 4.9 granthīkṛtāgrair advandvaiḥ pañcaviṃśatiniṣṭhitaiḥ | tatrāgnimadhye 'pāṃ pūrṇāṃ praṇītāmakṣatārcitām || 4.10 nidhāya darbhayugmena kūrcaṃ prādeśasaṃmitam | nirmāyācchādanaṃ tasya tribhir darbhaiḥ pavitritaiḥ || 4.11 kūrcena tena prokṣaṇyāṃ praṇītājalamāvapet | prokṣaṇīmātmanaś cāgre sakūrcaṃ nyasya mantravit || 4.12 aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tatkūrcaṃ tatkarayor dvayoḥ | punar ādhāramutpūya triḥ prokṣya prokṣaṇīṃ punaḥ || 4.13 homadravyāṇi sarvāṇi prokṣayet tena vāriṇā | spṛśec ca tāni dravyāṇi nāmādeśaṃ yathāyatham || 4.14 srāvayet prokṣaṇīvāri prādakṣiṇyena tāṃ punaḥ | kṛtvāmbhaḥpūritāṃ devaṃ praṇītāyāṃ sabhājayet || 4.15 agner dakṣiṇato darbhakūrce tanmayaviṣṭare | āvāhya buddhyā brahmāṇam iṣṭvā prakṣālya vāriṇā || 4.16 viṣṇugāyatriyā sthālīmāḍhakaṃ tatra taṇḍulam | prakṣipya hṛdayādyaṅgaiḥ prakṣālyāgnāvadhiśrapet || 4.17 ājyasthālyāṃ nirūpyājyaṃ drāvitaṃ gālitaṃ tathā | tatra pratyasya darbhāgradvayaṃ mantreṇa mantravit || 4.18 aṅgāreṣu nidhāyāgnau tāṃ dīptenātha bahirṣā | paryagnikuryād uttārya yathāsthānaṃ niveśayet || 4.19 utpūyotplavanaṃ kūrcamadbhiḥ spṛṣṭvā hy uṣarbudhe | prahṛtya cāmṛtīkṛtya ghṛtaṃ surabhimudrayā || 4.20 avakuṇṭhayā ca dikpālān indrādīn pūjayet kramāt | uṣṇodakena prakṣālya sruksruvau kuśapañcakam || 4.21 kūrcamādāya tau tena mūle madhye ca mūrdhani | saṃmṛjya kūrcamūlena madhyenāgreṇa ca kramāt || 4.22 niṣṭapyāgnau nidhātavyau tāv udīcyāmathātmanaḥ | sruveṇājyaṃ samādāya homavastuṣu secayet || 4.23 caruṃ cājyena saṃsicya pārśve tamavaropayet | kevalānnaṃ tathā maudgaṃ pāyasānnaṃ gulodanam || 4.24 caturvidhaś carurjñeyaḥ pākaścullyāmapīṣyate | yādṛṅnivedyate bimbe hotavyaś cāpi tādṛśaḥ || 4.25 udaksaṃsthāḥ paridhayaḥ pratyagārambhaṇās tathā | nidhātavyāḥ śikhīśānakoṇayos samidhau tathā || 4.26 ūrdhve nidhāya manasā dhyāyannidhmān prajāpatim | ekato 'grān sakṛtyañca daśoktān muṣṭimudrayā || 4.27 ādadyād ājyapātraṃ ca kuśakūrcena veṣṭite | vāme kare nidhāyāgnāvādhārāhutim ācaret || 4.28 prājāpatyantathācaindramājyabhāgaṃ tathācaret | āgneyaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge saumyaṃ bhāge tathottare || 4.29 madhye vyāhṛtibhir hutvā smared agnim anantaram | dviśīrṣakaṃ saptahastaṃ tripādaṃ saptajihvakam || 4.30 varadaṃ śaktipāṇiṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ sruksruvau tathā | abhītidaṃ carmadharaṃ vāme cājyadharaṃ kare || 4.31 jihvāyāṃ dakṣiṇe vaktre dhūmrāyāṃ māraṇādikam | lohinyāṃ ca vaśīkāraṃ kālyāṃ karma ca śāntikam || 4.32 sarvasiddhiḥ sphuliṅginyāmānane dakṣiṇetare | viśvarūparasajñāyāmaṇimādimahāphalam || 4.33 karālikā vijayadā puṣṭidā ca manojavā | kārṣṇyaṃ lauhityam etāsāṃ varṇaśśyāmatvam eva ca || 4.34 sphuliṅgarūpaṃ ca tato varṇaḥ sphaṭikasannibhaḥ | tapanīyanibhaḥ prokto jihvāyāmānupūrvaśaḥ || 4.35 tilānādhārasaṃmiśrān juhuyāj jātaśāntaye | aṣṭottaraśataṃ vārān dvādvaśākṣaravidyayā || 4.36 pūrṇāhutyavasāne tu dhyātvā jvalanam arcayet | gandhādyair ātmano dadyād akṣatāni ca varmaṇā || 4.37 pariṣicya jalenāgniṃ tanmadhye yogapīṭhikām | kalpayitvā ca tanmantrair jahuyāt sarpiṣāsakṛt || 4.38 tatrāvatārya hṛdayāc cidrūpaṃ parameśvaram | sakalīkṛtya mantrasya nyāsaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi || 4.39 ardhyapūrvaṃ nivedyānnaṃ juhuyāt sarpiṣā sakṛt | japārthaṃ ca sakṛn mantrair juhuyāt sarpiṣā tataḥ || 4.40 samidbhir vā tilaiḥ puṣpair bījair vāpy athavā phalaiḥ | parivārārtham apy evaṃ sarpiṣā juhuyāt sakṛt || 4.41 ārādhanaṃ harer etat saptārciṣi caturmukha | ārādhanaṃ ced anyatra pratimādāvanantaram || 4.42 juhuyāt samidājyānnair vakṣyamāṇena vartmanā | āyāmas samidhāṃ tālaḥ kaniṣṭhānahanaṃ kramāt || 4.43 carmahīne vināśas syād bhede kṣīṇaṃ kulaṃ bhavet | ārdrāsu bandhunāśas syāt putranāśaḥ purātane || 4.44 kṣatāsu bhāryāmaraṇaṃ kalahāya ca śākhinī | udvegāya bhavet sthūlā hrasvā 'vagrahakāriṇī || 4.45 dīrghātivṛṣṭikariṇī tyājyā doṣayutā samit | śataṃ tadardhaṃ pādo vā samidho 'ṣṭau yathoditāḥ || 4.46 tadardhaṃ vā ghṛtāktāstā juhuyān mūlavidyayā | ājyāvasiktāścaravaḥ pratyṛcaṃ grāsamudrayā || 4.47 nṛsūktena ca hotavyaṃ mūlamantreṇa sarpiṣā | śatādisaṃkhyayā homo dhyātvā paramapūruṣam || 4.48 sruveṇa juhuyād ājyaṃ hastena samidhaḥ punaḥ | caruṃ palāśapatreṇa yadvā hastādinā bhavet || 4.49 kṛtvā pūrṇāhutiṃ pūrvaṃ tataś śāntiṃ prakalpayet | yajñavṛkṣodbhavaiś śāntiḥ saubhāgyaṃ kusumaiś śubhaiḥ || 4.50 dhūpadravyaiḥ sadārogyaṃ puṣṭiṃ dadhnā payaśśuciḥ | annena vividhān kāmānājyenāyuṣmatīḥ prajāḥ || 4.51 śvetapadmais tu juhuyād icchan brahmaśriyaṃ naraḥ | lakṣmīpuṣpais tu juhuyāl lakṣmīkāmo 'tha vāruṇaiḥ || 4.52 padmair bilvasamidbhir vā jñānakāmas tu sarpiṣā | kanyākāmaḥ kālapuṣpaiḥ gokāmo gomayaiḥ punaḥ || 4.53 āyuṣkāmas tu dūrvābhir bhūmikāmas tu mṛtsnayā | yavair vendriyakāmas tu tilaiḥ sarvajanapriyaḥ || 4.54 brahmavarcasakāmas tu brahmavṛkṣasamudbhavaiḥ | veṇubhiś ca yavaiś caiva nīvāraiś śālijais tathā || 4.55 sarve kāmāḥ prasiddhyanti homabījair yathoditaiḥ | lājahomena siddhyanti sarve kāmā na saṃśayaḥ || 4.56 annair annādikāmas tu putrakāmas tu pāyasaiḥ | nimbapuṣpair hiraṇyārthī sarvaṃ siddhyati sarpiṣā || 4.57 home sarpir madhukṣīradhārā syāc caturaṅgulā | śuktir dadhyāhutir grāsaṃ pāyasādyāhutir bhavet || 4.58 bhakṣyāhutis tadardhaṃ syāt phalaiḥ puṣpair akhaṇḍitaiḥ | niṣpāvabījamānā tu dhūpadravyāhutir bhavet || 4.59 tilavrīhiyavādyais tu muṣṭyardhārdhāhutiḥ kramāt | aṣṭāṅgulā tadardhā vā samiddūrvā ṣaḍaṅgulā || 4.60 mṛdvīkākṣapramāṇā tu gomayāhutir iṣyate | pūrṇāhutir ghṛtasya syāt kuḍupena caturmukha || 4.61 nyūnādhikapramāṇaṃ tu havyakavyāhutiṃ kṛtām | bhuñjanti dānavā daityāḥ na phalāya ca kalpyate || 4.62 kukkuṭāṇḍapramāṇaṃ tu caroḥ piṇḍaṃ ghṛtāplutam | nikṣipya ca srucorgarte 'bhighārya sruveṇa ca || 4.63 sasamiddarbhakusumaṃ juhuyān mūlavidyayā | prāyaścittārthamājyena pañcopaniṣadā punaḥ || 4.64 srucamājyena saṃpūrya sadarbhaṃ samidhānvitam | uddhṛtya nāsikāgrāntam abhighārya sruveṇa ca || 4.65 juhuyān mūlamantreṇa pūrṇāhutyā tu sādhakaḥ | srucaṃ jalena saṃpūrya bahiḥ kuṇḍāt pradakṣiṇam || 4.66 secayed vāriśeṣaṃ tu ninayec chirasi svayam | bhasmanā tilakaṃ kṛtvā harim agnes samutsṛjet || 4.67 gṛhītvārdhyaṃ pradadyāc ca dhāmni devāya pūjakaḥ | bhaktyā yadagnau vihitaṃ yathāśakti yathāvidhi || 4.68 ārādhanaṃ tad eveti gṛhāṇa parameśvara | agnikāryavidhir hy eṣas saṃkṣepāt kathito mayā || 4.69 vidhinānena yaḥ kuryād agnikāryaṃ dine dine | sa yāti brāhmaṇassthānaṃ bhuktvā bhogāny athepsitān || 4.70
iti śrīpañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde agnikāryavidhir nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ
? pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
nityotsavasamārādhanakālavibhāgaḥ śrībhagavān uvāca atha nityotsavavidhiṃ kathayāmi caturmukha | sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvabhūtapraharṣaṇam || 5.1 rājño rāṣṭrasya grāmasya yajamānasya sadmanaḥ | sukhāvahaṃ śāntikaraṃ puṇyamāyurvivardhanam || 5.2 āvāhya tanḍule śuddhe pātrasthe parameśvaram | śaktibhir daśabhir dvābhyāṃ saha prātardine dine || 5.3 parikramedāyatanaṃ madhyāhne tvannakalpite | sāyaṃ kusumasaṃghāte trisandhyaṃ triṣu kalpayet || 5.4 bimbena vātha paridhau trisandhyam anuvāsaram | athavānnena madhyāhne kāle 'nyatra dvaye 'rcanā || 5.5 trisandhyam athavānnena kuryān nityotsavaṃ hareḥ | madhyandine vā sarvārthaṃ parikramya baliṃ kṣipet || 5.6 yadvotsavapratikṛter anvagagre 'thavā nayet | trisandhyaṃ cāmarac chatravitānadhvajasaṃyutam || 5.7 taṇḍulādikamannaṃ vā kevalaṃ kamalāsana | pañcāvaraṇake dhāmni pañcasvāvaraṇeṣv api || 5.8 baliṃ dattvā paryaṭanaṃ geyavādyapurassaram | utsavaṃ prāhur utkṛṣṭaṃ tadūnaṃ madhyamaṃ viduḥ || 5.9 hīne 'dhamaṃ jaghanyaṃ tannyūne kṣudram athetare | balipradānena vinā notsavo 'bhyudayāvahaḥ || 5.10 śuklāmbaradharaṃ saumyaṃ śuklayajñopavītinam | sottarīyaṃ ca soṣṇīṣaṃ svanuliptam alaṅkṛtam || 5.11 paricārakamāhūya bhāvitaṃ garuḍātmanā | tanmūrdhani ca vā pṛṣṭhe taṇḍule 'nne prasūnake || 5.12 devam āvāhayen mūlaberādārādhakas svayam | iṣṭvā ca gandhapuṣpādyais tatra devaṃ yathāvidhi || 5.13 viśvādimūrtīś ca punaḥ pūjayitvā pradakṣiṇam | prāgādyeṣu dvādaśasu pātrastheṣu daleṣu ca || 5.14 sūktaṃ sarvaṃ svastyayanaṃ tathānyac cāpi maṅgalam | paṭhan pātraṃ ca bibhrāṇo vrajec ca paricārakaḥ || 5.15 caṇḍapracaṇḍapramukhān dvārapālān prapūjayet | ghoṣayen maṭṭatālādyaiḥ balidānapurassaram || 5.16 nṛttaṃ ca vaijayantī syād ṛṣabhaṃ goyam iṣyate | vitānadhavalacchatracāmaravyajanādibhiḥ || 5.17 paribhrameta balyarthaṃ sarvānāvaraṇān kramāt | pīṭhaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praviśed ālayaṃ punaḥ || 5.18 taṃ ca pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praviśed garbhamandiram | dattvārdhyaṃ mūlamantreṇa mūlabere samutsṛjet || 5.19 baliśeṣaṃ kṣipet kiñcid viṣvaksenasya mūrdhani | pariśiṣṭaṃ mahāpīṭhe nikṣiped akṣatādikam || 5.20 nityotsavaś ced bimbena tadbimbaṃ śibikādiṣu | āropya yadvā śirasi paribhramaṇam iṣyate || 5.21 ātodyanṛttair bahudhā vādyamānais samedhitam | tatra nṛttaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tāni vakṣye samāsataḥ || 5.22 vilāsaṃ kartarī viṣṇukrāntamālīḍhamaṅgale | bhadramālī tārkṣyapakṣau karaṇaṃ svastikāhvayam || 5.23 cārī pracārī sūcī ca sāvartaṃ pāribhadrakam | saumyaṃ viṣamasūcī ca kheṭakaṃ cāvakuñcitam || 5.24 kaṭibandham alaṅkāram aśmarī piṣṭakuṭṭimam | ullaṃghī vāmajānvākhyamāsurī cāpaveṣṭitam || 5.25 vāsaveśvarasañcāribhāvau <�saṃcāri�> syātāṃ nikuṭṭimau | kuṭṭimaṃ ghaṭitaṃ sthāyibhāvo yac ca vijṛmbhitam || 5.26 maṇḍalaṃ kṛṣitārdhādi[kuñcitārdhendu] patākā sarvamaṅgalam | kāntārakuṭṭimāhvānaṃ prapūrvaṃ ghaṭitaṃ tathā || 5.27 vilāsaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ śuddhaṃ kuñcitam iṣyate | mārgacārī karādhīnamāvabhāsam anantaram || 5.28 āveṣṭitaṃ parīvartaṃ nirdhūtaṃ deśimaṇḍalam | samapūrvaṃ ca ghaṭitaṃ padaṃ viṣam apūrvakam || 5.29 karkarī vikalāsaś ca bhaved vigalitaṃ tathā | atra bhedāḥ pṛthag bhāvā gātrāvayavaceṣṭitaiḥ || 5.30 ātodyagītibhedānāmānantyānneha tanyate | puṣpaprabhāsamopetaṃ dhvajacchatrādisaṃyutam || 5.31 sarvavāditrasubhagaṃ sarvagoyasamanvitam | brahmavid brahmaghoṣeṇa sahitaṃ dīpasaṅkulam || 5.32 viṣṇukrāntaṃ khageśasya nṛttaṃ geyaṃ ca madhyamam | vilāsaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kheṭakaṃ cakramaṇḍalam || 5.33 kāntāra kuṭṭimaṃ pṛṣṭikuṭṭimaṃ kaṭibandhanam | vāmajānūrdhvanṛttaṃ ca puruhūtādiṣu smṛtam || 5.34 ṣaḍjarṣabhau ca gāndhāro madhyamaḥ pañcamas tathā | dhaivataś ca niṣādaś ca puruhūtādiṣu svarāḥ || 5.35 sapta jñeyā dhaivatas tu bhavasya svara iṣyate | nṛttaṃ ca viṣvaksenasya svastikaṃ ṛṣabhasvaraḥ || 5.36 hastinṛttaṃ gaṇeśasya svaraḥ pañcama iṣyate | dhaivataṃ syāt svaro nṛttaṃ durgāyās sarvamaṅgalam || 5.37 anyeṣām api devānāṃ nṛttaṃ syāt sarvamaṅgalam | gānaṃ ca dhaivataṃ proktaṃ gāndhāraṃ pañcamaṃ tathā || 5.38 tadavāntara bhede vā geyāgeyavicakṣaṇaiḥ | samatālāhvayaṃ vādyamaindcāṃ diśi havir bhujaḥ || 5.39 baddhāvatālābhidhānaṃ yamasya diśi bhṛṅgiṇī | naiṛtyāṃ maṭṭatālaṃ syād vāruṇyāṃ maṅgalāhvayam || 5.40 vāyavyāṃ jayatālākhyaṃ kauberyāṃ bhadrasaṃjñitam | aiśānyāṃ ḍhakkarītālaṃ tārkṣyasya garuḍāhvayam || 5.41 bhūtānāṃ balitālākhyaṃ seneśasyāpi tādṛśam | anyeṣām api devānāṃ tālaṃ bhadraṃ praśasyate || 5.42 dikṣu sarvāsu sarveṣu mandirāvaraṇeṣu ca | nṛttaṃ geyaṃ vādyaṃ ca sākalyena samīritam || 5.43 svagadhvajaṃ darśayitvā maṅgalāṣṭakam eva ca | sannidhāne ca devasya sarvatra balir iṣyate || 5.44 nivedya tatra tāmbūlaṃ bhakṣyaṃ ca pṛthukādikam | sarveṣv āvaraṇeṣv evaṃ sthānaṃ prati samācaret || 5.45 kevalāmbujanādena prākāradvāri nirgamaḥ | nirgatya ca mahāpīṭhe mandirābhimukhaṃ sthitaḥ || 5.46 dikṣu sarvāsu pīṭhasya vāditre ghoṣite bhṛśam | kṣālite pīṭhikāmūrdhni pūjayed viṣṇupārṣadān || 5.47 baliṃ niravaśeṣeṇa dattvā pīṭhasya mūrdhani | pīṭhaṃ parītya dhāmāntaḥ praviśya mukhamaṇṭape || 5.48 pradāya pāduke pīṭhe yānāderavaropya ca | prāṅmukhaṃ viṣṭare devam avasthāpya sabhājayet || 5.49 upahāram aśeṣeṇa pradāyāvasarocitam | praveśayed garbhagehaṃ devam ārādhakas svayam || 5.50 vādye geye tathā nṛtte bahir aṅgaṇabhūmiṣu | nyūnībhāvaṃ samādhātuṃ śuddhatāṇḍavam ācaret || 5.51 mahāvātādisaṃkṣobhe na nityotsavam ācaret | balipradānamātraṃ ca kuryāc ca sati sambhave || 5.52 baliṃ caṇḍapracaṇḍe tu kevalaṃ vā vinikṣipet | tayor madhye tu purato mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ || 5.53 bhūtebhyo nama ity evaṃ vikṣipet sodakaṃ balim | ārādhanavidhir hy eṣu kālabhedeṣu śasyate || 5.54 ahri rātrau ca tān brahmann adhunā kathayāmi te | ekas trayo vā ṣaḍ vāpi kālo dvādaśa eva vā || 5.55 pañcakālaś catuṣkālas tatkālo bahudhā mataḥ | yathāvibhavam uddiṣṭaṃ samārādhanakarmaṇi || 5.56 eko madhyāhnasamayaḥ prātarmadhyandinaṃ niśā | trayaś cet ṣaṭsu pūrve syuḥ kālabhedāḥ punas trayaḥ || 5.57 madhyarātro 'parāhṇaś ca tathā pratyūṣa īritaḥ | pratyūṣaś cārdharātraṃ ca prātarmadhyandinaṃ niśā || 5.58 pañca kālā ime proktās tataḥ kālacatuṣṭayam | eteṣu hīnaḥ pratyūṣo vijñeyaś caturānana || 5.59 kālā dvādaśa vijñeyāḥ pañca pañca ca nāḍikāḥ | itare kālabhedāḥ syuḥ pratyekaṃ yāmasaṃmitāḥ || 5.60 utsavāvasitaṃ śreṣṭham ārādhanam udāhṛtam | homāntaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ prāpaṇāntam athādhamam || 5.61 kṣudraṃ ca dhūpadīpamadham ārādhanaṃ hareḥ | ghaṭike dve bhavet snāne ghaṭikaikārcane bhavet || 5.62 nṛtte geye tathā caikā tadardhena nivedanam | homaś caikā cotsave dve śuddhanṛttāvasānike || 5.63 prahārakālapūjāyāṃ snānādividhirīdṛśaḥ | ghaṭikāsnānasamayas tathārdhaghaṭikārcanam || 5.64 geyaṃ nṛttaṃ ca ghaṭikā tadardhena nivedanam | homārdhe pariśiṣṭārdhaṃ bhaven nityotsavakriyā || 5.65 kālabhedeṣu sarveṣu śreṣṭhaṃ kālatrayaṃ viduḥ | prātarmadhyandinaṃ rātrir mukhyaṃ ca kamalāsana || 5.66 avaśyambhāvinau teṣu balinityotsavāv ubhau | homaparyantam anyatra kālabhedeṣu śasyate || 5.67 utsavādyaṅgabimbāni senānyaṃ vihageśvaram | caṇḍapracaṇḍau dvārasthau sarvakāleṣu pūjayet || 5.68 madhyandine pradoṣe ca purastād vādyavādanam | nīrājayet pradoṣeṣu evaṃ tad api kathyate || 5.69 svarṇapātrāṇi yugmāni vipulāni yathāvasu | tanmadhye śālipṛṣṭheṣu vartidīpān pradīpayet || 5.70 tathāvidhāni pātrāṇi karair uddhutya yoṣitaḥ | kalyāṇavastrābharaṇā nirgatāś ca mahānasāt || 5.71 śreṇībaddhāḥ purogītanṛttavādyasamanvitāḥ | antike devadevasya vinyaseyur mahītale || 5.72 ādhāreṣu tataḥ pātrāṇy arcayed viśvavidyayā | ācāryo dhruvaberādau aṅganyāsaṃ samācaret || 5.73 iṣṭvā ca devam ardhyādyair dīpapātrāṇi pūjakaḥ | uddhṛtya bhrāmayed devamāpādatalamastakam || 5.74 guṇamantrais tribhiḥ pātrānyanu yoṣitsu nikṣipet | arcanām evam anyatra pātrāṇy ekaikaśaḥ kramāt || 5.75 bhrāmayed dhruvaberasya yadvā sarvāṇi padmaja | evaṃ nīrājanaṃ dadyāt śrībhūmyor iṣyate pṛthak || 5.76 nīrājane tanyamāne tūryaghoṣam udīrayet | nṛttagītaprakārāṃś ca kuryur vārapurandhrayaḥ || 5.77 dīpapātrāṇi sarvāṇi balipīṭhe samutsṛjet | nityotsavaṃ nadīsnānaṃ vidhāyārcanam anyataḥ || 5.78 ardharātre tu saṃprāpte kṛtvā snānādikaṃ hareḥ | śuddhapāyasamudgānnamapūpādihaviḥ kramāt || 5.79 gokṣīraṃ sitakhaṇḍādi madhuraṃ ca nivedayet | bhāskarasyodayātpūrvaṃ bahavassūtamāgadhāḥ || 5.80 prabodhayeyur deveśaṃ stuvanto vādyavādanaiḥ | rātrau bimbeṣu sarveṣu kuryān nīrājanaṃ hareḥ || 5.81 rājopacāravatsarvam upacāraṃ pradarśayet | ahni rātrau ca ye proktāḥ kālabhedāś caturmukha || 5.82 jaghanyamukhyabhedena teṣu itthaṃ harim arcayet |
iti śrī pañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde nityotsavasamārādhanakālavibhāgo nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ
? ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ ?
nṛsūktopacāranīrājanavidhiḥ brahmā sūktasyāṅgeṣu bhagavan pauruṣasya kathaṃ bhavet | nyāsaḥ kathaṃ vā tena tvāṃ arcayāmi kathaṃ [prabho] || 6.1 pṛcchataḥ saṃśayānasya gṛhārcanavidhiḥ katham | yāthātathyena vaktavyo mayi ced asty anugrahaḥ || 6.2 śrībhagavān uvāca chando 'nuṣṭubṛṣis tasya vāsudevas sa devatā | mūrdhni phāle nayanayor nāsikāyāṃ tathā mukhe || 6.3 gale bāhvoś ca hṛdaye nābhāvaṅge ca mehane | ūrvoś caraṇayor nyāsaḥ prathamādyā ṛcaḥ kramāt || 6.4 ādyayā ''vāhayed devam āsanaṃ ca dvitīyayā | pādyaṃ tṛtīyayā cārdhyaṃ caturthyā vitared ṛcā || 6.5 pañcamyācamanaṃ snānaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā saptamyā cāmbaram | upavītamṛcāṣṭamyā navamyā gandhalepanam || 6.6 puṣpaṃ daśamyaikādaśyā dvādaśyā dhūpadīpakau | nivedanaṃ trayodaśyā caturdaśyā namaskṛtiḥ || 6.7 pradakṣiṇaṃ pañcadaśyā ṣoḍaśyodvāsanaṃ bhavet | samidannājyahomāś ca pratyṛcaṃ jātavedasi || 6.8 svagṛhe pūjayed viṣṇuṃ śucau deśe gṛhe kvacit | sthale ratnamaye dhyātvā vimāne ca tathāvidhe || 6.9 apsvagnau hṛdaye sūrye sthaṇḍile pratimāsu ca | puṣpodapātramādāya tiṣṭhannāvāhayed dharim || 6.10 oṃpūrvābhir vyāhṛtibhiḥ pratyekaṃ puruṣottamam | vyastābhiś ca samastābhir vedādyenāsanaṃ tataḥ || 6.11 pātrasthamambhassāvitryā abhimantrya pavitrakam | tadardhyaṃ viṣṇugāyatryā dadyāt trīṇi padeti ca || 6.12 pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca praṇavena prakalpayet | mantraiḥ snapanamabliṅgair aṅgañca vimṛjet tataḥ || 6.13 vyāhṛtyā plotavastreṇa jitaṃ ta iti vidyayā | vāso vidyādinā dadyād upavītaṃ ca lepanam || 6.14 idaṃ viṣṇur iti procya praṇavena prasādhanam | tadviṣṇor iti puṣpāṇi jitaṃ ta iti dhūpakam || 6.15 uddīpyasveti dīpaṃ ca devasya tveti vai haviḥ | vāsudevādimantraiś ca matsyādyaiḥ keśavādibhiḥ || 6.16 puṣpāṇi dattvā dhyātvā ca tāṃ tāṃ mūrtiṃ yathāyatham | caturmukhādidevānāṃ parivāratayārcanam || 6.17 na svātantryeṇa yaṣṭavyaḥ vaiṣṇavena gṛrhācane | japakāle nṛsūktaṃ vā dvādaśākṣaram eva vā || 6.18 aṣṭākṣaraṃ vā yadvānyaṃ mantraṃ praṇavam eva vā | japet samāhitamanā yadvā trayyantagocarān || 6.19 yo nityaṃ pūjayed viṣṇuṃ gṛhastho veśmani svayam | sa nayet svakulodbhūtān puruṣān ekaviṃśatim || 6.20 viṣṇoḥ padaṃ vā sālokyaṃ yadvā 'nyad api vāñchitam | upacārā hareradya saparyāvidhigocarāḥ || 6.21 aṣṭottaraśataṃ viṃśacchrutā ye manmukhodgatāḥ | āvāhanaṃ namaskāraṃ pratyutthānam anantaram || 6.22 puṣpāñjalissvāgatoktirāsanaṃ pādapīṭhikā | ardhyaṃ pādyaṃ pratigrāhaḥ pādyaṃ plotābhimarśanam || 6.23 ālepanaṃ caraṇayoś candanakṣodavāriṇā | apāmācamanīyānāṃ pratigrahaṇadarśanam || 6.24 upasparśanamālepaś candanādyambucarcayā | puṣpamālā dhūpadānaṃ madhuparkanivedanam || 6.25 ghanasāro nāgavallī snānaviṣṭaragocarāḥ | pāduke snānapīṭhaṃ ca snānaśāṭakamanvataḥ || 6.26 dantakāṣṭham athādarśo jihvānirlekhapaṭṭikā | tāmbūlavīṭikā vastra parārdhaprasāritam || 6.27 abhyaṅgo maulimālā ca tālavṛntam anantaram | candanaiś carcanaṃ tanvā gandhāmalakavāribhiḥ || 6.28 kaṅkataṃ rajanīsnānaṃ vastraṃ gandhānulepanam | uttarīyaṃ pavitraṃ ca nṛttaṃ geyam anantaram || 6.29 pādyaṃ daśaśatacchidraiḥ snānaṃ dhārābhirambhasām | nīrājanaṃ śikhāplotamuṣṇīṣaṃ plotavāsasā || 6.30 aṅgābhimarśanaṃ vastram upavītam anantaram | uttarīyaṃ triṃśad ete kathitāḥ kamalāsana || 6.31 alaṅkārāsanasthasya hares tatkālagocarāḥ | upānahau śirastrāṇaṃ pītakauśeyadhāraṇam || 6.32 karpūrarajasā lepamāpādatalamastakam | kastūrikā mṛgamadaścandanenānulepanam || 6.33 vyajanaṃ cāmaravyūhaḥ kuṅkumenānulepanam | gandhaṃ ca kṛtrimā bhūṣā brahmasūtraprakalpanā || 6.34 uttarīyaṃ maulimālā bāhumālāvilambanam | mṛtsnayā tilakaṃ kuryād añjanaṃ ca śalākayā || 6.35 puṣpāvikiraṇaṃ brahman mahādarśapradarśanam | tāmbūlikā dhūpadīpau śālitaṇḍulapātrikā || 6.36 svādhyāyādhyayanaṃ dānaṃ nāṭyaṃ veṇuninādanam | vīṇādivādanaṃ pāṭho maṅgalānām anantaram || 6.37 nīrājanaṃ ca piṇḍānāṃ pañcānāṃ kṣepaṇaṃ diśi | yātrāsanopacārāstu hares tatkālagocarāḥ || 6.38 upānahau cāmarāṇi muktātapanivāraṇam | mayūrapiñchavyajanaṃ tālavṛntaṃ ratho gajaḥ || 6.39 aśvaś ca śibikāyānaṃ vainateyadhvajonnatiḥ | krīḍāyaṣṭiś ca tāmbūlī krīḍāphalasamṛddhayaḥ || 6.40 evaṃ pañcadaśa proktā yātrāsanagatāḥ pare | bhojanāsanamārūḍhe harau tatkālagocarāḥ || 6.41 madhuparkaṃ ca tāmbūlavīṭikā mukhaśāṭikā | arhaṇāmbhaḥ pāyasānnaṃ mudgānnañca guḍodanam || 6.42 dadhyodanaṃ pānakaṃ ca pānīyaṃ hastaśāṭikam | śuddhiś ca karayorelā candanākṣodavāriṇā || 6.43 sukhāsīne ca dāśārhe candanodakacarcayā | aṅgeṣv ālepanaṃ mālyamapūpapṛthukās tathā || 6.44 saktavastilapiṇḍāś ca phalāni kvathitaṃ jalam | nālikerāmbudānaṃ ca tāmbulīdalavīṭikā || 6.45 pradakṣiṇanamaskāras stutirātmanivedanam | ardhyamudvāsanaṃ caite śatāṣṭottaraviṃśatiḥ || 6.46 upacārā harer brahman vistareṇa pradarśitāḥ | āvāhananamaskārau saparyāsanamanvataḥ || 6.47 pādapīṭhaṃ tathaivārdhyaṃ pādyādīnāṃ pratigrahaḥ | pādyamācamanīyāmbhaḥ pratigrahaṇam eva ca || 6.48 ācāmo mukhavāsaś ca pāduke snānaviṣṭaram | snānaśāṭī dantakāṣṭhaṃ jihvānirlekhanaṃ tathā || 6.49 tāmbūlābhyañjanaṃ caiva vyajanaṃ cāṅgapeṣaṇam | gandhāmalakajaṃ snānaṃ kaṅkatena viśodhanam || 6.50 rajanīcarcayā snānam uttarīyapariṣkṛtiḥ | vāridhārāsahasreṇa snānaṃ nīrājanaṃ tathā || 6.51 plotābhimarśanaṃ vāso brahmasūtraprakalpanam | uttarīyam alaṅkāraviṣṭaraṃ keśaśoṣaṇam || 6.52 paridhānaṃ dukūlena gandhadravyavilepanam | vyajanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ mālā puṣpāṇāṃ nayanāñjanam || 6.53 tāmbūlaṃ darpaṇaṃ dhūpadīpau mātrāparivyayaḥ | dānaṃ nīrājanaṃ chatramupānaccāmaraṃ dhvajāḥ || 6.54 vāhanaṃ śibikāyānaṃ tūryaṃ krīḍā phalaṃ tathā | bhojanāsanasamprāptir madhuparkanivedanam || 6.55 arhaṇaṃ prāpaṇādīni pānīyaṃ sukhaviṣṭaraṃ | nivedanamapūpādestāmbūlī stotraśaṃsanam || 6.56 visarjanam iti brahman ṣaṣṭiś ca caturuttarā | upacārānatho vakṣye dvātriṃśat tu yathātatham || 6.57 āvāhanāsane paścād ardhyaṃ pādyam anantaram | ācāmo mukhavāsaś ca pāduke dantadhāvanam || 6.58 jihvānirlekhanaṃ tailaṃ dhātrttyā snānaṃ haridrayā | vāsaś caivottarīyaṃ ca gandhālepaś ca bhūṣaṇam || 6.59 mālā 'ñjanaṃ tathādarśadānaṃ dhūpaś ca dīpikā | mātrādānam atha cchatraṃ cāmaraṃ tūryaghoṣaṇam || 6.60 madhuparkārhaṇaṃ caiva nivedanam anantaram | bhakṣyaṃ tathā nāgavallī visarjanam athāntimam || 6.61 upacārāḥ ṣoḍaśa syur ātmanaś śaktyapekṣayā | āvāhanāsane pūrvam arghyaṃ pādyam anantaram || 6.62 upasparśas tathā snānaṃ vastraṃ yajñopavītakam | gandhālepas tathā bhūṣā mālā dhūpaḥ pradīpikā || 6.63 madhūparkaṃ prāpaṇaṃ ca visarjanam athāntimam | āsaneṣu ca sarveṣu pādyaṃ pādyapratigrahaḥ || 6.64 pādaplotaś caraṇayor gandhālepaś caturmukha | ācāmaś ca tadambūnāṃ pratigrahaṇam iṣyate || 6.65 bhojyayātrāsane tyaktvā kartavyaṃ pādaviṣṭaram | upakramoparamayor madhuparkanivedanan || 6.66 bhojanānte ca vastrasya paridhāne tathāplave | jihvānirlekhanānte ca sarvatrācamanakriyā || 6.67 nivedane ca vastrāṇāṃ keśānāṃ śoṣaṇe tathā | ghaṇṭānādaṃ vinā dhūpo na vinānyatra ghaṇṭayā || 6.68 dīpopacāre naivedye ghaṇṭāsvananam anyathā | vibhavānāṃ kṣayasthāne syāc ca pūjā ''surī kṛtā || 6.69 nirlekhanaṃ trisandhyāyāṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca nikṣipet | upasparśanavārīṇāṃ pratigrahaṇabhājane || 6.70 bhakṣaṇādyannapānānte vāsasā hastamārjanam | tathāñjanaṃ nayanayormārjanaṃ vāsasā bhavet || 6.71 arhaṇaṃ bhojane dadyān na pānādau kadācana | parasya sūkṣmasya tathā sthūlasya tadanantaram || 6.72 cintāsaṅkramaṇaṃ tasya bimbe pratyudgamas tathā | svāgatoktir namaskāras sāṃnidhyaprārthanā tathā || 6.73 ity āvāhanam aṣṭāṅgaṃ parasya paramātmanaḥ | ratneṣu sphaṭike svarṇe rajate tāmraje 'pi vā || 6.74 kṣaṇike cārcayed devam āvāhya vidhipūrvakam | cakrābjamaṇḍalaṃ kumbhaṃ sodakaṃ sūtraveṣṭitam || 6.75 bījaṃ piṣṭaṃ tathaivānnaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ tathā | gandhaṃ vediḥ śakṛtkūrcam ityādi kṣaṇikaṃ matam || 6.76 ālaye sthāpitaṃ devaṃ sadā nīrājayed dharim | sampūrṇamambhasā kumbhaṃ hemādidravyanirmitam || 6.77 sragviṇaṃ sapidhānaṃ ca mukhe 'śvatthadalair yutam | akṣatair arcitaṃ gandhavāriṇā 'bhyukṣitaṃ tathā || 6.78 catuṣṭayāṅgulotsedhaṃ dīpavartivirājitam | uccairādāya hastābhyāmāpādatalamastakam || 6.79 triḥparibhrāmya deveśaṃ balipīṭhe vinikṣipet | etannīrājanaṃ ghoraśāntyarthaṃ puṣṭivardhanam || 6.80
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde nṛsūktopacāranīrājanavidhir nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ
? saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
maṇḍapārādhanācāryābhiṣekavidhi
brahmovāca bhagavān kathyatāṃ kīdṛk cakrābjaṃ nāma maṇḍalam | yadārādhyaṃ samārādhya taranti bhavavāridhim || 7.1 śrībhagavān caturbhir yājñikaiḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaghanaiś śubhaiḥ | dvādaśāṅgulavistārair ākāraṃ caturaśrakam || 7.2 maṇḍalānuguṇāyāmavistāraṃ parikalpayet | aṣṭatālāyatān stambhān suvṛttāṃś caturas tathā || 7.3 sannikṛṣṭasya koṇeṣu caturṣv etasya maṅgalān | sthāpayed upariṣṭāc ca stambhānāṃ sanniveśayet || 7.4 catvāri caiva dārūṇi yathā pūrvoktalakṣaṇam | tañcatuṣkaṃ ca dārūṇāṃ vitānadhvajamālayā || 7.5 bhūṣayet parito muktādāmāni ca vilambayet | śuddhayā ca mṛdā 'dhastāc catuṣkoṣṭhasya cāntaram || 7.6 pūrayed antaraṃ tasya gomayenopalepayet | cakrābjādīni bimbāni kuryāt tatra mahītale || 7.7 teṣām āyāmavistārāviṣyete hastasaṃmitau | dviguṇau triguṇau vāpi sthātām atha caturguṇau || 7.8 yadvā pañcaguṇau brahmannavakāśānusārataḥ | candanārdrāṇi sūtrāṇi prāñci saptadaśa kṣitau || 7.9 nipātayet tathodañci tāvanti kamalāsana | ṣaṭpañcāśatsamadhike santy eva dve śate punaḥ || 7.10 koṣṭhāni santi tatrāntaṣṣaṭtriṃśatkoṣṭhamadhyataḥ | sthāpayitvā tataś śaṅkuṃ bhrāmayet sūtravartmanā || 7.11 pañcavṛttāni bimbāni samāny ekaṃ tu madhyamam | karṇikākṣetram etasmād bahirbimbaṃ tridhā punaḥ || 7.12 vibhajya sūtramārgeṇa prathamā kesarāvaniḥ | dalabhūmir dvitīyā tu tṛtīyā nābhimaṇḍalam || 7.13 tadekaṃ dvividhaṃ vāpi trividhaṃ sūtravartmanā | vibhajen nābhibhūbhāgād bahir dve maṇḍale bhavet || 7.14 arakṣetraṃ bahir nemibhūr ekaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhavet | koṣṭhair athāṣṭaviṃśatyā parito bahirāsanam || 7.15 caturaśraṃ bhavet koṣṭhair aśītyā vīthikā bahiḥ | paṅktidvayena viśvātman caturaśrād bahiḥ punaḥ || 7.16 koṣṭhāni dvādaśādhikyaṃ śataṃ paṅktir dvayor bhavet | pratyāśaṃ teṣu koṣṭheṣu caturdvāraṃ prakalpayet || 7.17 koṣṭhaiś caturbhiḥ pratyekaṃ dvayoḥ paṅktyoś caturmukha | caturṣu koṇeṣu tathā pratyekaṃ śaṃkhasiddhaye || 7.18 koṣṭhadvayaṃ tu saṃmārjyaṃ dvayoḥ paṅktyoś caturmukha | pratidvāraṃ tadabhyarṇe pārśvayor ubhayor api || 7.19 ardhaśobhāprasiddhyarthaṃ bāhyānantarathyayoḥ | dve dve koṣṭhe bahiḥ paṃktyām ekaikaṃ tadanantare || 7.20 saṃmārjyam evaṃ śobhārtham ekaikaṃ bahir anyataḥ | trīṇi trīṇi ca koṣṭhāni mārjanīyāni padmaja || 7.21 upaśobhārtham apy evaṃ vyatyāsena catuṣṭayam | saṃmārjanīyaṃ koṣṭhānāṃ viniyogaḥ pradarśitaḥ || 7.22 yadvā pīṭhādinirmāṇaṃ vinā koṣṭhāni viṃśatiḥ | śatadvayaṃ ca paritaḥ parimṛjya caturmukha || 7.23 ādipadmapramāṇena kuryād āvaraṇatrayam | caturdiśaṃ caturdvārakalpanaṃ padmamānataḥ || 7.24 yadvaikavalayaṃ kuryād abhīṣṭadiśi padmaja | dvādaśābjāni kalpyāni pratyāvaraṇakalpanam || 7.25 caturṣu koṇeṣv ekaikaṃ dve dve valayapārśvayoḥ | dalair dvādaśabhir yuktaṃ karṇikākesarānvitam || 7.26 ādipadmārdhamānena padmajātaṃ prakalpayet | madhyame paṅkaje bindūn karṇikāyāṃ prakalpayet || 7.27 dvādaśābjajarekhāś ca śataṃ ca navatiṃ tathā | kesarāṇāṃ vidhāyānvagdalakṣetre prakalpayet || 7.28 vidikṣu dikṣu ca tathā catasro viṃśatiṃ tathā | rekhe dve dve dalāni syus sūcyagravadanantare || 7.29 pradarśayed upadalāny arakṣetre diśaḥ prati | are dve dve vidikṣu syād ekaikaṃ dvādaśāratā || 7.30 arāṇīndīvaradalais tulyāny abjapalāśavat | yadvā yavodarābhāni mātuluṅgasamāni ca || 7.31 pipīlikodarābhāni parasparasamāni ca | antarālāni caiteṣāṃ tulyamānāni padmaja || 7.32 īdṛśaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śastaṃ vāsudevasamarcane | nārāyaṇe tu yaṣṭavyā bindvādyāḥ pūrvam īritāḥ || 7.33 aṣṭāv aṣṭau vidhātavyāḥ kesarā navatissaṣaṭ | pūrveritāni koṣṭhāni mārjayitvā ṣaḍuttaram || 7.34 triṃśac ca tatra nābhyādi vinā padmaṃ prakalpayet | śaṅkumāhṛtya sūtreṇa tatsamaṃ vibhajed dvidhā || 7.35 prathamaṃ karṇikākṣetraṃ dvitīyaṃ vibhajet tridhā| triṇvādyaṃ kesarakṣetraṃ dalakṣetram anantaram || 7.36 tṛtīyam antarālaṃ syād dalapīṭhikayor dvayoḥ | aṣṭau dvādaśa vā kuryād bindvādīn kamalāsana || 7.37 maṇḍalaṃ bhadrakaṃ nāma tadidaṃ sarvakāmadam | cikīrṣan svastikaṃ bimbaṃ kṣetraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadbhir yutam || 7.38 saṃmṛjya tatra [ca] koṣṭhāny ekādaśa ca pātayet | prāg āyatāni [ca] sūtrāṇy udīcīnāyatāni ca || 7.39 saṃmṛjyaṃ madhyato dve dve vīthīṃ prāg āyatām api | tathodagāyatām ekāṃ kuryān nirgamanaṃ punaḥ || 7.40 prāg āyatābhyāṃ koṣṭhābhyāṃ bahiḥ paṅktyā [hy u] udaṅmukham | prācīnaṃ paścimaṃ cāpi dakṣiṇaṃ mukham iṣyate || 7.41 tathodagāyatāyāṃ syād udaṅpratyaṅmukhaṃ śubham | dakṣiṇāgraṃ bhavet prācyāṃ iti svastikam īritam || 7.42 dvidhā vibhajya pūrvoktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśat koṣṭhamaṇḍalam | madhyataḥ padmakaraṇam avaśiṣṭe tridhā kṛte || 7.43 dvābhyāṃ suvṛttaṃ bhāgābhyāṃ bhrāntaṃ vṛttasya maṇḍalam | aviśiṣṭena bhāgena tv antarālaṃ bhaved bahiḥ || 7.44 sauramaṇḍalam etat syād etad evendumaṇḍalam | sarveṣām eva bimbānāṃ pīṭhād bāhyaṃ yathāpuram || 7.45 vinā vidhadhyāt pīṭhādīn kevalaṃ cakrapaṅkajam | cakraṃ vinā vā padmaṃ syāt kartuḥ śaktisamīkṣayā || 7.46 maṇḍalaṃ śobhayed ratnaiḥ pañcavarṇais sitādibhiḥ | athavā cūrṇitai ratnair lohajair vātha dhātujaiḥ || 7.47 candanāgarukuṣṭhādigandhacūrṇair athāpi vā | śālyāditaṇḍulaiḥ piṣṭais sitair vrīhibhir apy uta || 7.48 puṭadagdhair avakṣuṇṇairasitair yājñikacchadaiḥ | śyāmaiś śuklair avakṣuṇṇaiḥ kausumbhair api pāṭalaiḥ || 7.49 niśācūrṇaiḥ prasūnair vā pañcavarṇaiś ca kālajaiḥ | śobhayet karṇikādīni yadvarṇāni caturmukha || 7.50 tadvarṇair eva ratnādidravyair ākāraśobhanam | antarālāni sarvatra kṛṣṇaiḥ śyāmair athāpi vā || 7.51 śobhayet karṇikāṃ pītaiś śuklair bindūni śobhayet | pāṭalaiḥ karṇikārekhāṃ kṛṣṇair vā kesarāvalim || 7.52 dvidhā kṛtvā pūrvabhāgaṃ śvetair bhāgam athottaram | pītai raktair virāmeṣu pratikesaram arjunaiḥ || 7.53 bindūnvindadhyād ratnais tu dalakoṭiṣu rekhayet | ādyantāni ca barhāṇāṃ sitaraktair viśobhayet || 7.54 barhāntavalayaṃ raktaiḥ sitair vā bhūṣayet pṛthak | śyāmaiḥ pītaiś ca raktaiś ca nābhirekhātrayaṃ kramāt || 7.55 dvinābhitve śyāmapītaiḥ śyāmair evaikanābhike | rekhayed asitair eva tvarakoṭīrarāṇi tu || 7.56 raktair arāntavalayaṃ kṛṣṇair nemyantamedinīm | sitair nemimahībhāgaṃ dvidhā kṛtvaikamāditaḥ || 7.57 bhāgaṃ kṛṣṇaiḥ sitair anyannemibhāgaṃ viśeṣayet | pīṭhaṃ pītaiḥ pāṭalair vā sitair vā vīthikāṃ punaḥ || 7.58 latāvitānapatrādiyuktāṃ cūrṇaiś ca citrayet | raktaiś śobhāṃ tathā pītair upaśobhāṃ ca śobhayet || 7.59 dvāraṃ śuklaiś ca raktaiś ca pītaiḥ kṛṣṇair yathākramam | śobhayed uttarādīṃś ca koṇān kṛṣṇair athārjunaiḥ || 7.60 śaṃkhaṃ ca kuryāt tenaiva svastikaṃ pāṭalaprabham | yadvā pītanibhaṃ ; sauramaṇḍalaṃ pāṭalaprabham || 7.61 maṇḍalaṃ caindavaṃ śuklamantarālaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | yatheṣṭavarṇaṃ subhagaṃ maṇḍale hastasaṃmite || 7.62 rekhāsu cūrṇair utsedhaḥ kaniṣṭhāṃgulisaṃmitaḥ | dvihaste 'nāmikā mānastrihaste 'nāmikāsamaḥ || 7.63 caturhaste maṇḍale tu tarjanyaṃgulisaṃmitaḥ | pañcahaste samoṃ 'guṣṭhair ity utsedhaḥ pradarśitaḥ || 7.64 maṇḍalaṃ citrayitvevam ārabheta samarcanam | ārādhayet karṇikāyāṃ mantrādhvānam anantaram || 7.65 tattvādhvānaṃ kesareṣu varṇādhvānaṃ daleṣu ca | padādhvānaṃ nābhibhāge kalādhvānamareṣu ca || 7.66 ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu bhuvanādhvānaṃ nemibhāge caturmukha | karṇikāyāṃ dvādaśasu biṃduṣu dvādaśārcayet || 7.67 akṣarāṇi samāvāhya karṇikāyāṃ samāhitāḥ | yajeta paramātmānaṃ sakalīkṛtya kṛtyavit || 7.68 kesareṣu śriyādīṃś ca yajeta dalabhūmiṣu | śaktīs tadīyā daśa ca dve ca pūjyā yathāvidhi || 7.69 śrīvatsādyāśśaktyas tu vyāptyādyāḥ paritassthitāḥ | dalāntavalaye pūjye viṣṇuḥ prathamanābhigaḥ || 7.70 brahmā dvitīyanābhisthaḥ triṇetras tu tṛtīyagaḥ | dvādaśāreṣu viṣṇvādyāḥ pūjyā dvādaśamūrtayaḥ || 7.71 arāntavalaye pūjyā mīnādyā daśa mūrtayaḥ | prathame nemivalaye śaṅkhādyāyudhapūjanam || 7.72 pīṭhakoṇacatuṣkeṣu varāho narakesarī | anantaś ca hayagrīvas tathāgneyādiṣu kramāt || 7.73 pīṭhikāyāṃ lekapālāḥ puruhūtādayaḥ kramāt | pūjyā dvāreṣu caṇḍādyā dvau dvau praticaturṣv api || 7.74 īśānakoṇe rathyāyāṃ viṣvaksenaṃ samarcayet | garuḍo 'bhimukhastiṣṭhan pūrvadvārād bahiḥkṣitau || 7.75 cakraṃ ca dakṣiṇadvāri gadāṃ ca dvāri paścime | valaje ccottare śaṃkhaṃ <śaṅkhaṃ> prathamāvaraṇe tataḥ || 7.76 viṣṇvādimūrtayaḥ pūjyā dvādaśābjeṣu padmaja | anantare cāvaraṇe padmeṣu dvādaśasv api || 7.77 vāsudevādikṛṣṇāntā mūrtayo dvādaśaiva te | padmeṣv āvaraṇe cānte dvādaśādityapūjanam || 7.78 etasmin maṇḍale devaṃ vāsudevaṃ samarcayet | biṃbe nārāyaṇākhye tu binduṣv aṣṭasu tāvatām || 7.79 aṣṭākṣarāṇāṃ nyasanaṃ vyāptyādyāś śaktayo 'ṣṭa ca | kesareṣu samārādhya daleṣv aṣṭau śriyādayaḥ || 7.80 areṣv aṣṭasu śaṅkhādīny āyudhāny aṣṭa pūjayet | caturviṃśatipadmeṣu caturviṃśatimūrtayaḥ || 7.81 triṣu cāvaraṇeṣv eṣu pūjyās tanmaṇḍale harim | nārāyaṇaṃ samāvāhya yajeta parameśvaram || 7.82 darśe ca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca saṃkrāntau śravaṇeṣu ca | dvādaśyāṃ viṣuve caiva grahaṇeṣv ayaneṣu ca || 7.83 janmaṛkṣe viśeṣeṇa maṇḍale harim arcayet | maṇḍalārādhanam idaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam || 7.84 cakrābjamaṇḍale śastā dīkṣās tasyāś ca maṇḍalam | ekadvāraṃ bhavet tac ca saumyaṃ syād agrajanmanām || 7.85 citritaṃ śvetavarṇena prāgdvāraṃ pṛthivībhujām | raktena citritaṃ dvāraṃ pāścātyaṃ pītavarṇakam || 7.86 viśāṃ bhaved dākṣiṇātyamasitaṃ pādajanmanām | dvārāṇi cānulomānām utpādakavad iṣyate || 7.87 sūtasya valajaṃ prācyāṃ śūdrāṇām iva yoṣitām | śiṣyaṃ sutaṃ vā sarvajñamanasūyaṃ jitendriyam || 7.88 ācāryavaṃśajanmānaṃ nigrahānugrahe kṣamam | śāntike pauṣṭike caiva karmaṇi kṣamamarthinām || 7.89 vedavedāṅgatattvajñamācāryapadakāṃkṣiṇam | deśikendro vidhānena vakṣyamāṇena tattvavit || 7.90 karṣaṇādiṣu sarveṣu vidhāneṣv adhikāriṇam | kuryān maṇḍalapūjādi kuṃbhayāgāvasānikam || 7.91 dīkṣāyām iva tatsarvaṃ kṛtvā śiṣyasya saṃnidhau | ājyena caruṇā caiva samidbhiḥ kusumais tilaiḥ || 7.92 juhuyān mūlamantrābhyām aṣṭottarasahasrakam | śiṣyasya dakṣiṇe haste baddhvā pratisaraṃ guruḥ || 7.93 nṛttair geyais tathā vādyair vedaghoṣair nayen niśām | tataḥ prabhāte śiṣyaṃ taṃ snātaṃ nūtanavāsasam || 7.94 samāhūya samārādhya maṇḍalaṃ kumbham eva ca | caturvidhaṃ nivedyānnaṃ homaṃ kuryādyayā niśi || 7.95 kalaśāṃś caturo droṇapūrṇān hemādinirmitān | mṛnmayān vā yathāvittaṃ sūtravastrādiveṣṭitān || 7.96 saṃsthāpya dhānyarāśau tu ratnādīni vinikṣipet | āgneyakuṃbhe ratnāni sarvāṇi viniveśayet || 7.97 naiṛte sarvalohāni gandhadravyāṇi mārute | īśāne tīrthavārīṇi tato devaṃ samarcayet || 7.98 agnikoṇe vāsudevaṃ saṃkarṣaṇam anantare | pradyumnaṃ vāyukoṇe tu koṇe raudre 'niruddhakam || 7.99 tato 'nu śiṣyaṃ saṃsthāpya pīṭhe bhadrādividyayā | śiṣyaṃ prāṅmukhamāsīnaṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsapūrvakam || 7.100 arcayitvā ghṛtāropam ācared avilaṃbayan | [tūrya]ghoṣeṇa geyena brahmaghoṣeṇa ghoṣayet || 7.101 caturdikṣu tato gaṃdhaiḥ puṣpais tāmbūlavīṭibhiḥ | ghanair bahuvidhair iṣṭais sadasyāṃs toṣayed dvijān || 7.102 toṣayec ca viśeṣeṇa bhagavadbhaktimāśritān | muhūrte śobhane prāpte brāhmaṇānām anujñayā || 7.103 ṛgvedamantritaṃ kumbhamāgneyadiśi niṣṭhitam | samupādāya pāṇibhyāṃ sūktena puruṣātmanā || 7.104 dvādaśākṣaramaṃtreṇa <�mantreṇa> saṃpuṭīkṛtya mūrtinā | abhiṣiñced guruḥ śiṣyaṃ kumbhena tadanantaram || 7.105 naiṛtasthena yajuṣā mantritena samāhitaḥ | vaiṣṇavena ca sūktena brahmannādyāvasānayoḥ || 7.106 saṃkarṣaṇākhyamaṃtreṇa <�mantreṇa> saṃpuṭīkṛtya mūrtinā | kumbhena mārutasthena sāmaghoṣitavāriṇā || 7.107 pradyumnasaṃpuṭenātha brahmanvāruṇasāmabhiḥ | kumbhenātharvavedena pavitrīkṛtavāriṇā || 7.108 īśānakoṇasaṃsthena saṃpuṭīkṛtya mūrtinā | aniruddhākhyamantreṇa nārāyaṇasamāhvayā || 7.109 vidyayā kalaśais sarvair abhiṣiṃced yathoditam | abhiṣiktas tataḥ śiṣyo navāmbaradharaśśuciḥ || 7.110 ācāntaścandanakṣodair liptāṅgas samalaṅkṛtaḥ | sragvī vāsobhir uṣṇīṣaṃ baddhvā makuṭasaṃnibham || 7.111 uttarīyaṃ ca bibhrāṇo bibhrāṇo yogapaṭṭikām | añjanāktekṣaṇadvandvo bahumālāpariṣkṛtaḥ || 7.112 nirīkṣitādarśatalo brāhmaṇaiḥ svastivācitaiḥ | dattaprasavavṛṣṭiś ca śvetavyajanavījitaḥ || 7.113 dattopānatsitacchatro dattāśvagajavāhanaḥ | nīrājitaś ca kalyāṇo jāyate gurvanugrahāt || 7.114 anenaivābhiṣekeṇa labdhvācāryapadaṃ svayam | ācāryakṛtyam akhilaṃ kartum icchec caturmukha || 7.115 gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād gobhūhemādikaṃ tathā | yathāvibhavavistāraṃ tato hastyādivāhanam || 7.116 āruhya dhavalacchatraśvetacāmaravījitaḥ | ācāryacihnair akhilair lakṣito brāhmaṇais saha || 7.117 rathayānenāgrahāraṃ prādakṣiṇyena rathyayā | gatvā devasya sadanaṃ praviśet svasya dhāma vā || 7.118
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde maṇḍalārādhanācāryābhiṣekavidhir nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ
? aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
mahābhiṣekaḥ brahmovāca rājño rāṣṭrasya martyānāṃ yad abhyudayasādhanam | yac cotpātapraśamanaṃ vyādhīnāṃ cāpanodanam || 8.1 yad abhipretam akhilaṃ sādhayaty avilambitam | kurvatāṃ bhagavaṃs tan me tadarcanam anuttamam || 8.2 kathyatāṃ mayi ced asti dayā paramapūruṣa | rahasyam api tanmahyamākhyeyaṃ jagato hitam || 8.3 śrībhagavān mahābhiṣeko nāmāgryaṃ snapanaṃ mama saṃmatam | viṣuve saṅkrame caiva grahaṇe cāyanadvaye || 8.4 dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇe caiva tathā kartus trijanmasu | dinatraye vyatīpāte rohiṇyāṃ ca tithitraye || 8.5 darśe ca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca punar vasvor viśeṣataḥ | pañcabhyāṃ śubhanakṣatre tithivāreṣu cābjaja || 8.6 prayujyamānaṃ sarvārthasādhanaṃ sarvaśāntidam | kartavyaṃ tat tridhā brahmann uttamādhamamadhyamam || 8.7 jātyutkarṣaṃ dhanotkarṣam athavāvekṣya tattvavit | prayuñjītottamaṃ snānam itareṣv itarad bhavet || 8.8 pūrvedyur aṅkuranyāso baddhvā kautukamaṅgalam | adhivāsaś ca bimbasya sadyo vā sakalaṃ bhavet || 8.9 snapanaṃ pratimāyāṃ syād adhivāsaś caturmukha | tīrthapratikṛtau vāpi pūrvālābhe 'dhivāsayet || 8.10 yadvotsavārthapratimāṃ balibimbam athāpi vā | bimbaṃ karmārtham athavā asatsu kuśakūrcakam || 8.11 lepamṛnmayabhittisthapaṭastheṣu ca darpaṇam | kūrcaṃ mūrtyantarābhāve kḷptir eṣā sanātanī || 8.12 prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryāt tataḥ snapanamaṇṭapam | daśahastapravistāraṃ dviguṇenāyataṃ śubham || 8.13 caturdvāraṃ caturdikṣu catustoraṇabhūṣitam | sarvāvaraṇabhūṣv etaddikṣu sarvāsu vā bhavet || 8.14 kḷpte vā maṇṭape kuryād avakāśānusārataḥ | vibhajya tattridhā kuryāt tṛtīyeṃ 'śe 'tha paścime || 8.15 avalambya brahmasūtraṃ caturaśraṃ samantataḥ | caturhastāṃ snānavediṃ hastotsedhāṃ śilādibhiḥ || 8.16 upānahādisaṃyuktaṃ darśanīyāṃ salakṣaṇām | upariṣṭāc ca valayaṃ vṛttaṃ vā caturaśrakam || 8.17 prādeśena ca vistīrṇaṃ tatamaṣṭāṅgulena vā | ṣaḍaṅgulena vā brahman caturaṅgulam unnatam || 8.18 vedikopari taddhārākulyāmāśvabhramedinīm | mṛnmayādiṣu bimbeṣu bahir vediprakalpanam || 8.19 ekabere tu na bahis snānavedīprakalpanam | dukūlakṣaumavasanair maṇṭapaṃ sarvatodiśam || 8.20 śobhayet pūrṇakumbhādyais toraṇāni vibhūṣayet | veṣṭayed darbhamālābhir muktādāmāni lambayet || 8.21 āsthānamaṇṭape snānam atha caivārdhamaṇṭape | toraṇādi na kartavyaṃ gṛhārcāyāṃ tathaiva ca || 8.22 nitye ca snapane cāpi kautukaṃ cāṅkurārpaṇam | niśācūrṇair na snapanam iṣyate maṇṭapasthale || 8.23 gomayāmbhobhir ālipya sudhācūrṇaiś ca bhūṣayet | dīpānāropayet tatra nyased aṅkurapālikām || 8.24 koṇe raudre maṇṭapasya jaladroṇyādibhājanam | kalpayed gālitasvādu sagandhijalapūritam || 8.25 pavamānādibhis sūktair mantritaṃ sāpidhānakam | vedidakṣiṇato bhūmāv upasnānāmbukalpanam || 8.26 ardhyādidīpaparyantaṃ pūjādravyāṇi kalpayet | candanādrāṇi sūtrāṇi caturdaśa nipātayet || 8.27 prāgāyatāni tāvanti sūtrāṇy eva caturmukha | udagāyatāni santy evaṃ koṣṭhāny ekonasaptatiḥ || 8.28 śataṃ ca teṣām āyāmaṃ vistāraṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulam | dhānyapīṭhānurūpaṃ vā kalaśānāṃ caturmukha || 8.29 dikṣv aṣṭāsu tathā madhye pratyekaṃ navabhūmiṣu | nava koṣṭhāni kumbhānāṃ padāni kamalāsana || 8.30 evam ekādhikāśītikoṣṭhāni kalaśāspadam | anyāny aṣṭottarāśītirathyāṃ saṃmṛjya kalpayet || 8.31 vrīhibhiḥ pīṭhikāṃ kuryāt koṣṭhabhūṣu pṛthak pṛthak | āḍhakena tadardhena tadardhārdhena vā bhavet || 8.32 pīṭhikādhānyaturyāṃśāstaṇḍulāḥ pīṭhikopari | tatturyāṃśāstilās teṣāṃ bhaveyur upari sthitāḥ || 8.33 dve dve kuśāgre pratyasyet pīṭhikāsu caturmukha | sauvarṇā rājatāstāmrā mṛnmayā vā yathāvasu || 8.34 kalaśā lakṣaṇopetāḥ pakvabimbaphalopamāḥ | acchidrās svanavantaś ca kālamaṇḍalavarjitāḥ || 8.35 abhinnā mṛnmayāḥ kumbhāḥ pāṣāṇasphoṭavarjitāḥ | dravyakumbhā droṇapūrṇās tadardhārdhena vāthavā || 8.36 pādena kalaśāś śiṣṭāḥ pūryā vārdhāḍhakena tu | prakṣālya viṣṇugāyatryā dravyakumbhāṃs tathetarān || 8.37 sthāpayitvā karatale savye 'savyena pāṇinā | indraṃ natveti mantreṇa tantunā paribeṣṭayet || 8.38 tantunā veṣṭitānāṃ syād antarālaṃ yavāntaram | ardhāṅgulāntarālaṃ syād yadvaikāṅgulam antaram || 8.39 kalaśāspadamedinyāḥ paścime dharaṇītale | dhānyapīṭhaṃ vidhāyāsmin kalaśān adhivāsayet || 8.40 dhānyapīṭhe tatas tasmin kuśānāstīrya viśvataḥ | prāgagrān udagagrāṃś ca teṣu kambhān adhomukhān || 8.41 omity uccārya vinyasyen navabhūṣu yathottaram | nyastānām api kumbhānām upariṣṭād yathāpuram || 8.42 darbhāṃstṛṇīyād ācāryo mantreṇa parameṣṭhinā | prokṣayed ardhyatoyena prāṅmukhaḥ puruṣātmanā || 8.43 viśvamantreṇa vikired akṣatāny adhivāsite | uttāniteṣu kumbheṣu nivṛttyāhvānavidyayā || 8.44 asthi ratnaṃ sirā tanturmāṃsaṃ mṛtsnā prakīrtitā | śoṇitaṃ raktamṛdbhis tu jalaṃ medas tathaiva ca || 8.45 kūrcaṃ tu śuklam ity uktaṃ carmaṇāmbaraveṣṭanam | tatatpratikṛtir jīvaṃ kramād evaṃ smared dvijaḥ || 8.46 sarpiṣāṣṭottaraśataṃ viṣṇugāyatriyā kṛte | home hutājyaśeṣeṇa snapanadravyasecanam || 8.47 ghṛtādisnapanadravyair astrapūtaiḥ pariṣkṛtaiḥ | pūrayet kalaśāṃs tāṃs tān mantraiḥ pūrṇān samuddharet || 8.48 sarvamantreṇa viśvātman kumbhān saptadaśodyatān | dravyakumbhān dhānyapīṭhe sthāpayed viṣṇupūrvayā || 8.49 gāyatryā ca catuṣṣaṣṭi dvādaśākṣaravidyayā | udakumbhān krameṇānyān prāṅmukho vāpy udaṅmukhaḥ || 8.50 navake madhyame sthāne sthāpanīye tu madhyame | ghṛtakumbhaṃ sthāpayitvā pade sautrāmaṇes tataḥ || 8.51 uṣṇodakumbhaṃ vinyasyed ratnakunbham anantare | phalakumbhaṃ yamapade lohakumbhaṃ ca nairṛte || 8.52 prācetase mārjanāmbhaḥ kumbhaṃ gandhāṃmbumārute | akṣatāmbu ca kaubere pade śārve yavodakam || 8.53 prācyāṃ tu kumbhanavake madhye pādyaghaṭaṃ pade | ardhyakumbhaṃ pade yāmye pade prācetase punaḥ || 8.54 upasparśanapānīyaṃ pañcagavyam udakpade | āgneyakumbhanavake madhye dadhighaṭaṃ pade || 8.55 nairṛte madhyataḥ kṣīraṃ vāyavīye ghaṭaṃ madhoḥ | kaṣāyakumbhamīśāne sarvatra parito ghaṭān || 8.56 śuddhodakāṃś catuṣṣaṣṭim aṣṭāv aṣṭau niveśayet | saptabhiḥ pañcabhir vāpi yadvā darbhais tribhiḥ kṛtān || 8.57 kūrcān kumbheṣv avāgagrān nikṣipel lakṣaṇānvitān | mahākumbhe kuśaiḥ kūrcaṃ caturviṃśatibhiḥ kṛtam || 8.58 cakramantreṇa tān sarvān śarāvairapidhāpayet | vāsobhir dravyakalaśān ' yuvā suvāsa ' ity ṛcā || 8.59 kaṇṭheṣu veṣṭayed anyān vāsobhiś chādayen navaiḥ | adhīyānais trayīvidyāṃ vidvadbhir brāhmaṇais saha || 8.60 ṛtvigbhis saha devasya yāyānmantravidantikam | ṛtvijo devam utthāpya guruś cottiṣṭhavidyayā || 8.61 sāmnā rathantarākhyena brahmayāne guruḥ svayam | sthāpayed ṛtvijais sārdhaṃ brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ || 8.62 śibikāyāṃ sthāpayitvā mṛdvāstaraṇakalpite | niveśayeyuḥ pratimāṃ snānavedītale śucau || 8.63 puṇyāhaṃ vācayet paścāt pañcakālaparāyaṇaiḥ | ayugmais toṣayed vittais tān vibhūtyanusārataḥ || 8.64 dvāratoraṇakumbhādīn samabhyarcya yathāpuram | dvāreṣv adhyayanaṃ nṛttaṃ vādyaṃ geyaṃ prarvatayet || 8.65 sarpiṣā juhuyād agnau yāvat kalaśasaṃkhyayā | mūlamantreṇa juhuyāc caruṃ pūrvoktasaṃkhyayā || 8.66 nṛsūktena samabhyarcya kalaśān sthāpitān guruḥ | ardhyādibhis tathā devaṃ ghṛtāropaṇam ācaret || 8.67 dantakāṣṭhaṃ tathā tailaṃ gandhāmalakavāri ca | vastraṃ dattvā cottarīyam ardhyādyair arcayet punaḥ || 8.68 dīpāntam arcanaṃ kṛtvā pādyakumbhamukhair ghaṭaiḥ | ghṛtakumbhāvasānaiś ca snāpayed deśikaḥ kramāt || 8.69 chinnaikatantum uddhṛtya pādyakumbhaṃ samarcitam | puṣpair dadyāt karatale deśikendrasya mūrtipaḥ || 8.70 kūrcamādāya kumbhasthaṃ taddhaste deśikottamaḥ | arvāgagreṇa kūrcena tīthair brahmādibhis tataḥ || 8.71 śuddhair vaiṣṇavagāyatryā snāpayet pādyavāribhiḥ | tadviṣṇor iti mantreṇa snāpayed ardhyavāribhiḥ || 8.72 na te viṣṇo iti śrutyā kumbhenācamanāmbunā | viṣṇoḥ karmeti mantreṇa pañcagavyābhiṣecanam || 8.73 dadhikrāviṇṇayajuṣā dadhnā devābhiṣecanam | sāmnā payovṛtenaiva payasā madhunā punaḥ || 8.74 madhuvāteti mantreṇa snapanaṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ | oṣadhya iti mantreṇa kaṣāyāmbhobhiṣecanam || 8.75 tadviṣṇor iti mantreṇa snānam uṣṇāmbudhārayā | phalinīty anuvākena snapanaṃ phalavāribhiḥ || 8.76 śaṃ no devīr iti snānaṃ mantritair mārjanāmbubhiḥ | sāvitryākṣatapāthobhis trātāram iti sāmabhiḥ || 8.77 ratnodakair lohatoyair mahāvyāhṛtividyayā | gandhadvāreti mantreṇa snapanaṃ gandhavāriṇā || 8.78 śatadhāreti mantreṇa snānaṃ syād yavavāribhiḥ | ghṛtasnāteti mantreṇa ghṛtena snapanaṃ hareḥ || 8.79 athavā pauruṣaiḥ sūktaiḥ kramāt pādyādivāribhiḥ | ṛgbhiṣ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ snānam ṛcedaṃ viṣṇur ity api || 8.80 aṣṭākṣareṇa[vā]yadvā dvādaśākṣaravidyayā | viṣṇugāyatriyā vāpi snānaṃ yadvā caturmukha || 8.81 svamūrtividyayā vāpi snapanaṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ | kṣālanaṃ ca ghṛtasnāne sāmānyair uṣṇavāribhiḥ || 8.82 pādyādidravyakumbhānām uddhāreṣyantarāntarā | śuddhodakumbhair anyaiś ca snānam aṣṭabhir aṣṭabhiḥ || 8.83 aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa bhaved devasya padmaja | upasnānaṃ tathā plotaṃ vastraṃ caivottarīyakam || 8.84 ardhyaṃ pādyaṃ tathācāmaṃ gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpakam | dīpaṃ caitāni deyāni pratidravyaghaṭāplavam || 8.85 uddhared dravyakalaśān viṣṇugāyatrividyayā | śuddhodakāṃś ca kalaśān dvādaśākṣaravidyayā || 8.86 haridrātaṇḍulais kharṇacūrṇaiḥ kumbhān sasūtrakān | pūrayen nava nirdoṣān sapta vā pañca vāthavā || 8.87 trīṇy ekakumbham athavā te ca sthāpyāḥ parivyaye | sāpidhāneṣu kumbheṣu sakūrceṣu samarcayet || 8.88 śriyaṃ ; kumbhān samuddhṛtya śrīsūktenābhiṣecayet | pūrṇāhutir yathā home cūrṇaiḥ snānaṃ tathā bhavet || 8.89 vāsudevatanubhraṣṭān cūrṇān paramapāvanān | ye vahanti śirobhis te narā nirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ || 8.90 te yānti vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ punar āvṛttivarjitam | abhiṣekajalaṃ viṣṇor ye pibanti vahanti ca || 8.91 te sarvatīrthābhiṣekaphalam aśnuvate mahat | kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ natvā stutvā stotraiś ca deśikaḥ || 8.92 tatas sahasradhārābhiḥ snāpayitvā janārdanam | nīrājanāntam iṣṭvaivaṃ tato 'laṅkāraviṣṭare <'laṃkāraviṣṭare> || 8.93 yajeta mātrādānāntaṃ mātrāsaṃkhyā parivyayā | khāri droṇaṃ tadardhaṃ vā deyās syur deśikāya te || 8.94 caturvidhāni cānnāni bhojayed bhojanāsane | homāntam arcayed devaṃ deśikendro yathāvidhi || 8.95 snapanānte tato devaṃ sukhamāsīnamāsane | yāceta yajamāno 'pi sarvam iṣṭaṃ janārdanam || 8.96 dakṣiṇāṃ deśikendrāya sauvarṇaśataniṣkakām | tadardhaṃ pādam athavā dadyād vittānusārataḥ || 8.97 kuryād ācāryasātsarvaṃ dravyaṃ pūjāṅgam āhṛtam | vastrādikaṃ tathānyeṣāṃ ṛtvijāṃ tuṣṭim āvahet || 8.98 nṛttageyaratānāṃ ca tathā svādhyāyaśālinām | brāhmaṇānāṃ yathā tuṣṭiḥ tathā vittavisarjanam || 8.99 adhamottamam evaṃ ca snapanaṃ parikīrtitam | koṇeṣu kumbhān dvātriṃśat kevalodakapūritān || 8.100 tair vihīnaṃ bhavet snānaṃ jñeyaṃ cādhamamadhyamam | śuddhodakumbhair yaddhīnaṃ sarvais tadadhamādhamam || 8.101 pādyakumbhe tathā cārdhye tathopasparśanāmbhasi | kumbhe kaṣāyaphalayoḥ kumbhe cākṣatagandhayoḥ || 8.102 ekaikasmin ghaṭeṣv eṣu dravyāṇāṃ aṣṭakaṃ kṣipet | pādyādiṣu kramād davyaṃ tatpramāṇaṃ ca kathyate || 8.103 tulasī ca tathā padmaṃ dūrvā ca syāt tathā 'kṣatam | śyāmākaṃ viṣṇuparṇaṃ ca bilvapatrāṇi candanam || 8.104 śiṣṭāni muṣṭimātrāṇi tatpalaṃ candanasya ca | siddhārtham akṣataṃ caiva kuśāgraṃ ca tathā phalam || 8.105 yavāstilāś candanaṃ ca prasavāś ca sugandhayaḥ | phalaṃ supakvam eteṣu candanaṃ ca triniṣkakam || 8.106 śiṣṭāni muṣṭimātrāṇi takkolaṃ campakasya ca | mukulaṃ ghanasāraṃ ca jātirelāphalāni ca || 8.107 lavaṅgatvak candanaṃ ca puṣpāṇi surabhīṇi ca | phalārdhaparimāṇāni pratyekaṃ kamalāsana || 8.108 śamīpalāśakhadiraṃ bilvāśvatthavikaṅkatam | ādumbaraś ca nyagrodhaś śamyādīnāṃ tvacas tathā || 8.109 prateyekaṃ palamānās syuḥ kadalībījapūrakam | āmramāmalakaṃ bilvaṃ nālikeraphalaṃ tathā || 8.110 panasaṃ mātuluṅgaṃ ca bhinnāny etāni nikṣipet | nīvāraveṇuśālīnāṃ priyaṅguyavayor api || 8.111 kaṅkuṣāṣṭikayoś caiva godhūmasya ca taṇḍulāḥ | muṣṭipramāṇaṃ vijñeyāḥ kuṅkumaṃ koṣṭhacandane || 8.112 agarūśīramūlāni hrīberaṃ girisambhavam | māṃsī muraṃ ca pratyekaṃ palamātrāṇi padmaja || 8.113 māṇikyaṃ padmarāgaṃ ca nīlaṃ vajraṃ ca puṣyakam | pravālaṃ mauktikaṃ caiva tathā marakataṃ kṣipet || 8.114 vaiḍūryaṃ navaratnāni tāni ratnaghaṭodake | suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ sīsakaṃ trapukaṃ tathā || 8.115 kāṃsyamāyasasāraṃ ca saptalohaghaṭodake | pratyekaṃ niṣkamānāni ; rajanī sūryavartinī || 8.116 sahadevī śirīṣaṃ ca sadābhadraṃ kuśāgrakam | mārjanāni ṣaḍ etāni muṣṭimātrāṇi nikṣipet || 8.117 yavā veṇuyavāś caiva vrīhayaś ceti tat trikam | yavodake nidhātavyaṃ pratyekaṃ kuḍapaṃ bhavet || 8.118 pañcagavyāni saṅgṛhya mṛtpātre nūtane śubhe | gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiś ca pañcamam || 8.119 kapilāyā jarāyā vā pañcagavyaṃ praśasyate | tayor abhāve tv anyāsāṃ gavāṃ gavyaṃ vidhīyate || 8.120 nārtāyā na ca garbhiṇyā na vṛddhāyāḥ kadācana | nāvatsāyā upādeyaṃ dhenor mūtraṃ śakṛd dvayam || 8.121 bhūmiṣṭhaṃ gomayaṃ grāhyaṃ soṣṇaṃ kṛmyādyadūṣitam | niṣpīḍya samyag gṛhṇīyād gomayasya rasaṃ punaḥ || 8.122 sadyastaptaṃ ghṛtaṃ śuddhamahorātroṣitaṃ dadhi | kṣīraṃ grāhyamataptaṃ ca daśāhāj janmanaḥ param || 8.123 gomūtraṃ viṣṇugāyatryā gandhadvāreti gomayam | āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi || 8.124 ghṛtaṃ śukramasīty evaṃ gavyāni saha yojayet | viṣṇugāyatriyā yadvā pañcopaniṣadais tu vā || 8.125 parameṣṭhī śakṛnmantre gomūtrasya tu puruṣaḥ | viśvamantro bhaved dadhno nivṛttis sarpiṣo bhavet || 8.126 payasas sarvamantraḥ syāt sarveṣām aṣṭavarṇakam | dadhi dviguṇamādhārāt pīyūṣaṃ triguṇaṃ tataḥ || 8.127 ṣaḍguṇaṃ mūtram etasmāc chakṛdvāri caturguṇam | snapane kathitaṃ mānaṃ prokṣaṇe pañcakaṃ samam || 8.128 gomayena samaṃ mūtraṃ dadhi syād dviguṇaṃ tataḥ | tataś caturguṇaṃ sarpis tasmād aṣṭaguṇaṃ payaḥ || 8.129 prāśane pañcagavyānāṃ pramāṇam idam īritam | droṇamānaṃ pañcagavyaṃ ghṛtamānaṃ ca tatsamam || 8.130 tādṛg eva dadhi kṣīraṃ tādṛg eva ca mākṣikam | ardhaṃ vā syād āḍhakaṃ vā nyūnaṃ ced āsuraṃ bhavet || 8.131 gṛhārcāsnapane nyūnaṃ prasthenaiva prakalpayet | pādye dravyāntarālābhe dūrvā cārdhyetvasarṣapaḥ || 8.132 śastamācamanīye tu takkolaṃ mārjanāmbhasi | sahadevīgandhatoye candanakṣoda iṣyate || 8.133 kaṣāyatoye cāśvatthaś śītam uṣṇodake 'sati | ratnodake vajram ekaṃ kadalyekā phalāmbhasi || 8.134 suvarṇaṃ lohapānīye śālitaṇḍulam akṣate | yavodakaghaṭe vrīhiś śasyate kamalāsana || 8.135 alābhe dadhini kṣīraṃ kṣīrālābhe bhaved dadhi | madhunyalābhe sarpīṃṣi tadalābhe bhaven madhu || 8.136 alābhe pañcagavyānāṃ ghṛtam evaikam iṣyate | pañcagavyeṣu yasya syād alābhas tatpade ghṛtam || 8.137 snapanaṃ madhyamaṃ vakṣye yathā tadavadhāraya | madhye pūrvoktakalaśasthāpane vihite sati || 8.138 dvau dvau bahis tataḥ paṅktīs saṃmṛjya kamalāsana | parito vīthikāḥ kuryāt bahis tābhyo ghaṭāspadam || 8.139 pañcāśatam athaikonaṃ kalaśānāṃ vinikṣipet | pūrvādiṣu pratidiśaṃ catasṛṣv ambujāsana || 8.140 catvāro dravyakalaśās teṣu śuddhodakāḥ pare | gulodakaṃ cekṣurasaṃ nālikerajalaṃ tathā || 8.141 śāntivāri ca pūrvādau kramān nyasyec catuṣṭayam | gulābhāve cekṣurasas tadabhāve gulodakam || 8.142 gulamānaṃ palāśītir ardham ardhārdham eva vā | nālikerajalābhāve tatsthāne kṣīram iṣyate || 8.143 tulsīveṇunīvārayavāśra śvetasarṣapāḥ | tilāś ca ṣaṭ śāntikumbhe dravyāṇi tulasī bhavet || 8.144 muṣṭimātraṃ dravyam anyat pṛthak kuḍubasaṃmitam | tulasīdalam anyeṣām alābhe grāhyam iṣyate || 8.145 gulodakādibhir dravyais snapane vihite sati | pādyādidravyakalaśair ghṛtāntas snāpayed dharim || 8.146 madhuvāteti mantreṇa snapanaṃ gulavāriṇā | madhu naktam iti snānamaikṣavena rasena ca || 8.147 madhumānna iti snānaṃ nālikerāmbunā punaḥ | vedāham iti mantreṇa śāntidravyaghaṭāmbubhiḥ || 8.148 jitaṃ ta iti śuddhena vāriṇā snapanaṃ hareḥ | madhyamottamam uddiṣṭaṃ madhyame madhyamaṃ punaḥ || 8.149 caturbhir dravyakalaśaiḥ snānaṃ śuddhodakair vinā | bahiṣṭh air devadevasya madhyamādhamamāplavaḥ || 8.150 sarvair eva dravyakumbhaiḥ sarvaiś śuddhodakair vinā | uttamaṃ snapanaṃ vakṣye yathāvadavardhāyatām || 8.151 vidikṣu dikṣuvat kumbhāḥ sthāpyāḥ pūrvoktasaṃkhyayā | teṣu ca dravyakalaśāś catvāro 'nye caturmukha || 8.152 śuddhodakāḥ vidiśy agner vinyasen maṅgalodakam | indravallyaṅkurāśvatthapallavāś ca kuśośayam || 8.153 ekapatrāmbujaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kuṅkumaṃ rohiṇadrumam | puṇyās sumanasaśvāṣṭau yūthikā mallikāpi vā || 8.154 trīṇy utpalāni jātiś ca campakaṃ ketakī tathā | dravyāṇi maṅgalānīti prāsyen maṅgalapāthasi || 8.155 aṅkuradvayam ekaikam ekapatraṃ ca paṅkajam | muṣṭimātraṃ sumanasaś caikaikaṃ candanādikam || 8.156 palatrayaṃ pṛthak kumbhe naiṛte sakalauṣadhīḥ | māṃsī kuṣṭhaṃ haridre dve murā śaileyacampake || 8.157 mustā vacā ca karpūraṃ pratyekaṃ phalasaṃmitam | piṣṭvā sarvaiṣadhighaṭe nikṣipet kamalāsana || 8.158 vāyavye sarvagandhadravyāṇāṃ kṣepaṇaṃ ghaṭe | karpūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī malayajaṃ muram || 8.159 priyaṅgu kesaraṃ mustā tamālaṃ nāgakesaram | mūladvayaṃ ca kaccoraṃ suraparṇikakesaram || 8.160 uśīraṃ tagaraṃ lodhraṃ tathaiva haricandanam | agarudvayaṃ sitaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kāleyaṃ granthipallavam || 8.161 mukulaṃ campakasyeti pratyekaṃ phalasaṃmitam | cūrṇīkṛtya samastaṃ tannyased gandhodake ghaṭe || 8.162 mūlauṣadhighaṭe śārve mūlauṣadhisamarpaṇam | vyāghrī śivā balā cāgniś śatapuṃkhā śatāvarī || 8.163 bilvamūlaṃ vacā cūrṇī poraṇḍaṃ śatamūlikā | pratyekaṃ palamānās syuḥ piṣṭvā kumbhe vinikṣipet || 8.164 maṅgalodakavastūnām alābhe candanaṃ varam | sarvauṣadhīnām etāsām alābhe kuṣṭham iṣyate || 8.165 alābhe sarvagandhānāṃ śasyate candanaṃ varam | mūlauṣadhīnāṃ sarvāsām alābhe śasyate balā || 8.166 adhidaivaṃ samabhyarcya uddhṛtya snāpayet kramāt | pūrvādidikṣu prathamamāgneyādi tataḥ param || 8.167 viṣṇor nukam iti procya snāpayen maṅgalāmbhasā | oṣadhya iti mantreṇa sarvauṣadhijalena ca || 8.168 nārāyaṇānuvākena sarvagandhāmbubhir harim | yā oṣadhīti mantreṇa mūlauṣadhijalais tataḥ || 8.169 atra śuddhodakais snāyād vidyayāṣṭākṣarātmanā | pādyapūrvaṃ ghṛtāntaṃ ca snāyād devaṃ yathāpuram || 8.170 uttamottamam etac ca snapanaṃ parikīrtitam | ardhaśuddhodakair hīnaṃ bhaved uttamamadhyamam || 8.171 sarvaśuddhodakair hīnam uttamādhamam ucyate | viṃśatiḥ pañca ca brahman saṃkṣepe kalaśā matāḥ || 8.172 catuśśataṃ ca vistāre saptatiś ca trir uttarā | dravyāṇām atha sarveṣāṃ kathayāmy adhidevatāḥ || 8.173 ghṛtasya paramātmā ca vāsudevo 'dhidevatā | uṣṇodakumbhe puruṣas satyas syāt tu phalodake || 8.174 acyuto mārjane daivam anantaś cākṣatodake | ratnodake keśavas syāl lohe nārāyaṇas smṛtaḥ || 8.175 gandhodake mādhavas syād govindas syād yavodake | pādyodake bhaved viṣṇur ardhye ca madhusūdanaḥ || 8.176 trivikramas tathācāme pañcagavyeṣu vāmanaḥ | dadhani śrīdharo devo gṛṣīkeśaḥ payasy api || 8.177 madhunaḥ padmanābhas syād dāmodaraḥ kaṣāyake | gulodake varāhaḥ syān nṛsiṃhaś caikṣavodake || 8.178 śrīdharo nālikerasya hayāsyaḥ śāntivāriṇaḥ | vāsudevo maṅgalasya kumbhasya kamalāsana || 8.179 sarvauṣadhyambukalaśe devas saṅkarṣaṇas smṛtaḥ | pradyumnas sarvagandhasya mūlauṣadhyo 'niruddhakaḥ || 8.180 mūrtir eteṣu kumbheṣu sāṅgaṃ pīṭhaṃ samarcayet | śuddhodakeṣu sarveṣu nārāyaṇasamarcanam || 8.181 dhānyānāṃ kalaśānāṃ ca devatā syād vasundharā | kūrcānāṃ daivataṃ cāstraṃ cakrikāṇāṃ sudarśanam || 8.182 vāsasāṃ daivataṃ viṣṇus sarveṣāṃ vā janārdanaḥ | ity evaṃ snapanaṃ proktaṃ navadhā tava padmaja || 8.183 eṣām anyatamaṃ kuryāt snānaṃ vittānusārataḥ | pañcamyāṃ snapanaṃ viṣṇor yathoktaṃ phalam aśnute || 8.184 trijanmarkṣe daśaguṇaṃ śravaṇe dviguṇaṃ bhavet | triguṇaṃ śaśinaḥ proktaṃ kṣaye śataguṇaṃ bhavet || 8.185 caturguṇaṃ tu dvādaśyāṃ triguṇaṃ tārakātraye | saṅkrāntyāṃ ṣaḍguṇaṃ vidyādviṣuve triguṇaṃ bhavet || 8.186 ayane dakṣiṇe snānam ekaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet | ayane 'nyatra vihite sahasraguṇam āplave || 8.187 vidhau vidhuntudagraste snānaṃ triṃśadguṇaṃ hareḥ | sūrye śatasahasraṃ tu yugānte koṭisaṃmitam || 8.188 anantaṃ syād vyatīṇate kāleṣv eteṣu pūjanam | anantaroktaphaladaṃ kalpate caturānana || 8.189 aṣṭottareṇa kumbhānāṃ śatena kamalāsana | snapanaṃ kathyate viṣṇor yathāvad avadhāryatām || 8.190 brāhmadivyamānuṣeṣu bhāgeṣu triṣu bhāgayoḥ | ādyayoḥ sphālayet sūtrāṇy ekādaśa pṛthak kṣitau || 8.191 prāgāyatāni tiryak ca tatra madhye vidikṣu ca | catvāri catvāry aṣṭāsu kumbhasthānāni vīthikāḥ || 8.192 anyāni kuryād evaṃ ca ṣaṭtriṃśatkoṣṭhakaṃ bhavet | tatra kumbhāṃs toyapūrṇānvinyasen mānuṣe punaḥ || 8.193 bhāge nava navāśāsu kumbhān aṣṭau samuddharet | aṣṭottaraśataṃ kumbhās sampadyante tathā sati || 8.194 brāhme tu madhyame sthāne kalaśānāṃ catuṣṭaye | ekasmin dravyam āghāraṃ śiṣṭaṃ śuddhodakaṃ trikam || 8.195 divye tu bhāge prācīne kalaśānāṃ catuṣṭaye | ekasminn uṣṇam udakaṃ diśy agne ratnaśambaram || 8.196 yāmye phalodakaṃ lohaṃ nairṛtyāmatha vāruṇe | mārjanaṃ vāyubhāge tu gandhatoyam udagdiśi || 8.197 akṣatodakamīśāne yavāmbhaḥ kathitā nava | dravyakumbhā bahirbhāge mānuṣe pūrvavad bhavet || 8.198 pādyādidravyakalaśāḥ pūrvādiṣu yathoditāḥ | kalpanīyā yathāpūrvam uddhṛtya snāpayet kramāt || 8.199 kumbhair ekonapañcāśakalaśair anyad īryate | candanārdrāṇi sūtrāṇi daśa prāgāyatāni ca || 8.200 tathodagāyatāni syuḥ sphālyāni kamalāsana | madhye navasu koṣṭheṣu vinyaset kalaśānnava || 8.201 dikṣu pratidiśaṃ kumbhān ṣaṭsu koṣṭheṣū tāvataḥ | vinyasec caturaḥ kumbhānvidikṣv api pṛthakpṛthak || 8.202 vīthayo 'nyāni koṣṭhāni dravyāṇi ca yathāpuram | kumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśatyā snānam anyad udīryate || 8.203 pūrvad daśa sūtrāṇi sphālayitvā bhuvaḥsthale | madhye navasu koṣṭheṣu navakumbhān prakalpayet || 8.204 prāgādidikṣu pratyekaṃ kalaśāṃs trīn prakalpayet | āgneyādiṣu kumbhānāṃ koṇeṣv ekaikakalpanam || 8.205 dvau dvau pūrvādiṣu ghaṭau pārśvataḥ kevalodakau | aṣṭau tānvarjayitvānye dravyakumbhā yathoditāḥ || 8.206 madhyame kumbhanavake yathoktadravyapūraṇam | gandhadravyaiḥ pūrayed vā kalaśān pañcaviṃsatim || 8.207 candanāgarukāśmīrakuṣṭhātagaravīraṇaiḥ | asitāgaruṇā cāpi haricandanavāriṇā || 8.208 hrīverakardamenāpi navamena ghaṭānnava | madhyādīśānaparyantaṃ pūrayet kamalāsana || 8.209 tamālasitamustābhyāṃ suraparṇīrajaḥkaṇaiḥ | karpūranāgasumanomustācampakakuḍmalaiḥ || 8.210 priyaṅgupuṣpakāleyagranthipallavabījakaiḥ | māṃsīkharjūraśaileyahrīberaiś ca suradrumaiḥ || 8.211 mureṇa tair yathāyogaṃ bahiṣṭhān api ṣoḍaśa | hitvā bahir vidikkumbhān yadvānyais snāpayed dharim || 8.212 sphālayen nava sūtrāṇi yathāpūrvaṃ bhuvaḥsthale | brāhme sthāne catuṣkoṣṭhe vinyasec caturo ghaṭān || 8.213 dvau dvau syātāṃ ca pūrvādidikṣv ekaikaṃ vidikṣu ca | ratnaṃ lohaṃ tathā gandham āghāraṃ ca yathākramam || 8.214 dravyāṇi kumbheṣv āgneyakoṇādistheṣv anukramāt | bahiraindrapade koṣṭhe dvayoḥ kalaśayor yathā || 8.215 pādyamardhyaṃ tathāgneyakoṇe dadhighaṭo bhavet | yāmye cācamanīyaṃ prāk pañcagavyaṃ tu paścime || 8.216 koṇe tu nairṛte kṣīraṃ paścime tu ghaṭadvaye | dakṣiṇe 'kṣatam anyatra mārjanāmbhastathānile || 8.217 koṇe madhu tathā saumye kaṣāyaṃ ca kuśodakam | yavodakaṃ śārvakoṇe dravyaiḥ pādyādibhiḥ kramāt || 8.218 ṛgbhiṣ ṣoḍaśabhis sūktaiḥ pauruṣaiḥ snāpayed dharim | kumbhair dvādaśabhir vāpi caturbhir madhyatas sthitaiḥ || 8.219 ratnena lohena tathā sarvagandhena sarpiṣā | pūritair bahir indrādikoṣṭhair aṣṭabhir ghaṭaiḥ || 8.220 prācīmārabhya pādyena dadhyardhyakṣīrapūritaiḥ | tathaivācamanīyena madhunā pañcagavyakaiḥ || 8.221 phalodakena yadvānyair dravyair dvādaśasaṃmitaiḥ | madhye 'gnikoṇe koṣṭhena nairrte varuṇānile || 8.222 granthipallavabījena śārve malayajāmbhasā | bahiḥkrameṇa pūrvādidikṣv aṣṭāsu caturmukha || 8.223 kāśmīrajena māṃsyā ca tamālena mureṇa ca | mūlena parvatotthena suraparṇīrajaḥkaṇaiḥ || 8.224 campakaprasavakṣodaiḥ kharjūreṇa prapūritaiḥ | kalaśaiḥ snāpayed devaṃ navabhir vā vidheḥ pade || 8.225 prāgādidikṣu cāṣṭāsu krameṇājyena vastunā | pādyena ca tathārdhyeṇa kṣīreṇācamanāmbhasā || 8.226 madhunā pañcagavyena phalena paripūritaiḥ | ratnair vā navabhiḥ pūrṇaiḥ kumbhair navabhir āplavaḥ || 8.227 pañcabhir vā ghaṭair madhye dikṣu pūrvādiṣu sthitaiḥ | maṇibhiś ca pravālaiś ca mukhābhiḥ pūritaiḥ kramāt || 8.228 vajrair vaiḍūryaśakalaiḥ lohair vā pañcabhiś śubhaiḥ | pañcāmṛtair vā madhunā gulenājyena pūritaiḥ || 8.229 dadhnā ca payasā yadvā pañcagavyaiḥ kramād bhavet | ekena vā hares snānaṃ dravyaiḥ pūrvoditaiḥ bhavet || 8.230 vyastais samastair vā vittadeśakālānusārataḥ | deyā ca dakṣiṇā svarṇaniṣkāḥ kalaśasaṃmitāḥ || 8.231 ardhaṃ pādaṃ tadardhaṃ vā yathāvittānusārataḥ | snapanaṃ dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ niṣphalaṃ phalakāminaḥ || kartus tasmād dakṣiṇeyaṃ deyā 'lpāpi phalārthibhiḥ || 8.232
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣa[di] pādme tantre caryāpāde mahābhiṣeko nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ
? navamo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
sahasrakalaśābhiṣekavidhiḥ
brahmā niyukto 'haṃ prajāsṛṣṭau tvayā kaiṭabhasūdana | muhyāmi ca prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ kathaṃ kartavyam ity aham || 9.1 śrībhagavān uvāca devarājyātparibhraṣṭo devendro brahmahatyayā | māṃ samārādhya vidhinā prāptavānātmanaḥ padam || 9.2 evam anye ca rājāno mamārāghanam uttamam | kṛtvā nirdhūya pāpāni pātakāni mahānty api || 9.3 prāpurlokān suduṣprāpāniṣṭānatyayavarjitān | ekottareṇa kalaśasahasreṇābhiṣecanam || 9.4 pavitravastusahitaiḥ pavitrajalapūritaiḥ | ārādhanaṃ mama brahman prīṇanaṃ paramaṃ matam || 9.5 pāpāpanodanaikāntaṃ sarvābhyudayasādhanam | prājānām api rāṣṭrasya rājñaś cāyurvivardhanam || 9.6 anuṣṭhitaṃ putrakāmais tathā vijayakāṅkṣibhiḥ | durbhikṣadurnimittādighorāṇāṃ śamanaṃ param || 9.7 sarvasampatkaraṃ sarvapuruṣārthaikasādhanam | ārādhanena tena tvaṃ māmārādhya yathāvidhi || 9.8 brahmā nirmuktamoho niṣpāpaḥ prajās tvaṃ sraṣṭum īśiṣe | sahasrakalaśasnānavidhiḥ kīdṛk kathaṃ bhavet || 9.9 pavitrāṇi ca vastūni kāni , ko hi bhavet kramaḥ | sthāpanaṃ kalaśānāṃ ca ko vā sthāpaka iṣyate || 9.10 śrībhagavān dvātriṃśaddhastavistāraṃ dviguṇenāyataṃ śubham | kalaśāspadabhūbhāge vaipulyānuguṇaṃ mahat || 9.11 maṇṭapaṃ kalpayitvā tu dvārāṇi ca yathāpuram | kalaśasthāpanābhūmiṃ pañcaviṃśatidhā samam || 9.12 vibhajya sūtrapātena madhyame brahmaṇaḥ pade | ekāśītighaṭāssthāpyā divye tu tadanantare || 9.13 bhāge pratyekamāśāsu pūrvādicatasṛṣv api | ekāśītighaṭāḥ sthāpyāḥ koṇānāṃ ca catuṣṭaye || 9.14 ūnā caikonapañcāśat pratyekaṃ mānuṣe punaḥ | bhāge ṣoḍaśadikṣu syāt pratyekaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ || 9.15 vīthikāś ca yathāyogaṃ kalpanīyāḥ pade pade | brāhme bhāge tu navake madhyame madhyame ghaṭe || 9.16 sarvalohāni ratnāni sarvāṇi ca phalāni ca | sarvauṣadhīś ca sarvāṃś ca gandhacūrṇāṃś ca nikṣipet || 9.17 śrīvatsādyāḥ pratikṛtīḥ kṛtvā niṣkapramāṇikāḥ | svarṇaṃ tāmraṃ ca rajataṃ kevalaṃ caiva nikṣipet || 9.18 śrīvatsaṃ vanamālāṃ ca śaṃkhaṃ <śaṅkhaṃ> cakraṃ gadāṃ tathā | padmaṃ khaḍgaṃ tathā śārṅgam aṣṭau cihnāni śārṅgiṇaḥ || 9.19 vāsobhyāṃ veṣṭite kumbhe vāsudevaṃ samarcayet | brāhma eva ca bhūbhāge parito navakoṣṭhake || 9.20 prācīnakumbhanavake madhyame kalaśe kṣipet | sūṛyakāntaṃ padmarāgaṃ puruṣas tasya devatā || 9.21 navakānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ kramād dravyaṃ ca devatāḥ | kumbhasya vakṣyate brahman madhyamasya pṛthakpṛthak || 9.22 vaiḍūryam indukāntaṃ ca dvayaṃ dravyaṃ ca devatā | vāsudevaś cendranīlo 'pyayaskāntaś ca tad dvayam || 9.23 devatā satyamūrtiḥ syāt pravālo vastu gāruḍam | saṅkarṣaṇo devatā syāt puṣyakaṃ sphaṭikadvayam || 9.24 dravyaṃ devo 'cyutaḥ , padmarāgaḥ kanakam eva ca | pradyumno devatā tasya vajraṃ rajatam eva ca || 9.25 ananto devatā tasya tāmraṃ muktā ca vastuni | devatā cāniruddhas syāt sarvakumbheṣu mauktikam || 9.26 divye bhāge diśi prācyām ekāśītighaṭāspade | navake madhyame madhyakalaśe kadalīphalam || 9.27 panasāmraṃ mātuluṅgaṃ havyajambukakesarāḥ | badarāṇi ca tattvātmā devatā tasya kathyate || 9.28 devatā dravyam anyatra navakeṣv aṣṭasūcyate | kramān madhyaghaṭe dravyaṃ mātuluṅgaṃ sadāḍimam || 9.29 pṛthivī devatā tasya , jambūnāraṅgam eva ca | devatā 'pām adhiṣṭhātrī , takkolailāphaladvayam || 9.30 tejasvī puruṣo devaḥ , kṣīrikāmalakadvayam | dravyaṃ devo jagatprāṇo drākṣākharjūrajaṃ phalam || 9.31 dravyaṃ viṣṇupadaṃ devaścūtaṃ pārāvatānvitam | devo manaḥ ; phalaṃ kṣudrapanasaṃ vastu , devatā || 9.32 ahaṅkāraṃ , phalaṃ bilvakadalyor vastu , devatā | buddhis sarveṣu kumbheṣu badarāṇi ca nikṣipet || 9.33 aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa pañcopaniṣadā punaḥ | kumbhānām api sarveṣām abhimantraṇam iṣyate || 9.34 ekāśītighaṭe yāmye madhye navakamadhyame | uśīraṃ kuṅkumaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī malayajaṃ muram || 9.35 hrīberamagaruṃ piṣṭvā kumbhe tatra vinikṣipet | trailokyamohanaṃ devam arcayen mantravittamaḥ || 9.36 navakeṣu tathā 'nyeṣu prācyādiṣu yathākramam | jalajo vairaṇīmūlaṃ , babhrur devas sabhājyate || 9.37 karpūrakāśmīram ubhau dravyaṃ , śauriś ca devatā | campakaṃ mukulaṃ māṃsī dāśārhaś cādhidevatā || 9.38 candanaṃ candanaṃ raktamannādhipatir acyutaḥ | sūraparṇīrajo mūraṃ kardamo vastu , devatā || 9.39 vaikuṇṭhī girijaṃ mūlaṃ priyaṅgvāś ca rajaḥkaṇāḥ | puruṣottamadaivatyaṃ kuṣṭhe dve dravyam ucyate || 9.40 mukundaḥ kṛṣṇadhavalo vakrarūpī vṛṣākapiḥ | tamālapatraṃ sarveṣu nikṣipet puruṣātmanā || 9.41 pavamānādibhir mantrair mantrayet tān sakṛtsakṛt | pratyekaṃ gandhavastūni kalāny aṣṭau yathoditam || 9.42 ekāśītighaṭagrāme vāruṇe brahmaṇaḥ pade | ghaṭe vāpisaritkūpahnadavṛṣṭihimāpagāḥ || 9.43 patyuḥ pāthāṃsi cāhṛtya taṭākeṣu ca nikṣipet | navakānām athānyeṣām aṣṭānāṃ madhyame ghaṭe || 9.44 pūrvoktāny eva vāpyādinīrāṇi kramaśaḥ kṣipet | madhyamān dravyakalaśān sarvān eva prapūrayet || 9.45 nalinīnirjharāmbhobhir matsyakūrmāv api dvayam | niṣkadvayaparicchinnakāñcanena vinirmitam || 9.46 kalaśeṣv eva navasu madhyameṣu vinikṣipet | matsyādirūpiṇaṃ devaṃ varjayitvā ca bhārgavam || 9.47 yathoktakumbhanavake krameṇaiva sabhājayet | ekāśītipade saumye madhye navakamadhyame || 9.48 yavagodhūmakavrīhiśāli mudgapriyaṅgukān | māṣaśyāmākanīvārān nikṣipet tatra pūjayet || 9.49 deveśaṃ garuḍārūḍhaṃ padmanābhaṃ yathāvidhi | dhānyāny etāni caikaikam anyeṣv aṣṭasu nikṣipet || 9.50 ghaṭeṣu madhyabhūteṣu kramāt sarvatra śālayaḥ | pūjayed vanamālāṃ ca śaṃkhaṃ <śaṅkhaṃ> cakraṃ ca kaustubham || 9.51 padmaṃ śāṅgaṃ gadāṃ khaṅgaṃ kramād uktaṃ ghaṭāṣṭake | pañcāśītighaṭeṣv agner ekoneṣu tathā diśi || 9.52 madhyamaṃ kumbhanavakam āghāreṇa prapūrayet | ṣaṭsv aindreṣu ca gomūtraṃ kṣīraṃ yāmyeṣu vāruṇe || 9.53 dadhi ṣaṭsu tathā saumye gomayaṃ ṣaṭsu nikṣipet | caturṣu kumbheṣv āgneye koṇe vāpy uṣṇam ucyate || 9.54 nairṛte
