pañcagavyāni pañcāmṛtamathānile | aiśāne saktubhis teṣu nārāyaṇasabhājanam || 9.55 nairṛtekonapañcāśadghaṭeṣu brahmaṇaḥ pade | tailena navakaṃ pūrya gandhādbhiṣ ṣaṭ puraḥsthitāḥ || 9.56 ghanasāradravair yāmye lājaiḥ kumbhe tu vāruṇe | saumye 'bhimantritāmbhobhiḥ koṇeṣu gulavāribhiḥ || 9.57 yajeta teṣu kumbheṣū vāsudevaṃ jagadgurum | mārutaikonapañcāśadghaṭeṣu navakaṃ punaḥ || 9.58 pūrya sarṣapatoyena prācyāṃ ṣaṭpādyavāribhiḥ | yāmye ṣaḍardhyaiḥ ṣaṭkumbhāḥ pratīcyācamanāmbubhiḥ || 9.59 ṣaṭ saumye maṅgalāmbhobhiḥ pūrayet kamalāsana | koṇeṣv ikṣurasaistatra samārādhyo 'niruddhakaḥ || 9.60 īśānaikonapañcāśadghaṭeṣu brahmaṇaḥ pade | navakaṃ madhubhiḥ pūrya prācyāṃ ṣaṭ sarvagandhakaiḥ || 9.61 śāntivāribhir anyatra ṣaṭkaṃ koṇe tu nairṛte | āgneye ca sthitāḥ kumbhā nālikerajalair api || 9.62 śārve ca vāyavīye ca pīyūṣair nālikerajaiḥ | yaṣṭavyo harir eteṣu kumbheṣu kamalāśana || 9.63 bhāge tu mānuṣe prācyāṃ kumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśake | madhyamaṃ pūrayen mṛdbhir vakṣyamāṇābhir aṣṭabhiḥ || 9.64 kṣetratīrthābdhiśaileṣu gajasūkarayor api | valmīkavṛṣayor mṛtsnā nyasyate madhyame ghaṭe || 9.65 aṣṭāsv anyeṣu kalaśeṣv ekaikāṃ tāṃ vinikṣipet | arcyaś ca keśavasteṣu kramād anyatra cocyate || 9.66 sahadevī vacā caiva śatamūlā śatāvarī | kumārī ca gulūcī ca siṃhī vyāghrīti cāṣṭamī || 9.67 mūlāni madhye caiteṣāṃ kalaśe madhyame kṣipet | ekaikam aṣṭāsv anyeṣu teṣu nārāyaṇārcanam || 9.68 nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthajambūbilvatvacāṃ rasāḥ | tathā palāśamadhukaśirīṣāṇām api tvacaḥ || 9.69 nyasanīyā ghaṭe madhye pratyekam itarāṣṭake | pūjyaś ca mādhavas teṣu turūṇāṃ pallavā ime || 9.70 palāśabilvapatraṃ ca kadambāmraśirīṣajāḥ | nyagrodhāśvatthajāś cāpi nyasanīyā vidheḥ pade || 9.71 ekaikam itareṣv arcyo govindo jātimallike | priyaṅgupadmabakulanandyāvartakacūtakāḥ || 9.72 kundaś ca puṣpāṇy eteṣāṃ nyasanīyāni madhyame | ekaikam aṣṭake 'nyatra teṣu viṣṇuś ca devatā || 9.73 siddhārtho rājasiddhārtho vaṃśo gorocanāpi ca | indraveṇuryavaṣṣaṣṭhiśśamī ca caṇakas tathā || 9.74 etāni madhyame kumbhe ekaikam itareṣu tat | teṣu pūjā madhuripos sarasīruhasambhava || 9.75 tilamāraṇyakaṃ grāmyaṃ jīrakadvayam eva ca | atasīsambhavaṃ bījaṃ śatapuṣpaṃ kumārakam || 9.76 ṛṣibījaṃ ca kalaśe madhyame 'nyatra pūrvavat | teṣāṃ trivikramo devo yaṣṭavyas sāṅgapīṭhakaḥ || 9.77 śyāmākaṣṣaṣṭikaśśālinīvāras syāc caturbhuja | dūrvākuśendravallīnām aṅkurāḥ pippalasya ca || 9.78 nyasyante madhyame kumbhe ghaṭeṣv anyatra pūrvavat | devatā vāmanas teṣu kuśā divyauṣadhās trayaḥ || 9.79 kāṃsyamūlamuśīrasya śarapuṃkhasya mūlikā | mūlikāstagarasyāpi tathāpāmārgamūlikā || 9.80 te madhye ca ghaṭe pūrve ghateṣv anyatra pūrvavat | devatā śrīdharas teṣāṃ tulasyau ca sitāsite || 9.81 veṇukesariṇoḥ patre patre ketakabilvayoḥ | śamīparṇaṃ tathā jāter madhyame 'nyatra pūrvavat || 9.82 devatā ca hṛṣīkeśo dvayaṃ mustākacorakam | kumudotpalayoḥ kandaṃ kahlāraṃ śītalīyakam || 9.83 nyasen madhye kuvalayaṃ kumbheṣv aṣṭasu pūrvavat | teṣāṃ devaḥ padmanābho mudgamāṣayavāṅkurāḥ || 9.84 niṣpāvaṃ tu varīvrīhikulutthānām athāṅkurāḥ | āḍhakasya ca kumbhānāṃ madhyame 'nyatra pūrvavat || 9.85 dāmodarārcanaṃ tatra śaṃkhapuṣpī balāṃ tathā | viṣṇukrāntā sadābhadrā padmam ekadalaṃ muram || 9.86 sahā ca sahadevyau ca nyasanīyā vidheḥ pade | anyatra pūrvavad devo yajñanārāyaṇo bhavet || 9.87 śvetārkaś ca tathaivāgnir bhadrā brahmasuvarcalā | sarasā ca viraktā ca pṛśniparṇī sthirā tathā || 9.88 eraṇḍakaṃ ghaṭe madhye anyatra syād yathāpuram | arcanīyo haris tatra surabhiḥ padmakesaram || 9.89 patramelā lavaṅgatvaṅ nāgakesaram eva ca | latā jātiphale madhye nyasanīyā vidheḥ pade || 9.90 ekaikam itareṣu syāt teṣu kṛṣṇaś ca devatā | suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ pratyekaṃ niṣkapañcakam || 9.91 kṛtvā padmākṛtiṃ kāṃsyaṃ darpaṇaṃ caṣakāni ca | ayolavitrādyākāraṃ trapusīsakapittalāḥ || 9.92 trayaṃ prakṛtirūpeṇa nyasyate madhyame ghaṭe | pratyekam itareṣv etad dhayagrīvo 'dhidaivatam || 9.93 kumbheṣv anyeṣu sarveṣu pūraṇaṃ gandhavāribhiḥ | sahasrakalaśasnāne deśikā bahavaḥ smṛtāḥ || 9.94 catvāro dviguṇaṃ vāpi teṣāṃ ṣoḍaśa ṛtvijaḥ | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvānvagadhidevārcanaṃ bhavet || 9.95 pañcopaniṣadair mantraiḥ sahasraṃ sarpiṣāhutiḥ | śāntyarthaṃ mūlamantreṇa juhuyāt samidādibhiḥ || 9.96 yāvad rajobhiḥ hāridrais snapanaṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ | mṛtsnābhir mānuṣe bhāge prakramya brahmaṇaḥ pade || 9.97 ratnodakāntaṃ kalaśaiḥ sahasreṇābhiṣecanam | mṛdā viṣṇor nu kam iti snapanaṃ mūlavāribhiḥ || 9.98 tadviṣṇor iti devasya kaṣāyakalaśāmbubhiḥ | pratadviṣṇur itīśasya vidyayā pallavāmbubhiḥ || 9.99 devasya tveti kusumais tavāmīty api sarṣapaiḥ | dhruvaḥ pātviti mantreṇa snapanaṃ tilavāribhiḥ || 9.100 bhadraṃ karṇeti mantreṇa ṣāṣṭikāmbubhir āplavaḥ | na te viṣṇur iti snānaṃ kuśamūlāmbubhir hareḥ || 9.101 irāvatīti mantreṇa tulasīdalavāribhiḥ | mustāmbubhir ato devā avantv iti caturmukha || 9.102 idaṃ viṣṇur iti snānaṃ muṣṇais trīṇi padeti ca | śaṃkhapuṣpyambubhiḥ śvetai raktaiḥ karmāṇi paśyate || 9.103 tadviṣṇoḥ paramam iti surabhyādijalais tataḥ | tadviprāsa iti snānaṃ lohair bhāge nṛṇām api || 9.104 divye bhāge tu paurastye ekāśītighaṭāspade | prāgādibrahmabhūmyantaṃ krameṇa snānam iṣyate || 9.105 aindre phalāmbubhiḥ snānaṃ yajñāyajñīyamantrakam | krameṇa mantrāḥ kathyante dravyakumbhāṣṭake yathā || 9.106 indrāviṣṇū pade mantro manīṣāpadalakṣitaḥ | vaṣaṭ te viṣṇor ity etat tisro vāca itīritaḥ || 9.107 iṣe tvorjeti mantreṇa stariritvamitīti ca | yasmin viśvāni vidyā ca parjanyāyeti lakṣitaḥ || 9.108 ekāśītipade yāmye snānaṃ gandhodakair ghaṭaiḥ | nārāyaṇānuvākasya ṛgbhir aṣṭābhir āditaḥ || 9.109 vyastābhir aṣṭabhiḥ snānaṃ sarvābhir madhyamena tu | digbhāge paścime brahmann ekāśītighaṭāspade || 9.110 prāgādibrahmabhūmyantaṃ snānaṃ vāpyādibhir jalaiḥ | mantrāḥ krameṇa vakṣyante pratidravyaghaṭāplavam || 9.111 yā āpa iti mantreṇa sindhudvīpeti vidyayā | eṣa te cety ṛcā snānam imaṃ me varuṇeti ca || 9.112 śaṃ no devīrabhīty eṣa yāsāṃ rājeti mantrataḥ | samudrajyeṣṭhamantreṇa yāsāṃ deveti vidyayā || 9.113 sūktena vāruṇenaiva snānaṃ dravyaghaṭair iti | ekāśīti ghaṭe saumye pūrvādyabjapadāvadhi || 9.114 dhānyādivastukumbhānāṃ navānāṃ mantra ucyate | trātāramindrasāmnā ca mantraścātvā vahantviti || 9.115 mantro jitaṃ ta ity eṣa āpo vahati lakṣitaḥ | mantraś ca tāvatīty eṣa sa tvaṃ no agnav ity ṛcā || 9.116 tvaṃ no agna ity ṛcā ca mahāvyāhṛtayas tathā | aṇoraṇīyānityanto mantraḥ snānavidhau kramāt || 9.117 ekonapañcāśatkumbheṣv agneḥ koṇe yathākramam | gomūtrādighaṭasnāne mantrāṇāṃ kathyate kramaḥ || 9.118 gāyatrī prathamā tāsāṃ payo vṛtam anantaram | dadhikrāvṇeti ca snānaṃ gandhadvārām itīdṛśam || 9.119 viṣṇor arāṭam iti ca mūrdhānaṃ diva ity ṛcā | hiraṇyagarbhamantreṇa āpyāyasveti vidyayā || 9.120 ghṛtasnāteti mantraś ca ghṛtasnānavidhau kramaḥ | ekonapañcāśatkumbhe pade nirṛtigocare || 9.121 mantrāḥ krameṇa vakṣyante vastukumbhair athāplave | rakṣoghnam iti sāmādyaṃ pavitraṃ na itīti ca || 9.122 bhagavān vāsudeveti sāmavedavratāhvayam | vairājasāmakathitaṃ tathā caivāparājitāḥ || 9.123 kathyante vāyukoṇe 'pi mantrasnānavidhau tathā | dvādaśākṣaramantraś ca drupadādiva ity asau || 9.124 aṣṭākṣarāhvayo mantraśśaṃ no devīr iti smṛtaḥ | hiraṇyapāṇir iti ca vedāham iti ca kramāt || 9.125 īśānakoṇe mantroktirānovīyur iti smṛtaḥ | śrīsūktaṃ madhumānnaś ca madhunakta itīti ca || 9.126 madhuvāteti koṇeṣu mantrakḷptir udāhṛtā | brāhme pade tu sūktasya pauruṣasyāditaḥ kramāt || 9.127 aṣṭāsu dravyakumbhānām aṣṭānāṃ mantra iṣyate | madhyame navake pūrvam aṣṭabhiś śuddhavāribhiḥ || 9.128 snāpayen mūlamantreṇa sahasreṇa ghaṭair iti | snāpite devadeveśe paścād ratnaghaṭāmbubhiḥ || 9.129 sūktena poruṣeṇaiva snāpayed deśikas svayam | ghaṭaiś śuddhodakair anyaiḥ snapanaṃ mūlavidyayā || 9.130 haridrācūrṇasampūrṇaiḥ pañcaviṃśatibhir ghaṭaiḥ | snapanaṃ saptadaśabhir yadvā ṣoḍaśasaṃmitaiḥ || 9.131 yadvā dvādaśabhiḥ kāryaṃ navabhir vā yathāvasu | ārādhya devamucitaṃ nivedya ca mahāhaviḥ || 9.132 homas sahasrairājyena samidbhir mūlavidyayā | annaiś caturvidhaiś caiva pratyṛcaṃ puruṣātmanā || 9.133 sūktena tuṣṭiṃ vastrādyair deśikānām anantaram | sahasrakalaśasnāne tatsaṃkhyā svarṇadakṣiṇā || 9.134 tadardham athavā pādo yathāśraddhaṃ yathāvasu | yāvatī dakṣiṇā teṣāṃ syād ardham atha ṛtvijām || 9.135 sahasraṃ brāhmaṇānannair bhojayed dakṣiṇām api | dadyāt tuṣṭikarīmanyānāgatān api toṣayet || 9.136 sevāṃ kurvanti ye martyāś śraddhābhaktisamanvitāḥ | devasya snānasamaye sahasrakalaśāmbubhiḥ || 9.137 gaṅgādisaritāṃ snānaphalam aśnuvate mahat | sahasrakalaśasnāne yatphalaṃ rājasūyake || 9.138 pūjānte tadaśeṣeṇa prāg uktam iti nocyate | mahotsavaphalenaitat viddhi tulyaphalaṃ smṛtam || 9.139
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde sahasrakalaśābhiṣekavidhir nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ
? daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
dhvajārohaṇavidhiḥ
brahmovāca kadā mahotsavaḥ kaścit kīdṛk tasya phalaṃ ca kim | phalakāmair anuṣṭhātum avijñāto na śakyate || 10.1 mahyaṃ jijñāsamānāya prasīda bhagavann idam | ākhyātum arhasi yathā mahotsavam anuttamam || 10.2 śrībhagavān ārādhanam idaṃ brahman mokṣakāmair anuṣṭhitam | paśvādiphalakāmais tu duranuṣṭhānam adbhutam || 10.3 toṣaṇaṃ mama kalyāṇam anuṣṭhitamamānuṣam | devair eva purā vṛtravadhapāpāpanuttaye || 10.4 indreṇāpi diviṣṭhena mām uddiśya kṛtaṃ śubham | rūpaṃ tasya pravakṣyāmi yathāvadavadhāraya || 10.5 sarve sāṃsārikaṃ duḥkham uttaranti tadambudhim | aṣṭākṣareti vidvāṃso nirbruvanty utsavāhvayam || 10.6 nityo nairmittikaḥ kāmyas trividhas sa mahotsavaḥ | tatra nityaṃ pratisamaṃ māsapakṣavyavasthayā || 10.7 śubhe ca tithinakṣatre viṣuve cāyanadvaye | kalpitāvabhṛthasnānaḥ sevitas sarvadaivataiḥ || 10.8 naimittikasya vijñeyo nimitte sati kalpitaḥ | avagrahe ca durbhikṣe colkāpāte tathā niśi || 10.9 darśane suracāpasya nālamīnasya darśane | devatāpratikāyānāṃ kampane bhedane tathā || 10.10 hamane calane caiva rodane patane tathā | gopurālayasālānāṃ maṇṭapasya ca bhedane || 10.11 bhaṅge vā patane vāpi parvatānāṃ tathaiva ca | nipāte caityavṛkṣasya bhaṅge jvalanadarśane || 10.12 vṛkṣe tv anyaphale dṛṣṭe divānakṣatradarśane | bhūtādidarśane ghore bhūmikampe tathaiva ca || 10.13 digdāhe ca mahāvāte mahāvṛṣṭau tathaiva ca | grahayuddhe ca sañjāte pratisūryasya darśane || 10.14 nṛpe rogābhibhūte ca grāme janapade tathā | masūrikādighorāṇāṃ vyādhīnāṃ ca praveśane || 10.15 paracakrapraveśe ca vyomni nemisvane tathā | divyadundubhinirhrāde nirmale gagane sati || 10.16 varṣe vāśanipāte ca śakradhvajanipātane | jale 'gnijanane caiva tathaivādbhutadarśane || 10.17 evam ādau mahotpāte naimittikamahotsataḥ | caturṇāṃ puruṣārthānām uddiśyānyatamaṃ phalam || 10.18 utsavo 'nuṣṭhitaḥ kāmyaḥ saṅkalpitaphalapradaḥ | kathyate 'vabhṛthasnānasamayas trividhotsave || 10.19 māsarkṣe viṣuve caiva grahaṇe cāyanadvaye | darśe ca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca śravaṇe sārvamāsike || 10.20 rohiṇyāñca punarvasvoḥ pratiṣṭhādivase tathā | rājño janmadine kuryād abhiṣekadine tathā || 10.21 ukteṣv avabhṛthasnānaṃ brahman sarvārthasādhanam | māsena vā tadardhena dvādaśāhena vā punaḥ || 10.22 navāhe notsavaḥ kāryas saptāhe na caturmukha | ahobhiḥ pañcabhir vāpi , tribhir vaikena vā punaḥ || 10.23 ekāhe tryahake dhīmān dhvajakarma na kārayet | saṅkalpapūrvam ālocya māse ṛkṣe tathā tithau || 10.24 tīrthāvagāhanaṃ yadvā saṃyoge tithitārayoḥ | viṣuve cāyane caiva nādarasthithitārayoḥ || 10.25 duṣṭavārādisaṃyoge śubham eva yathoditam | pattane nagare grāme pratilomānadhiṣṭhite || 10.26 aśūnye balidānādirathyāsu bahir ācaret | no ced āvaraṇeṣv eva kuryād antarmahotsavam || 10.27 grāmādirahite dhāmni notsavaṃ bahir ācaret | antarāvaraṇeṣv eva na tu tyājyaṃ kathañcana || 10.28 vāstvaṅge ca svatantre ca dhāmany utsavasampadi | yaugapadyena doṣas syād doṣo vāstvaṅgayor dvayoḥ || 10.29 svatantraṃ paratantraṃ cā(pyā)śrayaṃ samudāhṛtam | uttamādivibhedena ālayas trividho bhavet || 10.30 viṣṇvālayaṃ purā kalpya paścād grāmādikalpanam | svatantram iti vijñeyamālayaṃ tūttamaṃ bhavet || 10.31 grāmālayaṃ purā kalpya paścādālayakalpanam | asvatantram iti khyātamālayaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet || 10.32 svatantrālayakḷptāsu rathyāvīthīṣu padmaja | antare sthāpitaṃ yattadāśrayantvadhamālayam || 10.33 svatantre paratantre cāpy utsavādau kṛte sati | pūrvaṃ svatantre kartavyaṃ vāstvaṅge dviguṇārcanam || 10.34 āśrayādiṣu bimbeṣu utsavādau kṛte sati | tattadāvaraṇe kuryād bāhyavīthyāṃ tu nācaret || 10.35 mohād vā yadi vā lobhādviparīte kṛte sati | arātibhiḥ paribhavo mahāvyādhyādipīḍanam || 10.36 prāṅgaṇeṣu ca sarveṣu prāsādādiṣu mūrtiṣu | prītyābhiṣekamātraṃ ca snapanādyutsavaṃ vinā || 10.37 kārayed yadi saṃmohāt prajānāṃ pīḍanaṃ tathā | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena viparītaṃ tu nācaret || 10.38 anyathā kārayen mohād rājā rāṣṭraṃ ca naśyati | grāmāśrayādiberāṇām ālayāśrayakeṣu ca || 10.39 grāmavāstubalirhīnaṃ kevalotsavam ācaret | devatāntarakalyāṇe vartamāne 'pi vaiṣṇavam || 10.40 kuryād devotsavaṃ naiva vaiṣṇave 'nyaṃ kadācana | vāsudevo hi devānāṃ devatāmnāyate yataḥ || 10.41 utsave devadevasya dhvajārohaṇapūrvake | pravartite devayāge caulādir naiva saṃskriyā || 10.42 grāmādyanaṅgāyatane pravṛtte 'py utsave punaḥ | kuryād devāntaraṃ yāgaṃ caulādir naiva saṃskriyā || 10.43 toraṇādīni cānyeṣāṃ devānām utsave satām | uptāṭya rathyāsu harer utsavo nānyathā bhavet || 10.44 kltpānām utsave viṣṇo rathyādiṣv itarotsavaḥ | sthirāṇāṃ toraṇādīnāṃ kāryaṃ notpāṭanaṃ bhavet || 10.45 adhike māsi śukre ca gurau cāstamite sati | notsavaḥ prathamaḥ kalpyaḥ kalpane rājarāṣṭrayoḥ || 10.46 prajānāṃ caiva duḥkhaṃ syād vyādhir vā mṛtir eva vā | utsave ca dvitīyādau noktadoṣaḥ kathañcana || 10.47 māsādāv utsavadine pañcāhāvadhike kramāt | dhvajārohaṇakālas tu brahmannadya pradarśyate || 10.48 ekonaviṃśatitame dine tīrthāṅkurārpaṇāt | aṣṭādaśadine vāpi prāg eva samaye śubhe || 10.49 vainateyadhvajārohād dvādaśāhe 'thavā bhavet | yadvā kalyāṇadivasaṃ triguṇīkṛtya tāvatām || 10.50 ādau dinānāṃ kartavyaṃ dhvajārohaṇam abjaja | aṅkurān arpayitvāhni puṣye pūrvaṃ yathodite || 10.51 dhvajam āropayet paścān maṅgalaṃ maṅgale dine | devādvā mānuṣādvāpi kutaścit kāraṇādyadi || 10.52 utsavārambhaṇāt pūrvaṃ yathoktena kṛte dhvaje | utsavārambhaṇadine divāropya dhvajaṃ niśi || 10.53 bherītāḍanam anvak ca pālikāsv aṅkurān kṣipet | āghoṣya bherīṃ prathamaṃ dhvajārohaṇamanvataḥ || 10.54 tato 'ṅkurārpaṇaṃ yadvā yadvā niśyaṅkurārpaṇam | pradoṣe 'nvak dhvajāroho bherītāḍanamanvataḥ || 10.55 tatkāle 'pi dhvajārohe traividhyaṃ caturānana | tantūtthaṃ kṣaumavasanaṃ nirdoṣaṃ sūkṣmam āhṛtam || 10.56 kārpāsaṃ vā yathāvittaṃ dhvajārthe kalpayed budhaḥ | āyataṃ daśabhir hastair vistīrṇaṃ pañcabhir dṛḍham || 10.57 navabhir vāṣṭabhir vāpi saptabhir vā caturmukha | mūlaberasamāyāmaṃ dvārāyāmam athāpi vā || 10.58 āyāmārdhena vistīrṇaṃ pādena kṛtaśekharam | śekhareṇa samaṃ pucchaṃ tadardhaṃ karṇapucchakam || 10.59 nirṇejitaṃ khalīyuktaṃ śoṣitaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam | āhṛtya madhye vastrasya garuḍaṃ kāñcanaprabham || 10.60 navatālapramāṇena dvibhujaṃ dhṛtakañcukam | dhṛtapuṣpāñjalipuṭaṃ śvetāmbaradharaṃ vibhuṃ || 10.61 daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam | nīlanāsāgrasaṃyuktaṃ kuñcitāsavyapādakam || 10.62 pṛṣṭhe niviṣṭasavyāṅghriṃ pakṣavikṣepaśobhitam | gagane gamanārambhaṃ suvṛttaṃ ghoradarśanam || 10.63 karaṇḍikāmakuṭinaṃ lalāṭe racitālakam | hārakeyūravalayanūpurābharaṇojvalam || 10.64 ananto vāmakaṭako yajñasūtraṃ ca vāsukiḥ | urasi nyastakārkoṭaṃ kaṭisūtritatakṣakam || 10.65 bibhrāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe karṇe padmāhvayasarīsṛpam | mahāpadmaṃ tathānyatra śaṃkhaṃ śirasi bhoginam || 10.66 gulikaṃ cāṅgade sarpaṃ varṇas teṣāṃ ca kathyate | sphaṭikābhaś śoṇitābhaḥ pītābho dhūmravarṇakaḥ || 10.67 raktāmbujanibhaś caiva piṅgalastuhinaprabhaḥ | bhramarābhaḥ kramāc chatraṃ muktāhemapariṣkṛtam || 10.68 upariṣṭāc ca kartavyaṃ pārśvayoś cāmaradvayam | adhastād ambujaṃ pūrṇakumbhamadbhiś ca pālikāḥ || 10.69 sāṅkurā likhitavyāḥ syur dīpau dvau pārśvayor dvayoḥ | pañcavarṇair likhed evam antaraṃ śyāmavarṇakam || 10.70 antarālaṃ tu kṛṣṇena citayec citrakṛttamaḥ | dhvajārdhasaṃmitāṃ caiva patākāṃ caiva citrayet || 10.71 adhivāsadine prāpte tamisrāyāṃ guruḥ svayam | kāruśālāṃ praviśyātha kārayitvātha śilpinā || 10.72 nayanonmīlanaṃ tasmin visṛṣṭe śilpinīpsitaiḥ | arthaiś ca toṣite paścān nikṣipya śirasi dhvajam || 10.73 mūrtipasya suvarṇādilohapātre samarpitam | prādakṣiṇyena dhāmādīn nītvā tūryanināditam || 10.74 tataḥ praveśayed yāgamaṇṭapaṃ deśikottamaḥ | nayanonmīlanād anyat pratiṣṭhāyāmivācaret || 10.75 chāyādhivāsanaṃ sadyo jale kuryād yathāvidhi | kumbhaiṣ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ snāyāt snapanaṃ darpaṇe bhavet || 10.76 pauruṣeṇaiva sūktena gāyatryā svasya pūjayet | śāyayec chālibhārādāvāstīrṇe navavāsasi || 10.77 śāyitasya paṭasyādho 'pasavye sahāṣṭabhiḥ | parito nyastakalaśair vardhanyā ca ghaṭaṃ kṣipet || 10.78 āvāhya garūḍaṃ kumbhe karake ca sudarśanam | indrādīnaṣṭa pūrvādikalaśeṣu supūjayet || 10.79 śodhayitvā ca garuḍaṃ paṭasthaṃ śoṣaṇādibhiḥ | saṃhṛtya tattvāni tataḥ kramād utpādya pakṣiṇam || 10.80 caturṣu pārśvakuṇḍeṣu homasthaṇḍilabhūmiṣu | kuṇḍe mahānase vāpi samidājyair yathāpuram || 10.81 śāntihomasparśanaṃ ca secanaṃ ca yathāpuram | paṭaṃ vistīrya garuḍaṃ mandirābhimukhaṃ yathā || 10.82 pradarśyāvāhayet tatra vyāhṛtyā sannidhiṃ tataḥ | prārthayeta gurus tasya gāthayā vakṣyamāṇayā || 10.83 mahāvala mahābāho vainateya vayo 'dhipa | sannidhatsva paṭe tubhyaṃ namaḥ praṇavamūrtaye || 10.84 karmaṇāṃ siddhimāhūtaḥ karuṣva vihageśvara | āhūtavyās trayo lokā devasyotsavasampadi || 10.85 yajed ātmīyagāyatryā tamardhyādyupacaryayā | nivedayet tatas tasmai naivedyaṃ ca caturvidham || 10.86 kumbhāya ca nivedyānnaṃ stotrair garuḍatoṣaṇam | vāhanāya mahāviṣṇos tārkṣyāyāmitatejase || 10.87 garuḍāya namastubhyaṃ sarvasarpendramṛtyave | namo namaste pakṣīndra svādhyāyavapuṣe namaḥ || 10.88 vihagendra namaste 'stu samutpāṭitakalpaka | āśritāmṛtakumbhāya jananīdāsyamocine || 10.89 surāsurendrajayine nāgendrābharaṇāya te | yadādhāram idaṃ sarvaṃ tadādhārāya te namaḥ || 10.90 pakṣau yasya bṛhatsāma rathantaram api dvayam | akṣiṇī cāpi gāyatrī trivṛtsāma śiraḥ smṛtam || 10.91 stoma ātmā namas tasmai vāmadevyāṅgasampade | namaḥ prāṇādivāyūnām īśāya garuḍātmane || 10.92 doṣānapanayākhaṇḍān guṇān āvaha sarvataḥ | vighnāni jahi sarvāṇi ātmasātkuru mām api || 10.93 stutvaivaṃ gāruḍaṃ mantraṃ japed ekāgramānasaḥ | tūryaghoṣair vedaghoṣair jāgareṇa nayen niśām || 10.94 nivedyaṃ kavalīkṛtya mantrayitvā ca mantravit | pauruṣair gāruḍair mantrair vandhyānām api yoṣitām || 10.95 kṣiped añjaliṣu dhyātvā garuḍaṃ cācyutaṃ harim | bhakṣayitvā trayaḥ piṇḍān janayeyus sutān bahūn || 10.96 taṃ prabhāte samārādhya nivedya ca haviḥ kramāt | vastrābharaṇapuṣpais tu paṭasthaṃ śobhayet khagam || 10.97 āropya hastipṛṣṭhe vā rathe vānyatra maṅgale | śibikādau nayed grāmaṃ prādakṣiṇyena dhāma vā || 10.98 bherīmṛdaṅgapaṭahaiḥ śaṃkhakāhalacihnakaiḥ | ghoṣayet puratas tasya nṛttair geyaiś ca sarvataḥ || 10.99 khageśavādyayor madhye pālikāścāṅkurānvitāḥ | vaheyur brāhmaṇās sarve śirobhiḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ || 10.100 bimbamautsavam anvac ca garuḍasyāntike 'thavā | icchayā yajamānasya sarvamaṅgalasaṃyutam || 10.101 agrato balipīṭhasya bahir vā dhāmagopurāt | dhvajastambhaṃ khaned bhūmau nirdoṣaṃ dāravaṃ sthiram || 10.102 antassāro bahissāro nissāro trividhastaruḥ | kamukādi bahissāraṃ praśastaṃ vidur uttamam || 10.103 antassāraṃ candanādi praśastaṃ stambhakalpane | nissāraṃ varjayet stambhaṃ śatatālāyataṃ śubham | 10.104 mānāṅgulapramāṇena viṃśatyūnam athāpi vā | prāsādocchrāyam athavā yadvā gopurasaṃmitam || 10.105 caturdhā vibhajet stambham ekāṃśenaiva mastakam | tasya cādhārabhūtānāṃ chidritānāṃ ca mūlataḥ || 10.106 trayāṇām api pīṭhānāṃ stambhāgre viniveśanam | āyatāni ca pīṭhāni dvitālena caturmukha || 10.107 vistīrṇāni tadardhena tadardhena ghanāni ca | mūle sthūlāni sūkṣmāṇi cāgre yuñjīta bhūruhān || 10.108 agre pīṭhadvayoś chedre dhvajayaṣṭiṃ ca saṃskṛtām | niveśayec chidrayitvā dhvajastambhaṃ caturmukha || 10.109 niveśayed veṇukaṃ vā nava vā sapta pañca vā | itthambhūtaṃ dhvajastambhaṃ pīṭhasyottarapārśvataḥ || 10.110 ānāyya vedavidvipraiḥ prāgagraṃ śāyayed guruḥ | yadvodagagraṃ prakṣālya stambhamabliṅgamantrataḥ || 10.111 kuśaiś ca sāgraiḥ pracchādya stambham ūrdhvamukhaiś śubhaiḥ | saṃveṣṭya darbhamālābhir viṣṇusūktena deśika || 10.112 dhvajastambhāvaṭe nyasya lohabījādi śodhitam | tatrāvaṭe dhvajastambhaṃ sthāpayitvā dṛḍhaṃ yathā || 10.113 prāsādābhimukhaṃ tasya veṇvagravivare dhvajam | pāśenāṅguṣṭhanāhena triguṇīkṛtya tantunā || 10.114 dhvajaṃ niveśayed yadvā stambham āruhya bandhayet | baddhadhvajāgrastambhaṃ vā sthāpayec chaktyapekṣayā || 10.115 evaṃ niyojya yaṣṭyagre muhūrte śobhane guruḥ | pūrvāhṇe vātha madhyāhne dhvajam āropayet tathā || 10.116 baddhvā puruṣamaṃtreṇa sapatākaṃ saghaṇṭakam | suparṇo 'sīti mantreṇa dhvajasyāropaṇaṃ bhavet || 10.117 prāsādābhimukhaṃ sthāpya khagendraṃ paṭasaṃsthitam | tūryaghoṣaṃ tathāmnāyaghoṣaṃ dikṣu ca ghoṣayet || 10.118 khageśamālāmantrādīṃs tatkāle deśiko japet | stambhamūlasthale vediṃ hastais saptabhir āyatām || 10.119 tāvadbhir eva vistīrṇām ekahastasamucchritām | pañcabhir vā tribhir vāpi caturaśrāṃ prakalpayet || 10.120 vedikāyās tṛtīyāṃśe madhye pīṭhaṃ prakalpayet | catuṣṭayāṅgulotsedhaṃ mekhalātrayasaṃyutam || 10.121 bhāge tṛtīye tasyāpi padmam aṣṭadalair yutam | karṇikāsthe yathā stambhas tathā kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ || 10.122 ṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyuktā prapā syāt paritas tataḥ | caturdvārasamāyuktāṃ darbhamālādyalaṅkṛtām <�alaṃkṛtām> || 10.123 puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātha prokṣayet kumbhavāriṇā | gāruḍenaiva mantreṇa kalaśaiś cāṣṭabhis tathā || 10.124 indrādyaiḥ prokṣayet stambhaṃ svais svair mantrair yathākramam | prārthayeta sthitiṃ tasya garuḍasya dhvajodare || 10.125 utsavāvabhṛthaṃ yāvat gāthayā vakṣyamāṇayā | pakṣīndra pakṣavikṣepataraṅgānilasampadā || 10.126 nirastāsurasannāha samare śatrubarhaṇa | sannidhatsva paṭe yāvad utsavāvabhṛthāvadhi || 10.127 utsavapratimāṃ yānamāropya śibikādikam | dhvajastambhasamīporvīmānīyādarśayet khagam || 10.128 āhvānārthamaśeṣāṇāṃ lokānāṃ patageśvaram | niyujya devas tadanu prāpnuyān maṇḍapāvanim || 10.129 ārādhayet trikālaṃ ca garuḍaṃ ca nivedayet | anirvāṇaṃ yathā dīpaṃ rakṣennaktandivaṃ sadā || 10.130 utsavapratimāṃ tatra maṇḍape ca yathāvidhi | pūjayitvā nivedyātha havirhomāntam arcayet || 10.131 rātrau ca pūjayitvaivaṃ bherītāḍanasiddhaye | dhvajapīṭhasya purataḥ kṣitiṃ gomayavāriṇā || 10.132 ālipya caturaśraṃ ca sudhācūrṇaiś ca śobhayet | caturaśraṃ dhānyapīṭhaṃ śālināṃ droṇapañcakam || 10.133 kalpayitvā kālacakraṃ tasya madhye niveśayet | balyarcām api tatraiva sthāpayed dhvajasaṃmukham || 10.134 pūjayitvā nivedyātha havīṃṣi vividhāni vā | ālipte puratas tasya bhūtale dhānyapīṭhake || 10.135 tāvad eva mahābherīṃ veṣṭitāṃ navavāsasā | dakṣiṇetarayostasyā bherikāyā yathākramam || 10.136 bhāgayor arcayed viṣṇuṃ śriyaṃ caiva yathāvidhi | triguṇāṃ prakṛtiṃ caiva madhyabhāge sabhājayet || 10.137 muhūrte śobhane bherīṃ śabdatanmātravidyayā | koṇena tāḍayen mūrtitrayaṃ dhyāyed guruḥ svayam || 10.138 tataḥ pāraśavaḥsnāto darbhapāṇir alaṅkṛtaḥ | sopavītottarīyaś ca vahan bherīm alaṅkṛtāṃ || 10.139 śaṃkhādivādyasahitāṃ tālabhedavidhānavit | ghoṣayed guruṇendrādau hūyamāne marudgaṇe || 10.140 divyāyudhānāmāhvānaṃ tathā vaikuṇṭhavāsinām | tathā pāriṣadās sarve viṣvaksenābhirakṣitāḥ || 10. 141 āhūtavyā makhe tasmin kumudādyās sanāyakāḥ | ṛṣibhiś ca marīcyādyair brahmalokanivāsibhiḥ || 10.142 samāhvānaṃ viriñcasya indralokanivāsibhiḥ | sārdhaṃ pramathasārthaiśra rudraś ca vṛṣavāhanaḥ || 10.143 āhūtavyās tathānye ca tattallokanivāsinaḥ | vāhanaiḥ parivāraiś ca sākaṃ tasmin mahotsave || 10.144 vidyāś ca mūrtidhāriṇyastrayī cāṅgair vapuṣmatī | āhūtavyās samāhvānaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca svanāmabhiḥ || 10.145 nityotsavārcā parito vīthikāsu sudarśanam | annamūrtividhānaṃ ca pradīpair bahubhir vṛtam || 10.146 gamayitvā pratidiśaṃ bherītāḍanapūrvakam | grāmamadhyaṃ samāsādya tatrāvāhya caturmukham || 10.147 arcayitvā makhe tasmin yācitvā sannidhiṃ guruḥ | indrādīṃś ca pratidiśaṃ balyarthaṃ sannidhiṃ tathā || 10.148 arcayitvā tūryaghoṣaṃ ghoṣayitvā svatālavit | anyatra gāruḍaṃ tasyā antarāleṣu ghoṣayet || 10.149 praviśya mandiraṃ tatra yathāpūrvaṃ niveśayet | ādāyotsavabimbaṃ vā kevalaṃ vā sudarśanam || 10.150 annamūrtividhānaṃ vā bherīmādāya kevalām | rathyāsu devatāhvānaṃ tatra tatra yathāvidhi || 10.151 devatāhvānavelāyāṃ bherīṃ śṛṇvanti ye narāḥ | tair nadītaraṇaṃ naiva yānaṃ vā yojanātparam || 10.152 anādṛtyotsavaṃ mohād dūraṃ yāyājjano yadi | sa yāti nirayasthānaṃ pretya duḥkham ihāpi vā || 10.153 tasmād avabhṛthaṃ yāvad vaset tatraiva no vrajet | dhvajārthamaṅkurā yena nyastās sa yadi kāraṇāt || 10.154 kutaścid asamartho vā mṛto vā deśikottamaḥ | śeṣaṃ samāpayed anyaḥ putro vā tadanujñayā || 10.155 śiṣyo vā yadi vā bhrātā ṛtvig vā guṇavattaraḥ |
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde dhvajārohaṇavidhir nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ
? ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
mahotsavavidhiḥ śrībhagavān uvāca utsavārambhadivasādarvāgahani saptame | aṅkurānarpayellagne śobhane deśikottamaḥ || 11.1 aṣṭottaraśateṣv eva pālikāsu yathāvidhi | ṣaṭtriṃśatsv athavā paścād alaṅkārais samācaret || 11.2 kramukair dārujair vāpi toraṇair vīthikāmukham | catvarāṇi tathāgreṣu gopurāṇām alaṅkriyā || 11.3 phalabhārāvanamrāś ca kadalīkramukādayaḥ | pārśveṣu toraṇānāṃ syuḥ sthāpyāgamanavīthayaḥ || 11.4 samabhūmitalāḥ kāryās sikatābhiś ca śobhitāḥ | dukūlakṣaumavāsobhir darbhamālāśatena ca || 11.5 dhvajaiś ca sarvato dikṣu śobhayec ca prapādibhiḥ | śodhayet sarvabhūbhāgaṃ gomayāmbhobhir āplutaiḥ || 11.6 prāsādabhittayaḥ kāryāścitritā varṇapañcakaiḥ | rambhābhiḥ pūrṇakumbhaiś ca dīpikāvalibhis tathā || 11.7 muktādāmabhir anyaiś ca sāṅkuraiḥ pālikāśataiḥ | deśād deśāt sametānāṃ varṇānāṃ ca tadutsave || 11.8 sevituṃ devadeveśamannādyais tuṣṭimāvahet | prapāpānīyaśālādyair yajamāno divāniśam || 11.9 rogārtānatha bhaiṣajyair bhiṣajed dhanarāśibhiḥ | prathamāvaraṇe brahman kārayitvā ca maṇṭapam || 11.10 yadvāvakāśānuguṇaṃ dvitīyāvaraṇe bhavet | antarāleṣu sarvatra diśāmiṣṭe ca tadbhavet || 11.11 saptahastāyataṃ yadvā pañcahastāyataṃ śubham | vistārāyāmasadṛśaṃ caturdvārasamanvitam || 11.12 maṇḍapaṃ kārayet tasya paritaḥ kārayet prapām | tasya madhye triyaṃśe tu vediṃ hastasamucchritām || 11.13 vistīrṇāṃ dvitrihastena vedyāḥ prācyāṃ prakalpayet | kuṇḍam āhavanīyasya caturaśraṃ yathoditam || 11.14 dakṣiṇasyāṃ dakṣiṇāgner diśi cāpasamākṛti | kuṇḍaṃ ca gārhapatyasya pratīcyāṃ vṛttam adbhutam || 11.15 sabhyasya kuṇḍaṃ kauberyāṃ trikoṇaṃ tadanantaram | aiśānyāmagnikoṇe vā kuṇḍaṃ ca caturaśrakam || 11.16 āvasathyasya śikhinaḥ pañcāgnyutsavam uttamam | yadvāvasathyarahitaṃ caturagniṃ caturdiśam || 11.17 sabhyāvasathyarahitaṃ yadvāgnitrayasaṃyutam | ekam āhavanīyaṃ vā kalpayet kartur icchayā || 11.18 aśvatthādidrumair dvāratoraṇāni caturdiśam | sruksruvau kārayed aṣṭamaṅgalāni yathāpuram || 11.19 āsanāny ṛtvijāṃ homapātrāṇi vividhāni ca | maṇṭapānāṃ ca purataḥ prapā syāt pārśvayor api || 11.20 dukūlakṣaumakauśeyair vicitrair maṇṭapaṃ prapām | vitānayed veṣṭayec ca stambhān antarbahiḥsthitān || 11.21 muktādāmāni sarvatra lambayed dīpamālikāḥ | āropayec ca stambheṣu patākāvalibandhanam || 11.22 muktāvitānaṃ badhnīyāt puṣpamālāś ca sarvataḥ | evamādipariṣkārair bhūṣayen maṇṭapādikam || 11.23 tiraskariṇyo vipulā badhnīyāc ca vicitritāḥ | agre caturṇāṃ varaṇamācāryāṇām atha rtvijām || 11.24 ṣoḍaśānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ svīkāraḥ paricāriṇām | te ca bhūsyā yathāvittaṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ kaṭakādibhiḥ || 11.25 vāsobhiś ca navaiś citrair adhikārānusārataḥ | uṣṇīṣair uttarīyaiś ca gandhadravyānulepanaiḥ || 11.26 śobhanīyāḥ prayatnena yajamānena sarvathā | snapanaṃ cotsavārambhe tadante ca yathoditam || 11.27 kuryād devasya pūrvedyuḥ kautukaṃ bandhayed guruḥ | sauvarṇe rājate vāpi pātre kalamataṇḍulaiḥ || 11.28 khārīdvayāt tadardhena yadvā pādena sammite | nyaset sūtraṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ kṣaumaṃ kārpāsam eva vā || 11.29 saptabhiḥ pañcabhir vāpi sūtraṃ kṣaumāditantubhiḥ | śatena ṣaṣṭyārūḍhena phalaiḥ kramukajair api || 11.30 nāgavallīdalais sārdhaṃ phalasaṃkhyā caturguṇaiḥ | tadardhair vā tadardhair vā kadalyādiphalair api || 11.31 sārdhaṃ tadanu tatpātraṃ sādhāraṃ nyasya mūrdhani | vastreṇācchāditaṃ chatracāmaravyajanānvitam || 11.32 sahasradīpasaṃyuktaṃ savitānaṃ ca mūrtipaḥ | paṭhadbhiś śākunaṃ sūktaṃ brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ || 11.33 tūryamaṅgalagītaiś ca sārdhaṃ nītvā pradakṣiṇam | dhāma viṣṇos tathā tasya bahirāvaraṇāni ca || 11.34 prādakṣiṇyena vā grāmaṃ praviśed devatāntikam | devasya purato bhūmau tale gomayavāriṇā || 11.35 ālipte caturaśre ca śālibhāreṇa pūrite | pātraṃ nidhāya puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā yathāvidhi || 11.36 sabhājayitvā tatsūtram astramantreṇa deśikaḥ | aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tat gṛhītvā hastayor dvayoḥ || 11.37 aparājitayā sūtraṃ candanakṣodavāriṇā | ālipya dakṣiṇe haste baddhvā cotsavakautukam || 11.38 spṛṣṭvā dakṣiṇahastena sūtraṃ vārāṃś ca tajjapet | astramantraṃ tathārdhyādyair iṣṭvā devaṃ nivedayet || 11.39 mahāpūpaṃ tathāpūpān pṛthukāṃś ca phalāny api | geyaṃ nṛttaṃ tathā vādyamācared devatāntike || 11.40 tribhir bhāgavatair devaṃ sthāne 'nyatra niveśayet | snānāntaṃ kṣaumavasanam āliptaṃ cāñjanādinā || 11.41 bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇais sarvais sragviṇaṃ devadaivatam | arcayitvā yathāśāstraṃ paramānnaṃ nivedayet || 11.42 yathoditaṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ tathā śayyānukalpanam | bimbañ copari vinyasya śayane sthāpayec chume || 11.43 koṇeṣu sthāpayed dīpān pālikās sāṅkurās tathā | tūryaghoṣais tathā vedais stotrais stutvā madhudviṣam || 11.44 niśāṃ nayej jāgareṇa samāhitamanā guruḥ | śvobhūte śobhane prāpte muhūrte bhāskarodaye || 11.45 uttiṣṭhetyādimantreṇa tribhir bhāgavataiḥ saha | dikṣu śākunikaṃ sūktaṃ paṭhatsu brāhmaṇeṣv api || 11.46 utthāpya śayanād devaṃ tamidaṃ viṣṇur ity ṛcā | āropayeyuś śibikāṃ sauvarṇaprabhayā saha || 11.47 vaheyur bhūsurā yānaṃ dhyāyanto vihagādhipam | vikiret sarvato dikṣu puṣpāṇi surabhīṇi ca || 11.48 lājāṃś ca sākaṃ muktābhis tūryaghoṣaiś ca nādayet | īdṛśair maṅgalair anyais sarvāvaraṇabhūmikāḥ || 11.49 nītvā pradakṣiṇaṃ yānādavaromya prabhānvite | bhadrāsane dukūlādicitrāstaraṇaśobhite || 11.50 pārśve kalpadrumacchāyāśītale svarṇanirmite | niveśya maṇṭape sarvam upacāraṃ samācaret || 11.51 prāhṛtaṃ cāhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ dravyam utsavakāraṇam | devāya darśayet sarvaṃ janasaṃsadi deśikaḥ || 11.52 kṛtvopacāram akhilaṃ tadbimbaṃ snānamaṇṭape | snāpayed devadeveśaṃ yathāpūrvoditaiḥ kramaiḥ || 11.53 ācāryo yajamānaś ca samīkṣya vibhavodayam | mahāhavir nivedyānte hutvā havyair yathāvidhi || 11.54 garbhagehaṃ vimānasya nayen maṅgalasaṃyutam | tato 'parāhṇasamaye cāṅkurādhāramṛttikām || 11.55 ānetuṃ bahir udyānabhūmer yadvā nadītaṭāt | yānamāropya garuḍaṃ senānyaṃ vā pariṣkṛtam || 11.56 devādeśaṃ puraskṛtya sarvamaṅgalasaṃyutam | vahadbhiḥ pālikāḥ pūrvaṃ khanitraṃ cāpi bhūṣitam || 11.57 brāhmaṇair bahubhir vedānadhīyānais samantataḥ | nītvā pradakṣiṇaṃ grāmaṃ tato nirgatya deśikaḥ || 11.58 diśaṃ prācīm udīcīṃ vā pratisaṃgṛhya mṛttikām | yathāpūrvoditaṃ dhāma praviśya rajanīmukhe || 11.59 pradoṣe yāgasadasi pālikā dvādaśāvarāḥ | śarāvakumbhasahitās tadvargā api ṣoḍaśa || 11.60 īśānabhāge saṃsthāpya somakumbhasamanvitāḥ | āvapet tāsu bījāni muhūrte śobhane guruḥ || 11.61 tataḥ praviśya sadanaṃ yajamāno guruś ca tau | praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau devam utsavasampadam || 11.62 yācetāṃ gurur anvak ca baddhvā kalyāṇakautukam | utsavasnānabalyarthaṃ pratimāsu yathākramam || 11.63 sudarśane ca śayane kalpite 'nyatra pūrvavat | baddhvā pratisaraṃ sarvamadhivāsya yathākramam || 11.64 utthāpya sadyaścārādhya prādakṣiṇyena mandiram | nītvā praveśya yāgārthamaṇṭapaṃ tatra cāsane || 11.65 nityotsavārcāṃ cakraṃ ca niveśya tadanantaram | vedikāyāṃ dhānyapīṭhaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoditakramāt || 11.66 tatra prakṣālitān kumbhān sūtreṇa pariveṣṭitān | gandhodakena sampūrṇānnavaratnayutān nava || 11.67 sarvagandharajomiśrān karakeṇa samanvitān | pratyekaṃ nyastasauvarṇaniṣkānaśvatthapallavaiḥ || 11.68 kuśakūrcena sahitān mukheṣv eva samallikān | madhyamaṃ vastrayugmena śiṣṭān ekena vāsasā || 11.69 veṣṭitān vedikābhūmau sthāpayed dhānyarāśiṣu | āyataṃ saptabhir hastaiḥ ṣaḍbhir vā cātha pañcabhiḥ || 11.70 vistīrṇaṃ vastramāyāmamānārdhena niyojayet | bhagavanmayavipraiś ca puṇyāham api vācayet || 11.71 dvāratoraṇakumbhādīn pratiṣṭhāyāmivārcayet | madhyakumbhe mūlaberaṃ karake ca sudarśanam || 11.72 pūrvādyāśāgate kumbhe vāsudevādikān yajet | āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu yaṣṭavyāḥ puruṣādayaḥ || 11.73 krameṇa puruṣas satyas tathaivācyutadevatā | anantaś ceti haviṣā caturṇāṃ ca nivedanam || 11.74 dvārakumbhe tathāstre ca balibimbe 'ṣṭamaṅgalam | veṣṭitaṃ vāsasā veder adhastād dhānyarāśiṣu || 11.75 nyasyābhyarcya caturdikṣu veditūryādighoṣaṇe | pravṛtte juhuyād agnau dhyāyannāhavanīyake || 11.76 vāsudevaṃ dakṣiṇe 'gnau saṅkarṣaṇam anantare | pradyumnaṃ paścime cāgnāv udīcīne 'niruddhakam || 11.77 āvasathye mūlamūrtim iṣṭvā tīrthāvasānikam | sannidhiṃ prārthya kuṇḍeṣu juhuyāt sarpirādibhiḥ || 11.78 sarpiṣā ca prasūnaiś ca dhūpadravyaiś ca padmaja | samidhā payasā dadhnā tilavrīhiyavais tathā || 11.79 tattaddaivatamantreṇā(pya)ṣṭottaraśataṃ pṛthak | aṣṭāviṃśativārānvā kuṇḍeṣu prāg upakramaḥ || 11.80 pāyasaiḥ kṛsarair gaulyair haridrānnaiś ca maudgikaiḥ | hotavyaṃ pauruṣaiḥ sūktaiḥ pṛthag agniṣu pañcasu || 11.81 pañcame paramānnena brahmādyuddiśya daivatam | tattannāmnā caturthyantaṃ parivārapadānvitam || 11.82 svāhāntaṃ mantram uccārya dhyātvā brahmādidaivatam | brahmā prajāpatī rudras sarve devā yathākramam || 11.83 chandāṃsi vedā ṛṣayo gandharvāś ca sarīsṛpāḥ | yakṣāś cāpsarasaś caiva māsādyaiḥ saha vatsarāḥ || 11.84 saritaś ca samudrāś ca parvatāś ca tathāpagāḥ | bhūtāni paśavo vṛkṣās tathaivauṣadhayas smṛtāḥ || 11.85 vanaspatiś codbhidaś ca svedajāś cāṇḍajās tathā | jarāyujāś ca bhūrādisaptalokās tathaiva ca || 11.86 atalādyās tathā lokās sapta caṇḍādidevatāḥ | ity etebhyo havirdravyaṃ juhuyān mūlavidyayā || 11.87 idaṃ viṣṇur iti procya pūrṇāhutim athācaret | na dahet paridhīn darbhān devān nodvāsayet sthitān || 11.88 pratyahaṃ dhārayed agniṃ yāvat tīrthadināvadhi | ahorātraṃ pratidinaṃ juhuyād uktavartmanā || 11.89 ekāgnāv api hotavyaṃ homadravyam aśeṣataḥ | traye catuṣṭaye caivam agnīnāṃ caturānana || 11.90 balipradānaṃ prathamaṃ kuryād yāgasya maṇṭape | cakraṃ ca balibimbaṃ ca samādāyānnamūrtinā || 11.91 sākaṃ niṣkramya sadanāttaddvāre kumudādikam | abhyarcya purato dadyād baliṃ bhūmitale śucau || 11.92 pātrasthaṃ ca balidravyaṃ gandhaṃ prasavabhājanam | toyapūrṇaṃ ca karakaṃ dīpapātraṃ ca dīpikām || 11.93 dhūpapātraṃ gṛhītvāgre gacchantu paricārakāḥ | agre gacched annamūrtis tataś cakram anantaram || 11.94 nityotsavārcāṃ tadanu vitānādisamanvitām | tataś caṇḍapracaṇḍādīn dvāreṣv āvaraṇeṣu ca || 11.95 nityotsavaprakriyayā balim abhyarcya nikṣipet | madhyamārabhya ca grāme brahmādīnāṃ yathāvidhi || 11.96 deśeṣv īśānaparyantaṃ dattvābhyarcya baliṃ tathā | mahāpīṭhe balidravyaṃ pariśiṣṭam aśeṣataḥ || 11.97 dadyāt pāriṣadān sarvān uddiśya kamalāsana | muhūrte śobhane prāpte gurur utsavakautukam || 11.98 śayanastham upasthāpya mantram uttiṣṭhapūrvakam | uccārayan svastisūktaṃ paṭhadbhir brāhmaṇais saha || 11.99 niṣkramya mandirāt tasmād uccārya ca rathantaram | samāropya rathaṃ yuktaṃ caturbhir hastipuṅgavaiḥ || 11.100 vājibhir vā balīvardaiḥ śīghragāmibhir uttamaiḥ | kalpakadrumasaṃyuktaṃ hemapīṭham alaṅkṛtam || 11.101 rathasyopari kṛtvā ca nayed āsthitasārathim | yantreṇa vā vipravarair adhīyānair balānvitaiḥ || 11.102 gaje vā syandanālābhe yāne vā tadasambhave | bhadraṃ karṇeti mantreṇa yānam āropayed guruḥ || 11.103 sa puṣpahemaprabhayā yuktaṃ puṣpair alaṅkṛtam | haimena ca vitānena yuktaṃ puṣpādiśobhinā || 11.104 kūṭākāreṇa vā yuktaṃ mayūracchadaśobhinā | sarvālaṅkārayuktena sumanaḥpariveṣiṇā || 11.105 yāne tatra samāsīnam abhyarcya nyāsapūrvakam | devaṃ nivedayet tasmai bhakṣyaṃ ca pṛthukādikam || 11.106 nānnaṃ caraṇayor nyasyenniśācūrṇāni sarvaśaḥ | dīpair udagrair bahubhiḥ pariṣiktair ghṛtādinā || 11.107 parassahasrais sarvatra dīpayec ca śatāvaraiḥ | dvijendramukhyair bahubhir bhūṣitair dhavalāmbaraiḥ || 11.108 kañcukoṣṇīṣasahitair vyālavyajanapāṇibhiḥ | tālavyajanahastaiś ca barhibarhakarais tathā || 11.109 muktātapatraiḥ śvetaiś ca meghaḍambaradhāribhiḥ | bibhrāṇair dhūpapātrāṇi gandhodgārīṇi viśvataḥ || 11.110 yānārūḍhena purato racitāñjalikarmaṇā | uccair dhvajādhirūḍhena tathā tārkṣyeṇa padmaja || 11.111 pṛṣṭhataś ca praṇamatā śibikāṃ kanakojjvalām | ārūḍhena viriñcādīn samutsārayatā bahiḥ || 11.112 viṣvaksenena devena vetrahastena sevitaḥ | upānahau pāduke ca pātre kanakanirmite || 11.113 samāropya puro viprair dhārayadbhir alaṅkṛtaiḥ | rājacihnāni cānyāni yātavyamavilambitam || 11.114 viprais trayīmadhīyānair japastutiparāyaṇaiḥ | nṛtyatā gāyatā cāpi gāṇikyenānusevitam || 11.115 vīṇādivādanaparair vandibhiś ca tathāparaiḥ | ṣaḍjādigītanipuṇair vādyavādanakovidaiḥ || 11. 116 gadyaṃ padyaṃ tathā miśraṃ paṭhadbhis stotram ujjvalam | bhāṣāś ca bahudhāścitrā bhāṣamāṇair itas tataḥ || 11.117 vaitaṇḍikais tathā jalpanipuṇair vādaśikṣitaiḥ | tathā tattvakathāniṣṭhaiḥ padārthajñaiś ca tārkikaiḥ || 11.118 mīmāṃsakair yājñikaiś ca chāndasaiḥ sāṃkhyakovidaiḥ | yogajñaiś ca purāṇajñaiś śābdikais tattvavedibhiḥ || 11.119 mauhūrtikaiś ca gaṇaśaḥ parasparajigīṣubhiḥ | tattacchāstroktamārgeṇa prameyaṃ bahudhā sthitam || 11.120 uccair bruvāṇair vidvadbhiḥ pañcarātraparāyaṇaiḥ | vāsudevasya māhātmyaṃ kathayadbhiś ca sāttvataiḥ || 11.121 saṃskṛtaṃ prākṛtaṃ miśramīrayadbhir itas tataḥ | śāstreṣu naipuṇaṃ sarvaṃ pradarśayitum udyataiḥ || 11.122 devasya purataḥ pṛṣṭhe pārśvataś ca sthitair janaiḥ | senayā sarvato dikṣu caturaṅgabalāḍhyayā || 11.123 devasya pārśvayoḥ pūrve lākṣārañjitamaskaraiḥ | yantrair dārumayaiś citraiḥ pakṣyākārair itas tataḥ || 11.124 devatākṛtiyantraiś ca tathā yantrair gajādibhiḥ | niṣādibhis samārūḍhaiḥ stībhiś ca bharatoditaiḥ || 11.125 mārgair bahuvidhair nṛttaṃ darśayantībhir adbhutam | lekhāyantrais striyārūḍhair yantrair anyais tathāvidhaiḥ || 11.126 gatāgatāni kurvāṇair anuyātas samākulaiḥ | itthamāvaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ parikramya bahis tathā || 11.127 grāmādivīthikāś cāpi parikramya pradakṣiṇam | praveśasamaye cāpi prākāravalayaṃ tathā || 11.128 prādakṣiṇyena gatvāntaḥ praviśen maṇṭapāvanim | tatrāvaropayed devaṃ baliberaṃ tu mandire || 11.129 cakraṃ ca yāgasadane balipīṭhe bahiḥ sthite | annamūrtiṃ kṣipen nityaṃ samārādhanakalpitaiḥ || 11.130 vastubhir dviguṇair nityaṃ dhruvaberaṃ samarcayet | rātriśeṣe vyatikrānte maṇṭape siṃhaviṣṭare || 11.131 avasthāpyautsavaṃ bimbam arcayec chāstravartmanā | snapanaṃ tatra vā bimbe yadvā snapanakautuke || 11.132 ekaberavidhāne tu mūlabimbe 'bhiṣecanam | pratyahaṃ snapanaṃ kuryād yathāśakti yathāvasu || 11.133 mahāhavir nivedyātha bimbe kalyāṇakalpite | maṇḍanālayam āsādya śobhayed bhūṣaṇādibhiḥ || 11.134 bimbe tatra sthite yāgamaṇṭapaṃ prāpya deśikaḥ | kumbhādikaṃ samabhyarcya nivedya ca yathoditam || 11.135 hutvā ca pūrvavatpīṭhe baliṃ dattvā yathāvidhi | sarvam anyac ca balyarcāṃ nītvā grāmādivīthikām || 11.136 yathāniśaṃ vidhāyānvagutsavārcāṃ nayed bahiḥ | yathāpuram alaṅkāraṃ kṛtvā parikarāṃs tathā || 11.137 divasānuguṇān anyān dhvajādīn viṣvagucchritān | tāmbūlavīṭikāṃ dattvā sthāne sthāne samāhṛtām || 11.138 pṛthukādīṃs tathā bhakṣyānnālikeraphalāni ca | pānīyācamanādīni coditāni yathāvidhi || 11.139 dattvā nivedyamakhilamadbhiḥ prokṣyāstravidyayā | nivedayed apūpādīn pakvaṃ tūṣṇīṃ pradarśayet || 11.140 pānīyaṃ ca tathā svādu payaḥprabhṛti cāhṛtam | puṣpamālādi yaccānyac candanakṣodabhājanam || 11.141 bhūṣaṇaṃ cāṅgulīyādi bhaktyā yatpratidīyate | prokṣya sarvam athāstreṇa devāṅge yojayed guruḥ || 11.142 grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ nītvā tathaivāvaraṇāni ca | praveśya dhāma śibikām anyām āropya maṅgalām || 11.143 snānamaṇṭapabhūbhāge kāñcane paramāsane | sukhāstaraṇasaṃyukte yānāderavaropya tam || 11.144 niveśyābhīṣṭadigbhāge saṃmukhaṃ maravakautukam | ārādhayed bhāgavataḥ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaḥ || 11.145 ahatena susūkṣmeṇa vāsasā ślakṣ ṇatantunā | baddhoṣṇīṣottarāsaṅgaḥ <�saṃgaḥ> karṇikādyair alaṅkṛtaḥ || 11.146 sauvarṇavāravāṇena dhavalena virājitaḥ | baddhasvadehasaṃnāhaḥ pavitritakaraśśuciḥ || 11.147 samārādhanavastūni nayadbhiḥ paricārakaiḥ | kañcukoṣṇīṣavāsobhir bhavitavyaṃ samantataḥ || 11.148 devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve pūjakendropaveśanam | āsitavyaṃ bhagavataḥ pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhatas tataḥ || 11.149 ekāgramānasais sarvair ekāntibhir upāsakaiḥ | āsitavyaṃ yativairastridaṇḍair ekadaṇḍibhiḥ || 11.150 brahmadhyānaparair anvagārādhanavidhikramam | anusandhāyibhiś śaśvad upaveṣṭavyam antike || 11.151 bahis teṣāṃ ca kalyāṇair vaiṣṇavaiḥ saṃyatendriyaiḥ | ānandajāśrusalilair āplutāṅgair mahīsuraiḥ || 11.152 upāsitavyam anyais tu sadasyair maṇṭapād bahiḥ | adhastāt sarvato dikṣu prapāyām upaveśanam || 11.153 adhastād agrato nṛttagītavādyaviśāradaiḥ | nāṭyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ vādyaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ bahudhā sthitam || 11.154 nṛttaṃ gītaṃ ca ṣaḍjādyaiḥ svaraiḥ kālānusāribhiḥ | pradarśayadbhir vādyāni nibaddhānītarāṇi ca || 11.155 āviṣkurvadbhir anyāṃś ca śrāvyaṃ dṛśyaṃ ca taddvayam | darśayadbhir adhīyānais trayīṃ svādhyāyakalpitām || 11.156 itihāsapurāṇāni kathayadbhir yathā tathā | sannidhātavyam anyābhir varṇinībhis samantataḥ || 11.157 itthaṃ saṃsevite tatra maṇṭape madhuvidviṣam | ārcayitvā tatas snānapīṭhe nītvā yathāpuram || 11.158 sahasradhārāparyantaṃ snāpayet puruṣottamam | alaṅkārāsane nītvā tatra kṛtyam aśeṣataḥ || 11.159 kṛtvā yātrāsane devam āropya saparicchadam | praveśya maṇṭapaṃ tatra nyaset taṃ bhojanāsane || 11.160 mahāhavirnivedyātha pānakāntaṃ yathoditam | sukhāsane sthāpayitvā rājavatsarvam ācaret || 11.161 alaṅkārāsanaṃ nītvā yānam āropya maṅgalam | avaropyāsane tatra maṇḍayitvā yathāpuram || 11.162 homādibalidānāntaṃ kṛtvā sarvam aśeṣataḥ | autsavaṃ bimbamādāya kuryād evaṃ mahotsavam || 11.163 pratyahaṃ ca mayoktena vidhinā vihitaṃ kramāt | apūrvābharaṇair mālyair apūrvaiś cāmbarais tathā || 11.164 apūrvodyānayānādyair yathā kautūhalaṃ bhavet | tathā viśiṣya kartavyaṃ yāvat tīrthadināvadhi || 11.165 yasminn āsthānabhūbhāge ye bhogāḥ kalpitāḥ purā | tatraiva te vidhātavyā devasya sati sambhave || 11.166 śriyā vasudhayā sārdhaṃ grāmādau nityam utsave | parikramaṇam īśasya kevalasyāpi vā bhavet || 11.167 ahani prathamādau syād balidānam anukramāt | palalaṃ rajanīcūrṇaṃ karambhān lajasaṃyutān || 11.168 caruṇā saha saṃyojya baliṃ dadyād yathāvidhi | dvitīye 'hani saṃyojya caruṇā tilataṇḍulam || 11.169 miśritāś caruṇā lājān dhānyānyāpūpikāṃs tathā | tṛtīye ca caturthe ca nālikerajalais saha || 11.170 saktuṃ ca śālipiṣṭaṃ ca saṃyojya caruṇā saha | pañcame padmabījāni pāyasaṃ śālitaṇḍulam || 11.171 ṣaṣṭhe apūpān saṃyojya caruṇā nikṣiped balim | saptamādiṣu sarvatra sārdhamannaiś caturvidhaiḥ || 11.172 apūpāṃś ca tathā saktūn pratyahaṃ nikṣiped balim | brahmādīśānaparyantaṃ sthāneṣv aṣṭasu pūrvavat || 11.173 vidhāya bilipīṭhāni gomayāliptabhūmiṣu | teṣu vādyaṃ tathā nṛttaṃ geyaṃ nityotsavaṃ tathā || 11.174 kṛtvā dadyāt toyapūrvaṃ baliṃ toyottaraṃ tathā | balimudrāṃ darśayitvā darśayen maṅgalāṣṭakam || 11.175 baliṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya gaccheyur balidāyinaḥ | ārambhadivase rātrau samāptidivase 'hani || 11.176 balim ekāṃ kṣipen madhyadivaseṣu balidvayam | ahni rātrau ca sarvatra balidānaṃ yathāvidhi || 11.177 avasānadine rātrau grahaṇe viṣuve dine | prāpte kuryād avabhṛthaṃ yadi tasmin balidvayam || 11.178 grāmādirahite sthāne madhye tu purato balim | mahāpīṭhasya vitared brahmaṇe deśikottamaḥ || 11.179 pūrvedyus tīrthadivasād devasya mṛgayā bhavet | mṛgayādivasāt pūrvaṃ jaladroṇyavagāhanam || 11.180 avagāhadinātpūrvadivase devam arcayet | śrībhūmibhyāṃ sahaikasmin viṣṭare vipule sthitam || 11.181 udyānādau ca devībhyāṃ sārdhaṃ devasya nirgamaḥ | krīḍāś ca tatra bahudhā darśayec copadāḥ punaḥ || 11.182 deśād deśād āhṛtāni prābhṛtāni guruḥ svayam | pradarśya devadevāya janasaṃsadi maṇṭape || 11.183 ito yāta mithas sarvaṃ ito yātamitīrya ca | devādīn api cāhartrn kāle vijñāpayet tataḥ || 11.184 tanmayatvād deśikendro devo 'ham iti bhāvayet | kuryād anugrahaṃ sarvaṃ devasyālokya cānanam || 11.185 abhiprāyaṃ yathārājño jñātvā tena pradarśanam | bruvanti tatsamīpasthā rājñāṃ tattadanugraham || 11.186 sudarśanānnamūrtibhyāṃ sahitābhyāṃ vināpi ca | saha balyarcayā kuryād vinā vā taṃ mahotsavam || 11.187 kevalotsavabimbena dineṣv avabhṛthāvadhi | jaladroṇīṃ jalasnānadine kṛtvā yathāpuram || 11.188 utsavaṃ devadevasya prātarārabhya maṅgalam | aparāhṇe jaladroṇyām avagāhanam iṣyate || 11.189 sopānadeśe sarasi jaladroṇīṃ niveśayet | kaṭāhaṃ vāpi sauvarṇaṃ pūrayed gandhavāribhiḥ || 11.190 muktākārāṇy akṣatāni parito vikiret sthale | jaleṣv āvāhya gaṅgādyāsmaritastās sabhājayet || 11.191 jale 'bhimantrite mantrair abliṅgair devam arcitam | upacārair yathāpūrvaṃ snānāntair avagāhayet || 11.192 kāle tasminn adhīyīran sūktaṃ vāruṇam uccake | tanmayā dikṣu sarvāsu ghoṣayet turyam uccakaiḥ || 11.193 avagāhanato devaṃ yānam āropya maṇṭapam | anyamānīya tatrāpi yathāpūrvaṃ sabhājayet || 11.194 anuṣṭhitam idaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmādyair api daivataiḥ | etaścai tīrthasalilaiḥ pītaiś śirasi dhāritaiḥ || 11.195 snānair nirdhūtapāpmāno yānti brahma sanātanam | mṛgayādivase vāpi prātarārabhya pūrvavat || 11.196 kṛtvotsavam aśeṣeṇa tasyānte mṛgayā bhavet | mṛgayānuguṇais sarvair bhūṣaṇair bhūṣitaṃ tattaḥ || 11.197 tadyogyāyudhasannāhaṃ hastyādau parikalpite | āropya kṛtrime cāśve nayed grāmādi pūrvavat || 11.198 devībhyāṃ saha siṃhādau sainyair hastyādibhir yutam | udyānamaṇḍape cāpi madhye sauvarṇaviṣṭare || 11.199 āsane tatra cāsīnaṃ snānapūrvaṃ samarcayet | maṇṭape 'nyatra vidhinā nivedya ca mahāhaviḥ || 11.200 yānam ārāpya tadrātrau mandirāntarbhuvaṃ nayet | nityotsavaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ kuryāt tadanu maṅgalam || 11.201 paścime rātribhāge tu tīrthabimbādhivāsanam | baddhvā pratisaraṃ tīrthabimbābhāve caturmukha || 11.202 nityotsavapratikṛterabhāve tv adhivāsanam | snānārcāyāṃ bhaved yadvā bimbasyotsavakāriṇaḥ || 11.203 utsavaṃ prātarārabhya kuryāt pūrvoditakramāt | utthāpya śāyitaṃ bimbaṃ niveśya mukhamaṇḍape || 11.204 ādāya sthāpitān kumbhānyāgamaṇḍapabhūmiṣu | nītvā pradakṣiṇaṃ dhāma tīrthabimbasya sannidhau || 11.205 sthāpayitvā dhānyarāśau tīrthabimbaṃ yathāvidhi | vastrāntam arcayitvānte muhūrte śobhane guruḥ || 11.206 ekabere mūlaberam anyathā tīrthakautukam | kumbhair abhyuddhṛtair devaṃ mūlamantreṇa mantravit || 11.207 pūrvādimadhyakumbhāntam abhiṣiñced yathāvidhi | snānādidīpaparyantaṃ pratikumbhaṃ samarcayet || 11.208 paṭhatsu vipravaryeṣu dikṣu svādhyāyam uccakaiḥ | ghoṣayatsu ca vādyeṣu mantrairabdaivatair guruḥ || 11.209 navavastrottarīyādyair dīpāntair arcite harau | dhvajapīṭhasma purataḥ kṣitau gomayavāriṇā || 11.210 ālipte caturaśre ca śālibhārair vikīrya ca | vastrapūrvādyalaṅkārair <�alaṃkārair> ulūkhalam alaṅkṛtam || 11.211 kṣālitaṃ sthaṇḍile pīṭhe sthāpayitvā caturmukha | śrīsūktavidyayā lakṣmīṃ dhyāyan mantritamarcitam || 11.212 musalaṃ kṣālitaṃ cāpi mantritaṃ mūlavidyayā | ādāya mūrtipais sārdhaṃ deśikendras samāhitaḥ || 11.213 avahanyānniśācūrṇaṃ nikṣiptaṃ tadulūkhale | gāyantyo gaṇikā gāthāṃ maṅgalaṃ devadāsikāḥ || 11.214 avahanyur niśācūrṇaṃ yathā sūkṣmataraṃ bhavet | nikṣiptacūrṇaṃ tadanu kumbhaṃ veṣṭitavāsasam || 11.215 sakūrcaṃ mallakaṃ pīṭhe taṇḍalaiḥ parikalpitam | sthāpitaṃ mūlamantreṇa gandhādibhir athārcitam || 11.216 ādāya kumbhacūrṇais taiḥ śrīsūktenābhiṣecayet | ṛtvijo deśikendraś ca devaṃ gatvā pradakṣiṇam || 11.217 aṣṭāṅgapraṇipātena praṇipatya vikīrya ca | puṣpāṇy añjalibhir devaṃ stutvā stotrair anekaśaḥ || 11.218 alaṅkṛtair bhāgavataiś chatracāmaradhāribhiḥ | tair eva sarvair bahubhir bhāvyaṃ devasamīpake || 11.219 āropya devaṃ hastyādau tīrthabimbam alaṅkṛtam | paścād utsavabimbena nīyamānena pūrvavat || 11.220 sahitaṃ saritastīrthaṃ nītvā yadvā sarittaṭam | darśe ca paurṇamāsyāṃ cā(pya)rvāk ced yojanāvadhau || 11.221 samudratīram athavā maṇḍape tatra kalpite | avaropyāsane yānānniviṣṭe tīrthakautuke || 11.222 kalaśānagrataḥ pañcaviṃśatiṃ daśa sapta ca | yadvā yadvā nava nyasya yathāvidhi yathāpuram || 11.223 kalaśair abhiṣiñceta cakraṃ śiṣṭaiś ca vāribhiḥ | saridādau ca tīrtheṣu tīrthāny āvāhya nāmataḥ || 11.224 nimajjayet tatra bimbaṃ cakramantrair yathāvidhi | tīrthārthamautsave bimbe samānīte tu vāribhiḥ || 11.225 prokṣya kūrcāgrapatitair bimbaṃ cakraṃ nimajjayet | cakrābhāve tu tatkūrcaṃ kevalaṃ devasannidhau || 11.226 devena saha tatkāle nimajjanti ca ye janāḥ | te nirdhūyāśubhaṃ sarvaṃ mahāpātakam apy atha || 11.227 yānti dhruvaṃ suduṣprāpaṃ sthānamācandratārakam | maṇṭape devamānīya pūjayitvā yathāpuram || 11.228 mahāhavirnivedyātha brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥ | pratyahaṃ bhojayed viprān sahasraṃ śatam eva vā || 11.229 ālayābhyantaraṃ yānam āropya prāpayet tataḥ | tadrātrau maṇḍape devaṃ nītvābhyarcya yathāvidhi || 11.230 nivedya ca yathānyāyaṃ prabhāte maṇṭapāntare | bhaktair bhāgavataiś caiva sevite bhūtale kvacit || 11. 231 cakrābjaṃ vartayitvoktavartmanā varuṇānvitam | prasavaiḥ kālajaiḥ śyāmaiḥ kṛṣṇaiś ca tulasīdalaiḥ || 11.232 nyūnātirekarahitair varṇair eva sitādibhiḥ | vicitrayet pañcavarṇaiś citrite tatra madhyataḥ || 11.233 bhadrapīṭhe yathāyukte nyaste kalyāṇakautukam | niveśyārādhayed arghyapādyādibhir anukramāt || 11.234 dvādaśākṣaramantrasthāny akṣarāṇi yathāyatham | uddiśya bhūṣāparyantair arghyādyair navabhiḥ kramāt || 11.235 pratyakṣaraṃ samastāni puṣpair upacared dharim | hṛdayādīni cāṅgāni samuddiśyāñjalisthitaiḥ || 11.236 phalaṃ bhavatu me puṣpair nama ity avasānakam | taṃ taṃ mantraṃ samuccārya mantravit deśikottamaḥ || 11.237 bhūṣaṇāni tathoddiśya śrīvatsādīny anukramāt | āyudhāni ca divyāni cakrādīni yathākramam || 11.238 tathaivāvaraṇasthānāṃ devatānāṃ samarcanam | matsyādimūrtidaśakaṃ keśavādīṃs tathāparān || 11.239 caturviṃśati saṃkhyātānuddiśya kusumārcanam | pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena pratyṛcaṃ kamalāsana || 11.240 nārāyaṇānuvākena viṣṇusūktena deśikaḥ | puṣpāṇi dadyād devasya caraṇāmbhojayor dvayoḥ || 11.241 tathopaniṣadair mantraiḥ pañcabhis sarvapāvanaiḥ | dikṣu vedāṃś ca caturaḥ paṭheyur mantravittamāḥ || 11.242 vidikṣv ekāyanāṃ śākhāṃ tanmayās sumukhās tathā | adhīyīraṃs tathā stotrair nṛttaiś ca satatodyataiḥ || 11.243 toṣayed devadeveśaṃ geyaiś ca bahudhā sthitaiḥ | puṣpābhiṣekaṃ prahitaiḥ puṣpair eva sitādibhiḥ || 11.244 devasya kṛtvā devāya pāyasādi caturvidham | annaṃ nivedya juhuyād diśy agner maṇṭapasya ca || 11.245 samidbhir ājyaiś carubhiś caturbhyaś ca pṛthakpṛthak | aṣṭottaraśataṃ vārān mūlamantreṇa mantravit || 11.246 tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ stutvā ca bhūtale | praṇamed daṇḍavadyānam āropya śibikādikam || 11.247 praveśayed āvaraṇaṃ prathamaṃ tatra ca sthitaḥ | sevānubhūtivivaśān bhaktān bhāgavatāṃś ca saḥ || 11.248 brahmādīn api kalyāṇam anusandhātum āgatān | praṇatānālayaṃ svam svaṃ gantuṃ sarveśvaro hariḥ || 11. 249 niyujyāvaraṇasthaṃ ca parikramya pradakṣiṇam | sārdham abhyantarair nityais sevakair anuyāyibhiḥ || 11. 250 abhyantaraṃ mandirasya praviśen maṅgalānvitam | tadaharniśi pūrvasmin nyaset snapanamaṇṭape || 11.251 utsavāntocitaṃ snānaṃ kalaśair ācaret kramāt | mahāhavirnivedyātha nītvā taṃ maṇḍapāntare || 11.252 yāgamaṇṭapamāsādya homaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi | śāntihomaṃ tataḥ kuryād yathāpūrvoditakramam || 11.253 prāyaścittaṃ tu juhuyāt pañcopaniṣadā ghṛtam | sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vāpi hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ caret || 11.254 agnīn visarjayed devāṃs tatrasthāṃs toraṇādiṣu | dhvajastambhaṃ samāsādya pūjayitvā khagādhipam || 11.255 havirnivedya garuḍaṃ parikramya pradakṣiṇam | tamudvaset paṭāttārkṣyaṃ saṃhārakramamāśritaḥ || 11.256 avaropya dhvajastambham utpāṭya ca mahāniśi | stambhaṃ dhvajaṃ ca gṛhṇīyād deśikendraḥ svayaṃ tataḥ || 11.257 grahaṇaṃ deśikendreṇa tārkṣyatṛptikaraṃ bhavet | sthāne cāvāhitān devāṃs tatra tatra sthitān api || 11.258 baliṃ dattvā tūryaghoṣais sthāne sthāne sakṛtsakṛt | ghoṣayitvā caturvaktra samudvāsya svanāmabhiḥ || 11.259 mūkaiḥ parijanais sārdhaṃ gurur aṣṭākṣaraṃ japet | praviśya dhāma devasya vijñāpya śakaṭādikam || 11.260 yānam āropya dhāmāntaḥ prāpayen makhakautukam | prabhāte tanniśāyā vānuṣṭhite yāgakarmaṇiḥ || 11.261 yajamāno guruṃ vastrair bhūṣaṇaiḥ kaṭakādibhiḥ | sauvarṇair gandhapuṣpādyair alaṅkṛtyābhipūjya ca || 11.262 dakṣiṇām uttamāṃ svarṇaśatenaikāntato 'dhikām | yathāvibhūti dattvānyā dakṣiṇāḥ prativāsaram || 11.263 daśaniṣkaṃ tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā yathāvasu | niṣkarūpāṃ yathāśraddhamācāryāya tadardhakām || 11.264 tadardham ṛtvijāṃ dattvā tadardhaṃ paricāriṇām | hemavastrais tathānnādyais toṣayed upacaryayā || 11.265 gāyakādyān janān sarvān adhikārānusārataḥ | karmāṅgabhūtān anyāṃś ca kalyāṇaṃ draṣṭum āgatān || 11.266 bhaktān bhāgavatāṃś caiva sāmānyāṃś cepsitair dhanaiḥ | atyalpikāṃ vāpi dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ yāgakarmaṇi || 11.267 karmibhyo dakṣiṇāhīno niṣphalaḥ kartur abjaja | yajñaḥ pratyuta kartrṇāṃ pratyavāyāya kalpate || 11.268 tasmād arthānuguṇyena dātavyā dakṣiṇā bhavet | śraddhayā vāsudevasya sāṅgopāṅgaṃ sadakṣiṇam || 11.269 utsavaṃ devadevasya yaḥ kuryāt sakalaṃ svayam | uttārayan svayaṃ viṣṇos sāyujyaṃ gacchati dhruvam || 11.270 hayamedhasahasrāṇi yajate ca samāhitaḥ | yaścotsavena yajate tayos tulyaphalānvayaḥ || 11.271 yāgānām api sarveṣāṃ phalam utsavakarmaṇā | devasyāśnuvate sarvaṃ yaṣṭāro nātra saṃśayaḥ || 11.272 upakurvanti ye martyā devasyotsavakarmaṇi | karmaṇā manasā vācā te 'pi yānti yathepsitam || 11.273 grāme vā nagare vāpi pattane vā mahotsavaḥ | viṣṇoḥ pravartate yatra deśe rāṣṭre 'pi vā bhavet || 11.274 bhayaṃ na mṛtyor na vyādher na durbhikṣādisambhavaḥ | naśyanti taskarās tatra nādharmas sampravartate || 11.275 dharmayukto bhaved rājā janā dharmaparāyaṇāḥ | bhavanti sukhinas sarve sarvaduḥkhavivarjitāḥ || 11.276 mahotsave vartamāne yadarthibhyaḥ pradīyate | pānīyamannaṃ vastraṃ vā tatsahasraguṇaṃ bhavet || 11.277 puṣpamālāphalair ijyā devasyābharaṇādikaiḥ | kriyamāṇā yathāśakti phalānantyāya kalpate || 11.278 sevante tatra ye devamaharniśamatandritāḥ | teṣām idam iyac ceti phalaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate || 11.279 ālepanaṃ mārjanaṃ ca rajaḥpraśamanaṃ tathā | vāribhir dīpakāropaṃ kṣvelanāsphoṭanādikam || 11.280 kurvanti ye brahmalokaṃ te yānty amaradurlabham | yānaṃ vahanti ye viprās te yānti brahmaṇaḥ padam || 11.281 rathaṃ vahanti ye cānye te 'pi yānti surālayam | chatrādidhāriṇaś cāpi modante divi mānavāḥ || 11. 282 deśiko mūrtipāś caiva tathaiva paricārakāḥ | utsave 'dhikṛtā viṣṇoḥ prāpnuvanti yathepsitam || 11.283 ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni ye tatrādhīyate janāḥ | te pare vyomni devasya pārśve vartanti niḥspṛhāḥ || 11.284 sarvaśāntikaraṃ sarvaduḥkhotsādanam uttamam | rājño rāṣṭrasya sukhadam āyur ārogyavardhanam || 11.285 prajānāṃ vāsudevasya kalyāṇaṃ sādhanaṃ mahat | imaṃ devādayas sarve viṣṇor utsavam uttamam || 11.286 kṛtvā śāśvatikaṃ sthānaṃ prāpuratyantadurlabham | utsave tridinaikāhasādhye śraddhā pravartite || 11.287 balipradānaṃ sumanoyajanaṃ cādhivāsanam | navānām api kumbhānāṃ tathā tīrthāvagāhanam || 11.288 mṛgayā ca jaladroṇī varjanīyāni padmaja | tāvatyevotsavadine tīrthānte grāmavīthiṣu || 11.289 brahmādidevatās sadyas samāvāhya baliṃ kṣipet | kevalodanam agnau ca homo niśyadhivāsanam || 11.290 snapanaṃ viṣuvādyeṣu nadyādāvavagāhanam | puṣpayāgo jaladroṇī mṛgayā ca na yujyate || 11. 291 anyat sarvaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ kartavyaṃ phalakāṅkṣibhiḥ | iti guhyatamaṃ brahmann uttamārādhanaṃ param || 11.292
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde mahotsavavidhir nāma ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
puṣpahavirvidhānam brahmovāca samārādhyo hariḥ puṣpaiḥ kaiḥ patrair vā havīṃṣi ca | phalamūlāni cānyāni kāni yogyāni kathyatām || 12.1 śrībhagavān puṣpāṇi nandanavanādārāmādātmano 'pi vā | araṇyādvā gṛhītvā ca vikrītānyāpaṇasthalāt || 12.2 ayācitāni labdhāni yadvā kamalasambhava | pūrvapūrvoditālābhe grāhyam uttaram uttaram || 12.3 anyāyopārjitāny anyadevatārthāni vā punaḥ | agrāhyāṇi tathā bhinnaṃ mukulaṃ patitaṃ tathā || 12.4 jīrṇaṃ paryuṣitaṃ kīṭadūṣitaṃ pādalaṃghitam | mlānaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ tathāspṛśyair nītaṃ ca pratilomajaiḥ || 12.5 snātaś śuddhāmbaro maunī pādau prakṣālya vāriṇā | pātre puṣpāṇi gṛhṇīyād vetraje tṛṇaje 'thavā || 12.6 (sat?) kalpakadrumānnītaṃ pārijātasamudbhavam | haricandanasantānamandāradrumasambhavam || 12.7 saugandhikodbhavaṃ puṣpaṃ ṣaḍ ete suradārujāḥ | pālāśaṃ saptamaṃ puṣpam upayuktāni cārcane || 12.8 anirmālyāni deyāni punaḥ prakṣālya vāribhiḥ | uttarottaram ekaikaṃ sahasraguṇam iṣyate || 12.9 prātaḥ padmadvayaṃ śastam utpalatrayam arcane | phalaṃ ca pūrvavajjñeyaṃ tathaiva śatapatrikā || 12.10 campakaṃ ketakaṃ śrīmanmālatī mādhavī tathā | nandyāvartaṃ ca punnāgaṃ suraparṇyekaparṇikā || 12.11 priyaṅgupāṭaladvandvaṃ mandāradvayam eva ca | lakṣmīś ca karṇikāraś ca yūthikā kurabas tathā || 12.12 paṭṭikaitāni śastāni phalaṃ pūṛvavad iṣyate | śastaṃ madhyandine śvetakaravīrajam arcane || 12.13 kiṅkarātaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ puṣpaṃ sahacarī tathā | pūrvavac ca phalaṃ vidyāt pradoṣe ca praśasyate || 12.14 jātīyugmaṃ vicakilaṃ mallikādvayam eva ca | vakulaṃ vanajātiś ca tathā ca navamallikā || 12.15 kumudaṃ vanamallī ca pūrvavac ca phalaṃ smṛtam | prātaḥkāloditaṃ puṣpaṃ yuktaṃ madhyandine 'pi ca || 12.16 pradoṣe kathitaṃ puṣpaṃ madhyarātre ca śasyate | divāpuṣpair divā pūjā niśāpuṣpais tathā niśi || 12.17 āpatkāle yathāyogam arcayet puruṣottamam | mālatyā pūjayet prātarmadhyāhne karavīrajaiḥ || 12.18 sāyāhne jātipuṣpais tu pradoṣe vakulair api | madhyarātre mallikābhir yajeta jalajais sadā || 12.19 pratyūṣe nandikāvartaiḥ kāla eṣa udāhṛtaḥ | padmādijalapuṣpāṇām arvāk kartus tryādbhavet || 12.20 na ca paryuṣito doṣo nīrajanāṃ bhavet tathā | abaddhebhyaḥ prasūnebhyo baddhā mālā praśasyate || 12.21 mālābhyaḥ sragvarā mālā sajātīyā prasūnajā | srak tu nānāvidhaiḥ puṣpair nirmitā kadalītvacā || 12.22 hrīberaṃ ca tamālaṃ ca tathā damanakatrayam | na paryuṣitam etaiś ca sadaivārādhayed dharim || 12.23 tulasyau sitakṛṣṇe ca kevalākṣapakās tathā | catvārastulasībhedā dūrvā bilvadalāni ca || 12.24 sarvadārādhanārhāṇi pūjituṃ karavīrajaiḥ | gṛhe kulakṣayakarī puṣpapatrādyasannidhau <�saṃnidhau> || 12.25 akṣatair arcanaṃ kuryād dhareḥ kalamajais sitaiḥ | nīvārāveṇavaśśālikalamādyā yavā api || 12.26 haviryogyā vrīhayaś ca tadabhāve priyaṅgavaḥ | anye ca yājñikā dhānyabhedāḥ kodravavarjitāḥ || 12.27 nīcair dattās tathā spṛṣṭāḥ patitaiḥ pratilomajaiḥ | āśaucavadbhir aparair apakvāḥ kalamādayaḥ || 12.28 śasyante carupākeṣu pakvāś ca tadasannidhau | cāturvarṇair upahṛtā taṇḍulā doṣavarjitāḥ || 12.29 akhaṇḍitāḥ khaṇḍitāś cā(pya)bhāve niṣphalīkṛtāḥ | carupātraṃ tāmramayaṃ praśastaṃ mṛnmayaṃ tu vā || 12.30 viṣṇugāyatriyā bhāṇḍe kṣālite gālitair jalaiḥ | pūrṇe praṇavasaṃspṛṣṭe taṇḍulānmūlavidyayā || 12.31 yadvā pañcopaniṣadā kṣālayed vāribhiḥ punaḥ | pūrayet praṇavenaiva pidadhyāc cakramudrayā || 12.32 adhiśriyya ca mūlena mantreṇāgniṃ samedhayet | pañcopaniṣadair mantraiḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ kīṭādyadūṣitaiḥ || 12.33 pakve jalam api srāvya siktvājyena caruṃ punaḥ | udagudavāsayed darbhaiḥ phalake yajñadāruje || 12. 34 sādhayed dīkṣitaḥ pākaṃ vidhinoktena tat striyaḥ | yadvā tūṣṇīṃ sādhayeyur upadaṃśāṃś ca śodhitān || 12.35 phalamūlāni tatrādau phalāni kadalīphalam | āgraṃ panasamurvāruṃ bṛhatīṃ karkarīm api || 12.36 kāravallīmalābuṃ ca kūṣmāṇḍaṃ tintriṇīm api | karavartaṃ ca niṣpāvaṃ gavākṣaṃ trapusaṃ tathā || 12.37 mudgamedāṃś ca nirdoṣān sadoṣān parivarjayet | ucchiṣṭaṃ krimiṇā daṣṭaṃ śivādyair laṅghitaṃ tathā || 12.38 ghrātaṃ lālājalaspṛṣṭamamedhyaprabhavaṃ tathā | pādaspṛṣṭaṃ ca patitamakāle cāśucisthitam || 12.39 bhuktaśeṣaṃ (muktaśeṣaṃ ?) tathāspṛśyaiḥ spṛṣṭaṃ dattāvaśiṣṭakam | varjyaṃ vallītrayaṃ kandaṃ sūraṇadvayam utpalam || 12.40 piṇḍāradvitayaṃ cāpi haviryogyaṃ caturmukha | jīvantīṃ vāstukaṃ śākaṃ kāravallīdalaṃ tathā || 12.41 tumbīdalaṃ ca bhāñjalī (ca) śimbī mudgadalāni ca | śākinīṃ śataparvāṇaṃ tathaivāśvāsamardinam || 12.42 āgastyaṃ pācayec chākaṃ vihitaṃ brāhmaṇasya ca | ekamūlāni cānyāni gṛhṇīyād aniṣedhane || 12.43 aṅkurāṇy api veṇvādivastūnāṃ kamalāsana | chedayitvā lavitreṇa lavaṇair maricais tathā || 12.44 sarṣapair jīrakair hiṅguśrīparṇīdalamiśritaiḥ | nālikeraphalair ājyair yathāyogaṃ niveśitaiḥ || 12.45 saṃskāryaṃ vyañjanaṃ yūṣayuktaṃ rahitam eva vā | sarpiṣā vā ''yase pātre ghṛṣṭaṃ mṛnmaya eva vā || 12.46 kalāyamudganiṣpāvaśimbamāṣakulutthakāḥ | sayūṣā vā viyūṣā vā pacanīyā guṇānvitāḥ || 12.47 tvaco vyapohya kulmāṣāḥ kāryā yadvā yathoditam | āmrādīnāṃ ca śuṣkāṇāṃ phalānuguṇatintriṇī || 12.48 miśrāṇi pacanīyāni tathā lavaṇavāsitam | āmraṃ ca śṛṅgiberaṃ ca tathā kevalam iṣyate || 12.49 panasaṃ kadalī cāmraṃ kapitthaṃ badarīphalam | drākṣā rājādanaṃ jambūphalaṃ toṭakam apy atha || 12.50 kharjūraṃ vetrajaṃ caiva mātuluṅgaṃ ca dāḍimam | phalāny etāni pakvāni kālapakvāni yojayet || 12.51 kṣīram eko guṇas tasya toyam ardhaṃ tadardhakam | taṇḍulas tāvad eva syād bhinno mudgas tadardhakaḥ || 12. 52 ghṛtaṃ samuditaṃ sarvaṃ paramānnaṃ nivedayet | samabhāgaṃ tu pūrvoktais taṇḍulais sammitaṃ samam || 12.53 gulaṃ phalena nikṣipya gulānnaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ | taṇḍulais saṃmitaṃ nistvaṅ mudgabhinnaṃ sumādhitam || 12.54 mudgānnaṃ kālapakvais tu phalair ājyapariplutam | nivedayet kevalānnaṃ taṇḍulair eva sādhayet || 12.55 phalāni kandāś śākāni mudgabhedās tathāṅkurāḥ | payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ cāpi kālapakvaṃ tathā phalam || 12.56 āmrādirlavaṇaiś cāpi śṛṅgiberādi sādhitam | matsyaṇḍigulabhedāś ca yac cānyad upadaṃśakam || 12.57 parimāṇamamīṣāṃ ca yathāśraddhaṃ yathāvasu | marīcyādi yathāyogyaṃ dravyasaṃskārakaṃ bhavet || 12.58 nāgavallīdalāni syur aśītiravarās tathā | viṃśatiḥ kramukasyāpi phalāny avarasaṃkhyayā || 12.59 aṅgāni tailaṃ takkolaṃ lavaṅgaṃ jātir eva ca | mātuluṅgatvag anyac ca cūrṇaṃ karpūramiśritam || 12.60 pāṣāṇajaṃ nālikeraphalaṃ pakvaṃ ca nirjalam | karpūraṃ kevalaṃ vāpyāmaṃ (vāpi cāmaṃ) vā śuṣkam eva vā || 12.61 etair vastubhir anyaiś ca nyūnabhāvavivarjitaiḥ | tāmbūlaṃ vīṭikāstailamṛdupūgaphalānvitam || 12.62 nivedya yajamānasya śraddhāvittānusārataḥ | godhūmaśālipiṣṭotthā apūpāś cāpi saṃskṛtāḥ || 12.63 gulabhedājyamārīcajīrakādyair yathāyatham | vastubhir vividhākārā gulapākapariplutāḥ || 12.64 puṭadagdhāṃs tilānikṣurasapākapariplutān | marīcair jīrakair yuktān palalāṃś ca nivedayet || 12.65 pṛthukān puṭadagdhān vā kevalān vā gulāplutān | marīcair jīrakair yuktān nālikeraphalais saha || 12.66 saktūn guladravair miśrān marīcair api jīrakaiḥ | karambhān api pūrvoktais saṃskārair api saṃskṛtān || 12.67 pākasthānāc ca bhāṇḍān vā vāribhiḥ kṣālitān bahiḥ | bhasmanā ca caturdikṣu kṛtordhvākārapuṇḍrakān || 12.68 astramantreṇa vāsobhiś channān vā vetrapañjare | yadvā pratiṣṭhitān bhūmau jaladhārāpurassaram || 12.69 vaheyur vidhṛtoṣṇīṣāssitakañcukasaṃvṛtāḥ | paricaryāparā viprā maṇṭape mandire 'pi vā || 12.70 devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve nītvā phalakabhūmiṣu | sauvarṇādīni pātrāṇi viṣṇugāyatriyā tataḥ || 12.71 kṣālitāni parāmṛjya praṇavenājyadhārayā | pātrāṇi siddhamantreṇa tathā darvyā havīṃṣi ca || 12.72 ādāyādāya nikṣipya mantreṇānnam athārpitam | khāri tadardhaṃ pādaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā paraṃ matam || 12.73 pratisthālīṃ pāyasādi bhaktamānaṃ caturmukha | yathāyathaṃ vyañjanāni nikṣepyāṇi ghṛtais saha || 12.74 dadhnā ca sarvāṇy annāni prakalpya vyañjanais saha | nivedayeyur dhanāni yāni kāni ca pūjakāḥ || 12.75 coṣyāṇi lehyakhādyāni yathāvibhavavistaram | niveditānāṃ turyāṃśaṃ viṣvaksenāya kalpayet || 12.76 taccāgādhe jale kṣipya tadbhaktānvāpi bhojayet | tenaiva pārṣadāstṛptā bhaveyur bhūtatṛptaye || 12.77 dāsyo vā gaṇikā bhojyā devasya paricārikāḥ | brahmeśānādidevānāṃ naiva bhojyaṃ niveditam || 12.78 na spṛśyaṃ laṅghanīyaṃ ca caṇḍādīnāṃ tathaiva ca | devīnāṃ ca śriyādīnāṃ vinatānandanasya ca || 12.79 cakrādīnām āyudhānāṃ vastu yadyanniveditam | bhoktavyam eva sarveṣāṃ viprādīnām aśaṅkitam || 12.80 viṣṇor niveditaṃ śuddhaṃ pāvanānāṃ ca pāvanam | prāpaṇaṃ durlabhaṃ bhojyaṃ na tyājyaṃ syāt kadācana || 12.81 bhuñjānānāmedhate śrīḥ tyajatāṃ parihīyate | vratopavāsastulitam tvaśanaṃ tasya pāvanam || 12.82 śunām iva puroḍāśo na nīceṣu tad iṣyate | viṣṇor niveditānnena yaṣṭavyaṃ devatāntaram || 12.83 pitṛbhyaś cāpi taddeyaṃ tadānantyāya kalpate | dhāritaṃ viṣṇunirmālyaṃ candanādyanulepanam || 12.84 aharniśaṃ dhārayato na punar jananaṃ bhavet | tathā hi caraṇasparśi viṣṇos tripathagājalam || 12.85 punāti siddhadevarṣisaṃghānaṃhovighātakam | pādodakaṃ ca devasya pavitraṃ paramaṃ matam || 12.86 pādyaṃ dattvā jalaṃ viṣṇor mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ | gṛhītvā śatadhāreṇa mūrdhni dhāryaṃ viśuddhaye || 12.87 śodhanaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ sarvaduḥsvapnāśanam | lakṣmīvivardhanaṃ nityam āyur vṛddhikaraṃ param || 12.88 mriyamāṇas svayaṃ viṣṇoś caraṇasparśitaṃ jalam | pītvā sadgatim āpnoti na corvyāṃ jāyate punaḥ || 12.89 pirṇāṃ tarpitaṃ śastaṃ vāriṇā tena tarpitāḥ | ṛṇebhyaḥ pitaro muktā vasanti divi devavat || 12.90 bhaktāya deyaṃ pādodaṃ śāntāya śubhakarmaṇe | pañcakālavidhijñāya tadanuṣṭhānaśīline || 12.91 na nāstikāya dātavyaṃ dātavyaṃ nābhyasūyave | pāṣaṇḍine na dātavyaṃ tebhyo rakṣet prayatnataḥ || 12.92
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde puṣpahavirvidhānaṃ nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
pañcakālavidhiḥ brahmovāca pañcakālavidhijñānaṃ praśastaṃ bhagavann iha | vihitaṃ pañcake kāle vidhayaś cāpi pañca ke || 13.1 mahyaṃ jijñāsamānāya kathayasva yathātatham | na ced rahasyam atyantaṃ yadahaṃ pṛṣṭavān idam || 13.2 śrībhagavān ādyaṃ karmābhigamanam upādānamataḥ param | ijyā ca paścāt svādhyāyas tato yogas tataḥ param || 13.3 pañcaite vidhayas teṣāṃ kālāḥ pañcaiva te kramāt | kalyāṇācaraṇāntaṃ yat karmajātaṃ caturmukha || 13.4 utthānādi kramād etad abhiyānam udīritam | brāhme muhūrte budhyeta dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ param || 13.5 utthāyāsīta śayane kīrtayan nāma vaiṣṇavam | krameṇa spṛṣṭvā tattvāni deham utpādya tattvavit || 13.6 nyasya dehe ṣaḍaṅgāni mantram uccārya mānasam | daśāvatārān vyūhāṃś ca caturṇāṃ māsapān api || 13.7 dhyātvā svanāmabhistāni kīrtayitvā pṛthak pṛthak | avakuṇṭhya ca vastreṇa śarīraṃ dakṣiṇāṃghriṇā || 13.8 ākramya bhūmiṃ prathamaṃ trivikramam anusmaran | namaḥ kṣitidharāyeti mantram uccārya vāgyataḥ || 13.9 grāmād bahir diśaṃ gatvā nairṛtiṃ nyasya dakṣiṇe | upavītaṃ karṇadeśe vyavadhāya tṛṇādinā || 13.10 bhūmau samutsṛjen mūtraṃ kiṭṭaṃ ca tadanantaram | udaṅmukho divā kuryāt sandhyayor ubhayor api || 13.11 dakṣiṇābhimukho rātrau vāti vāte 'nusāriṇi | dakṣiṇetarahastena gṛhṇīyān mehanaṃ tataḥ || 13.12 dakṣiṇe mṛttikāṃ haste samutthāya jalāśayam | prāg udīcyāṃ pratīcyāṃ vā gatvā śaucaṃ samācaret || 13.13 mṛttikābhir dvādaśabhir gudaṃ ṣaḍbhiś ca mehanam | antarā cāntaraṃ vāmakaraṃ prakṣālya vāribhiḥ || 13.14 mṛnmātrābhis tadante ca karau dvādaśasaṃkhyayā | saṃśodhya caraṇau jaṅghe kaṭiṃ coruñca vāribhiḥ || 13.15 pratyekaṃ mṛttikāmātrā catuṣkeṇa viśodhayet | ācamya prāṅmukho bhūtvā dantadhāvanam ācaret || 13.16 nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣāmrārjunadhātakī | pālāśaveṇukhadiraśamīdārūṇi dhāvane || 13.17 dantānām uditāny ekādaśa cāmbhoruhāsana | dantadhāvanakāṣṭhaṃ ca dvādaśāṅgulamāyatam || 13.18 daśāṅgulaṃ tathā mānam aṣṭāṅgulam athāyatam | brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ krameṇa tadudāhṛtam || 13.19 jihvānirlekhanaṃ kuryād gaṇḍūṣācamanaṃ punaḥ | kṣālayitvā mukhaṃ toyair ācāntas snānam ācaret || 13.20 avagāho bhaved vāpyāṃ snāyādvā sarasīṣu ca | vāpyādyasambhave (vāpyādisambhave ?) naiva kūpeṣvāplavanaṃ bhavet || 13.21 snānaṃ vā taptatoyena doṣavaiṣamyasambhave | nābher adhastād vā dehaṃ kṣālayitvātmanas tanum || 13.22 ācamya prokṣayed dehaṃ vāribhir mantravittamaḥ | oṃpūrvayā ca gāyatryā vāribhiś cābhimantritaiḥ || 13.23 ātmānaṃ pariṣicyordhvam utkṣipet salilāñjalim | yoddhukāmāni rakṣāṃsi sandhyayor ubhayor api || 13.24 śāmyanti tair vajrahatair hastābhipreritair jalaiḥ | prāyaścittaṃ tu hiṃsāyāḥ paribhramaṇamātmanaḥ || 13.25 taryayed upaviśyātha tattanmantram udīrayan | devādīn salile tiṣṭhan sāvitrīṃ prāṅmukho japet || 13.26 yāvat sūryodayaṃ dṛṣṭvā prāñjalistimirāpaham | upasthāya svaśākhoktair mantrair dhyāyan hṛdi sthitam || 13.27 abhivādya gurūn vṛddhān tathā bhāgavatān kramāt | praviśya svāśramaṃ devam abhigamya yathāvidhi || 13.28 arcayej japahomāntaṃ dadyād grāsaṃ yathāvidhi | añjanālepanais sragbhiḥ vāsobhiḥ bhūṣaṇais tathā || 13.29 alaktakarasādyaiś ca tāmbūlamukhaśodhanaiḥ | upeto maṅgalair anyair nayed abhigamakriyām || 13.30 upādadyāt tataḥ pūjāsādhanāni yathāvidhi | puṣpāṇi phalamūlāni vividhāny oṣadhīr api || 13.31 dadhyādi ca haviryogyaṃ taṇḍulāni gulāni ca | snānīyāni ca vastrāṇi svādūni salilāni ca || 13.32 darbhān parṇāni samidho yathāśakti yathāvasu | āhṛtya yājñikārthair vā pūjāsthāne niveśayet || 13.33 nītvopādānasamayamitthaṃ tadanu pūjayet | prāpte madhyāhnasamaye snānaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi || 13.34 nyāsamagre ṣaḍaṅgānāṃ kṛtvādāya mṛdaṃ kare | savye nidhāya kṛtvā tu tridhā mūlāgramadhyataḥ || 13.35 mūle sthitāṃ mṛdaṃ pūrvam abhimantryāstravidyayā | vidikṣu dikṣu cordhvāyāmadharāyāṃ vinikṣipet || 13.36 tato madhyasthitāṃ mṛtsnāmudake mūlavidyayā | nikṣipya bhāgamagrasthaṃ karābhyāṃ karayor dvayoḥ || 13.37 vidhāya paṅkamambhobhirdarśayitvā ca pūṣaṇam | astrahīnāṅgavidyābhirāpādatalamastakam || 13.38 ālipya deham akhilam avagāhya ca vāriṣu | devam āvāhya lakṣmīśaṃ dattvā cārdhyādikaṃ tataḥ || 13.39 tatpādakṣālanāmbhobhiḥ pāṇibhyāṃ kumbhamudrayā | pāvanaiḥ śirasi nyastair ātmānam abhiṣicya ca || 13.40 vāsudevam abhidhyāyann aghamarṣaṇam ācaret | uttīrya karma nikhilaṃ madhyāhnasamayocitam || 13.41 kṛtvā yajeta deveśaṃ homāntaṃ kamalāsana | stotreṇābhiṣṭuyād devaṃ daṇḍavatpatitaḥ kṣitau || 13.42 ``jitaṃ te puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana | namaste 'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa pūrvaja || 13.43 namaste vāsudevāya śāntānandacidātmane | ajitāya namastubhyaṃ ṣāḍguṇyanidhaye namaḥ || 13.44 mahāvibhūtisaṃsthāya namaste puruṣottama | sahasraśirase tubhyaṃ sahasracaraṇāya te || 13.45 sahasrabāhave tubhyaṃ sahasranayanāya te | amūrtāya namastubhyam ekamūrtāya te namaḥ || 13.46 anekamūrtaye tubhyamakṣayāya ca te namaḥ | vyāpine vedavedyāya namaste paramātmane || 13.47 cinmātrarūpiṇe tubhyaṃ namastrayyantabhūmaye | aṇiṣṭhāya sthaviṣṭhāya mahiṣṭhāya ca te namaḥ || 13.48 nediṣṭhāya daviṣṭhāya kṣepiṣṭhāya ca te namaḥ | varṣiṣṭhāya yaviṣṭhāya kaniṣṭhāya ca te namaḥ || 13.49 pañcātmane namastubhyaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ | kalpanāpoḍharūpāya sṛṣṭisthityantahetave || 13.50 namaste guṇarūpāya guṇarūpātivartine | vyastāya ca samastāya samastavyastarūpiṇe || 13.51 ādimadhyāntaśūnyāya tadvate ca namo namaḥ | praṇavapratipādyāya namaḥ praṇavarūpiṇe || 13.52 lokayātrāprasiddhyarthaṃ sṛṣṭabrahmādirūpiṇe | namastubhyaṃ nṛsiṃhādimūrtibhedāya viṣṇave || 13.53 pātakaiḥ karmaṇaḥ kleśair aspṛṣṭavapuṣe namaḥ | namo brahmaṇyadevāya tejasāṃ nidhaye namaḥ || 13.54 nityāsādhāraṇānekalokarakṣāparicchada | saccidānandarūpāya vareṇyāya namo namaḥ || 13.55 yajamānāya yajñāya yaṣṭavyāya namo namaḥ | ijyāphalātmane tubhyaṃ namassvādhyāyaśāline || 13.56 namaḥ paramahaṃsāya namaḥ sattvaguṇāya te | sthitāya parame vyomni bhūyo bhūyo namo namaḥ || 13.57 saṃsārasāgare ghore viṣayāvartasaṅkule | apāre dustare 'gādhe patitaṃ karmabhis svakaiḥ || 13.58 anāthamagatiṃ bhīruṃ dayayā parayā hare | mām uddhara dayāsindho sindhorasmāt sudustarāt || 13.59 mantrahāniṃ kriyāhāniṃ hāniṃ vānyāṃ tvadarcane | kṣamasva devadeva tvamaparādhasaho hy asi" || 13.60 `` janmaprabhṛti dāso 'smi śiṣyo 'smi tanayo 'smi te | tvaṃ ca svāmī gurur mātā pitā ca mama mādhava || 13.61 nāhaṃ hitaṃ vijānāmi tvāṃ bhajāmy eva kevalam | buddhvaivaṃ naya govinda mām upāyena vartmanā || 13.62 tvam eva vettha śreyo me nedam etad itīti ca | buddhiyogaṃ ca me dehi yena tvām upayāmy aham" || 13.63 iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ svadhāmani | kuryāt pañca mahāyajñān api gṛhyoktavartmanā || 13.64 atithīn api tatkāle yathāśakti samarcayet | poṣyavargān bhojayitvā bhuñjīta niyatas svayam || 13.65 ijyāyās samayas tasyāḥ kathitaḥ kamalāsana | mandire vā harer nadyās tīre vā maṭhabhūmiṣu || 13.66 vivikte vipine vāpi parvate vā gṛhe 'pi vā | ṛco yujūṣi sāmāni bhidyamānāny anekadhā || 13.67 śākhābhedair mūlaśākhāmekāyanasamāśrayām | trayīmayīmadhīyīta sukhāsīnas samāhitaḥ || 13.68 anyais sārdhamadhīyānaiṣ ṣaḍaṅgeṣu ca kovidaiḥ | adhyāpayīta vā śiṣyān śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca || 13.69 itihāsapurāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi vā punaḥ | tathārādhananiṣṭhāni samabhyasyed yathāyatham || 13.70 saṃsārabhīrubhir viprais tattvaniṣkarṣakovidaiḥ | sahāsītopadeśādiprakāracaturair api || 13.71 svādhyāyakālaḥ kathitaḥ svādhyāyo 'pi ca kīrtitaḥ | tataḥ paścimasandhyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ tatra coditam || 13.72 japahomādikaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā paramapūruṣam | arcayitvā yathānyāyaṃ yathāpūrvam aśeṣataḥ || 13.73 bhuktvā saṃviśya śayane samutthāya mahāniśi | ācamya prayato bhūtvā dhyātvā paramapūruṣam || 13.74 yogāsane sukhāsīno yuñjītātmānam ātmani | yathoktena prakāreṇa yathāśakti caturmukha || 13.75 saṃhārakramamāśritya tattvānyātmani saṃharet | ātmānaṃ vāpi hṛtpadme paramātmani niṣṭhite || 13.76 saṃhared utthito yogātsvāpaṃ kleśāpahaṃ vrajet | ity eṣaḥ kathito brahman yogaḥ kālaś ca pañcamaḥ || 13.77 pañcaite hi mayā pañca vidhayas teṣu darśitāḥ | ittham eteṣu kāleṣu darśitaiḥ karmabhir naraḥ || 13.78 ārādhanaṃ bhagavataḥ kurvannaivāvasīdati | varṣeṣu dvādaśasv evam anutiṣṭhan samāhitaḥ || 13.79 kriyākalāpamakhilaṃ yāti sāyujyasampadam | ṣaṭsu varṣeṣu sārūpyasāmīpyādi suniścitam || 13.80 sālokyaṃ phalam ekasmin vatsare nātra saṃśayaḥ |
iti śrīpañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde pañcakālavidhir nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
pavitrādyutsavavidhiḥ brahmovāca māsi māsi praśastāni nakṣatrāṇi janārdana | bhagavān kāni yeṣu syād arcanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam || 14.1 kāni cāṃśāvatārāṇāṃ janmarkṣāṇi yuge yuge | ucyatāṃ tāni deveśa śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ || 14.2 śrībhagavān caitre māsi punar vasvorjanma rāmasya maṅgalam | tithau navamyāṃ lagne ca kulīre kamalāsana || 14.3 rāghavasyāprameyasya nakṣatre tatra rāghavam | devyā ca sītayā sārdham arcayitvā yathāvidhi || 14.4 utsavaś ca bhavet tasmin sarvamaṅgalasaṃyutaḥ | puṣye ca mīnalagne ca bharatas samajāyata || 14.5 tatra syād arcana devyā māṇḍavyā saha pūrvavat | utsavāś ca tathā sārpe nakṣatre lakṣmaṇo 'pi ca || 14.6 śatrughnaś ca kulīre ca lagne jātas tadarcanam | ubhayos tatra divase devyā cormilayā saha || 14.7 lakṣmaṇasyetarasyāpi śrutakīrtyā mahotsavaḥ | rāmasya janmanakṣatre sarve vā bharatādayaḥ || 14.8 arcanīyā hanumatā etaiḥ sarvair mahotsavaḥ | tatraiva śravaṇe caiva sāyāhne narakesarī || 14.9 arcanīyas sa hi tadā hiraṇyamavadhīdripum | tasminn eva site pakṣe trayodaśyāṃ samarcayet || 14.10 viṣṇuṃ yadvā punar vasvoḥ paurṇamāsyām athāpi vā | vasantakālatṛptyarthaṃ tatsamṛddhibhir āhṛtaiḥ || 14.11 puṣpair nānāvidhair devam arcayed dakṣiṇāmukham | āsīnaṃ maṇḍape kḷpte vedimadhye manorame || 14.12 udyāne mandire vāpi kṛtrimodyānaśobhite | nadyādau ca yathāyogaṃ phalapuṣpodakānvite || 14.13 paurṇamāsyāṃ tithau tasmin māse damanikādalaiḥ | puṣpānvitaiḥ prapāṃ kṛtvā maṇṭape pūjayed dharim || 14.14 puṣpair damanikābhiś ca sarvālaṅkāram ācaret | utsavaś ca bhavet tasmin homo damanikādalaiḥ || 14.15 vaiśākhe māsi vā kuryād vasantotsavam abjaja | damanīdalakalyāṇam api vā pūrvam īritam || 14.16 vaiśākhe māsi vā caitrai site pakṣe śubhe dine | damanīdalavatkuryāt kalhārakusumotsavam || 14.17 sthāneṣu pūjayed devaṃ kumbhādiṣu caturṣv api | mahāhavirnivedyātha homaṃ kṛtvā samāpayet || 14.18 phalāny api samāhṛtya vanyajānapadāny api | jyeṣṭhe vā śrāvaṇe vāpi devāya vinivedayet || 14.19 sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ vidadhyāc ca mahotsavam | evaṃ yaḥ kārayet pūjāṃ śraddhāpūtena cetasā || 14.20 sarvān kāmānihāvāpya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati | śrāvaṇe janma pūrvāhṇe vāmanasya trivikramam || 14.21 madhyandine ca tatkāle pūjā ca madhuvidviṣaḥ | paurṇamāsyāṃ ca vaiśākhyāṃ harer arcanam iṣyate || 14.22 anūrāghe hanumatau janma tasmin samājayet | taṃ rāghaveṇa sahitaṃ sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca || 14.23 āñjaneyaṃ tadatyantaprīṇanaṃ rāghavātmanaḥ | anūrāghe paurṇamāsyāṃ kalaśaiḥ snapanaṃ hareḥ || 14.24 āṣāḍhe śuklapakṣe ca dvādaśyāṃ kamalāsana | cakrābjamaṇḍale devam arcayitvā yathāvidhi || 14.25 kalpite śayanāgāre mandire vā yathāvasu | paryaṅke kalpite tatra śāyayitvātha kautukam || 14.26 devībhyāṃ saha kūrcaṃ vā tritayaṃ tadabhāvataḥ | tatra nityārcanaṃ māsāṃś caturo maṅgalānvitam || 14.27 nayec ca śayanenaiva śāyayed anyakautukam | vratopavāsaniyamān kalpayitvā tadādikān || 14.28 tathānuṣṭhāyinas tatra cāturāśramyamāśritāḥ | āsīnās tatra niyatās tareyus te taraṅgiṇīm || 14.29 devasya yāvad utthānaṃ bhogiparyaṅkaśāyinaḥ | śrāvaṇe māsi kṛṣṇe ca pakṣe 'ṣṭamyāṃ tithau hareḥ || 14.30 rohiṇyāṃ janma kṛṣṇasya lokānāṃ maṅgalāvaham | jayantī nāma sā khyātā jayatyaśubham ity asau || 14.31 madhyarātre tatas tasmin kalyāṇaṃ sarvam ācaret | tathyayoge 'pi nakṣatre kevale 'rcanam iṣyate || 14.32 devasya devakīsūnoraparedyur mahotsavaḥ | nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ karma yacchruticoditam || 14.33 tatkurvatāmāśrameṣu sthitānāmānupūrvaśaḥ | varṇānāṃ mantralopādiśāntyarthaṃ pratyahaṃ naraiḥ || 14.34 ārādhanaṃ bhagavataḥ pūrṇāhutyā samaṃ matam | tasya nyūnātirekābhyāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ sakalaṃ bhavet || 14.35 karmajātaṃ tataḥ pūrṇam ārādhanam abhīpsitam | pratisaṃvatsaraṃ māsi śrāvaṇe tantunirmitam || 14.36 pavitrabhūṣaṇaṃ viṣṇor āropyaṃ bahumālyavat | ārādhya vidhivadbhādrapade cāśvayuje 'pi vā || 14.37 mantralopādinā karma patitaṃ vihitaṃ punaḥ | prāyaścittena tatkarma kartāraṃ trāyate punaḥ || 14.38 tatpavitraṃ phalair bhūyo rohatyeva samāhitam | iti nirvacanāt tajjñaiḥ pavitrārohaṇaṃ matam || 14.39 pūrvāditeṣu māseṣu dvādaśyāṃ pratipadyapi | daśamyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā pañcamyām athavā tithau || 14.40 ekādaśyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ dvitīyāyām athāpi vā | site pakṣe śubhe vāre lagne śubhatare 'thavā || 14.41 śravaṇe puṣyarohiṇyāṃ revatyāṃ bharaṇīṣu ca | svātau hastapunar vasvoraśvinyāṃ mitradaivate || 14.42 ṛkṣeṣv anyatame kāryaṃ pavitrāropaṇaṃ hareḥ | tantūn brāhmaṇakanyābhir nirmitān doṣavarjitān || 14.43 kārpāsānvātha kauśeyān krītānvā śuddhavāribhiḥ | kālitānmiśritāṃś cūrṇair maudgakaiś śodhayed bahiḥ || 14.44 ātapeṣu tataś śuddhān śoṣitāṃs triguṇīkṛtān | punas tāṃs triguṇīkṛtya tāvato 'pi caturguṇān || 14.45 yadvā triguṇitān nītvā cāturguṇyaṃ caturmukha | triguṇāṃs triguṇīkṛtya yadvā tānekatāṃ nayet || 14.46 gomayālepite bhūmitale mānānusārataḥ | śaṅkvos sthāpitayor yajñadrumasambhūtayos tataḥ || 14.47 āropya bhagavadbhaktāḥ prāṅmukhā vāpy udaṅmukhāḥ | āsīnā gurur anyo vā tatprayuktāḥ samāhitāḥ || 14.48 snātā nirmāṇanipuṇā manuṣyā bhagavanmayāḥ | kuryuḥ pavitraṃ kalyāṇaṃ yathā syād bhūṣaṇottamam || 14.49 pavitram adhivāsārthamādyaṃ nābhyavadhi smṛtam | aṣṭottaraśatais sūtrair dvātriṃśadgranthibhir yutam || 14.50 mūlaberādiberāṇāṃ pavitram idam iṣyate | pavitraṃ maṇḍale padmatulyamānaṃ ghaṭe 'pi ca || 14.51 kuṇḍe ca mekhalāmānaṃ pūrvedyurmānam īritam | aparedyuḥ pavitreṣu mānaṃ saṃprati kathyate || 14.52 padmanābhyaranemīnāṃ cakrābje maṇḍale satām | tanmānāni pavitrāṇi bāhyamānaṃ bahis samam || 14.53 granthayastantavaś caiṣāṃ kathyante ca yathākramam | catuśśatāni sūtrāṇi granthayas saptaviṃśatiḥ || 14.54 śatatrayaṃ tantusaṃkhyā granthayo dviguṇā matāḥ | dve śate triguṇā granthiś śatam ekam anantaram || 14.55 caturguṇā granthisaṃkhyā bāhyasūtraṃ catuśśatam | granthayaḥ pañcaguṇitāḥ kumbhe cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 14.56 tantavo granthisaṃkhyā ca saptaviṃśatir iṣyate | ekādhikāśītisaṃkhyāstantavaḥ karake matāḥ || 14.57 saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyāś ca granthayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ | pavitrasaṃkhyā berāṇāṃ daśa tāni vadāmi te || 14.58 prāmāṇyaṃ granthisaṃjñaṃ tadalaṅkārāhvayaṃ tathā | uttamādhamamadhyākhyaṃ kirīṭāhvam anantaram || 14.59 śrīvatsakaustubhāhvānaṃ vanamālāhvayaṃ tathā | mānāny eṣāṃ ca sūtrāṇi granthayaś ca yathākramam || 14.60 kathyante nābhimaryādā sūtrāṇy aṣṭottaraṃ śatam | dvātriṃsadgranthayastasya hṛdayāntam anantaram || 14.61 sūtrāṇy aśītistasyoktā granthayaḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ | jaṅghāmadhyasthamāyāmaṃ nirmitaṃ śatatantubhiḥ || 14.62 aṣṭottarair granthibhiś ca dvātriṃśadguṇitair yutam | uttamākhyasya sūtrāṇāṃ bhavet saṃkhyā catuśśatam || 14.63 śatam aṣṭottaraṃ saṃkhyā granthīnāṃ jānusīma tat | śatāni trīṇi tantūnāṃ granthayo 'śītir iṣyate || 14.64 āyataṃ corumadhyāntaṃ dve śate tantavaḥ punaḥ | nābhyantaṃ granthayaṣpaṣṭis tantavaś ca catuśśatam || 14.65 kirīṭamānaṃ dvātriṃśadgranthayas tadanantaram | śatāni trīṇi tantūnāṃ hārākāraprakalpitam || 14.66 granthibhis saptaviṃśatyā dve śate granthayaḥ punaḥ | dvātriṃśat stanamaryādaṃ sahasraṃ cāṣṭabhir yutam || 14.67 tantavaś caraṇāyāmamanekagranthibhir yutam | viṣṭarasya sahordhvasya pavitraṃ tatsamaṃ tatam || 14.68 tantavo 'ṣṭottaraśataṃ granthayaḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ | prabhā pavitraṃ tattulyaṃ granthayo bahavas smṛtāḥ || 14.69 sarveṣāṃ ca svatantrāṇāṃ bimbānām idam īritam | paratantreṣu bimbeṣu tritayaṃ tūttamādikam || 14.70 devīnāṃ ca śriyādīnāṃ pavitraṃ tadvad iṣyate | aṣṭottaraśatais sūtrair granthis saptabhir yutam || 14.71 agnikuṇḍe mekhalāsu pavitraṃ pratimekhalam | tantubhis saptaviṃśatyā tāvadbhir granthibhir yutam || 14.72 agneḥ pavitraṃ hastena samāyāmaṃ prakīrtitam | madhyamaṃ pañcaviṃśatyā dvāviṃśatyādhamaṃ matam || 14.73 sūtrāṇāṃ pañcaviṃśatyā pavitraṃ sruksruvādiṣu | tadāyāmasamāyāmaṃ granthibhir bahubhir yutam || 14.74 ardhyapātre tathā dhūpadīpapātre caturmukha | ghaṇṭāyāmakṣamālāyāṃ sarvatrāṣṭottaraiś śataiḥ || 14.75 sūtrair yathepsitā granthir dvādaśāṅgulamāyatam | viṣvaksenasya tārkṣyasya tathā duścyavanādiṣu || 14.76 digdevatāsu druhiṇe durgāyāṃ vighnanāyake | rudre ca parivāreṣu pavitraṃ tantubhiḥ kṛtam ||
