14.77 śatenāṣṭottareṇa syāt dvātriṃśadgranthibhir yutam | hastamānāyataṃ kāryaṃ caṇḍādiṣu tu sarvataḥ || 14.78 saptaviṃśatisūtreṇa granthabhinnena nirmitam | hastamānaṃ bhavet kumbhatoraṇādiṣu tādṛśam || 14.79 balipīṭhapavitraṃ tu karṇikāyās samaṃ mitam | ācāryāṇāṃ yatīnāṃ ca pavitraṃ tantubhiḥ kṛtam || 14.80 aṣṭottaraśatais sūtrair granthibhiḥ parvabhir yutam | ṛtvijāṃ pūjakānāñ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca || 14.81 ekāśītyā kṛtaṃ sūtrair nābhyantaparilambitam | rājñaḥ pavitraṃ sūtreṇa śatenāṣṭottareṇa tu || 14.82 yatheṣṭagranthinicayais tūlagarbhaiś ca nirmitam | nābhyantamānam etat syāt tathā tadanujīvinām || 14.83 ekāśītyā kṛtaṃ sūtrair vaiśyādīnāṃ ca tantubhiḥ | caturviṃśatibhis teṣāṃ pavitram upavītavat || 14.84 pavitreṣu samasteṣu vistāro vibhave sati | pādonamardhaṃ pādo vā saṃkhyā syād vibhavakṣaye || 14.85 granthiṃ tataḥ pavitrāṇāṃ dravyaiḥ kastūrikādibhiḥ | maṇimuktāpravālādyai ratnaiś cāpi yathāvasu || 14.86 lohaiś ca kaladhautādyais tūlair vā tadasannidhau | pūrayitvā dṛḍhaṃ baddhvā granthīṃs tāṃs tanturajjubhiḥ || 14.87 granthayaś śaṃkhasaṃsthānasamānākṛtayo 'thavā | dhātrīphalasamākārā yadvā muktādisannibhāḥ || 14.88 kuṃkumai rocanābhiś ca tathā malayajair api | lohitair apy avaśyāyais sampiṣṭaiḥ kardamīkṛtaiḥ || 14.89 granthīnām antarālāni limpec chobhā yathā bhavet | granthīnāṃ pūraṇaṃ yadvā mallikādyais sugandhibhiḥ || 14.90 puṣpais tadantarālāni niśācarcābhir eva vā | rañjayet tantavaś cāpi granthayaś ca yathecchayā || 14.91 yathāvibhavavistāraṃ kalpanīyāś caturmukha | vibhave sati saṅkoco naiva kāryo na vāsati || 14.92 vistāro naiva kāryas syāt tad eva prīṇanaṃ hareḥ | sadyo 'dhivāsya vā tasminn upoṣyārādhayed dharim || 14.93 gṛhārcane kautuke vā maṇḍale vā ghaṭe 'pi vā | arcanaṃ śraddhayā kāryaṃ śraddhāpūtam idaṃ jagat || 14.94 vihiteṣu pavitreṣu yathoktenaiva vartmanā | ārabhetārcanaṃ viṣṇor daśamyāṃ ca nivedanam || 14.95 niśāmukhe gurus sārdhaṃ mūrtipais susamāhitaḥ | yajamānena sahitaḥ praviśed viṣṇumandiram || 14.96 praviśya pūjayitvā taṃ gurus tais sahitas svayam | vijñāpayed imāṃ gāthām īrayan prāñjalissthitaḥ || 14.97 nyūnātirekaśāntyarthaṃ pavitrāropaṇaṃ param | arcanaṃ bhagavan sarvaduritotsāraṇakṣamam || 14.98 sampadāṃ cāpi sarvāsām utpādanamanuttamam | kriyate tadavighnena yathā syāt karma coditam || 14.99 tathānujñāpayāmi tvām anujānīhi karma tat | iti vijñāpya nirgatya mandirānmaṇḍape punaḥ || 14.100 saṃstīrya darbhān prāgagrāṃs teṣu prāgānato guruḥ | upaviśyopavāsaṃ ca kalpayitvā samāhitaḥ || 14.101 nayet tatraiva tāṃ rātriṃ japadhyānaparas sadā | aparedyur niśāyāṃ syād adhivāsanakarma tat || 14.102 ārabhetaikabereṣu baddhvā tatraiva kautukam | bahubereṣu kalyāṇabimbe kautukamaṅgalam || 14.103 tato nirgatya vipule maṇḍape toraṇādikam | arcayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ dikṣu caiva vidikṣu ca || 14.104 caturvedavido viprānekāyanavidaḥ tathā | adhīyānān sthāpayitvā tūryaghoṣeṣu satsu ca || 14.105 maṅgaleṣv api cānyeṣu kalpiteṣu yathātatham | pavitrapātrāṇyādāya prāgudakbhuvi maṇḍape || 14.106 dhānyarāśiṣu saṃsthāpya puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥ | dahanāpyāyanadhyānaiḥ pātrasthāni viśodhayet || 14.107 dhūpayed gandhavaddravyair limpet kastūrikādibhiḥ | puṣpāṇi vikiret teṣu gandhavanti bahūni ca || 14.108 tāni bhūṣaṇapātrāṇi veṣṭayen navavāsasā | darśayec cakramudrāṃ ca pūjayed astravidyayā || 14.109 aiśānīṃ diśamārabhya sūtrais saṃveṣṭya maṇḍapam | maṇḍapasyopari dhyātvā cakraṃ bhūmitale punaḥ || 14.110 padmaṃ gadāñ ca dvāreṣu śaṅkham aṣṭasu dikṣu ca | pratyūhakāriṇāṃ tasya chidram anviṣya dhāvatām || 14.111 bhūtānāṃ rākṣasādīnāṃ māṣānnena baliṃ kṣipet | bahubereṣu kalyāṇabimbaṃ snānāsane bahiḥ || 14.112 sthāpayitvopavītāntam upacarya yathāvidhi | cakrābjamaṇḍalaṃ bhūyas samānīya caturmukha || 14.113 havirnivedanānte tu samārādhanakarmaṇi | niṣṭhite karake kumbhe devam āvāhya pūjayet || 14.114 havirnivedayitvānte hutvā cāgniṃ yathāpuram | ekabere tu kalyāṇakautukārādhanaṃ vinā || 14.115 anyat sarvam anuṣṭheyaṃ yathāpūrvoditakramāt | sambhave kautuke tasmin pavitraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ punaḥ || 14.116 nikṣipet kumbhakarake dahane tadanantaram | cakrābjamaṇḍale mantram idaṃ viṣṇur iti bruvan || 14.117 praviśya mandiraṃ sarvair maṅgalais saha deśikaḥ | mūlaberaṃ samāsādya pavitranyasanaṃ tataḥ || 14.118 pūrvoditena mantreṇa sarvārcās syur yathākramam | pavitrabhūṣaṇanyāsaḥ pañcaraṅgaiś ca tantubhiḥ || 14.119 prāsādaṃ veṣṭayed rātrau sarvamāmnāyaghoṣaṇaiḥ | vādyair geyaiś ca nṛttaiś ca stotrair jāgaritā janāḥ || 14.120 nayeyur aparedyuś ca kautukaṃ maṇḍale sthitam | strānavedyāṃ samānīya snāpayitvā yathāvidhi || 14.121 alaṅkṛtya ca deveśaṃ maṇḍale mārjanādibhiḥ | śodhite vartayitvā ca cakrābjaṃ varṇapañcakaiḥ || 14.122 dvārādiyajanaṃ prāgvatkṛtvāvasthāpya maṇḍale | devam ārādhya dīpāntaṃ kumbhādīn api pūjayet || 14.123 annaṃ caturvidhaṃ cāpi kumbhe deve nivedya ca | agnau ca juhuyād annaṃ pāyasādi caturvidham || 14.124 pauruṣeṇaiva sūktena yavaiś ca vrīhiveṇubhiḥ | tilair lājais tathā puṣpais tathā cāgarubhir ghṛtaiḥ || 14.125 samidbhir mūlamantreṇa pṛthag aṣṭottaraṃ śatam | muhūrte śobhane prāpte daivajñapariśodhite || 14.126 pavitrāṇi samādāya cakrābjaṃ bhūṣayet punaḥ | padmādīni tadaṅgāni yathāsvamidamityṛcā || 14.127 tataḥ kumbhe ca karake deve ca tadanantaram | sa eva mantraḥ kuṇḍe 'pi havyavāhe 'pi toraṇe || 14.128 dvārakumbheṣu tatstheṣu pavitrāṇi yathātatham | tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya maṇḍalasthaṃ jagadgurum || 14.129 praviśya mandiraṃ sarvair maṅgalais saha deśikaḥ | snapanādi vidhāyādau samārādhanam ucyate || 14.130 havirnivedanāntaṃ tat kṛtvā tatratyadevatāḥ | mūlaberaṃ samārabhya pavitrair bhūṣayet svakaiḥ || 14.131 svatantrāḥ paratantrāś ca sarvāḥ pūrvoktavidyayā | abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pavitrāṇi pṛthak pṛthak || 14.132 deyāni dānavelāyāṃ vādyavādanakovidāḥ | nartakāḥ gāyakāś caiva tathā svādhyāyakovidāḥ || 14.133 sarve yathā svanṛttādi darśayeyus tadantike | caṇḍādiparivārāṇām anyeṣāṃ prāṅgaṇe satām || 14.134 pavitrāṇi pradeyāni balipīṭhāvasānakam | brahmādidevatānāṃ ca tārkṣayaseneśayor api || 14.135 anyeṣām apy anuktānāṃ pavitrāṇi yathāyatham | mantraś ca viṣṇugāyatryā yadvedaṃ viṣṇur ity ayam || 14.136 yadvā cāṣṭākṣareṇaiva mantreṇa dvādaśātmanā | deśiko mūrtipais sārdhaṃ yajamānena saṃyutaḥ || 14.137 praviśya mandiraṃ viṣṇo ratnapūrṇāñjalis svayam | hemapuṣpāñjalir vāpi yadvā puṣpabhṛtāñjaliḥ || 14.138 stotrais stuvāno bahubhir vikiret tāni pādayoḥ | ratnāni hemapuṣpāṇi puṣpāṇi surabhīṇy api || 14.139 kalpitāni manuṣyāṇāṃ pavitrāṇi yathāyatham | nyasya deveśapadayoḥ puṣpavat susamāhitaḥ || 14.140 kṣaumādīni pavitrāṇi devaṃ vijñāpya deśikaḥ | svayaṃ gṛhītvā kṣaumādi pavitraṃ cātmanaḥ kṛtam || 14.141 dadyāt pūjakamukhyānām ṛtvijāṃ sahakāriṇām | ekāyanīyaniṣṭhānām anyeṣāṃ viduṣām api || 14.142 yathādhikāraṃ kramaśo devasyālokya cānanam | spṛṣṭvā devapadāmbhojam ācāryo 'tha janāntike || 14.143 nyūnātirekaśāntyarthaṃ gāthām etām udīrayet | bhagavan devadeveśa śaṃkhacakragadādhara <śaṅkha�> || 14.144 saṃvatsaropacārāṇāṃ pūraṇārthaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā | ārādhanaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ bhaktānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 14.145 nāhaṃ svatantraḥ kiñcic ca karomi vihitaṃ hitam | kiṃ tu tvatpreritas sarvaṃ karomi tava na svayam || 14.146 tat kṣantavyam aśeṣeṇa kriyālopādyanuṣṭhitam | samaye yajamānas tu gāṃ bhuvaṃ kāñcanaṃ tathā || 14.147 vastrādīni tathā dhānyaṃ bhojayitvā mahīsurān | dattvā yathepsitaṃ natvā ācāryāya ca dakṣiṇām || 14.148 śataniṣkāvarāṃ gobhūvastradhāny ādikāny api | mūrtipebhyas tathānyebhyas tatatkarmānusārataḥ || 14.149 yathā tuṣṭikaraṃ deyaṃ yāge tatropakurvatām | aparāhṇe bahir grāme kuryād evaṃ mahotsavam || 14.150 prokṣya pratyaham etāni pūjākāleṣu pūjakaiḥ | nyasanīyāni divasāṃś caturdaśa caturmukha || 14.151 yadvaikaviṃśatiṃ sapta yadi vā divasān api | trirātram ekarātraṃ vā paścāt tāny avarohayet || 14.152 uccaran pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ sāma yadvā rathantaram | trisuparṇaṃ tathā mantraṃ mūlamantram athāpi vā || 14.153 avaropya pavitrāṇi deyāni gurave tataḥ | gurave tāni dattāni prīṇanāya madhudviṣaḥ || 14.154 anyathā karmanaiṣphalyaṃ kṣayas syād rājarāṣṭrayoḥ | maṇḍalasthaṃ ca kumbhastham agnisthaṃ ca visarjayet || 14.155 pavitrāropaṇadine kālotkarṣo na yujyate | kṛtvāvaropaṇaṃ teṣāṃ snapanaṃ tadanantaram || 14.156 kāryaṃ yathoktavidhinā praviśen mandiraṃ tataḥ | ity eṣa kathito brahman pavitrāropaṇe vidhiḥ || 14.157 anena vidhinā viṣṇoḥ pavitrārohaṇaṃ caret | kurvan phalāny anantāni prāpnuyān naiva saṃśayaḥ || 14.158 sukhaṃ jīvati nirvyādhiryāvadāyus samṛddhimān | āyuś ca vindati prāptaṃ dharmārthī dharmam āpnuyāt || 14.159 kāmānavāpnuyāt kāmī arthārthī cārtham āpnuyāt | mokṣārthī mokṣam āpnoti prajārthī labhate prajāḥ || 14.160 bāndhavair labhate cāpi prabāsibhis samāgamam | kīrtiṃ cāpnoti paramāṃ kīrtikāmo na saṃśayaḥ || 14.161 jñānārthī jñānam āpnoti śāntyarthī śāntim āpnuyāt | śatravastu praṇaśyanti grahabhūtādyupadravāḥ || 14.162 ārogyakāmī cārogyaṃ śrīkāmaḥ śriyam āpnuyāt | bahunātra kim uktena phalaṃ yadyadabhīpsitam || 14.163 tatsarvaṃ tasya hastasthaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | bhuktvā bhogāṃś ca vipulān dhyātvā cānte madhudviṣam || 14.164 tallokaṃ samavāpnoti punaś ceha na jāyate | dhārayanti pavitrāṇi ye bhaktāḥ śraddhayānvitāḥ || 14.165 te 'pi nirdhūya pāpāni modante divi devavat | ācāryo mūrtipās sarve ye cānye paricārakāḥ || 14.166 ye śṛṇvanti ca paśyanti kīrtayanti ca karma tat | te sarve 'pi samṛddhārthā labhante sarvasampadaḥ || 14.167 āgrayaṇaṃ śrāvaṇe māsi māsi proṣṭhapade 'pi vā | māse cāśvayuje brahman kārtike māsi vā bhavet || 14.168 varṣāsv evaṃ tato 'nyatra taiṣe māghe 'pi bhavet | phālgune cāpi caitre vā vaiśākhe vā tathācaret || 14.169 haste ca śravaṇe pauṣṇe nairṛte ca prajāpateḥ | nakṣatre vāruṇe puṣye vāyavye 'ditidaivate || 14.170 maghāsu maitre citrāyāṃ śraviṣṭhāyām athāpi vā | saumye triṣūttarākhyeṣu sambhavānuguṇaṃ bhavet || 14.171 ayugmāstithayas sarvā navamīparivarjitāḥ | yugmāstu tithayo neṣṭā dvitīyāṃ daśamīṃ vinā || 14.172 somo vṛhaspatis saumyo bhṛguś ceti grahāś śubhāḥ | meṣavṛścikamīne tu kanyājhaṣakulīrake || 14.173 pūrvapakṣe ca kartavyas tatrāyaṃ karmaṇaḥ kramaḥ | ādau dadhyodanaṃ kṣetre kṣetrapālāya kalpayet || 14.174 muhūrte lavanasyokte vidhāya lavanaṃ tataḥ | dhānyaṃ kaṇiśabhāreṇa gṛhṇīyād bhūmikarṣakaiḥ || 14.175 kadalīpanasādīni tathā dadhighṛtādikam | dhānyabhārān api tathā kadalyādidalāni ca || 14.176 nayeyur nṛttavāditragītālaṅkārasaṃyutam <�alaṃkārasaṃyutam> | purataḥ pṛṣṭhataś caiva seneśavihagādhipau || 14.177 alaṅkṛtau kuñjarādiyānārūḍhau yathāvasu | chatracāmarakauśeyadhvajādiparibarhiṇau || 14.178 nītvā pradakṣiṇaṃ grāmamālyaṃ ca madhudviṣaḥ | goṣṭhāgāraṃ praviśyāntardhānyaṃ kaṇiśagocaram || 14.179 śrīsūktena samabhyarcya bhāṇḍeṣv abhinaveṣu tat | nikṣipya saṅgrahaṃ tasya kuryus tatrālayeṣu ca || 14.180 karmiṇāṃ devadevasya yathādevaṃ samarcitam | yathādhikāraṃ dhānyādi dadyāc ca samaye śubhe || 14.181 taṇḍulānnūtanānāmān kṣālitāṃs triphalīkṛtān | marīcair jīrakair yuktān gulapāke subhāvitān || 14.182 nālikeraphalopetānikṣudaṇḍasamanvitān | mūlaberādiberāṇāṃ muhūrte śobhane guruḥ || 14.183 nivedayet tato mūlavidyayāṣṭottaraṃ śatam | taṇḍulair juhuyād agnau brahmādīnāṃ yathāpuram || 14.184 tasmin dine paredyur vā navānnāni nivedayet | prabhūtasaṃstutānekaniṣṭhāni kadalīdale || 14.185
iti pañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde pavitrādyutsavavidhir nāma caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
vratānuṣṭhānakramaḥ śrībhagavān māsi bhādrapade devaṃ śrāvaṇe cādipūruṣam | varāhadevaṃ subhagaṃ hiraṇyākṣāsuradviṣam || 15.1 yajeta devyā dharayā sārdhaṃ sarvārthasiddhaye | anyeṣāṃ mūrtibhedānām api tasmin samarcanam || 15.2 snātvā cāyuje māsi yajanaṃ snapanādibhiḥ | kārtike māsi samprāpte dvādaśyāṃ cāsitetare || 15.3 pakṣe prabodhayed devam arcayitvā yathāvasu | mantraścodityamityeṣa uttiṣṭheti ca bodhane || 15.4 prabodhya cārcayed devam utthitaṃ vidhivartmanā | autsavaṃ bimbam abhyarcya maṇḍape maṇḍale sthitam || 15.5 dvāratoraṇakumbhādiyajanaṃ ca yathāpuram | grāme mahotsavaḥ kāryas sarvamaṅgalasaṃyutaḥ || 15.6 sarve cāśramiṇaḥ kuryur vratānāṃ ca visarjanam | daśaniṣkaṃ tadardhaṃ vā dakṣiṇāṃ gurave tadā || 15.7 kṛttikāsu ca kārtikyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ madhudviṣaḥ | kṛttikābhir ayoge vā kevalāyāṃ tithau bhavet || 15.8 dīpotsavas tadā sarvaṃ śobhayed devamandiram | āropya sarvato dīpān stambheṣūccair madhudviṣaḥ || 15.9 dikṣu sarvāsu sarvatra tathā cāvaraṇeṣu ca | kūṭākārāḥ kalpanīyās teṣu syur dīpamālikāḥ || 15.10 prākārabhittiṣu tathā maṇṭape gopureṣu ca | bahvībhir dīpamālābhir bhāvyaṃ sarvāṣu dikṣu ca || 15.11 dīpotsavāya pūrvedyur niśi kalyāṇakautukam | badhnīyād autsave vimbe sarvamaṅgalasaṃyutam || 15.12 aparedyuś ca mūlādiberāṇām arcanaṃ bhavet | naimittikaṃ pradoṣe tu kuryād dīpādhivāsanam || 15.13 purastān mūlaberasya pātram āropya nūtanam | dhānyarāśau tatas tasminnājyamāḍhakasaṃmitam || 15.14 kāpilaṃ tailam athavā nikṣipya pariśodhitam | ṛjuvartiṃ tantubhir vā vāsasā nūtanena vā || 15.15 kalpayitvā samuddhṛtya kuṇḍāgniṃ tena dīpayet | vartimāgneyamantreṇa agnimudrāṃ pradarśayet || 15.16 abhyarcya cāgnimantrais tu muhūrte śobhane guruḥ | ādāya pātranyastena bahninā valajādiṣu || 15.17 dīpayed dīpikās sarvās tūryeṣu vidiśo diśaḥ | ghoṣayatsu tathā nṛttagītādīnāṃ samudyame || 15.18 adhīyāneṣu vipreṣu mantrānanaladaivatān | autsavaṃ bimbamādāya sarvālaṅkāraśobhitam || 15.19 yānam āropya rathyāsu nayedāvaraṇeṣu ca | dṛśyāni nāṭakādīni kṛtrimāṇītarāṇi ca || 15.20 darśayed devadevāya bhāṣābhedān yathoditān | āsādya maṇḍape tasmin nivedya ca mahāhaviḥ || 15.21 pṛthukān saṃskṛtān saktūn palālān agnitṛptaye | apūpān samaye tasmin nivedya madhuvidviṣe || 15.22 abhyantaraṃ mandirasya gamayen maṅgalānvitam | kṛttikādīpavidhinā samārādhanam īritam || 15.23 viśāṃ ca rājño rāṣṭrasya sampatkaramanuttamam | vipatpraśamanaṃ brahman prīṇanaṃ jātavedasaḥ || 15.24 mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe māsi vratam anuttamam | dvādaśīvratapūrvatvād vratamārādhanaṃ hareḥ || 15.25 ārādhanaṃ bhagavataḥ kurvaṃs tādṛśam uttamam | daśamyāṃ harim ārādhya bhojayitvā ca bhūsurān || 15.26 dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśakti dattvā tebhyas samāhitaḥ | bhagavatsannidhau teṣāṃ vijñāpya dvādaśīvratam || 15.27 anujñāpūrvikāṃ pūjāṃ vratapūrvāṃ mahāphalām | saṅkalpya darbheṣv āsīnaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ praṇidhānavān || 15.28 haviṣyāśī vratī kṛtvā sarvaṃ karmāhnikaṃ tathā | rātrau ca bhagavadyogamāsthāya ca yathāvidhi || 15.29 aparedyuḥ kriyājātam ekādaśyāṃ yathāvidhi | pūrvaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī niyamaṃ paramāsthitaḥ || 15.30 anaśnen devam ārādhya homāntaṃ maunamāsthitaḥ | bhagavaddhyānanirato vyavahāraṃ ca laukikam || 15.31 asaṃspṛśanmanaḥ kāyakarmabhiś ceṅgitādibhiḥ | sthito maunī tadā tadvadrātrau kautukabandhanam || 15. 32 baddhvā deveśam ārādhya darbhaśāyī nayen niśām | brāhme muhūrte cotthāya kṛtvā sandhyāṃ yathāvidhi || 15.33 karma devāntikaṃ gatvā kuryāt pūjāṃ yathāpuram | caturvedavido viprān dikṣu prācyādiṣu kramāt || 15.34 darbhāsaneṣvāsayitvā devasyābhimukhaṃ yathā | koṇeṣu ca diśāṃ viprān ekāyanavidas tathā || 15.35 adhyāpayedadhyayanaṃ yathā svacchandasāṃ guruḥ | sāmagānitarālābhe kevalāṃs tapasi sthitān || 15.36 ekāyanavido vāpi hares tatprīṇanaṃ param | prāśayed brāhmaṇais sārdhaṃ vratasthaḥ kāyaśuddhaye || 15.37 kuśodakaṃ pañcagavyaṃ prāpaṇaṃ ca yathākramam | divāsvāpaṃ parānnaṃ ca punar bhojanakarma ca || 15.38 strīsevāṃ tailasevāṃ ca kāṃsyabhojanam eva ca | māṃsāśanaṃ tyajet tasmin divase karma garhitam || 15.39 bhojayec ca yathāśakti dadyād ante ca dakṣiṇām | upavāsākṣamo naktam ekādaśyāṃ samācaret || 15.40 ajñānāc ca trayodaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ rākṣasaṃ bhavet | varjyāś ca vārā mandasya bhṛgor aṅgārakasya ca || 15.41 nakṣatraṃ yamadaivatyaṃ vratārambhe caturmukha | pāraṇaṃ copavāsaś ca na doṣāya tithitraye || 15.42 na sambhāṣeta pāṣaṇḍavṛttibhir garhitair naraiḥ | pramādād api naivānyair nāstikaiḥ pratilomajaiḥ || 15.43 nāśaucavadbhir dvādaśyāṃ vratastho nāvalokayet | ārdrāyām api māse 'smin janmarkṣe ca garutmataḥ || 15.44 tatprītaye samārādhyo hariś śāstroktavartmanā | pāyasānnaṃ gulānnaṃ ca prabhāte vinivedayet || 15.45 bimbaṃ cautsavamākalaya vīthikāvaraṇeṣu ca | garuḍenaiva sahitaṃ gamayen maṅgalānvitam || 15.46 uttare cāyane devaṃ snapanādyais samarcayet | ghṛtenābhyañjayed devaṃ majjayed vā ghṛtādiṣu || 15.47 ghṛte vā dadhni pīyūṣe yadvā madhuni sambhṛte | phaleṣu vā phalarasaiḥ pañcagavyaraseṣu vā || 15.48 pāyasādiṣu cānneṣu kālapuṣpoccayeṣu vā | daleṣu vā tulasyāder navaratnacayeṣu vā || 15.49 suvarṇakaladhauteṣu puṣpākāreṣu śobhane | suvarṇagolakāḥ kṛtvā kalpitāvayavojjvalāḥ || 15.50 kalpitākalpakalyāṇapratimākārasaṃmitāḥ | pīṭhikākāratulitāstābhirācchādya bhūṣayet || 15.51 pañcāyudhasamākārā hastādisadṛśākṛtīḥ | kṛtvā pṛthagyathāśobhaṃ golakāḥ kañcukākṛtīḥ || 15.52 bhūṣayet tābhiraṅgāni cāyudhāni ca sarvaśaḥ | āpādamastakāṃ vānyair vrīhyādibhir adhokṣajam || 15.53 chādayen mūlanmantreṇa pūraṇaṃ sarvavastubhiḥ | tisras tripādasahitān api vā dviguṇāṃs tathā || 15.54 pūrayet kālamātodyanṛttagītādimaṅgalam | ācaret sarvam etasmin yathāvibhavavistaram || 15.55 juhuyāt sarpiṣā yāvat pūraṇaṃ mūlavidyayā | deyā ca dakṣiṇā svarṇamācāryāya yathāvasu || 15.56 ghṛtādipūraṇaṃ caitat sarvakāmasamṛddhidam | puṣye ca māsi nakṣatre paurṇamāsyām athāpi vā || 15.57 ārādhanaṃ bhagavatas sarvapāpavināśanam | māghamāse site makṣe pañcamyāṃ madhuvidviṣam || 15.58 samārādhya yathāśāstraṃ devasyāgre mahītale | gomayālepite dvābhyāṃ hastābhyām api saṃmite || 15.59 caturbhir vā samāyāmavistāre chādite punaḥ | vāsasā nūtanenaiva sadaśena tathopari || 15.60 kṛṣṇājinena śuddhena bhedanacchedanādinā | varjitena samācchādya vastraṃ tadupari kṣipet || 15.61 tilānāṃ bhāram ekaṃ vā dvau vā kṛtvā ca vedikām | trimekhalāṃ tile tasmin padmākārasamākṛtim || 15.62 niṣkatrayātmakaṃ svarṇaṃ lekhāpadmaṃ tileṣu vā | nikṣipya navaratnāni dikṣu cāṣṭāsu nikṣipet || 15.63 dhānyapūrṇāni pātrāṇi dve dve pratidiśaṃ kramāt | prasthatailaṃ tathā sarpirdadhi cāpi caturguṇam || 15.64 pārśvayoḥ purataś cāpi pātrasthaṃ nyasya bhūtale | tilājyāhāraḥ puratas trīṇy ahāni yatendriyaḥ || 15.65 upoṣya vā guruḥ pūrvam ekarātraṃ caturmukha | abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyais tilānnais tadanantaram || 15.66 adhīyāneṣu vipreṣu tūryavāditraghoṣaṇe | maṅgaleṣu tathānyeṣu pravṛtteṣu yathātatham || 15.67 tilais sahasrakṛtvo 'gnau juhuyān mūlavidyayā | ācāryaṃ pañcakālajñaṃ bhagavacchāstrakovidam || 15.68 kalyāṇācāranirataṃ sarvais samuditaṃ guṇaiḥ | tasmai bhāgavatāyedam arcayitvākṣatādibhiḥ || 15.69 tilapadmaṃ pradātavyaṃ sannidhau vāripūrvakam | prīyatāṃ bhagavān viṣṇur ity ācāryeṇa mantravit || 15.70 tadante devam abhyarcya bhojayitvā mahīsurān | dadyāc ca dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyo gurave ca yathoditām || 15.71 itthaṃ tilasarojaṃ yo dadyād dhānyādisaṃyutam | punāti sa pitṝn sarvān ātmānaṃ ca parāvarān || 15.72 māsarkṣe paurṇamāsyāṃ ca yajanaṃ snapanādibhiḥ | phālgune māsi phalgunyāṃ śrīkāmo harim arcayet || 15.73 upoṣya pūrvaṃ niyato dhyāyann itthaṃ samāhitaḥ | vipule bilvavipine madhye puṣkaraśobhite || 15.74 mahātaṭāke śiñjānapakṣisaṅghasamākule | maṇḍale tatra māhendre prākārapariveṣaṇe || 15.75 caturdvāre caturdikṣu kalpakadrumamaṇḍite | sauvarṇe bahukalyāṇaratnastambhasamanvite || 15.76 siṃhāsane vare ratnapadme 'ṣṭadalasaṃyute | karṇikākesaropete sukhāsīnaṃ śriyā saha || 15.77 pūrvādidikṣu dhyātavyā vāsudevādayo dale | āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu catvāro hastinaḥ kramāt || 15.78 gugguluś ca kuraṇḍaś ca damakaśśalalas tathā | śaṅkhapadmanidhī cāpi siṃhaviṣṭarapārśvayoḥ || 15.79 anyonyābhimukhau bhūri vamantau vasu sarvadā | bhūmyādayo 'ṣṭau pūrvādidikṣu cāmarapāṇayaḥ || 15.80 indrādayaś ca pūrvādidikṣv aṣṭāv aṣṭasu sthitāḥ | sthitāś caturṣu dvāreṣū vetrahastās sakuñcikāḥ || 15.81 kubjaveṣāṃ striyo dvāri palayantyo manoharāḥ | balākinī bhīṣikā ca tathaiva vanamālinī || 15.82 śāṅkarī ca kramād etāḥ pūrvādiṣu caturmukha | dvārāṇi pālikābhiś ca pūrṇakumbhair dvijais tathā || 15.83 toraṇair dāmabhir mauktair dīpair anyaiś ca maṅgalaiḥ | pariṣkṛtāni dhyātvaivaṃ devīṃ devaṃ ca pūjayet || 15.84 śriyaṃ vā kevalāṃ padme karṇikāyāmavasthitām | maṇḍape tatra pūrvokte parivārasamanvite || 15.85 lakṣmīprasūnakaiḥ padmaiḥ homo bilvādipallavaiḥ | samidājyaiś ca mantreṇa śriyaś cāṣṭākṣareṇa ca || 15.86 śrīsūktāni caturdikṣu pāṭhyāni pṛthivīsuraiḥ | ārādhyābhiṣṭuyādante stotrair bahuvidhaiḥ śriyam || 15.87 namāmi devi lokānāṃ janayitryabjasambhave | sarvalokeśvaraiśeśavallabhe durlabhe 'dhamaiḥ || 15.88 vāsudevāṅgasaṃsparśasukhaikarasabhājane | namaste śubhade devi devānām adhidevate || 15.89 yadṛcchayāpi te yeṣu kaṭākṣāḥ patitās sakṛt | kṣudreṣv api pragalbhante te trilokeśvarāḥ kramāt || 15.90 na spṛśanti trilokeśān api yān vīkṣaṇāni te | sampādyante kṣaṇāt kṣudrā nākaspṛṣṭhād api cyutāḥ || 15.91 lāvaṇyādiguṇā yatra kāṣṭhāmaśnuvate parām | tāni tvadīyāny aṅgāni devi kaḥ stotum arhati || 15.92 tvaṃ māyā tvam avidyāsi baṃśantī [tvaṃ śaktiḥ] karmaṇām api | caitanyaśaktis tvam asi prakṛtis triguṇātmikā || 15.93 tvam eva vidyā tryyantā trayī ca tvaṃ parāvare | yasyāstavāyutāṃśāṃśe devyo vāgādayassthitāḥ || 15.94 saccidānandarūpasya parasya paramātmanaḥ | ānandādimayī mūrtiravibhaktā bhavatyasi || 15.95 prabhāsi tasya nityā tvaṃ bhāsvataḥ paramātmanaḥ | sandhyā tvam asi viprāṇāṃ vandanīyā dine dine || 15.96 bhūrbhuvaḥ svastrayī ca tvaṃ bhūrasi tvaṃ bhuvo 'si ca | svarasi vyāhṛtiś cāsi ṛgyajussāmakāraṇam || 15.97 tvam āhutis tvam iṣṭiś ca dakṣiṇāsi tvam eva ca | siddhiś ca karmaṇāṃ tvatto nānyāsti kamalālaye || 15.98 nītirānvīkṣakī vārtā vidyā cānyāsi laukikī | dṛṣṭvā devi tvayā hīnaṃ mṛtaprāyaṃ jagattrayam || 15.99 yatnair ambhodhimathanaprāyair āvirbabhūvitha | ānuṣaṅgikam utpannaṃ prāptam apsarasām api || 15.100 tādṛg evāmṛtādanyadindire harimandire | hālāhalaviṣaṃ cāpi janmanaḥ śreyase tava || 15.101 pratyūharūpeṇotpannaṃ kṣīravāridhisambhave | abhyarhitā tavotpattirevaṃ nāma madhudviṣaḥ || 15.102 kūrmāditiryagyonitvaṃ yatprāptaṃ paramātmanā | tvaṃ sarvalokajananī janako jagatāṃ hariḥ || 15.103 tvayā ca viṣṇunā caitadvyāptaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam | mā naḥ kośaṃ tathā goṣṭhaṃ mā gṛhaṃ mā paricchadam || 15.104 mā śarīraṃ kalatraṃ ca tyajethā mā ca santatim | śrutavān śīlavān dakṣo buddhimānvittavānṛjuḥ || 15.105 vṛttavān bandhumān śrīmān paśumān dhānyavān api | guṇavān kīrtimān loke tathābhijanavān prabhuḥ || 15.106 āyuṣmān vijayī bhūmāṃs tathaivārogyavān api | ślāghyavāg devi puruṣaḥ kaṭākṣaviṣayāttava || 15.107 guṇair yathoktai rahitastvaddarśanavivarjitaḥ <rahitas tvaddarśanavivarjitaḥ | krīḍābhūmir harer yasyā vakṣobhūmis sanātanī || 15.108 ānantyāt tava kalyāṇi guṇānāṃ varṇane kṣamaḥ | na vācaspater anyeṣāṃ dūre syān mādṛśāṃ sthitiḥ || 15.109 prasīda devi padme tvaṃ padmahaste śucismite | padmāsane padmayonerjanayitri haripriye || 15.110 padmapriye namastubhyaṃ viṣṇor vakṣaḥsthalālaye | stutyantamittham ārādhya devyas sarvāḥ śriyādayaḥ || 15.111 arhaṇaṃ copavītaṃ ca varjayitvopacaryayā | dhyātvā yathoktamātreṇa yadvā dhūmadhvajārcanam || 15.112 utsavaṃ ca śriyā devyā sārdhaṃ tadvan madhudviṣaḥ | yāvajjīvaṃ śriyaṃ devīm arcayan sampadaṃ parām || 15.113 ihānubhūya bhūyo 'pi paratra śriyam aśnute | yadyatkāmayamānena puruṣeṇārcanaṃ śriyaḥ || 15.114 labhate tattad eveha phalabhedaiḥ kim īritaiḥ | ārogyakāmassāvitre maṇḍale raktapaṅkaje || 15.115 āsīnaṃ viṣṭare pītakauśeyavasanaṃ harim | niṣṭaptapanīyābhaṃ caturbhujamadhokṣajam || 15.116 prasādasumukhaṃ sevyaṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitam | devīsahāyaṃ kalyāṇaṃ kevalaṃ vā caturmukha || 15.117 pūrvādyaṣṭadalāsīnaṃ śaktyaṣṭasamupāsitam | evaṃ dhyātvārcayen nityam ārogyaṃ param aśnute || 15.118 ananyalabhyam ārogyaṃ sarvaṃ labdhvā tataḥ param | dināni pañca śastāni vaiṣṇavāni caturmukha || 15.119 teṣu vratamanuṣṭheyaṃ sarvābhipretasādhanam | pakṣadvaye 'pi dvādaśyau sinīvālī kuhūs tathā || 15.120 śravaṇarkṣaṃ dināni syur māseṣu dvādaśasv api | caitrādiṣu dvādaśasu māseṣu dvādaśādhipāḥ || 15.121 arcanīyāḥ kramād viṣṇus tathaiva madhusūdanaḥ | trivikramo vāmanaś ca śrīdharas tadanantaram || 15.122 hṛṣīkeśaḥ padmanābho dāmodarasamāhvayaḥ | keśavo nāmadheyena tathā nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 15.123 mādhavo 'nyaś ca govindo dvādaśaite prakīrtitāḥ | māse caitre samārambho mārgaśīrṣe 'thavā bhavet || 15.124 aśnan haviṣyaṃ pūrvedyuranaśnannapare 'hani | śravaṇe madhyame bhāge śucirdakṣas samāhitaḥ || 15.125 cakrābjamaṇḍale yadvā bimbe kumbhe 'thavā harim | ārādhya mūrtiṃ māseśam upacārair yathoditaiḥ || 15.126 ādāv ante ca vittāni dattvā śaktyanusārataḥ | brāhmaṇebhyas tathā dattvā gurave dakṣiṇādikam || 15.127 aparedyus tathā devīm arcayitvā yathāvidhi | pāraṇaṃ brāhmaṇais sārdhaṃ kuryān niyatamānasaḥ || 15.128 evaṃ caturṣu cānyeṣu dineṣv ārādhanakramaḥ | māsi māsi ca yaṣṭavyā māseśo mūrtir abjaja || 15.129 dineṣu pañcasūkteṣu sarvābhipretasiddhaye | triṣu saṃvatsareṣv evaṃ kṛtvā māseṣu ca triṣu || 15.130 vrate samāpte snapanaṃ kuryāt pūrvoktavartmanā | yācayeta vrataphalaṃ dhānyarāśau sthito dvijaḥ || 15.131 bhojayitvā dvijavarān dattvā tebhyaś ca dakṣiṇām | dakṣiṇābhistathācāryaṃ toṣayet kāñcanādibhiḥ || 15.132 paurṇamāsyām api hy eṣa kramo māsādhipārcane | viśeṣatas triyāmāyāṃ candramasyudite 'rhaṇām || 15.133 kuhvām api tithau prāgvadarcayed vratamāsthitaḥ | ārādhanaṃ dineṣv eṣu caturvargaphalapradam || 15.134 sarvasmin māsanakṣatre prādur bhavadineṣu ca | arcayitvāṅkurān pūjā kāryā snapanapūrvikā || 15.135 homāvasānikā vripān tarpayec ca yathāvasu |
iti śrīpañcarātre mahopanaṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde vratānuṣṭhānakramo nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
saṃmārjanādiphala - devasvāpahāradoṣakīrtanam brahmovāca bhagavan bhāvināṃ karmaphalānām aśubhātmanām | sūcaneṣu nimitteṣu sañjāteṣv aśubhātmasu || 16.1 grahadoṣādiṣu nṛṇām adhipasya ca bhūpateḥ | teṣām akasmājjātānāṃ karma yacchamanaṃ param || 16.2 tatsamākhyāyatāṃ kīdṛk kiṃ kathaṃ veti cācyuta | rahasyam api tadvācyaṃ dayayā parayā mayi || 16.3 śrībhagavān janmarkṣādyaśubhasthānaṃ gateṣv aṅgārakādiṣu | krūreṣu durnimitteṣu duḥsvapnasamayeṣu ca || 16.4 gṛhakṣetrādikeṣv evaṃ valmīkajanane tathā | raktavṛṣṭiṣu jātāsvagnidāhe ca veśmanām || 16.5 vastrādimūṣikādaṃśe dagdheṣū śayanādiṣu | saṅkaṭeṣv api cānyeṣu putrādikalahātmasu || 16.6 nṛpakope tathā cittaduḥkhe nigalabandhane | pīḍāyāmaripakṣeṇa piśācādyair mayānakaiḥ || 16.7 vratadhvaṃse prāgabhāve putrāṇām arthahāniṣu | aniṣṭasūcane putrajanmany utpātasambhave || 16.8 evamādiṣu cānyeṣu doṣeṣv ārādhanaṃ mama | śāntaye kalpate brahman prakāras tasya kathyate || 16.9 snānapūrvāṇi karmāṇi kṛtvā vidhivadādṛtaḥ | śucau bhūmitale kumbhaṃ sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tu vā || 16.10 tāmraṃ vāpi yathāvittaṃ vāripūrṇaṃ sakūrcakam | tantubhir veṣṭitaṃ nyastavāribījaṃ samallakam || 16.11 ācāryaṃ varayet paścān madārādhanatatparam | śamādiguṇasaṃyuktaṃ pañcakālaparāyaṇam || 16.12 dhānyarāśiṣu saṃsthāpya nyastaratnasuvarṇakam | śāntidravyasanāthaṃ ca aśvatthadalamaṅgalam || 16.13 veṣṭitaṃ navavastreṇa raktenākṣatasaṃyutam | prācyāṃ diśi ca deveśamāvāhya ghaṭikāsane || 16.14 kuśakūrcaiḥ paścimāśāsaṃmukhe 'ṣṭākṣareṇa tu | yajetārdhyādinā yadvā riktaṃ tasya tadarcanam || 16.15 kumbhe cāvāhya yajanaṃ juhuyād gavyasarpiṣā | mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇaiva lakṣavārānathāyutam || 16.16 sahasram api vā kuṇḍe śataṃ vāṣṭottaraṃ guruḥ | dhyātvā hariṃ sarvaśāntikaraṃ sarvasamṛddhidam || 16.17 gauravaṃ lāghavaṃ cāpi samavekṣya yathocitam | doṣāṇāṃ yatnamātiṣṭhed arcanādiṣu sarvataḥ || 16.18 ante praṇavamabliṅgair yajamānaṃ gurus svayam | mantraiḥ kumbhasthatoyena prokṣayen mūlavidyayā || 16.19 sahasrakṛtvaḥ kūrcena snāpayec cheṣavāribhiḥ | ācāryāya yathāvittaṃ dadyāt svarṇādi dakṣiṇām || 16.20 brāhmaṇān bhojayet tebhyo dakṣiṇām alpikām api | prabhūṇām api sarveṣāṃ sarvopadravaśāntaye || 16.21 sarvābhipretalābhāya viśeṣayajanaṃ hareḥ | kuryāt snapanapūrvaṃ tadahni nityārcane kṛte || 16.22 tadante śāntikaṃ karma aparāhṇe 'tha pauṣṭikam | pūrvāhṇe nityakarmoktaṃ vastubhir dviguṇair iha || 16.23 pūjādravyair ekabere mūlabere samarcanam | bahubere tu bimbe syād autsave kamalāsana || 16.24 ācārya eva pūjāyāṃ vaiśeṣikyāṃ samarcayet | homakuṇḍaṃ bhavet padmatulyākāraṃ suśobhanam || 16.25 pauṣṭike śāntike vṛttaṃ pratyahaṃ samidādibhiḥ | pratyekaṃ tilahomas syād ayutaṃ vā śatāvaram || 16.26 pratyahaṃ bhojayed viprān yathāśakti ca dakṣiṇā | nṛttaṃ goyaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca tahādhyayanamanvaham || 16.27 karmāvasānadivasaṃ yāvad agneś ca dhāraṇam | saptāhaṃ dviguṇaṃ vā syāt triguṇaṃ vā caturguṇam || 16.28 snapanaṃ pratyahaṃ kāryaṃ dānahomādayas tathā | śāntike karmaṇi dhyeyo hariḥ sphaṭikasannibhaḥ || 16.29 pauṣṭike tu suvarṇābhaḥ śriyāsīnas sahāsane | cakrābjamaṇḍale kumbhe yatra prathamam arcanam || 16.30 tatraivānyedyurārādhyo na tu nirmālyatā tayoḥ | ācāryadakṣiṇā cāpi yathāvibhavavistaram || 16.31 karmaṇy adhikṛtāṇāṃ ca karmagauravalāghavam | avekṣya toṣaṇaṃ vittai ṛtvijāṃ copakurvatām || 16.32 dineṣu cānukūleṣu prārabhyā pauṣṭikī kriyā | śāntikī pratikūleṣu yajamānasya padmaja || 16.33 brahmovāca bhagavan mārjanādīni mandire kurvatāṃ nṛṇām | viṣṇoḥ kṣetrādidātrṇāṃ pūjopakaraṇāni ca || 15.34 bhūṣaṇāni ca vastrāṇi phalam abhyudayātmakam | kīdṛk kīdṛk ca tāny eva dattānyāharatām api || 15.35 anarthakaram etan me saṃśayānasya kathyatām | mārjanaṃ mandire viṣṇoḥ kurvan saṃmārṣṭi dehajam || 15.36 śrībhagavān malaṃ pāpātmakaṃ sarvaṃ paratreha ca sambhṛtam | pratyahaṃ mārjanaṃ kurvan pratyahaṃ hanti kilbiṣam || 15.37 gocarmamātram ālipya gomayena ca bhūtalam | ālaye labhate sadyo gopradānaphalaṃ naraḥ || 15.38 mārjanālepane kurvan viṣṇor āyatane naraḥ | uṣitvā sa ciraṃ svarge karmaśeṣeṇa bhūtale || 16.39 bhūyo 'pi jāyate bhūpaḥ kule mahati pūjite | srajaṃ baddhvā sumanasāṃ yaḥ prayacchati viṣṇave || 16.40 sa bhuktvā vipulān bhogān nākapṛṣṭhe virājate | dīpānāropayed viṣṇor mandirābhyantare bahiḥ || 16.41 divi devavadāsthitvā jāyate paramārthavit | nityonnaimittikānvāpi dīpān āropayen naraḥ || 16.42 bahuduḥkhasamākīrṇaṃ narakaṃ na sa paśyati | ahorātraṃ tvanirvāṇaṃ dīpam āropayen naraḥ || 16.43 sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā viṣṇuloke mahīyate | udakābhyukṣaṇaṃ viṣṇor ālaye vidadhāti yaḥ || 16.44 lokaṃ sa vāruṇaṃ prāpya ramate vatsarān bahūn | saṃmṛjyālipya ca harer dhāma puṣpāṇi bhūtale || 16.45 vikiren manujas sarvakāmānāpnoti puṣkalān | viṣṇusātkurute bhūmiṃ bahusasyaphalapradām || 16.46 yasya lokānavāpnoti sarvān eva saṃśayaḥ | puṣpodyānapradānena tapoloke mahīyate || 16.47 phalavṛkṣasamopetāṃ prāgbhūmiṃ (tu) jalānvitām | yo dadāti maharloke sa ciraṃ vasati dhruvam || 16.48 utpādayati yaḥ kṣetre vaiṣṇave phalinastarūn | nālikerādikān yāti sa svargaṃ pretya durlabham || 16.49 ārādhanāya tulasīṃ utpādayati yatnavān | surabhīṇi ca puṣpāṇi divi devaiḥ sa pūjyate || 16.50 vāpīkūpataṭākāni viṣṇor mandirabhūmiṣu | utpādayati haste syus tasya sarvasamṛddhayaḥ || 16.51 na taṃ badhnanti pāpāni bahujanmārjitāny api | yaḥ kuryād vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma bhaktiśraddhobhayocitam || 16.52 khaṇḍite sphuṭite dhāmni dūṣite ca sudhādibhiḥ | samādadhyāt punar dhāma sa lokaṃ yāti vaiṣṇavam || 16.53 snānapānāmbhasor viṣṇoḥ pradānāttatsalokabhāk | snānīyadravyadānena nīrogaḥ pretya modate || 16.54 kṣaumādidānād āpnoti paraloke mahat sukham | ālepanadravyadānāt kāmān āpnoti śāśvatān || 16.55 ekākarpūratāmbūlītailādisparśanāt sukhī | paratreha ca loke syād dīrghakālaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 16.56 cāmaravyajanacchatradānāt svārājyam aśnute | dānādābharaṇādīnāṃ tejasvī divi modate || 16.57 dānāc ca navaratnānāṃ devasālokyam aśnute | ādarśanapradānena dṛśyas sarvair bhaviṣyati || 16.58 dhūpadravyapradānena svasthānaṃ svargiṇāṃ bhavet | upānahau pāduke ca vāhanaṃ yānam eva ca || 16.59 dadāti yo maṇḍayitvā maṇikāñcanacitritam | sa vimānaṃ suduṣprāpaṃ prāpnoty eva na saṃśayaḥ || 16.60 alaṅkṛtaṃ bhadrapīṭhaṃ prayacchan sarvakāmabhāk | vinatānandanasthānaṃ dhvajam utpādya darśayan || 16.61 sāmīpyaṃ sahasā viṣṇor yāti sadyaś caturmukha | dhvajaṃ ca vādyam utpādya viṣṇusātkurute ca yaḥ || 16.62 sa divyadundubhiprāyaṃ sthānaṃ prāpya virājate | dāsīdāsaṃ tadātmīyam ātmānaṃ ca prayacchati || 16.63 vāsudevāya dāsyena muktiḥ karatale sthitā | nṛttabhedair gītabhedais tathā vādyair anekadhā || 16.64 śrotavyair api divyaiś cāpy evaṃ devasya sannidhau | āsanādyupacārais tair ye samārādhayanti te || 16.65 pretya divyeṣu kāleṣu pūjyante tair na saṃśayaḥ | pradakṣiṇanamaskārais stutiprāyopacaryayā || 16.66 ārādhayanti ye devaṃ devānām adhidaivatam | te devair upavarṇyante paratra bhagavān yathā || 16.67 sthitaṃ śayānamāsīnaṃ devaṃ deveśvareśvaram | yadṛcchayāpi paśyantaḥ prāpnuvanti paraṃ padam || 16.68 kiṃ punar bhaktipūrvā ye vīkṣante kṣaṇam apy atha | nirdhūtaduṣkṛtās sarve yānti lokān yathepsitān || 16.69 aṣṭāṅgapraṇipātena ye namasyanti mānavāḥ | tapassvādhyāyaśīlānāṃ phalam aśnuvate 'cirāt || 16.70 iyad etad iti smartuṃ phalaṃ vaktuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ | sakṛt praṇamatāṃ devaṃ phalaṃ yanmadhuvidviṣam || 16.71 śirasā śravaṇābhyāṃ ca manasā vā kareṇa vā | bāhubhyāṃ vātha padbhyāṃ vā jānubhyāṃ vāpi vakṣasā || 16.72 ekaikenāṅgajātena praṇamanmadhuvidviṣam | kāmān āpnoti vaipulān anantān anyadurlabhān || 16.73 kiṃ punar ye 'ṣṭabhis sarvair aṅgaiḥ praṇipatanti te | vāsudevāśrayakathā vyācakṣāṇā dine dine || 16.74 vāsudevālaye yānti vācaspatyam asaṃśayam | gavāṃ ca kapilādīnāṃ pradānādaśnute janaḥ || 16.75 brahmalokādilokeṣu vāsaṃ vindati śāśvatam | haviṣāṃ pāyasādīnāṃ haraye ca nivedanāt || 16.76 sukhaikarasapūrṇātmā rājate viṣṇusannidhau | bhakṣyapānīyabhojyānām anyeṣām api dānataḥ || 16.77 śvetadvīpe tatsamīpe vasanti sukhinaḥ sadā | bahunātra kim uktena vāsudevārthamādarāt || 16.78 dadāti vastujātaṃ yaḥ sthānaṃ prāpnoti cepsitam | karmaṇāṃ mārjanādīnāṃ phalabhogādanantaram || 16.79 karmaśeṣaiḥ punar janma karmānuguṇayoniṣu | utkṛṣṭāsv eva bhoktāro labhante sukhinaḥ sadā || 16.80 prāsādamaṇḍapādīnāṃ bhoktāraḥ kaiṭabhadviṣaḥ | ye mūḍhamatayaḥ pretya nirayeṣu niratyayāḥ || 16.81 vasanti bhūyo nīcāsu jāyante yoniṣu dhruvam | bhūṣaṇacchatravastrādihartā yo durmatir naraḥ || 16.82 gale nigalitaḥ pāśaiḥ kṛṣyate nirayeṣu saḥ | vāhanāni ca yānāni vaiṣṇavāni haranti ye || 16.83 mohād vasanti te dīrghamaṅgāranarakodare | pretya bhūyo 'pi jāyante gardabhoṣṭrādiyoniṣu || 16.84 candanādīni vastūni puṣpāṇi surabhīṇy api | haranti svāni viṣṇos te vrajante yāmyayātanām || 16.85 anubhūya punar brahman jāyante gandhamūṣikāḥ | upānatpādukāpīṭhavyajanāni haranti ye || 16.86 uṣitvā nirayeṣv ete jāyante phaṇināṃ kule | gobhūhiraṇyavastrādidhanaṃ viṣṇoḥ parigraham || 16.87 āhṛtya ye tu bhuñjante narakeṣu niratyayāḥ | uṣitvā pretya bhūyo 'pi jāyante 'śvādiyoniṣu || 16.88 sarveṣu narakeṣv evaṃ devabrahmasvahāriṇaḥ | vasanti mūḍhamatayo yāmyaduḥkhāni bhūyasā || 16.89 vyāyāmodvartanābhyaṅgasnānapānāśanādikam | kurvanti mandire viṣṇor ye te nirayagāminaḥ || 16.90 pacyante tatra bhūyo 'pi jāyante nīcayoniṣu | vāsudevapratikṛteḥ bhedanacchedanādiṣu || 16.91 vikṛtādīni cānyeṣu yatante pāpacetasaḥ | ete yānti kramāt sarvān narakān bhṛśadāruṇān || 16.92 anyeṣv apy apacāreṣu sthūlasūkṣmeṣu mānavāḥ | kṛtinaḥ pretya narake pacyante duḥkhabhāginaḥ || 16.93
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde saṃmārjanaphaladevasvāpahāradoṣakīrtanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
jīrṇoddhārasaṃprokṣaṇavidhiḥ brahmā pratimānāṃ tathā dhāmnāṃ jīrṇānāṃ bhagavann aham | uddhāraṃ śrotum icchāmi tan me brūhi yathāyatham || 17.1 śrībhagavān svāyambhuvārṣadivyeṣu mānuṣeṣu caturṣv api | aṅgahānau ratnajeṣu taptajāmbūnadaiḥ punaḥ || 17.2 samādhātavyam evāṅgaṃ na tyājyaṃ śailajeṣv api | tadvad eva samādhānaṃ dārujādiṣu pañcasu || 17.3 hīnāṅgāni tu bimbāni hitvā tāni punaḥ sṛjet | aṅgamātrasamādhāne sṛṣṭau sarvātmanāpi ca || 17.4 kumbhe śaktiṃ samāvāhya nirmāya ca yathāpuram | adhivāsādikaṃ sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmivācaret || 17.5 sthitavat sveṣu bimbeṣu samādhir yadi śakyate | na tyāgo yujyate teṣāṃ sarveṣām eva padmaja || 17.6 tyaktaṃ ca lohajaṃ bimbaṃ dāvayitvā punaḥ sṛjet | deve jīrṇe punaḥsṛṣṭau devyaḥ prācyo yathāsthitāḥ || 17.7 tābhir eva punar yojyo devo nānyāḥ sṛjet punaḥ | nodvāhaś ca punaḥ kāryaḥ santatau tāsu pūjane || 17.8 prabhāpadmāsanādīnāṃ vaikalye calane 'pi vā | āyudhe 'pi ca cakrādau yaṣṭavyo nāsamāhitaḥ || 17.9 udvāsya pratimāśaktiṃ mūlabere ghaṭe 'pi vā | cakrādeś ca samādhānaṃ kāryaṃ tasmin samāhite || 17.10 samprokṣya pūjayec chaktim āvāhya pratimāsu tām | bimbe purātane jīrṇe navabimbaṃ kṛtaṃ yadi || 17.11 taṃ pīṭhe sthāpayed devaṃ na doṣaḥ padmasambhava | pīṭhe 'py anūtane jīrṇe navaṃ kṛtvā yathāpuram || 17.12 tadbimbaṃ sthāpayet pīṭhe pratiṣṭhākarmabhiḥ sadā | na doṣas tatra vijñeyaḥ prabhādīnāṃ caturmukha || 17.13 bālālayaṃ kalpayitvā tatra śailādivastuṣu | bimbe tu śaktim āvāhya jīrṇebhyaḥ pūjanaṃ hareḥ || 17.14 tyaktaṃ ca bimbaṃ nikhanet kṣitau vāmbhasi nikṣipet | prāsāde cāpi śithile pūjayed bālaveśmani || 17.15 upetaṃ parivāraiḥ svair devaṃ mūle yathā tathā | ujīrṇe dhruvabimbe tu jīrṇe dhāmani ca sthitān || 17.16 devān devaparīvārān mūlabere niveśayet | ajīrṇadhāmaniṣṭhānāṃ jīrṇe tu dhruvakautuke || 17.17 nodvāso 'nyatra kartavyo devādīnāṃ caturmukha | ajīrṇe cāṅgahīne ca dhāmādau naiva kalpayet || 17.18 bhūyastaro 'pi martyena vyāmohād yadi kalpayet | ātmahānirdhruvā tasya yajamānasya sānvayā || 17.19 yadi pramāṇarahitaṃ pramādāt kalpitaṃ purā | prāsādādi tadāpy ūrdhvaṃ kalpayel lakṣaṇānvitam || 17.20 bahuberaikabereṣu kalpanaṃ syād yathāpuram | bahubere naikaberaṃ naikabere tathāparam || 17.21 devīvirahitaṃ pūrvaṃ bahuberaṃ kṛtaṃ yadi | punaḥ prakalpane tasya devībhyāṃ saha vā vinā || 17.22 amānuṣaṃ ca bimbādi pūrvaṃ lakṣaṇavarjitam | jīrṇoddhāre 'pi kartavyaṃ tathaiva na tadanyathā || 17.23 śayanaṃ vāsanaṃ sthānaṃ yānaṃ vā tadyathāpuram | bimbasya punar uddhāras tathaiva syādamānuṣe || 17.24 mānuṣeṣu sthitādīnāṃ bimbānām icchayā bhavet | punaḥsṛṣṭir na doṣāya tathā sati caturmukha || 17.25 divyaṃ vimānaṃ yadvastu yanmānaṃ yādṛśaṃ purā | tādṛg eva punaḥ sṛṣṭau nānyathā tat prakalpayet || 17.26 anyathākalpane doṣo rājño rāṣṭrasya ca dhruvam | mānuṣaṃ sadanaṃ cārṣaṃ caiṣṭakaṃ vātha mṛnmayam || 17.27 jīrṇaṃ punaḥ samuddhāre śaileneṣṭakayāpi vā | upapīṭhādikaṃ sarvaṃ rakṣārthaṃ bandhayed bahiḥ || 17.28 parivārāṃś ca tatrasthānupapīṭhe ca vardhite | sthāpayen mūlaberasya rakṣārthatvān na dūṣaṇam || 17.29 sālagopurapīṭhādivalane jīrṇa eva vā | dṛḍhaṃ śilādibhiḥ kuryād vistīrṇam athavānyathā || 17.30 nadyādijalavegena calite naṣṭa eva vā | prāsādādau punaḥsthāne nirbādhe 'nyatra kalpayet || 17.31 yā mūrtir yena tantreṇa yādṛśenādhikāriṇā | prathame kalpane saiva dvitīye kalpane bhavet || 17.32 mūrtis tadeva tantraṃ ca sa eva sthāpakaḥ punaḥ | apūrvakalpane jīrṇe samuddhāre dvayor api || 17.33 tulyaṃ phalaṃ kalpanānāṃ dhāmāder nāsti saṃśayaḥ | tantrādhikārimūrtīnāṃ vyatyaje kalpite punaḥ || 17.34 nṛṇāṃ narapateś cāpi rāṣṭrasya ca bhavet kṣayaḥ | bahuberapratiṣṭhāyāṃ jīrnoddhāre yathāpuram || 17.35 karmārcāṃ sthāpayed vedyāṃ śāyayec cāpi maṇṭape | nādhivāso jale kāryo na netronmīlanaṃ tathā || 17.36 na tattvasaṃhārotpādau sarvaṃ karmāny athācaret | mūlabimbaṃ samāsādya prāgvatsarvaṃ samācaret || 17.37 bālakautukam abhyarcya yātrāmanyatra tadgatām | śaktiṃ kumbhe samāvāhya kumbhaṃ dhānyasthitaṃ punaḥ || 17.38 abhyarcya samaye prāpte mūlabere guruḥ svayam | śaktiṃ niveśayec chāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā harau || 17.39 kumbhatoyāvaśeṣeṇa parivāraprakalpanam | utsavaṃ kārayed ante sarvaśāntikaro hi saḥ || 17.40 brahmā samprokṣaṇanimittaṃ kiṃ prakāro vāsya kīdṛśaḥ | kathyatāṃ bhagavan mahyaṃ jijñāsā me 'nuvartate || 17.41 śrībhagavān prāsāde cāṅgabhaṅgādisandhāne nūtane kṛte | pratimāyāṃ ca pīṭhe ca prabhāyāṃ cāyudhe 'pi ca || 17.42 ārādhane ca vicchinne māsādau kamalāsana | sparśane pratilomādyair nityāśaucavigarhitaiḥ || 17.43 udakyādibhir anyaiś ca śilpibhiḥ sparśadūṣite | viṇmūtrarudhirāpeyasparśadoṣe ca mandire || 17.44 janane maraṇe caiva śvasṛgālaśavādibhiḥ | spṛṣṭe ca bimbe tantrāṇāṃ saṅkare samupasthite || 17.45 evamādiṣu cānyeṣu samprokṣaṇavidhir bhavet | dhāmādikamasamprokṣya pratimādikam apy atha || 17.46 arcane rāṣṭram adhipaḥ prajāś ca sadanaṃ hareḥ | śūnyaṃ syād iriṇaprāyamupadravasamākulam || 17.47 durbhikṣavyādhikalahamṛtiprāyāḥ syurītayaḥ | tasmāt samprokṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ dhāmādīnāṃ yathāvidhi || 17.48 viṣṇornukam iti svacchair jalaiḥ prokṣaṇam iṣyate | abliṅgair itarair mantrair ācāryo brāhmaṇaiḥ saha || 17.49 dhruvaberādibimbānāṃ śodhane kṣālane kṛte | idaṃ viṣṇur iti prāyair mantraiḥ paramapāvanaiḥ || 17.50 snapanaṃ ca yathāśakti kuryāt puṇyāhapūrvakam | dvāratoraṇakumbhādīn pūjayet samanantaram || 17.51 dhānyapīṭhe maṇṭapasya madhyabhāge suśobhite | sthāpayitvā mahākumbhaṃ sūtravastrādiveṣṭitam || 17.52 pūrvoktavartmanā tasmin paramātmānam arcayet | kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vāpi juhuyāt samidhādibhiḥ || 17.53 pratyekam aṣṭottaraśataṃ śāntihomo yathāpuram | badhnīyāt kautukaṃ bimbe prokṣayed apare 'hani || 17.54 prabhātasamaye prāpte śobhane deśikottamaḥ | sthāpitaṃ kumbhamādāya prādakṣiṇyena mandiram || 17.55 nītvā devasya purato dhānyapīṭhe niveśya ca | kūrcena toyamādāya kumbhasthaṃ mūlavidyayā || 17.56 pañcopaniṣadair mantrair abliṅgair itarais tathā | śāntimantrāṇi samaye paṭheyur viprasattamāḥ || 17.57 brāhmaṇān bhojayec cāpi yathāśakti ca dakṣiṇā | ācāryadakṣiṇā cāpi daśaniṣkāvarā tathā || 17.58 sadyo vā sakalaṃ kuryān niśi vā divase 'pi vā |
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde jīrṇoddhārasaṃprokṣaṇavidhir nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
nityārādhanaprāyaścittavidhiḥ brahmā naimittikānāṃ nityānāṃ karmaṇāṃ bhagavan hare | ārādhanānāṃ vaikalyaṃ lopo vā prāyasaṃjñitam || 18.1 tasya cittaṃ samādhānam iti nirvacanakriyā | tasya kiṃ vā samādhānaṃ kaḥ prakāro 'sya kathyatām || 18.2 śrībhagavān asnāto 'nupavīto vā na kṛtvā tilakaṃ tathā | arcayed devadeveśaṃ prāyaścittīyate naraḥ || 18.3 samādhānaṃ mūlamantraśataṃ ca syāt tadarcanam | akṛtvā pādayoś śaucamanācamyāpi vārcane || 18.4 pañcopaniṣadāṃ jāpaḥ prāyaścittaṃ tadarcanam | namno vā muktakeśo vā svinnāṅgo vā hasan śvasan || 18.5 kupyan vā pralapan vāpi pūjāyāṃ tu śataṃ japet | śatakṛtvo 'stramantrasya samārādhanamanvataḥ || 18.6 keśāsthilomaloṣṭādisparśane naiva niṣkriyā | vasāno nīlamalinakliṣṭavāso 'pavitrakaḥ || 18.7 arcayen mūlamantrasya japas tasya pratikriyā | gatvā striyamanāplutya pūjayet snāpayed dharim || 18.8 pañcagavyais tataḥ pañcamahopaniṣadāṃ japaḥ | viṇmūtraretorudhirabālādisparśane sati || 18.9 asnānapūjane devaṃ snāpayet kuśavāribhiḥ | mūlamantrajapaś cokto niṣkriyā tasya karmaṇaḥ || 18.10 vastraṃ rajasvalāyāś ca spṛṣṭvā devārcane kṛte | pañcagavyaiḥ snāpayitvā pañcopaniṣadāṃ japaḥ || 18.11 śvānaṃ rajasvalāṃ yūpaṃ caṇḍālaṃ vedavikrayam | citiṃ ca nīcacaityasthaṃ vṛkṣaṃ spṛṣṭvā tadarcane || 18.12 pañcavāruṇamantraiś ca snāpayet kuśavāriṇā | kākapāṣaṇḍapatitapratilomakharādikān || 18.13 aspṛśyam anyad apy evaṃ spṛṣṭvā prāgvatpratikriyā | keśādidoṣaduṣṭena puṣpeṇārādhane kṛte || 18.14 kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ kṛtvā śāntihomaḥ pratikriyā | purīṣādikamākramya yadyanāplutya pūjayet || 18.15 snapanaṃ kuśapāthobhir japaḥ prāgvatpratikriyā | striyo vānupanīto vā spṛśed bimbaṃ pratikriyā || 18.16 ukṣaṇaṃ kuśatoyena mantreṇa parameṣṭhinā | ārādhane sampravṛtte niṣṭhīvādikamantarā || 18.17 ādāv ante cācamanaṃ spṛśed vā dakṣiṇaṃ śravaḥ | pralayādikramād dehamasaṃśodhya samādhinā || 18.18 mantranyāsamakṛtvā ca pūjane pūrvavajjapaḥ | arcanaṃ ca punas sarvaṃ kṛtvā devasya niṣkṛtiḥ || 18.19 caṇḍālādyair asaṃspṛśyair haviḥ spṛṣṭaṃ nivedayet | yadi pramādāt , snapanaṃ goghṛtena pratikriyā || 18.20 śāntihomaś ca kartavyas tadante kamalāsana | dṛṣṭaṃ ca spṛṣṭavat tadvatsṛgālādyaiś ca dūṣitam || 18.21 ācārarahitair anyais tathā vāśucivastubhiḥ | ayājñīyaiḥ kodravādyair havirbhiś ca nivedane || 18.22 pūrvavac ca samādhānaṃ mūlamantrāyutaṃ japet | śākamūlaphalair lehyapeyādyaiś ca vivirjitaiḥ || 18.23 snapanaṃ śāntihomaś ca mūlavidyājapas tathā | atyuṣṇasyātiśītasya haivṣaś ca nivedane || 18.24 nivṛttimantrajāpaś ca viśvamantrajapaḥ kramāt | śavādidūṣite gehe pakvasya haviṣas tathā || 18.25 nivedanaṃ cet snapanaṃ śāntihomas tathaiva ca | kṛmikeśādiduṣṭasya haviṣaś ca nivedane || 18.26 pauruṣeṇaiva sūktena kuryāc chuddhābhiṣecanam | mukhavātahatāghrātaṃ rajastuṣakaṇānvitam || 18.27 mṛtpāṣāṇaśakṛtprāyadūṣitasya nivedane | mūlamantrajapaṃ kuryāt tadvatparyuṣitaṃ yadi || 18.28 niveditasya haviṣo bhūyo yadi nivedanam | snānapūrvārcanaṃ mūlamantrasya ca japas tathā || 18.29 nivedayec ca nirmālyamucchiṣṭaṃ vā pratikriyā | kumbhair dvādaśabhiḥ snānaṃ śāntihomo japas tathā || 18.30 gurvādīn manasā vācā karmaṇānumataḥ kare | sthitāni havirādīni puṣpādīni caturmukha || 18.31 pūjāvastūnyayogyāni samārādhanakarmaṇi | tair arcane pañcakumbhaiḥ snapanaṃ pūrvavajjapaḥ || 18.32 vāsudevaṃ praṇamataḥ pūjāvastūni hastayoḥ | sthitāni nārcanārhāṇi senānye tāni nikṣipet || 18.33 tair arcanaṃ cet snapanaṃ kalaśaiḥ saptabhir bhavet | śāntihomaś ca kartavyo mūlamantrajapas tathā || 18.34 maṇḍukamūṣikāsarpabiḍālādyaiś ca jantubhiḥ | kṛmikīṭapataṅgādyaiḥ pakṣibhir vāyasādibhiḥ || 18.35 spṛṣṭaṃ daṣṭaṃ havir naiva deyaṃ yadi nivedane | snapanaṃ kalaśair eva tribhir homāntam arcanam || 18.36 makṣikādyaiś ca saṃspṛṣṭaṃ prokṣya devāya kalpayet | bhuktaśeṣaṃ pramādāc ca lobhādvā devam arcayet || 18.37 mūlamantrāyutajapaḥ śāntaye tasya kalpate | bhuktaśeṣapradānena tadvad eva ca niṣkṛtiḥ || 18.38 snāne paryuṣitāmbhobhiḥ punar evam athāmbubhiḥ | abliṅgaiḥ pāvanair mantraiḥ prāyaścittir nirucyate || 18.39 puṇyatīrthe sarittoye na paryuṣitadūṣaṇam | samudratoyaṃ daśamātparaṃ paryuṣitaṃ dināt || 18.40 tiryagyonibhir aspṛśyair mānuṣair atilaṅghitam | spṛṣṭaṃ ca vāri na snānayogyaṃ snāne ca vāruṇaiḥ || 18.41 snānaṃ punar vidhātavyaṃ śāntyarthaṃ tasya karmaṇaḥ | ajāśvamukhasaṃsparśo na doṣāya kadācana || 18.42 gomukhenaiva saṃspṛṣṭaṃ varjanīyaṃ samarcane | prāyaścittaṃ punaḥ snānaṃ mūlamantrajapas tathā || 18.43 viṇmūtrarudhirāpeyayuktaiḥ toyādivastubhiḥ | nārcayed arcane snānaṃ kalaśair adhamādhamaiḥ || 18.44 śivanirmālyaduṣṭena toyaprabhṛtivastunā | pūjane kalaśaiḥ snānamadhamair madhyamair bhavet || 18.45 śavādidūṣite kūpe jalam uddhṛtya pūrvavat | sarvaṃ tadante puṇyāhaṃ vācayej jalaśuddhaye || 18.46 paśvādimaraṇe kūpe caṇḍālasnānapānayoḥ | tathā rajasvalādyaiś ca pratilomair vigarhitaiḥ || 18.47 kūpasthaṃ tajjalaṃ sarvam uddharet kamalāsana | cucundaryādimaraṇe jalasyārdhaṃ samuddharet || 18.48 divā samuddharet toyaṃ rātrau ced agnisannidhau | uddhared anyathā tauyair upayoge ca vāruṇaiḥ || 18.49 pañcabhir juhuyād agnau brāhmaṇān api bhojayet | pūjākāle tu dīpasya nirvāṇe dviguṇārcanam || 18.50 dīpam uddīpya japtavyo viśvamantraḥ śatāvaraḥ | akasmād eva nirvāṇe śāntir naiva tvahaituke || 18.51 anirvāṇasya nirvāṇe dīpasya snapanaṃ hareḥ | kṣīreṇa mūlamantrasya japaś cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 18.52 sarpiṣā tilatailena dīpāropaṇam ācaret | nānyair eraṇḍatailādyair nājāvimahiṣādijaiḥ || 18.53 snehair āropaṇaṃ kuryān na ca prāṇyaṅgasambhavaiḥ | pramādātphalajais tailaiḥ snapane dīpane haviḥ || 18.54 nivedane ca home ca snehair anyaiś ca ninditaiḥ | anuṣṭhāne kṛte kumbhaiḥ snāpayen madhyamottamaiḥ || 18.55 śāntihomas tathā dānaṃ dvijebhyo bhojanaṃ tathā | haviḥprabhṛtidadhyādyaiḥ snānādau vihite sati || 18.56 prāyaścittaṃ yathāpūrvam ācaret kamalāsana | pūrvopacārakḷptau tu nyūnāyāṃ kḷptavastubhiḥ || 18.57 vastubhir dviguṇair bhūyas samārādhya madhudviṣam | sarpiṣāṣṭottaraśataṃ juhuyān mūlavidyayā || 18.58 mantrahānau kriyāhānau mudrāhānau tathaiva ca | japahānau dhyānahānau hīneṣv anyeṣu keṣucit || 18.59 mūlamantrajapas tasya yathāśakti pratikriyā | geyavāditranṛtyeṣu pūrvakḷpteṣu pūjane || 18.60 hīne kasmiṃścid ārādhyo hariḥ snapanavartmanā | vādyahānau tu payasā nṛttahānau ghṛtena tu || 18.61 gānahānau tu madhunā juhuyāt pūrvasaṃkhyayā | pūrvakḷptopadaṃśādihānau dviguṇavastubhiḥ || 18.62 nivedayet snānapūrvaṃ kālātikramaṇe 'pi ca | bhogadravyair dviguṇitair ārādhyaḥ kṣamyatām iti || 18.63 uccārayet tathā sandhyātikrāntau dvādaśasv api | kāleṣu kḷptasaṃkhyeṣu hānau kālasya kasyacit || 18.64 dviguṇair vastubhiḥ pūjyaḥ kāleṣu ca yathottaram | kālaṃ prathamam ārabhya dviguṇais triguṇais tathā || 18.65 caturguṇaiḥ pañcaguṇair evamādyais tu vastubhiḥ | pūjayej japahomādyais tadvad eva yathāyatham || 18.66 atikrānte dinavidhau vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ | dvidinādau tu pakṣānte pūjāhīne ghaṭais tathā || 18.67 adhamottamamārgeṇa snāpayet tasya śāntaye | māse ca pūjāvikale madhyamottamavartmanā || 18.68 tilājyacarubhiś caiva juhuyān mūlavidyayā | saṃvatsaratrayādarvāṅ māsād ūrdhvamanarcite || 18.69 samprokṣaṇaṃ bhaved ūrdhvaṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhir ucyate | bhūguptām api caikāham uddhṛtya pratimāṃ punaḥ || 18.70 samprokṣayed gṛhārcāyāmārādhanavilopane | snapanaṃ pañcagavyena sūktena puruṣātmanā || 18.71 śāntaye juhuyād agnau brāhmaṇān api tarpayet | māsād ūrdhvaṃ tu ṣaṇmāsaṃ pūjāhīne caturmukha || 18.72 kumbhaiṣ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ snānaṃ sūktena puruṣātmanā | bhojayed brāhmaṇān agnau juhuyāc chāntaye punaḥ || 18.73 ūrdhvaṃ samprokṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ yāvat saṃvatsarāvadhi | pratiṣṭhāvidhir ūrdhvaṃ tu vatsarād uktavartmanā || 18.74 tridaśādipratiṣṭhāyāṃ pūjālopo na dūṣaṇam | prāyaścittaṃ tu madhyānāṃ pratiṣṭhāyām udīritam || 18.75 sālagrāmaśilādīnāṃ pūjālopo na dūṣaṇam | tathaivāśucisaṃsparśe kṣālayitvārcayet punaḥ || 18.76 sarvathā lopane śāntiś coktakāle yathā bhavet | ajñānād athavā jñānād vahnitarpaṇavarjane || 18.77 pañcopaniṣadair mantraiḥ sarpiṣā juhuyāt śatam | ekādikālātikrāntau dviguṇādi yathāpuram || 18.78 bahubhiḥ kalaśair devaṃ snāpayed divasātparam | māsāvadhi tadūrdhvaṃ tu kalaśair vatsarāvadhi || 18.79 aṣṭottaraśataiḥ kuryāt snapanaṃ juhuyāt punaḥ | aṣṭottarasahasreṇa tilājyacarubhiḥ kramāt || 18.80 dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa śāntihomas tathā bhavet | vatsarād upariṣṭāt tu snapanaṃ madhyamottamam || 18.81 kuṇḍe cāgniṃ sthāpayitvā tilavrīhiyavair api | lājaiś ca kālapuṣpaiś ca samiccarughṛtair api || 18.82 aṣṭottarasahasreṇa juhuyān mūlavidyayā | śāntihomas tato dānaṃ viprāṇāṃ cāpi bhojanam || 18.83 satyagnāvapyahome tu prāyaścittam itīritam | agnau sānte mathitvāgniṃ śāntihomaṃ samācaret || 18.84 pañcopaniṣadair mantrair vyāhṛtipramukhair api | suparistīrya ca kuśair homaḥ praṇavavidyayā || 18.85 aṣṭottaraśatenājyaiḥ mūlamantrajapas tathā | ayathoktakrame tadvatprāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate || 18.86 kāmye paridhayo neṣṭā nityakarmaṇi vā na vā | alābhe samidhāmājyaiś carubhir vāhutir bhavet || 18.87 tayoralābhe bījair vā samidbhir vā yathoditaiḥ | agnau keśādibhir duṣṭe 'spṛśyasparśane tathā || 18.88 homo vyāhṛtibhiḥ kāryo vārānaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | ayutaṃ puṣpavatyādisparśe mathanaje 'nale || 18.89 pākasthāne cullīsparśe naraiḥ pūrvoditais tathā | śvādibhiḥ sthānamālipya gomayena mahānasam || 18.90 ānīyāgnyantaraṃ cullyāṃ puṇyāhaṃ vācayed dvijaiḥ | viṇmūtrādyais tathā sparśe pūrvavac chuddhir iṣyate || 18.91 pakvena cullyāṃ duṣṭāyāṃ haviṣā ca nivedane | snāpayen navabhiḥ kumbhair devaṃ vātha ghaṭais tribhiḥ || 18.92 parivārārcane cchinne tattannāmāny udīrayan | sarpiṣā juhuyād agnau pratyekaṃ tv aṣṭasaṃkhyayā || 18.93 dviguṇādyair dvikālādau balyarthaṃ ca havir yadi | dūṣitaṃ keśakīṭādyair aspṛśyair manujais tathā || 18.94 kākādibhiś ca tat tyaktvā haviṣānyena karma tat | yadi duṣṭena haviṣā baliṃ dadyāt pramādataḥ || 18.95 śāntihomas tadā kāryaś śāstradṛṣṭena vartmanā | taṇḍule codane puṣpe balyarthe pātrasambhṛte || 18.96 deve cāvāhite tasmin pūrvavad dūṣaṇaṃ yadi | patite vā balidravye mūlabere 'thavātmani || 18.97 udvāsya devamānīya dravyāntaramadūṣitam | tasminn āvāhya deveśaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ punar nayet || 18.98 taddoṣaśāntaye paścād dadhnā kṣīreṇa vā harim | snāpayej juhuyāc chāntiṃ mūlamantrajapas tathā ||18.99 balibimbe nipatite yānāder utsave bahiḥ | sthāpayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ baliśeṣaṃ nayet punaḥ || 18.100 śāntaye navabhiḥ kumbhaiḥ snāpayet patite bhuvi | adhamādhamamārgeṇa śāntihomo japas tathā || 18.101 nṛttageyaratā nāryā gaṇikāścāthavetarāḥ | devadāsyo dūṣayeyū rajobhiḥ pṛthivītalam || 18.102 rajasvalārajoduṣṭaṃ bhūtalaṃ jānumātrakam | khātvā ca mṛdbhir anyābhiḥ pūrayitvā mahītalam || 18.103 ālipya gomayāmbhobhiḥ puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥ | prokṣaṇam pañcabhir gavyais sannikṛṣṭaṃ ca kautukam || 18.104 adhamottamamārgeṇa kalaśaiḥ snāpayed dharim | tilājyacarubhir homaḥ pratyekaṃ mūlavidyayā || 18.105 sahasrakṛtvāttadanu śāntihomo japas tathā | kavāṭādikam apy anyat spṛṣṭaṃ prakṣālyamambhasā || 18.106 tāsāṃ ca mārgā saṃśodhyāḥ gomayāmbhobhir ukṣaṇam | corabhūtair brāhmaṇādyaiḥ spṛṣṭe bere 'py acoditaiḥ || 18.107 corasparśanimittaṃ tu snapanaṃ kalaśair hareḥ | varṇānāmānupūrvyeṇa tvadhamādhamapaddhatim || 18.108 ārabhya gaṇitaiḥ kuryāt saṃskārair api tadbhavet | bījaprayuktakalaśaiḥ snapanaṃ śāntaye bhavet || 18.109 śāntihomo brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojanaṃ dānam eva ca | ajñātajātisaṃsparśe snāpayed uttamottamaiḥ || 18.110 trivastukaṃ mṛnmayaṃ ca lepabimbaṃ ca bhittijam | citraṃ nīcair yadi spṛṣṭaṃ caṇḍālādyais tathāparaiḥ || 18.111 navīkaraṇamāstheyaṃ samprokaṇavidhis tathā | pratiṣṭhā vā yathāvittaṃ doṣabhūyastayāthavā || 18.112 paṭasparśe kṣālayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ punaḥ sṛjet | dīkṣitair anyaśāstreṣu spṛṣṭe snapanam ācaret || 18.113 dīkṣitair itarair vāpi śūdrais tadvatsamācaret | mahāpātakisaṃsparśe snapanaṃ cottamottamam || 18.114 upapātakisaṃspṛṣṭe snapanaṃ cādhamottamam | parastrīgamanāsaktais tathāniyatavṛttibhiḥ || 18.115 sparśe ca navabhiḥ kumbhaiḥ snapanaṃ kautuke bhavet | aspṛśyair itarair vāpi kuṇḍādisparśane sati || 18.116 snapanaṃ pūrvavatkāryaṃ strībhir duṣṭābhir eva ca | anulomāḥ striyaśśūdā vrajeyur garbhamandiram || 18.117 bhūtalaṃ pañcagavyena siñced vā gomayāmbubhiḥ | caṇḍālaiḥ pulkasair vāpi patitair madyapais tathā || 18.118 śvapacair mandirābhyantaḥ praveśe mṛnmayāṃs tyajet | tatra sthānaṃ kṣālayitvāntaḥ kavāṭādimahītalam || 18.119 ālipya gomayāmbhobhiḥ puṇyāhaṃ vācayed dvijaiḥ | pratimāś cāpi tatrasthāḥ snāpayet kalaśair guruḥ || 18.120 śāntihomo japaś caiva dvijānāṃ dānabhojane | āśaucavatpraveśe ca pūrvavadvidhir iṣyate || 18.121 caṇḍālaḥ śvapaco vāpi tādṛśāḥ pulkasādayaḥ | ajñānādgarbhagehe tu karmasvadhikṛtā yadi || 18.122 vaseyuś caiva tais sārdhaṃ bhojyaṃ vā vastu tādṛśam | spṛṣṭam ārādhanaṃ cet spṛṣṭaṃ vā kautukaṃ yadi || 18.123 kriyāsamabhihāreṇa prāyaścittam ihocyate | śodhayen mandiraṃ pūrvaṃ gomayālepanādibhiḥ || 18.124 puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātha brāhmaṇāṃs tatra bhojayet | svādhyāyaṃ parikurvīran brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ || 18.125 itihāsapurāṇāni paṭheyur vā divāniśam | kapilāś ca pradeśeṣu tatra tarādhivāsayet || 18.126 evaṃ māsādikāleṣu doṣagauravalāghavam | avekṣya śodhite dhāmni brāhmaṇāṃs toṣayed dhanaiḥ || 18.127 pratimānāṃ yathāyogam utthānaṃ vā navīkṛtam | kuryāt tato yathāpūrvaṃ nimitte vā navīkṛte || 18.128 pratiṣṭhāpya yathāśāstraṃ sthāpayet kalaśair api | sahasreṇa purāvṛttadoṣāṇāmapanuttaye || 18.129 anyo mahotsavaḥ kāryo na ced rāṣṭranṛpakṣayaḥ | bimbaṃ na cālayec chailaṃ na navīkaraṇaṃ tathā || 18.130 tathaiva divyamārṣaṃ ca svayaṃvyaktaṃ ca kautukam | tathānyair māgadhādyaiś ca pratilomaiś ca garhitaiḥ || 18.131 sahasrakalaśair devaṃ snāpayet tasya śāntaye | śvāpadaiś ca sṛgālādyaiś caṇḍālādyaiś ca garhitaiḥ || 18.132 prathamādi praviṣṭaṃ ced dhāmāvaraṇabhūtalam | prokṣayet pañcagavyena puṇyāham api vācayet || 18.133 dhāmasparśe tathānyasya balipīṭhādikasya ca | sparśe kṛtvā yathāpūrvaṃ śāntihomaṃ samācaret || 18.134 āgantukaiḥ kukkuṭādyaiḥ spṛṣṭaṃ ced dhāma sarvataḥ | prokṣayen mantrapūtena vāriṇā śāntim ācaret || 18.135 devān saṃsnāpayed evaṃ prathamāvaraṇādiṣu | sarpiś carutilair homo mūlenāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 18.136 khadyotasparśane devaṃ snāpayen navabhir ghaṭaiḥ | pūjākāle kavāṭasya bandhanaṃ ced asaṅkule || 18.137 aṣṭottaraśataṃ mūlamantrasya japa iṣyate | saṅkule bandhanaṃ naiva doṣāya bhavati kvacit || 18.138 prabhāpīṭhāstrasaṃsparśe bimbasparśavad iṣyate | ācāryāḥ pūjakāś cānye tathaiva paricārakāḥ || 18.139 āsaneṣv āsikāṃ bhaktyā śayanaṃ ca yathātatham | kuryuḥ karmaṇy adhikṛtā doṣo naiva tadā bhavet || 18.140 anye cet kuryur avaniṃ prokṣayed gomayāmbubhiḥ | prākāre maṇḍape dhāmni gopure pākaveśmani || 18.141 dagdhe 'gninā samādhāya pūrvavanmaṇḍapādikam | pratiṣṭhāpya yathāproktaṃ śāntikarma samācaret || 18.142 adhamottamamārgeṇa snapanaṃ śāntidaṃ bhavet | śāntihomas tu kartavyo dvijānāṃ dānabhojane || 18.143 pratimādahane cāpi samādhāya yathāpuram | snānaṃ sahasrakalaśaiḥ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi || 18.144 vastrādidahane tasyāḥ prabhādidahane tathā | navabhiḥ kalaśaiḥ snānaṃ homādi tadanantaram || 18.145 sudarśane 'gninā dagdhe snānaṃ navaghaṭair bhavet | dhvaje vitāne chatre ca dagdhe cāstaraṇādike || 18.146 punar utpādya tatsarvaṃ śāntihomādikaṃ bhavet | prāsādādyavakāśānāṃ vṛddhiś cet sarvato bhavet || 18.147 yadvā prācyām udīcyāṃ vā vṛddhir nānyatra śobhanā | dakṣiṇāparapṛddhiś cet snapanaṃ cottamottamam || 18.148 śāntihomo dvijendrāṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ bhojanādibhiḥ | śobhanā sarvato vṛddhir upapīṭhasya ceṣyate || 18.149 prathamāvaraṇaṃ yāvad doṣas syād devanirmite | vardhitaṃ yadi pūrvoktaṃ snapanaṃ śāntidam bhavet || 18.150 na hrāsayet purākḷptaṃ dhāmādi na ca cālayet | paurāṇikaṃ śiraḥpīṭhaṃ dhāma cihnañ ca vaiṣṇavam || 18.151 noddhṛtyaṃ pūrayitvā vā na vṛddhir gopurādiṣu | alpīyaḥ prāgvimānādi divyavargaṃ dhanaiḥ punaḥ || 18.152 vardhayec chraddhayā mukhyair dravyair arcānnayed guruḥ |
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde nityārādhanaprāyaścittavidhir nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? ekonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
utsavaprāyaścittanārāyaṇabaliḥ śrībhagavān nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ nipated yugapad yadi | kṛtvā naimittikaṃ nityamācāryas tadanantaram || 19.1 gṛhārcāsnapane prāpte vistāre sati veśmani | tatraiva snapanaṃ kāryaṃ saṅkaṭe tu bahir bhavet || 19.2 parvatādau śucau deśe prapānirmāṇapūrvakam | snapanaṃ devadevasya kāryaṃ bhāgavatena tat || 19.3 ālaye sthāpitaṃ bimbaṃ na kadācic caturmukha | nirgamayya bahiḥ snāpyamantareṇa tu sarvadā || 19.4 tīrthāvabhṛthavelāyāṃ nadyādīnāṃ taṭe bhavet | anyathā cec chāntihomaṃ kuryāt sarvamṛddhidam || 19.5 aṅkurārpaṇahīne ca snapane kautukānvite | adhivāsavihīne ca kalaśaiḥ snapane sati || 19.6 śāntihomo vidhātavyaḥ sarvadoṣāpanuttaye | saṅkalpitasnānahānau snapanaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet || 19.7 akṛte rājarāṣṭrasya bhaved vibhavasaṃkṣayaḥ | yajamānasya dhāmnaś ca prajānāṃ ca dhanakṣayaḥ || 19.8 akāle tu kṛte snāne viṣuvādau yathodite | śāntiḥ kāryāyane caiva dakṣiṇe prāgupakrame || 19.9 uttare caiva pāścāt ye uttamaṃ naiva dūṣaṇam | caitre ca viṣuve tadvat kramādāśvayuje 'pi vā || 19.10 sthāpitānāṃ ca kumbhānāṃ bhedane patane tathā | kālādidoṣaduṣṭe ca kṛmikeśādidūṣite || 19.11 laṅghite 'śucisaṃspṛṣṭe vāyasādyaiś ca dūṣite | garhitaiḥ śvāpadādyaiś ca spṛṣṭe cāśucibhis tathā || 19.12 pāṣaṇḍaiḥ pratilomaiś ca tathodakyādidūṣite | kalaśaṃ taṃ tam uddhṛtya sthāpayitvāparān punaḥ || 19.13 taddaivatyān japen mantrānaṣṭottaraśatāvaram | snapanaṃ yadi taiḥ kuryāc chāntihomaṃ samācaret || 19.14 akrameṇa samuddhṛtya sanapane vihite sati | japaḥ pañcopaniṣadāṃ kartavyaś ca yathāpuram || 19.15 devatāmantrabhūbhāgadravyāṇāṃ vyatyaye sati | pūrvavanmantrajāpaḥ syāt pratidravyamanarcite || 19.16 ardhyādibhir japas tadvanmahiṣājoṣṭrasambhavaiḥ | kṣīrādibhis tathā dravyaiḥ snapane snāpayet punaḥ || 19.17 samidbhir mūlamantreṇa juhuyāt kamalāsana | adbhiḥ paryuṣitābhiś cet snapanaṃ snāpayet punaḥ || 19.18 śāntihomo mūlavidyā japaś cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam | ārādhanāṅgavaikalye nṛttavādyādibhis saha || 19.19 śāntihomo bhaved vedyāṃ snapane calane tathā | pratimācalane tadvatprāyaścittaṃ caturmukha || 19.20 snapane vartamāne tu calane patane 'pi vā | yathāpūrvam avasthāpya snāpayitvā yathāvidhi || 19.21 śāntihomaś ca kartavyaḥ pīṭhādīnāṃ ca bhañjane | sahajānāṃ tathā hastapādādīnāṃ caturmukha || 19.22 bhaṅge tu toṣāmāvāhya kūrcādau tadgataṃ harim | kriyāṃ samāpayed bhagne prabhāpīṭhādikaṃ punaḥ || 19.23 samādhāya yathāpūrvaṃ samprokṣaṇavidhir bhavet | vastuṣu snapanāṅgeṣv ādhikyaṃ [vā] hānir eva vā || 19.24 yadi syān mūlamantrasya japaś cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam | mokṣamāṇaḥ sadā kuryāt snapanaṃ niśi vāhani || 19.25 ripukṣayārthī divase dharmārthī dinamadhyame | dinānte sarvabhogārthī prāyaścittāya sarvadā || 19.26 baddhapratisare bimbe snapanārthaṃ tu mantriṇā | snapanāntarasamprāptau na ca pratisarāntaram || 19.27 maṇḍūkamūṣikāsarpacucundaryādijantubhiḥ | spṛṣṭe vilaṅghite naṣṭe sthāpite kalaśe tathā || 19.28 tyaktvānyaṃ tu tathā kṛtvā mūlamantraṃ japed guruḥ | sthāpitaṃ kalaśaṃ yattu pāṣaṇḍaiḥ pratilomajaiḥ || 19.29 āśaucavadbhir aparaiḥ kalaśasparśane sati | sadravyaṃ kalaśaṃ hitvā tathānyaṃ tatra nikṣipet || 19.30 vācayitvātha puṇyāhaṃ śāntihomaṃ samācaret | karmaṇi snapanādau tu pravṛtte deśikottamaḥ || 19.31 sautakaṃ maraṇārśaucaṃ śṛṇuyānna śucir bhavet | utsave ca yathāśāstracodite skhalane 'pi ca || 19.32 śāntis tadocyate brahmaṃs tadetadavadhāryatām | vimānasthāpanāhīne na kuryād utsavaṃ hareḥ || 19.33 kuryād vā dhvajam uddhṛtyotsavaṃ ca krameṇa vā | vāyavīye yāmyakoṇe vidhinā śāntim ācaret || 19.34 saṃvatsarāntaṃ tatraiva dhvajayaṣṭeḥ sthitir bhavet | hīnanityotsave dhāmni dhvajārohaṇapūrvakam || 19.35 notsavaṃ kārayet kāmyaṃ kārite śāntim ācaret | pramāṇahīne pakṣīndre dhvaje stambhādike 'pi vā || 19.36 śāntiḥ kāryā tathā hīne mūṣikādyaiś ca dūṣite | aśucidravyasaṃsparśe tyaktvāropya dhvajāntaram || 19.37 śāntihomaś ca kartavyo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam | dhvajārohaṇakarmāṅgaṃ dhvajaṃ vā stambham eva vā || 19.38 sakṛnniyuktaṃ tyaktavyaṃ dhvajayaṣṭiṃ parityajet | sakṛnniyukte stambhādau bhūyo 'pi viniyojite || 19.39 prāyaścittaṃ na tatra syāt snapanaṃ cottamottamam | śāntihomaś ca kartavyo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam || 19.40 sthāpite vihageśāne dhvaje vātātapādibhiḥ | varṇahānau na doṣaḥ syāt samārādhanam iṣyate || 19.41 patite vātavegena hetunā yena kenacit | uddhṛtya baddhvā bhūyo 'pi snapanaṃ madhyamādhamam || 19.42 varṇahānau tathā hīne dhvaje cchinne 'pi vā kvacit | dhvajāntaraṃ samutpādya tyaktvā nipatitaṃ dhvajam || 19.43 yaṣṭiṃ vā kalpyam evānyanna tu kālapratīkṣaṇam | viparītaṃ dhvajapaṭaṃ pramādād yadi bandhayet || 19.44 tanmocayitvā yadvānyaṃ baddhvā snapanam ācaret | dhvajastambhe tu patite bhagne vā suṣire 'pi vā || 19.45 stambhāntaraṃ sthāpayitvā śāntiḥ snapanapūrvikā | patane bhramaṇe vāpi patite vā yadṛcchayā || 19.46 śāntihomo bhavet prāgvat mūlamantrajapas tathā | pakṣīśādhiṣṭhite kumbhe bhinne naṣṭe 'pi vā tathā || 19.47 aspṛśyaiḥ pāṇibhiḥ spṛṣṭe sthāpyaṃ kumbhāntaraṃ punaḥ | āvāhya tatra vihagaṃ karmaśeṣaṃ samāpayet || 19.48 dhvajastambhe ca saṃspṛṣṭe caṇḍālādyair vigarhitaiḥ | stambhāntaram avasthāpya śānthihomaṃ samācaret || 19.49 sūtakaiḥ pretakaiś caiva pratilomais tathāvidhaiḥ | spṛṣṭe prokṣya dhvajastambhaṃ puṇyāhoktipurassaram || 19.50 sakṛnniyojitaṃ tyaktvā mṛnmayaṃ pālikādikam | aṅkurānarpayenno cec chāntihomādikaṃ caret || 19.51 aṅkureṣv api rakteṣu śyāmavarṇayuteṣu vā | aprarūḍheṣu sarveṣu tathā tiryaggateṣu ca || 19.52 aspṛśyasparśane teṣāṃ bhinnacchinneṣu vā punaḥ | pālikādiṣu naṣṭeṣu patiteṣu yathā tathā || 19.53 valmīkādiprarohe ca mūṣikādyaiś ca bhakṣite | śāntihomaś ca kartavyo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam || 19.54 prārabdhakarmamadhye cet karma naimittikaṃ punaḥ | āpated arpayed bhūyas tadardhāṃś cāṅkurān guruḥ || 19.55 arpiteṣv aṅkureṣu syād daivād vā yadi mānuṣāt | karmalopas tadā tyaktvā kalpitān aṅkurān api || 19.56 śāntyarthaṃ juhuyād agnau mūlamantrajapas tathā | baddhapratisare bimbe karmārtham aparaṃ yadi || 19.57 antarā karma nipated badhnīyāt kautukaṃ punaḥ | antarā patite snāne samāpte snapanaṃ punaḥ || 19.58 pūrvārabdham anuṣṭheyaṃ yathāśāstraṃ caturmukha | grāmādiṣu syāc chūnyeṣu na balir vīthikotsavaḥ || 19.59 dhāmany eva bhavet kāmaṃ yadi syāt vīthikotsavaḥ | sahasrakalaśaiḥ snānaṃ prāyaścittaṃ tad iṣyate || 19.60 utsave vartmāne syān mahāvātādinā yadi | grāmādau śithile kṛtvā prāyaścittaṃ punar mahaḥ || 19.61 kāryo na lopyo lope tu kumbhair aṣṭottaraiś śataiḥ | snapanaṃ kārayed dhomo japaś cārthair dvijārcanam || 19.62 muhūrtādikrame śāntiḥ sarveṣāṃ karmaṇām api | kāryā homādibhiḥ paścāt karmārambho yathoditaḥ || 19.63 karmaṇy adhikṛte pūrvaṃ deśiko mūrtipeṣu vā | hetor devān manuṣyādvā vihiteṣv adhikāriṣu || 19.64 prārabdhaṃ karma kartavyaṃ tādṛśair aparair dvijaiḥ | utsave vighnite daivān mānuṣād vā yathodite || 19.65 balim eva kṣiped dhamni grāmādau vīthikāsv api | balipradāne prakṛte kasmiṃścid divase punaḥ || 19.66 kurvan balim atikrāntaṃ kṛtvaivaṃ balim ācaret | utsavāṅgeṣu hīneṣu kalpiteṣu yathāpuram || 19.67 udyānayānamṛgayājaladroṇyādikarmasu | śāntiḥ kāryā bhojanaṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ japas tathā || 19.68 hīnāyāṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ punar utsavam ācaret | uttamottamamārgeṇa kṛtvā snapanamāditaḥ || 19.69 māse yathokte 'tikānte nakṣatrādau yathodite | utsavānantare cāpi yadyarvāgvatsarādbhavet || 19.70 ūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarātkurvan śāntiṃ kṛtvā samācaret | sahasrakalaśaiḥ snānaṃ śāntihomaṃ japādikam || 19.71 lupte parvotsave śāntiḥ snapanaṃ śaktyapekṣayā | anyeṣu viṣṇor lupteṣu śravaṇādyutsaveṣu ca || 19.72 uttamottamamārgeṇa snapanaṃ tasya niṣkṛtiḥ | vyatyāse balivastūnāṃ juhuyāt sarpiṣā śatam || 19.73 vātātapādisaṃsparśe bimbe snapanam uttamam | ācared yāgaśālāyāṃ prapādiṣu mahotsave || 19.74 agnidagdheṣu tatsarvaṃ samādhāya yathāpuram | śāntihomo dvijendrāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ dānam eva ca || 19.75 kuryāt sudarśanploṣe kumbhair navabhirāplavaḥ | kāryo bimbādidāhe 'pi tathā snapanam ācaret || 19.76 śvasṛgālādibhir yāgamaṇḍapādau praveśane | saṃsparśe pūrvakḷptāni tyaktvānyāni nidhāya ca || 19.77 śānthihomo dvijendrāṇāṃ bhojanādi yathāpuram | caṇḍālādipraveśādau tyaktvā tadvastu dūṣitam || 19.78 utsavārthāni vastūni śāntihomaṃ samācaret | utsavāgnau svayaṃ śānte śāntiṃ kuryād yathākramam || 19.79 viṣuve cāyane caiva tīrthayātrā na doṣakṛt | rātrāv api tato 'nyatra kartavyā caiva sā bhavet || 19.80 pramādādyadi yātrā syāt snapanaṃ cottamottamam | utsave homavicchede dviguṇaṃ homam ācaret || 19.81 bimbe corādibhir naṣṭe vartamāne mahotsave | karmārcādiṣu bimbeṣu bimbaṃ cotpādya pūrvavat || 19.82 ārādhayen nipatite bimbe yānānmahotsave | āropya pūrvavadyānaṃ rathyāsu parito nayet || 19.83 ekādhikāśīti ghaṭaiḥ snāpayec chāntaye punaḥ | aṅgahānau kautukasya bimbam anyan nayet tathā || 19.84 hīnāṅgaṃ cet samādhāya sadyaḥ samprokṣaṇaṃ caret | snapanaṃ śāntaye kuryād brāhmaṇānāṃ ca toṣaṇam || 19.85 yānabhaṅge nayed devaṃ yānenānyena vīthikām | śāntiś ca kāryā patanabhramaṇādau tu sāratheḥ || 19.86 puṇyāhavācanādīni kāryāṇi kamalāsana | aspṛśyā yadi yānāni vaheyur bimbam eva vā || 19.87 kṣālayitvā tu yānāni bimbaṃ ca snāpayed ghaṭaiḥ | puṣpayāgo niśi bhavec chāntaye bhuktaye 'pi vā || 19.88 abhāve puṣpayāgasya snapanaṃ cottamottamam | ārabhya tīrthadivasād ūrdhvaṃ pañcadināvadhi || 19.89 dhvajāvarohaṇaṃ kāryaṃ paścāc ced avarohaṇam | doṣaḥ syād doṣaśamanaṃ snapanaṃ madhyamottamam || 19.90 avaropya dhvajapaṭaṃ snapanānantaraṃ punaḥ | udvāsya devatās sarvāḥ śakaṭādbalikarmaṇā || 19.91 mahotsavāntaḥpatitaṃ karma vaiśeṣikāhvayam | kāryam eva na lopyaṃ tallope snapanam ācaret || 19.92 pavitrārohaṇe prāyaścittam anyat pradṛśyate | hīnamāne pavitre vā kuṇḍe vā maṇḍalādike || 19.93 astramantraṃ śataṃ japtvā pūjayed astravardhanam | tyaktvā pavitraṃ keśādidūṣitaṃ punar eva tat || 19.94 kṛtvā pūrvavadāropya tataś śāntiṃ samācaret | aspṛśyasparśane kumbhe bhinne naṣṭe 'pi vā punaḥ || 19.95 kumbhāntare samāvāhya mūlamantraṃ japet punaḥ | asthāne sthāpitaṃ śūlam anyatra pratimādikam || 19.96 sthāpayitvā yathāsthānaṃ snapanādi samācaret | māne nyūne 'dhike vāpi vedyādīnāṃ prakalpite || 19.97 śāntirājyāhutiḥ kāryā pañcopaniṣadā śatam | teṣām abhāve ca tathā śāntir nayanamokṣaṇam || 19.98 akṛtvā sthāpane śāntiṃ kṛtvā nayanamokṣaṇam | toyādhivāsākaraṇe pratiṣṭhā cen madhudviṣaḥ || 19.99 snapanaṃ śāntihomaś ca tadvad evāṅgahāniṣu | anācāryapratiṣṭhāyāṃ punaḥsthāpanam ācaret || 19.100 ācāryapadamārūḍho vaidhuryādyalpadoṣavān | adhikāryeva vijñānapāraṃ yāto yadi svayam || 19.101 jñānādhikena deveśe sthāpite jñājarūpiṇi | na doṣo jñānadahanaḥ sarvadoṣān dahet khalu || 19.102 yāvat kālaṃ sthitir bālamandire prārthitā purā | tāvat yatīte samaye snapanaṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ || 19.103 kāryaṃ punaś ca tatraiva sthitikālaṃ prakalpayet | anyatra vā bālagehe yadvā mūlālaye bhavet || 19.104 karmārthapīṭhikāyāṃ tat sthāpayitvā samācaret | gopure vālaye yadvā prākāre maṇṭape 'thavā || 19.105 śithilīsaraghātumbīvalmīkādisamudbhave | uddhṛtya tattatsaṃśodhya deśaṃ kṛtvā yathāpuram || 19.106 snapanaṃ devadevasya kuryād uttamamadhyamam | śāntihomo dvijendrāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ dānam eva ca || 19.107 siddhāntasaṅkare jāte pramādāt tatra saṅkare | karṣaṇādiṣu doṣaḥ syād rājarāṣṭrakṣayāvahaḥ || 19.108 brahmovāca siddhānto nāma kaḥ ko vā bhedas tasya janārdana | śrotum icchāmi tatsarvaṃ na rahasyam idaṃ yadi || 19.109 śrībhagavān mahopaniṣadaṃ nāma siddhāntapadaśabditam | mīmāṃsādiṣu śāstreṣu ye siddhārthā manīṣiṇaḥ || 19.110 teṣām ante 'dhikāro 'sminn iti siddhāntasaṃjñitam | taccaturdhā sthitaṃ śāstramṛgādivadanekadhā || 19.111 ekaikaṃ bhidyate tantraṃ śākhābhedena bhūyasā | prathamaṃ mantrasiddhāntaṃ dvitīyaṃ cāgamāhvayam || 19.112 tṛtīyaṃ tantrasiddhāntaṃ turyaṃ tantrāntaraṃ bhavet | ekaiva mūrtir ārādhyā prādhānyenetarāḥ punaḥ || 19.113 devyaḥ śriyādayaś cāpi sampūjyāḥ parivāravat | āyudhaiś śaṅkhacakrādyaiḥ śrīvatsādyaiś ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ || 19.114 mūrtimadbhiḥ parivṛtā kevalā vāmbujāsana | kathyate yatra tatproktaṃ mantrasiddhāntamagrimam || 19.115 vāsudevādayo vyūhāś catvāraḥ sādhakair api | kramāgatais tulyakakṣyāḥ pūjyās tatprabhavāvyaye || 19.116 karmaṇām api saṃnyāsaḥ kathyate yatra cāgame | tatra cāgamasiddhāntaṃ taduktaṃ kamalāsana || 19.117 navānām api mūrtīnāṃ prādhānyaṃ yatra kathyate | mūrtayo dvādaśāṅgāni teṣām eva tathāpare || 19.118 prādurbhāvagaṇāś cānye mūrtyantaraguṇā api | prādurbhāvāntarayutāḥ sadigdevaiḥ sahāyudhaiḥ || 19.119 mūrtimadbhiś ca devībhir lakṣyamyādibhir api sphuṭam | tattantrasiddhāntāhvānaṃ caturthaṃ paramaṃ punaḥ || 19.120 saumyasiṃhādibhuyiṣṭhaṃ vakrabhedaiś caturmukha | dvitrādimukhabhedā vā mūrtir ekaiva pūjyate || 19.121 parivāraiḥ saṃvṛtā vā vinā vā sarvakāmadā | yattantrāntarasaṃjñaṃ syāc caturthaṃ caturānana || 19.122 yena siddhāntamārgeṇa karṣaṇādikriyā kṛtā | ādau tenaiva sakalaṃ nānyasiddhāntavartmanā || 19.123 tantreṇāpi tathā yena karṣaṇādikriyā kṛtā | tenaiva sakalaṃ kāryaṃ na tantrāntaravartmanā || 19.124 tantrāntare 'pi kathitamanuktaṃ grāhyam eva hi | siddhāntasaṅkaro < �saṃkaro> na syāt tantrasaṅkara eva ca || 19.125 doṣāya kalpate rājarāṣṭradhāmakṣayātmane | siddhāntasaṅkare jāte pramādāt tasya śāntaye || 19.126 kṛtvā samprokṣaṇaṃ pūṛvaṃ sahasrakalaśāplavaḥ | kartavyaḥ, snapanaṃ kuryāt tantrasaṅkarasambhave || 19.127 ante mahotsavaṃ kuryād dhvajārohaṇapūrvakam | sthāpite pañcarātreṇa deve ṣaḍbhir athādhvabhiḥ || 19.128 pratiṣṭhādau kṛte drohād doṣaḥ sarvakṣayātmakaḥ | śāntiś ca tasya bhūyo 'pi pañcarātroktavartmanā || 19.129 pratiṣṭhāpi sahasreṇa kalaśaiḥ snapanaṃ hareḥ | mahotsavaś ca kartavyo dhvajārohaṇapūrvakaḥ || 19.130 ekatra dīkṣitas tantre siddhānte vā dvijottamaḥ | kriyāṃ na kuryād anyatra karṣaṇādi caturmukha || 19.131 ācāryatvamathārtvijyaṃ pūjāyāṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ | tantrabhede ca siddhāntabhede cāpi na yujyate || 19.132 brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ niṣkṛtiḥ smṛticoditā | mṛtānāṃ viṣaśastrāgniprāyair ugraiś ca karmabhiḥ || 19.133 nārāyaṇabalir nāma samārādhanam uttamam | gatihetur vinā tena gatir anyā na vidyate || 19.134 punar dahanam ārabhya karma smārtam aśeṣataḥ | kṛtvā sapiṇḍīkaraṇaparyantaṃ tadanantaram || 19.135 devadevaṃ samārādhya vakṣyamāṇena vartmanā | viṣṇvālaye nadītīre parvate vā vane 'pi vā || 19.136 anyatra vā puṇyadeśe kartur vā bhavane śubhe | yaṣṭavyaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya dvādaśyāmayanadvaye || 19.137 upoṣitaḥ san pūrvedyuḥ kartā niyatamānasaḥ | brāhmaṇān bhagavadbhaktān vratasvādhyāyaśālinaḥ || 19.138 āmantrya mantravid buddhvā keśavādi yathā svayam | śodhayed gomayāmbhobhiḥ bhūtale kuśaviṣṭare || 19.139 upaveśya vṛtān eva prāṅmukhān kamalāsana | ardhyādibhiḥ samabhyarcya nāmabhiḥ keśavādibhiḥ || 19.140 namo 'ntair nāgavallyādi dattvā cābhyañjayed dvijān | snātānāṃ sannidhau teṣāṃ homaṃ caupāsane 'nale || 19.141 kṛtvāgnimukham agneś ca prāgbhāge cakrapaṅkaje | sthaṇḍile kuśakūrce vā devam āvāhayed yadi || 19.142 puṣpāñjaliḥ samutthāya nṛsūktādyā ṛco japan | oṃpūrvābhir vyāhṛtibhir ārādhya puruṣottamam || 19.143 mūrtibhedān keśavādīn nāmabhiḥ svair anantaram | āvāhyārdhyādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhir upacarya pṛthak pṛthak || 19.144 tarpayitvā tilāmbhobhiḥ keśavādīn svanāmabhiḥ | upacarya ca dīpāntaṃ puruṣaṃ puruṣātmanā || 19.145 sūktena keśavādīṃs tu nāmabhiḥ svair yathākramam | agnau padmāsanāsīnaṃ dhyātvā paramapūruṣam || 19.146 ārabhya pāyasaṃ viṣṇornukam ity ṛcam abjaja | paścāt paro mātrayeti yājyayā juhuyād dhaviḥ || 19.147 keśavādyair nāmadheyaiḥ sarpiṣā juhuyāt tataḥ | caturthyantair dvādaśabhir namo 'ntair dhyānamāsthitaḥ || 19.148 kṣīrājyaguḍamiśrānnaṃ tebhya eva nivedayet | devasya tvā savituriti mahāviṣṇor nivedanam || 19.149 saptavyāhṛtibhir bhūyo juhuyāt sarpiṣānale | darbhāsaneṣu bhūdevānāhatān upaveśya tān || 19.150 vastrāṅgulīyakaiś chatrakuṇḍalopānahādibhiḥ | yathāśakti samabhyarcya mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇa tān || 19.151 tilājyamiśrahavyena tadanujñānapūrvakam | juhuyād anale havyaṃ vidyayā vakṣyamāṇayā || 19.152 pitṛbhyas tatpitṛbhyaś ca tatpitṛbhyaḥ punas tathā | mātṛbhyaḥ pitṛmātṛbhyas tatpitṛbhyaḥ punas tathā || 19.153 mātāmahebhyas teṣāṃ ye pitaras tebhya eva ca | mātāmahībhyo mātuś ca pitṛmātṛbhya eva ca || 19.154 pituḥ pitāmahībhyaś ca tathācāryebhya eva ca | tatpatnībhyo gurubhyaś ca gurupatnībhya eva ca || 19.155 sakhibhyas tatpurandhrībhyo jñātibhyo yāś ca tāḥ striyaḥ | tābhyo 'mātyebhyas tatstrībhyaḥ sarvābhyaḥ tatstriyaś ca yāḥ || 19.156 tābhyaś ceti samuccārya svadhā nama iti bruvan | nārāyaṇāya svāheti pratyekaṃ pṛthagāhutiḥ || 19.157 agniśabdaṃ caturthyantaṃ kavyavāhanam ity atha | tadante sviṣṭakṛcchabdam anuṣaṅgaś ca pūrvavat || 19.158 hutvaivaṃ sarpiṣā paścād dvādaśākṣaravidyayā | pratyekaṃ śatam aṣṭau ca tathāṣṭākṣaravidyayā || 19.159 viṣṇugāyatriyā tadvadbrāhmaṇān ṣaḍrasānvitam | bhojayed dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt tān praṇamya pradakṣiṇam || 19.160 tānanujñāpya śiṣṭānnaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kriyatām iti | dakṣiṇenānalaṃ darbhān prāgagrān śodhite sthale || 19.161 saṃstīrya teṣu darbheṣu baliṃ dadyāt samāhitaḥ | viśvebhyaś caiva devebhyaḥ sādhyebhyas tadanantaram || 19.162 sarvebhyaś caiva devebhyo viṣṇur nārāyaṇas tathā | sahasraśirase caiva yajñātmapadam eva ca || 19.163 puruṣaṃ yajñapūrvaṃ ca sarveśvarapadaṃ tathā | caturthyantaṃ samuccārya namaḥ svāhetyanantaram || 19.164 sarvatraivānuṣaṅgaṃ ca sviṣṭakṛdyajanādikam | ādhenuvaradānāntaṃ kṛtvā pretaṃ nivedayet || 19.165 mūrtiṣu dvādaśasvenaṃ yajñaśarmāṇamākhyayā | nivedayāmi devāya keśavāyetyanukramāt || 19.166 dvādaśabhyo nivedyaivaṃ paramānnaṃ nivedayet | nārāyaṇabalir hy eṣa dvijānāṃ samudīritaḥ || 19.167 evaṃ yasya kṛto datto balir devārcanātmakaḥ | sa yāti nikhilaṃ pāpaṃ nirdhūya brahma śāśvatam || 19.168 pāpānām itareṣāṃ ca baliḥ puṇyakṛtām api | paramātmapadaprāptyai kalpate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 19.169
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde utsavaprāyaścittanārāyaṇābalir nāma ekonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
hiraṇyagarbhādividhiḥ brahmā rājānastadamātyo vā ye rājyadhuri niṣṭhitāḥ | bhagavan rakṣaṇavyagrāḥ prajānāṃ satatodyatāḥ || 20.1 brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpair abhibhūtā vigarhitaiḥ | kāyakleśātmake śāstracodite ghorakarmaṇi || 20.2 pāpanirharaṇopāye pravartitumanīśvarāḥ | te kathaṃ tāni pāpāni vidhūya sakalāny api || 20.3 karmādhikāriṇo bhūyassatāṃ saṃsadi saṃmatāḥ | kalpante bhagavaddhyāne tadarcanavidhāv api || 20.4 yogyāḥ prakāraṃ taṃ deva brūhi mahyaṃ yathātatham | brahmahatyādipāpānām apanodanam uttamam || 20.5 śrībhagavān kāyakleśātmake karmaṇyakṣamāṇāṃ mahībhṛtām | vihitaṃ sukaraṃ teṣāṃ prāyaścittaṃ caturmukha || 20.6 hiraṇyagarbhanāmaikaṃ karma proktaṃ tathāparam | tulābhārasamākhyaṃ tad dvābhyāṃ nirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ || 20.7 bhagavaddhyānapūjādividhau bhūyo 'dhikāriṇaḥ | bhavanti karma dvitayaṃ tadaśeṣeṇa kathyate || 20.8 kartuṃ vyavasitaṃ karma varayed gurumāditaḥ | sarvaśāstrārthatattvajñaṃ mantrāṇāṃ pāragaṃ param || 20.9 dayāluṃ sarvabhūtānām akrodhanamalolupam | karmadvayavidhānajñamṛjuṃ bhāgavataṃ dvijam || 20.10 parīkṣyaivaṃ vidhaṃ yatnād upasaṅgamya pārthivaḥ | arthayitvā yathānyāyam upacarya dvijottamam || 20.11 karmārabheta puṇyeṣū deśakāleṣu yantritaḥ | ṣaṭsu taiṣyādimāseṣu śravaṇe tvāṣṭra eva vā || 20.12 maitre vāśvayuji brahman rohiṇyāṃ vāsave 'pi vā | .... .... .... .... .... .... .... .... || 20.13 puṣye vā saumyanakṣatre cottaratritaye 'pi vā | deśe tīre ca saritāṃ samudrataṭabhūṣu vā || 20.14 yadvā sarvaguṇopete deśe bhagavadālaye | naimittikaṃ cet karmaitan na kālādiparīkṣaṇam || 20.15 maṇḍapaṃ prathamaṃ kuryāt pratiṣṭhā yadi vālaye | anyatra vā yathoddiṣṭe deśe śāstroktavartmanā || 20.16 sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktamantaḥkalpitavedikam | aṅkurān arpayet pūrvamukteṣv anyatame dine || 20.17 sambhārāṃs tatra sambhārya yathāvasu yathāvidhi | ekāṅgulaghane tulye kapāle dve hiraṇmaye || 20.18 adharaṃ cottaraṃ cāpi kārye dvābhyāṃ caturmukha | saṅgatābhyāṃ praviśyāntarāste garbhāśaye yathā || 20.19 kartā sukhaṃ tannirmāya dvayamaṇḍasamākṛtim | hiraṇyagarbhasaṃjñaṃ tadyatrāyaṃ jāyate punaḥ || 20.20 homapātrāṇi sarvāṇi raimayāny eva kārayet | sambhāreṣu samasteṣu sambhṛteṣu mahīpatiḥ || 20.21 pūrvedyur niyataścoptaromaśmaśrunakhaśśuciḥ | śuddhadacchuddhavasanaḥ śvetamālyānulepanaḥ || 20.22 upoṣito ghṛtaṃ prāśya rātriṃ niyamatatparaḥ | nītvā paredyuḥ pratyūṣe snāto niyatamānasaḥ || 20.23 ṛtvigbhiḥ kārayet karma guruṇā coditaḥ svayam | vedimadhye śālibhārair navabhiḥ kṛtaviṣṭare || 20.24 prāgagreṣu ca darbheṣu stīrṇeṣv āropya raimayam | kapālamadharaṃ cordhvaṃ toraṇādisamarcane || 20.25 yathāpuraṃ kṛte nṛttageyavāditramaṅgale | hiraṇyagarbhamabhitaś caturdikṣu bhṛtodakān || 20.26 saṃsthāpya caturaḥ kumbhān dhānyapīṭheṣu teṣv api | kumbheṣu nyastaratneṣu veṣṭiteṣu navāmbaraiḥ || 20.27 catastro devatās svīyair nāmadheyair anukramāt | āvāhyaḥ puruṣaḥ satyaḥ prācīdakṣiṇayos tathā || 20.28 vārūnyām atha kauberyām acyuto 'nanta eva ca | samudīryārdhyapādyādyair dhūpadīpāvasānakaiḥ || 20.29 annaṃ caturvidhaṃ cāpi kumbhe kumbhe nivedayet | pūrvādidikṣu kuṇḍeṣu pratiṣṭhāyām iva kramāt || 20.30 kḷpteṣu juhuyād agnau samidhājyena ca kramāt | pratyekaṃ mūlamantreṇa śatam aṣṭottaraṃ guruḥ || 20.31 caturvidhena cānnena pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ | kuryāt puruṣasūktena dhyātvā yaṣṭavyadevatām || 20.32 prāpte muḥūrte bhūdevānanujñāpya guruḥ svayam | pāṇinā bhūmipaṃ haste gṛhītvā pralayakramāt || 20.33 dehaṃ saṃhṛtya bhūpālaṃ dehamātrāvaśeṣitam | dhyātvā praveśayed garbhaṃ raimayaṃ kamalāsana || 20.34 adhare raimaye bhāge sukhāsīnaṃ ca bhūmipam | chādayed upariṣṭhena bhāgenaitat praveśanam || 20.35 ghṛtamiśrais tilais tattvasaṃhārāhutim ācaret | tattvotpādena mārgeṇa cintayitvā guruḥ punaḥ || 20.36 spṛṣṭvā śarīraṃ bhūpasya sṛṣṭīhomaṃ yathāpuram | kuryāt kuṇḍeṣu sarvatra caturṣu caturānana || 20.37 ānīya mantravajjātaṃ kuṇḍāt tasmān mahīnṛpam | vaiyāghracarmaṇyāropya kalaśair abhiṣecayet || 20.38 uttamādhamamārgeṇa devavanmantravittamaḥ | tad eva mantrasnapanaṃ dravyajātaṃ ca tādṛśam || 20.39 karmaṇānena nirdhūtakalmaṣaḥ puṇyakṛttamaḥ | jāto guruprasādena gurumagre sabhājayet || 20.40 sahasraniṣkamānena tapanīyena bhūmipaḥ | ṛtvijāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ tāvatī dakṣiṇā matā || 20.41 karmopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ kuryād ācāryasānnṛpaḥ | hairaṇyamaṇḍaṃ vidvadbhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāpayet || 20.42 evaṃ kṛtavatas tasya viṣṇor ārādhanādiṣu | sampadyate 'dhikāritvaṃ dvir evaṃ karma kurvataḥ || 20.43 phalaṃ ca viṣṇoḥ sārūpyaṃ sāyujyaṃ triguṇaṃ bhavet | tulābhārāhvayaṃ karma dvitīyaṃ kathyate 'dhunā || 20.44 nirmāya maṇṭapaṃ prāgvattanmadhye yajñadārujau | stambhau dṛḍhau sāravantau hastaiṣ ṣaḍbhiḥ samucchritau || 20.45 dvihastapariṇāhau dvau suvṛttau śilpikalpitau | dvihastamānāntarālau sthāpitau bhūtale dṛḍham || 20.46 kṛtvā tayor uparyekaṃ dāru sāravad uttaram | vistīrṇaṃ hastamānena tāvan mānaṃ ghanaṃ dṛḍham || 20.47 trihastamāyataṃ caiva tulādaṇḍamayomayam | āyasenaiva pāśena yojayed uttareṇa tu || 20.48 vidhāyetthaṃ tulāmanyat saṃbhārādi yathāpuram | kalpayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ karma copari śāstrikam || 20.49 homāntaṃ sakalaṃ kuryād yathāyogamalopayan | snāto narapatiḥ kṣaumavasanābharaṇānvitaḥ || 20.50 śucirdhyāyanvāsudevaṃ carmakhaḍgadharaṃ tathā | parikramya namaskṛtya devāṃs tān puruṣādikān || 20.51 tulām api tathā kṛtvā bhāge tasyāś ca paścime | sthitvā prāgānano bhūtvā ārohet paścimaṃ ghaṭam || 20.52 svastidā ityṛcaṃ sūktam adhīyānaṃ ca maṅgalam | prācye ghaṭe nṛpasamaṃ nikṣiped dhāṭakottamam || 20.53 caturdikṣu pravṛttāsu nṛttavāditragītiṣu | adhīyāneṣu vipreṣu vedāṃś ca caturas tathā || 20.54 śāntihome ca kuṇḍeṣu pravṛtte pārthivaḥ svayam | kañcitkālaṃ ghaṭabhuvi dhyāyan rukmamayaṃ harim || 20.55 āsitvā gurvanujñātaḥ pūrvaṃ ghaṭabhuvas tataḥ | avarohet suvarṇaṃ ca bhūṣaṇāni ca bhūpatiḥ || 20.56 bhūsurebhyo yathāyogaṃ vibhajya vitaret tataḥ | ācāryāya śataṃ niṣkaṃ mūrtipebhyaś ca tatsamam || 20.57 sarvebhyo ye ca tatkarmasahakāre niyojitāḥ | tebhyo 'pi dadyād īkṣitvā teṣāṃ karma yathāyatham || 20.58 tulābhārāhvayaṃ karma kurvann itthaṃ mahīpatiḥ | anyo vā dhanavān kaścit sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 20.59 pretya cābhimatān bhogān aśnute divi devavat | asakṛtkarma kurvāṇo brahmaloke mahīyate || 20.60 pāpāpanodanaṃ karma paraloke sukhāvaham | āyurvṛddhikaraṃ sarvarogaśāntikaraṃ param || 20.61 sampatkaraṃ yaśovṛddhikāraṇaṃ sarvakāmadam | caturānana karmānyat svarṇagarbhasamanvitam || 20.62 puṣyābhiṣecanaṃ nāma śṛṇu guhyaṃ
