sanātanam | vihitaṃ pṛthivīśānām indrādyair apy anuṣṭhitam || 20.63 māsi taiṣye proṣṭhapade māse cāśvayuje śubhe | śravaṇe caiva nakṣatre janmarkṣe kartur eva vā || 20.64 mahābhiṣecanaṃ karma prārabheta gurus tataḥ | pūrvokteṣv eva deśeṣu kasmiṃścid abhipūjite || 20.65 pañcadaṇḍāyatāṃ bhūmiṃ kṛtvā vai vartulākṛtim | tasyām antaḥsthalaṃ samyak kṛtvā kiṣkusamucchritam || 20.66 toraṇādi caturdikṣu sthāpayitvā caturmukha | alaṅkṛtya yathāpūrvaṃ vitānadhvajamālayā || 20.67 tanmadhye kalpayen meruṃ mṛdaṅgasadṛśākṛtim | ślakṣṇādi ca mṛdā kāryaṃ tasyocchrāyastrihastakaḥ || 20.68 mūle cāgre ca viṣkambho hastamānas tathā bhavet | caturdikṣu ca catvāro bhāgās tasya yathākramam || 20.69 śveto 'ruṇas tathā pītaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kalpyaś ca sarvataḥ | ratnaiḥ svarṇair bhūṣaṇīyāḥ ṣaṭ tathā kulaparvatāḥ || 20.70 pūrvāparāyatāḥ kalpyāḥ himavāṃs tadanantaram | hemakūṭaś ca niṣadho nīlaś śvetaś ca parvataḥ || 20.71 śataśṛṅgaś ca viṣkambhas teṣāṃ syāt ṣoḍaśāṅgulaḥ | śvetaś ca piṅgalo rakto nīlaś candrasamaprabhaḥ || 20.72 hemavarṇaḥ kramād varṇaiś citrayed dhātupāṃsubhiḥ | jambūdvīpaṃ likhitvaivaṃ lavaṇodadhiveṣṭitam || 20.73 plakṣadvīpaṃ likhed dikṣu samudrapariveṣṭitam | śālmalyā lakṣitaṃ dvīpaṃ parītaṃ madhurāmbubhiḥ || 20.74 kuśaṃ parītam āghāraiḥ krauñcaṃ dadhisamṛddhidam | śākaṃ dugdhodadhikṣiptaṃ puṣkaraṃ svacchatoyadhim || 20.75 kramāl likhitvā sarveṣāṃ lokālokamahācalam | vapravatkalpayet prācyāṃ tasyāntaramarāvatīm || 20.76 purīmindrasya yāmyāyāṃ nāmnā saṃyamanīm api | yamasya varuṇasāpi pratīcyāṃ nagarīṃ tathā || 20.77 vibhāvarīm udīcyāntu purīṃ somasya kalpayet | indrādilokapālānāṃ sthāne sthāne prakalpayet || 20.78 saikate sthaṇḍile tatra tānāvāhya samarcayet | mahāmeruṃ ca tanmūrdhni vārāhīṃ mūrtimarcayet || 20.79 meror uttarapārśve tu śvabhraṃ kṛtvā pramāṇataḥ | adhaḥ kapālaṃ sauvarṇaṃ nyasya tatra samarcayet || 20.80 punar ūrdhvakapālaṃ ca nyasya tasyopari kramāt | pūrvoktena vidhānena purodhā niyataḥ svayam || 20.81 kumbhān ṣoḍaśa sauvarṇān ṣoḍaśaprasthapūraṇān | parito 'ṇḍakapālasya sūtravastrādiveṣṭitān || 20.82 sthāpayitvā dhānyarāśau sāpidhānānalaṅkṛtān <sāpidhānānalaṃkṛtān| | diśamaindrīṃ samārabhya prādakṣiṇyena pūrayet || 20.83 pañcagavyādibhir dravyaiḥ praṇavena prapūrayet | pañcagavyaṃ ca pīyūṣaṃ dadhi sarpis tathā madhu || 20.84 haricandanatoyaṃ ca vāri cākṣatasaṃyutam | kauṅkumaṃ ca tathā toyaṃ karpūrāgaruvāri ca || 20.85 kuśodakaṃ ca ratnāmbhaḥ sarvapuṣpodakaṃ tathā | phalodakaṃ ca dhānyāmbhaḥ sarvatīrthodakaṃ tathā || 20.86 sarvagandhodakaṃ cāpi dravyāṇāṃ krama īritaḥ | meroś ca paścime bhāge kuṇḍam agneḥ prakalpayet || 20.87 ājyena juhuyād agnau śatam aṣṭottaraṃ pṛthak | varāhamūrtiprabhṛtīr upakṣiptvā ca devatāḥ || 20.88 anyāś ca devatāś śailān samudrānviṣṭapāni ca | bhūrādīni tathā dvīpabhedāṃś coddiśya nāmabhiḥ || 20.89 teṣām āhūya tatkāryaṃ guruṇā sapurodhasā | bhūr bhuvaḥ svar iti brahmann ante ca juhuyād ghṛtaiḥ || 20.90 agniṃ visṛjya vitared dakṣiṇāś ca yathāvasu | tadante yajamānas tu sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaḥ || 20.91 śuciḥ samāhito bhūtvā kṛtakautukabandhanaḥ | praviśya tatra taddhaimamaṇḍaṃ prāṅmukhaḥ svayam || 20.92 praviśyāsīta deveśaṃ dhyāyann eva sudhākaram | yajñamūrtiṃ dharāṃ devīṃ bibhrāṇaṃ nijadaṃṣṭrayā || 20.93 evaṃ dhyāyantamāsīnaṃ nṛpaṃ sopaskriyaṃ svayam | ācāryānumataḥ kumbhaiḥ sthāpitair abhiṣecayet || 20.94 pañcagavyādibhir dravyair mantrānuccārya mantravit | vasoḥ pavitramantreṇa pañcagavyābhiṣecanam || 20.95 śaṃ no devīr iti payaḥsnānaṃ dadhnābhiṣecanam | iṣe tveti ghṛtenāgna āyāhīti tathā punaḥ || 20.96 agnimīleti madhunā , mānastoka iti bruvan | haricandanatoyena , tathaivākṣatavāriṇā || 20.97 idaṃ viṣṇuriti procya kuṅkumakṣodavāriṇā | ahārṣaṃ ceti mantreṇa tathā karpūravāriṇā || 20.98 gāyatryā snāpayed urvīpatiṃ ratnāmbhasā tataḥ | catvāri śṛṅgety uccārya tathā sarvaphalodakaiḥ || 20.99 sarvaṃ rājānam ityādimantram uccārya mantravit | sarvadhānyodakenaiva śatamanviti vidyayā || 20.100 sarvatīrthāmbhasā snānamāpohiṣṭheti vidyayā | taratsamandīty uccārya sarvagandhābhiṣecanam || 20.101 niṣkrānto nṛpatir garbhāt prokṣito maṅgalāmbhasā | śuddhāmbaradharaś śuddhaś cācānto dattadakṣiṇaḥ || 20.102 ācāryāya yathāvittaṃ vistāraṃ raimayaṃ tataḥ | aṇḍaṃ vibhajya vitared brāhmaṇebhyaś caturmukha || 20.103 dadyād vā viṣṇave sarvam ardhaṃ vā pādam eva vā | paunaḥpunye 'bhiṣekasya muktiḥ karatale sthitā || 20.104
iti śrīpañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pāme tantre caryāpāde hiraṇyagarbhādividhir nāma viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? ekaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
siddhāntabhedapañcarātrādhikārivyavasthāvidhiḥ brahmā siddhāntānāṃ śruto bhedaś caturṇāṃ bhagavanmukhāt | sāmprataṃ śrotum icchāmi vyavasthāmadhikāriṇām || 21.1 śrībhagavān ahaṃ te niyamaṃ teṣāṃ kathayiṣyāmi śāstrataḥ | jāteṣu sarvavipreṣu manmukhāt kamalāsana || 21.2 nānācaraṇagotreṣu nānākarmapareṣu ca | teṣāṃ madhye mahābhāgā ṛṣayo 'ṣṭasahasriṇaḥ || 21.3 aupagāyanapūrvāste nānāgotrā mumukṣavaḥ | adhīyānāḥ kaṇvaśākhāṃ tathā mādhyandināhvayam || 21.4 teṣāṃ buddhiḥ samutpannā mokṣaikaphaladāyinī | te sarve saha saṅgamya brahmāṇaṃ procuravyayan || 21.5 mokṣyamāṇāṃ vayaṃ brahman mokṣopāyavivitsayā | śaraṇaṃ tvām iha prāptājanmamṛtyujigīṣavaḥ || 21.6 aupagāyanamukhyāṃs tān upāsannāṃś caturmukha | iti bruvāṇānāhūya tadanugrahakāmyayā || 21.7 pañcarātroktamārgeṣu mantrasiddhāntavartmanā | dīkṣayitvā yathānyāyaṃ cakravārijamaṇḍale || 21.8 āhūtān dīkṣitān brahmā kartavyam idamādiśat | kāṇvīṃ mādhyandinīṃ śākhāṃ śākhāntarhite ubhe || 21.9 adhīdhvaṃ mūlaśākhe te niṣekādyāś ca saṃskṛtīḥ | tābhyām eva tv anuṣṭhadhvaṃ somayāgādikarma ca || 21.10 bhagavaddhyānasahitaṃ tatsamārādhanātmakam | kartavyatvena vedoktaṃ ity evaṃ phalavarjitam || 21.11 kartavyam iti kurvāṇaiḥ karma niśśreyasaṃ param | prāpyate 'nena yuṣmābhir mantrasiddhāntavartmanā || 21.12 pañcakālaṃ yathāśāstra gṛhe vā mandire 'pi vā | bhagavatpūjanaṃ kāryamadyaprabhṛti nānyathā || 21.13 yūyaṃ bhāgavatās tena jātā bhagavadarcanāt | bhagavadbhaktikaraṇādvaṃśajātāś caturmukha || 21.14 nāmnā bhāgavatāḥ santo dīkṣayitvā yathāvidhi | yathoktaṃ karma kurvāṇāḥ prāpnuvanti paraṃ padam || 21.15 śākhāntareṣu ye mantrāḥ pāvanāḥ paramarṣayaḥ | tānapyadhīdhvaṃ tair mantrair arcayadhvamadhokṣajam || 21.16 ātmārthayajanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kalpate 'bhyudayāvaham | tathā parārthayajanaṃ grāme vā pattane pure || 21.17 svagṛhe vā svatantre vā kāryaṃ bhāgavatair naraiḥ | ātmanaś ca pareṣāṃ ca tanniśśreyasakṛd bhavet || 21.18 abhāgavatavaṃśais tu dīkṣitair api mānavaiḥ | ātmārtham eva yajanaṃ na parārthaṃ kadācana || 21.19 parārthayajanaṃ teṣāṃ garhitaṃ viprasattamāḥ | abhāgavatavaṃśyo 'pi dīkṣitaś śāstravartmanā || 21.20 parārthayajanaṃ kuryād api bhāgavatājñayā | bhagavān eva govindaḥ sākṣād bhāgavataḥ smṛtaḥ || 21.21 taṃ dṛṣṭvā vidyayā hīnam api duṣkṛtakāriṇam | nirguṇaṃ guṇinaṃ vāpi pratyuttiṣṭhet kṛtāñjaliḥ || 21.22 tānayācata viśvātmā maharṣīnamitaujasaḥ | yuṣmābhiḥ kṣitiloke 'smin kāryaṃ bhagavadarcanam || 21.23 svārthaṃ parārtham athavā kartavyaṃ mama śāsanāt | iti bruvāṇas tān brahmā tatraivāntaradhīyata || 21.24 dhyeyaṃ yattat pravakṣyāmi mantrasiddhāntināṃ nṛṇām | dvibhujaṃ ced vāsudevaṃ rekhābhis talayoḥ kare || 21.25 lañchitaṃ śaṃkhacakrādyaiḥ dhyāyet taddviguṇaiḥ punaḥ | dvābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ bibhrāṇaṃ śaṃkhacakre <śaṅkhacakre> gadāmbuje || 21.26 mukhyābhyām athavābhītidānaṃ kaṭyavalaṃbanam | ito 'dhike bhujagaṇe bahvāyudhadharaṃ harim || 21.27 varṇena śyāmasubhagam athavā dhavaladyutim | śailādivastubhiḥ kḷptaṃ beraṃ cādipade sthitam || 21.28 āsīnaṃ vā śayānaṃ vā garuḍārūḍham eva vā | dhyāyeyur arcayeyuś ca trayīmantrais trayīvidaḥ || 21.29 dhyāyet tvāgamasiddhānte sthitaṃ lambabhujadvayam | vāsudevādayas sarve nirākalpā nirāyudhāḥ || 21.30 sitās sitāmbaradharāś catvāraḥ samadiṅmukhāḥ | ekaviṣṭaraniṣṭhāste śayanāsanavarjitāḥ || 21.31 devībhyāṃ parivāraiś ca hīnā yogāsanena ca | samapradhānaṣāḍguṇyabhājo mantrair balādibhiḥ || 21.32 pratiṣṭhāpya kramāt pūjyā nityaṃ kamalasambhava | balipradānarahitā nityotsavavivarjitāḥ || 21.33 pavitrāropaṇasvāpaśayanotthānavarjitāḥ | kartavyatvena bhuvane prāsāde vā caturmukha || 21.34 kāle madhyandine 'chidrapañcakālaparāyaṇaiḥ | nirāśaiḥ karmasaṃnyāsakāribhir devapūjanam || 21.35 balādimantrair acchidrapañcakālaparāyaṇaiḥ | ekādhvanā niṣekādisaṃskāraiś ca balādibhiḥ || 21.36 caturṇāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ vihitaṃ nayakarma ca | dvādaśākṣaravidyaiva teṣāṃ vidyā na ca trayī || 21.37 na sāvitrī na mantro 'nyaḥ svādhyāyajaparkarmaṇoḥ | bījaśaktyaṅgarahitamṛṣicchandovivarjitam || 21.38 svarūpam eva mantrasya japasvādhyāyakarmaṇoḥ | caturṇām api varṇānāṃ saṃjñās teṣāṃ kramoditāḥ || 21.39 bhago hi dvijamukhyasya saṃjñā vā vipravannṛpe | vaiśyasya vardhanī saṃjñā maudgalī vṛṣalasya ca || 21.40 sarve samānāś catvāro gotrapravaravarjitāḥ | utkarṣo nāpakarṣaś ca jātitas teṣu saṃmatā || 21.41 phaleṣu niḥspṛhāḥ sarve dvādaśākṣaracintakāḥ | mokṣeṣu niścayārthāś ca sūtakāśaucavarjitāḥ || 21.42 nādhikāro 'sti sarvatra karṣaṇādiṣu karmasu | mohāt tāni prayuñjānāḥ patantyakṛtabuddhayaḥ || 21.43 rājarāṣṭramanuṣyāṇāṃ yajamānasya sadmanaḥ | kṣayo bhavati tenaite na kuryuḥ karṣaṇādikam || 21.44 yāceta mantrasiddhānte dīkṣitaṃ viprasattamam | pūjārtham ātmano bimbapratiṣṭhākaraṇādiṣu || 21.45 so 'pi bījādirahitaṃ dvādaśākṣaravidyayā | kuryāt pratiṣṭhāmācāryaḥ pūjārthaṃ mantravittamaḥ || 21.46 ekāyanaś caturmūrtiṃ pratigṛhya samarcayet | arcanaṃ ca catuḥsthāne vārisragbimbavahniṣu || 21.47 nādhikāro 'sti mantreṣu bījapiṇḍapadādiṣu | caturṇāṃ maudgalādīnāṃ viduṣāṃ dvādaśākṣaram || 21.48 prāṇānām api niryāṇe na spṛśenna dahecchavam | putrapautrādirahitaṃ saṃtyajettaṃ kāṣṭhavadbahiḥ || 21.49 mūrtyantarārcanaṃ teṣāṃ pratyavāyāya kalpate | siddhāntāntaramārgeṇa sthāpitaṃ bimbamālaye || 21.50 ajñānād athavā mohād ekāyanavidhānataḥ | arcayannāpadaḥ sarvā āpnotīha paratra ca || 21.51 pradakṣiṇapraṇāmādi rāddhānte 'nyatra kevalam | vihitaṃ nārcanaṃ kāryaṃ rājarāṣṭrakṣayāvaham || 21.52 na dīkṣā naiva dehasya dahanādiviśodhanam | nāṅganyāsādi sakalaṃ neṣṭamekāyanādhvani || 21.53 ekāyane praviṣṭānāṃ traividyānām ayaṃ kramaḥ | tantrasiddhāntamārgeṇa sampratyācāra ucyate || 21.54 caturṇām api varṇānām itareṣāṃ ca tadbhuvām | dīkṣā samaiva sarveṣām ācārastantravartmanā || 21.55 niṣekādiś ca saṃskāras teṣāṃ tantroktavartmanā | tyaktvā trayīṃ tantram eva prapadya śaraṇaṃ sthitāḥ || 21.56 sāntarālam anuṣṭhānaṃ pañcakāloditaṃ tathā | yatas tantrāntara iva nṛṇāṃ kamalasambhava || 21.57 tattvasaṃhārajanane nyāsaś ca karadehayoḥ | yogaviṣṭarakḷptiś ca navapadmaprakalpanam || 21.58 mūrtayor navapadmeṣu tāsv adhiṣṭhānamadhyame | tā vīkṣante diśo vāpi mūrtayo 'ṣṭau yathāyatham || 21.59 yādṛśī madhyamā mūrtirīkṣate seśvarī matā | yāṃ ca vālokya puruṣas samārādhanakarmaṇi || 21.60 āste 'sau pauruṣī jñeyā prājāpatyā ca vāsavī | yogaviṣṭarapādānāṃ dharmādīnāṃ prakalpane || 21.61 ālayāntaḥ parivārāṇāṃ suparṇītanayasya ca | balipradānapīṭhasya gopurasya caturmukha || 21.62 bāhyānām api caiteṣāṃ prācī syād aiśvarī harit | bāhyānāṃ parivārāṇām anyeṣāṃ parikalpane || 21.63 prājāpatyaiva dik prācī diksaṃmohe tu pauruṣī | prācyādikāṃ samāhṛtya parivāraprakalpanam || 21.64 dviṣaṭkākṣarapūrvāṇāṃ bījaśaktyaṅgasaṃyutam | ṛṣicchandovihīnaś ca mantrāṇāṃ japa iṣyate || 21.65 varṇānām itareṣāṃ ca samamārādhanakramaḥ | navānām api mūrtīnāṃ mūrtyantaragaṇasya ca || 21.66 prādurbhāvagaṇasyāpi varṇāḥ strīvyaktayo matāḥ | na dhvajārohaṇaṃ nāpi māsādyutsavasambhavaḥ || 21.67 kevalaṃ śayanotthāne balihomādivarjitaḥ | prādakṣiṇyena gamanaṃ grāmādeḥ kautukotsavaḥ || 21.68 naimittikaṃ catuḥsthāne svātantryeṇārcanaṃ hareḥ | cakrābjamaṇḍale kumbhe pratimāyāṃ ca pāvake || 21.69 tantrāntare ca siddhānte sampratyācāra ucyate | trivakraṃ vā caturvaktram adhikānanam eva vā || 21.70 yogapīṭhe sthitaṃ devaṃ parivāraiś ca sevitam | piṇḍamantraiḥ kalāmantrair bījaśaktyaṅgasaṃyutaiḥ || 21.71 ṛṣicchandovihīnaiś ca catvāro brāhmaṇādayaḥ | samarcayeyus sarveṣāṃ niṣekādyakhilakriyāḥ || 21.72 tantrāntaroktamārgeṇa kāryāḥ trayyātmanāpi ca | siddhāntānāṃ caturṇāṃ tu sāṅkaryaṃ vyasanāvaham || 21.73 siddhānteṣu caturṣv ekaṃ pūrvair nṛbhir anuṣṭhitam | tyaktvā samāśrayed anyaṃ naro bhavati kilbiṣī || 21.74 tasmāj janmaprabhṛtyekarāddhāntaniyato bhavet | anyathā kulamātmānaṃ sarvaṃ nāśayati dhruvam || 21.75 mantramaṇḍalakuṇḍādikriyāmudropacārakaiḥ | yogaṃ nayati yo mohāt svasiddhāntoktavartmanā || 21.76 so 'pi svakulajān dharmān paramātmānam añjasā | nayen nirayamatyugraṃ puruṣān puruṣādhamaḥ || 21.77 niṣphalā ca kriyā tasya pratyutānarthakāraṇam | kupyec ca devas tatkopo rājarāṣṭrakṣayāvahaḥ || 21.78 kartā kārayitā cobhau sānvayau dvau vinaśyataḥ | na sannidhānaṃ ca harer dhāmni hāniś ca sampadām || 21.79 tasmān na saṅkaraḥ kāryo rāddhāntoditakarmaṇaḥ | mantrasiddhāntamukhyeṣu caturṣv api yathāpuram || 21.80 anutiṣṭhānti ye karma samārādhanam acyutam | asaṅkareṇa te hy evaṃ sambandhārhā narottamāḥ || 21.81 ye 'nabhijñās tu deveśaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam | tattvena ye 'pi puruṣā mahopaniṣadīritam || 21.82 arthaṃ na jānanty adhamāstaiḥ sambandhaṃ vivarjayet | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena pañcarātroditāḥ kriyāḥ | ye 'nutiṣṭhanti tair eva sambandho 'bhyudayāvahaḥ || 21.83
iti śrīpañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde siddhāntabhedapañcarātrādhikārivyavasthāvidhir nāma ekaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
mudrālakṣaṇavidhiḥ brahmā kīdṛśī bhagavan mudrā tadbhedāś caiva kīdṛśāḥ | prayojanaṃ vā kiṃ tasyāḥ kathyatāṃ tadaśeṣataḥ || 22.1 śrībhagavān aṅgulīracanābhedo mudrā yasmāt pradarśitā | hiṃsakānām aśeṣāṇāṃ mudaṃ drāvayati kṣaṇāt || 22.2 tato mudrā nirasanaṃ teṣāṃ tasyāḥ prayojanam | prīṇanaṃ cāpi devānāṃ karmaṇā sāpi darśitā || 22.3 prayoktavyāś ca rahasi na bahir janasaṃsadi | mantramaṇḍalamudrāṇāṃ guptir eṣā sanātanī || 22.4 gandhaliptau karau kṛtvā mudrādarśanam ācaret | anāmikāmadhyamayoḥ praveśyāṅguṣṭhamāyatam || 22.5 vidhāya muṣṭiṃ hṛdaye nyased dhṛdayamudrikām | saiṣā muṣṭim adho baddhvā sthāpayitvā ca mūrdhani || 22.6 aṅguṣṭhāgreṇa hananaṃ tarjanyā śīrṣamudrikā | ūrdhvāṅguṣṭhaṃ dṛḍhaṃ muṣṭiṃ baddhvā nyasyec chikhāpade || 22.7 śikhāmudreyamuditā ; varmamudrā tu kathyate | praveśyābhyantarāṅguṣṭhaṃ baddhvā muṣṭipraveśanam || 22.8 unnamya kiñcid agre ca vitatāstena muṣṭinā | bhāvayed varmaṇo baddhaṃ saiṣā kavacamudrikā || 22.9 tarjanyāṅguṣṭhaśirasi sphoṭayec cakravat smaran | dikṣu sarvāsu śeṣābhirmuṣṭiṃ baddhvā caturmukha || 22.10 saiṣāstramudrā vijñeyā , śikhāmudrāmadhomukhīm | vinyaset tāṃ bhruvor madhye netramudreyam īritā || 22.11 ṣaḍaṅgamudrāsv etāsu hastas sarvatra dakṣiṇaḥ | kaniṣṭhādistribhir baddhvā muṣṭiṃ sāṅguṣṭhamunnatām || 22.12 vidhāya tarjanīṃ tena bhrāmayedāśu cakravat | agniprākāramudreyaṃ tayaivātmābhir akṣaṇam || 22.13 nābher adhastād vinyasya savyaṃ karatalaṃ punaḥ | uttānamitaraṃ tasya vinyased uparīdṛśī || 22.14 yogamudrā , karatalaṃ savyaṃ nābher adhastataḥ | avāṅmukhaṃ tadupari savyetaratalaṃ punaḥ || 22.15 samāṅguṣṭhaṃ viracayed yogasampuṭamudrikā | yogābhyāsena tattvānāṃ saṃhārotpatane 'pi ca || 22.16 mudrādvayam idaṃ brahman kathitaṃ yogināṃ hitam | yogasampuṭamudreyaṃ mudritā ghaṭavat kṛtā || 22.17 ūrdhvaṃ syāt kumbhamudraiṣā tayā snānaṃ samācaret | tarjanyānāmikāgraṃ tu veṣṭayitvā krameṇa tat || 22.18 tathāṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhe tu jñeyā saṃhāramudrikā | tattvānāṃ saṃhṛtau caiva devatodvāsane tathā || 22.19 eṣā mudrā prayoktavyā sarvakarmasu sarvadā | saṃhatābhiś ca tisṛbhir aṅgulībhiś ca saṃhṛtiḥ || 22.20 vimuktatarjanī bhūyaḥ sṛṣṭimudreti kīrtitā | āvāhane tattvasṛṣṭau mudraiṣā parikīrtitā || 22.21 aṅguṣṭhatarjanībhyāṃ tu saṃyogas tattvamudrikā | tattvanyasanakāle ca mudraiṣā parikīrtitā || 22.22 jñānamudrāpi saivaiṣā syād ajñānatamopahā | ubhayoḥ karayor madhyaṃ madhyamābhyāṃ tu saṃspṛśet || 22.23 uttānitau karau kṛtvā nyāsamudreti kīrtitā | devātmadehayor mantraṃ nyāsamudreyam īritā || 22.24 aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ tu karayos tarjanyor ubhayor api | madhyamābhyāṃ spṛśed anyāṃ vistṛtāni yathā tathā || 22.25 japamudreti vijñeyā japakāle pradarśayet | aṅgulībhis samastābhir dakṣiṇetarahastayoḥ || 22.26 sampuṭīkaraṇaṃ brahmamudrā saṃśabditā budhaiḥ | aṅguṣṭhe dve kaniṣṭhe dve tathā syāt tarjanī dvayoḥ || 22.27 sahayuktāgratāśliṣṭā viṣṇumudreti kīrtitā | sā caiva śleṣitāṅguṣṭhā samastena parasparam || 22.28 ubhayāṅguṣṭhamudrā sā rudrasya kathitā tava | śrotre pidhāya pāṇibhyāṃ daṇḍavaddakṣiṇaṃ karam || 22.29 prasārayed gurūṇāṃ tvabhivādanakarmaṇi | savyahastāṅgulīs savyāḥ karṇe nyasya tathetaram || 22.30 prasared vighnarājasya mudrā vighnavināśinī | antas tu tarjanīyugmaṃ saṃhatāṅguṣṭhakadvayam || 22.31 mudrā bhāgavatī sā , syāt karayugmaṃ tu sampuṭe | kṛte , varāhamudrā sā sarvasiddhikarī śubhā || 22.32 gurupaṅktikrame brahman sarṣā mudrā pradarśitā | apasavye karatale saṃsmared raktapaṅkajam || 22.33 tanmadhye cintayed agniṃ trikoṇaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim | avāṅmukhaṃ karatalaṃ kṛtvā dravyopari nyaset || 22.34 jñeyā dahanamudraiṣā dravyaśuddhipradā sadā | savye karatale śvetapaṅkajaṃ ṣoḍaśacchadam || 22.35 kalāṣoḍaśasaṃyuktaṃ śaśinaṃ paṅkajāsana | tanmadhye cintayitvā tu srāvitaṃ cāmṛtaṃ smaret || 22.36 tenāmṛtena tadbhasma kṣālitaṃ tūtthitaṃ smaret | āpyāyanasya mudraiṣā kathitā kamalāsana || 22.37 aṅguṣṭhe dve kaniṣṭhe dve tathā syāt tarjanī dvayoḥ | śiṣṭaṃ prasārayed brahmannaṅgulāni karadvaye || 22.38 madhyamāṃ dakṣiṇakare 'nāmikāṃ ca tathetare | saṃhṛtya prasarec cheṣaṃ karayor ubhayor api || 22.39 jñeyā surabhimudrā sā yāgadravyaviśodhanī | hastābhyām añjaliṃ kṛtvā īṣad vikasitaṃ sphuṭam || 22.40 āvāhanasya mudraiṣā darśanāt sannidhiṃ bhajet | hṛdaye śirasi dve 'pi (?) sampuṭāñjalir ūrdhvagā || 22.41 praṇāmamudrā sā jñeyā kṣipraṃ devaprasādinī | sā jñeyā vāsudevādimūrtīnāṃ kamalāsana || 22.42 caturviṃśatimūrtīnāṃ mīnādīnāṃ tathaiva ca | mudraiṣā cānyamūrtīnāṃ kathitā kamalāsana || 22.43 prasārya karajān sarvān maṇibandhau sametya tau | antaḥpraviśya cāṅguṣṭhau tayoḥ pṛṣṭhamanuspṛśet || 22.44 prasārayet padmamudrāmāsane sampradarśayet | śriyādīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ devīnāṃ caturānana || 22.45 proktā kamalamudrā sā sarvakāmaphalapradā | nibadhya dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhaṃ vāmahastasya muṣṭigam || 22.46 kṛtvā cāṅguṣṭhatarjanyau saṃyukte prasṛte same | tisras tu dakṣiṇasyānyā badhnīyān muṣṭim ūrdhvagāḥ || 22.47 śaṅkhamudreyamuditā jñānadā mokṣadācirāt | maṇibandhasamau hastau tiryak sambhrāmya ca kramāt || 22.48 paryāyeṇa prayoktavyā cakramudrā mahodayā | muṣṭiṃ kṛtvā tu hastābhyām aṅguṣṭhau vitatāv ubhau || 22.49 madhyamāṅguliyugmaṃ tu ṛjum ūrdhvaṃ prasārayet | śeṣābhiraṅgulībhis tu bandhayeyuḥ parasparam || 22.50 saṃśliṣṭau kūrparau dvau tu gadāmudreyam īritā | tarjanyagraṃ madhyamayā saṃspṛśec cāpamudrikām || 22.51 muṣṭiṃ kṛtvā vāmahastam aṅguṣṭhamṛjum ūrdhvataḥ | apasavyakareṇaiva tadaṅguṣṭhaṃ tu bandhayet || 22.52 prasārya dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhaṃ jñeyā musalamudrikā | kaniṣṭhāṅgulipūrvaṃ tu saṃhṛtyāṅguṣṭhakena tu || 22.53 nibadhya tarjanīṃ bhūyas tadagraṃ natam eva ca | khaḍgamudrā tu sā jñeyā sarvaduṣṭabhayaṅkarī || 22.54 hastābhyāṃ lambayed brahmann aṅgulyagraiḥ parasparam | bandhayed vanamālā sā aṅguṣṭhau dvau tu saṃharet || 22.55 ākhaṇḍalādidevānāṃ mudrā cāñjalisaṃjñitā | ubhau karatale pṛṣṭhau saṃśliṣṭau tu kaniṣṭhakau || 22.56 bandhayet tarjanīyugmaṃ prasaret tuṇḍavat kramāt | aṅguṣṭhau dvau pādayugmam adhastāl lambayet kramāt || 22.57 madhyamānāmikābhyāṃ tu karayor ubhayor api | pakṣavaccālanaṃ kuryāj jñeyā garuḍamudrikā || 22.58 kaniṣṭhāditrayaṃ brahman saṃhṛtyāṅguṣṭhakena ca | nibadhya tarjanīṃ bhūyo viṣvaksenasya mudrikā || 22.59 prasārya karajān sarvān viralān ūrdhvagāminaḥ | kṛtvā hastasya cāyāmaṃ tadagrān kuñcayet kramāt || 22.60 phaṇiphaṇāgrasadṛśā jñeyānantasya mudrikā | caṇḍādīnāṃ bhaven muṣṭimudraiṣā balimudrikā || 22.61 aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu tathā syād vastramudrikā | muṣṭimudrā tu muṣṭis syād aṅguṣṭhena tu veṣṭitā || 22.62 jñānamudreti vijñeyā saiva muktakaniṣṭhikā | gandhamudreti vijñeyā vimuktānāmikā ca sā || 22.63 puṣpamudreti vijñeyā vimuktā madhyamā tathā | madhyamāṅguṣṭhaśirasi saṅgatir hy agraparvaṇā || 22.64 yajñopavītamudrā syād aṅguṣṭhena kaniṣṭhikā | ākalpamudrikā jñeyā viṣṇoḥ prītikarī śubhā || 22.65 saṃhṛtāṅgulīnāṃ tu kṛtvā vyatikarāṅgulīḥ | sahaivordhvīkṛtāṅguṣṭhau karābhyāṃ dhūpamudrikā || 22.66 ūrdhvaṃ tu madhyamāṃ kṛtvā saṃhṛtyāṅguṣṭham eva ca | tarjanyanāmikābhyāṃ tu saṃhṛtya tu kaniṣṭhikām || 22.67 tenaiva vāmahastena dakṣiṇena kṛtā tu yā | dīpamudreti sā proktā devadevapriyādhikā || 22.68 anyeṣām upacārāṇāṃ mudrā syāt sā kṛtāñjaliḥ | yā cāpy ūrdhvakṛtāṅguṣṭhā śeṣābhir muṣṭibhiḥ kṛtā || 22.69 sā jñeyā pratimāmudrā , devadevapriyāvahā | uttānīkṛtya hastaṃ ca vakritāgrāṅgulibhiḥ kramāt || 22.70 aṅguṣṭhaṃ ca pṛthak kṛtvā jñeyā svāgatamudrikā | sā caiva prārthanāmudrā sā caiṣā dānamudrikā || 22.71 pañcāṅgulīnāmagraṃ tu saṃyojya kamalāsana | anvārabdhena vāmena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena ca || 22.72 nivedya paramānnādimudrā sā grāsasaṃjñitā | madhyamānāmikābhyāṃ tv aṅguṣṭhāgreṇa saṅgatiḥ || 22.73 kaniṣṭhātarjanīyugmaṃ dīrghaṃ kṛtvā yathātathā | tilavrīhiyavādīnāṃ homakarmaṇi śasyate || 22.74
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣādi pādme tantre caryāpāde mudrālakṣaṇavidhir nāma dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
mātṛkādyarthavarṇanam brahmā saṃjñābhedas tu varṇānāṃ mantroddhāraś ca kīdṛśaḥ | prayojanaṃ ca kiṃ tasya kathyatāṃ tadaśeṣataḥ || 23.1 bhagavān ahaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu sarvaṃ yathātatham | hrasvadīrghavibhāgena bhinnāḥ padmaja manmukhāt || 23.2 akārādyāḥ svarā jātāḥ kramād anye 'rdhamātṛkāḥ | kakārādyāś ca cakre te nyasya pūjyāḥ pariṣkṛte || 23.3 praśaste nirjane gupte bhūbhāge śobhane same | hastadvayena vistīrṇaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ caturaśrakam || 23.4 darpaṇodarasaṅkāśamunnatam <�saṃkāśam> caturaṅgulaiḥ | mṛdbhiḥ pidhāya suṣiraṃ gomayenopalipya ca || 23.5 prokṣya cakraṃ vidhātavyaṃ ṣoḍaśārapariṣkṛtam | nābhinemisamāyuktaṃ candanakṣodarekhayā || 23.6 tanmadhye chandasāmādirarabhūṣu svarāstathā | sparśākṣaraṃ nābhimadhye nemimadhye ca yādayaḥ || 23.7 evaṃ nyasteṣu varṇeṣu dvādaśākṣaravidyayā | ardhyādyaiḥ sakalair bhogair varṇātmānaṃ samarcayet || 23.8 cakrasaṃsthitavarṇānāṃ nāmabhedaḥ pradarśyate | udgīthaś chandasāmādiḥ praṇavastārakas tathā || 23.9 brahmā ca brahmakośaś ca vyāpī coṅkāra ity api | nāmāni prathitāny aṣṭāvakāro viṣṇur ucyate || 23.10 oṅkārādiś cāprameya ākāro madhusūdanaḥ | ādidevo gopanaś ca syād ikāras trivikramaḥ || 23.11 māyā bandhuś ca rāmaś ca kathyate tadanantaram | pañcabindur mahāmāyā vāmanaḥ smaryate tathā || 23.12 ukāro bhuvanāhvānaḥ śrīdharaś codayas tathā | ūkāraś cordhvalokeśo hṛṣīkeśo guhālayaḥ || 23.13 ṛkāra ṛtadhāmā ca padmanābhas tathocyate | rkāraḥ pīṭhanāmā syād yogī dāmodaras tathā || 23.14 lkāraḥ keśavo goptā prajñādhāro maheśvaraḥ | lkāro dīrghaghoṇaś ca nārāyaṇasamāhvayaḥ || 23.15 samprasāraṇanāmā syād ekāro mādhavāhvayaḥ | devadatto mṛgeśaḥ syād aikāro godhanaḥ smṛtaḥ || 23.16 govindo vīrasenaś ca syād okāraś caturmukha | otadeho vāsudevo brahmasādhana ity api || 23.17 aukāra auṣadhāhvāna aurvaḥ saṅkarṣaṇo manuḥ | aṃkāraḥ kapilākṣaś ca pradyumno devatā smṛtaḥ || 23.18 aḥkāraś cāniruddhāhvaḥ kalāntas sargisaṃjñitaḥ | kakāraḥ kamalo brahmā karālaś śaṅkhinaḥ smṛtaḥ || 23.19 khakāraḥ kharvadehaś ca cakrī garuḍavāhanaḥ | gadadhvaṃsī gakāraś ca gadī pañcātmakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 23.20 padmapāṇir ghakāras tu pañcātmā gajavāhanaḥ | ṅakāraś śārṅgapāṇiś ca ekadaṃṣṭraḥ kapidhvajaḥ || 23.21 vakratuṇḍaḥ khaḍgadharaś cakāraḥ pretanāyakaḥ | chakāraś chalavidhvaṃsī svacchandaḥ kuṇḍalī smṛtaḥ || 23.22 musalī janmahantāca jakāraḥ kakubhaḥ smṛtaḥ | jhakāraḥ sāmavedātmā jhaṣāśī ca suvarṇabhāḥ || 23.23 ñakāraś candradhavalaḥ pāśapāṇir bhṛguḥ smṛtaḥ | ṭakāro hṛdayāhlādī kheṭakī parvataḥ smṛtaḥ || 23.24 ṭhakāraḥ kaustubho meghī tomaro dussahaḥ smṛtaḥ | ḍakāraḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo jhaṣo bhūmir vanālayaḥ || 23.25 ḍhakāraḥ puṣpabhadraś ca dṛḍhakarmā pratardanaḥ | ṇakāro vanamālī syāt pracaṇḍas sumukhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 23.26 ekanetrastakāraḥ syād vairājo vijayaḥ smṛtaḥ | thakāras sarvarodhaś ca rasātmā supratiṣṭhitaḥ || 23.27 dakāro vaidharo dṛṣṭir tris satripurāntakaḥ | dhakāro dhanadaḥ puṇyaḥ subhago mohanāśanaḥ || 23.28 nakāro bhadrapāṇiḥ syād vighneśo mānuṣeśvaraḥ | pakāraḥ pāpahananaḥ pavitraḥ paścimānanaḥ || 23.29 phakāraḥ phullanayanaḥ śikhaṇḍī syād vikarmaṇaḥ | bakāro jṛmbhalo hrasvo matimān kālanemijit || 23.30 bhallāyudho bhakāraś ca subhadraḥ sūkṣmalocanaḥ | makāro mandaro dakṣo mādhavīpāṭalapriyaḥ || 23.31 yakāraḥ puruṣātmā syād vāyuś śaṅkhaś caturgatiḥ | repho 'nalo mahājvālo viśvātmā sarvadāhakaḥ || 23.32 lakāraḥ pītavarṇābho mahendraḥ pulahaḥ smṛtaḥ | vakāro varuṇaḥ kumbhaḥ pīyūṣātmā sudhākaraḥ || 23.33 śakāraḥ śubhado lakṣmīḥ śrīvatso vittavardhanaḥ | ṣakāraḥ krodharūpī syād ugrātmā śatrusūdanaḥ || 23.34 pūrṇacandraḥ kalātmā syāt sakāraś śuklasaṃjñitaḥ | dvādaśātmā hakāraḥ syād dīptimān bhāskaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 23.35 lakāro ḍuṇḍubho bhargo viṣkambho viṣamadhvaniḥ | kṣakāro garuḍo 'nantaḥ kūṭo narahariḥ smṛtaḥ || 23.36 anusvāro dhruvo bindur yaṣṭiś candrārdha ucyate | svāhākāro hutānnaś ca ṭeṭheti parikīrtitaḥ || 23.37 namaskāro natirvarṇasaṃjñā ity ādayaḥ smṛtāḥ | cakrasaṃsthitavarṇānāṃ devatā kathyate kramāt || 23.38 sarveṣām api varṇānām akāraḥ kāraṇaṃ yataḥ | sarvakāraṇarūpatvād viṣṇus tasyādhidevatā || 23.39 ākārasya madhudveṣī syād ikāras trivikramaḥ | īkāro vāmano devas tathokāraḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ || 23.40 ūkārasya hṛṣīkeśo varṇasya syād anantaram | padmanābha ṛkārasya devo dāmodaro bhavet || 23.41 rkāraḥ keśavo devo lkārasya ca devatā | nārāyaṇo 'dhidevaḥ syāt lkārasya caturmukha || 23.42 mādhavo 'nantarārṇasya hy asya govindo devatā bhavet | aikārasya tathārṇasya syād okārasya devatā || 23.43 vāsudevas tathārṇasya syād aukārasya devatā | saṅkarṣaṇas tathāṅkāro bhavet pradyumnadaivataḥ || 23.44 aḥkārastho 'niruddhaḥ syād devā itthaṃ kramādacām | devatāḥ kathitā brahman halāṃ samprati kathyate || 23.45 kakārasya vidhir devaḥ khakārasya sudarśanaḥ | gakārasya ghakārasya vāṇī śārṅgaś ca devatā || 23.46 ṅakārasya cakārasya devo nandaka iṣyate | chakārasya yamo devo jakārasya ca devatā || 23.47 musalī syāt jhakāras tu bhaved aṅkuśadaivataḥ | ñakārasya bhṛgur devaḥ ṭakārasya mahīdharaḥ || 23.48 meruḥ kaustubhadaivatyaḥ ṭhakāro ḍastu pārthivaḥ | ḍhakāro mātṛdaivatyo ṇakāro vanamālikaḥ || 23.49 takārasya tathā dṛṣṭisthakāro rasadaivataḥ | atrirdakārasya bhaved dhakārasya dhaneśvaraḥ || 23.50 lambodaro nakārasya pakārasya pavitrakaḥ | śikhaṇḍavān phakārasya bakārasya tu devatā || 23.51 jṛmbhalo bhākṣarasya syāt subhadro devatā tathā | dakṣo makārasya bhaved yakāro vāyudaivataḥ || 23.52 dhūmadhvajaḥ syād rephasya lakārasya divaspatiḥ | vakāro varuṇeśānaḥ śakāro mādhidaivataḥ || 23.53 krodhākāraḥ ṣakāraḥ syāt sakāraś candradaivataḥ | sahasrāṃśur hakārasya lkāro bhargadaivataḥ || 23.54 narasiṃhaḥ kṣakārasya kathitāḥ kādidevatāḥ | varṇānāṃ cakraniṣṭhānāṃ nāmāny api ca devatāḥ || 23.55 yo vetti tasya phaladā mantriṇaś caturānana | yāvato yasya varṇasya yannakṣatraṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 23.56 sa ca tāvāṃs tatra varṇāḥ kramād iha nigadyate | ādyaṃ vinā svaraṃ varṇā vādyāvāśvayujau smṛtau || 23.57 ikārasyāpi bharaṇī kṛttikātrayam uttaram | catuṣṭayam ṛkārādi rohiṇy ekam atheḍakā || 23.58 raudram apy ekavarṇaḥ syāt punar vasvordvisaṃmitam | dvayam eva tathā pauṣṇamādyantaṃ vā matāntare || 23.59 kādiṣu prathamaṃ puṣyaṃ dvayaṃ sārpaṃ dvayaṃ maghā | ekamarthamaṇaṃ yugmaṃ bhargadaivatam ucyate || 23.60 yugmam eva tu sāvitraṃ dvayam indrādhidaivatam | ekaṃ niṣṭyā viśākhe dve trayaṃ maitram anantaram || 23.61 aindram ekaṃ trayaṃ mūlaṃ pūrvamāṣāḍham ekakam | āṣāḍham uttaraṃ caikam ekam evābhijinmatam || 23.62 dvayaṃ vaiṣṇavam ekantu śraviṣṭhā śatatārakam | ekam eva triyaṃśādivarṇas syād aja ekapāt || 23.63 ahirbudhnyastrayo varṇā iti varṇeṣu tārakāḥ | ādau cauṣṭayaṃ meṣo varṇānām ṛṣabhastrikam || 23.64 tathaiva mithunaṃ yugmaṃ kulīraṃ mṛgarāṭ tathā | śiṣṭadvayaṃśādayas tu kanyā kuḥ prathamaṃ tulā || 23.65 cavargo vṛścikaścāpaḥ ṭavargaḥ sadbhir ucyate | tavargo makaraḥ kumbhaḥ pavargo 'ntyasya yādayaḥ || 23.66 nakṣatraṃ yatsādhakasya mantrasyādyakṣarasya yat | naranāryād iva tayor yogāyogau parīkṣayet || 23.67 catuṣpadaṃ likhitvorvyāṃ tatrākārādi nikṣipet | yasmin pade sādhakasya nāmādyarṇalipis tathā || 23.68 tatraiva ced bhaven mantrasyādyaṃ varṇam avasthitam | tatsiddhaṃ syād ditīye tu sādhyaṃ vidyād anantare || 23.69 pade susiddhaṃ turye tu vaiparītyāya kalpate | siddhe siddhaṃ japādyais tu sādhye sādhyaṃ susiddhake || 23.70 adhītamātre mahate phalāya bhavati dhuvam | pade tu vairiṇaḥ syāc cel lipiradhyetṛnāśanam || 23.71 ānuguṇyaṃ parīkṣeta nimittāni parīkṣya ca | sādhakas sādhayen mantraṃ devasya kuṭilā gatiḥ || 23.72 caturṣu mūlamantreṣu nānuguṇyaṃ parīkṣayet | tāram aṣṭākṣaraṃ caiva dvādaśākṣaram eva ca || 23.73 viṣṇugāyatryapi tathā catvāraḥ prathame matāḥ | dvātriṃśadakṣarādhikye mūlamantraṃ daśādhike || 23.74 bījamantrās samasteṣu pūrve vārdhakaśobhanāḥ | itare yauvane tadvat sarve bālye 'pi śobhanāḥ || 23.75 strīpunnapum iti traidhaṃ bhajante mantrajātayaḥ | saṃstyānamantrāḥ svāhāntā namo 'ntāstu napuṃsakāḥ || 23.76 śeṣāḥ puruṣamantrāḥ syur iti trividham īritam | uccāṭane ca vaśye ca vidveṣe kṣudrakarmasu || 23.77 striyaḥ praśastā abliṅgāḥ karmasv anyatra pūjitāḥ | puṃliṅgeṣu tu mantreṣu diṅmātraṃ kiñcid ucyate || 23.78 phaḍantāḥ maraṇādyarthe śāstā bhūtādyupadrave | huṅkārāntāḥ praśasyante vauṣaḍantāstu te punaḥ || 23.79 āpyāyane niyujyante dharmakāmārthamuktiṣu | caturthyantāḥ praśasyante omantāḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ || 23.80 sarvamantrāḥ sarvaphalā guruvaktrādyadhiśrutāḥ | yadṛcchayā śruto mantraś channenātha cchalena vā || 23.81 patre kṣitau vā vyarthaḥ syāt pratyutānarthakaḥ smṛtaḥ | ekas susādhito mantro japahomāditarpaṇaiḥ || 23.82 sa sādhakasya sarvārthaṃ prasūte nātra saṃśayaḥ | samyaksiddhaikamantrasya nāsādhyam iha kiṃcana || 23.83 kiṃ punar bahavo yasya kā kathā harir eva saḥ | kuśeṣu kṛṣṇakṛtau tu bṛsyāmekāntabhūmiṣu || 23.84 prāgādidiṅmukho bhūtvā na tu yāmyamukhaḥ kvacit | upaviṣṭo japen mantraṃ sapavitrakaraśśuciḥ || 23.85 dhṛtordhvapuṇḍraracano nānyāṃ vācam udīrayan | guruṃ praṇamya prathamaṃ praṇavapramukhaṃ japet || 23.86 devatāyatane nadyāṃ śaile sāgararodhasi | vane vā tīrthadeśe vā nyagrodhāśvatthayor adhaḥ || 23.87 anyatra vā śucau deśe kuṭīṃ kṛtvārabheta saḥ | anaśnan vāyubhakṣo vā yadvābbhakṣo jalāplutaḥ || 23.88 jīrṇaparṇāśanaśśākabhojano vā phalāni vā | pakvāni mūlāny athavā bhuñjāno lavaṇaṃ vinā || 23.89 yavoṣṇikālājadugdhabhikṣāhāro jitendriyaḥ | pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ praśastaṃ syād aśanīyaṃ viśodhanan || 23.90 mantrasya devatā tāratithivāreṣu sādhakaiḥ | dvādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā grahaṇe karma śasyate || 23.91 viśeṣayajanaṃ kurvan cakrābje japam ācaret | śikhī vā jaṭilo vāpi valkalājinakarpaṭaḥ || 23.92 trisandhyaṃ snānaniyatas tailābhyaṅgavivarjitaḥ | yāvad uktaṃ kṛtayuge mantrābhyasanam iṣyate || 23.93 tretādiṣu triṣu proktaṃ dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ kramāt | caturguṇaṃ paraṃ vāpi tato mantraphalecchayā || 23.94 sarvasiddhikaro mantraḥ siddhiḥ siddhyet kriyāvaśāt | kriyādhigamyate śāstrāc chāstraṃ deśikapūruṣāt || 23.95 mananaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ trāṇaṃ saṃsārasāgarāt | mananatrāṇasaṃyogān mantra ity ucyate budhaiḥ || 23.96 athavā gopanīyatvāddhetormantrayate param | rapratyāntaḥ puṃliṅgas tathāyaṃ lokavedayoḥ || 23.97 mantreṇa sthāpyate devo mantreṇaiva visṛjyate | jñānānāṃ tatparaṃ jñānaṃ mantrajñānaṃ vidur budhāh || 23.98 aihikāmuṣmikaṃ sarvaṃ mantreṇaiva prasiddhyati | chandomantrākṣare yattaddarśanād ṛṣir ucyate || 23.99 darśanaṃ ca phalasyāhur na punar mantradarśanāt | devatā mantraphaladā mantreṇa pratipāditāḥ || 23.100 bruvanti nilayaṃ kṣetraṃ tattvaṃ tattvavido viduḥ | mantrākṣarāṇāṃ śuklādimantrabhedaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 23.101 mūlamantrādimantrāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ śṛṇu sāmpratam | vidhāya yāgayogyāni puṣpamūlaphalāni ca || 23.102 śākādīni tu parṇāni varjayed itarāṇi tu | gṛhṇīyād yāni varjyāni tāni vakṣyāmi padmaja || 23.103 ugragandhāny agandhāni durgandhāni parityajet | vastrārkaparṇaspṛṣṭāni puṣpāṇy ārādhane hareḥ || 23.104 unmattaśālmalībījapūradhattūrikājapāḥ | bandhūkāsitakoraṇḍadroṇakanyāparājitāḥ || 23.105 bṛhatyagastyakūṣmāṇḍapaṭolyāragvadhais samāḥ | nirguṇḍī damayantī ca kiṃśukaṃ pāribhadrakam || 23.106 kośātakī priyālaś ca tapasvī girimallikā | nimbavyāghrīkarañjaśvīṣaṇḍapāṇḍurapaṭṭikā || 23.107 vibhītakiṅkiṇīkolalāṅgalī śaṅkhapuṣpiṇī | nāraṅganandikāvartavallikākṣīrikādiṣu || 23.108 puṣpāṇi varjanīyāni ; śākāny api tathā śṛṇu | śṛṅgāṭaṃ gṛñjanaṃ śigru nālikā suniṣaṇṇakam || 23.109 saubhāñjanaṃ raktabāṣpaṃ grāmabāṣpaṃ trikaṇṭakam | droṇapatraṃ liliṅgāṃ ca taṇḍulīyaṃ tapasvinī || 23.110 kośātakī ca varjyāni ; mūleṣu tyājyam ucyate | chatrākaṃ laśunaṃ tālaṃ phalamūle paṭolikā || 23.111 bimbakūṣmāṇḍanāraṅgamūlāni parivarjayet | bilvodumbarabodhyarkavaṭapatreṣu bhojanam || 23.112 varjayet sādhako yatnādālasyaṃ dīrghacintanam | vivādanidrānirvedanigrahānugrahāṃs tyajet || 23.113 padmākṣamālāṃ grīvāyāṃ lambayet sādhakaś śuciḥ | dhārayed raimayaṃ cakraṃ sarvavighnopaśāntaye || 23.114 japakāle 'thavā cakraśaṅkhākṛtir yathā tathā | śārṅgakhaḍgagadākāraṃ lāñchanaṃ lāñchayet sudhīḥ || 23.115 śarīrāvayave bāhvor vakṣobhuvi caturmukha | cakrādipañcabhir jñānalakṣitāṅgapariṣkṛtam || 23.116 puruṣaṃ dūrato dṛṣṭvā bhūtādyā bhayavihvalāḥ | vidravanti tathā ghorāḥ pāpā vīkṣaṇamātrataḥ || 23.117 vinaśyanti , tathā puṇyapuñjāni praviśanti ca | praṇamanti tathā devā devarṣipravarās tathā || 23.118 akṛtyam api kurvāṇo bhuñjāno vā yatas tataḥ | pāpair na lipyate dehī cakrādyāyudhalāñchitaḥ || 23.119 havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca dātavyaṃ tasmai taddānamakṣayam | avidhāya śikhābandhamakṛtvā tilakaṃ mṛdā || 23.120 adhārayaṃs tato darbhān sūtrair anupavītayan | kurvan karmāṇi na phalaṃ prāpnuyāt puruṣādhamaḥ || 23.121 namno muktaśikhābandho vāsasā cāvakuṇṭhitaḥ | gacchan śayānaḥ pralapan na japāt phalam aśnute || 23.122 japen maunaṃ samāsthāya saha sambhāṣaṇādikam | pratilomādibhir nīcair na kuryān mantravittamaḥ || 23.123 vyāhared api kāryārthaṃ nityaṃ tadgatamānasaḥ | dvādaśākṣaram anyaṃ vā japed akṣaralakṣakam || 23.124 tadardhaṃ juhuyād agnau homaśālāṃ prakalpayet | dhūmanirgamanopetāṃ caturaśrāṃ manoramām || 23.125 tanmadhye kalpayet kuṇḍamāhutyanuguṇaṃ śubham | vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā mekhalātrayasaṃyutam || 23.126 yonimanmṛtsnayā brahman mānaṃ kuṇḍasya kathyate | ayutāhutiparyante home hastapramāṇakam || 23.127 dvihastaṃ niyute kuṇḍaṃ trihastaṃ prayute tathā | śaṅkhahome caturhastaṃ mahāśaṅkhe tu ṣaṭkaram || 23.128 bṛndāhutau saptahastaṃ mahābṛnde 'ṣṭahastakam | arbude navahastaṃ syān nyarbude daśahastakam || 23.129 ekādaśakaraṃ kharve parārdhe dvādaśāyatam | trayodaśakaraṃ madhye 'ntike tu caturdaśa || 23.130 padme karāḥ pañcadaśa mahāpadme tu ṣoḍaśa | samudre viṃśatikaraṃ mahaughe dvāviṃśatiḥ smṛtā || 23.131 ito 'dhikāhutividhau caturviṃśatihastakam | prasaṅgād ucyate saṃkhyā tāṃ krameṇāvadhāraya || 23.132 ekaṃ daśaśataṃ saṃkhyā sahasram ayutaṃ tathā | niyutaṃ prayutaṃ śaṅkho mahāśaṅkhas tataḥ param || 23.133 bṛndaṃ tathā mahābṛndam arbudaṃ nyarbudaṃ tathā | kharvaṃ parārdhaṃ madhyānte padmaṃ tanmahadādikam || 23.134 padmottaraṃ samudraṃ syān mahaughaṃ cottamaṃ bhavet | ekam ārabhya gaṇayet prayutāntaṃ yathākramam || 23.135 sthānāt sthānaṃ daśaguṇaṃ vardhayet prayutāvadhi | lakṣasya niyutaṃ saṃjñā koṭiḥ prayutam ucyate || 23.136 śaṅkham ārabhya gaṇayen mahaughāntaṃ kramād yathā | śataṃ koṭisahasrāṇāṃ śaṅkhasaṃjñā nigadyate || 23.137 tathaiva syān mahāśaṅkha eva bṛndaṃ prakīrtitam | tadvad eva mahābṛndam evam evārbudaṃ smṛtam || 23.138 itthaṃ nyarbudham ākhyātam evaṃ kharvam udāhṛtam | evam eva parārdhaṃ syān madhyam itthaṃ caturmukha || 23.139 evam antaṃ tathā padmaṃ mahāpadmaṃ tathaiva ca | sāgarapralayāv evaṃ saṃkhyā nāsti tataḥ param || 23.140 yatra kāṣṭhaṃ tu tacchrotraṃ yatra dhūmas tu nāsikā | yatrālpajvalanaṃ netraṃ yatra bhasma tu tacchiraḥ || 23.141 yatra samyak sthitā darbhās tatra keśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | yatra prajvalito vahnir jihvā tatraiva kīrtitā || 23.142 agnikarṇe hutau rogo nāsikāyāṃ manovyathā | cakṣuṣor nidhanaṃ kuryāt keśe dāridcadaṃ bhavet || 23.143 hutaṃ śirasi pāpaṃ syāt tasmāj jihvāsu homayet | samidbhir yājñiyair bījaiḥ ghṛtair gavyais tathā dalaiḥ || 23.144 sumanobhis samiddhe 'gnau juhuyād agnim āvahet | āraṇyaṃ maṇijaṃ lauhaṃ kuṇḍamadhye pariṣkṛte || 23.145 yogāsanaṃ cāgnimadhye kalpayitvā hariṃ punaḥ | āvāhayet tatra devaṃ homāntaṃ tatra sannidhim || 23.146 prārthayeta samārādhya homaṃ kuryād dine dine | āhomakālamaryādaṃ rakṣed agnim atandritaḥ || 23.147 na dehatparidhīn darbhān upastīrṇānupakrame | evam uktena mārgeṇa japato mantram uttamam || 23.148 sādhakasya punaḥ svapnāḥ sambhavanty avicāritāḥ | mantrasiddhim asiddhiṃ ca sūcayantaḥ śubhāśubham || 23.149 ācāryaṃ pratimāṃ devīṃ pūjopakaraṇāni ca | vipraṃ bhāgavataṃ bhūpaṃ chatracāmaradantinaḥ || 23.150 siṃhāsanamapāṃ kumbhaṃ pūrṇaṃ kanyāṃ vadhūjanam | dīpaṃ śaṅkhaṃ tathā yānaṃ śrīvatsaṃ pādukāṃ tathā || 23.151 śvetaṃ vastraṃ ca mālyaṃ ca candanaṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca | ratnāni kāhalādīni pāyasaṃ dadhi pālikāḥ || 23.152 tāmbūlaṃ pustakaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ taṇḍulānavagāhanam | samudrataraṇaṃ śailārohaṇaṃ drumarohaṇam || 23.153 bhūmilābhaṃ mṛdāṃ lābhaṃ taṭakūpādidarśanam | prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi yātrāṃ kurvan svayaṃ yadi || 23.154 vimānadarśanaṃ viṣṇor dīptau ca śaśibhāskarau | dīptam agniṃ vedaghoṣaṃ siddhavidyādharādikam || 23.155 devatāsamitiṃ caiva paśyan mūlaphalāni ca | apūpādīni bhakṣyāṇi kuśayaṣṭiṃ kamaṇḍalum || 23.156 yajñopavītaṃ pātrāṇi sruksruvādīni lokayan | akṣamālām evamādyaiś śubhaiḥ svapnair vinirdiśet || 23.157 mantrasiddhiṃ bahumukhāṃ duḥsvapnāś cāpy aśobhanāḥ | kathyante muṇḍitais sārdhaṃ sambhāṣā sahavartanam || 23.158 svayaṃ muṇḍaś ca bibhrāṇo jīrṇaṃ nīlaṃ tathāmbaram | kanyāṃ raktāṃ tathā nīlāṃ puṣpamālāṃ ca mūrdhani || 23.159 gardabhārohaṇaṃ bhagnayānādhiṣṭhānam abjaja | chinnacchatradharo vāpi mahiṣārohaṇaṃ tathā || 23.160 dakṣiṇābhimukho gacchannuṣṭravāhādhirohaṇam | daṣṭaś ca kapibhir dehe sṛgālair vā vṛkais tathā || 23.161 karṇapādaśiraś chedo dantānāṃ patanaṃ tathā | navavastradharaḥ pīḍā bhaṭaiḥ pāśena bandhanam || 23.162 vidhavāliṅganaṃ nīcaiḥ pāṣaṇḍaiḥ pratilomajaiḥ | vartanaṃ gopurādīnāṃ patanaṃ śākhinām api || 23.163 turagārohaṇaṃ bhuktir bauddhādyālayasevanam | madirāpāyibhiḥ pāparogibhiḥ kitavaiḥ saha || 23.164 vartanaṃ dīpanirvāpaṃ devānām utsavaṃ tathā | grāmādidāho 'bhakṣyāṇāṃ phalādīnāṃ ca bhakṣaṇam || 23.165 madhūcchiṣṭaṃ praticchāyā yātrāyuddhomaṃ bhaṭaiḥ | abhyaṅgaṃ tailalābhāñ ca marīcaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā || 23.166 lokayannevamādīni svapne śāntiṃ samācaret | japahomādibhiś cittaikāgrataḥ pratyayāt tathā || 23.167 vakṣyāmi sādhakasyāgre jātānabhyudayāvahān | vyomni devagaṇānnemighoṣaṃ dundubhinisvanam || 23.168 siddhais sambhāṣaṇaṃ cāpi vimānānāṃ ca darśanam | bhūtapretapiśācādidarśanaṃ bhūtale tathā || 23.169 homakāle ca saptārcis triśikhaḥ paridṛśyate | śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśo <śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśo> dakṣiṇāvartaśobhitaḥ || 23.170 divyagandhopalambhaś ca cchatrabimbadhvajādikam | śaṅkhadundubhivīṇādi vedaghoṣaśrutiṃ punaḥ || 23.171 pūrṇāhutividhau siddhiliṅgāny etāni lokayet | sādhakas tāni liṅgāni kathayen na guruṃ vinā || 23.172 homānte bhojayed vidvān viṣṇavān dvādaśāparān | yāvac ca mantrasiddhiḥ syāt tāvad ārādhayed dharim || 23.173 kāmanānuguṇākāraṃ dārvādyaiḥ parikalpitam | dine dine japen mantraṃ juhvann agnau yathāpuram || 23.174 praṇavasya śṛṇu brahman puraścaraṇam uttamam | bījaṃ sāṅgaṃ samuddhāraṃ yathāvadavadhāraya || 23.175 aprameyādimudayaṃ madhye mandarapaścimam | samāhṛtya tryavayavaṃ trīn varṇān vācakaṃ hareḥ || 23.176 plutodāttasvaraṃ brahman cakramadhye pratiṣṭhitam | uddhared bījamasyādyaṃ pratīkaṃ daṇḍaśekharam || 23.177 vaiṣṇavaṃ daṇḍayet tveṣā śaktiḥ sarvatra kīrtitā | bījaśaktyaṅgahīnā ye mantrāḥ syus te nirarthakāḥ || 23.178 tasmāt sāṅgaṃ bījayuktaṃ śaktiyuktaṃ phalapradam | bījaṃ śaktiś ca kathitā śrūyatāmaṅga jātayaḥ || 23.179 ṛṣir brahmāsya cchandastu devī gāyatram ucyate | pratipādyaḥ paro devaḥ paramātmā sa devatā || 23.180 buddhis tattvaṃ paraṃ vyoma kṣetraṃ varṇas sitacchaviḥ | jñānaṃ balaṃ tathā vīryam aiśvaryaṃ tejasā saha || 23.181 śaktir ete caturthyantā namaḥ svāhā vaṣaṭ tathā | huṃ phaṭ vauṣaṭ kramād etad avasānāś śubhāvahāḥ || 23.182 aṅgāni hṛdayādyeṣu ṣaṭsu sthāneṣu mantriṇā | prayojyāni prayukteṣu mantraḥ sāṅgaḥ kṛto bhavet || 23.183 dehe karatale caiva sthāneṣu dvādaśasv api | dvādaśākṣaravinyāsaḥ praṇavaḥ sphaṭikaprabhaḥ || 23.184 nyāse namo 'ntaḥ svāhānto japapūjāhutiṣv api | vaśye cākarṣaṇavidhau uccāṭe huṅkṛtir bhavet || 23.185 māraṇe phaṭkṛtir jñeyā stambhavidveṣamohane | natiṃ vināṅgamanyaḥ syāt dharmādau natir eva sā || 23.186 śākayāvakabhaikṣāśī japel lakṣatrayaṃ śuciḥ | tadardhaṃ tarpaṇe saṅkhyā tadardhaṃ homakarmaṇi || 23.187 homānte siddhayas tasya jāyante yāvad īpsitam | aihikāmuṣmikaṃ sarvaṃ praṇavāllabhyate phalam || 23.188 praṇavān na paro mantraḥ kaścid asti caturmukha | śāntipuṣṭyabhicāreṣu kim anyaiḥ siddhivarṇanaiḥ || 23.189 antyakāle ca māṃ dhyātvā vyāharan praṇavākṣaram | yogābhyāsoktavidhinā jīvam ārohayed dhṛdi || 23.190 bhuvor madhye tato jīvaṃ tato brahmabilaṃ tataḥ | uccaran praṇavaṃ bhittvā bilaṃ vrahmaṇi līyate || 23.191 yāvat prāṇavinirmokam abhyaset praṇavākṣaram | sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti brahya sanātanam || 23.192 proktaḥ praṇavakalpaste samāsena caturmukha |
iti śrī pañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde mātṛkādyarthavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
dvādaśākṣarakalpaḥ śrībhagavān dvādaśākṣaramantrasya śṛṇu kalpaṃ caturmukha | mātṛkācakram abhyarcya dvādaśārṇaṃ samuddharet || 24.1 praṇavaṃ paramātmānaṃ bhadrapāṇim anantaram | viṣṇuṃ dakṣaṃ cotadehaṃ subhadraṃ gadinaṃ sudhām || 24.2 viṣṇuśīrṣaṃ trayaṃ paścād vijayaṃ samprasāraṇam | varuṇaṃ cādidevāntaṃ śuklaṃ bhuvanaśīrṣakam || 24.3 atriṃ mādhavanāmāntaṃ pīyūṣaṃ madhusūdanam | vāyuṃ tathā 'prameyāntam evam uddhāraṇa kramaḥ || 24.4 bījamasya dvādaśātmā daṇḍaśīrṣa udāhṛtaḥ | kruddho mahāṃś ca vīraś ca dyus sahasraṃ ca tejasā || 24.5 ulkāntāṣ ṣaḍime śabdāś caturthyantās svadhāntakāḥ | aṅgāni hṛdayādau syuḥ sthāne bījākṣarāṇi ca || 24.6 parasya vāsudevasya bījāṅgaṃ samudāhṛtam | dīptimānūrdhvalokānto bījaṃ daṇḍaś śiras tataḥ || 24.7 dīptimān kumbhasaṃyogo madhusūdanamastakaḥ | sa eva vāmanaśirā hṛṣīkeśaś śiras tathā || 24.8 vīrasenaśirāś cāpi kalkyastoyam anantaraḥ | ṣaṣṭhamaurvaśiraḥ proktamaṅgāni kramaśaḥ punaḥ || 24.9 natyantaṃ daṇḍaśirasaḥ sarve vibhavapūrvakāḥ | vāsudeve prayoktavyā hṛdayādiṣu ṣaṭsv api || 24.10 vyūhapūrve tu bījaṃ syād viṣṇuḥ kuṇḍādi pūrvavat | aṅgaṃ yadvā dvādaśārṇāḥ pūrveṣāṃ hṛdayādayaḥ || 24.11 ṣaṇṇāmarṇāḥ ṣaḍapare tundaguhyabhujoravaḥ | jānu pādam iti sthāneṣv ete yojyāḥ kramād budhaiḥ || 24.12 ṛṣiś ca devatā cobhe vāsudevaḥ smṛtas triṣu | chandaś ca devī gāyatrī varṇaḥ śvetaś caturmukha || 24.13 tattvaṃ buddhiḥ paraṃ vyoma kṣetraṃ mantrasya śabditam | pratyakṣaram ṛṣiś chando devatā varṇavistaraḥ || 24.14 tattvaṃ kṣetraṃ kramāt sarvam ucyate dvādaśasv api | parameṣṭhī sanandaś ca sanakaś ca prajāpatiḥ || 24.15 bhṛguḥ sanatkumāraś ca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ | marīciratryaṅgir asau kathitā ṛṣayaḥ kramāt || 24.16 chandāṃsi daivī gāyatrī mastakaṃ tu prajāpatiḥ | triṣṭup paṅktiś ca bṛhatī virāṭ baṣṭaśrivṛtsakaḥ || 24.17 uṣṇik ca śrīr iti brahman varṇeṣu dvādaśasv api | viṣṇavādyā māsapā devās tattvāni kathayāmi te || 24.18 cijjīvaḥ prakṛtir buddhir manaḥ sattvādayo guṇāḥ | vyomāgnimarutaś cāpi varṇānāṃ tattvam īritam || 24.19 kṣetrāṇi paramavyoma vāyur agnir jalaṃ tathā | satyaṃ tapo janaś caiva mahaḥ svargo bhuvas tathā || 24.20 bhūmiḥ pātālam etāni krameṇa kathitāni te | āmnādidhāmā śreyāṃsaṃ gopanāntaṃ sadaṇḍakam || 24.21 natyantaṃ pāpahananaṃ viṣṇvantaṃ vahnimatparam | śaṅkhamādyakṣaraṃ paraṃ kamalaṃ madhusūdanam || 24.22 pulahaṃ cāparaṃ vighnanāyakaṃ pītasūdanau | ekanetraṃ mandaraṃ ca viṣṇvantaṃ bhadrahastakam || 24.23 samprasāraṇamūrdhānam uddharen mantravittamaḥ | agniprākāramantro 'yaṃ kathitaḥ kamalāsana || 24.24 durgāgaṇapatis tārkṣyaḥ kṣetrapālapadāni tu | caturthyantāni natyantapraṇavādīni mantriṇā || 24.25 koṇadikṣu prayujyerannārabhyāgner diśaṃ kramāt | bhāṣyaṃ ca dvādaśārṇasya pravakṣyāmi yathātatham || 24.26 omity uktaṃ paraṃ brahma sukharūpaṃ dhruvaṃ sthiram | vyāpitvāt tasya vācyasya vācakaṃ sarvagaṃ smṛtam || 24.27 puruṣārthaparais sarvaiḥ surāsuramaharṣibhiḥ | namyate deva evaikaḥ sa evaikaḥ parāyaṇam || 24.28 ādau sṛjati bhūtāni bhūtānugrahakāmyayā | paripālanam apy eṣa karoti bahumūrtibhiḥ || 24.29 viśramārthaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ saṃharatyakhilaṃ jagat | gatir gatimatāmanyā vāsudevān na vidyate || 24.30 saṃharatyātmabhūtāni punaḥ sṛjati māyayā | deve jāgrati jāgarti supte svapiti cākhilam || 24.31 carācaram idaṃ kṛtsnaṃ bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham | dvādaśākṣaravācyo 'sau tasya māhātmyamāśritaḥ || 24.32 brahmabhūyaṃ gato brahmā devabhūyaṃ ca devatāḥ | ṛṣayaś ca marīcyādyā munayas sanakādayaḥ || 24.33 mantramāhātmyamāśritya jagmuḥ padam anuttamam | gatvā gatvā nivartante candrasūryādayo grahāḥ || 24.34 na kadāpi nivartante dvādaśākṣaracintakāḥ | kiṃ tasya yajñaiḥ kiṃ tīrthaiḥ kiṃ viśrāṇanakarmabhiḥ || 24.35 kiṃ vratair yasya mantro 'sau dvādaśākṣaralakṣaṇaḥ | sarvayatnena puruṣas tanmantranirato bhavet || 24.36 saṃsārabhayabhīrūṇāṃ mokṣaikaphalakāminām | muktaye paramopāyo mantro 'yaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥ || 24.37 devadānavagandharvayakṣavidyādharādayaḥ | praṇamanti mahātmānaṃ dvādaśākṣaracintakam || 24.38 yasya rāṣṭre mahīpasya mantriṇaḥ santi nirbhayāḥ | tadrāṣṭre dhanadhānyādi samṛddhaṃ vardhate 'dhikam || 24.39 bhūtāni ca palāyante grahāś ca na bhayaṅkarāḥ | rāṣṭrād rājapurād rājñaḥ sakāśāc ca nipīḍitāḥ || 24.40 na phalaṃ śakyate vaktuṃ kārtsnyena kamalāsana | caturmukhamukhais sarvair divyair varṣaśatair api || 24.41 śarīraśuddhaye pūrvaṃ puraścaraṇamācaret | śarīramantrasaṃskāraḥ puraścaraṇam iṣyate || 24.42 brāhmaṇāṃs tanmayān pūrvamāhūya dvādaśāvarān | bhojayitvā tataś cakramaṇḍale devam arcayet || 24.43 vijñāpya deśikaḥ pūrvamanujñātaḥ sahāyavān | āśrame yatra munibhiḥ pūrvam ācaritaṃ tapaḥ || 24.44 siddhamantraphale tatra vāsudevaniketane | paścimadvāri vānyatra pūrvoktasthānabhūmiṣu || 24.45 sthāne 'bhirucite puṣpasamitkuśaphalodakaiḥ | samupete yathoktānāṃ sampannābhimatāśanaḥ || 24.46 bhikṣānnabhoktā bhaktānāṃ tanmayānāṃ gṛheṣu vā | brahmacārī gṛhastho vā sādhayet dvādaśākṣaram || 24.47 vaikhānaso vā niyatastapasyabhirataśśuciḥ | bhikṣānnabhugbrahmacārī śākakandaphalāśanaḥ || 24.48 gṛhasthaś cet svayaṃ pakvaṃ putrair vā bhāryayāpi vā | śiṣyeṇa vā pācitānnaṃ nivedya haraye 'grataḥ || 24.49 vaiśvadevādikarmānte bhojayitvā 'tithīn api | śiṣyaṃ bhāryāṃ tathā putraṃ toṣayitvā yathātatham || 24.50 svayaṃ bhuñjīta vidhivatpaścād annamakutsayan | putradārasamāyukto japed vaikhānasaśśuciḥ || 24.51 viyuktaḥ putradārādyair athavā niyatasthitaḥ | añjasaiva svayaṃ pakvam annamadyānmitāśanaḥ || 24.52 sarveṣāṃ kāyaśuddhyarthamādau cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret | pādodakaṃ pañcagavyaṃ brahmakūrcajalaṃ tathā || 24.53 pītvā kāyaviśuddhyarthaṃ puraś caraṇam ācaret | ārambhaḥ karmaṇāṃ māsi mārgaśīrṣe 'tha śobhane || 24.54 caitre māsi site pakṣe brahmannekādaśītithau | upoṣya pūrvaṃ cakrābje pratimāyām athāpi vā || 24.55 kūṛce vā sthaṇḍile vāpi yathābhir ucite pade | dvādaśyāṃ homaparyantam arcayitvā janārdanam || 24.56 puṣpaiḥ patrair brahmacaryanirato deśakālavit | saṅkalpya kālaniyamaṃ vratādiniyamaṃ tathā || 24.57 nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnānam adhaśśayanam eva ca | śayanaṃ vā kuśe parṇe mṛgacarmaṇi vā 'bjaja || 24.58 saṅkalpya māṣaṃ tailaṃ ca kṣāraṃ ca lavaṇaṃ tathā | tilānnabhojanaṃ kāṃsye divā svāpādi varjayet || 24.59 dehaśuddhiṃ purā kṛtvā mantrajāpo 'kṣamālayā | ādyantayor bījayuktaṃ tathaiva praṇavānvitam || 24.60 japakāle japen mantraṃ na drutaṃ na vilambitam | lakṣyīkṛtyācyutaṃ dhyāyet tadadhīnamanogatiḥ || 24.61 dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvāghanāśanaṃ kamalāsana | caturbhujam udārāṅgaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || 24.62 śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśamayutendusamaprabham <�saṃkāśam�> | cāruhāsaṃ sutāmroṣṭhaṃ karṇāntāyatalocanam || 24.63 nirdhūtapadmarāgābhaṃ dantacchavisuśobhitam | mahoraskaṃ mahābāhuṃ prasannendunibhānanam || 24.64 subhrūlalāṭaṃ sumukhaṃ dhanakuñcitamūrdhajam | taṭicchatasahasrābhaṃ pītanirmalavāsasam || 24.65 pāṇipādatalāmbhojaṃ puṇḍarīkāyatekṣaṇam | śrīvatsāṅkaṃ kirīṭādisarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 24.66 padmacakragadāśaṅkhadhāriṇaṃ kaustubhorasam | divyagandhaviliptāṅgaṃ divyamālāvibhūṣitam || 24.67 śeṣāhibhoge vipule sukhāsīnaṃ caturmukha | śrībhūmisahitaṃ devaṃ lalāṭe śvetamṛtsnayā || 24.68 dhṛtordhvapuṇḍratilakaṃ maṇḍitaṃ caṇḍabhānubhiḥ | niyutair ayutaiś candraiḥ vidyutkālāgnikoṭibhiḥ || 24.69 samavetair ivaikatra tejaḥpuñjair visarpibhiḥ | bhrājamānaṃ durālokaṃ dehamaṇḍalanirgataiḥ || 24.70 bhāsayantaṃ jagat sarvaṃ dhyāyet prakṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ | ārādhya devaṃ sandhyāyāmaparasyāṃ yathāvidhi || 24.71 visṛjya punar utthāya ghautapādakaraśśuciḥ | ācamya vāgyato mantraṃ japet samyak samāhitaḥ || 24.72 yāvad brāhmamuhūrtasya prādurbhāvas tataḥ param | snātvā yathoktaṃ sandhyāyām anuṣṭhāya vidhiṃ kramāt || 24.73 ārādhya devamardhyādyair upacārair yathoditaiḥ | japen mantraṃ śarīrasya sthitiyuktaiḥ phalādibhiḥ || 24.74 dvādaśārṇaṃ japed evaṃ viśuddhenāntarātmanā | lakṣaṃ dvādaśa tasyārdhaṃ tarpaṇaṃ vāribhiḥ smṛtam || 24.75 tadardhaṃ juhuyād agnau sādhakas samidādibhiḥ | caturviṃśatilakṣeṇa mantrajāpena kiṅkarāḥ || 24.76 siddhavidyādharāḥ sarve pātāle divi vā bhuvi | yathābhirucite deśe duṣprāpe sādhakaṃ dvijam || 24.77 nayantaḥ tatra niyataṃ sevante paricāriṇaḥ | ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣajāpena devabhūyaṃ samaśnute || 24.78 aśītilakṣajāpena homais tāvan mitair vaset | maharloke sukhaṃ śaśvattatratyair abhipūjitaḥ || 24.79 koṭilakṣeṇa jāpena prāpnuyād aṇimādikān | guṇān janāhvaye loke vaset tatsthaiḥ supūjitaḥ || 24.80 mahārbudaśatenaiva japahomais tathā vaset | tapoloke mahāpadmajapahomena tāvatā || 24.81 satye vasati deveśaṃ śrībhūmisahitaṃ harim | dṛṣṭvā nirāmayas tatra vaset tallokavāsibhiḥ || 24.82 mahaughaiś śatajāpena tāvad āhutisaṃkhyayā | sākṣāt kurvan vāsudevaṃ tanmayo bhavati dhruvam || 24.83 kim ebhir bahubhiḥ proktaiḥ padaṃ yadyadabhīpsitam | tattadāpnoti puruṣaḥ samārādhanakarmabhiḥ || 24.84 vaśyākarṣaṇamukhyāni japahomādikarmabhiḥ | phalāni citrarūpāṇi darśayet sādhakaḥ svayam || 24.85 pātāle divi vā bhūmau ye bhogā bhuvi durlabhāḥ | tānavāpnoti puruṣaḥ puruṣottamapūjayā || 24.86 kāmopabhogavaimukhyaṃ mantriṇaḥ kāryam ucyate | mokṣaikaphaladaṃ dhāma dakṣiṇadvāram uttamam || 24.87 siddhāyatanamāsādya tatra daivaṃ caturvidham | manuṣyanirmitaṃ cārṣaṃ daivaṃ rūpaṃ madhudviṣaḥ || 24.88 svayaṃvyaktaṃ samārādhya mokṣakāmaḥ samāhitaḥ | sālokyādicaturbhedāṃ muktim āpnoty asaṃśayam || 24.89 sālokyaṃ mānuṣādārṣāt sāmīpyaṃ devanirmitāt | sārūpyaṃ tulyam āpnoti svayaṃvyaktād anukramāt || 24.90 prāsādadvāri cādhmāte śaṅkhe tasya mahādhvaniḥ | śrūyate yatra taṃ deśaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mānuṣālaye || 24.91 tato dviguṇamārṣe tu triguṇaṃ devanirmite | caturguṇaṃ svayaṃvyakte deśe ṛddhir anukramāt || 24.92 brahmacaryaparo bhūtvā kuśaśāyī jitendriyaḥ | mumukṣamāṇas tanmantraṃ lakṣajāpena siddhyati || 24.93 yuñjīta yogavidhinā hṛdayāmburuhāsane | karṇikāyāṃ sukhāsīnaṃ śuddhasphaṭikavarcasam || 24.94 caturbhujamudārāṅgaṃ jyotirmaṇḍalamadhyagam | aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ dhyātvā bhogair yathākramam || 24.95 abhyarcayen nirmalena manasā susamāhitaḥ | yogāmyāsabalenaiva guṇotkarṣaḥ prajāyate || 24.96 candrārkāgnimayaṃ bījaṃ ravimaṇḍalasannibham <�saṃnibham> | tataḥ sūkṣmataraṃ bimbaṃ rājamudgasamaprabham || 24.97 taṃ sarvamantrānākramya sthitaṃ vidyādvicakṣaṇaḥ | tatas tu rājikābījapramāṇaṃ cintayet kramāt || 24.98 utpādakamathānyābhir yasyānte nāda āśritaḥ | taṃ vilīya samutpannamaśvavālapramāṇakam || 24.99 yasya gacchati tadvyomni vyoma cāgacchate hṛdi | tato vicintayet sūkṣmamaśvavālapramāṇakam || 24.100 brahmanāḍīmanenāśu paśyati dhyānasevanāt | tato 'ṅgaromamātraṃ tu bījajālaṃ samantataḥ || 24.101 dhyāyen niyamamāsthāya brahmanāḍīprakāśakam | evaṃ dhyāyann imaṃ piṇḍaṃ paripakvaṃ parityajet || 24.102 parijñāya purā piṇḍaṃ pākalakṣaṇam uttamam | niruddhasandhimātraṃ ca kṛtvā dehasamīraṇam || 24.103 muktvā tadbrahmarandhreṇa utkrāntikaraṇena ca | dhyātvā parityajed dehaṃ nityābhyāsarato yadi || 24.104 sa brahma paramabhyeti vāsudevākhyamavyayam | tile tailaṃ ghṛte sarpiḥ kṣīre kṣīraṃ jale jalam || 24.105 tadvanna bhedo gṛhyeta jīvātmaparamātmanoḥ | taptalohe yathā toyaṃ līnaṃ naiva prajāyate || 24.106 agnidagdhāni bījāni na rohanti yathā punaḥ | tadvanna jāyate bhūyo jīvātmā kamalāsana || 24.107 sārūpyaṃ bhagavadrūpaprāptiḥ sadbhir udāhṛtā | sāmīpyaṃ sannidhau sevā devasya paricaryayā || 24.108 sālokyaṃ ca tadākhyātaṃ loke vaikuṇṭhasaṃjñite | tadīye nityavāso 'yaṃ punarāvṛttivarjite || 24.109 brahmā śrotum icchāmi bhagavan dehapātasya lakṣaṇam | saṃkṣepatastu bhagavan vāyor gatinirodhanam || 24.110 śrībhagavān yuktāhāravihārasya kriyāsaktasya padmaja | yuktasvapnāvabodhasya yogayuktasya sarvadā || 24.111 nivartate sadā śabdo hṛdgato dundubhisvanaḥ | sparśaṃ na śītaṃ nātyuṣṇaṃ vijānāti tvagindriyam || 24.112 bhravor madhye yadā jyotirdvādaśānte vyavasthitam | pratyastameti vai śīghraṃ na codayati vai punaḥ || 24.113 na jānāti samādhistho hārdamabjaṃ yadantare | pariśuṣyati gātrasthaṃ śoṇitaṃ śleṣmalakṣaṇam || 24.114 na vetti pārthivaṃ gandhaṃ na bāhyābhyantare tathā | piṇḍas tadā praboddhavyaḥ kālenaiva cireṇa tu || 24.115 pṛthivyāṃ saṃsthitaṃ caiva dhāraṇāyāṃ samāhitaḥ | na vetti śabdaṃ prāguktaṃ pañcamāt pañcame kṣaṇe || 24.116 sthitassamedhā bāhye tu śītoṣṇe na ca vindati | pateddinacatuṣkeṇa piṇḍaṃ tatkalitekṣaṇaḥ || 24.117 rūpadhyānaṃ samāsādya pūrvoktavidhinā yadi | na bhāti hṛdayākāśe bahir vā jyotiṣāṃ patiḥ || 24.118 piṇḍapāto hyavaśyaṃ syāt jñātvāriṣṭaiḥ puroditaiḥ | tṛtīye 'hni caturvaktra sarvam etat tadā kṣaṇe || 24.119 samādhau yadi vāyavye yogī samyak pravartate | sa vetti paramāhlādaṃ tṛṣitaḥ parikampate || 24.120 dinadvayena piṇḍasya pāto 'sya dvitayakṣaṇe | sthito gaganabhāge tu prāguktavidhinā yadi || 24.121 na vetti vidhinā gandhaṃ na bāhye ca śubhāśubham | tatraivaikadine vātha lakṣaṇe prathame kṣaṇe || 24.122 dhyātvaivaṃ vidhinā samyagyogī dhyānaikamānasaḥ | mayi saṃsthāpitamanā vyāharan dvādaśākṣaram || 24.123 svayamutkramate piṇḍādyāyādyoganiketanam | śeṣāsane sukhāsīnaṃ vaikuṇṭhe maṇimaṇḍape || 24.124 aṣṭabāhuṃ viśālākṣamaṣṭāyudhadharaṃ harim | śrībhūmisahitaṃ devaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 24.125 caturbhujaṃ vā vāmena hastenāliṅgya paṅkajām (padma?) | aṣṭau vārastriyas tasya vālavyajanapāṇayaḥ || 24.126 tiṣṭhanti paritaḥ paścāc chaṅkhādyāyudhadhāriṇaḥ | sevante puruṣās tasmād bahistiṣṭhanti mūrtayaḥ || 24.127 caturviṃśatisaṃkhyākās tato mīnādimūrtayaḥ | pakṣīndraviṣvaksenābhyāṃ kumudādigaṇais tathā || 24.128 mahābhāgavatās tatra dvādaśākṣaracintakāḥ | sevante maṇḍape nityaṃ punar āvṛttivarjitāḥ || 24.129 iha yatkarma kurvāṇā viṣṇorārādhanātmakam | mucyante yogamāsthāya puruṣāḥ paramaṃ padam || 24.130 prāpyāpi tattatkurvāṇāḥ sevante puruṣottamam | athavā piṇḍapatanaṃ vijñāya prāgudīritaiḥ || 24.131 nimittair aihikair bhogais sṛjantaḥ pṛthivīkṣitaḥ | piṇḍāntaram upāyena viśanti kamalāsana || 24.132 yena taṃ kathayāmyadya śrūyatāṃ sādaraṃ vacaḥ | paripiṇḍaṃ navaṃ śuddhaṃ madhyame vayasi sthitam || 24.133 sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ pāparogabahiṣkṛtam | brāhmaṇasya śarīraṃ vā bāhujasyāthavā tanum || 24.134 ūrdhvavaktraṃ dīrghapādam ekānte śāyayec chavam | tatpādapārśve śāyīta baddhvā yogāsanaṃ tataḥ || 24.135 abhyasyed yogam ekāgro yathāpūrvaṃ caturmukha | sajīvaṃ nābhicakrasthaṃ bhramantaṃ bhāskaraprabham || 24.136 haṃsākāraṃ valarkṣābhamiḍayā piṅgalena vā | haṃsarūpaṃ samāsthāya nirgataṃ nāsikāpuṭāt || 24.137 khagavadyāti gaganaṃ sārdhaṃ prāṇasamīraṇaiḥ | tālaṃ hastāvadhiṃ daṇḍaṃ krośaṃ yojanam eva ca || 24.138 gatvā gatvā nivartante yojanāni caturmukha | nāsikāpūṭarandhreṇa nābhicakraṃ praveśayet || 24.139 abhyasya nityamaniśaṃ yogī yogam atandritaḥ | nirgamayya svakād dehāt nāsikārandhravartmanā || 24.140 ātmānaṃ parakīyena nāsikābilavartmanā | parapiṇḍaṃ svadehasya vinipāte praveśayet || 24.141 nābhicakraṃ praviśyātha nāḍīṣu vicaret sukham | sarvatra yogī tatrastho yuñjānaḥ pūrvavat sadā || 24.142 draḍhimne tatra vapuṣaḥ tatra sthitvā ciraṃ sukham | tasyāpi pātamālocya piṇḍe 'nyatra niveśayet || 24.143 ity etat kathitaṃ brahman parapiṇḍapraveśanam | siddhaye mūlamantrasya samāsāt kathitantava || 24.144 mūlamantra iti proktaḥ sākṣād devasya vācakaḥ | prasū 'yaṃtemantralatāṃ prasūtimaṇimādikām || 24.145 kiṃ punar dharmakāmārthī siddhiṃ kamalasambhava | nāsādhyam asti mantreṇa dvādaśākṣararūpiṇā || 24.146 sarvalokeṣu sarvatra satyam etad bravīmi te | nāsmāt parataro mantro vidyate sarvakāmadaḥ || 24.147 rahasyam etat kathitaṃ mantramāhātmyamakṣayam | ayam evāṣṭamūrtīnām adhikaścaturakṣaraiḥ || 24.148 amunā ṣoḍaśārṇena caturviṃśatimūrtayaḥ | ārādhanīyā bhogaś cel labhyate durlabho mahān || 24.149 mantraṃ tantraṃ yathāpūrvam uddhṛtya dvādaśākṣaram | akṣarāṇi ca catvāri varṇacakrāt samuddharet || 24.150 guhālaye parikrāntaṃ bhāskaraṃ daṇḍaśekharam | dviṣaṭkākṣaravaccāṅgam asyāpi caturānana || 24.151 mūrtiṣv aṣṭāsu yo dhyātā ṛṣir mantrasya niścitaḥ | chandaś ca devī gāyatraṃ vāsudevo 'dhidaivatam || 24.152 adhikārṇasamaṣṭeḥ syād varṇaḥ sphaṭikasannibhaḥ | kṣetraṃ ca paramavyoma tattvadhīḥ pūrvam īritā || 24.153 śiṣṭārṇakānāṃ dyumaṇir vāsudevo nṛkesarī | manobhavaś caturṇāṃ syād adhidaivatakalpanā || 24.154 japen namo 'ntaṃ pūjāyām ubhayor homakarmaṇi | svāhāyāṃ viramedvauṣaḍantamāpyāyane tathā || 24.155 māraṇe tu phaḍantaṃ syād evam anyatra yojayet | nyāso mūrdhni lalāṭe ca dṛśoḥ śravasi ca kramāt || 24.156 nāsikāpuṭayor vaktre galakūpe tathā hṛdi | nābhideśe rahasye ca tathorvor jaṅghayor api || 24.157 kāryānurūpaṃ sṛṣṭyādinyasanaṃ sarvakarmasu | ārādhanaṃ sarvasiddhikāraṇaṃ tac ca kathyate || 24.158 tejasāṃ nidhimaṣṭāraṃ sudarśanam anuttamam | cintayitvā caturvaktraṃ pūrvasyāṃ diśi vedhasam || 24.159 saṅkarṣaṇaṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ pradyumnaṃ diśi cāppateḥ | aniruddham udīcīne koṇadikṣu śriyādayaḥ || 24.160 devyaś catastro madhye ca vāsudevaṃ jagadgurum | ardhyādibhis samārādhya mantraṃ ṣoḍaśalakṣakam || 24.161 japan hutvāgnim udakais tarpayitvā yathāvidhi | evaṃ prasādhito mantraḥ puruṣārthāṃś caturvidhān || 24.162 sādhayet puruṣārtheṣu yo yenāvāptum iṣyate | sa sarvo 'vāpyate brahman kim anyair ativistaraiḥ || 24.163 yadi brahmapade brahmann abhilāṣaḥ pravartate | brāhmī mūrtiṃ yajetāsau dhyātvānanyamanogatiḥ || 24.164 grīṣme māsi sthito bhūmyāṃ pādāṅguṣṭhena padmaja | pādam anyaṃ samuddhṛtya bāhū cotkṣipya niścalaḥ || 24.165 varṣāsu parṇaśālāyāṃ bahiśśaradi śaiśire | hemante triṣu caiteṣu vasante 'gniṣu pañcasu || 24.166 madhyastho mantrajāpaḥ syād itthaṃ syāt pratihāyanam | upāṃśupravaro 'vyaktān mānasaḥ pravaras tataḥ || 24.267 vighnanti devatās tasya tapaḥkarma suduścaram | padahāniṃ samāśaṅkya gandharvapramukhais tathā || 24.168 apsarobhir vilobhyainaṃ nṛttavāditragītibhiḥ | tasmāt sthiramatirbhūtvā japan siddhim avāpnuyāt || 24.169 pratyakṣaṃ yāti bhagavān triviṣṭapapatiḥ svayam | brahmatvaṃ vā tato 'nyadvā prayacchati mahat phalam || 24.170 mūrtīnām itarāsāṃ ca padaṃ yady abhilaṣyate | mūrtiṃ tāṃ tām abhidhyāyan japen mantraṃ ca pūrvavat || 24.171 labhate tatprasādena svaṃ svaṃ padam anuttamam | mantreṇānena mukhyena sādhakaḥ sādhayet phalam || 24.172 aihikāmuṣmikaṃ tattannātra kāryā vicāraṇā | brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vāpi vaiśyo vā japam ācaret || 24.173 jape 'dhikāro nānyasya mantrarāṭ svayam uttamaḥ ||
iti śrīpañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde dvādaśākṣarakalpo nāma caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
śrīmadaṣṭākṣaramantravaibhavaḥ brahmā aṣṭākṣarasya mantrasya mahimānam anuttamam | śuśrūṣitam atha cchandoviśeṣaṃ sarṣidaivatam || 25.1 phalaṃ tanmantrajāpasya rūpaṃ vā kīdṛśaṃ matam | devatā sādhanaṃ cāpi madanugrahakāmyayā || 25.2 bhagavān brūhi sarvam aśeṣeṇa mahyaṃ śuśrūṣave 'cyuta | aṣṭākṣarasya mantrasya phalāni na hi śakyate || 25.3 vaktuṃ varṣaśatenāpi teṣāṃ diṅmātram ucyate | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇām ekāntaphaladaṃ śubham || 25.4 siddhayo bahudhā japtur mantraṃ coditasaṃkhyayā | acintanīyo mahimā devasyeva madhudviṣaḥ || 25.5 śucau vivikte vijane sarvadoṣavivarjite | varṇacakraṃ samālikhya bhūmāvardhyādisādhanaiḥ || 25.6 abhyarcya ca yathānyāyaṃ tato varṇān samuddharet | udgīthamādau vighneśaḥ prayojyas tadanantaram || 25.7 brahmasādhanasaṃyukto mandaraḥ syād anantaram | ādidevo vrato bhadrabāhuḥ paścād udīritaḥ || 25.8 vahnirgopanasaṃvītaḥ śvasano viṣṇuśīrṣakaḥ | vanamālī tato yojyo madhusūdanasaṃyutaḥ || 25.9 praṇavādiśiro vāyur iti varṇāḥ kramoditāḥ | bījaṃ viṣṇur anusvāraḥ sāmarthyaṃ kathitaṃ punaḥ || 25.10 aṅgāni ṣaṭ dviṣaṭakasya mantrasyeva vidurbudhāḥ | chandaś ca devī gāyatrī antaryāmī muniḥ smṛtaḥ || 25.11 devo nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣād daivataṃ kṣotram īritam | paramaṃ vyoma buddhiḥ syāt tattvaṃ varṇassitas tathā || 25.12 pratyakṣaram ṛṣir brahman gautamaḥ prathamaḥ smṛtaḥ | bharadvājo viśvāmitro jamadagnir anantaram || 25.13 vasiṣṭhaḥ kāśyapaḥ paścād atriḥ kumbhasamudbhavaḥ | chandāṃsi gāyatryādīni virāḍavasitāni ca || 25.14 dharo dhruvaś ca somaś ca āpaś cāgnir jalādhipaḥ | pratyūṣaś ca prabhātaś ca devāḥ pratyakṣaraṃ tathā || 25.15 ākāśaṃ paramaṃ kṣetramakṣarasyāvasānataḥ | satyādilokāḥ sapta syuḥ prātilomyena bhūmayaḥ || 25.16 akṣarāṇāṃ pṛthivyantāḥ saptānāṃ sapta padmaja | agnir bhūr vāyur ākāśaḥ sūryo dyaur atha candramāḥ || 25.17 nakṣatrāṇi tathā rāśir ete tattvāny anukramāt | niruktamasya mantrasya kathayāmi yathātatham || 25.18 āpaḥ kvībanto vyāptyarthaḥ smaryate kartṛsādhanaḥ | okāravarṇavyatyāsaḥ syād ukāras tu padmaja || 25.19 makāravarṇavyatyāso vakārasyāpyayantvidam | antarbahiś ca tatsarvaṃ vyāpnoti tad udīryate || 25.20 athavā tantusantānavṛtter vātha bhaviṣyati | ṭeś ca lopo vakārasya prasāraṇamataḥ param || 25.21 pūrvatvaṃ copasargeṇa syād antaścād guṇaḥ kṛtaḥ | yasminnotamidaṃ sarvaṃ tad evam abhidhīyate || 25.22 avate rakṣaṇārthatvādaṭillope ca vartate | vakārasyopadhāyāś ca dvayorūṭhāgamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 25.23 guṇe ca rūpaṃ yatsarvaṃ trāyate tatparaṃ padam | abhidheyam iti proktā niruktiḥ praṇavasya sā || 25.24 namyate deva evaikas teṣām ekaṃ parāyaṇam | naro devaḥ parasstraṣṭā sargādau pāthasāmatha || 25.25 tasmān nārāṇi pāthāṃsi tāny evāyanamucyate | devasya hetoś cāmuṣmān nārāyaṇasamāhvayaḥ || 25.26 nārā vāyanamāvāsaḥ puruṣasya madhudviṣaḥ | aṇpratyayaḥ prakṛtyarthe tato vāsasamāhvayaḥ || 25.27 evaṃ mantram imaṃ labdhvā samyag gurumukhāt tataḥ | guruśuśrūṣaṇaparaḥ sarvamantrāṇi sādhayet || 25.28 brahmacarye sthito maunī medhyāhārāśano vratī | aśanīyāni medhyāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tāny api || 25.29 payoyāvakaśākāmbuphalamūlāni saktavaḥ | ādyaṃ kuśodakaṃ medhyaṃ dadhi bhikṣānnam eva ca || 25.30 sādhane mantrajāpasya śṛṇu kālaṃ yahoditam | mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi dvādaśyāṃ candravardhane || 25.31 ārādhya parayā bhaktyā nārāyaṇamananyadhīḥ | cakrābjamaṇḍale devaṃ dhyāyed evaṃ samāhitaḥ || 25.32 caturbāhumudārāṅgaṃ cakrādyāyudhasevitam | kālameghapratīkāśaṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇam || 25.33 pītāmbaradharaṃ saumyaṃ prasannendunibhānanam | cāruhāsaṃ sutāmroṣṭhaṃ ratnojjvalitakuṇḍalam || 25.34 subhrūlalāṭasumukhaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | lalāṭe tilakaṃ saumyaṃ dīpavat śvetamṛtsnayā || 25.35 sphuratkaṭakakeyūrahārakaustubhabhūṣitam | sphuradbhāskaravarṇābhaṃ śobhitaṃ vanamālayā || 25.36 pradyotanasahasrābhabhūṣaṇair api maṇḍitam | divyacandanaliptāṅgaṃ divyamālāvibhūṣitam || 25.37 śrībhūmibhyāṃ sukhāsīnaṃ svarṇasiṃhāsane śubhe | dhyātvaivaṃ devadeveśaṃ mantrajāpaparo bhavet || 25.38 sukhāsīno yathākālaṃ śucir bhūtvā samāhitaḥ | mantraṃ japej jagannāthaṃ samārādhya dine dine || 25.39 japel lakṣāṣṭakaṃ proktaṃ tadardhaṃ jalatarpaṇam | tadardhaṃ juhuyād agnau tatas siddhyati mantrarāṭ || 25.40 atha saṃsādhite mantre svapne jāgaraṇe tathā | siddhiliṅgāni mantrasya mantrī paśyati santatam || 25.41 tatas siddhena mantreṇa sādhayed dharmam uttamam | atha mantravarāt dharmasādhanaṃ yo 'bhivāñchati || 25.42 yaḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tarpaṇaṃ mantravittamaḥ | ṛṇatrayādvinirmuktiṃ sarvasmād abhivāñchati || 25.43 upoṣya sa śucir bhūtvā kumbhe cakrābjamaṇḍale | āvāhya devam ārādhya samyag ardhyādisādhanaiḥ || 25.44 gohiraṇyādibhir dravyais tilaiś caiva kuśodakaiḥ | dattair mantrajapair yuktaḥ prāpayel lokamakṣayam || 25.45 pitṝn mantraprasādena narakasthān api kṣaṇāt | ato 'nyal luptapiṇḍānāṃ pitrṇāṃ tṛptikāraṇam || 25.46 vidhiṃ vakṣyāmi kalyāṇaṃ caturvaktra yathātatham | upoṣya mantravit pūrvaṃ pūrvedyuḥ susamāhitaḥ || 25.47 pañcamyāṃ māghamāsasya maṇḍalaṃ cakrapaṅkajam | arcayitvā tatas tasya madhye devaṃ jagad gurum || 25.48 yajeta kṛsarānnena homaṃ tenaiva kalpayet | samidājyatilaiś cāpi mantreṇāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 25.49 pitrādināma saṅkīrtya tārayeti padānvitam | prācīnāvītiko bhūtvā homānte dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || 25.50 dakṣiṇāgrān kuśān bhūmāvāstīrya dhyānamāsthitaḥ | dhyātvā nārayaṇaṃ devaṃ tarpayec ca tilodakaiḥ || 25.51 tadakṣayaṃ jalaṃ dattaṃ pitrṇāṃ tṛptimāvahet | tarpayitvā sadācārān brāhmaṇān bhagavanmayān || 25.52 bhojayet ṣaḍrasopetaṃ bhojanaṃ dvādaśāvarān | dadyāt tebhyas tilānvastrān gohiraṇyādikaṃ tataḥ || 25.53 tatas savye bhuje nyasya brahmasūtraṃ samāhitaḥ | agre bhagavato darbhān dakṣiṇāgrān dharātale || 25.54 āstīrya sāgrān susamānāsīno dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | pātrasthamannaṃ dadhi ca tilāṃś ca badarīphalam || 25.55 kabalīkṛtya tān piṇḍān samān mantram udīrayan | madhuvāteti tisṛbhir ṛgbhir barhiṣi nikṣipet || 25.56 gotranāma samuccārya pitrṇāṃ secanaṃ jalaiḥ | piṇḍān pitṛbhyo mātṛbho bhrātṛbho gurave tathā || 25.57 ācāryāya tathānyebhyo bandhubhyo dhyānamāsthitaḥ | avasecanapūrvaṃ tu mantreṇānena mantravit || 25.58 piṇḍān dadyād abhidhyāyan devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim | avanejanaṃ prakurvīta punar eva vicakṣaṇaḥ || 25.59 evaṃ vidhāya vidhivadvaṇānmuktaś ca tatkṣaṇāt | vimānaṃ divyam āruhya yāti brahma sanātanam || 25.60 upavāsān bahuvidhānakṣamaḥ kartum añjasā | devaṃ cakrābjamadhyasthaṃ yajetārdhyādisādhanaiḥ || 25.61 siddhenānena manunā naivedyaiś ca caturvidhaiḥ | hutvā ghṛtena jvalane samidhāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 25.62 tanmayān bhojayed viprān dadyāc ca vibhavocitam | iṣṭvaivaṃ devadeveśaṃ vratastho nyatendriyaḥ || 25.63 cāndrāyaṇaṃ parākañca kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ tathā | saṃvatsaropavāsaṃ ca tathaikādaśyupoṣitam || 25.64 kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ śrāvaṇe ca jayantyādivrateṣv api | ekaikasyopavāsasya yaduktaṃ phalam uttamam || 25.65 tattacchataguṇaṃ vidyāt phalaṃ pūjāvidher api | yajñakarmaphalākāṅkṣī tattatphalam avāpnuyāt || 25.66 tīrthābhigamanasyāpi phalaṃ saptāhapūjanāt | pavitrārohaṇenāpi vratādiparipūraṇe || 25.67 snapane cotsave pañcakālābhigamane tathā | gopurālayasālādinirmāṇe pratimāsu ca || 25.68 kṣetrārāmataṭākādipradāne ca madhudviṣaḥ | ghṛtadīpapradāne ca yat phalaṃ tatsahasradhā || 25.69 phalatyārādhanādviṇṇornātra kāryā vicāraṇā | saṃkrāntau maṇḍale kumbhe jvalane ca madhudviṣam || 25.70 āvāhya pūjayed devaṃ paramānnaiś caturvidhaiḥ | juhuyān manunānena jvalane 'ṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 25.71 tanmayān bhojayet prītyā dadyāc caiva yathāvasu | yasya yasya ca dharmasya phalaṃ yadyad udīritam || 25.72 tasya tasya phalaṃ tattanmantrācchataguṇaṃ bhavet | ayane cottare kumbhe vahnau cakrābjamaṇḍale || 25.73 sopavāsaś śucir bhūtvā samāvāhya jagadgurum | yajeta pūrvavat paścād dhomaṃ pūrvavad ācaret || 25.74 athārthasādhanaṃ mantram abhivāñchati cennaraḥ | bhadrakaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tasminn ārādhya mantravit || 25.75 tilair bilvais tathācedhmair nimbapuṣpaiś ca taṇḍulaiḥ | campakair mallikābhiś ca mālatyā karavīrajaiḥ || 25.76 nandyāvartair yūthikābhiḥ pratyekaṃ śatasaṃkhyayā | juhvīta vidyayā vidvān saptāhaṃ caturānana || 25.77 dhanamakṣayam āpnoti mantrasyāsya prabhāvataḥ | candanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ koṣṭhaṃ rocanālaktakaṃ tathā || 25.78 ghanasāraṃ mṛgamadaṃ piṣṭvā tatkṣodavāriṇā | dhanadaṃ vilikhed bhūmau saptarātramananyadhīḥ || 25.79 yajeta gandhapramukhair nivedya ca gulaudanam | pādenākramya hṛdayaṃ dhanadasya japet tataḥ || 25.80 ayutaṃ niyutaṃ vāpi mantrarājaṃ jitendriyaḥ | dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ tadante mantravittamaḥ || 25.81 sākṣāt karoti dhanadaṃ tasmai ca dhanamakṣayam | prayacchati dhanādhyakṣairānītaṃ svāśrayāt kṣaṇāt || 25.82 māṇibhadrādibhir mantraiḥ prabhāvena caturmukha | saptāham athavā dhyānaṃ kṛtvā bhadrakamaṇḍale || 25.83 hutvāhutiṃ tadante ca kuryād brāhmaṇatarpaṇam | dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devam ātmānaṃ sādhakottamaḥ || 25.84 paśyan mahītalaṃ śuddhamagrahārād bahiḥ sthitaḥ | bhavanti cāsya nidhayaḥ pratyakṣā bahavas tathā || 25.85 añjanāñjitacakṣur vā mantreṇānena mantravit | nidhīn paśyati duṣprāpānabhīṣṭāṃs tatkṣaṇād asau || 25.86 bhadrake maṇḍale pūrvam iṣṭvā devaṃ janārdanam | yajñadāruṃ vṛṣaskandhe baddhvā tasmin halaṃ punaḥ || 25.87 karṣayed bhūtalaṃ śuddhaṃ sitāsu maṇikāñcanam | mahadāpnoty abhipretam athavā kamalāsana || 25.88 valmīkasya tathābhyarṇe kṛtvā bhadrakamaṇḍalam | yajeta pūrvavad devam ante valmīkabhūmiṣu || 25.89 nālikerajalais sārdhaṃ piṣṭaṃ nāgabaliṃ kṣipet | khātvā valmīkadhiṣṇyantaṃ tatra paśyen mahaddhanam || 25.90 khanitraṃ kṣālayitvā tu niśāyām adhivāsayet | maṇḍale svastike devam iṣṭvā hutvā tathāhutīḥ || 25.91 aṣṭottaraśataṃ bhūyaḥ prātarnikṣipya bhūtale | śucau khanet khanitreṇa labhate sumahaddhanam || 25.92 sādhitaṃ pāradaṃ kṛtvā haste japtvā manuṃ punaḥ | niyutaṃ prayutaṃ vāpi yathāśakti samāhitaḥ || 25.93 taddravasparśamātreṇa sarvaṃ kāñcanatāmiyāt | pāṣāṇam athavā loṣṭamagnitaptaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 25.94 auṣadhāni ca sarvāṇi rasayuktāni padmaja | lohasaṃsparśayuktāni suvate kanakaṃ mahat || 25.95 itthaṃ dhanavatāṃ kāmasamudrāntaḥ kaḥ pravartate | tatprāptaye vidhāyābjamaṇḍalaṃ tatra saṃsmaret || 25.96 mantreśam arcayitvāgre yathāpūrvamananyadhīḥ | juhuyāc ca yathoktena mārgeṇa dinasaptakam || 25.97 padmarāgarucaṃ devaṃ smṛtvā mantraṃ japet sudhīḥ | pūrvoktasaṃkhyayā strīṇāṃ bhogaṃ cecchati durlabham || 25.98 cintayitvā phalaṃ homakarmaṇyavasite tataḥ | arbhāṣṭasādhakaṃ sarvāḥ prārthayante varastriyaḥ || 25.99 yāvaj jīvaṃ na tyajanti kāmārtā mantravittamam | kanyākāmaḥ phalaiḥ pakvaiḥ puṣpair lājair dine dine || 25.100 sahasraṃ juhuyād devam ārādhya garuḍadhvajam | labhate kanyakām iṣṭāṃ tadante na vicāraṇā || 25.101 yantraṃ vaśyakaraṃ vakṣye śrūyatāṃ tadyathātatham | bhūrjapatre likhec cakram aṣṭāraṃ rocanādikaiḥ || 25.102 candanadvayakāśmīraśaśikastūrikānvitaiḥ | hemasūcyā likhed etair gandhadravyais tathāparaiḥ || 25.103 nābhinemiyutaṃ cakram aṣṭāraṃ jvālayānvitam | aṣṭasvareṣu vilikhedakṣarāṇyaṣṭa padmaja || 25.104 prādakṣiṇyena vispaṣṭaṃ hrīṅkāraṃ madhyame pade | sādhyanāmāpi tatraiva soṅkāraṃ tadanantaram || 25.105 huṅkāraṃ nābhivalaye dikṣv aṣṭāsu samarpayet | hrīṅkāraṃ nemivalaye vaśīkaraṇamakṣaram || 25.106 tathaivāśāsu sarvāsu vaśaṃ kuru padānvitam | tasminn āvāhya deveśam iṣṭvā mantraṃ japet tataḥ || 25.107 aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu juhuyāt tāvad āhutīḥ | gulikāṃ bibhratas tasya vaśyaṃ sarvam anantaram || 25.108 athavā pādayoḥ pāṃsūn raktacandanamiśritān | ādāya puruṣākāraṃ strīrūpaṃ vā yathepsitam || 25.109 kṛtvā pratikṛtiṃ tasminnātmānaṃ saṃsmared dharim | tāḍayen mūlamanunā raktais tu hayamārajaiḥ || 25.110 pratyahaṃ mantrajāpaḥ syād aṣṭottarasahasrakam | vaśyā nārī pumānvāpi saptāhānte japād bhavet || 25.111 yāvaj jīvaṃ dhanair dattair ātmanā vā yathepsitam | tilataṇḍuladūrvāṇām ayutāhutibhiḥ kramāt || 25.112 brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśo vaśyā mantraprabhāvataḥ | apāmārgasamidbhir vā homādvaiśyānvaśaṃ nayet || 25.113 audumbarasamidbhir vā palāśasamidhāpi vā | homena brāhmaṇā vaśyāḥ pūrvoktāhutisaṃkhyayā || 25.114 tribhir madhurasaiḥ siktair apāmārgasamicchataiḥ | daśabhir juhuyād agnau rājā vaśyaḥ kṣaṇād bhavet || 25.115 aśvatthaiḥ khādirair vāpi vaśīkaraṇam īritam | vaṭavṛkṣasamitsaṅgharvaiśyās sarve vaśīkṛtāḥ || 25.116 śūdras tu plakṣasamidhāmāhutyā svavaśaḥ kṣaṇāt | gandhadravyasamāyuktamṛtsnayā tilakaṃ dadhat || 25.117 dṛṣṭamātreṇa janatāṃ vaśaṃ nayati mantravit | dhyātvā karatale candraṃ tanmadhye viṣṭhitaṃ harim || 25.118 sukhāsīnaṃ puṇḍarīkakarṇikāyāṃ sitaprabham | dhyāyan karatalasparśaiḥ sarvaṃ vaśyaṃ kṣaṇād bhavet || 25.119 bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ tathā peyaṃ phalaṃ vā puṣpam eva vā | spṛṣṭvā sahasrajāpena dattaṃ sarvaṃ vaśaṃ nayet || 25.120 ākarṣaṇavidhiṃ vakṣye taṃ brahmannavadhāraya | bhūrjapatre likhec cakram aṣṭāraṃ pūrvavartmanā || 25.121 gandhadravyair likhen mantraṃ hemasūcyā vicakṣaṇaḥ | veṣṭayed rukmasūtreṇa tadyantram abhimantritam || 25.122 śikhipiñchapuṭe nyastaṃ bhāvayitvā japet tataḥ | tannāmasaṃyutaṃ mantraṃ kruddhyannākarṣayeti ca || 25.123 yuktaṃ sahasraṃ saptāhaṃ japet pratidinaṃ sudhīḥ | ātmānaṃ garuḍārūḍhaṃ sāyudhāṣṭabhujaṃ harim || 25.124 bandhūkapuṣpasadṛśaṃ bhāvayitvā jitendriyaḥ | vāmotsaṅge harer devīṃ niṣaṇṇāṃ kāmavihvalām || 25.125 pāśāṅkuśadharāṃ lakṣmīṃ dhyātvā ca tadanantaram | nṛpaṃ baddhvā gale pāśaiḥ tāḍayitvāṅkuśādibhiḥ || 25.126 āyudhaiḥ pṛṣṭhato mantramākarṣayapadānvitam | japtvāyutaṃ saptadinaṃ yojanānāṃ śate sthitam || 25.127 api bhūpaṃ nayatyāśu sādhako mantratejasā | dhanena mahatā yuktāḥ svayam evāgatā nṛpāḥ || 25.128 vaśyā bhavanti kṛtvaivaṃ viprādīn api cānayet | yoṣidākarṣaṇe cāpi kṛtvaivaṃ karma mantravit || 25.129 pañcabāṇeṣubhir viddhāṃ sarvāṅgeṣu striyaṃ smaret | pāśabaddhāṃ tathaivānyair āyudhais tāḍitāṃ bhṛśam || 25.130 kṣipramekāṃ nayennārīṃ saptāhāccharavegavat | dūrasthitām api tathā rājño vā mahiṣīm api || 25.131 sā sannidhatte kāmārtā madavihvalalocanā | samṛddhārthātmanā vāpi dhanair vāpi yathepsitaiḥ || 25.132 sādhakaṃ toṣayatyeṣā mantrajāpādyathoditāt | mṛtanārīkapāle vā rocanādyena vastunā || 25.133 pūrvavac cakramālikhya tanmadhye 'bhīṣṭayoṣitaḥ | likhitvā nāmadheyaṃ tatkapāle jvalane punaḥ || 25.134 tāpayitvā japen mantraṃ saptāhaṃ pūrvasakhyayā | tatas sidhyati nārī sā dūrasthāpi yathepsitā || 25.135 yakṣāṇām atha yakṣīṇāṃ sādhanaṃ śṛṇu kathyate | vaṭavṛkṣe kuṭīṃ kṛtvā tatra cakrābjamaṇḍale || 25.136 ārādhya devaṃ juhuyād vaṭavṛkṣasamicchataiḥ | daśabhiḥ pratyahaṃ mantrī saptāhe pariniṣṭhite || 25.137 pūrvam eva vaṭe yakṣaṃ yakṣīṃ vā kuṅkumādibhiḥ | likhitvā karma tatsarvaṃ kuryād abhimukhe svayam || 25.138 saptame 'hri vaṭe rātrau kampite 'bhītavat sthitaḥ | gugguluṃ ghṛtamiśraṃ ca dhūpayen mantravittamaḥ || 25.139 vaṭābhimukhamutthāya yakṣīṃ vā yakṣamevavā | sākṣāt karoti tāṃ taṃ vā yācetābhīṣṭam uttamam || 25.140 mātṛtvaṃ vā svasṛtvaṃ vā bhrātṛtvaṃ vā yathātatham | pitṛtvaṃ vātha bhāryātvam īpsitaṃ sarvam āpnuyāt || 25.141 prayacchati yathāyogaṃ yakṣī yakṣaś ca mantriṇe | mātā cen mātṛvadrakṣet pitā cet pitṛvat tathā || 25.142 evaṃ bhrātrādayo 'py anye yathāsvatrāṇatatparāḥ | vidyādharavaśīkāre vidhānam aparaṃ śṛṇu || 25.143 aśokavṛkṣamūlorvyāṃ kuryāt pūjādi pūrvavat | vidyādhareṇa yacchakyaṃ kartum asyāpi tadbhavet || 25.144 anyeṣāṃ devayonīnām evaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi | te te sarvaṃ prayacchanti mantratuṣṭā yathātatham || 25.145 pātālasādhanaṃ cāpi śṛṇu guhyaṃ yathātatham | homāvasānaṃ pūjādi karma kṛtvā yathoditam || 25.146 biladvārasamīpe tu lakṣam aṣṭākṣaraṃ japet | kṣīravṛkṣaśamīdūrvātilādyānāmananyadhīḥ || 25.147 pratyekam ayutaṃ homaṃ kuryādvau sādhakottamaḥ | nirgacchati bilāt tasmāt kāmārtā kanyakā svayam || 25.148 sahasraparivāreṇa sārdhamāyatalocanā | gṛhītvā mantriṇaṃ sveṣu mandireṣu yathāsukham || 25.149 ramate divyabhogais sā vicitrair atimānuṣaiḥ | pātāladvārapārśve tu kārayed yāgamaṇḍapam || 25.150 dhvajatoraṇasaṃyuktaṃ dvārakumbhopaśobhitam | cakrābjaṃ vartayet tatra dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 25.151 yajeta pūrvavaddhomaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktasaṃkhyayā | aṣṭalakṣaṃ mitāhāro jitendriyo ananyadhīḥ || 25.152 tatkṣaṇād eva nāgendrakanyakā mantriṇaḥ puraḥ | sthitā manobhavavaśā sahasraiḥ parivāritāḥ || 25.153 ātmatulyābhir anyābhiḥ kanyakābhir vaśīkṛtāḥ | gṛhītvā mantriṇaṃ tāś ca nāgālayapurottame || 25.154 praviśya vividhair bhogair vaśīkurvanti mantriṇam | pītvā rasāyanaṃ cāpi yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 25.155 ramate bhīrubhis sārdhaṃ divi devapatir yathā | khaḍgasādhanamāścaryaṃ vakṣyate tadyathātatham || 25.156 dehajaṃ lohitaṃ mantrī śmaśānāṅgāramiśritam | peṣayitvā lipet khaḍgaṃ catustālāyataṃ śubham || 25.157 śmaśānadeśe tanmūlaṃ spṛṣṭvā mantraṃ japet sudhīḥ | niśīthe nirjane tāvad yāvaj jvālāṃ vimuñcati || 25.158 jvālābhir asya śobhante diśo daśa caturmukha | nānāvidhāni bhūtāni bhavanti bhayahetavaḥ || 25.159 abhīto niścalo mantraṃ japed evaṃ samāhitaḥ | sphurantaṃ pāṇinā khaḍgaṃ gṛhītvā dṛḍhamuṣṭinā || 25.160 mantraṃ japannabho yāti yatra vidyādharādayaḥ | vidyāmahimnā teṣāṃ sa rājā bhavati mantravit || 25.161 yakṣarākṣasadaityānāṃ jetā martyeṣu kiṃ punaḥ | khaḍgahastaḥ sadā mantraṃ japan yāti triviṣṭapam || 25.162 tatrāpi bhogamutalaṃ labhate cāpsarogaṇaiḥ | khaḍgaṃ vātha samādāya parṇaiḥ pippalasambhavaiḥ || 25.163 antarhitaṃ vidhāyāśu niyutaṃ japam ācaret | samidājyais tathā bījair juhuyād ayutāvaram || 26.164 nararaktaṃ gajamadaṃ pittamārkṣaṃ vimiśritam | rājāvartena taiḥ khaḍgaṃ vilipyārādhayed dharim || 26.165 tasmin pūrvoktamārgeṇa khaḍgaṃ spṛṣṭvā japaḥ smṛtaḥ | aṣṭottarasahasreṇa paścāt tāpādisambhavaḥ || 25.166 tāpe syād adhamā siddhir madhyamā dhūmajanmani | uttamā jvalane dṛṣṭe paścāt khaḍgadharaḥ svayam || 25.167 cared abhīpsitān lokān bhogāṃś cāpnoti puṣkalān | śaṅkhaśuktyudare mantraṃ likhed gorocanāmbubhiḥ || 25.168 japen mantravaraṃ spṛṣṭvā yāvaj jvālāvalokanam | samutthitā ca tanmadhye kanyā sarvavarapradā || 25.169 tilakaṃ cākṣamālāṃ ca gulikāñjanapādukāḥ | divyauṣadhaṃ rasendrañca kapālasthaṃ rasāñjanam || 25.170 dadāti sarvaṃ sā kanyā mantriṇe mantravaibhavāt | tilakaṃ bibhratas tasya naranārīmṛgādikam || 25.171 smṛtimātreṇa purato dṛṣṭaṃ bhavati tad dhruvam | tayākṣamālayā japtaḥ puraścaraṇavarjitaḥ || 25.172 mantro yathepsitān kāmān tasmai śīghraṃ prayacchati | nidhāya gulikāmāsye nirbhayaḥ sarvaviṣṭape || 25.173 caratyeṣa yathākāmaṃ dīrghamāyuś ca vindati | añjanenāktanayanaḥ syād adṛśyaḥ surāsuraiḥ || 25.174 pādukāsparśamātreṇa cārayatyanale jale | dūraṃ vā gamayec chīghraṃ yaṃ yaṃ deśamabhīpsati || 25.175 divyauṣadhena bhuktena durvyādhir naśyati kṣaṇāt | acikitsyo 'pi kuṣṭhādir nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 25.176 pāṣāṇādi rasendreṇa spṛṣṭam agnau pratāpitam | hiraṇyaṃ bhavati brahman pītvā cāpi rasāyanam || 25.177 balavān api tejasvī valīpalitavarjitaḥ | kapālāgnau ca nikṣipya śatrumūrdhani nikṣipet || 25.178 ucchvāsito vā mriyate sānvavāyas suhṛjjanaḥ | darśayannindrajālaṃ cen māyāṃ devīṃ likhed bhuvi || 25.179 kṛṣṇāṃ caturbhujāṃ saumyāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām | sarvāṅgasundarīṃ mantrī pūjayitvā japet tataḥ || 25.180 ayutaṃ niyutaṃ vāpi mantram aṣṭākṣarāhvayam | siddhiḥ karasthā sā devī caturaṅgabalaṃ mahat || 25.181 bhūmau vyomni balaṃ sarvamudyatādāyudhamadbhutam | darśayitvāśu mantreṇa mantriṇe mantrasiddhidā || 25.182 trailokyam api sarvaṃ sā pradarśayati toṣitā | gulikā kathyate brahmannirmāṇamadhunocyate || 25.183 manaśśilā tathā kuṣṭhaṃ haritālaṃ ca kuṅkumam | gorocanāñca cakrāṅgaṃ sarvaṃ piṣṭvā madhutrikaiḥ || 25.184 kṛtvā ca gulikāṃ cakrapadmamadhye niveśayet | ekādaśīniśāyāṃ vā yajeta harim avyayam || 25.185 dvādaśyām arcayitvā ca japen mantraṃ yathāpuram | homam agnau prakurvīta sahasraṃ sarpiṣā tataḥ || 25.186 siddheyaṃ gulikā sarvaṃ sādhayet sādhakasya hi | vetālasādhanaṃ brahman kathayāmi yathātatham || 25.187 brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ vāpi yuvānaṃ nirvraṇaṃ mṛtam | tatkṣaṇād eva saṅgṛhya śūnyāgāre niveśayet || 25.188 kṣālayitvā malaṃ sarvaṃ cakrapadme niveśya tam | hṛdayaṃ tasya cākramya pādena dhyānamāsthitaḥ || 25.189 japen mantraṃ divārātraṃ niśīthe kampate śavaḥ | nirbhayastāḍayed dehaṃ siddhārthair abhimantritaiḥ || 25.190 kampamānaṃ śarīraṃ tadutthāyāgre 'vatiṣṭhate | kiṃ karomīti ca tato mantriṇaṃ sampuṭāñjaliḥ || 25.191 bruvāṇo mantriṇe tasmai prayacchati yathepsitam | khaḍgam iṣṭaṃ tathā divyamauṣadhaṃ ca rasāyanam || 25.192 gulikāṃ pāduke siddhaṃ rasaṃ veṇupuṭe sthitam | pādalepaṃ cākṣasūtram anyad vā durlabhaṃ nṛbhiḥ || 25.193 pādalepena gamanamākāśeṣu sumantriṇaḥ | khaḍgena śatrusainyānāṃ vadhaḥ kesariṇām api || 25.194 divyauṣadhānāṃ sarveṣāṃ phalaṃ pūrvam udīritam | āmayānām apasmāramukhānāṃ śāntaye vidhiḥ || 25.195 bhūbhāge śalyarahite kṛtvā maṇṭapamāditaḥ | nirvraṇān lakṣaṇopetān kalaśān pañcaviṃśatim || 25.196 pūritān droṇamātreṇa sarpirādyena vastunā | sasūtrān sakuśāṃś caiva sāpidhānān savastrakān || 25.197 dvārakumbhāṃś caturdikṣu toraṇāni ca kalpayet | pratyekaṃ kalaśān sarvān mantreṇaivābhimantrayet || 25.198 aṣṭākṣareṇa pratyekam aṣṭottaraśatāvaram | niśāmbunā candanena śvetadūrvāṅkureṇa ca || 25.199 bhūr japatrodare padmam aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam | nābhinemiyutaṃ cakram aṣṭāraṃ kamalādbahiḥ || 25.200 praṇavaṃ karṇikādeśe sādhyanāma ca madhyataḥ | aṣṭākṣarāṇy aṣṭadale nābhau sparśākṣaraṃ likhet || 25.201 nemikṣetre yakārādīnaṣṭāreṣu svarān punaḥ | mahāmāyāgnisaṃyuktaṃ bhāskaraṃ daṇḍaśekharam || 25.202 nemibhāge kramād dikṣu vidikṣu caturānana | kṛtvaivaṃ sitasūtreṇa pariveṣṭya nirantaram || 25.203 gulikāṃ taṇḍuladroṇamadhyasthe kalaśe kṣipet | āvāhya hṛdayāt tasmin mantreśaṃ cakrapaṅkaje || 25.204 candanādyais sitair vastraiḥ puṣpair anyaiś catādṛśaiḥ | śālyodanena ca hariṃ yajeta susamāhitaḥ || 25.205 pūrṇendumaṇḍalāntaḥsthamudgirantaṃ sudhārasam | śaśāṅkaśatasaṅkāśaṃ dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 25.206 śāntiṃ prayaccha mahatīmityante samudīrayet | śaśino diśi vṛtte 'tha kuṇḍe śrīrājyataṇḍulaiḥ || 25.207 gugguluṃ kṣaudrabījāṃś ca saptāhaṃ homam ācaret | pūrvoktasaṃkhyayā kumbhaiḥ sthāpitairāmayāvinam
