|| 25.208 snāpayen mūlamantreṇa dhyāyec caiva janārdanam | pūrṇenduśatasaṅkāśaṃ <�saṃkāśaṃ> syandamānaṃ sudhārasam || 25.209 tadīyapādakamalāt sarvato vyādhipīḍitam | praviśya brahmarandhreṇa plāvayantamananyadhīḥ || 25.210 dhyātvā japen mūlavidyāṃ mantravid vyādhipīḍitam | utthāpayati tanmūrdhni nyasya tāṃ gulikāmadhaḥ || 25.211 apasmārādayas sarve śāmyanti manutejasā | athādāya ca mṛtpātraṃ paittalaṃ vātha kāṣṭhajam || 25.212 tasmin nikṣipya pīyūṣaṃ dadhisarpis samanvitam | odanaṃ caityavṛkṣādimūle bhūtabaliṃ kṣipet || 25.213 bhojayed brāhmaṇānante dadyāt tebhyo yathāvasu | pauṣṭiṃ vakṣyāmi te karma maṇḍapādi yathāpuram || 25.214 bhūrjapatre likhed yantraṃ prāgvat padmādisaṃyutam | śrībhūmimantraṃ ca likhet kesareṣu daleṣu ca || 25.215 gulikāṃ veṣṭitāṃ raktasūtrair madhughaṭe kṣipet | vidrumābhaṃ ca mantreśaṃ samāvāhya ca sarvagam || 25.216 saumyāśāyāṃ padmakuṇḍaṃ kalaśān raktavāsasaḥ | vastu sarvaṃ yathoktaṃ tadyuktaṃ syāt sati sambhave || 25.217 balikarma ca kartavyaṃ karmānte kamalāsana | mahatī vṛṣṭir eva syāt kṛte karmaṇi śāntike || 25.218 āyuṣkāmastu dūrvābhir ghṛtāktābhir yathoditam | juhuyān maṇḍapādīnāṃ vidhānaṃ pūrvavartmanā || 25.219 karmānte kalaśaiḥ snānaṃ sādhyasya kamalāsana | evaṃ kṛte yathāśāstraṃ āyurvindati puṣkalam || 25.220 ārogyakāmassāvitre maṇḍale harim arcayet | rukmābhaṃ vidyayā 'rdhyādisādhanairuktavartmanā || 25.221 pūrvavajjapahomādi homo gugguluvastubhiḥ | japānte praṇamennityamaṅgair aṣṭābhir ātmavān || 25.222 yāvad āyuṣyamārogyaṃ labhate mantravaibhavāt | jvaritasya bhavec chāntiramṛtācūtapallavaiḥ || 25.223 pūrvoktena vidhānena sarvam anyad yathoditam | jvaraśāntir bhaved ante vidyāvīryaprabhāvataḥ || 25.224 candanādidrumair lohair yadvā pratikṛtiḥ kṛtā | pūjitā pūrvavat sarvān kāmānāśu prayacchati || 25.225 homaś ca karmānuguṇair dravyaiḥ syāt kamalāsana | aśvatthaṃ mandavāreṣu spṛṣṭvā dakṣiṇapāṇinā || 25.226 japato nāpamṛtyuḥ syāt pūrvam īritasaṃkhyayā | ghṛtamiśraṃ vacācūrṇaṃ yadvā brāhmīṃ ghṛtāplutām || 25.227 jyotiṣmatīrasaṃ vāpi spṛṣṭvā lakṣaṃ japan pibet | muhūrte śobhane prāpte vāksiddhis tasya niścitā || 25.228 audumbare 'thavā pātre kapilājyaṃ catuṣpalam | miśraṃ śvetavacācūrṇaṃ yadvā candremaghāyute || 25.229 puṇye sārasvate yoge śvetavarṇaṃ caturbhujam | śvetapadme sukhāsīna candramaṇḍalamadhyagam || 25.230 iṣṭvā devaṃ goghṛtena juhuyāc ca yathāvidhi | spṛśan srucaṃ sruvaṃ paścāl labhate vācam uttamām || 25.231 aṣṭabāhuṃ candranibhamātmānaṃ śeṣaviṣṭare | sukhāsīnaṃ bhāvayitvā kaupīnaṃ prativādinam || 25.232 pidhāya jihvāṃ hṛdayaṃ musalena śiro 'ṅkuśaiḥ | tāḍayed gadayā pṛṣṭhaṃ pāśair baddhvā kalebaram || 25.233 tasyaiva jihvāmadhye ca māhendraṃ daṇḍaśekharam | vinyasya stambhayed vācam evaṃ dhyāyanvicakṣaṇaḥ || 25.234 ātmano vādinaś caiva madhye yavanikā bhavet | mantraṃ śataguṇaṃ japtvā vādī vācaṃ samutsṛjet || 25.235 sadyaḥ parasyāpajayo vijayaś cātmano bhavet | stambhane naiva doṣaḥ syād bāhyaś cotprativādinaḥ || 25.236 brahmavarcasakāmaś cet samidho brahmavṛkṣajāḥ | śvetapaṅkajahomo vā rājyakāmasya mantriṇaḥ || 25.237 samidho raktavarṇāḥ syur bilvapuṣpāṇi padmaja | lakṣmīṃ sumanaso vāpi yadvā bodhisamudbhavām || 25.238 candramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ śvetapaṅkajaviṣṭare | sthitaṃ dvihastaṃ subhagaṃ bālabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam || 25.239 bālāvasthaṃ prasannenduvarcasaṃ nīlakuntalam | rājataṃ pātramannena pāyasena prapūritam || 25.240 bibhrāṇaṃ vāmahastena dadhyannakabalaṃ punaḥ | didhānam itareṇāpi dhyātvā devaṃ samāhitaḥ || 25.241 annena juhuyād agnau bahvannaṃ samavāpnuyāt | gokāmo gomayaiḥ kṣīrais tadīyair homam ācaret || 25.242 labhate dhenukaṃ sadyo mantravinmantravaibhavāt | bhūmikāmo mṛdā homaṃ durlabhāṃ labhate bhuvam || 25.243 phalair bilvasamudbhūtair homādrāṣṭrasamudbhavaḥ | vastrakāmas sumanasāṃ kālajānāṃ caturmukha || 25.244 sitāsitādivarṇānāṃ homānniyutasaṃkhyayā | nānāvidhāni vastrāṇi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 25.245 yadyatkāmayate mantrī dhānyajātamanekadhā | tattaddhomena tatsarvaṃ labhate mantravaibhavāt || 25.246 mantrākṣarair mantritaṃ bījamuptaṃ bahuphalaṃ bhavet | putrakāmo haviṣyāśī samārādhya jagadgurum || 25.247 cakrābjamaṇḍale kumbhasthāpanādi vidhāya ca | yathāpūrvaṃ pāyasānnaṃ homānte sthāpitair ghaṭaiḥ || 25.248 abhiṣicya tadambhāṃsi pāyayet striyamāgatām | sā putrān labhate tv iṣṭān bahūn vidyāvicakṣaṇān || 25.249 iṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ cakrābje proktavartmanā | anugrahe nigrahe ca sarveṣāṃ śaktimān bhavet || 25.250 kampane vasudhādīnāṃ parvatānāṃ ca bhedane | śoṣaṇe vā samudrāṇāṃ sarpāṇāṃ stambhane 'pi ca || 25.251 sargasthitivināśānām api kartā yathā hariḥ | dhyānāc ca devadevasya japānmantrasya ca kṣaṇāt || 25.252 naśyanti bhūtavetālapramukhāni caturmukha | duṣṭasatvāni mantrasya prabhāvānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 25.253 viṣadaṣṭamavasthāpya dhyātvā ca garuḍadhvrajam | devaṃ vidyāṃ samuccārya tīkṣṇatuṇḍena tāḍayet || 25.254 garuḍasya ca pakṣābhyāṃ viṣad aṣṭasya mūrdhani | evaṃ dhyātvā viṣaṃ sarvaṃ vyapohyotthāpayen mṛtam || 25.255 bhuktaṃ viṣeṇa saṃsṛṣṭam annaṃ bījaṃ phalaṃ tathā | jarayed vidyayā sadyaḥ sarvadoṣaṃ ca nāśayet || 25.256 akṣayaścābhivṛddhiś ca dhanasya yadi kāṅkṣataḥ | saṃspṛśya vidyayā sarvaṃ nikṣiped vahujaptayā || 25.257 bandhūkakusumaprakhyamātmānaṃ bhagavanmayam | dhyāyan yāvātsabhāṃ tatra kruddhaśśāmyati bhūmipaḥ || 25.258 anuktās siddhayaḥ sarvāḥ sidhyanty atyantavistṛtāḥ | śāstre mantraprabhāvena devabhūyaṃ prapadyate || 25.259 vṛṣṭikāmo bahiś śālāṃ pūrvoktavidhinā kṛtām | cakrābjamaṇḍalādīni kṛtvā karmāṇi pūrvavat || 25.260 saptāhamājyasiktābhiḥ samidbhir juhuyāt sudhīḥ | vaitasībhiḥ pratidinaṃ niyutāyutasaṃkhyayā || 25.261 vṛṣṭir bhavati tadrāṣṭre taddeśe vā dinatraye | marīcikṣuṇṇasaṃmiśraiḥ sarṣapaiḥ rājasarṣapaiḥ || 25.262 pūrvoktasaṃkhyayā homādativṛṣṭiś ca śāmyati | devatādipadaprepsur vidyayā lokam īpsitam || 25.263 svargādyabhīṣṭalokasya mahimānuguṇair japaiḥ | labhate tattadāścaryaṃ phalaṃ naivātra saṃśayaḥ || 25.264 cintāratnaṃ tathaivānyamaṇimādiguṇaṃ padam | lipsur mantrajapaiḥ koṭisaṃkhyaiḥ prāpnoti mantravit || 25.265 mantrādhidaivataṃ devaṃ draṣṭukāmo jitendriyaḥ | ṣaṇmāsān mantramaniśaṃ japet taddhyānamāsthitaḥ || 25.266 āgatya devadeveśaḥ pratyakṣo bhavati kṣaṇāt | varāṃś ca durlabhāṃs tasmai pradadāti yathepsitān || 25.267 mantriṇe mantramāhātmyādacireṇa caturmukha | mantrāntarāṇāṃ yā siddhiḥ kalpe samīritā || 25.268 sāpi prasiddhyed asyaiva sakalā vīryavattayā | ṣaḍaṅgāni ca vedāś ca mantrāś cānye paraśśatāḥ || 25.269 anyac ca vāṅmayaṃ sarvaṃ mantre 'smin susamāhitam | apunarbhavalipsūnāṃ gatir aṣṭākṣaraṃ matam || 25.270 janmany asminn atīte vā yadenaḥ sañcitaṃ mahat | tanmantrajāpamātreṇa pralayaṃ yāti niścayam || 25.271 mriyamāṇaś śucir bhūtvā mantram etad udīrayan | prāpnoti vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ duṣprāpamavinaśvaram || 25.272 kiṃ tasya bahubhir mantraiḥ kiṃ tasya bahubhiḥ śrutaiḥ | yasyaiṣā vaśamāpannā vidyā sarvārthasādhanī || 25.273 ye mantramāhātmyam idaṃ śṛṇvanti ca paṭhanti ca | teṣām api phalāny āhuḥ pūrvoktāni manīṣiṇaḥ || 25.274 caturmukhaś caturvaktraiḥ phalāny asya pradarśayan | nāntaṃ jagāma vistīrṇaṃ saṃkṣepo 'yam udīritaḥ || 25.275
iti śrīpañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde śrīmadaṣṭākṣaramantravaibhavo nāma pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
viṣṇugāyatryādimantroddhāraḥ śrībhagavān gāyatrīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ brahmaṃś caturviṃśatyakṣarātmikām | śṛṇu vakṣyāmi paramaṃ rahasyaṃ kathyate 'dhunā || 26.1 mātṛkācakram abhyarcya chandasāmādim uddharet | ādidevaś śiraś cātra vighneśaṃ tadanantaram || 26.2 vahnyantaṃ gopanaṃ pañcaśākhaṃ viṣṇuśiraḥ smṛtam | sumukhaṃ gopanayutam anyac ca marudādimat || 26.3 māyāśritaṃ sudhādhāma vaidharo 'nvak ca mandaram | viṣṇuśīrṣo bhāskaro 'tha mādhavādhiṣṭhitaḥ kramāt || 26.4 ādidevasamākrāntaḥ kumbhaśuklodayāvahau | vaidharo devatāntaś ca pīyūṣarucirāśirāḥ || 26.5 anilaḥ praṇavādyanto mahāmāyāśirāḥ kramāt | dhanado 'nu tato dakṣo viṣṇumūrdhā 'tha bhāskaraḥ || 26.6 māyāśirāś ca vairājo viṣṇvanto bhadrapāṇiyuk | otadehaḥ paraḥ kumbhaḥ trivikramaparaḥ smṛtaḥ || 26.7 krodhanaṃ vanamālyantaṃ taddvayaṃ bhuvanāvadhi | visargaḥ pāpahantā ca vahniścādyarṇasaṃyutaḥ || 26.8 cakāraś cotadehaś ca dvau dṛṣṭir viṣṇumūrdhagaḥ | daraś ca gopanaś cobhau vijayorṇas samuddhṛtaḥ || 26.9 chandaś ca devī gāyatram ṛṣir brahmādhidaivatam | viṣṇuṣṣaḍaṅgāni tathā kruddholkādīni padmaja || 26.10 mūrdhādipādaparyantamakṣaranyasanaṃ matam | mūrdhni phāle nayanayor nāsikāpuṭayos tathā || 26.11 śrotrayorāsyagalayor hṛdaye bāhumūlayoḥ | nyāsaḥ kūrparayoś caiva tathaiva maṇibandhayoḥ || 26.12 hastayoḥ kukṣimadhye ca guhye corvoś ca jaṅghayoḥ | pādayoś ca kramād evaṃ nyāsaḥ proktaś caturmukha || 26.13 pītaṃ raktaṃ ca dhūmrābhaṃ śvetaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca lohitam | valarkṣaṃ pītakaṃ raktaṃ śyāmaṃ śaṅkhanibhaṃ tathā || 26.14 pāṭalaṃ sphaṭikābhaṃ ca pītaṃ rajatasannibham | candradīdhitisaṅkāśaṃ <�saṃkāśaṃ> padmakiñjalkasannibham <�saṃnibham> || 26.15 tārābhaṃ bandhujīvābhaṃ nakṣatrābhaṃ ca pāṭalam | japākusumasaṅkāśaṃ taptajāmbūnadaprabham || 26.16 raviprabhaṃ ca varṇānāṃ varṇabhedaḥ pradarśitaḥ | kālamedhanibhaṃ saumyaṃ caturbāhuṃ kirīṭinam || 26.17 śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ garuḍārūḍham acyutam | evaṃ dhyātvā 'rcayed devaṃ prātaḥkāle samāhitaḥ || 26.18 sphaṭikopalasaṅkāśaṃ garuḍārūḍhavigraham | madhyandine 'rcayitvā tam ācarej japamātmavān || 26.19 pradoṣeṣu caturhastaṃ vainateyoparisthitam | śyāmalaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ dhyāyan mantram udīrayet || 26.20 kurvaṃstriṣavaṇasnānaṃ vratasthaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ | caturviṃśatilakṣeṇa mantrajāpena sidhyati || 26.21 mantravit sādhako vāritarpaṇaṃ homakarma ca | kurvannāpnoti sakalāṃ siddhimiṣṭāṃ sudurlabhām || 26.22 gomūtrayāvakāhāro japel lakṣamatandritaḥ | pātakebhyo mahadbhyo 'pi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 26.23 brahmakūrcaṃ piban lakṣatrayaṃ mantraṃ japan sudhīḥ | tatsamebhyaḥ pātakebhyo vimukto mantravittamaḥ || 26.24 brahmādidevatāḥ sarvā ninīṣurvaśamātmanaḥ | aṇimādi phalaṃ prepsuḥ tathaivākarṣaṇodyataḥ || 26.25 vaśīkāre ca sarveṣāṃ pātālagamane tathā | gandharvayakṣapramukhān pramukhānātmanaḥ sadā || 26.26 cikīrṣuraṣṭākṣaravadanutiṣṭhec caturmukha | sakṛduccārayanmantraṃ viṣṇugāyatrisaṃjñitam || 26.27 vedānāmasakṛt sarvaśākhādhyayanapuṇyabhāk | keśakīṭādiduṣṭāni havīṣi dhyānamāsthitaḥ || 26.28 spṛṣṭvā japen mantram idaṃ sadyaś śuddhāni padmaja | caturṇāṃ mūlamantrāṇāṃ phalam etena sidhyati || 26.29 śrīkaraṃ mantram aparaṃ vakṣye sarvārthasādhanam | aṣṭākṣaraṃ caturvaktrai rahasyaṃ paramaṃ śṛṇu || 26.30 varṇacakraṃ likhitvādau samyag abhyarcya tatpunaḥ | uddharec chrīkarāṣṭārṇaṃ mantraṃ mantraprabhāvavit || 26.31 ādau samuddharet tāramudayaṃ tadanantaram | dvirekanetramāyāntaṃ krodhanaṃ kaustubhākṣaram || 26.32 viṣṇuśīrṣaṃ tato lakṣmīmanalaṃ tadanantaram | mahāmāyāyutaṃ padmamaprameyam anantaram || 26.33 agnimādiṃ caturvaktra ṭhaṭheti śrīkarāhvayam | bījamasya pravakṣyāmi yathātattvam udīryate || 26.34 dīptimānanalaḥ pañcabindūrardhenduniṣṭhitaḥ | bījamaṅgāni ṣaṭ cāpi kruddholkādīni pūrvavat || 26.35 chandaś ca devī gāyatraṃ ṛṣir asya prajāpatiḥ | devatā devadeveśaḥ pratyarṇaṃ pūrvavat smṛtaḥ || 26.36 ṛṣiś chando daivataṃ ca dhyānaṃ samprati kathyate | kalpakānokahacchāyāmāśritya sukhaśītalām || 26.37 garuḍasya caturbāhos sarvālaṅkāradhāriṇaḥ | skandhadeśe sukhāsīnamaṣṭabāhuṃ kirīṭinam || 26.38 kundendudhavalaṃ saumyaṃ sarvākalpapariṣkṛtam | divyagandhaviliptāṅgaṃ divyamālāvibhūṣitam || 26.39 pītāmbaradharaṃ nīlakuntalair upaśobhitam | cakraṃ ca musalaṃ bāṇamaṅkuśaṃ dadhataṃ bhujaiḥ || 26.40 caturbhir dakṣiṇair anyaiḥ śaṅkhaṃ kaumodakīṃ tathā | śārṅgaṃ pāśaṃ ca kalyāṇaiḥ prasannendunibhānanam || 26.41 garuḍo 'pi ca hastābhyām ubhābhyāṃ pādapaṅkaje | devasya dhārayan kumbhaṃ pūrṇaṃ pīyūṣavāriṇā || 26.42 itarābhyāṃ ca bāhubhyāṃ spṛśannāste sthitaṃ tathā | śriyaṃ ca vāmorutale rukmābhāṃ kṣaumavāsasīm || 26.43 divyagandhaviliptāṅgāṃ sarvākalpapariṣkṛtām | subhrūlalāṭamakuṭāṃ karṇaviśrāntalocanām || 26.44 lāvaṇyāmṛtatoyena varṣantīm iva sarvataḥ | pāśāṅkuśadharāṃ lakṣmīṃ kandarpaśarapīḍitām || 26.45 dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayitvā tu vratasthas saṃyatendriyaḥ | dvādaśāhaṃ japen mantraṃ dhyātvā pārśve nidhidvayam || 26.46 ūrdhvabāhur jale tiṣṭhannurodadhne samāhitaḥ | ādityābhimukho mantrī juhuyāc ca samicchatam || 26.47 bilvodbhavais tathā lakṣmīṃ kusumaiḥ pāyasodanaiḥ | śuddhodanair ghṛtāktaiś ca aṣṭottarasahasrakam || 26.48 evaṃ kṛte vidhānena puṣṭir utpadyate 'calā | pauṣṭikādi ca pūrvoktaṃ phalaṃ pūrvoktasaṃkhyayā || 26.49 śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ karma mantreṇānena sādhayet | lakṣmīnārāyaṇāhvānaṃ mantraṃ paramadurlabham || 26.50 tasyoddharaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu varṇakrameṇa tam | udgīthaṃ manujeśānaṃ viṣṇuṃ mandarapotavat || 26.51 sūkṣmadṛṅmukhyam aparaṃ gadinaṃ kumbhamarpitam | ādyantaṃ vijayaṃ dattaṃ māhendraṃ cāprameyakam || 26.52 garuḍaṃ dakṣam aparaṃ mahāmāyāṃ vināyakam | ādidevaṃ tato vahniṃ gopanaṃ ca caturgatim || 26.53 ādyaṃ pracaṇḍamākāraṃ śaṅkhamādiṃ ṭhaṭheti ca | uddhṛtya ṣoḍaśārṇaṃ taṃ mantrabījaṃ ca kathyate || 26.54 dyumaṇiṃ bindumaparaṃ vāmanaṃ bindum uddharet | aṅgāni pūrvamuktāni chando gāyatramucyate || 26.55 viddhi śukro munirdevo lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | japaṣṣoḍaśalakṣaṃ tu tadardhaṃ vāritarpaṇam || 26.56 homastadardho mantrasya phalāny āhur yathākramam | saṅkarṣaṇādimūrtīnāṃ tisṛṇāṃ manur ucyate || 26.57 āditaḥ pūrvavat saptavarṇānāmānupūrvaśaḥ | uddhāraśśiṣṭavarṇānāṃ brahman samprati kathyate || 26.58 dīptimānvahniraurvaś ca dhruvaśuklas tathādimān | binduḥ prajāpatiś cādyo vahnirugro mukhaṃ tataḥ || 26.59 sumukhaṃ gopanayutaṃ vāyurādyaṃ ṭhaṭhāntimam | dvādaśārṇātmako mantro bījamaṅgaṃ ca pūrvavat || 26.60 chandaś ca devī gāyatraṃ ṛṣiḥ syān nīlalohitaḥ | devaḥ saṅkarṣaṇo varṇo devatātattvanirṇayaḥ || 26.61 dvādaśākṣaravajjñeyaḥ puraścaraṇamīritam | phalāni pūrvamuktāni vāksiddhirmahatī bhavet || 26.62 jñānaṃ ca mahad āpnoti yac cānyad adhikāṅkṣitam | tatsarvam acirād eva sidhyen mantraprabhāvataḥ || 26.63 śaṅkhagokṣīradhavalaṃ caturbāhuṃ kirīṭinam | vasānaṃ vāsaḥkṣaumaṃ ca pūrṇacandranibhānanam || 26.64 muktābhūyiṣṭhamākalpaṃ sauvarṇamatiśobhanam | dadhānaṃ mukhyahastena jñānamudrāsamanvitam || 26.65 pustakaṃ vāmahastena bibhrāṇaṃ bhujayor dvayoḥ | ūrdhvayoḥ sphāṭikaṃ śaṅkhamakṣamālāṃ yathātatham || 26.66 dhavalaiḥ kālajaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śobhitaṃ vanamālayā | śvetapadme sukhāsīnam evaṃ dhyāyīta mantravit || 26.67 dhyāyato buddhir amalā bhaved jñānaṃ ca puṣkalam | śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ karma kuryād etena padmaja || 26.68 bahunā kiṃ pralāpena dviṣaṭkākṣaravatphalam | sarvam āpnoti manunā sādhakaḥ kamalāsana || 26.69 pradyumnamantramadhunā sarvakāmaphalapradam | bravīmi tasya coddhāraḥ kathyate 'kṣaraśaḥkramāt || 26.70 āditaḥ saptavarṇānām uddhāraḥ pūrvam īritaḥ | asyāsādhāraṇārṇānāṃ sampratyuddhāra ucyate || 26.71 pāpmānamanalaṃ viṣṇumantraṃ vāyumukāravat | mandaraṃ bhadrapāṇiṃ ca madhusūdanamārutau || 26.72 āgneyī daśa caikaṃ cāpyarṇas saṃhanana matam | anusvāraparo viṣṇurbījamaṅgāni pūrvavat || 26.73 ṛṣiḥ sanatkumārasyāc chando gāyatramucyate | pradyumno devatā mantraḥ sādhanaṃ phalam eva ca || 26.74 pūrvoktaṃ mantram aparam aniruddham ataḥ param | śṛṇu brahmanyathāpūrvaṃ saptārṇānām anukramāt || 26.75 uddhāraḥ pariśiṣṭānāmarṇānāṃ kathyate 'dhunā | praṇavādyo bhadrahasto māyā saptārcireva ca || 26.76 udayau dvau ca subhagau gopano vāyurādimān | bījamasyāprameyaś ca visargaś cāvasānataḥ || 26.77 ṛṣiś ca sanakaś chandaḥ pūṛvavad devatā tathā | aniruddho dvādaśārṇaḥ krameṇa samudīritaḥ || 26.78 yathāpuraṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni sādhanaṃ phalam eva ca | caturviṃśatimūrtīnāṃ samākhyā dvādaśādibhiḥ || 26.79 prasiddhāstāś caturthyantāḥ saptākṣarapuraskṛtāḥ | mantrabījāni caiteṣāṃ ādyarṇāḥ praṇavādayaḥ || 26.80 binduśīrṣāś caturvyūhanāmnā uddhāra īritaḥ | aṣṭānām itarāsāṃ ca mūrtīnāṃ ca samāhvayāḥ || 26.81 caturthyantās saptavarṇā pūrvā mantrāḥ samīritāḥ | nṛsiṃho 'dhokṣajaś cobhāvacyutaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 26.82 janārdanas tathopendro hariḥ kṛṣṇa udīritaḥ | bījānyādyakṣarāṇy eṣāṃ aṅgāni ca yathāpuram || 26.83 chandaś ca devī gāyatraṃ devatā ca caturmukha | ṛṣayo mūrtayas tāstāḥ puraścaryā ca pūrvavat || 26.84 uktamevaphalaṃ caiṣāmaihikāmuṣmikātmakam |
iti śrīpañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde viṣṇugāyatryādimantroddhāro nāma ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
matsyādimūrtimantrakathamam śrībhagavān matsyādidaśamūrtīnām avatārakramānmanuḥ | ucyate pūrvavac cakramakṣarāṇāṃ samālikhet || 27.1 sādhāraṇān gṛhītvā 'rṇān yathāpūrvaṃ caturmukha | asādhāraṇarūpaṃ tatsampratyuddhriyate <�uddhriyate> kramāt || 27.2 sparśāntamādyaṃ vijayaṃ candramanvakcaturgatim | ādimagniṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ pavitraṃ madhusūdanam || 27.3 śvasanaṃ cāprameyaṃ ca dvādaśārṇāḥ samīritāḥ | mādhavaṃ puruṣātmānaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ ca bindumat || 27.4 bījamaṅgeṣu yadrūpamasādhāraṇamucyate | sparśāntamādiṃ sarvatra ṣaṭsu cādyaś ca bindumān || 27.5 ādidevaṃ mahāmāyāṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ ca gopanam | viṣṇumaurvīṃ ṣaḍaṅgeṣu madhyamārṇaṃ kramoditam || 27.6 uddhṛtyaivaṃ prayoktavyaṃ ṛṣirasya manuḥ smṛtaḥ | chandaś ca devī gāyatraṃ matsyarūpaḥ paraḥ pumān || 27.7 devatā rūparahitaḥ pañcārṇo vā manuḥ smṛtaḥ | bījaṃ tadaṅgāni tathā sādhanaṃ ca yathāpuram || 27.8 mūrter anantarāyāstu manvarṇoddhāraṇaṃ śṛṇu | asādhāraṇarūpasya sparśanādi guhālayam || 27.9 analaṃ mandaraṃ viṣṇuṃ pūrvavad dvādaśākṣaram | bījoddhāraḥ kroḍarūpī bhūdharaś ca guhālayaḥ || 27.10 sānusvāro bījam etat ṣaḍaṅgāni caturmukha | ṛṣir etasya dūrvāsāśchandaḥ pūrvavad iṣyate || 27.11 devatā kamaṭhākāro devaḥ sampratyanantaram | varāhavapuṣo mantraṃ varṇacakrāt samuddharet || 27.12 varuṇo viṣṇuranalaś cādidevaś ca bhāskaraḥ | gopanaḥ puruṣātmā ca viṣṇur ete samuddhṛtāḥ || 27.13 asyā 'sādhāraṇā varṇāḥ proktās sādhāraṇāḥ purā | ekādaśākṣarātmāyaṃ bījaṃ samprati kathyate || 27.14 sūkṣmadṛgbinduparyantaḥ ṣaṭcācāmaṅgapaddhatiḥ | bījam eva muniś śaṅkhaś chando gāyatram īritam || 27.15 nārāyaṇo devatāsya natyantaś ca ṣaḍakṣaraḥ | yadvā pūrvavad evāṅgaṃ bījaṃ ca kamalāsana || 27.16 trayodaśārṇān uddhṛtya pūrvoktān vyāhṛtitrayam | uddharet patiśabdaṃ caturthyantam anantaram || 27.17 bhūmeḥ patitvamāśāsye me dehi tadanantaram | dāpayeti ṭhaṭhāntaḥ syād dvātriṃśadvarṇasantatiḥ || 27.18 chando 'nuṣṭupū ṛṣiḥ pūrvo devatā sā caturmukha | bījamuktaṃ tadaṅgāni bhaṅktvā mantraṃ prakalpayet || 27.19 varṇān kanakasaṅkāśān nyased aṅgeṣu pūrvavat | dhyātvā ṣoḍaśalakṣāṇi japen mantramatandritaḥ || 27.20 urvarāyāḥ patissadyo bhaven mantraprabhāvataḥ | pātālagamanādīni phalāny asyāpi padmaja || 27.21 catuṣṣaṣṭyarṇasaṃghāto mālāmantraḥ pradṛśyate | trayodaśārṇāḥ prathamam ekadaṃṣṭrapadaṃ tataḥ || 27.22 caturthyantaṃ tathā meghapadaṃ dviḥ procya ca kramāt | ulkāvarṇapadadvandvaṃ caturthyantaṃ tataḥ paraṃ || 27.23 chandomayaḥpratyayāntaṃ sambuddhyantam udīrayet | dvirloḍanto dahirvācyo hantiś ca mathir eva ca || 27.24 paciñca mahadādyantaṃ bhaumeti padayor yugam | huṃ dvir uccāryāriśiraḥsvaṃ tathaiva [khaniṃ] punaḥ || 27.25 loḍantamāyamāgnīyīmiti mantrapadasthitiḥ | bījamuktaṃ tadaṅgāni bhaṅktvā mantraṃ prayojayet || 27.26 jāmadagnyo muniḥ proktaś chando 'ticchanda īritaḥ | devatā devadeveśaḥ sthūlaghoṇavapuḥ smṛtaḥ || 27.27 lakṣaṃ japed imaṃ mantraṃ bhūmikāmaś caturmukha | mṛtsnayā juhuyāt tāvad yāvad āpnoti medinīm || 27.28 aṣṭākṣaramanostulyaphalo 'yaṃ manur īritaḥ | ulkāvarṇaṃ caturthyantamakṣarasyāvasānataḥ || 27.29 catuṣṣaṣṭiprabhedasya mantrasya nṛharer mayā | na vistāraḥ kathayituṃ śakyate boddhum eva vā || 27.30 tasmāt tricaturo bhedāḥ kathyante kamalāsana | varṇacakrādayoddhāraḥ sampratyekākṣarātmanaḥ || 27.31 mantrasya kathyate brahman brahmakośapurasskṛtaḥ | nṛsiṃhakarṣaṇo bindur ity ekākṣaram īritam || 27.32 etad eva bhavec chando devī gāyatramucyate | devo muniś ca durvāsā nṛsiṃho devatā matā || 27.33 varṇaś ca pāṭalo lakṣatrayaṃ japyaṃ vipaścitā | jigīṣuṇā caturvargaphalam anyac ca kāṅkṣitam || 27.34 triyakṣarañca natyantam etad evāṅgam apy ataḥ | aṣṭākṣarātmano 'syaiva mantrasyoddhāraṇaṃ kramāt || 27.35 praṇavo natiranvak ca vighneśo madhusūdanaḥ | analaścādirinduś ca rāmo 'nusvāra eva ca || 27.36 gopatirgopanaś śaṅkho viṣṇur aṣṭākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ | bījamuktaṃ tadaṅgāni munir vyāso 'nyad īritam || 27.37 japasaṃkhyā phalāny asya tathaiva kamalāsana | saptākṣaraṃ ca natyantam anyat praṇavavarjitam || 27.38 bījādi pūrvavat sarvaṃ pañcāṅgo japa eva ca | sādhāraṇāḥ saptavarṇāḥ pañcāsādhāraṇās tathā || 27.39 pūrvoktadvādaśārṇātmā śaṅkhodarasamāhvayaḥ | yathāpūrvaṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni bījaṃ caiva yathāpuram || 27.40 pratyakṣaraṃ lakṣajapo homastarpaṇam eva ca | puruṣārthasya sarvasya sādhakas sādhvanuṣṭhitaḥ || 27.41 mantro nṛsiṃhavapuṣo dvātriṃśārṇātmako 'paraḥ | vakṣyate tasya varṇānām uddhāraḥ saṃpradarśyate || 27.42 chandasāmādirudayo gadī vahniracāṃ mukham | yaṣṭiḥ kumbho mahāmāyā jvalano vaiṣṇavas tathā || 27.43 sparśāntaṃ dviracāmādi dvādaśātmā ca gopanaḥ | parjanyo bindurugrātmā pracaṇḍaś codayas tathā || 27.44 mandaro janmahantā ca pīyūṣātmā sa vaiṣṇavaḥ | mahendro vāṅmukhaṃ padmapāṇir vijayasaṃjñitaḥ || 27.45 ardhacandrākṛtiś śuklaḥ praṇavādir vibhāvasuḥ | varuṇaś cāprameyaś ca vairājo brahmasādhanaḥ || 27.46 sparśāntamudayaṃ sparśadvitīyaṃ viṣṇudaivatam | mādhavaṃ bhadrapāṇiś ca padmanābhaḥ kalātmakaḥ || 27.47 trivikramo dhruvaḥ pūṣā svarādir mandaraḥ smṛtaḥ | bhallāyudho mahāmāyā krodharūpī ca vaiṣṇavaḥ || 27.48 vanamālī svarādiś ca mādhavaḥ sūkṣmalocanaḥ | aprameyo [vai] dharaś ca jvalanoṅkārasaṃyutaḥ || 27.49 dvirmandaraḥ padmanābho vijayaś ca caturbhuja | udayo mandaraśirāḥ padam etad anantaram || 27.50 varṇānisu samīkṛtya namāmy aham udīrayet | virāḍṛṣiranuṣṭup ca cchando narahariḥ smṛtaḥ || 27.51 devatā bījamasyoktaṃ mantraṃ bhaṅktvā 'ṅgakalpanā | nyāsaś cāṅgeṣu pūrvoktakrameṇa kamalāsana || 27.52 dhyāyet sphaṭikavarṇābhaṃ japasaṃkhyā ca pūrvavat | mantro 'yaṃ nārasiṃhasya sakalāpannivāraṇaḥ || 27.53 samastasampajjanano vācyo naiva ca kasyacit | ucyate narasiṃhasya mālāmantraś caturmukha || 27.54 adhikaṃ saptadaśabhir varṇair arṇaśatatrayam | prathamaṃ chandasāmādir natiś ca tadanantaram || 27.55 caturthyantaṃ padaṃ vācyaṃ nārasiṃheti mantriṇā | tad eva ca mahatpūrvaṃ devadānavapūrvakam || 27.56 śoṇitetipadaṃ paścād digdhapūrvaṃ nakhottaram | padam ekaṃ caturthyantaṃ namo 'ntaṃ samudīrayet || 27.57 paca graheti ca padaṃ śuṣirṇyantaḥ samuddhṛtaḥ | grathniṃ ṇijanto hantiṃ ca santiloddhṛdhamodayaḥ || 27.58 huṃ phaṭ tadantaraṃ procya tathā kalipadaṃ tataḥ | careti ca lupety uktvā kṣareti tadanantaram || 27.59 hāṃ hoṃ khara ciraṃ caiva drūṃnhyoṃ jvalanam eva ca | jvaliśśucirdravispheṭirṇyantā loṇmadhyamodayaḥ || 27.60 bhidicchidistaṃ vikaro loṇmadhyamaśirās tataḥ | hisimṛjbhyāṃ ṇijantābhyāṃ loṇmadhyamam udīrayet || 27.61 [āṃ]pūrvo nayatirloṭi humphaḍantam udīritam | dravadraveti ca tato vipūrvaṃ taddvayaṃ punaḥ || 27.62 pātālāntaṃ sarvaśabdaṃ vāsināmiti paścimam | hṛdayādīni kathayet kṛṣirṇyantaś ca madhyame || 27.63 āṅpūrvo vidviṣirṇyanto loṭi sambuddhiśīrṣakam | bhagavatpadamurccāya nārāyaṇapadaṃ tataḥ || 27.64 vāsudevahṛṣīkeśapadadvitayam īrayet | dānavādiḍantaś [dānavādirlaḍantaś] ca jahi rākṣasapūrvakam || 27.65 antaketi padaṃ paścād uktvā kaumodakī dhanuḥ | dhareti garuḍādiṃ ca dhvajāntaṃ pamabjaja [padamabjaja] || 27.66 tripūrvadhāmannityetannatirastv iti te padam | tvāṃ prapanno 'smīti paṭhedevamuccāryate manuḥ || 27.67 bījamuktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni procyante padaśo 'dhunā | praṇavādiś ca natyantaś ca caturthyantaś ca vigrahaḥ || 27.68 puruṣādimukhādiś ca narasiṃhapadaṃ tathā | vajraśabdaṃ dviruccārya kramāc ca nakhavigrahau || 27.69 vajreti nakhadaṃṣṭreti coktvā ''yudhapadaṃ tataḥ | mahānarapadaṃ siṃhaparyantaṃ ṣaṣṭham īritam || 27.70 aniruddho muniś chandastvatipūrvaṃ ca devatā | nṛsiṃharūpī bhagavān iti sarvam udīrayan || 27.71 biladvāri japen mantrī ṣoḍaśa prayataḥ sthitaḥ | lakṣāṇi sadyaḥ pātālavāsinaḥ kurute vaśe || 27.72 lokāntaragatānāṃ ca vaśīkārakṣamo bhavet | etāvanti phalā nyanyetyabhidhātuṃ na śakyate || 27.73 ato 'nyaṃ nārasiṃhasya mantraṃ sarvārthasādhakam | catuśśatākṣaraṃ tasya samuddhāraḥ pradarśyate || 27.74 ādāv udgītham uddhṛtya natyantaṃ brahmasādhanam | bhallāyudhaṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ vāruṇaṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 27.75 mādhavaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca pāvakaṃ śvetadīdhitim | vikramaṃ sadhruvaṃ brahman bhāskaraṃ madhuvidviṣam || 27.76 mārutaṃ mādhavaṃ brahman dhanadaṃ madhusūdanam | śvasanaṃ vāruṇaṃ janmahantāramṛtadhārakam || 27.77 dviradaṃ sarvadehaṃ syād vyaidharaṃ tadanantaram | acāmādiṃ sadhruvañ ca krodharūpamadhokṣajam || 27.78 sa parvataṃ hutavahamāvṛtaṃ madhuvidviṣam | daraṃ sacandraṃ phullaṃ ca mādha [mādhavaṃ] nagavāriṇam || 27.79 savikramaṃ ca kamalaṃ parvataṃ pāśapāṇinam | sabandhuṃ kamalaṃ pañca bindusastakabhūṣitam || 27.80 sumukhaṃ cāgniśirasaṃ karālaṃ mṛgavallabham | kṣapākaraṃ tathāyāntaṃ yāminīnātham abjaja || 27.81 hṛdayāhṇādamākāraṃ caturgatim anantaram | nṛhariṃ bhuvanaṃ sūkṣmalocanaṃ rāmaśīrṣakam || 27.82 vijayaṃ pāṭalaṃ bhānuṃ sudanaṃ sumukhaṃ tathā | yāntaṃ tacchirasaṃ paścād vāruṇaṃ gajavāhanam || 27.83 vāsudevaṃ tathā krodharūpamākāramārutau | vaidharaṃ sūdanaṃ bhadrahastaṃ vāruṇamaindavam || 27.84 pūrṇendunāmakamatha madhusūdanasaṃjñakam | vatsotadehaṃ sumukhaṃ vikramaṃ vijayābhidham || 27.85 dṛṣṭivikramapāśāntasubhagārpitavighnarāṭ | taddvitīyamacāmādidvitayaṃ śvasanaṃ tathā || 27.86 mādhavaṃ sadhruvaṃ bhānumāntaṃ mādhavabhāskarau | rāmaṃ bhallāyudhaṃ pañcāntakaṃ syāt sudhārasam || 27.87 bhadrahastamacāmādi bhāntamāntarasūdanau | bhadra vasuṃ śvetaruciṃ vikramaṃ saddhruvaṃ tathā || 27.88 mārtāṇḍaṃ mādhavaṃ bhānuṃ gopanannāntamādharau | yāntaṃ sa śrīdharaṃ cograṃ vasuṃ vāruṇagodhanau || 27.89 kuśeśayaṃ mādhavaṃ ca sumukhaṃ kaustubhaṃ tathā | vighneśaṃ gopanaṃ brahman rohitāśvaṃ sagopanam || 27.90 śvasanaṃ sumukhaṃ paścād varuṇaṃ madhuvidviṣam | dākṣāyaṇīśamudayaṃ vaidharaṃ mādhavaṃ tataḥ || 27.91 amṛtaṃ vaidharamacāṃ dvitīyaṃ māntam abjaja | otadehaṃ tathā dṛṣṭiṃ yāntamākāramakṣaram || 27.92 vakratuṇḍaṃ gandhavahaṃ viṣṭaraṃ vijayaṃ tathā | amṛtaṃ vikramaparaṃ śrīvatsaṃ varuṇārpitam || 27.93 yāntam guhālayaṃ nāntaṃ ṣāntaṃ ca madhusūdanam | sudhruvaṃ druhiṇaṃ krodhaṃ pāvakaṃ sumukhaṃ punaḥ || 27.94 sapaścimaṃ padmanābhaṃ vaidharaṃ ca caturmukha | pavamānaṃ sabhuvanaṃ bhāntaṃ kuñjaragopanau || 27.95 bhadrahastaṃ sarāmaṃ ca yāntaṃ syāc chrīdharaṃ tathā | bhadraṃ ca dhanadaṃ pāpahananaṃ jayamandarau || 27.96 vighneśaṃ sūdanaṃ bhallaṃ bhāskaraṃ syāc caturgatim | śubhadaṃ vāmanaparamugraṃ vasuśiras tathā || 27.97 pradyotanaṃ tathā yāntamṛtadhāmogravāmanau | kamalaṃ mādhavaparaṃ sarasīruhasambhava || 27.98 vāntaṃ ca śubhadaṃ daṇḍaṃ kharvaṃ khaḍgadharaṃ punaḥ | sarojamṛtadhāmānaṃ kattṛtīyaṃ ca vaidharam || 27.99 acāṃ dvitīyaṃ dhanadaṃ bahulaṃ sauramāntarau | nāsikyaṃ ca samuccārya huṃphaṭśīrṣāṇi yojayet || 27.100 trayodaśāni bījāni humphaḍantāni yojayet | bījākṣareṣu pratyekaṃ huṃphaṭkāram udīrayet || 27.101 dvādaśāṅgavidāṃ procyaṃ bhāskaraṃ saguhālayam | nāsikyaṃ nṛhariṃ caurvaṃ candrārdhaṃ yāntamauṣadham || 27.102 saddhruvaṃ mārutaṃ caurvīṃ sadaṇḍaṃ ca kṣapākaram | samaraṃ saddhruvaṃ bhānumaurvaṃ nāsikyam abjaja || 27.103 pradyotanaṃ sabhuvanamardhenduṃ sāntam eva ca | sāgniṃ savāmanaṃ sārdhaṃ candraṃ caiva saroruham || 27.104 vāsavaṃ vāmanaparaṃ sadhruvaṃ kattṛtīyakam | māhendramaurvaṃ nāsikyaṃ mādhavaṃ dviradānanam || 27.105 subhadraṃ śrīdharaṃ bhadrahastaṃ gāruḍam eva ca | citrabhānuṃ śaśidharaṃ pīyūṣaṃ vasuśīrṣakam || 27.106 mārutaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca vijayaṃ vasusūdanau | pracaṇḍaṃ bandhusahitaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ guhālayam || 27.107 sumukhārṇaṃ ca saptārcirdaraṃ candramasāṃ mukham | apāmadhipatiṃ cāgniṃ jṛmbhalaṃ dviradānanam || 27.108 dhanadaṃ varuṇaṃ māyāṃ bhāntaṃ syād brahmasādhanam | pannagaṃ sumukhaṃ pāpahananaṃ yāntam abjaja || 27.109 amṛtaṃ vikramayutaṃ vaidharaṃ dhūliketanam | gopanaṃ saddhruvaṃ candraṃ sārdhenduṃ bhāskaraṃ vasum || 27.110 sapaścimaṃ hutavahaṃ matimadvāsavaṃ tataḥ | pāṭalaṃ sarvarodhaṃ syāt kuñjaraṃ mandaradvayam || 27.111 lakṣmīṃ savijayaṃ cāgniṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ caturmukha | bhadrahastaṃ mānuṣeśaṃ sūdanaṃ harimandiram || 27.112 śaṅkhaṃ kalānidhimapāṃ nāthaṃ vasumadhudviṣau | paścimaṃ vijayaṃ cāgniṃ subhadraṃ puruṣātmakam || 27.113 kalānidhyoś ca yugalaṃ vāruṇaṃ vasuśīrṣakam | vaidharaṃ madhuvidveṣī mādhavīṃ madhuvidviṣam || 27.114 ardhacandraṃ hutavahamanantaṃ ca dviruddharet | sāntaṃ savikramaṃ sendraṃ bindumastakabhūṣitam || 27.115 daśa pañca ca bījāni humphaḍantāni pūrvavat | mandaraṃ vikramavaśaṃ aindraṃ traivikramaṃ tathā || 27.116 khaḍgahastaṃ sarāmaṃ ca vāsavaṃ sahavikramam | vaidharaṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ śrībījaṃ cānunāsikam || 27.117 otadehaṃ sayaṣṭiṃ ca acāmādiṃ sayaṣṭikam | acāṃ dvitīyamardhenduṃ kapilaṃ saṅgiṇaṃ tathā || 27.118 māṭharaṃ gopanaṃ daṇḍaṃ māṭharaṃ pañcabindukam | nāsikyaṃ bhāskaraṃ vīrasenaṃ yaṣṭiṃ ca bhāskaram || 27.119 otadehaṃ sayaṣṭiṃ ca patanaṃ caurvanāsikau | rohitāśvaṃ ca kalaśaṃ vikramaṃ kamalāsana || 27.120 vāsudevaṃ sahṛdayāhlādanaṃ bandhumastakam | śuklaṃ sahasrakiraṇamaindavaṃ cāgnimastakam || 27.121 vairiñcaṃ bandhusāhitaṃ pavakaṃ sumukhaṃ tathā | pañcamaṃ tvṛtadhāmānaṃ kakubhāhvam anantaram || 27.122 savāruṇaṃ surapatiṃ sabandhuṃ vijayaṃ tathā | lakṣmīṃ madhudviṣamatho ekadaṃṣṭragatiṃ punaḥ || 27.123 agniśīrṣaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca jhaṣaṃ pañcāntakaṃ matam | druhiṇaṃ codayaṃ brahman vāsavaṃ vāmanaṃ tataḥ || 27.124 śubhadaṃ paścimamacāṃ dvitīyaṃ kamalāsana | dvitīyaṃ saddhruvaṃ cābjayoniṃ śrīdharapaṅkaje || 27.125 śrīvatsamajaṃ vijayaṃ rāmamastakamandaram | udayaṃ śukaśatruṃ ca vijayaṃ brahmasādhanam || 27.126 mandaraṃ yāntadhanadaṃ yāntaṃ candraghaṭaṃ vasum | bhallāyudhaṃ hṛṣīkeśam ekanetraṃ ghanaṃ punaḥ || 27.127 sabandhumandaraṃ dṛṣṭiyugalaṃ cāgniśīrṣakam | bhadraṃ caturgatim atho phaṇīndraṃ yāntasūdanau || 27.128 nṛhariṃ kalānidhimacāmādiṃ yāntaṃ madhudviṣam | kattṛtīyaṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ vighneśaṃ naravāhanam || 27.129 amṛtaṃ vasunāmānaṃ dharitriṃmadhusūdanam | kamalaṃ vikramaparaṃ yāntaṃ vāmanahastakam || 27.130 nāntaṃ guṇālayaṃ caiva ṇāntaṃ ḍāntamadhudviṣam | paścimaṃ caindavamatho bhāntārpitasagopanam || 27.131 dhanadaṃ cotavapuṣaṃ bhadraṃ dakṣaṃ ca sūdanam | vaidharaṃ caindiramacāṃ dvitīyaṃ kamalāsana || 27.132 trivikramaṃ bhadrakaraṃ mahāmāyāṅkitaṃ vasum | mṛgeśaṃ varuṇaṃ caiva vairājaṃ pañcabindukam || 27.133 kṣapākaraṃ kañjabhavaṃ tataḥ syād vighnanāyakam | sadṛṣṭiṃ vaidharaṃ devadattaṃ kumbhaṃ caturmukha || 27.134 gataṃ saṛtadhāmāhvaṃ mārtāṇḍaṃ pāśahastakam | samādhavaṃ syād vijayaṃ gopanaṃ viṣamadhvanim || 27.135 sarasīruhaṃ sordhvalokaṃ sarasīruhasambhava | padmām sa mandarākārau pracaṇḍajhaṣasaṃmitau || 27.136 vaidharaṃ varuṇaṃ rāmaṃ bhūdharaṃ vahnimastakam | jṛmbhalaṃ ṛtadhāmā ca syātāṃ bhāskaramandarau || 27.137 ādyantaṃ yāntamākāraṃ gāruḍaṃ himadīdhitim | oṅkārādiṃ śaśidharaṃ saviṣṇuṃ varuṇaṃ vasum || 27.138 sudhārasaṃ pracaṇḍāgniṃ bhaved ṛtamanantaram | krodharūpaṃ sarāmaṃ ca gadaṃ ca ṛtadhāmakam || 27.139 gopatiṃ vāruṇapatiṃ vikramaṃ yādasāṃ patim | madhudviṣaṃ hutavahaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ yāminīpatim || 27.140 sudhārasaṃ vasuyutaṃ janmadhvaṃsamapāṃ patim | yāntaṃ sudhārasaṃ bandhuṃ dvidvirākāramindirām || 27.141 dviradaṃ pāpahananaṃ madhusūdanam abjaja | vijayākāra garbhāś ca ākāravidhumādharāḥ || 27.142 pāvakaṃ pītavarṇābhaṃ brahmasādhanam abjaja | bhadravikramatoyeśamākārendusavikramāḥ || 27.143 ibhākāraṃ tato dyumnabhāskarābhūtavaidharāḥ | mārutākārabhadrāś ca māntākāramahotpalāḥ || 27.144 ugrātmavasuvāyavyasūdanā vidhir abjaja | ugraśīrṣakamārutyau paścimadyutimaindavam || 27.145 vāmanaṃ vaidharaṃ sūkṣmalocanaṃ kattṛtīyakam | kumbhaṃ bhadrakaraṃ cāpi mādhavīṃ bhāskaraṃ madhu || 27.146 sūdanaṃ tridaśāhāraṃ vikramaṃ cograrūpakam | pracaṇḍamotadehaṃ ca śubhadaṃ vittavardhanam || 27.147 pāvakaṃ sumukhaṃ bhadrahastaṃ vairājamakṣaram | kumbhaṃ sudarśanaṃ caiva kapilākṣaṃ caturmukha || 27.148 dviḥprapanno 'smīti padaṃ samuccārya pitāmaha | brahmakośaṃ puraskṛtya nṛhariṃ cānalaṃ tathā || 27.149 brahmasādhananāsikyau bījaṃ proktamataḥparam | nigamādiṃ subhadraṃ ca pāṭalaṃ sadhruvaṃ tathā || 27.150 mantrasya śaktimuddhṛtya chandasāmādim uddharet | gāruḍaṃ madhuhantāraṃ nāsikyaṃ vijayaṃ vasum || 27.151 sapadmanābhaṃ māyāṃ ca sūkṣmadṛṅmādhavaṃ ghaṭam | bhadrahastaṃ vaidharaṃ ca śrīdharaṃ cāgnivikramau || 27.152 vairājaṃ bhāskaraṃ yāntaṃ madhuśatrusamīraṇau | mandaraṃ māṭharamacāṃ dvitīyaṃ vighnapāvakau || 27.153 kalānidhiṃ sabandhuṃ ca sārdhacandraṃ tviṣāṃ patim | sūdanaṃ śaṅkhamaparaṃ kattṛtīyaṃ caturmukha || 27.154 sāntaṃ vasuyutaṃ caiva dviruccārya caturmukha | humphaḍantaṃ ca natyantaṃ hṛnmantraṃ parikīrtitam || 27.155 vedādiṃ pannagaṃ pañcabindubhūṣitamastakam | nāsikyaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca madhudveṣiṃ vasuṃ tathā || 27.156 aindavaṃ vikramaparaṃ nāsikyaṃ bhāskaraṃ ghaṭam | sabandhuṃ kamalaṃ padmanābhaṃ vāmanahastakam || 27.157 puṇḍarīkaṃ sabandhuṃ ca vairājaṃ vaidharaṃ tataḥ | godhanaṃ vijayaṃ māntaṃ vaidharaṃ madhusūdanam || 27.158 mānuṣaṃ cāmṛtaṃ bhadrakaraṃ gopanapadmajau | sagopanaṃ daraṃ caiva mādharaṃ kattṛtīyakam || 27.159 ṛtaṃ ca saindhavaṃ bandhuṃ saddhruvaṃ māṭharaṃ tvacām | dvitīyaṃ puruṣaṃ brahman mādhavīṃ mādharaṃ punaḥ || 27.160 bhṛguṃ khaḍgakaraṃ caiva dvir uccāryamataḥ param | humphaḍantaṃ śiromantraṃ ṭhaṭha ity avasānakam || 27.161 vedādimuragaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ acāmardhendumaindavam | phullanetraṃ sabhuvanaṃ garhitaṃ bhūdharātmakam || 27.162 kumbhaṃ savikramaṃ padmaṃ kheṭakīṃ kalaśaṃ tvacām | tṛtīyaṃ kamalaṃ pañcabinduṃ sumukham abjaja || 27.163 yāntaṃ ca śirasāmabjayonimeṇeśamaindavam | svāhādharaṃ śaśidharaṃ mukhaṃ bhūdharasūdanau || 27.164 caturgatiṃ śatānandaṃ vāsudevaṃ sapaścimam | kalānidhiṃ sarāmaṃ ca yaṣṭiṃ bhāskaragopanau || 27.165 caturgatiṃ kharvadehaṃ sūdanaṃ bhānuvikramau | dvirasenduṃ humphaḍantaṃ śikhāmantram udīritam || 27.166 devānāṃ dāsa vacasā ante saṃyojya mantravit | oṅkāraṃ nṛhariṃ vīrasenaṃ nāsikyamaindavam || 27.167 māṭharaṃ yāminīnāthamṛtadhāma sadarbhitam | ākhaṇḍaleśaṃ sarveśamākāraṃ kattṛtīyakam || 27.168 dviradaṃ vikramaparaṃ bahulaṃ ghaṭavikramau | ambhoruhaṃ cotadehaṃ hṛdayāṃhlādavikramau || 27.169 kalānidhiṃ subhadrāntaṃ sumukhāntaṃ samādhavam | cāntaṃ śaśadharaṃ devadattaṃ cāntaṃ sakumbhakam || 27.170 aindraṃ ca kuñjaramukhaṃ pīyūṣadyutivikramau | sayaṣṭiṃ dvimaṇiṃ cādidevaṃ yāntaṃ himālayam || 27.171 sadaṇḍaṃ garuḍaṃ bandhuṃ paścimaṃ ca dvir uddharet | humphaḍantaṃ ca kavacaṃ huṃphaṭśīrṣaṃ prakīrtitam || 27.172 āgamādiṃ narahariṃ caurvaṃ nāsikyam abjaja | vaidharaṃ gopanaṃ ṇāntaṃ mārutyaṃ mādhavaṃ madhu || 27.173 sūdanaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca pīyūṣaṃ sarasīruham | gopanaṃ pulahaṃ caiva sūdanaṃ mārutaṃ vasum || 27.174 kūṭaṃ phullāyudhamacāṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ vairājam eva ca | kattṛtiyaṃ padmanābhaṃ bhāskaraṃ madhuvidviṣam || 27.175 dṛṣṭiṃ savāmanaṃ bhadrahastaṃ sāgniṃ samuddharet | bhāskaraṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca taddvir uccārya mantravit || 27.176 paścimaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ ca mandaraṃ supratiṣṭhitam | tānudīryātha mantrajñaḥ subhadraṃ caindavaṃ punaḥ || 27.177 sadakṣaṃ vāmanaśirā ambhoruhaniketana | ambhoruhaṃ sabhuvanaṃ pāvakaṃ bhuvanaṃ tathā || 27.178 nṛhariṃ pāpahananaṃ vikramaṃ vijayaṃ punaḥ | vairiñcaṃ vāmanaṃ dakṣamaugraṃ dakṣaṃ caturmukha || 27.179 guhālayaṃ savijayamagniśīrṣaṃ ca mārutam | eṇeśaṃ mandaraṃ bhānuṃ sūdanaṃ vighnanāyakam || 27.180 yāntaṃ tārādhipaṃ māyāṃ saddhruva māṭharaṃ tathā | madhudviṣaṃ mārutaṃ ca humphaḍastraṃ prakīrtitam || 27.181 astraśabdaṃ caturthyantaṃ phaḍantaṃ ca samuddharet | udgīthaṃ nṛhariṃ sargamandharaṃ māṭharaṃ tvacām || 27.182 dvitīyaṃ paścimaṃ padmanābhaṃ cādisamanvitam | khaḍgahastaṃ ca sumukhaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣamambujam || 27.183 sagopanaṃ surapatiṃ gopanaṃ khadvitīyakam | bhadrahastaṃ sarāmaṃ ca vāsavaṃ brahmasādhanam || 27.184 khaḍgahastaṃ gajamukhaṃ sūdanaṃ ca caturgatim | acāmādiṃ gajamukhamauṣadhaṃ nāntam abjaja || 27.185 mādhavīṃ mārutaṃ yāntamādharaṃ paścimaṃ tathā | sabandhuṃ sapracaṇḍaṃ cāpyeṇeśaṃ pāṭalāpriyam || 27.186 mārtāṇḍaṃ madhuvidveṣiṃ bhadraṃ syād ṛtadhāmakam | dākṣāyaṇīśaṃ rāmaṃ syād anusvāraṃ caturmukha || 27.187 divākaraṃ cādidevaṃ deraṃ vaidharagopanau | pāvakaṃ puruṣātmānaṃ dviruktaṃ kamalāsana || 27.188 humphaḍantaṃ ca netrābhyāṃ vauṣaṭkāraṃ prayujya ca | evaṃ nyasya vidhānajño viṣkambhāntaṃ sadaṇḍakam || 27.189 divākarasahasrābhaṃ hṛdayārṇaṃ ṣaḍuddharet | utpalaṃ kumudaṃ raktajapābandhūkakiṃśukam || 27.190 pāṭalaṃ hṛdayādīnāṃ varṇaṣṣaṇṇāṃ kramād bhavet | rakṣāmantraṃ pravakṣyāmi chandasāmādim uddharet || 27.191 vighneśaṃ padmanābhaṃ syād dvijarājaṃ savikramam | sadaṇḍaṃ ca samārtāṇḍaṃ bahulaṃ saguhālayam || 27.192 paścimaṃ vāmanaparaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ hariṇaṃ bhavet | bhallāyudhaṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ lāntaṃ bhadrakaraṃ tathā || 27.193 acāmādiṃ dinamaṇiṃ mādhavau sauramakṣaram | eṇeśaṃ dhanadaṃ dakṣaṃ vasuśīrṣaṃ ca sūdanam || 27.194 dhanādyakṣaṃ tathā dakṣaṃ pāvakaṃ mastakasthitam | dhāntaṃ savikramaṃ khāntaṃ hāntaṃ syāt kapilaṃ punaḥ || 27.195 dviradāsyaṃ bandhuparaṃ mādhavīṃ yāntaśīrṣakam | vāsudevaṃ khaḍgadharaṃ caturgatim anantaram || 27.196 mukhaṃ savaidharaṃ brahman māṭharaṃ tad dvir uddharet | pavitramaprameyaṃ syāt tuṇḍaṃ cādisamandaram || 27.197 sarvarodhaṃ dvir uccārya kamalaṃ savilocanam | yathāpuraṃ sadaṇḍaṃ ca sūdanaṃ yāntamārutau || 27.198 dvir vaktavyaṃ subhadraṃ ca vikramaṃ vighnavaidharau | tadviruddhacchaladhvaṃsī bandhuvighnaṃ savaidharam || 27.199 aindiraṃ cotadehaṃ ca ugraṃ māntaṃ caturmukha | atriṃ cāgniṃ madhudveṣim amṛtaṃ dhūliketanam ||27.200 tārkṣyaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ taddvir uccārya padmaja | mārtāṇḍam ūrdhvanāsikyaṃ tadudīryamataḥ param || 27.201 pāvakaṃ caurvaśirasaṃ sadaṇḍaṃ gopanaṃ tathā | gadadhvaṃsaṃ chaladhvaṃsaṃ tadudīrya jayaṃ tathā || 27.202 vairājaṃ yāntaśirasaṃ śuklaṃ vairājapāvakau | jṛmbhalaṃ samatā brahman māṭharaṃ dakṣasaṃjñitam || 27.203 pracaṇḍaṃ mādhavaṃ caiva kalaśaṃ bandhuśīrṣakam | kamalāṃ vāruṇaṃ yāntaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ ca paścimam || 27.204 māyājitaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca mādhavaṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntimam | bījamaṅgāni coktāni durvāsā ṛṣir ucyate || 27.205 chando 'nuṣṭub devatā ca mahānaraharir hariḥ | mālāmantre trivarṇāḥ syuḥ śuklapītasitāsitāḥ || 27.206 tattvaṃ ca paramavyoma sakalīkaraṇaṃ tathā | vikalīkaraṇaṃ caiva mantrasyāpyāyanaṃ bhavet || 27.207 mocanaṃ caiva ity ete kathitāḥ kamalāsana | catuṣṣaṣṭividhe mantre nārasiṃhe mahānayam || 27.208 nṛsiṃho vyomacakrākhyaḥ pātālākhyaś ca sūribhiḥ | dhyāyen mṛtyubhaye kṛtyāpraveśe yudhi vidviṣām || 27.209 uccāṭane saṃhanane bhūtānāmapanodane | ākhyāyate dhyānamasya smṛtaṃ savitṛmaṇḍale || 27.210 madhye vikasvare śubhre paṅkaje viṣṭarodare | āsīnaṃ ṣoḍaśamukhaṃ bhujais taddviguṇair yutam || 27.211 āyudhaiś śaṅkhacakrādyair durdarśai raśmimālibhiḥ | paracakrapratikṣepe duṣkareṣv anyakarmasu || 27.212 brahmovāca dvādāśāṅgāni yo vetti mantraṃ so 'rhati veditum | ity uktaṃ bhagavan bhūyo vijñāsā teṣu vartate || 27.213 śrī bhagavān bījaṃ śaktis tathaivāṅgaṃ hṛdayādi ca ṣaḍivadham | ṛṣiś chando devatā ca varṇoddīpanam eva ca || 27.214 āpyāyanaṃ mocanaṃ ca sakalīkaraṇaṃ tathā | vikalīkaraṇaṃ caiva dvādaśaitāni padmaja || 27.215 teṣāṃ svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi kramāt tadavadhāryatām | mantrasya prakṛtir bījamakṣaraṃ tatsamuddhṛtam || 27.216 ātmā mantrasya sā śaktir yathā mantraphalapradā | hṛdayādīni mantrasya ṣaḍaṅgāni pitāmaha || 27.217 devasyeva mukhādīni eṣu mantraḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ | ṛṣiḥ phalasya draṣṭā syāc chandas tadabhidhīyate || 27.218 akṣarāṇāmiyattā yā devatā vācyam ucyate | rūpabhedaś ca śuklādirvarṇāḥ kamalasambhava || 27.219 sampuṭīkaraṇaṃ rephalakārābhyāṃ tu dīpanam | yathoditākṣarais sarvaiḥ saṃskāraś śoṣaṇādibhiḥ || 27.220 mantrasya devavat proktaṃ yattadāpyāyanaṃ budhaiḥ | mantrasya mocanaṃ nāma prayogaḥ stambhanādiṣu || 27.221 mantrākṣarāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ sampuṭīkaraṇaṃ smṛtam | sakalīkaraṇaṃ viddhi praṇavena caturmukha || 27.222 vauṣaṭkāravaṣaṭkārahuṅkāraiḥ pṛthag īritaiḥ | devatānām abhīṣṭānāṃ sannidhir yaḥ puṭādiṣu || 27.223 prārthyate sa caturvaktra vikalīkaraṇāhvayaḥ | etāny eva prayuñjīta vidyayor ādyayor api || 27. 224 ekādaśākṣaro mantro vāmanasya pradarśyate | pūrvoditās saptavarṇā viśeṣaḥ samudīryate || 27.225 pīyūṣamādidevaṃ ca mandaraṃ cādim uddharet | vighneśaṃ gopanaṃ vāyumādyaṃ ceti caturmukha || 27.226 bījaṃ śirasy ūrdhvaloko yaṣṭiś ceti caturgatim | aṅgāni ṣaṭ phalādīni svarāntānyānupūrvaśaḥ || 27.227 sānusvārāṇi yojyāni kāśyapo munir iṣyate | chandaś ca daivaṃ gāyatraṃ vāmano devatā punaḥ || 27.228 lakṣāṇy ekādaśa japed dhome ca jalatarpaṇe | tatas sidhyati mantro 'yaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || 27.229 phalam anyac ca yac ceṣṭam aṣṭākṣaravadīritam | omādi nati pūrvāṇi catvāryādyāni pūrvavat || 27.230 saptākṣarasya mantrasya sādhanaṃ ca yathāpuram | saptalakṣajapād uktaṃ phalam āpnoti mantravit || 27.231 gṛhītvārṇān sapta pūrvān vairājo 'gnis strivikramaḥ | yādasāṃpatiṃ māyāṃ ca sparśādiranalonmukham || 27.232 sparśāntaś cādidevaś ca śaṅkho viṣṇur itīritaḥ | dvādaśārṇātmako mantras tad eva kamalāsana || 27.233 trivikramasya bījaṃ ca bhāskaro viṣṇur eva ca | ardhacandrākṛtiś ceti tad evāṅgaṃ ca ṣadvidham || 27.234 ṛṣiś ca devatā chandaḥ pūrvoktāny eva sādhanam | pūrvavatphalamasyāpi rājyādi prāptir iṣyate || 27.235 natvekaṃ śakyate vaktumānantyātphalasampadām | rāmasya jāmadagnyasya mantroddhāraś caturmukha || 27.236 gṛhītvā pūrvavat sapta varṇān sādhāraṇāṃs tataḥ | asādhāraṇavarṇānāṃ kramād uddhāraṇaṃ śṛṇu || 27.237 janmahantā gopanaś ca mādhavī viṣṇur anvataḥ | dṛṣṭiś cādigatir bhadrapāṇir vāyuś ca gopanaḥ || 27.238 caturgatiḥ svarādiś ca vahnirākāra eva ca | mandaraś cādidevaś ca śvasano viṣṇur abjaja || 27.239 humphaḍanta iti prokto mantraḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥ | analaḥ praṇavādiś ca sayaṣṭir bījam īritam || 27.240 etad evāṅgamāvṛttaṃ ṣaṭkṛtvo gārgyadarśanaḥ | chandaś ca daivaṃ gāyatraṃ jāmadagnyo 'sya devatā || 27.241 japed viṃśatilakṣāṇi tatas sarvārthasādhanaḥ | daśākṣaro 'thavā mantro jāmadagnyapadaṃ vinā || 27.242 bījādi sarvaṃ pūrvoktaṃ mantraś satrukṣayāvahaḥ | mantro rāmāvatārasya brahman dāśarathervaraḥ || 27.243 kathyate bharatādīnāṃ taddevīnām anukramāt | dvādaśākṣaram ārabhya mantraṃ tadanu padmaja || 27.244 caturmūrtimayāyeti padam uccārya mantravit | abhirāmaśarīreti caturthyantam udīrayet || 27.245 rāmeti tadvibhaktyantaṃ ṭhaṭheti tadanantaram | dvātriṃśadakṣarātmā 'yaṃ manuruktaś caturmukha || 27.246 bījamasyānalo viṣṇuḥ sānusvaraḥ kramāt smṛtaḥ | aṅgāni ṣaṭ ca tadbījamakārādikramād bhavet || 27.247 aparaṃ rāmamantraṃ te kathayāmi caturmukha | prathamaṃ praṇavaṃ procya pañcabinduṃ sayaṣṭikam || 27.248 caturthyantaṃ caturmūrtipadamuktvā tataḥ param | caturgatimayāyeti śaraśārṅgabhṛdanvataḥ || 27.249 caturthyantaṃ śaratpūrvamindīvarapadaṃ tathā | tviṣeti ca padaṃ paścāt prayojyaṃ bhagavatpadam || 27.250 caturthyantaṃ samuccāryam abhirāmapadaṃ tataḥ | śarīrāyeti ca procya rāmāyeti padaṃ tathā || 27.251 natyantam iti mantrasya padoddhāraḥ pradarśitaḥ | bījaṃ tadaṅgaṣaṭkaṃ ca tadṛṣiś ca śarabhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 27.252 chandaś ca pūrvavad devo rāmātmā bhagavān hariḥ | japed akṣaralakṣaṃ tu tatas sidhyati mantrarāṭ || 27.253 phalaṃ cābhīṣṭamacirāl labhate durlabhaṃ mahat | mātṛkācakravinyastānarṇaṣaṇḍān sumantritān || 27.254 abhyarcya kusumais tasminn uddharet bhagavanprayaḥ | ato 'nyamantrasaṃghātaṃ mālāmantraṃ yathātatham || 27.255 vakṣyāmi samprati brahman yathāvadavadhāryatām | ādau nādaṃ saptavarṇaṃ vasuṃ madhuniṣūdanam || 27.256 sparśāntaṃ gopanaṃ śaṅkhaṃ mukhaṃ viṣṇuṃ jayaṃ tathā | acāṃ pañcamamāhendrau nādādiṃ ghaṭavikramān || 27.257 śaṃkhinaṃ śikhinaṃ dakṣaṃ karālaṃ vasuniṣṭhitam | hāntaṃ madhudviṣaṃ brahman dhūliketanamādimam || 27.258 nāntayāntau sadakṣāhvau paścimodayamakṣaram | atriṃ ramādharaṃ krodharūpiṇaṃ cānalāhvayam || 27.259 acāṃ dvitīyaṃ pavanaṃ kalaśaṃ bindumastakam | ugrātmasumukhau syātāṃ yādonāthamṛgādhipau || 27.260 dineśamādiṃ nāsikyaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ madhuvidviṣam | vairājaṃ mādhavīṃ bhadrakaraṃ mādhavam abjaja || 27.261 vakratuṇḍamacāmādiṃ vijayodayasaṃjñitam | pañcāntakaṃ tathā yāntaṃ mastakasthaṃ jayaṃ punaḥ || 27.262 rāmamandaraśaṃkhaḥ syur gopanaṃ pavanaṃ mukham | ādibhallāyudhau rāmavasugopanapāṭalau || 27.263 śrīvatsamādimanalaṃ vāmanāgniṃ madhudviṣam | caturgatiṃ khaḍgadharam ekadṛkvaidharaṃ tathā || 27.264 dakṣaṃ cāgniṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ vijayadvayamanvataḥ | yāntaṃ tacchirasaṃ paścāt pavanaṃ mṛgavallabham || 27.265 ṛkṣeśamekanayanaṃ daragopanavighnarāṭ | bandhuyāntau ca bhuvanaṃ vaidharau puṇyabhāskarau || 27.266 śvasanaṃ dakṣabhuvanau cakravighneśasaptamam | acāṃ kāraṇameṇeśaṃkalātmā vasuvikramāḥ || 27.267 karālagopanau pāpahananau vikramaṃ tathā | māhendrakumbhāvanalo madhusūdanabhāskarau || 27.268 yāntagopanasaptārcir madhusūdanamārutāḥ | pracaṇḍagopanau khaḍgadharaśrīdharavaijayāḥ || 27.269 pīyūṣagopanau padmaśrīdharau vanamālinau | meghapañcātmadviradakamalāmadhuvidviṣaḥ || 27.270 pīto mṛgeśapavanagopanāśśuklaśrīdharāḥ | pāvakasthānagovindavairājadaravaidharāḥ || 27.271 madhusūdanavighneśasudhārasasamāhvayāḥ | brahmasādhanasaptārcir gatir bhāskarasaptamāḥ || 27.272 acāmādiṃ dharo vedhāḥ brahmasādhanakheṭakī | agniś ca kapilaṃ brahman bhallāyudhasavikramam || 27.273 vighneśaṃ vaidharaṃ pretanāyakaṃ rāmaśīrṣakam | bhadrapāṇiṃ tathādṛk ca sarasīruhasambhava || 27.274 dakṣādi devahutabhuk caturgatim anantaram | śrīvatsavāsudevau dvau krodharūpasamīraṇau || 27.275 karālaṃ ca ṛtaṃ bhadrapāṇiṃ vairājamārutau | paścimaṃ vasukarmaṃ ca vikramaṃ dṛṣṭigopanau || 27.276 vighneśacchalavidhvaṃsamādhavā vaidharātmakam | jalajaṃ pāpahantāraṃ hutabhukkamalaṃ ghaṭam || 27.277 vakratuṇḍaṃ tathā dyumnaṃ dviradānanavikramam | bhāntamagniṃ cotadehaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ caturgatim || 27.278 paścimānanayāntau ca otadehasamanvitau | vairājadvitayaṃ dakṣaṃ gopanaṃ vāsikodbhavam || 27.279 gadadhvaṃsaṃ ca kapilamatriṃ madhuniṣūdanam | yāntaṃ caturgatiṃ śuklaṃ vāruṇāgnisamīraṇāḥ || 27.280 ekadantam ekadṛṣṭiṃ vahulaṃ madhuvidviṣam | pracaṇḍa vikramaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ ca saguhālayam || 27.281 sumukhaṃ hutabhuk śaṅkhamanalaṃ madhuvidviṣam | yaṣṭiṃ dakṣaṃ tathākāraṃ nāsikyaṃ dhūliketanam || 27.282 dhruvaṃ māhendramākāramardhāṃśuṃ kumbhagopanau | saddhruvaṃ janmahantāraṃ vāruṇaṃ pulahaṃ tathā || 27. 283 musalīkumbhamākāraṃ pītavāyudhanapradāḥ | śrīdharaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca hariṃ svāhāmayāvaham || 27.284 humphaḍantaṃ navaitāni bījāni kamalodbhava | padmapāṇiṃ padmanābhaṃ vanamālāṃ trivikramam || 27.285 śrīvatsaṃ śaṃkhibhuvanaṃ bhadrahastās savikramāḥ | agniṃ mṛgeśaṃ varuṇaṃ vairājaṃ bandhumastakam || 27.286 daraṃ tārkṣyaṃ tathā cādidevaṃ śuklaṃ śriyaḥpatim | vasugopanaśītāṃśubhuvanānalavāruṇāḥ || 27.287 mṛgeśavijayākāraviṣkambhāśśuklavikramau | dṛkpuṇyamādidevaṃ ca bhāskaraṃ ṛtadhāmakam || 27.288 sūkṣmadṛkśaṅkhadakṣau ca vaidharo 'gniś caturgatiḥ | paścimaṃ tritadakṣādi agnivāyusaroruhāḥ || 27.289 ṛtadhāmā jayāgopā paścimā śuklam abjaja | bhānugopanasaptārcir bhallāyudhaguhālayāḥ || 27.290 vairājakakubhau kumbhahavyavāṭ kapilāhvayāḥ | vaidharaṃ bhāskaraṃ pāpahananaṃ vakratuṇḍakam || 27.291 gadinaṃ ṛtadhāmānaṃ bhāskaraṃ sumukhaṃ tathā | kumbhavikramajanmāhva padmanābhassadevarāṭ || 27.292 subhadraśaṅkhadakṣāhvamotadeho 'tha bhāskaraḥ | pavanaṃ pāpahananaṃ gopanau vijayo daraḥ || 27.293 udayaṃ pītakamalaṃ madhusūdanavighnarāṭ | māhendraśubhadau vahnigodhanau kumbhavikramau || 27.294 agniratriḥ kumbhadharau lakṣmī kharvāś caturmukha | śuklodayaṃ tathā dṛṣṭiśsrīvatsaṃ vasuśīrṣakam || 27.295 vighneśaśubhadau syātāṃ sarasīruhasambhava | madhusūdanaḥ śārṅgapāṇiḥ pañcāntaka viddhi punaḥ || 27.296 aurvadakṣau tadehāś ca dṛṣṭiṃ sarasijaṃ tathā | vāmano dhanado yāntaḥ subhagāgnivanasrajaḥ || 27.297 rāmapuṇyāgnigaruḍavikramau jayavikramau | subhago 'gnirādidevaḥ kuñjareṇa mukhākṣaraḥ || 27.298 karālaṃ kapilaṃ pāpahananaṃ pavanātmajam | śrīdharaṃ dṛṣṭidhanadaṃ pañcabinduṃ savighnarāṭ || 27.299 śubhotadehāvugrātmā caturgatimacāṃ mukham | śailadvayaṃ dvādaśātmā gopanaśśuklapaścimau || 27.300 śrīdharassumukho bhūmiranalaḥ pañcabindukaḥ | karālāgniṃ mahāmāyā subhago bandhuranvataḥ || 27.301 vairājaṃ vikramaṃ pāpahanana bandhumastakam | pracaṇḍaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ vāsudevaṃ jayaṃ vasum || 27.302 sūkṣmadṛkkumbhavaruṇa paścimānanamādharāḥ | ugrātma mṛgadakṣāhvā gopanā dhanadaḥ kuṭaḥ || 27.303 dakṣaḥ puṇyodayaśsuklo śubhadṛṣṭirvināyakaḥ | vaidharo madhuhantā ca mandaraṃ brahmasādhanam || 27.304 atriragniḥ pavitrāhvā vaidharau sparśapaścimaḥ | bhadrādi devabhallāhvāmugrabhūmiṃ madhudviṣam || 27.305 ekadṛgdakṣavighneśamādhavāmṛgavallabhāḥ | bhāskaraṃ devadattaṃ ca bhānuṃ bandhuṃ subhadrakam || 27.306 gadadhvaṃsaṃ tathā kumbhaṃ dviradaṃ paścimānanam | aurvāgni bhuvanāvugrayaṣṭirvedhāḥ śriyaḥpatiḥ || 27.307 agniṃ ramādharaṃ dviś ca agnikūṭavigarhitam | tathā bhadramadhudveṣi dṛṣṭigopanamastakān || 27.308 vairāja dakṣakamalagopanā bindu pakṣirāṭ | manuṃ dhruvāgnimākāraṃ binducandramadhudviṣaḥ || 27.309 nāsikyamādiratriś ca bandhumandaraviṣṭapāḥ | vairājarephaśaṅkhāhnamādhavāvādivighnarāṭ || 27.310 mṛgeśakamalau dakṣaṃ guhamambhoruhāsana | jayo 'gnir vāyureṇeśamukho garuḍavāhanaḥ || 27.311 bandhupīta pavitrāhvā madhusūdanavaijayāḥ | gopano bhārgavākāraśuklodayahutāśanāḥ || 27.312 pītotadehakamalavighnavikramamādhavāḥ | gopanaṃ somabandhuś ca karigopanayaṣṭayaḥ || 27.313 dineśamṛtadhāmāhvā dṛṣṭiśaṅkhamadhudviṣaḥ | vighnavāyū tathā gopakamalau śatrudāhakaḥ || 27.314 dhāntaśākhau madhorhantā padmakrodhāgnimārutāḥ | ādiścakrī subandhuś ca pītassarvapurāntakaḥ || 27.315 udayorantarāmau vai rājate pavanāgnayaḥ | ādiḥkharvatanurbandhupītapadmamadhudviṣaḥ || 27.316 pāṭalaṃ paścimaṃ padmanābhaṃ vaidharamādhavau | bhallāyudhaṃ gadī kumbhavairājamṛgavallabhā || 27.317 śrīvatsamagnimīkāraṃ kumbhaṃ pītadvayaṃ tathā | subhadragopanau śaṅkhamandarau dinakṛt tathā || 27.318 acāṃ caturdaśaṃ janma śaśāṅkhamṛgavallabhāḥ | hutāśagopadakṣāhvā mādhavyaś ca guhālayaḥ || 27.319 vairājayugasaptārcirdaradevahutāntimāḥ | analo yaṣṭisahito bījamasya samīritam || 27.320 śarabhaṅgaṛṣīs tasya varivaṃ chanda īritaḥ | japo lakṣatrayas tasmin cauśśatamitākṣare || 27.321 puṃso rāmāvatārasya parasya paramātmanaḥ | catuśśatārṇarūpo 'yaṃ mālāmantras samuddhṛtaḥ || 27.322 yathāpuraṃ puraścaryā siddhiś caiva yathāpuram | anyeṣāṃ bharatādīnāṃ itaravyūhanāmabhiḥ || 27.323 ātmaśīrṣaiś caturthyantair nāmāni sahitāni ca | caturthyantāni vācyāni mantrarūpāṇi padmaja || 27.324 bījānyādyakṣarāṇy eva sānusvārāṇi yojayet | sītādīnāṃ ca devīnāṃ caturthyantāssamāhvayāḥ || 27.325 mantraṣaṣṭheti paryanto bījānyādyakṣarāṇi ca | śrīmantravat puraścaryā tadvac ca phalasambhavaḥ || 27.326 rāmasya balabhadrasya manussamprati kathyate | saptārṇaṃ padam uccārya tataḥ paścād udīrayet || 27.327 rāmāyeti caturthyantaṃ balabhadrapadaṃ tathā | bījamasyocyate brahman jṛmbhalampulahaṃ tathā || 27.328 sānusvāro hṛṣīkeśaḥ paiṅgalaḥ syād ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ | chandaḥ pūrvavad eva syād devatā musalāyudhaḥ || 27.329 rāmaḥ kamalapatrākṣo bījam evāṅgapaddhatiḥ | lakṣāṇy akṣarasaṃkhyāni bhaven mantrasya siddhaye || 27.330 phalamiṣṭamavāpnoti pātālagamanādikam | caturvargaphalāvāpteḥ phalamasya kare sthitam || 27.331 yādavasyātha kṛṣṇasya mantras samprati kathyate | udgītham uccārya mukhe sparśādi tadanantaram || 27.332 ṛtadhāmā tataḥ paścāt krodharūpam anantaram | vanamālinamākāraṃ śvasanaṃ viṣṇumastakam || 27.333 natyantamiti ṣaḍvarṇā mantrasya kathitā mayā | bījaṃ kamalamādyaṃ syāt saptārcis tadanantaram || 27.334 aurvaḥ paścāt sayaṣṭiḥ syād etenaivāṅgakalpanā | sanako 'sya bhaved draṣṭā chando gāyatram ucyate || 27.335 devatā bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ puraścaryā ca pūrvavat | phalāni pūrvamuktāni nānantyād ucyate punaḥ || 27.336 govardhanākhyamantrasya varṇoddhāraḥ pradarśyate | vedādiṃ pūrvam uccārya prathame sparśapañcake || 27.337 tṛtīyāṃ yādiṣu tathā svareṣu ca caturmukha | saddhruvaṃ gadinaṃ brahmasādhanaṃ ca sudhārasam || 27.338 ādiṃ saptārciṣaṃ puṇyaṃ makaraṃ tadanantaram | bhadrabāhuṃ dvitīyaṃ ca śvasanaṃ mukhamanvataḥ || 27.339 natyantam evam uddhāraḥ kathito navavarṇakaḥ | mantrastadeva bījādisādhanaṃ phalam īritam || 27.340 gopālamantrasyoddhāraḥ kathyate kamalāsana | chandasāmādim uccārya tṛtīyaṃ sparśasaṃjñitam || 27.341 otadehaṃ pavitraṃ ca vāmanaṃ kakubhaṃ tataḥ | aniruddhaṃ vighnarājamakāraṃ yādasāmpatim || 27.342 ādyaṃ [pu]lahamāvṛttaṃ sparśopāntaṃ ca gopanam | prabhañjanaṃ svareṣv ādiṃ ṭhaṭhānto manur īritaḥ || 27.343 bījaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sparśānāṃ pītaṃ turyamacāmataḥ | nāsikyamaṅgāni punar gopanaṃ khaḍgasaṃjñitam || 27.344 mukhyaṃ sparśādimanalaṃ gopanaṃ sparśanaṃ tathā | ādyaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ prathamaṃ tad evāṅgam anantaram || 27.345 vipūrvam adhikaṃ paścād aṅgaṃ trailokyapūrvakam | rakṣaṇeti caturthyantaṃ tadvibhaktyantamanvataḥ || 27.346 asurādyantakaparaṃ padaṃ sarvādyanantaram | grahaṃ nivāraṇāyeti humphaḍantamitīritam || 27.347 mantrasya nārado draṣṭā virāṭ chandaś ca devatā | kṛṣṇāvatāro bhagavān japasthānaṃ puroditam || 27.348 sahasraśaḥ pratisthānaṃ japaḥ proktaś caturmukha | japāt sidhyati mantro 'yaṃ sādhayaty akhilaṃ phalam || 27.349 āścaryamaparaṃ mantraṃ vakṣyāmi kamalāsana | uccārya praṇavaṃ pūrvaṃ mādharaṃ tadanantaram || 27.350 caturthyantam udīryātha tadvibhakyantam adbhutam | bhogeśvarapadaṃ tadvat taduccakrīpadaṃ tataḥ || 27.351 suvarṇādidhvajāntaṃ ca padaṃ tādṛgvibhaktikam | pītādivāsaśśabdāntaṃ vāsudevapadaṃ tataḥ || 27.352 tadvibhaktiśiro yojyaṃ natyanto manuruddhṛtaḥ | pūrvam aṅgāni yojyāni pūrvavannātiricyate || 27.353 ṛṣiś chando devatā ca pūrvavat phalam eva ca | dharmārthakāmamokṣādi neha bhūyaḥ pratanyate || 27.354 mālāmantraṃ tāvadarṇaṃ devasya madhuvidviṣaḥ | kṛṣṇāvatārarūpasya caturvargaphalapradam || 27.355 uddharāmi yathātattvaṃ yathāvadavadhāryatām | nigamādidviṣaṭkārṇaṃ sarojamṛtadhāmakam || 27.356 krodhaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ madhubhic chaṅkhakumbhatānvitāḥ [chaṅkhakumbhaṛtānvitāḥ] | krodhaścaṇḍakramaḥ kumbhaśaṃ khā [khāgni] madhusūdanāḥ || 27.357 daraśrīvatsa eṇeśa krodhasūkṣmamataḥ param | vāsudevo gadī pāpahananaṃ ca caturgatim || 27.358 agnibindur viriñcādi devāś śaṅkhamacāṃ mukham | pavitram agnimadhubhidbhadrapāṇidvayaṃ punaḥ || 27.359 vaidharaṃ paścimavasuṃ dakṣendubhuvanātmakam | sūkṣmacakṣur gatis somaḥ kumbhāgnis saguhālayau || 27.360 pavitragopanau vāyuṃ paścimāgniṃ madhudviṣaḥ | vairājamādhavīvighnaḥ sāraṅgāsi dharāḥ paraḥ || 27.361 bandhuvairājahutabhuk pañcātmadviradānanaḥ | gopanaḥ śaṅkhadinakṛdṛtavaidharamārutāḥ || 27.362 abjotadehāvadriś ca yāntabhadratrivikramāḥ | māhendraśaṅkhamadhubhinmārutāḥ kakubhāhvyāḥ || 27.363 bhṛgugopanavighneśajanmahantreṇasaṃhitāḥ | māruto gopano vāyur indubhāskaramaindavam || 27.364 ṛtaṃ lakṣmīṃ mahāmāyāṃ krodhāgnivaruṇahvayāḥ | atrir vighnadvayaṃ śaṅkho dviradaḥ sūkṣmalocanaḥ || 27.365 śriyaḥpatiṃ tathā janmahantāraṃ vakratuṇḍakam | hutāśacaṇḍamadhubhiddharaśukladineśvarāḥ || 27.366 kālātmā pratimākārajayapāvakabhadrakāḥ | udaikaś cakṣuramṛtaṃ vikramā vidhipāvakau || 27.367 dakṣo vidhiś cintadhāmā dakṣagopanam abjaja | śaṅkhamādiṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ māhendraṃ pañcabindukam || 27.368 saddhruvaṃ cendirābījaṃ puṣṭibījaṃ tataḥ param | kāmabījaṃ pāśabījaṃ śrīvatsaṃ bindumastakam || 27.369 cakra khaḍgadharo brahmā padmanābho 'tha paścimaḥ | vaidharaṃ dakṣakamala śrīdharāḥ pītavāmanau || 27.370 indirā pāpahananā gopanā vittavardhanāḥ | madhusūdananāsikyakuśeśaya ramādharāḥ || 27.371 śrīvatsadvaṃdvabahulavitteśamadhuvidviṣaḥ | kapidhvajo gadī yāntadakṣaśrīdharacandramāḥ || 27.372 pītādidevaśśītāṃśurmāyākamalam abjaja | manur dakṣotadehau ca dṛṣṭiḥ śaṅkhaghaṭāhvayaḥ || 27.373 māyākarālamīkāracaṇḍārṇavasumastakam | nādādiṃ paścimaṃ padmanābhaṃ vairājavikramau || 27.374 pāvakaṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ paścimaṃ cāprameyakam | kharvavikramamāhendrabhallāyudhasudhārasāḥ || 27.375 vighnamandaravighneśamādhavī supratiṣṭhitāḥ | kumbhodarāmaśubhadapīyūṣāgniguhālayāḥ || 27.376 paścimānanavighneśa māyā mandarāśmakāḥ | vasumūrdhāmahendrādi devāḥ kapilasaṃyutāḥ || 27.377 jṛmbhalo yāntasubhagahutāśadhanadāḥ paraḥ | govindavighna bhuvanavidhiḥ paścimasaṃjñitāḥ || 27.378 saptārciḥ pītavarṇābhaṃ devaro matimāṃs tathā | śaṅkhagopanavairāja śrīdharo dhanadābhidhaḥ || 27.379 madhudviṭkuñjaramukhaś caturgatisapannagāḥ | bhadrahasto madhudveṣī gadadhvaṃsī dvayānvitaḥ || 27.380 bhadrapāṇis tathā puṇyaṃ sarasīruhasambhava | sudhāraso vasurbhūmir gopanākhyamataḥ param || 27.381 karālabandhuvighneśau pañcabinduśubhāhnayāḥ | madhuhantā tathā brahmā māyāvighnaścavāmanāḥ || 27.382 yāntaṃ mādhavapīyūṣavairājāḥ pañcabindukam | śaśāṅkakamalau bhadrapāṇidṛgvaidharānvitāḥ || 27.383 eṇeśakumbha dṛk sa śrī śrīdharāścāntayādikāḥ | gadī ca ṛtadhāmā ca dinakṛdvaruṇo mṛgaḥ || 27.384 vairājaṃ madhuhantāraṃ viṣṇvābhaṃ bhadrasādhanam | mānuṣeśaṃ tathā dakṣaṃ madhusūdanavaidharau || 27.385 ṛkṣeśabhuvanau yāntaṃ madhuśatruhimālayāḥ | udayo 'gnipavitraṃ ca bandhu śrīmadhuvidviṣaḥ || 27.386 vakratuṇḍaviriñcau dvau hṛṣīkeśaśubhābhidhau | bhāntādidevasumukhau puṇḍarīkavidarbhitau || 27.387 pūrṇacandraṃ sarāmaṃ ca vaidharaṃ mohanāśanam | pīyūṣarāmadṛk śaṅkhamadhuśatrudhanādhipāḥ || 27.388 svāhādharaṃ vaidharaṃ ca govindaṃ vijayābhidham | śvasano dṛṣṭimadhubhiddheramba makarālayāḥ || 27.389 kuśeśayamadhudveṣī pītamādhavamārutāḥ | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ nṛhariṃ vasumastakam abjaja || 27.390 sūkṣmadṛk sordhvalokeśavairājamadhuvidviṣaḥ | pāpahantā tathā somadaksākara vidarbhitau || 27.391 acāṃ dvitīyamanalaṃ kamalāmṛtavaijayāḥ | dvayaṃbandhuṃ tathā dakṣaṃ sandhavāgnistrivikramam || 27.392 svayambhūrjanmahantā ca pīyūṣāgnimadhudviṣaḥ | dṛṣṭivikramayāntau ca kumbhabandhuṃ caturmukha || 27.393 atrimārutamākārabhadrahastāssavikramāḥ | vakratuṇḍānilau vighnadṛg dineśadvayaṃ tathā || 27.394 kuñjarāsyaṃ paścimāsyaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ tathākṣaram | mandaraḥ sparśarodhaś ca gadī ca ṛtadhā raviḥ || 27.395 pracaṇḍapiṇḍamākāramadhubhidvaruṇābhidham | acāmekādaśaṃ lakṣmīm uddhṛtya kamalāsana || 27.396 samīrakalaśau bandhusubhagau makarālayam | sakaviṃ pāṇḍararuciṃ mārutābhṛtavikramāḥ || 27.397 ekādaśyāntamadhudviṭ śuklaśaṅkhendavas tathā | phullalocanamākārakheṭakī mārutābhidhaḥ || 27.398 subhadravasuvighneśavaidharāḥ pretanāyakāḥ | sarāmavighnadṛgdakṣamadhusūdanamanvataḥ || 27.399 yāntavāyudhanādhyakṣaramādharagaṇādhipāḥ | bhujaṅgahutabhukpuṇyadakṣadvipasugopanāḥ || 27.400 subhago mandaradvandvamagnibhadrakarāhvayam | bandhumastakapañcāntā viṣkambhadyumnabhadrakāḥ || 27.401 vikramo dakṣahutabhuk brahmasādhanam abjaja | vakratuṇḍadharau śuklakumbhāgnidviradānanāḥ || 27.402 madhusūdana pañcānta paścimātamandarāḥ [paścimāṛtamandarāḥ] | vaidharo 'gniśirāś śaṅkhaśuklakumbhavapuśśirāḥ || 27.403 sūkṣmadṛk cordhvavijayavaruṇāvittavardhanāḥ | yaṣṭiṃ saroruhaṃ yāntaṃ paścimagniḥ samandarāḥ || 27.404 dyumaṇis sadhruvaṃ śuklaṃ varuṇodaramanvataḥ | otadehaṃ tathā dakṣaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ karālakam || 27.405 agnireṇeśa śrīvatsakumbhāgnisahapaścimau | ṛtaṃ bhallāyudhaṃ gopa pāśapāṇir janārdanāḥ || 27.406 atriṃ śrīvatsamanalaṃ vāyuṃ śuklaṃ jalāśayam | vasuṃ madhudviṣaṃ candraṃ śrīdharāgniṃ caturmukha || 27.407 samprasāraṇavairājavasuśuklamadhudviṣaḥ | vaidharo bhadracaṇḍāṃśuśvasanau dakṣaśrīdharau || 27.408 cakrī samandaramacāṃ pañcamaṃ kamalodbhava | udayaṃ vighnanayanāvādi khaṅgadharāramā || 27.409 vairājapadmahutabhukpañcabindur dhanādhipāḥ | agnirugrātmamadhubhid hṛdayāhlādamakṣaram || 27.410 gadadhvaṃsaṃ śriyaḥkāntaṃ vanasrak tatsamīraṇaḥ | kumbhavikramapañcānta ṛtabhāskaravaijayāḥ || 27.411 bhuvano 'mṛtavairājavasubhallakarālakāḥ | vairājajanmahantāraṃ dviradaḥ kumbhavaijayāḥ || 27.412 svaśirogniṃ tathā śuklapītakumbhāstu dhāmani | nāthaṃ ramādharaṃ vighna māyāñcaiva saroruham || 27.413 hutāśakapilā [hutāśakapilākṣau] dvau paścimavratadhānilau | chaladhvaṃsī pavitrāhvā hṛṣīkeśahutāśanau || 27.414 kāntādi pītaphaṇabhṛddakṣavāmanamastakān | hairambo 'gni madhudveṣī śubhadodaramaindavam || 27.415 pāṭaladvandvamoṃkāra caṇḍāṃśuṃ kapilākṣaram | kamalo 'gni sabhuva [sabhuvanaṃ] dakṣagopanayaṣṭikāḥ || 27.416 hutāśatārkṣyamadhubhinnāsikyaṃ caturānana | śrībījaṃ ca gadadhvaṃsaṃ pītaurvaṃ dhruvamādimat || 27.417 pāṭalo bandhuvijaya vairājamṛgavallabhāḥ | kakubho mādhavavaraṃ ṭhaṭhānto manur īritaḥ || 27.418 nārado 'sya munir draṣṭā varivaṃ chanda īritam | devatā devadeveśaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kamalasambhava || 27.419 aṅgāni pūrvavac cāsya puraścaryā ca pūrvavat | jātipuṣpair bilvaphalaiḥ samidbhir homam ācaret || 27.420 chāyāyāṃ bilvavṛkṣasya japahomādika bhavet | aṇimādikamaiśvaryaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || 27.421 phalaṃ dadāti mantro 'yaṃ mantravidbhiḥ susādhitaḥ |
iti śrīpañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde matsyādimūrttimantrakathanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? aṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
bajñamūrtyādi mantroddhāraḥ bhagavān he brahman yajñavapuṣamantraḥ samprati kathyase | mahāphalaṃ procyamānam imaṃ tvamavadhāraya || 28.1 ātmane iti paryantam aṣṭākṣaravaduddharet | kālādyanalamadhyaṃ ca vigrahāntaṃ padaṃ tataḥ || 28.2 caturthyantaṃ mūrtiśīrṣaṃ yajñādiparamanvataḥ | tadvibhaktayantamaparaṃ ṭhaṭhānttaṃ <ṭhaṭhāntaṃ> manur īritaḥ || 28.3 bījamasyānalaṃ mukhyamanusvārāntamuddharet | aṅgāni cānalādīni ṣaṭbhārāntāny anukramāt || 28.4 sānusvārāṇi yojyāni kratudraṣṭā virāṭ punaḥ | chandaś ca yajñamūrtyātmā devatā bhagavān hariḥ || 28.5 lakṣatrayaṃ japaḥ kāryo mantrasyāsya prasādhane | phalaṃ prasūte dharmādipuruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || 28.6 annādhipatimantrasya prabhāvo rūpam eva ca | kathyate samprati brahman na vācyaṃ yasya kasyacit || 28.7 praṇavādir manus sarvo viśeṣastūcyate 'dhunā | mukhyamarṇaṃ bhadrapāṇiṃ dviruktaṃ tadanantaram || 28.8 ādi devaṃ dhanapatiṃ māyām uddhṛtya paścimam | viṣṇuṃ vijayanāmānamādyaṃ vāyum anantaram || 28.9 devadattaṃ ca daksādimādyaṃ dakṣaṃ punas tadā | ādidevaṃ manuṣyeśaṃ dviruktaṃ mukhyamanvataḥ || 28.10 mandaraṃ pāpahananamṛtadhā vaiṣṇavākṣaram | śaṅkhamādimacāmanvak dviḥproktaṃ pretanāyakam || 28.11 praṇavādiṃ ṭhaṭhetyantam iti mantraś caturmukha | bījamasya pravakṣyāmi dvādaśātmānam uddharet || 28.12 jvalanaṃ vāmanaṃ bindum etad evāṅgam ucyate | ākārādikramād dīrghasvarabhaktir viśeṣakṛt || 28.13 astro viśeṣo viṣṇuś ca visargaś ca samīritaḥ | vyāso draṣṭāsya mantrasya chandas tu bṛhatī tathā || 28.14 devatānnapatiḥ prokto mantrasyāsya caturmukha | anyathā śṛṇu vakṣyāmi bahvannaphaladaṃ śubham || 28.15 natyantaṃ praṇavaṃ pūrvaṃ varuṇaṃ ca trivikamam | krodharūpaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca viṣṇuṃ varuṇamanvataḥ || 28.16 mādhavaṃ pūrṇacandraṃ ca pīyūṣātmānam eva ca | ādiṃ vaiśvānaraṃ mukhyaṃ pavitraṃ praṇavādi ca || 28.17 ekanetramakāraś ca śvasanaṃ mādhavaṃ tataḥ | mandaraṃ praṇavādyaṃ ca dīptimantaṃ caturmukha || 28.18 gopānaṃ jṛmbhalaṃ viṣṇuṃ māhendraṃ gopanaṃ tataḥ | vāyumādyaṃ ṭhaṭhātañ ca varṇoddhāra itīritaḥ || 28.19 bījam aṅgāni pūrvoktamṛṣirasya parāśaraḥ | chandaś ca devī gāyatraṃ devatānnapatir bhavet || 28.20 pūrṇendubimbamadhyasthe sitapadme vikarasvare | āsīnaṃ dhavalākāraṃ nīlakuñcitamūrdhajam || 28.21 dukūla kṣaumavasanaṃ bālayogya vibhūṣaṇam | kaladhautamayaṃ pātraṃ pāyasānnena pūritam || 28.22 bibhrāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe haste dadhyodanamathetare | dhyāyet lakṣatrayaṃ dhīmān japet tadgatamānasaḥ || 28.23 annena juhuyāc cāgnau niyataṃ mantravittamaḥ | bahvannatvamavāpnoti sarvam iṣṭaṃ labheta ca || 28.24 śaktīśamantram adhunā kathayāmi caturmukha | āditaḥ saptavarṇānām uddhāraḥ pūrvam īritaḥ || 28.25 krodhanaṃ hṛdayāhlādaṃ bhubanaṃ bhāskaraṃ tataḥ | guhālayamanusvāraṃ ravimagniṃ ca mārutam || 28.26 sayaṣṭiṃ pītamādyarṇaṃ kamalaṃ krodharūpiṇam | mādhavīṃ pañcabinduñ ca hananaṃ cāprameyakam || 28.27 vairājamaprameyañ ca puruṣātmā ca mādhavaḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ caturthyantaṃ ṭhaṭheti manur īritaḥ || 28.28 aṃśumān vītihotraś ca vāmano bindumastakaḥ | aṅgaṃ ca bījaṃ pūrvoktamṛṣiś cāpi parāśaraḥ || 28.29 chandaś ca devī gāyatraṃ śaktīśo devatā tathā | japet dvādaśalakṣaṃ tu prāpnuyāt sarvam īpsitam || 28.30 kālanemimanurbrahman kathyate sarvasādhakaḥ | ādyarṇāḥ pūrvavatsapta pīyūṣātmā trivikramaḥ || 28.31 ugradehaḥ pracaṇḍaś ca viṣṇuḥ kalaśamādhavau | kamalaṃ gopanayutaṃ māhendraṃ viṣṇumastakam || 28.32 vighneśaṃ devadattaṃ ca dakṣaṃ māyāpariṣkṛtam | pataṅgāmṛtadhāmānaṃ vaidharaṃ ca caturgatim || 28.33 ādyaṃ sudhārasaṃ māyā atrirgopanahavyavāṭ | ādyaṃ sumukhamādyaṃ ca śvasanaṃ cāprameyakam || 28.34 humphaḍantaṃ ṭhaṭhaparaṃ manur evaṃ samuddhṛtaḥ | bījaṃ vakṣye dinakaraṃ bhuvanaṃ yaṣṭimastakam || 28.35 kruddhādi pūrvavac cāṅgaṃ nārado mantradarśanaḥ | chando virāḍdevatā ca kālanemiś caturmukha || 28.36 japasaṃkhyā phalaṃ cāpi dviṣaṭkākṣaravadbhavet | trailokyamohanaṃ mantraṃ kathayāmi yathātatham || 28.37 udgīthaṃ kamalaṃ pītaṃ vāmanaṃ bindumastakam | ekākṣaro manur ayaṃ devatāṅgam anukramāt || 28.38 ṣaḍbhir yutamacāmādyaiḥ sānusvāraṃ prayojayet | ṛṣir vṛddhamanuśchando daivaṃ gāyatram īritam || 28.39 trailokyamohano devo devatā japatarpaṇam | homaś ca phalam apy asya nidhisthānopalambhanam || 28.40 japan bhūyas tathā sarvaṃ durlabhaṃ phalam aśnute | ṣoḍaśārṇo manur brahman trilokīmohanātmakaḥ || 28.41 ucyate pūrvavat sapta varṇānādyān samuddharet | trailokyamohanapadaṃ caturthyantaṃ tataḥ param || 28.42 tadvibhaktipadaṃ viṣṇupadaṃ svāhāntam uddharet | manur eṣasya evāṅgaṃ bījaṃ pūrvavad īritam || 28.43 muniḥ pulastyaśchandaś ca pūrvavad devatā tathā | japasaṃkhyā phalaṃ caiva mūlamantravid iṣyate || 28.44 mantro navākṣaraś cānyas trilokīmohanātmakaḥ | trailokyamohanapadaṃ caturthyantaṃ namas tathā || 28.45 bījamaṅgamayaṃ caiva sarvakāmaphalapradam | nigamādiṃ caturthyantaṃ padaṃ trailokyamohanam || 28.46 aṃśumālinamagniṃ ca pañcabinduṃ sayaṣṭikam | śaṅkhinaṃ pulahaṃ pañcabinduyaṣṭisamanvitam || 28.47 tadbījaṃ ca dvirabhyasya natiś ca tadanantaram | dvādaśārṇātmako mantrastrilokīmohanātmakaḥ || 28.48 pratyakṣaraṃ lakṣajapo dvādaśākṣaravatphalam | kāmakāmeśvarī nāma mantraḥ sarvaphalapradaḥ || 28.49 udgīthaṃ pūrvam uccārya bhāskaraṃ jvalanaṃ tataḥ | mahāmāyāṃ yaṣṭiyutām ity ekākṣaram uddharet || 28.50 etad evāṅgam uditaṃ śaunako munir ucyate | chandaś ca devī gāyatraṃ devatā puruṣottamaḥ || 28.51 lakṣam ekaṃ japen mantrī sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt | śaṅkhakundendudhavalaṃ caturbāhuṃ kirīṭinam || 28.52 garuḍārūḍhamāropya devīṃ vāmorubiṣṭare | dāḍimīkusumaprakhyāṃ sarvākalpapariṣkṛtām || 28.53 pāśāṅkuśadharāṃ lakṣmīṃ kāmavihvalalocanām | kāmakāmeśvarīm evaṃ dhyāyed ekāgramānasaḥ || 28.54 trailokyamohanaṃ nāma manus samprati kathyate | brahmakośam udīryādau natyantaṃ tadanantaram || 28.55 padāni sambuddhyantāni krameṇoddhārayet sudhīḥ | puruṣādyuttamapadaṃ rūpamapratimeti ca || 28.56 lakṣyādi ca nivāsāntāṃ sakalājagatpadam [sakalādiṃ] | kṣobhaṇāntaṃ ca sarvādipadaṃ strīhṛdayāvadhi || 28.57 vidāraṇaśiraś cāpi trayādi bhuvanāvadhi | unmādakaraparyantaṃ surāsurapadaṃ tataḥ || 28.58 manujeti samuccārya sundarījanamanvataḥ | manāṃsīti samuccārya tāpayeti caturmukha || 28.59 dīpayeti padaṃ paścāc choṣayeti ca māraya | stambhaya drāvayākarṣaparyantaṃ ca kriyāpadam || 28.60 dvir vaktavyaṃ tato brahman paramaṃ subhagāvadhi | sambuddhyantaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ karoti ca padaṃ tataḥ || 28.61 sarvakāmapradaṃ procya padaṃ cāmukamityataḥ | haneti dviḥsamuccārya cakreṇa gadayeti ca || 28.62 khaḍgena sarvabāṇaiś ca dvirbhindeti paṭhet tataḥ | pāśeneti tato bandha bandheti ca padadvayam || 28.63 aṅkuśeneti samprocya tāḍayeti dvir abhyaset | kurviti dviḥ samuccārya kiṃ tiṣṭha padamanvataḥ || 28.64 tāvad yāvat pade procya samīhitapadaṃ tataḥ | me siddhir bhavatūccārya me humphaḍiti śīrṣakam || 28.65 ity eṣa mālāmantrasya samuddhāraḥ pradarśitaḥ | nigamādiranantaṃ ca aurvaścandrārdhaśekharam || 28.66 bījam evaṃ samuddhṛtya ṣaḍaṅgāni manuḥ punaḥ | ṣoḍhā vibhajya kartavyā ṛṣiḥ syān nalakūbaraḥ || 28.67 chando 'ticchandanāmāsya devatā puruṣottamaḥ | dhyāyet tam eva puruṣaṃ sādhayen mantravittamaḥ || 28.68 aṣṭabāhuṃ viśālākṣaṃ garuḍārūḍham acyutam | akalaṅkaśaśiprakhyaṃ pūrṇendusadṛśānanam || 28.69 sabhrūlalāṭamakuṭaṃ lāvaṇyāmṛtasāgaram | pītakauśeyavasanaṃ kapolāmṛṣṭakuṇḍalam || 28.70 cakraṃ ca musalaṃ bāṇamaṅkuśaṃ dakṣiṇe bhuje | śaṅkhaṃ kaumodakīṃ śārṅgaṃ pāśaṃ vāmeṣu bibhratam || 28.71 sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇaṃ sarvākalpapariṣkṛtam | divyacandanaliptāṅgaṃ divyasragdāmavibhūṣitam || 28.72 devyo 'ṣṭau paritastasya bālavyajanapāṇayaḥ | vījayanti sadā devaṃ kāmavihvalalocanāḥ || 28.73 etābhyo bahir aṣṭau ca dikṣu cakrādi dhāriṇaḥ | puruṣā devadeveśaṃ praṇipatya bahiḥ sthitāḥ || 28.74 evaṃ saparivāraṃ taṃ dhyātvā devaṃ samāhitaḥ | saptāhaṃ mantrajāpena vaśyā manujayoṣitaḥ || 28.75 divaseṣu ca tāvatsu punar yakṣādiyoṣitaḥ | tiṣṭhanti saṃmukhā sarvā manmathāviṣṭacetasaḥ || 28.76 bhajanti mantriṇaṃ mantra vaibhavānmohayanti ca | japī bhūyas tathā kāmān sarvān vindanty asaṃśayam || 28.77 kiṃ punar bahunoktena devaḥ pratyakṣatāmiyāt | śāntiḥ puṣṭiś ca dharmaś ca kāmārthau mokṣa eva ca || 28.78 pātālākāśagamanamantardhānamadṛśyatām | nidhānaṃ balisiddhiś ca khananaṃ cauṣadhaṃ tathā || 28.79 pādukāṃ gulikāṃ cāpi rasāyanamanuttamam | akṣasūtraṃ daraṃ khaḍgaṃ tathā vetālasādhanam || 28.80 phalāni durlabhāny evaṃ sidhyanti manuvaibhavāt | pratyekaṃ na pradarśyante granthavistarabhīrubhiḥ || 28.81 phalānāṃ digiyaṃ proktā durlabhānāṃ caturmukha | trailokyamohanākhyasya kāmakāmeśvarasya ca || 28.82 ekākṣaramukhasyoktaṃ phalaṃ mantrasya padmaja | mantraṃ yajñavarāhasya vakṣyāmi kamalāsana || 28.83 gṛhītvā pūrvavat sarvavarṇānādyānanukramāt | sparśāntaṃ bhāskaraṃ cādyaṃ kalaśaṃ praṇavādi ca || 28.84 analaṃ cādidevāntaṃ bhāskaraṃ madhusūdanam | śvasanaṃ varṇamādyaṃ ca oṣadhīśamacāṃ mukham || 28.85 vahniṃ pracetasaṃ mukhyaṃ mārutaṃ praṇavādi ca | musaliṃ candradhavalamacāmādimanantaram || 28.86 śrīvatsamādimanalaṃ mahāmāyāgnigopanam | daraṃ viṣṇuṃ khaḍgadharaṃ vijayaṃ śrīdharaṃ tathā || 28.87 pīyūṣarūpamamalaṃ mādhavaṃ vaidharaṃ tathā | ādiṃ pavitradṛṣṭiṃ ca praṇavādi vibhūṣitam || 28.88 śvasanaṃ cāprameyaṃ ca kalātmā viṣṇumastakaḥ | varuṇaṃ dahanākrāntaṃ vaidharaṃ mādhavākṣaraṃ || 28.89 varuṇaṃ cādivarṇaṃ ca tathaivogrātmasaṃmitam | analaṃ mādhavopetaṃ mandaraṃ prathamaṃ marut || 28.90 madhusūdanavikrāntaṃ pavanaṃ śvetarociṣam | varuṇaṃ vītihotraṃ ca subhadraṃ ca guhālayam || 28.91 vairājamādi devāntaṃ vijayaṃ mandaraṃ tathā | bhadrapāṇiṃ mṛgeśaṃ ca vaidharaṃ yaṣṭimastakam || 28.92 ugrātmā parvataṃ cādiṃ ṛtadhāmapariṣkṛtam | vighneśaṃ mārutaṃ caikanetra śuklaśiras tathā || 28.93 subhadraṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ nābhipaṅkajasambhava | mādhavīmaprameyaṃ ca vanamālī jhaṣas tathā || 28.94 māhendraṃ gopanayutaṃ mārutaṃ prathamasvaram | bhallāyudhaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ subhadraṃ bhuvanaṃ vasum || 28.95 pracetasaṃ kalātmānamamṛtaṃ savisargakam | pavitramādiṃ vairājaṃ mukhyaṃ pavanamādhavau || 28.96 subhadramaurvaṃ dakṣaṃ ca mukhadvipadam īrayet | śaśāṅkadvipadaṃ vahniṃ bhuvanaṃ dvipadaṃ paṭhet || 28.97 acāṃ dvitīyaṃ dṛṣṭi ca māyāṃ kalaśamādiśat | havyavāḍgopanayutaṃ bhāskaraṃ madhusūdanam || 28.98 prabhañjanamakāraṃ ca sūkṣmadṛgbhuvanaṃ tathā | mādhavīṃ rāmasahitaṃ paścimānanamādimat || 28.99 ekanetramikāraṃ ca vijayaṃ kalaśaṃ tathā | mandaraṃ devadattaṃ ca vaidharaṃ viṣṇumastakam || 28.100 dvir brūyāt gopanākāntaṃ paścimānanamādimat | prabhañjanamakāraṃ ca ṭhaṭhānto manur īritaḥ || 28.101 sūkṣmadṛgbhuvanaṃ sargaṃ bījam etat samuddhṛtam | mantraṃ ṣoḍhā vibhajyāṅgakalpanā kāśyapo muniḥ || 28.102 chando virāṭ stomaghoṇī devatā kamalāsana | japo lakṣadviṣaṭkaṃ syāt phalaṃ sarvaṃ yathāpuram || 28.103 darodaranṛsiṃhasya manus samprati kathyate | oṅkāraṃ pūrvam uddhṛtya kamalaṃ śatrudāhakam || 28.104 guhālayaṃ sayaṣṭiṃ ca gopatiṃ bhuvanaṃ dhruvam | phullalocanamādyaṃ ca hṛdayāhlādanaṃ tathā || 28.105 bhadrapāṇiṃ svarādiṃ ca jvalanaṃ cādimaṃ tathā | oṣadhīśamikāraṃ ca yaṣṭiṃ bhāskaragopanau || 28.106 śvasanaṃ ca natirmantro nārasiṃha udīritaḥ | ayam eva manur bījaṃ chando gāyatram īritam || 28.107 devatā nṛharir draṣṭā kapilo dhyānam ucyate | darodare sukhāsīnaṃ śatapatre vikasvare || 28.108 taptajāmbūnadanibhaṃ caturbāhumudāyudham | paryaṅkabandhasubhagaṃ prasāritabhujadvayam || 28.109 jānunorupariṣṭāc ca sarvākalpapariṣkṛtam | vyāttānanaṃ trinayanaṃ nakhadambholibhīṣaṇam || 28.110 siṃhasyārdhaṃ narasyārdhaṃ meghagambhīragarjitam | evaṃ dhyātvā japed aṣṭalakṣaṃ mantrī samāhitaḥ || 28.111 sāvitre maṇḍale devamāsīnaṃ sarvakāmadam | dhyāyel labheta dharmādi puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || 28.112 bahunātra kimuktena sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt | caturṇāṃ puruṣādīnāṃ manuḥ samprati kathyate || 28.113 praṇavādīn saptavarṇān samuddhṛtya yathāpuram | svaṃ svaṃ nāma caturthyantaṃ mantrāneṣāṃ prakalpayet || 28.114 teṣāṃ bījāni vakṣyāmi varṇoddhāraiḥ kramād aham | tigmāṃśurgopanayutassadaṇḍaḥ puruṣātmanaḥ || 28.115 mārtāṇḍaḥ pañcabinduś ca senduḥ satyaḥ sa kathyate | vairājaṃ pāvakaṃ pañcabinduṃ nāsikyam eva ca || 28.116 trayītanuṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ yaṣṭiṃ cānantanāmani | ṛṣiś chando devatā ca phalam aṣṭākṣare tathā || 28.117 hayagrīvasya mantrasya varṇoddhāraḥ pradarśyate | saptavarṇān samuddhṛtya vijayaṃ bahulaṃ tataḥ || 28.118 kālātmā caikadṛgvahniṃ gopatiṃ viṣṇumastakam | śvasanaṃ praṇavādiṃ ca lakṣmīṃ bindumanantaram || 28.119 jvalanaṃ govanayutaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā | svāhāntamaśvaśirasaḥ kathitaḥ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ || 28.120 sa eva bījamaṅgāni kruddholkādi yathāpuram | ṛṣir bṛhaspatir hy asya chando gāyatram ucyate || 28.121 devo hayaśirānāma devatā kamalāsana | daśalakṣaṃ japen mantraṃ mahadjñānam avāpnuyāt || 28.122 oṅkārapūrvaṃ natyantaṃ caturthī devatā kramāt | ṭhaṭhānto mantrarājo 'yaṃ daśākṣaravidarbhitaḥ || 28.123 bījāni pūrvavatsarvaṃ kartavyaṃ kamalāsana | ato 'nyaṃ vājiśiraso mālāmantraṃ bravīmi te || 28.124 arṇassaptakamuddhṛtya padaṃ hayaśirās tathā | caturthyantaṃ sarvavidyālayeti padamanvataḥ || 28.125 sakalāmaraśabdādigurave padam uddharet | samasta pratiśabdādi hantānantyetyanantaram || 28.126 vīryaṃ tejaḥ padaṃ paścāj jñānaiśvaryapadaṃ tataḥ | śaktiś caiva balaṃ caiva sarvādyāvāsamanvataḥ || 28.127 tadvibhaktiṃ tataḥ paścāt paramātmapadaṃ tataḥ | caturthyantaṃ vāsudevaśabdastādṛgvibhaktikaḥ || 28.128 jñānajñeyapadaṃ tadvadvyaktāvyaktaparāya ca | sarvaduṣṭāsuraṃ procya duritaṃ vrajinaṃ tathā || 28.129 pramāthi tadvibhaktyantaṃ tatsadrucirapūrvakam | padaṃ ca turagāyeti jñānam uccārya mūrtaye || 28.130 iti coccārya tasyānu sahasraṃ koṭimanvataḥ | padaṃ ca vidyādinikaraṃ muñca gaccha pade tataḥ || 28.131 sphoṭirvijṛmbhiloḍantaṃ dvir vaktavyaṃ ca tiṅpadam | sarvāditejomadhyaṃ ca nidhyantaṃ ca padatrayam || 28.132 caturthyantaṃ samuccārya nirdhūtapadamanvataḥ | vikīrṇapadam uccārya prāk pradīptapadaṃ tataḥ || 28.133 kesaraṃ ca kaṭaṃ śabdaṃ kalāpapadamanvataḥ | pradīptasūryamaśuṃ ca pratīkāśapadaṃ tathā || 28.134 bhāskarākāraśabdaṃ ca ūṣmamūrdhvajamavnataḥ | śaṅkhamābhamatāṅghriñ ca prasaravrātadīptimān || 28.135 dravatkanakasuccārya piṅgalāyatamānanam | mahāsvara samākāraṃ viśuddhadaśanaṃ tataḥ || 28.136 paddhatiṃ nirgatāṃ coktvā virājitapadaṃ tathā | lokatrayadravaddīptapadaṃ cāmīkarādimat || 28.137 piṅgalāyatam uccārya visphāritapadaṃ paṭhet | locanādimahāśabdaṃ vibhiṣaṇapadānvitam || 28.138 nāsikāpuṭamadrīndraśikharākārasaṃyutam | ruciraṃ padam uccārya vikuñcitapadaṃ tathā || 28.139 mahāśravaṇasaṃyuktaṃ śreyaseti paṭhet padam | tacchabdaṃ ca caturthyantaṃ duṣṭasatvānanantaram || 28.140 bhinddhicchinddhis tathā mārimardistrāsiścadhātavaḥ | loḍantādviḥ samuccārya svauṃ vaumiti padadvayam || 28.141 dhvasi hanti tathā dhmāpi hanti grāhi ca tāḍaya | pacirmandiś ca te ete loḍantādviḥ kṛtās tathā || 28.142 paravidyāpadaṃ procyacchinddhirṇyantaḥ prayujyatām | amītyuktvā tathā nārī loṇmadhyamaśirāḥ smṛtaḥ || 28.143 ehy ehi bhagavan śabdaṃ vajraśabdam anantaram | aṅkuśeneti tadanu procya cākarṣayeti ca || 28.144 hṛdayādyādiranvak syād bhaktipūrvajaneti ca | jihvādi nilayaṃ procya baḍavānalamanvataḥ || 28.145 sambuddhyantaṃ viśvamūrtiṃ saumanasyam anantaram | bhagavann iti vaktavyam oṅkāra hṛdayaṃ tataḥ || 28.146 sadā yadbrahmasadanādātmeti ca padaṃ punaḥ | cidghanādi caturthyantaṃ bhagavatpadam īrayet || 28.147 ṭhaṭhāntam uddhared evaṃ hayagrīvaṃ caturmukha | pūrvoktam evāsya bījaṃ pūrvavac cāṅgapaddhatiḥ || 28.148 vyāso munir hayagrīvo devatā chanda utkṛtiḥ | dhyāyan hayaśirovakrādadvāntaṃ phenamulbaṇam || 28.149 pibanniva sudhīr mantrarājaṃ mantravid uccaret | ayutaṃ niyutaṃ vāpi japen mantrasyasiddhaye || 28.150 vidyāpāramavāpnoti vāgīśatvaṃ ca padmaja | vyākhyātṛtvaṃ ca kartṛtvaṃ śāstrāṇāṃ bahuvartmanām || 28.151 sakṛdgrahaṇamātreṇa vidyāḥ sarvāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ | avismṛtiś ca tāsu syāt puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye || 28.152 nāsādhyaṃ kiñcid asyāsti dīrghamāyuś ca vindati | ṣaṇṇāṃ mukundamukhyānaṃ manuḥ samprati kathyate || 28.153 saptārṇān pūrvam uccārya nāmadheyāni ṣaṭ tathā | caturthyantāni yojyāni śiṣṭārṇān evam uddharet || 28.154 jīmūtamādiṃ nāsikye varuṇaṃ praṇavādi ca | sabinduṃ bhāskaraṃ rephaṃ pañcabinduṃ sayaṣṭikam || 28.155 ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca mukundasya manur evaṃ samuddhṛtaḥ | bhāskaraṃ pāvakaṃ pañcabindur yaṣṭisamanvitaḥ || 28.156 akṣaraṃ ca dvir abhyasyen mārtāṇḍaṃ ca guhānvayam | sānusvāraṃ dvir abhyasyed viṣṇuśabdam anantaram || 28.157 caturthyantaṃ ṭhaṭhāntañ ca babhror manur udīritaḥ | parvataṃ bhuvanaṃ bhānumūrdhvalokeśanāsike || 28.158 bhāskaraṃ pāvakaṃ pañcabinduṃ nāsikyam uddharet | phaṭkāraṃ ca hutāntaṃ ca manuś caivaṃ vṛṣākapeḥ || 28.159 śubhadaṃ pāvakaṃ caiva pañcabinduṃ sadarthakam | akṣaraṃ tad dvir uccāryaṃ ṭhaṭhānto mantra īritaḥ || 28.160 śaures tathāparaṃ vakṣye dāśārhaṃ manum abjaja | savitāraṃ bṛhadbhānuṃ sayaṣṭiṃ pañcabindukam || 28.161 hutāntaś ca manuḥ prokto vaikuṇṭhamanur ucyate | paramātmā caturthyantaṃ varuṇaṃ prathamaṃ svaram || 28.162 nāsikyaṃ kumbhamākāramardhenduṃ bhāskaraṃ tataḥ | hṛṣīkeśamanusvāraṃ nārāyaṇapadaṃ tataḥ || 28.163 caturthyantaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhamanur īritaḥ | ṛṣiś chando devatā ca bījam aṅgāni ṣaṭ tathā || 28.164 aṣṭākṣaravad eteṣāṃ phalāni ca caturmukha | athāparājitaṃ mantraṃ vakṣyāmi kamalāsana || 28.165 nigamādīn saptavarṇān gṛhītvādau yathāpuram | caturthyantānantapūrvamantaḥśabdaṃ samuddharet || 28.166 sahasrādi ca śīrṣāntaṃ tadvibhaktipadaṃ punaḥ | tatsugandhaṃ tathā kṣīramudārṇavapadānvitam || 28.167 śāyineti padaṃ procya śeṣabhogapadaṃ tathā | paryaṅketi caturthyantaṃ tadvibhaktiś ca vāhanam || 28.168 garuḍādipadaṃ paścād vāsudevapadaṃ tataḥ | tadvibhaktiś ca natyantaṃ vāsaḥ pītādi tādṛśam || 28.169 sampūrvaṃ karṣaṇapadaṃ sambuddhyantam anantaram | pradyumnādyaniruddhaṃ ca tadvibhaktipadaṃ smṛtam || 28.170 māyādiśīrṣaṃ sambuddhau varāhaṃ tadvad iṣyate | nṛsiṃhavāmanapade trivikramam anantaram || 28.171 rāmaśabdaṃ triruccārya kṛṣṇeti padam uddharet | varapradeti natyantamastītyanvakkriyāpadam || 28.172 te ca śabdaṃ caturthyantamasureti padaṃ tataḥ | daityayakṣapade coktvā rākṣaseti padaṃ tataḥ || 28.173 bhūtaṃ piśācaṃ siddhaṃ ca yoginī ḍhākinīti ca | brahmādirākṣasapadaṃ vināyakapadaṃ tataḥ || 28.174 pūtanārevatīskandha purogama samuddhṛtiḥ | grahādīni ca nakṣatragrahānity apy anukramāt || 28.175 anyāṃ ceti mahatpūrvaṃ gṛhāniti paṭhet padam | haniṃ dahiṃ paciṃ caiva mathihyantaṃ śabanvitam || 28.176 anibhir dviḥ pathīṃś caiva patibhyantaṃ samanvitam | ākhyātaṃ dviḥ samuccārya gṛhāṇeti tathaiva ca || 28.177 āviśadhvaṃsiraparā druhyantaloṭparāḥ | catvāro dhātavo mantre dvir vaktavyāś caturmukha || 28.178 cakraṃ gadāṃ ca vajraṃ ca tṛtīyāntam udīrayet | bhasmīkurvity anukramya bāhuṃ sambuddhiśīrṣakam || 28.179 sahasrārapadaṃ sarvaṃ mukhya praharaṇāyudham | jayeti vijayeti dve pade dviḥ procya padmaja || 28.180 anantamaparā pūrvaṃ jitaṃ pratihataṃ tathā | nañ pūrvaṃ netṛparyantaṃ sahasrādipadaṃ tataḥ || 28.181 prajvalir jvalir ity ete loḍante dviḥ samuddharet | viśvarūpaṃ samuddhṛtya madhusūdanamanvataḥ || 28.182 mahāpuruṣavaikuṇṭhanārāyaṇapadaṃ tataḥ | padmādi nābhiparyantaṃ hṛṣīkeśapadaṃ tataḥ || 28.183 sarvamuktvā tathābhūtaṃ vaśīkaraṇam uddharet | śaṅkhacakragadāmuktvā dhareti tadanantaram || 28.184 uddhṛtya sarvabhūtaṃ ca namaskṛtapadaṃ tathā | sarvamanvaṅnāgapadaṃ pramardana padānvitam || 28.185 sarvaṃ prapaṭhyānupūrvyādasurotsādhanaṃ tataḥ | sarvadevam anukramya maheśvaram udīrayet || 28.186 sarvaṃ grahaṃ samuccārya nivāraṇapadaṃ tathā | yantramanyañ ca sarvādi prabhañjanapadaṃ tataḥ || 28.187 sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ sarvajvaravināśanam | sarvabandham anukramya vimokṣaṇapadaṃ tathā || 28.188 duḥsvapnamadhyaṃ sarvādhi vināśanamanuddharet | namaskṛtāntaṃ sarvādibhūtamadhyaṃ padatrayam || 28.189 padadvayaṃ pūrvavat syād apakarṣaṇam ācaret | janārdaneti sambuddhau namaścāstviti te padam || 28.190 aprameyamanusvārasahitaṃ bījam īritam | mantraṃ ṣoḍhā vibhajyāṅgamṛṣiḥ pradyumna ucyate || 28.191 chando 'ticchanda etasya viśvarūpaś ca devatā | sādhayen mantravinmantram aṣṭākṣarasamādhinā || 28.192 aparājitamantreṇa nāsādhyaṃ vidyate phalam | vaśyamuccāṭanaṃ caiva tathā māraṇakarma ca ||28.193 kṛtyādibhūtadoṣāṇāṃ nivāraṇam anantaram | phalāni lipsus sarvāṇi mantramenaṃ samāśrayet || 28.194
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde yajñamūrttyādi mantroddhāro nāma 'ṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
parivāramantravarṇanam śrī bhagavān devīnāṃ ca śriyādīnāṃ mantraviṣṭarakalpanam | mantrāṃś ca parivārāṇāṃ prathamāvaraṇādiṣu || 29.1 anukrameṇa vakṣyāmi yathā tadavadhāraya | chandasāmādirādyarṇaṃ turyamagner anantaram || 29.2 agniṃ ca mahatīṃ māyāmanusvāraṃ ca paścimam | ekākṣaro manur brahman śriyas sarvaphalapradaḥ || 29.3 ṛṣir maṅkaṇakaḥ proktaś chando gāyatramucyate | śrīrasya devatāṅgāni svenurūpeṇa kalpayet || 29.4 bilvānokahamūle tu lakṣajāpena sādhayet | samidbhiś ca tadīyābhiḥ juhuyāl lakṣasaṃkhyayā || 29.5 śrīpuṣpaiḥ pāyasānnaiś ca juhuyād ukta saṃkhyayā | śriyam āpnoti mahatīṃ śrīkāmo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 29.6 praṇavādicaturthyantaṃ nāma natyantam īritam | caturakṣaramantro 'yam aparaṃ śrīsamārūtam || 29.7 ṛṣirasya dhanādhyakṣaḥ chandaḥ śrīr devatā tathā | pratyakṣaraṃ japel lakṣaṃ sādhako mantrasiddhaye || 29.8 prāgvac ca bījam aṅgāni phalam apy asya pūrvavat | nigamādiṃ bhadrahastaṃ hairambaṃ mandarādhipam || 29.9 śubhadaṃ dahanaṃ māyāṃ mārutaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā |
