saptākṣaro 'yaṃ śrīmantraḥ sarvam anyad yathāpuram || 29.10 gṛhītvaikākṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ bhānum agniṃ ca vāmanam | bhalvāyudhaṃ ca māhendraṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ sayaṣṭikam || 29.11 śaśāṅkamaurvaṃ nāsikyaṃ subhadraṃ gadinaṃ param | jalādhidaivamādyarṇaṃ vairājaṃ godhanaṃ dharam || 29.12 pulahaṃ kamalaṃ śakraṃ dāhakaṃ pāṭalapriyam | godhanaṃ kamalaṃ citrabhānuṃ māyāvibhūṣitam || 29.13 prabhañjanaṃ mṛgeśaṃ ca svāhāyāṃ viramet tataḥ | ṣoḍaśākṣaramantro 'yaṃ śriyaḥ kamalasambhava || 29.14 oṅkārapūrvaṃ natyantaṃ kamalaṃ mandaraṃ tathā | māhendraṃ varuṇaṃ cādidevaṃ candraṃ trivikramam || 29.15 vighneśaṃ pañcabinduṃ ca hutāntaṃ tvidam īritam | pūrvavatsarvaṃ bījādi parigrāhyaṃ caturmukha || 29.16 ity uddhṛto manuś cānyaḥ śriyaḥ kamalasambhava | uddhṛtya pūrvam udgīthaṃ śrīvatsamanalaṃ tathā || 29.17 vāmanaṃ yaṣṭiśirasaṃ dineśaṃ yāntam abjaja | pañcabinduṃ sayaṣṭiṃ ca śubhadaṃ vasumastakam || 29.18 mahāmāyāṅkitaṃ daṇḍaṃ ṭhaṭha ity avasānakam | maṅkaṇo 'sya ṛṣiś chando gāyatrī śrīś ca devatā || 29.19 japel lakṣatrayaṃ mantraṃ bilvāraṇye 'tha sādhayet | vaśyākarṣaṇabhūlābhakhaniratnādisiddhayaḥ || 29.20 dhyānamasya pravakṣyāmi śriyo māhendramaṇḍale | āsīnāyāḥ parijanānindrādīnarcayet kramāt || 29.21 caturthyantaṃ svanāmoktvā natyantaṃ mantram abjaja | maṇḍale tantra padmasya pūrvādiṣu daleṣu ca || 29.22 vāsudevādayo vyūhāś catvāro dikṣvavasthitāḥ | teṣāṃ nāma caturthyantaṃ natyantaṃ praṇavānvitam || 29.23 gulguluś ca karaṇḍaś ca damakaś śalalas tathā | koṇavarṇeṣu saṃsthāpya mantrāṃs tannāmapūrvakam || 29.24 ratis sarasvatī bhūmiḥ prītiḥ kīrtiś caturmukha | śāntiḥ puṣṭiś ca tuṣṭiś ca śriyodhastāc ca śaktayaḥ || 29.25 nāmāni tāsāṃ manavo yathāpūrvam udīritāḥ | pārśve ca dakṣiṇe tasyāḥ śriyaḥ padmanidhiḥ sthitaḥ || 29.26 vāme śaṅkhanidhir nāma tayor mantro yathāpuram | dhanado māṇibhadraś ca jṛmbhalo nalakūbaraḥ || 29.27 pūrṇabhadraś calendraś ca kalisṛk śibikuṇḍalaḥ | pūrvādidikṣu bhavinām eteṣāṃ manur ucyate || 29.28 nigamādiṃ subhadraṃ ca ekadantaṃ sayaṣṭikam | dhanadasya manuḥprokto nāma natyantam eva ca || 29.29 bhallāyudhaṃ padmanābhaṃ pañcabinduṃ sadaṇḍakam | nalakūbaramantraś ca kathitaḥ kamalodbhava || 29.30 kakubhaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca nāsikyaṃ jṛmbhalo manuḥ | sparśāntaṃ pulahaṃś cordhvalokeśaṃ tadanantaram || 29.31 māṇibhadrasya sadṛśo manuḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ | paścimaṃ pītavarṇābhaṃ bhuvanaṃ yaṣṭimastakam || 29.32 pūrṇabhadrasya kathito manur evaṃ caturmukha | vakratuṇḍamakāraṃ ca pulahaṃ bhuvanaṃ punaḥ || 29.33 nāsikyaṃ manur etasmin śibikuṇḍalanāmani | brahmāṇamādiṃpulahaṃ guhālayasayaṣṭikam || 29.34 uddhāraś ca manor evaṃ kathitaḥ kalimālinaḥ | vakratuṇḍaṃ pītavarṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ ca taddhruvam || 29.35 carendramantraḥ kathitaḥ pūrvādiṣu yathākramam | mandaraṃ pulahaṃ caiva guṇālayasayaṣṭikam || 29.36 mahendrasya manuḥ proktaḥ subhagaḥ pulahodayaḥ | dhanādhyakṣasya mantro 'yaṃ kathitaḥ kamalāsana || 29.37 pārśve ca dakṣiṇe pūjyāḥ śriyaḥ parijanāḥ sthitāḥ | khaḍgadāmodaraṃ caiva mahāmāyāṃ sabindukam || 29.38 cintāratnasya kathito manuḥ pūrvadalāśrayaḥ | srīvatsamagniṃ bhuvanaṃ sadaṇḍaṃ ca caturmukha || 29.39 kathitaś ca balāmantrastārkṣyasthāne samarcanam | indrādayolokapālās svāśāsu paritasthitāḥ || 29.40 tṛtīyāvaraṇe cāpi balākī vanamālinī | vibhīṣī śāṅkarī caiva dikṣupūrvādiṣu sthitāḥ || 29.41 sakañcukā vetrahastā mantrāstāsāṃ samāhvayāḥ | viṣvaksenapade puṣpadhāriṇīm arcayet tataḥ || 29.42 kalpakaṃ pārijātaṃ ca haricandanabhūruham | santānamandarau caiva dvārabhūṣu niveśayet || 29.43 bilvaṃ ca sarasīṃ caiva śatapatrasamākulām | śriyaṃ parigatāṃ pakṣisaṅghātakalanisvanām || 29.44 parivārān prakalpyaivaṃ tattannāmabhir arcayet | caturthyantairnati paraiḥ praṇavapramukhais tathā || 29.45 mālāmantraṃ pravakṣyāmi śriyaḥ kamalasambhava | udgīthamuktvā prathamaṃ natiś ca tadanantaram || 29.46 uktvā bhagavatī śabdaṃ ca śrīcaturthyantamanvataḥ | dhīrāpadaṃ ca sambuddhau śrīpūrvaṃ nilayas tathā || 29.47 ākārapūrvaṃ bharaṇaṃ śatamaṇḍitamanvataḥ | śarīreti ca sambuddhiḥ padāny evaṃ samuddharet || 29.48 bhāskaraṃ cānalaṃ pañcabinduṃ candrārdhaśekharam | kalātmānaṃ visargāntaṃ bījam etad dvir uccaret || 29.49 dvir uccāryaṃ bharapadaṃ pāpaśabdād anantaram | alakṣmīm iti vaktavyaṃ nāśayeti dvir īrayet || 29.50 bhāskaraṃ pāvakaṃ pañcavinduṃ yaṣṭim anantaram | trir abhyaset tathā saptajanma pūrvārjitaṃ tathā || 29.51 akhilaṃ procya dāridcaṃ padaṃ dūrāt tathā padam | utsārayeti dviḥprocya candramādivisargitam || 29.52 tristriḥprocyaṃ tvadbhaktajanaśabdam anantaram | vasuṃ niyojayet yuktvā dhārayetipadaṃ punaḥ || 29.53 pūrayeti dvir uccārya padamambhoruhāsana | prapannalokaṃ hrīṅkāram trir uccārya hayaṃ gajam || 29.54 vividhaṃ paśum uccārya nicayaṃ tadanantaram | dāsīdāsaṃ parijanaṃ tadantaṃ dvir vilokaya || 29.55 māṃ ca saumyeti cetyuktvā avalokanasaṃyutam | lakṣmīm agniṃ vikramaṃ ca śrīdharaṃyaṣṭimastakam || 29.56 trir uccārya yajeti dvir bhavatīti ca padmaja | surāsuretyanupadaṃ siddhagandharvarākṣasam || 29.57 yakṣavidyādharapadaṃ nikhilaṃ jantuśabdakam | manobhir iti cākāṅkṣya samāgamam anantaram || 29.58 priyeti sambuddhipadaṃ bhāskaraṃ saguhālayam | sārdhacandramidaṃ bījaṃ trir uccārya parādite || 29.59 varaṃ vividham uccārya sitamālāmbaraṃ tathā | dhāriṇīti samuccārya nikhilaṃ rociṣaṃ vasu || 29.60 nicayā bhavatī padmā sambuddhau tattrayaṃ padam | śrīpadaṃ cāpi natyantamastv ity etat kriyāpadam || 29.61 yuṣmacchabdaṃ caturthyantaṃ ṭhaṭhānto manur īritaḥ | pūrvavad bījamasyāpi mantraṃ bhaṅktvāṅgakalpanā || 29.62 chando 'ticchandam etasya devatā śrīdhanādhipaḥ | draṣṭā phalaṃ japaṃ cāsya dviṣaṭkākṣaravat phalam || 29.63 adhunā vasudhāmantraṃ pravakṣyāmi caturmukha | brahmakośaṃ mukhaṃ tasya śrīvatsaṃ jvalanaṃ tathā || 29.64 vāmanaṃ mādhavaṃ devadattaṃ śrībījam eva ca | kamalaṃ bahulaṃ pañcabinduṃ subhagamanvataḥ || 29.65 bhadrahastaṃ vidhātāramanalaṃ vāmanaṃ tathā | subhagaṃ gopanayutaṃ vighneśaṃ ca samīraṇam || 29.66 karālamagnimīkāraṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaram | tārādivasumadhyaṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntaṃ hṛdayādiṣu || 29.67 yojayec ca namaskārapadaṃ śrīpadamanvataḥ | tathā saumyau ca sambuddhau samayetipadadvayam || 29.68 abhayaṃkari cetyuktvā mahāśabdam anantaram | ṭāvantas samayāvantaḥ sambuddhau ca ḍhaḍhāvadhi || 29.69 hyantameti tathā pūrvaṃ gaccheti padamanvataḥ | dvir vaktavyaṃ padadvandvaṃ bhagapūrvāvadhīti ca || 29.70 vasuśabdaṃ dehi śīrṣaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ tenacāhvayet | devīṃ ca vasudhāṃ dhyāyet taptahāṭakarociṣam || 29.71 siṃhāsanasthāmākalpair anekair bhūṣitāṃ sadā | gṛhītadāḍimīnālavāmahastāṃ tathetare || 29.72 haste dadhānāṃ subhagaṃ cintāratnaṃ caturmukha | pūrṇaṃ nānāvidhairatnaiḥ kumbhaṃ cordhvamukhaṃ sthitam || 29.73 dakṣiṇe caraṇāṅguṣṭhe paścimāmarabhūruham | pārśvayor ubhayoś cāpi vālavyajanapāṇibhiḥ || 29.74 anyābhiś śuklatāmbūla dhāriṇībhiś ca sevitām | śaṅkhapadmanidhī cāpi vamantau vipulaṃ dhanam || 29.75 parasparamukhaprekṣau parivārau sthitau punaḥ | anukta parivārāś ca grāhyāḥ śrīmanuvartmanā || 29.76 samudragāyāḥ saritaḥ sretasi prāṅmukhaḥsthitaḥ | stanadaghne japellakṣaṃ mantrasiddhau samāhitaḥ || 29.77 vaiśākhe māsi śukle ca pakṣe māsarkṣapaścime | vrataṃ samāpayec cakre pūjayec ca mahāniśi || 29.78 mallikāvakulaiś cānyaiḥ sugandhaiḥ kālajaiś śubhaiḥ | goghṛtaiś ca tilair anyair yathābhilaṣitair alam || 29.79 tarpaṇaṃ mantrajāpaṃ ca nityam etat samācaret | evam ācarataḥ samyaṅ mantriṇo yāvad āyuṣam || 29.80 vasati śrīr gṛhe tasya saptajanmasu niścalā | manuṃ dharaṇyā vakṣyāmi sādhanaṃ ca yathātatham || 29.81 chandasāmādim uddhṛtya sūkṣmadṛk pulahaṃ tathā | hṛṣīkeśaṃ visargāntaṃ manur ekākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 29.82 gopanaṃ pañcabinduś ca ūrdhvalokeśamanvataḥ | vīrasenaṃ kalāntaṃ ca saṅkarṣaṇasamāhvayam || 29.83 sabinduṃ gatisantānaṃ kalpayed hṛdayādiṣu | paiṭhako 'sya mauniś chando daivaṃ gāyatram īritam || 29.84 devatā dharaṇīdevī japel lakṣamatandritaḥ | manur dharaṇyāḥ saptārṇaḥ kathyate kamalāsana || 29.85 dhandaṃ pāvakaṃ cādiṃ sumukhaṃ godhanāhvayam | natyantam evaṃ saptārṇo dharaṇyāḥ sampradarśitaḥ || 29.86 manuś catustriṃśadvarṇaḥ kathyate kamalodbhava | ādāya cādau saptārṇān kumbhamādimacāmanuḥ || 29.87 śaśāṅkamādiṃ bhuvanaṃ subhagaṃ dattasaṃjñitam | subhadramūrdhvalokeśaṃ vijayaṃ viṣṇuśīrṣakam || 29.88 mohanāśaṃ tathākāraṃ vairājaṃ cāgnivikramam | bhallāyudhaṃ ca māhendraṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ vidarbhitam || 29.89 sānusvāraṃ ca kamalaṃ pāvakaṃ saguhālayam | nāsikyaṃ tridaśāhāraṃ trivikramasamāhvayam || 29.90 krodharūpaṃ ca sumukhaṃ sodakaṃ kalaśaṃ tataḥ | praṇavādiṃ ca māhendraṃ pulahaṃ ca samuddharet || 29.91 pāvakaṃ pāṭalaṃ brahma māhendrañ ca guhālayam | prabhañjanaṃ pūrṇacandramauṣadhaṃ yaṣṭisaṃyutam || 29.92 subhadraṃ devadattaṃ ca bhāskaraṃ yaṣṭi mastakam | svāhāyāṃ viratirmantraḥ kathitaḥ kamalāsana || 29.93 pūrvoktaṃ bījamaṅgāni ṛṣiś chandaś ca devatā | sārasvataṃ manuvaraṃ pravakṣyāmi yathātatham || 29.94 nigamādiṃ śvetaraśmiṃ manumardhenduśekharam | ity uddharet svayaṃ gāṃ ca draṣṭā kāśyapanandanaḥ || 29.95 chandaś ca devī gāyatraṃ devatā bhāratī svayam | lakṣam ekaṃ niyamavān japen mantramatandritaḥ || 29.96 atulā vāgvibhūtiḥ syāl labhate jñānam uttamam | sakṛdgrahaṇamātreṇa grahaṇaṃ dṛḍham aśnute || 29.97 smṛtipramoṣo naivāsya sabhāyāṃ na parābhavaḥ | anyaṃ sārasvataṃ mantramadhunā kathayāmite || 29.98 mukhamasya brahmakośaṃ godhanaṃ candraśekharam | kamalaṃ pulahaṃ māyāmanusvārapariṣkṛtām || 29.99 yaṣṭiṃ yaṣṭyāvisargāntaḥ pūrvoktaṃ mantramanvataḥ | trayakṣarasyacoddhāraḥ kathitaḥ kamalāsana || 29.100 draṣṭā vasiṣṭho mantrasya virāṭchandaḥ sarasvatī | devatā japasaṃkhyā ca lakṣatrayam udāhṛtam || 29.101 parāvarajño vāgmī ca saptakṛtvo 'bhimantritam | jalaṃ pibed dhruvaṃ tasya kalyāṇī vāgbhaviṣyati || 29.102 ṣaḍakṣaragaṇo mantraḥ kathyate kamalāsana | tārakaṃ varuṇaṃ cādiṃ nāsikyaṃ jvalanāhvayam || 29.103 madhusūdanamanvak ca humphaḍantaṃ namaskṛtiḥ | ṛṣir maheśvaraś chando virāṭ saiva ca devatā || 29.104 daśākṣaraṃ mantrarājaṃ varṇoddhāreṇa cocyate | vyāpī sudhārasaś cāpi vaidharo viṣṇumastakaḥ || 29.105 varṇānta eva catvāraḥ samanantaram īritāḥ | īrayitvā tathā kumbhaṃ madhusūdanamanvataḥ || 20.106 pañcāntakaḥ pāśapāṇiṃ madhusūdana paścimam | vaidharaṃ rāmasahitaṃ vighneśaṃ bandhumastakam || 29.107 hutāntavarṇānuddhṛtya manureṣa samīritaḥ | aṅgāni rūpaṃ mantrasya bījam evaṃ vibhājitam || 29.108 candramaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ tuṣāranicyaprabhām | vamantīmamṛtaṃ vakrājjihvāmadhyagatāṃ smaret || 29.109 dhyāyato mantriṇas tasya vāksiddhiratulā bhavet | nigamādiṃ ca natyantaṃ subhadraṃ gadinaṃ tathā || 29.110 kumbhamādiṃ ca vijayaṃ govindaṃ madhuketanam | vijayaṃ mādhavayutaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ manum uddharet || 29.111 jvalanaṃ cādimardhenduṃ bījam evaṃ samuddharet | draṣṭāsya devalaś chando virāṭ devī ratis tathā || 29.112 daśalakṣaṃ japen mantraṃ tataḥsidhyati mantriṇaḥ | vaśyākarṣaṇavidveṣamukhā ca phalasantatiḥ || 29.113 dūrādāgamanaṃ cāpi proṣitasyācirād bhavet | saptavarṇān samuccārya pūrvoktān samanantaram || 29.114 pavitraṃ pīṭhamanvak ca pañcabindum anantaram | vairājaṃ godhanaṃ vāyuṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ manum uddharet || 29.115 ekacakṣuś capīṭhaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ sabindukam | bījamuktaṃ manorasya munirāṅgirasaḥ smṛtaḥ || 29.116 chandaś ca devīgāyatraṃ devatā prītir ucyate | sādhayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ dharmādiphalabhāg bhavet || 29.117 saptārṇāḥ pūrvavad grāhyāḥ karālaṃ vāmanaṃ tataḥ | edṛg [ekadṛg] godhanaṃ citrabhānuṃ ca madhusūdanam || 29.118 yaṣṭiṃ karālamagniṃ ca dhruvaṃ cāgneś ca yoṣitam | tadeva bījaṃ draṣṭā ca manuḥ kīrtiś ca devatā || 29.119 chandaś ca devīgāyatraṃ pūrvavat siddhisādhane | varṇānādāya saptādau pariśiṣṭān samuddharet || 29.120 śrīvatsaṃ gopanaṃ bhadrapāṇiṃ ca vijayaṃ tathā | sparśanaṃ vīrasenaṃ ca śubhadaṃ dahanaṃ manum || 29.121 yaṣṭiṃ ca bhāskaropetaṃ pāvakaṃ bindupañcakam | sayaṣṭiṃ bījasahitaṃ śriyaḥ svāhāpadāvadhi || 29.122 chando virāḍ gautamaṛṣir devatā śāntir ucyate | manunā sādhayed brahman pādukādi phalaṃ mahat || 29.123 saptavarṇān yathāpūrvaṃ nṛhariṃ pāvakaṃ tathā | mahāmāyāmanusvāraṃ vijayaṃ praṇavādikam || 29.124 udayaṃ krodharūpaṃ ca bhūdharaṃ gopanaṃ tathā | ṭhaṭhāntam evam uddhṛtya manur jñeyo vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 29.125 draṣṭā vyāso virāṭ chando devatā tuṣṭir īritā | lakṣatrayajapenaiva tuṣṭiś ca mahatī bhavet || 29.126 saptārṇāḥ pūrvavad grāhyāḥ śiṣṭārṇasyoddhṛtiḥ kramāt | bhāskaraṃ pāvakaṃ pañcabinduṃ yaṣṭisamanvitam || 29.127 pavitraṃ bhuvanaṃ krodharūpaṃ bhūdharamanvataḥ | govindamāgneyīmanvaguddhṛtya manur īritaḥ || 29.128 draṣṭeritas tatheśānā puṣṭiś chando virāḍabhūt | aṣṭalakṣaṃ japen mantraṃ puṣṭikāmas samāhitaḥ || 29.129 bhuktvā bhogāṃś ca vipulān rasāyanapurogamān | atalādiṣu lokeṣu mantrī carati devavat || 29.130 yogāsanāṅgānyādhāraśaktyādīni caturmukha | yāni teṣāṃ kalpaneṣu varṇoddhārapurassaram || 29.131 mantrānvakṣyāmyānupūrvyā yathāvadavadhāraya | brahmakośaṃ mukhaṃ vidyāt pavitramṛtadhāma ca || 29.132 hṛṣīkeśaṃ binduparaṃ pratardanamataḥ param | padmanābhaṃ ca nāsikyaṃ gopanaṃ subhagaṃ punaḥ || 29.133 ādi devaṃ hutavahaṃ śrīvatsaṃ kamalāhvayam | vairājaṃ vīrasenaṃ ca natim evaṃ samuddharet || 29.134 ādhāraśaktimantro 'yaṃ kathitaḥ kamalāsana | caturmukhaṃ caturvāhuṃ śuddhasphaṭikavarcasam || 29.135 kirīṭahārakeyūra pramukhākalpabhūṣitam | śrīvatsāṅkaṃ śaṅkhacakragadāpadmāyudhair yutam || 29.136 tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ dhyāyed ādhārarūpiṇam | brahmakośaṃ dinakaraṃ bhuvanaṃ pāvakāhvayam || 29.137 guhālayaṃ dhruvaṃ bhūyaḥ kamalaṃ saguhālayam | pāvakaṃ mantaraṃ padmamākāraṃ vipulaṃ tathā || 29.138 gopanaṃ ca gadadhvaṃsaṃ vināyakam anantaram | prabhañjanaṃ mādhavaṃ ca natyantaṃ manumuddharet || 29.139 ekavaktraṃ caturbāhuṃ japāpuṣpasamadyutim | śaṅkhacakradharaṃ kruddhaṃ padmakaumodakīdharam || 29.140 vahnimaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ jvalanāpītavigraham | sakalābharaṇopetaṃ dhyāyet kūrmam anantaram || 29.141 udgīthaṃ bhānumākāraṃ yaṣṭimādiṃ vināyakam | dviradaṃ vijayākāraṃ śvasanaṃ prathamaṃ svaram || 29.142 natiṃ coddhṛtya mantro 'yam anantasya pradarśitaḥ | sphaṭikādripratīkāśaṃ caturbāhuṃ kirīṭinam || 29.143 pūrṇacandrānanaṃ saumyaṃ sitapuṣpair virājitam | lāṅgalaṃ musalaṃ mukhyakarayordadhataṃ śivam || 29.144 jaghanyakarayoś śaṅkhacakradvandvaṃ yathāyatham | nīlāmbaradharaṃ daṃṣṭrākarālavadanair yutam || 29.145 praśāntavapuṣāyuktaṃ sahasraphaṇamunnatam | phaṇāmaṇisahasrāṃśunīrājanavirājitam || 29.146 anantavaktrakuharair udvamantamudarciṣam | maṇḍalīkṛtanāgendra bhogaveṣṭanavigraham || 29.147 dhyāyed anantam ubhayoḥ pārśvayor nāgayoṣitaḥ | devyastasya sukhāsīnāḥ phaṇāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ || 29.148 dhyātvā bhuvo manuḥ paścād varṇoddhāreṇa vakṣyate | tāraṃ subhaganāmānamarciṣmantaṃ caturmukha || 29.149 sumukhaṃ godhanaṃ vāyuṃ natyantam iti kalpayet | tasyopari phaṇīndrasya tapanīyanibhāṃ śubhām || 29.150 caturaśrāṃ mahāpīṭhīṃ kalpayen madhuvidviṣaḥ | dharmādīnāṃ caturṇāṃtbadharmādīnāṃ ca tāvatām || 29.151 pādānāṃ kalpanāmantrāḥ vakṣyante kamalāsana | ādyarṇān praṇavādīṃś ca sānusvārānyathāyatham || 29.152 caturthyantāni nāmāni procyante natim īrayet | madhye sadāśivapadaṃ pādatvena prakalpayet || 29.153 taccaturthyantamādau ca bhāskaraṃ saguhālayam | natyantaṃ caiva pādānāṃ navānāṃ kalpayen manūn || 29.154 ṛgādayaś caturvedās teṣāṃ tu manavaḥ punaḥ | sānusvārāṃs tadādyarṇān procyādau kamalāsana || 29.155 caturthyantāni nāmāni ṛgādīnāṃ natiḥ punaḥ | manūn prakalpayed evaṃ bhautikādir ahaṅkṛtiḥ || 29.156 tisraḥ prakalpayet paścāt tāsāṃ mantrān bravīmi te | praṇavādīn phullanayanānacāmādiṃ sadaṇḍakam || 29.157 bhautikādir ahaṅkāraś caturthyanto natis tathā | paścimaṃ mārutaṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ bindumastakam || 29.158 padaṃ ca taijasaṃ śiṣṭaṃ pūrvavan manur īritaḥ | kumbhamaurvaṃ sanāsikyaṃ vaikāripadamanvataḥ || 29.159 śiṣṭaṃ yathāpuraṃ sarvaṃ manuranyaḥ samīritaḥ | sattvaṃ rajastamaśceti guṇān paścāt prakalpayet || 29.160 sānusvārāṃs tadādyarṇāṃś caturthyantāṃs tadāhvayān | manūn prakalpayed evaṃ mahyādyais tatprakalpanam || 29.161 ātmaśabdaṃ caturthyantaṃ mahnayādi padapūrvakam | humphaḍantaṃ ca natyantaṃ prayuñjīta munuṃ punaḥ || 29.162 praṇavaṃ mandaraṃ yaṣṭiṃ musalaṃ pañcabindukam | amṛtaṃ gopanayutaṃ vijayaṃ mādhavīṃ tathā || 29.163 bhadrahastaṃ mṛgeśaṃ ca natimuddhṛtyamantravit | mantreṇāstaraṇādhyāso vahnanyādimaṇḍalatrayam || 29.164 tasyopariṣṭādadhyāsānmantrān sarvān yathākramam | pāvakaṃ śaśinaṃ sūryaṃ trayamākārabindukam || 29.165 manum evaṃ samuddhṛtya padmaṃ coparikalpayet | praṇavaṃ paścimaṃ yaṣṭiṃ pavitraṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 29.166 dakṣaṃ ca gopanaparaṃ śvasanaṃ ca vināyakam | viṣṇuṃ ca mandaraṃ svargam uddhṛtyājamanuḥ smṛtaḥ || 29.167 śrīvatsādi dvādaśānāṃ śaktīnāṃ tatsamāhvayā | caturthyantāḥ sanāsikyāḥ tadādyarṇapuraskṛtāḥ || 29.168 mantro bhadrāsanasyaiṣa kathitaḥ kalpanākramaḥ | brahmādayas trayaḥ paścāt sanakāditrayaṃ punaḥ || 29.169 vināyakaś ca durgā ca mantriṇo gururanvataḥ | praṇavādyāś caturthyantā natyantāś ca tadāhvayāḥ || 29.170 tānarcayec ca brahmādīn paricaryāmukhair hare | aṣṭau vyāptyādikāḥ śāktīḥ prathamāvaraṇe yajet || 29.171 pūrvavat tatsamākhyābhir mantraiḥ pañcāyudhāny api | divyāni dikpatīn sarvānidrādīn vihagādhipam || 29.172 seneśaṃ ca caturthyantair natyantaiś ca svanāmabhiḥ | pūrvavat pūjayed brahman dvitīyāvaraṇe tataḥ || 29.173 caṇḍapracaṇḍāvantasthau dvāḥsthau ca manunā yajet | nigamādiṃ khaḍgadharamṛtamotaṃ sayaṣṭikam || 29.174 vakratuṇḍaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca puṇḍarīkākṣagopanau | prabhañjanaṃ cāprameyaṃ natyanto manur īritaḥ || 29.175 prathamaṃ chandasāmādiṃ paścimaṃ ṛtadhāmakam | sadaṇḍaṃ pāpahananaṃ dahanaṃ vakratuṇḍakam || 29.176 pracaṇḍaṃpuyḍarīkākṣaṃ caturthyantaṃ tathā natiḥ | caṇḍapracaṇḍayor mantraḥ samuddhṛtyārṇam īritaḥ || 29.177 udumbarasya natyantaṃ śāntimādivibhaktikam | udīrayed adhiṣṭhātrī tasya śāntiś ca devatā || 29.178 sarasvatī dakṣiṇasyāṃ ratiś cottara dāruṇi | śrīḥ paścimād adhastasyāḥ śāntir bhavati devatā || 29.179 caturthyantañ ca tannāma mantraś coktaḥ caturmukha | kavāṭai dakṣiṇe viśvanetrasyād devatā tathā || 29.180 uttare viśvavaktraś ca devatā vetra dāruṣu | vasanti vedaśāstrāṇi nārāceṣu tathāmarāḥ || 29.181 ṛṣayaḥ kīladeśeṣu bhūteśaḥ paṭṭikābhuvi | viśvabhāvanavāsaḥ syāt kandapaṭṭadvayaṃ tathā || 29.182 nāma teṣāṃ caturthyantaṃ manur vāstupates tathā | kṣetreśasya manur brahman chandasāmādim uddharet || 29.183 nṛsiṃhamudayaṃ dakṣamṛtadhāma sadaṇḍakam | caturthyantaṃ namo 'ntaś ca tārkṣyamagrehareḥ sthitam || 29.184 dvārapārśve śaṅkhacakradvayaṃ tatsaṃjñayārcayet | vacmidhāmārcane mantraṃ chandasāmādim uddharet || 29.185 varuṇaṃ bandhuśirasaṃ krodharūpaṃ vanasrajam | varuṇaṃ devadattaṃ ca paścimaṃ vahnigopanau || 29.186 śaśāṅkamādidevāntaṃ vaidharaṃ dahanaṃ tataḥ | hṛṣīkeśaṃ paścimaṃ ca rāmaṃ sumukhamanvataḥ || 29.187 mādhavaṃ humphaḍantaṃ ca svāhāntāvadhiko manuḥ | diṅmūrtayaś cānupūrvyā kathyante kamalāsana || 29.188 indreśānau nṛsiṃhaś ca viriñcaś ca kramāt bhavet | diṅmūrtayo 'thavā śaktidharaḥ paśupatis tathā || 29.189 śrīdharo dhanadaś ceti yadvā kroḍākṛtir hariḥ | nṛsiṃhaḥ śrīdharaś ceti hayaśīrṣākṛtis tathā || 29.190 api vā syāt caturvaktra naranārāyaṇāv ubhau | hariḥ kṛṣṇaś ca kathito yadvā satyādayaḥ kramāt || 29.191 vāsudevādayo vyūhā yadvā diṅmūrtayaḥ kramāt | kramāc ca toraṇāyānte pūrvapaścimadhāmayoḥ || 29.192 caturaśrāyate dhāmni pūrvapaścimanāsayoḥ | pūrṇaś ca puṣkaraś ca dvāv adhiṣṭhāne punaḥ kramāt || 29.193 āgneye hastivadano yāmye paśupatis tathā | vāruṇe dakṣiṇāmūrtiḥ kaubere viśvarūpadhṛk || 29.194 śāṅkare ca caturvakra tasmin bhagavatī tathā | antarmaṇḍalasaṃbandhi gopurobhayapārśvayoḥ || 29.195 candrādityau tathorvyāṃnvindradikṣu vidikṣu ca | manmathaś ca vidhātā ca vighneśaḥ ṣaṇmukhas tathā || 29.196 durgādhanadarudrāś ca kṣetreśas tadanantaram | someśānāntare caiva viṣvaksenaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 29.197 dakṣiṇorvītale saptamātaro vīrabhadrakaḥ | vighneśaḥ pārśvayos tāsāṃ jyeṣṭhā niṛti bhūtale || 29.198 indrādayaḥ svāsu dikṣu dvitīyāvaraṇe punaḥ | bhagavatpramukhe tārkṣyo dvitīyāvaraṇe tataḥ || 29.199 tadīyagopuradvārapārśvayoḥ puruṣācyutau | khalūrikādharitrīṣu vahnyādīnāṃ diśi kramāt || 29.200 hayaśīrṣaḥ karṣaṇaś ca kroḍākṛtir anantaram | pradyumno 'nanta nāmānāv aniruddho nṛkesarī || 29.201 cakraṃ ca musalaṃ śaṅkhaṃ khaḍgaṃ kaumodakīṃ dhanuḥ | vajraṃ padmam iti proktaṃ prāgādiṣu tṛtīyake || 29.202 gopuro bhayapārśvasthāḥ dvādaśāḥ śītaraśmayaḥ | yamāgnimadhye vasavaḥ pitaro yamarākṣasoḥ || 29.203 viśvedevāś ca madhyasthā nirṛter varuṇasya ca | marutaḥpāśahastasya śvasanasya ca madhyamāḥ || 29.204 pāśīmārutayor madhye munayaḥ sapta ca sthitāḥ | kubereśānayor madhye rūdrāś caikādaśāsthitāḥ || 29.205 kṣetrapālaś ca tatraiva prācyādau kumudādayaḥ | maryādāhvayasālasya dvāri pūrṇaś ca puṣkaraḥ || 29.206 urvītale samārādhyāḥ prāṅgaṇe kḷptapīṭhake | sthāpyāś caivottamagaṇāḥ prācyādiṣv aṣṭasu kramāt || 29.207 tathopendrādayaḥ sthāpyā mahatyāvaraṇe tathā | mahītale madhyagaṇā viśveśādyā diśi kramāt || 29.208 jayādayo gopurāṇāṃ bahir bhūmau vyavasthitāḥ | balipīṭheṣu sarvatra prathamāvaraṇādiṣu || 29.209 ādyāś ca karmajāś caiva ye bhūtāḥ prāgdiśisthitāḥ | prasannāḥ parituṣṭāste gṛhṇantu balikāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 29.210 bhūmau vyomni tathā vṛkṣaparvatādiṣu viṣṭhitāḥ | vināyakaḥ kṣetrapālāḥ śūrāś ca kumudādayaḥ || 29.211 sarvaiḥ pāriṣadaiś cānyais sārdhaṃ gṛhṇantu te balim | caṇḍādayo 'tha dvārasthāś caturthyantais svanāmabhiḥ || 29.212 praṇavādyaiś ca natyantair devīparijanānvitāḥ | savāhanāste sampūjyāḥ sve sve deśe caturmukha || 29.213 balipīṭheṣu sarveṣāṃ baligrahaṇakāṅkṣiṇām | tattannāma samuccārya balir deyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 29.214 dhāmeśānaṃ vinātena balidānena yo 'rcayet | haranti rāṣṭraṃ rājānaṃ dhāmacātmānam eva ca || 29.215 parivārānanabhyarcya tathaivāgnesamindhanam | bhogair akṛtvā devasya pūjā syān niṣprayojanā || 29.216 tasmād yathoktamārgeṇa pūjanaṃ sthānavṛddhidam | vardhanaṃ rājarāṣṭrāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ vṛddhikāṅkṣiṇām || 29.217 dṛśyādṛśyena rūpeṇa sthitānāṃ balikāṅkṣiṇām | bhūtānāṃ bhūtikāmena deyo 'ṣaśyaṃ balis sadā || 29. 218
iti śrī pañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde śriyādi parivāramantravarṇanaṃ nāma ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
tithidevatāmantroddhāraḥ śrī bhagavān tithiyāgaṃ caturvaktra bravīmi sukhasādhanam | kāmyasya karmaṇaḥ kālaḥ śuklapakṣas tathā tithiḥ || 30.1 japahomārcanaiḥ samyak kāleṣv ārādhayet sudhīḥ | agnir brahmā dhaneśānau vighneśaḥ śrīḥṣaḍānanaḥ || 30.2 bhānurvṛṣadhvajo durgā yamo valaniṣudanaḥ | viṣṇuḥ kāmo 'śvinau candra ity uktāstithidevatāḥ || 30.3 praṇavaṃ navabinduṃ ca varuṇaṃ śrīdharaṃ tataḥ | gadadhvaṃsaṃ bhadrahastaṃ pāvanaṃ mādhavaṃ tataḥ || 30.4 ṭhaṭhāntam uddhṛtya manuḥ kathito jātavedasaḥ | agnimādyamanusvāraṃ bījaṃ tenāṅgapaddhatiḥ || 30.5 chando virāḍ devalaś ca draṣṭāgnir adhidevatā | caturthyantaṃ svābhidhānaṃ natyantamaparo manuḥ || 30.6 ṛṣicchando devatāpi manorasyāpi pūrvavat | pratyakṣaraṃ japaḥ sādhanaṃ sthāpanaṃ mantrayor dvayoḥ || 30.7 kāmyasya lābhas sarvasya phalamatyantadurlabham | nigamādiṃ kālanemimṛtadhāmavidarbhitam || 30.8 mārtāṇḍamandarayutaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ mādhavaṃ natim | ity uddhared brahmamanumuddhāro 'nyasya kathyate || 30.9 caturthyantaṃ brahmapadam āgneyī niṣṭhitaṃ manuḥ | vairājamakṣaprathamaṃ vijayaṃ rohiṇīpatim || 30.10 akāram ekanetraṃ ca bījaṃ praṇavasaṃyutam | etad evāṅgasantānaḥ svaraś chandaś ca lohitaḥ || 30.11 munir brahmā ca devaś ca yaṣṭavyaṃ paṅkajodare | praṇavaṃ sūkṣmadṛṣṭiṃ ca bhadrapāṇiṃ sabindukam || 30.12 uddhṛtyekākṣaro mantraḥ kuberasya samīritaḥ | uṣṇik chando munir vahnir dhaneśānaś ca devatā || 30.13 ārambhaṃ natimanvak ca subhagaṃ vighnanāyakam | pavitraṃ vijayaṃ paścād dhvaṃsanaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā || 30.14 kamalaṃ codayaṃ procya jṛmbhalaṃ mṛgavallabham | pāvakaṃ gopanayutaṃ sadāgatim anantaram || 30.15 kumbhaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ bhuvanaṃ herambaṃ rāmasaṃyutam | vakratuṇḍaṃ jagatprāṇaṃ mandaraṃ paścimānanam || 30.16 agnimādyaṃ mārutaṃ ca prathamaṃ pretanāyakam | acāmādimathāgneyīm uddhṛtya manur īritaḥ || 30.17 dhanadasya nabho draṣṭā chando gāyatram īritaḥ | daivaṃ dhanādhipo devo bījaṃ pūrvavad īritam || 30.18 aṅguṣṭhe māṇibhadrākhyaṃ tarjanyāṃ pūrṇabhadrakam | kalimāliṃ madhyamāyāṃ vikuṇḍalamanāmikām || 30.19 mūle kaniṣṭhikāyāṃ ca madhye ca maṇibandhayoḥ | makhendraṃ pāṇitalayor aṅganyāse dhanādhipam || 30.20 snātvā jṛmbhalamantreṇa prakṣiped udakāñjalim | ambhojakarṇikāmadhye mahākāyaṃ mahodaram || 30.21 dvibhujaṃ pītavasanaṃ cintāratnaṃ kare sthitam | dhārayantaṃ manaḥ kāntaṃ mantribhyobhītsitaṃ vasu || 30.22 yakṣayakṣīparijanaṃ dhyāyannardhyādibhir yajet | ṛddhiṃ guptiṃ ca tatpārśve caturthyantaṃ svasaṃjñayā || 30.23 ardhyādyair arcayitvā tu tato jṛbhbhalam abjaja | kalimaliṃ maṇibhadraṃ carendraṃ pūrṇabhadrakam || 30.24 mukhendraṃ śikhipūrṇañ ca kuṇḍalaṃ nalekūbaram | ambhojakarṇikāmadhye daleṣv indrādiṣu kramāt || 30.25 arcayet purataś śaṅkhanidhiṃ padmanidhiṃ tathā | śabalāṃ purato nyasyet pṛṣṭhataḥ kalpakadrumam || 30.26 japahomau tarpaṇādi phalaṃ mūlamanor yathā | vakṣyāmi jṛmbhalamanumaṇorddhāreṇa samprati || 30.27 omādiṃ subhagaṃ bhadrahastaṃ vaidharamakṣaram | ādidevaṃ mārutaṃ ca dhanadaṃ bhadrabāhukam || 30.28 pavitraṃ vijayaṃ caiva mārutaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā | jamnahantṛ tathāmnāyaṃ madhavaṃ sūkṣmadarśanam || 30.29 viṣkambhamādidevaṃ ca sparśanaṃ svāhayā yutam | bījamādyakṣaraṃ bhargo draṣṭā chando virāṇmanoḥ || 30.30 devatā jṛmbhalaḥ kāryaḥ phalaṃ sarvaṃ prayacchati | vighneśamantram uddhṛtya varṇān vakṣyāmy anukramāt | 30.31 udgīthaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca sparśeṣu pulahaṃ manum | daṇḍa ity uddhṛto mantro gaṇikāḥ ṣaḍ virāṭ tathā || 30.32 devatāvighnarājaś ca japo lakṣatrayaṃ smṛtam | bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyac ca svapne paśyati mantravit || 30.33 ārabdhaṃ karma nirvighnaṃ phalaṃ dugdhe yathepsitam | tṛtīyādiṃ ca sumukhamādyaṃ paścimasaṃjñitam || 30.34 acāṃ mukhaṃ ca vijayaṃ prāṇaṃ mādhavamanvataḥ | natyantamādau pūrvoktaṃ manuṃ ca manur īritaḥ || 30.35 ajo muniś chanda uṣṇigdevatā vighnanāyakaḥ | saptalakṣaṃ japen mantraṃ siddhayaḥ pūrvam īritāḥ || 30.36 ekākṣaraṃ natiśiro manurasya samīritaḥ | nigamādiṃ dinakarajvalanaṃ pañcabindukam || 30.37 sānusvāraṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca vāmanam | yaṣṭiṃ sahasrakiraṇaṃ pāvakaṃ daṇḍaśekharam || 30.38 triyakṣaramanur brahman kathitaḥ sarvasādhanaḥ | aṅgādi gaditaṃ varṇamākārādisvarāntakam || 30.39 prayuñjīta manuś cānyo vakṣyate kamalāsana | udgīthamādiṃ kamalaṃ pāvakaṃ pañcabindukam || 30.40 ardhendusahitaṃ bhadramanalaṃ binduvāmanam | saroruhaṃ samāhendraṃ mahāmāyā sayaṣṭikam || 30.41 bījaṃ ca tatsvarādyarṇaṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ pracaṇḍakam | paścimānanavairājau māyāṃ ca vasudhārasam || 30.42 ādimagnimakāraṃ ca ṣaṭpadadvayam īrayet | śaśinaṃ varuṇaṃ vahniṃ kakubhaṃ bhadrabāhukam || 30.43 mandaradvayamekāraṃ varuṇaṃ kamalāmukham | acāṃ dakṣaṃ gopanaṃ ca vighneśaṃ śvasanaṃ tathā || 30.44 ṭhaṭhāntam ittham uddhāro bījādi kathitaṃ purā | aihikāmuṣmikaphalaṃ sarvam etena sādhayet || 30.45 śriyaṃ pūrvoktamārgeṇa devīmardhyādibhir yajet | tatkaṭākṣanipātena labhate śriyam uttamām || 30.46 tāraṃ natiṃ krodharūpaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ dakṣamanvataḥ | udayaṃ kharvadehaṃ ca gopanaṃ ca prabhañjanam || 30.47 śaśāṅkaṃ śrīdharaṃ hrasvamṛtadhāmasamāhvayam | dineśaṃ mādhavīmanvak pracaṇḍaṃ madhusūdanam || 30.48 śvasanaṃ svāhayā sārdhaṃ manureṣa samīritaḥ | jṛmbhalaṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ pulahaṃ yaṣṭimastakam || 30.49 etad bījasamuddhāras tadevāṅgamṛṣiḥ punaḥ | varṇātmā kathitaś chando gāyatraṃ devatā guhaḥ || 30.50 dāḍimīkusumaprakhyāṃ tanmantreṇa samaracyet | evaṃ kṛtavato vaṃśe subrahmaṇyādayo grahāḥ || 30.51 na pīḍayanti tadvaṃśyān bhavanti cirajīvinaḥ | nigamādiṃ coṣadhīśamanunāsikyam uddharet || 30.52 ekākṣaro 'yaṃ kathito mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ | hārīto mantradṛk chando virāṭ sūryaś ca devatā || 30.53 brahmakośaṃ padmapāṇimṛtaṃ sumukhasaṃjñitam | rāmaminduṃ hṛṣīkeśam agniṃ vāyuṃ acāṃ mukham || 30.54 vaidharaṃ binduvairājaṃ vāyuṃ tāraṃ samuddharet | ittham aṣṭākṣaro mantro bījam ekākṣaraṃ smṛtam || 30.55 ṛṣiratriś ca devaś ca pūṣā caivādhidevatā | paraṃ saptākṣaraṃ mantraṃ mantrair uddhṛtya varṇyate || 30.56 saptārṇāḥ pūrvavadgrāhyāḥ subhadramadhusūdanau | bhadrahastaṃ ca kalaśaṃ mādhavaṃ pūrvam īritam || 30.57 bījam abhyantarīkṛtvā dviruktaṃ kakubhaṃ tathā | aprameyaṃ gandhavahamādyam etad anantaram || 30.58 pādadvitayamāvāhyamādidevam anantaram | pāvakaṃ vikramayutaṃ vaidharaṃ ṛtadhāma ca || 30.59 mārutaṃ cāpi nāsikyaṃ vighneśaṃ gopanāhvayam | kamalāmādipavanamādyaṃ dviḥpadam īrayet || 30.60 mādhavīmādisahitam akṣaraṃ dviradaṃ paṭhet | pavitraṃ gopanayutaṃ paṭhec ca svarasaṃyutam || 30.61 vighneśaṃ dahatiṃ dhātuṃ loḍantaṃ dvis samuddharet | śāntarogaṃ sukhapadaṃ pūrvaloḍantamadhyamam || 30.62 yamaṃ caṇḍaṃ dvir uccārya trir anvak praṇavaṃ padam | svanāmnā praṇavāntena manur evaṃ samuddhṛtaḥ || 30.63 bījam aṅgāni coktāni sindhudvīpaś ca dṛṣṭavān | atticchandaḥ svayaṃ chandaḥ sūryaś cānena kathyate || 30.64 padmamadhye karṇikāyāmādityaṃ dalabhūmiṣu | prācyādiṣu grahānanyān tadānīṃ bimbam arcayet || 30.65 kramāt ṣaḍṛtavaḥ sarve grahās sānugrahās tathā | āyurārogyasaundarya samṛddhimukhasampadaḥ || 30.66 saptajanmasu vaṃśe 'sya bhavanti niravagrahāḥ | praṇavaṃ natimatvak ca śubhadaṃ ca trivikramam || 30.67 varuṇaṃ gopanaṃ vāyumādim uddhṛtya mantravit | manuḥ pañcākṣaraḥ kāryo bījaṃ samprati kathyate || 30.68 gopatiṃ viṣṇusahitamanusvāraṃ samuddharet | bījam etac caturvaktra ṣaḍaṅgānām udāharet || 30.69 upamanyuḥṛṣiś chando devaṃ gāyatramucyate | pratipādyo maheśāno japaḥ syāl lakṣapañcakam || 30.70 aṣṭākṣaravadasyāpi phalaṃ sādhanam eva ca | raktāmbujāsanāsīnam arcayet taddaleṣu ca || 30.71 prāgādiṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni pārvatīnandikeśvarau | kramād vinyasya purato bāhanaṃ samyag arcayet || 30.72 dikṣv aṣṭasu surendrādīnaṣṭāvardhyādinārcayet | sṛṣṭyādi nyasanaṃ kṛtvā prathamaṃ tadanantaram || 30.73 akṣaranyasanaṃ kuryāt sthāneṣv eteṣu padmaja | mūrdhni cāsye hṛdaye guhye pādatale tathā || 30.74 varṇānāṃ kramaśo varṇāḥ pañcānāṃ kathyate 'dhunā | sphaṭikaṃ pāṭalaṃ pītaṃ śvetaṃ nīlam iti smaret || 30.75 śivo 'ham iti cātmānaṃ bhāvayen mantravittamaḥ | dhyāyantaṃ devadeveśam ārādhyaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam || 30.76 tyaktvā sāṃsārikaṃ duḥkhameti sthānamanaśvaram | bhogānapyaihikān bhuktvā durlabhānamarair api || 30.77 omādisaptavarṇānām uddhāraḥ pūrvam īritaḥ | vaidharaṃ nṛhariṃ māyāṃ pracaṇḍaṃ madhusūdanam || 30.78 mandaraṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ vairājaṃ [dviḥ] caturmukha | pāvakaṃ pavanaṃ devadattaṃ pāṭalamanvataḥ || 30.79 gopatiṃ mārutamatho mandaraṃ mādhavīṃ tathā | mādhavaṃ dhanadaṃ brahman madhusūdana saṃjñitam || 30.80 nāsikyaṃ paścimaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca pavanāhvayam | khaḍgaṃ dvir uccaret svāhā iti mantraṃ samuddharet || 30.81 manumanyaṃ pravakṣyāmi tamarṇair uddharāmy aham | tāramatriṃ garutmantaṃ rāmaṃ sumukhamanvataḥ || 30.82 gopanaṃ mandaraṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ vijayaṃ punaḥ | tamarṇaṃ cābhiśaṅkhañ ca mādhavaṃ varuṇābhidham || 30.83 gopanaṃ ca karālaṃ ca kamalaṃ jṛmbhalaṃ tataḥ | śrīdharaṃ subhagaṃ māyāṃ janmadhvaṃsam anantaram || 30.84 pāśapāṇiṃ cādidevaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca paścimam | ṛtāhvayaṃ vaidharaṃ ca madhubhinmārutaṃ tataḥ || 30.85 natim uddhṛtya kathito varṇān ṣoḍaśasaṃjñitān | mantrayor anayor brahman jīvo draṣṭābhidhīyate || 30.86 dharmavartī maheśāno devatā dakṣiṇā tanuḥ | dineśa rāmasahitaṃ śvasanaṃ matibindumat || 30.87 bījam etad ato dhyānamīśānasya bravīmi te | kundendu muktā śaṅkhābhaṃ sarvākalpapariṣkṛtam || 30.88 vaiyāghracarmavasanaṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam | nāsāgranyastanayanaṃ śaśikhaṇḍavirājitam || 30.89 prasannavadanaṃ devaṃ caturbujam abhīṣṭadam | vāmajānuni vinyasta vāmetara padāmbujam || 30.90 sphāṭikīṃ cākṣamālāṃ vai bibhrāṇaṃ dakṣiṇekare | vāme karāmbuje svīye dhṛta vijñānapustakam || 30.91 darśayantaṃ jñānamudrāṃ maharṣigaṇa sevitam | dhyāyato mantriṇas tv evaṃ sidhyanti sakalāḥ kalāḥ || 30.92 gaṅgāpravāhavattasya vākprasāraḥ pravartate | caturvargaphalāvāptis tasya haste sthitā dhruvam || 30.93 japan bhūyas tathākāmān durlabhān sukham aśnute | tithau bhagavatīṃ durgāṃ navamyāṃ samyag arcayet || 30.94 nigamādiṃ vaidharaṃ ca bhuvanaṃ ca visarjanam | manur ekākṣaraḥ proktaḥ samuddhṛtya yathātatham || 30.95 svīkṛtyaikākṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ gatadhvaṃsaṃ hutāśanam | sparśanaṃ gopanāhvānaṃ tatiṃ ca manur īritaḥ || 30.96 bījamasyoddhariṣyāmi gopatiṃ pāvakaṃ tataḥ | vāmanaṃ yaṣṭiśirasamasya kātyāyano muniḥ || 30.97 chandaś ca devī gāyatraṃ vanadurgā ca devatā | mantram anyaṃ pravakṣyāmi durgāśrayam anuttamam || 30.98 nigamādiṃ viṣṇusaṃjñaṃ kapilaṃ jṛmbhalāhvayam | mādhavaṃ ca surendrādiṃ pradyumnaṃ kālanemijam || 30.99 madhusūdananāmānaṃ pulahaṃ māyayā vṛtam | karālaṃ devadattākhyaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ kamalānugau || 30.100 pavitramādidevaṃ taṃ nṛhariṃ sparśanaṃ tathā | brahmāṇam agniṃ coddhṛtya pañcabindum anantaram || 30.101 ādiṃ śrīvatsamudayaṃ subhadraṃ nāsikāhvayam | bhāskaraṃ bhadrabāhū dvau vaidharaṃ gopatidvayam || 30.102 pavitrakhaḍganāmānau dvau ca dakṣam anantaram | supratiṣṭhaṃ dvir uccārya dinakṛn mādhavī dhruvau || 30.103 phaṭkāram agnyādim anvagity uddhṛtya japen manum | asyoddhārakramādanyaṃ mantraṃ vacmi caturmukha || 30.104 praṇavaṃ vaidharaṃ paścāc chrīdharaṃ gadinaṃ tathā | vaiśvānaraṃ mṛgapatiṃ tam evārṇam anantaram || 30.105 yāntaṃ nṛsiṃha sumukhaṃ rāmaṃ svāhāṃ samuddharet | uddhṛto 'yaṃ manuś cānyo bījamaṅgāni pūrvavat || 30.106 ṛṣir jayamaticchando giridurgā ca devatā | udgīthaṃ srīdharaṃ caiva dṛṣṭidvandvaṃ trivikramam || 30.107 krodharūpī ca jīmūtaṃ paścimaṃ bhuvanāhvayam | bahulaṃ śrīdharaṃ krodhaṃ vikramaṃ sarasīruham || 30.108 vikramaṃ dharmaśītāṃśuṃ śaśāṅkaṃ ca sudhāmayam | paścimaṃ rāmaśirasaṃ krodharūpaṃ pavitrakam || 30.109 bhallāyudhaṃ tathā śaṅkhaṃmādhavī dvayamādhavam | śuklamādiṃ mṛgapatiṃ śrīdharaṃ paścimānanam || 30.110 nīhāradīdhitiṃ sarvarodhaṃ vikramaśīrṣakam | vairājaṃ kapilaṃśaṅkhaṃ vaidharaṃ bandhumastakam || 30.111 śubhadaṃ kamalaṃ vāyuṃ mandaraṃ vittavardhanam | ādiṃ karālamanilaṃ nāsikyaṃ yādasāṃ patim || 30.112 gopanaṃ vijayaṃ vighnanāyakaṃ dakṣamādhavau | subhadraṃ ca gadiṃ kumbhaṃ vairājaṃ bandhuśīrṣakam || 30.113 śubhadaṃ mandaraṃ śaṅkhaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ manur īritaḥ | ṣoḍhā vibhajya taṃ mantro hṛdayādyaṅgakalpanam || 30.114 draṣṭā vareṇyako nāma hy anuṣṭup chanda īritam | devatā vanadurgāsyād asyāṣṭākṣaravat phalam || 30.115 sarvadāhvayadurgāyāṃ mantram uddhārayāmi te | udgīthaṃ natimanvakū ca sūkṣmadṛgdṛṣṭiśīrṣakam || 30.116 gadadhvaṃsamakāraṃ ca kumbhamādyaṃ caturmukha | vairājaṃ rājamānaṃ vai vaidharaṃ śrīdharāhvayam || 30.117 gadinaṃ bandhusaṃjñaṃ ca svāhāśīrṣaṃ śriyaḥpatim | gadinaṃ pāvakaṃ caiva dṛṣṭimīkārapāvakam || 30.118 dehaṃ ca vikramaṃ caṇḍaṃ rāmaṃ mandarasaṃjñitam | madhusūdaṃ gandhavahaṃ mādhavaṃ mandarāhvayam || 30.119 ādityaṃ gopanaṃ dakṣamādidevaṃ ca mārutam | mṛgeśaṃ mandaraṃ bhānuṃ madhusūdanasaṃjñitam || 30.120 pulahaṃ devadattaṃ ca dakṣañ ca yadubhāskaram | rāmamugrātmanātmānaṃ madhūsūdanamanvataḥ || 30.121 śaśāṅkaṃ śrīdharaṃ saptajihvaṃ kumbhaṃ trivikramam | gajānanaṃ gopatiṃ ca lakṣmīṃ bhadraṃ trivikramam || 30.122 vaidharaṃ bhuvanāhvānamugrarūpaṃ ca kheṭakam | bhallāyudhaṃ tato brahman śvasanaṃ nāsikābhuvam || 30.123 vidhātāraṃ hutavahaṃ vikramaṃ ca sudhārasam | rāmaṃ ca bhadraṃ subhagamanilaṃ vighnanāyakam || 30.124 rāmaṃ mahendraṃ subhagaṃ maheśaṃ gaganāhvayam | mārtāṇḍamādidevaṃ ca śaśāṅkaṃ śrīdharaṃ tathā || 30.125 citrabhānuṃ tathā dakṣaṃ vaidharaṃ havyavāhanam | vighneśaṃ vikramaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ devadattamapāṃpatim || 30.126 madhusūdananāmānaṃ kalātmānamataḥ param | bhuvanaṃ pāvakaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ gopanaṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 30.127 vāyuṃ pavitramākāraṃ musalaṃ vikramaṃ punaḥ | ekanetraṃ mādhavaṃ ca kalaśaṃ pāvakāhvayam || 30.128 vaidharaṃ devadattaṃ ca vighneśaṃ madhusūdanam | dahanaṃ gopanaṃ caiva mārutaṃ vanamālinam || 30.129 māyāṃ ca vaidharāhvānaṃ madhusūdanamandarau | otadehaṃ dṛṣṭim agniṃ paścimānanamanvataḥ || 30.130 ṛtadhāmaṃ vikramaṃ ca śvasanaṃ mṛganāyakam | puṣṭibījaṃ trir uccārya sahasrakiraṇāhvayam || 30.131 guhālayam anusvāraṃ bījam etat trir uddharet | bhadraṃ guhālayaṃ caiva vijayaṃ gadinaṃ tathā || 30.132 padmanābhaṃ gopatiṃ ca kalaśaṃ mṛgarāṭ tathā | vairājamādidevaṃ ca ḍuṇḍubhaṃ locanodayau || 30.133 ugrātmā kheṭako vahniṃ gopatiṃ vihagādhipam | śvetāṃśuṃ paścimaṃ lakṣmīmādidevam anantaram || 30.134 vakratuṇḍaṃ gopanaṃ ca bhadrapāṇim anantaram | vijayākāramādiṃ ca śaśāṅkaṃ ca sadāgatim || 30.135 dvir abhyaset kālanemiṃ bhadraṃ puṇyaṃ dvir uccaret | mandaraṃ cādidevaṃ ca dahanaṃ śvasanaṃ tathā || 30.136 dvir brūyāt sūkṣmadṛg brahman karālaṃ vijayaṃ punaḥ | pīyūṣamādiṃ vijayaṃ vasumastakaniṣṭhitam || 30.137 nīhāradīdhitimacāmādiṃ pītaṃ samādhavam | subhadraṃ kamalaṃ caikadṛṣṭiṃ ca caturānana || 30.138 pavitramṛtadhāmānaṃ trivikramamataḥ param | puruṣātmānameṇeśaṃ paścimaṃ puratas tatha || 30.139 dhruva dhruva tathā hnasvaṃ māhendraṃ mandaraṃ tataḥ | sarvarodhaṃ gajāsyaṃ ca māyāṃ kamalamandarau || 30.140 ekanetramṛtaṃ śūlaṃ bahukukṣis trivikramam | karālaṃ padmanābhākhyaṃ vighneśaṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 30.141 bhadrahastaṃ tathā rāmaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ manumanvataḥ | subhadraṃ gopanaṃ paścāt pañcāntikamathānilam || 30.142 paścimaṃ padmanābhākhyaṃ ṛtadhāmasamanvitam | jṛmbhalaṃ pulahaṃ pāpahananaṃ padmanābhakam || 30.143 dṛṣṭiṃ mṛgeśamamṛtaṃ māyāṃ ca dvir guhālayam | pavitramṛtadhāmānaṃ vaidharaṃ mādhavaṃ tataḥ || 30.144 mārutaṃ kamalāṃ padma pavitramṛtadhāma ca | atriṃ mṛgapatiṃ lakṣmī bahulaṃ pañcabindukam || 30.145 pavitramṛtadhāmānaṃ vairājaṃ vikramaṃ tathā | paścimaṃ padmanābhākhyaṃ vaidharaṃ mṛgavallabham || 30.146 dakṣaṃ raviṃ gopanākhyaṃ subhadraṃ bhuvanaṃ tathā | kukubhaṃ mādhavaṃ paścān mādhavīṃ bhāskarāhvayam || 30.147 gopanaṃ matimantañ ca pulahaṃ mādhavaṃ ravim | yaṣṭiṃ ca vyāhared brahman tathaiva madhusūdanam || 30.148 dhruvaṃ nabhomaṇiṃ gopaṃ binduṃ ca caturānana | evaṃ trir vyāhared arṇaṃ sugataṃ sāgarottamam || 30.149 mandaraṃ bhāskaraṃ paścād gopanaṃ mādhavīṃ tathā | ādidevaṃ jagatprāṇaṃ mādhavaṃ nātim uddharet || 30.150 ity evam uddhṛto mantro brahman sarvārthasiddhidaḥ | śatena saṃmitovarṇo raśmītyādibhir eva saḥ || 30.151 bhāskaraṃ mandaraṃ pañcabinduṃ yaṣṭim anantaram | uddhṛtya bījam etena ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayet || 30.152 draṣṭā kakutsthaś chandaḥ syād aticchando 'tra devatā | sarvadāhvānamantrasya ccaturlakṣo japasmṛtāḥ || 30.153 jñānāddhyānāj japān mantraḥ siddhiṃ sarvāṃ prayacchati | mantriṇo nityayuktasya pratyahaṃ prayatātmanaḥ || 30.154 āmuṣmikaṃ caihikaṃ ca phalaṃ sarvaṃ prayacchati | daśamyām arcayed brahman kṛtāntamabhyapradam || 30.155 nigamādiṃ gandhavahaṃ hṛṣīkeśam anantaram | daṇḍaṃ prabhañjanaṃ dakṣaṃ cādidevaṃ sadāgatim || 30.156 natim uddhṛtya kathito manur vaivasvatāhvayaḥ | bījamarṇān samuddhṛtya śvasanaṃ yaṣṭiśīrṣakam || 30.157 uditaṃ tena bījena hṛdayādyaṅgakalpanam | ṛṣis satyātapaśchando gāyatraṃ daivam īritam || 30.158 mantraś ca pitṛdaivatyo japaḥ syāt pañcalakṣakaḥ | tenārādhya śrāddhadevamabhīṣṭaṃ sarvam aśnute || 30.159 prathamaṃ chandasāmādiṃ vikramaṃ mānuṣeśvaram | vaidharaṃ vahnim aparaṃ gopanaṃ pavanaṃ mukham || 30.160 natim uddhṛtya maghonaḥ kathito manur abjaja | vaidharaṃ cordhvalokeśaṃ nāsikyaṃ bījam uddhṛtam || 30.161 ṛṣir devo virāṭ chando devatā valasūdanaḥ | eteneṣṭvā turāsāhaṃ sāmrājya phalam aśnute || 30.162 dvādaśyāṃ mūlamantreṇa pūjayed uktavartmanā | bhagavanta śriyaḥkāntaṃ phalamīpsan sudarlabham || 30.163 nigamādiṃ ca natyantaṃ paścimodayanaṃ tathā | krodharūpaṃ pavitraṃ ca śrīvatsaṃ pāvakaṃ tataḥ || 30.164 adidevaṃ ca pavanaṃ gopanaṃ yaṣṭimanvataḥ | gopatiṃ bahulaṃ pañcabinduṃ narahariṃ tataḥ || 30.165 aurvaṃ yaṣṭiṃ ca kamalaṃ gopanaṃ mandarāhvayam | vaidharaṃ devadattaṃ ca kamalaṃ gopanaṃ tathā || 30.166 śaṅkhaṃ ṭhaṭhāntam uddhṛtya manur eṣa samīritaḥ | svargādiṃ pulahaṃ bandhuṃ nāsikyaṃ bījam uddharet || 30.167 ṛṣiḥ śrīnidhirasyokto virāṭ chandaś ca devatā | manmathastena yaṣṭavyaḥ saḥ sarvaphalakāṅkṣibhiḥ || 30.168 ekārṇamaparaṃ mantram uddhariṣyāmi padmaja | tāraṃ garuḍamaurvaṃ ca sabinduṃ manur īritaḥ || 30.169 lakṣam ekaṃ japen mantrī karmaṇyākarṣaṇādike | samarthaṃ kāmadaivatyaṃ manum anyaṃ bravīmi te || 30.170 udgītaṃ kamalaṃ pītaṃ māyāmardhenduśekharam | karālaṃ gopanaṃ dakṣaṃ vaidharaṃ tadanantaram || 30.171 mṛgendraṃ varuṇaṃ cādidevaṃ śvasanasaṃjñitam | śuklaṃ sudhāmayaṃ vahniṃ kakubhaṃ savināyakam || 30.172 śaśāṅkaṃ mādhavaṃ brahmasādhakaṃ bhāskarāhvayam | hairamvaṃ gopanaṃ vāyuṃ kakubhaṃ yādasāṃpatim || 30.173 pulahaṃ nigamādiṃ ca tadvayaṃ tat dvir uccaret | paścimaṃ ṛtadhāmānaṃ pūrṇaṃ parvabhir uccaret || 30.174 śaśāṅkamādiṃ jalajaṃ pītaṃ varuṇam abjaja | kakubhaṃ viṣṇubighneśau prathamaṃ tigmadīdhitim || 30.175 padmannābhaṃ vaidharaṃ ca vāyumādyaṃ ca mandaram | mandarādyadvayaṃ bhūyas tad eva samanantaram || 30.176 varuṇaṃ viṣṇum abjāñ ca yaṣṭimabdodayau tathā | dahanaṃ śrīdharaṃ varṇaṃ pulahaṃ brahmasādhanam || 30.177 karālamādyaṃ kalaśaṃ mukhaṃ śrīvatsamanvataḥ | prabhañjanaṃ gopanaṃ ca sparśamādyamapāṃ patim || 30.178 ṭhaṭhāntam uddhṛtya manuḥ kathitaḥ kamalāsana | ṛṣiḥ kaliṅgo 'ticchandaḥ kāmaś ca devatā || 30.179 japed dvir aṣṭaulakṣāṇi nāsādhyaṃ tena mantriṇā | ratiś ca viratiś cobhe tasya pārśve sthite sadā || 30.180 mantras tayoś caturthyantaṃ nāmamātraṃ triśīrṣakam | madanaḥ prathamo bāṇas tathaivonmādano 'paraḥ || 30.181 mohanaṃ dveṣaṇaṃ ca dve dīpanaṃ pañcamaṃ smṛtam | mallikā ketakī jātiḥ paṅkajaṃ yūthikā tathā || 30.182 puṣpāṇi kramaśo bāṇamāhus teṣāṃ manuṃ punaḥ | saṃvidvarṇāś ca sahitāś caturthyantasamāhnayāḥ || 30.183 teṣāṃ natyantasahitaṃ tais teṣām arcanaṃ viduḥ | dhanuraṅkuśapāśāś ca tasyāstrāṇi manobhuvaḥ || 30.184 mantrāś ca pūrvavat teṣāṃ nāmāny eva caturmukha | kalpakānokaha prāyaḥ puṣpitadrumaśobhite || 30.185 udyāne mañjuśiñjāna pakṣisaṃghaniṣevite | madhye mahāhrade pūrṇe sarojaiś ca vikasvaraiḥ || 30.186 viṣṭare kāñcane nyaste śubhās taraṇasaṃyute | āsīnaṃ saha devībhyāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 30.187 raktacandanaliptāṅgaṃ raktamālyopaśobhitam | cārukuṇḍalinaṃ kāntaṃ yuvānaṃ kṣaumavāsasam || 30.188 vasānamapsaromukhyaiḥ strīgaṇaiḥ parito vṛtam | dhyāyannanena manunā kramād ardhyādibhir yajet || 30.189 kāmagāyatryayā cāpi yajeta makaradhvajam | japādi pūrvavat sarvaṃ vaśyaṃ ca bhuvanatrayam || 30.190 mantriṇo nityayuktasya kim anyair ativistaraiḥ | aśvinor mantramadhunā bravīmi kamalāsana || 30.191 uddhṛtya pūrvam udgīthaṃ vighneśaṃ pāṭalapriyam | brahmasādhananāmānaṃ śrīvatsaṃ ca sudhāmayam || 30.192 māyāṃ subhadramākāramaśvinor īrito manuḥ | ādimardhendusahitaṃ bījaṃ tenāṅgakalpanā || 30.193 bhṛgur draṣṭā bṛhac chandaḥ pratipādyau tathāśvinau | japan vai pañcalakṣeṇa siddhis sarvārṇasādhanaḥ || 30.194 rājayakṣmādayo rogā na tiṣṭhanti tadanvaye | auṣadhāni ca dakṣāṇi vyādhīnāmapanodane || 30.195 tatkarasparśamātreṇa sarvaṃ vastauṣadhaṃ bhavet | paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā somaṃ yajeta manuvittamaḥ || 30.196 nigamādiṃ pūrṇacandramotadehaṃ samandaram | madhumārutavighneśaṃ mādhavīṃ ca visarjanam || 30.197 somasya kathito mantro bījam uddhārayāmi te | sitamādimanusvāraṃ kuryāt tenāṅgasantatim || 30.198 draṣṭā kaumodako nāma paṅktiś chandaś ca devatā | japaḥ pūrvavad evāsya gāyatryā vā samarcaṃyet || 30.199 phalaṃ ca sarvaṃ pūrvoktaṃ candrasālokyam apy atha | ity uktāstithayo devās teṣāṃ mantrasamarcanam || 30.200 phalāni ca samastāni krameṇāpy uditāni te | nāsādhyaṃ tithiyogais tair aihikāmuṣmikātmakam || 30.201 phalaṃ mantraprasādena taddevānāṃ mahattayā | sukṛtāny api karmāṇi vinā vighneśapūjayā || 30.202 na phalantyantarāyeṇa nihatāni caturmukha | tadādau karma kurvāṇair ārādhyo vighnanāyakaḥ || 30.203
iti śrī pañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde tithi devatā mantroddhāro nāma triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? ekatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
viṣvaksenoptattiḥ, kirīṭādi mantroddhāraṇam ca brahmā bhagavān vighnarājasya janma kīdṛk kutaś ca saḥ | bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca koṭīrapramukhānāṃ yathātatham || 31.1 cakrādīnām āyudhānāṃ tārkṣyaseneśayor api | manavaḥ pūjitā yais taiḥ pūjitāḥ phalahetavaḥ || 31.2 iti sarvaṃ samācakṣva mayi te yady anugrahaḥ | śrībhagavān asurair arditā devā balino yuddhadurjayaiḥ || 31.3 śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ pradyumnam abhayapradam | devāḥ āhaveṣu vayaṃ dairtyair balavanto 'pi bādhitāḥ || 31.4 yathā te vighnavihatāḥ palāyante tathā kuru | pradyumnas tair iti proktaḥ kruddhas saṃraktalocanaḥ || 31.5 kopāt tasya samudbhūtaṃ samyak stamberamānanaḥ | sañjātaṃ prāñjalipuṭaṃ kurvāṇaṃ taṃ puraḥsthitam || 31.6 taṃ dṛṣṭvā gajavadvaktraṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā | devānām asurāṇāṃ ca saṅgrāme samupasthite || 31.7 sannidhāya bhavāṃs tatra daityānāṃ vighnamācara | ity uktvā miṣatas tasya pradyumno bhagavān hariḥ || 31.8 antardadhe surāś cāpi pratijagmur yathāgatam | tataḥ prabhṛti vighneśaprasādād devatāgaṇāḥ || 31.9 asurān jaghniṃvāṃsaste na ca jagmuḥ parābhavam | ākalpasya kirīṭasya manu vakṣyāmi samprati || 31.10 vyāpinaṃ natim uddhṛtya kamalaṃ tadanantaram | mahāmāyāṃ saptajihvāṃ pañcabindusamāhvayam || 31.11 hṛdayāhlādamākāraṃ pavanaṃ śuklamandarau | dākṣāyaṇīśavijayau mandaraṃ ca saroruham || 31.12 śrīdharaṃ hṛdayāhlādaṃ mādhavaṃ vittavardhanam | kumbhaṃ hutāśanaṃ devadattaṃ kṣīraṃ sudhāmayam || 31.13 dahanaṃ gopanaṃ vāyuṃ karālaṃ kamalodbhava | otadehaṃ kṣitidharaṃ vikramaṃ dhūmaketanam || 31.14 amṛtaṃ bandhusahitaṃ bhadrahastaṃ trivikramam | caturgatiṃ śrīdharaṃ ca vijayaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā || 31.15 hastivaktraṃ vaidharaṃ ca bhuvanaṃ kāmagaṃ tataḥ | vairājaṃ vaidharāhvānam īrayitvā tataḥ param || 31.16 rāmaṃ pavitraṃ vijayaṃ gopanaṃ dviradānanam | mahendraṃ kuñjaramukhaṃ vikramaṃ sūkṣmalocanam || 31.17 gopanaṃ sparśanāmādidevaṃ samasaroruham | māhendraṃ paścimaṃ cādidevaṃ ca dhanadāhvayam || 31.18 vikramaṃ paścimaṃ caiva vijayaṃ caturānana | prabhañjanaṃ mṛgeśaṃ ca madhusūdanasaṃjñitam || 31.19 mārtāṇḍaṃ pāvakam atho pañcabinduṃ sabindukam | karālamṛtadhāmānaṃ mahāmāyāṃ sayaṣṭikam || 31.20 gopatiṃ śrīdharayutaṃ nāsikyaṃ phaṭkṛtiṃ tathā | svāhāyāṃ viramemnantraṃ bījam asyocyate 'dhunā || 31.21 kamalaṃ ṛtadhāmānaṃ mahāmāyāṃ pariṣkṛtam | uddhṛtaṃ yat ṣaḍaṅgāni draṣṭā cākhaṇḍalas tathā || 31.22 chandaś ca paṅktir ity uktaṃ kirīṭo devatāpi ca | kirīṭinaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahodaram || 31.23 kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ prahvaṃ susthitaṃ bhūṣaṇair yutam | dhyātvaivaṃ mantravinmantraṃ pañcalakṣamatandritaḥ || 31.24 natyantaṃ chandgamāmādiṃ śrīśabdaṃ kalaśaṃ tathā | ekanetraṃ hutavahaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ madhusūdanam || 31.25 sadāgatiṃ cādidevaṃ nāsikyaṃ yaṣṭisaṃjñitam | lakṣmīṃ karālaṃ pulahaṃ mahāmāyāṃ sabindukam || 31.26 tārkṣyamaurvādikaṃ yaṣṭiṃ humphaṭkāraṃ hutāntimam | śrīvījaṃ tadbhaved vījam ṛṣaś caiva prajāpatiḥ || 31.27 virāṭ chandaś ca gāyatraṃ śrīvatso devatā matā | śrīvatsamantram aparaṃ kathayāmi caturmukha || 31.28 oṅkāraṃ prathamaṃ somaṃ svarādi jayamārutau | mādhavaṃ tārakādhīśamekanetraṃ samārutam || 31.29 kalaśaṃ vijayaṃ paścān mahāmāyā pariṣkṛtam | śuklaṃ ca tāraṃ śvasanaṃ kumbhaṃ vairājam eva ca || 31.30 analaṃ pūrṇacandraṃ ca pulahaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā | natyantaṃ śuklavijayau śvasanaṃ śvetarociṣam || 31.31 dakṣaṃ daraṃ devadattamoṣadhīśaṃ tathābjaja | vairājaṃ prathamaṃ kumbhamṛtadhāmavidarbhitau || 31.32 jayaṃ sadāgatiṃ devadattaṃ caiva ṭhaṭhāntimam | śrībījaṃ pūrvam evoktam ṛṣir devala ucyate || 31.33 chandaś cākṣarapaṅktiḥ syāc chīvatso devatā matā | tato lakṣajapenaiva sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt || 31.34 praṇavādiṃ ca natyantaṃ vidhātāraṃ tathā manum | sakāraṃ vijayaṃ lokaṃ subhadraṃ madhuvidviṣam || 31.35 prabhañjanaṃ pāvakaṃ ca vairājaṃ vighnanāyakam | gopanaṃ dhanadaṃ māyāṃ paścimaṃ prathamasvaram || 31.36 vairājaṃ mārutaṃ paścād ekāraṃ prathamasvaram | mādhavīṃ padmanābhaṃ ca vijayaṃ brahmasādhanam || 31.37 agniṃ bhallāyudhaṃ kumbhamākāraṃ mārutaṃ tathā | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ kamalaṃ pulahaṃ ca pavitrakam || 31.38 ādidevaṃ ca dhanadaṃ trivikramam anantaram | paścimaṃ vijayaṃ cādiṃ sparśanaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā || 31.39 oṣadhīśamikāraṃ ca dṛṣṭiṃ ca dhanadaṃ punaḥ | rāmaṃ pradyumnasahitaṃ paścimaṃ padmanābhakam || 31.40 prabhañjanaṃ chaladhvaṃsaṃ dvayaṃ svāhāvasānakam | kaustubhaṃ bindusahitaṃ bījam etad dṛṣiḥ punaḥ || 31.41 jamadagnir virāṭ chando devatā kaustubhāhvayā | kaustubhaṃ ca caturthyantam uccārya natim uddharet || 31.42 pañcalakṣajapāt tasya manoḥ sidhyati vāñchitam | saptārṇapūrvakaṃ kumbhaṃ bhadrahastaṃ priyadviṣam || 31.43 bhadrahastaṃ mandarañ ca madhusūdanam abjaja | pulahaṃ devadattaṃ ca mādhavīṃ madhusūdanam || 31.44 māhendraṃ rāmanāmānaṃ vighneśaṃ pañcabindukam | paścimaṃ śrīdharaṃ vahniṃ bhuvanaṃ tadanantaram || 31.45 krodhāgniṃ vāsudevaṃ ca vairājau dvau ca mandaram | paścimaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca māyāśirasamanvataḥ || 31.46 mārutaṃ mādhavayutaṃ ṭhaṭhānto manur īritaḥ | kalaśaṃ mārutaṃ paścād udayaś cāniruddhakam || 31.47 bījaṃ muniś ca dhanadaḥ paṅktiś chandaś ca devatā | vanamālāparaṃ mantraṃ kathayāmi mahāphalam || 31.48 brahmakośaṃ natiṃ kumbhaṃ mukhaṃ vighneśamandarau | gopanaṃ pulahaṃ cādidevaṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca godhanam || 31.49 mādhavaṃ sūdanaṃ vāyuṃ mṛgeśaṃ dakṣagopanau | caturgatiś cādidevamanalaṃ saguhālayam || 31.50 paścimaṃ vikramaparaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ pañcabindukam | dakṣaṃ dinakaraṃ cakṣuḥ dvitīyaṃ śvetadīdhitim || 31.51 dakṣadvayaṃ vāsudevaṃ tigmāṃśuṃ bandhuśīrṣakam | dviradāsyaṃ pañcabinduṃ śvetarocivamādimat || 31.52 amṛtaṃ vahniśirasaṃ kamalaṃ gopanāhvayam | mandaraṃ vaidharaṃ māyāṃ pañcamaṃ gajavāhanam || 31.53 mādhavaṃ śvetadīdhitaṃ ca kumbhaṃ bahulaśīrṣakam | vijayaṃ caikadṛṣṭiṃ ca varuṇaṃ pāṭalapriyam || 31.54 caturgatiṃ sūdanaṃ ca mārutaṃ cādimat tathā | caturthamṛtadhāmānam agniṃ ca śvasanaṃ punaḥ || 31.55 brahmakośaparāṃ caiva bhadrapāṇiṃ ca padmajām | vijayaṃ praṇavādiṃ ca śvetadīdhitim abjaja || 31.56 śaśāṅkaṃ padmanābhaṃ vaidharaṃ māyāmahādhanau | paścimaṃ vijayaṃ māyāśīrṣaṃ vighneśam īrayet || 31.57 vikramaṃ sūkṣmadṛṣṭiṃ ca gopanaṃ ca caturmukha | janmadhvaṃsaṃ ca kalaśaṃ pulahaṃ ca dvir uccaret || 31.58 pūrvavac ca dvir abhyasya puṣṭibījam athoddharet | gopatiṃ gopanaṃ yaṣṭiṃ varuṇaṃ cādi bindukam || 31.59 bhāskaraṃ bhuvanaṃ yaṣṭiṃ phaṭkāraṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntimam | pīyūṣaṃ pavanaṃ brahmasādhanaṃ yaṣṭiśīrṣakam || 31.60 bījam etac caturvaktra pradhānārṇāṅgakalpanā | bhavaś cāsya muniś chando asyā uṣṇik ca devatā || 31.61 dvibhujāṃ bālikāṃ pīnavakṣoruhavibhūṣitām | karaṇḍamakuṭopetāṃ vibhrāṇāṃ vanamālikām || 31.62 darpaṇaṃ vāmahastena bibhrāṇāṃ dakṣiṇena tu | puṣpamañjarikāṃ dvābhyāṃ dhyātvā lakṣaṃ japen manum || 31.63 anyeṣāṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca caturthyantaṃ samāhvayam | mantraṃ namo 'ntaṃ jānīyāt bījamādyaṃ prakalpayet || 31.64 prabhāmanuṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvadavadhāraya | udgīthamādiṃ natyantaṃ paścimaṃ tv ṛtadhāmakam || 31.65 bhallāyudhaṃ cādidevaṃ śvasanaṃ sūkṣmalocanam | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ śvetāṃśuṃ kamalaṃ cādimattayā || 31.66 pāvakaṃ cauṣadhaṃ padmapāṇiṃ vairājamanvataḥ | mṛgeśaṃ janmavidhvaṃsaṃ brahmasādhanasaṃyutam || 31.67 kakubhaṃ kalaśaṃ cādidevaṃ pulaham abjaja | oṅkāraṃ mādhavīm agniṃ māyāmastaka bhūṣitam || 31.68 pāṭalapriyamākāraṃ pītābhaṃ madhuvidviṣam | śrīvatsamādiṃ vijayaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ viṣṇumastakam || 31.69 mārtāṇḍam indumanalaṃ madhusūdanamārutau | śriyaḥpatimathaikākṣaṃ gopanaṃ kamalodbhava || 31.70 amṛtaṃ tv ṛtadhāmānaṃ vijayaṃ kamalālayam | otadehaṃ subhadraṃ ca bandhumastakabhūṣitam || 31.71 vijayaṃ gopanaṃ prāṇaṃ huṃphaṭkāraṃ ṭhaṭhāntakam | ādyarṇaṃ yaṣṭisahitaṃ bījamasya prakīrtitam || 31.72 ṛṣir bhāskara etasya paṅkticchandaś ca devatā | prabhā japaś ca mantrasya lakṣasaṃkhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 31.73 bhogāṃś ca puṣkalān bhuktvā mantravin mantravaibhavāta | paraṃ padam avāpnoti dehatyāge na saṃśayaḥ || 31.74 nigamādiṃ kaustubhaṃ ca gopanaṃ bindumaindavam | vikramaṃ vaidharaṃ puṇyaṃ rāmaṃ śuklasamāhnayam || 31.75 vairājamagnimākāraṃ sparśanaṃ viṣṇumastakam | natyantam uddharen mantramevamakṣasrajaḥ sudhīḥ || 31.76 akṣamālādharaṃ dhyāyed dvibhujaṃ sphaṭikaprabham | alaṅkṛtaṃ pītavastraṃ padmaviṣṭarasaṃsthitam || 31.77 varadābhayadākāraṃ mantrasya ca japas tathā | mantrī ca mahadāpnoti phalamatyantadurlabham || 31.78 udgīthaṃ subhagaṃ śaṅkham ūrdhvayaṣṭim anantaram | dhanadaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ mandaraṃ brahmasādhanam || 31.79 bahulaṃ caikanetraṃ ca pañcāntaṃ bandhumastakam | analaṃ gopanaṃ śaṅkhamacāmādiṃ natiṃ tataḥ || 31.80 dhūpapātramanuḥ prokto ghaṇṭāmantraḥ pravakṣyate | āmnāyādiṃ kṣitidharaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ raviṃ tathā || 31.81 guhālayaṃ ca nāsikyaṃ padmapāṇiṃ pracaṇḍakam | jhaṣākāreṇa saṃyuktaṃ caturgati namaskṛtiḥ || 31.82 kathitaṃ ca manur brahman dīpapātrasya kathyate | udgīthaṃ kakubhaṃ cādiṃ gadadhvaṃsamacāṃ mukham || 31.83 pāvakaṃ vijayaṃ janmahantāraṃ brahmasādhanam | vairājaṃ vikramaparamanalaṃ ca guhālayam || 31.84 paścimaṃ cādidevaṃ ca śvasanaṃ natiśīrṣakam | dīpapātrasya kathito manuḥ samprati kathyate || 31.85 brahmakośamukhaṃ brahman saptārṇaṃ tadanantaram | śaśāṅkaṃ śrīdharaṃ dṛṣṭimādilakṣmīṃ hutāśanam || 31.86 lambodharaṃ cādidevaṃ daraṃ viṣṇuṃ ca mādhavam | nabhomaṇimatho rāmaṃ pulahaṃ cādimat tathā || 31.87 vakratuṇḍaṃ vidhātāraṃ vakratuṇḍamacāṃ mukham | kamalaṃ tv ṛtadhāmānaṃ yāntaś ca madhusūdanam || 31.88 musalaṃ gopanayutaṃ śvasanaṃ kakubhaṃ tataḥ | amṛtaṃ pītavarṇābhaṃ humphaṭkāraṃ ṭhaṭhāntimam || 31.89 śuklaṃ mukhaṃ sabinduṃ ca bījam evaṃ samuddharet | tāraṃ karālamākāraṃ pulahaṃ cādimat tathā || 31.90 vakratuṇḍaṃ vidhātāraṃ bahulaṃ madhuvidviṣam | ādiṃ caturgatiṃ humphaḍityādi hṛdayādiṣu || 31.91 kālarudro 'tha bhagavān ṛṣiś chandaḥ prakīrtitam | gāyatraṃ devatā cāsya hetirājas sudarśanaḥ || 31.92 japet dvādaśalakṣaṃ ca siddhaye mūlamantravat | āditaḥ saptavarṇāṃś ca pūrvoktān śaśinaṃ tathā || 31.93 śrīdharaṃ vaidharaṃ viṣṇuṃ śrīvatsamanalaṃ tathā | bhadrahastādidevaṃ ca śaṃkhādiṃ ca caturmukha || 31.94 sudarśanasya kathito dvādaśārṇātmako manuḥ | bījamaṅgaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ draṣṭā ca kapilaḥsmṛtaḥ || 31.95 chando virāṅ devatā ca hetirājaḥ sudarśanaḥ | japo dvādaśalakṣaṃ ca dviṣaṭkākṣaravat phalam || 31.96 āmnāyādiṃ ca natyantaṃ sudarśanapadaṃ tataḥ | caturthyantaṃ prayuñjīta phalam aṣṭākṣare tathā || 31.97 ṛṣir bhavas tathā chando gāyatraṃ hetisaṃjñitam | pūrvoditaṃ dviṣaṭkārṇaṃ mādhavīmādim uddharet || 31.98 nabhomaṇiṃ cādidevaṃ vakratuṇḍamacāṃ mukham | karālamṛtam agniṃ ca gopanaṃ kakubhaṃ tathā || 31.99 acāṃ dvayaṃ gandhavahaṃ mukhaṃ dakṣaṃ caturmukha | gopatiṃ gopanam atho jṛmbhalaṃ cādimat tathā || 31.100 māhendraṃ yādasāṃ nāthaṃ dviradaṃ pannagādhipam | sparśanaṃ nṛhariṃ kumbhaṃ rāmaṃ subhagamanvataḥ || 31.101 prācetasa sayaṣṭiṃ ca śuklamādiṃ daraṃ tathā | amṛtaṃ bandhusahitaṃ dhanādhyakṣamapāṃ patim || 31.102 nāsikyaṃ śaśinaṃ cādiṃ mārutaṃ mandaradvayam | mukhaṃ lakṣmīṃ tathaikākṣaṃ vasuṃ caiva guhālayam || 31.103 sayaṣṭiṃ kuñjaramukhaṃ gopanaṃ śubhadaṃ daram | mādhavīṃ gopatiṃ caiva gopanaṃ kālanemijit || 31.104 māhendraṃ gopanaṃ śaṅkhaṃ kakubhaṃ kumbhasaṃjñitam | pulahaṃ musalaṃ kumbhaṃ māhendraṃ bhuvanāhvayam || 31.105 gadadhvaṃsaṃ hutavahaṃ vairājaṃ mṛgavallabham | janmadhvaṃsaṃ śaśadharameṇeśaṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntimam || 31.106 bījamaṅgaṃ yathāpūrvam ṛṣiḥ syān nīlalohitaḥ | yaṣṭic chandaś ca kathito devatā hetirāḍasau || 31.107 japel lakṣatrayaṃ mantrī japasyāsya ca vaibhavāt | nigrahe 'nugrahe śaktiḥ stambhavidveṣaṇādikṛt || 31.108 calācalasamudrādiśoṣaṇaṃ kampanaṃ tathā | tatkaṭākṣavinikṣepāt sṛṣṭyādīnāṃ vidhir bhavet || 31.109 sudarśanamahāmantraṃ vakṣyāmi caturānana | mātṛkācakramālikhya samabhyarcya yathāvidhi || 31.110 svīkṛtya dvādaśārṇāṃ ca vakratuṇḍamacāṃmukham | karālamagnisahitaṃ gopanaṃ mārutaṃ tataḥ || 31.111 paścimaṃ pāvakaṃ khaḍgamanalaṃ ca kṛśānukam | vidhātāraṃ cādidevaṃ pulahaṃ madhusūdanam || 31.112 daraṃ hutavahaṃ tārkṣyaṃ dvir vasuñ ca samuddharet | pāṭalapriyamākāraṃ daraṃ dhruvasamanvitam || 31.113 lakṣmīṃ mukhaṃ ca vairājam agniṃ bhuvanaśīrṣakam | dviradānanamākāraṃ kamalāṃ madhusūdanam || 31.114 sparśanaṃ vaidharaṃ cādimanalaṃ vaidharaṃ tathā | amṛtaṃ cādidevaṃ ca māhendraṃ ca samīraṇam || 31.115 śuklaṃ mukhaṃ bhāskaraṃ ca kamalaṃ vikramaṃ tathā | analaṃ sumukhaṃ viṣṇuṃ padmanābhavināyakau || 31.116 janmadhvaṃsaṃ ca kalaśaṃ pulahaṃ bandhusaṃmitam | vairājaṃ śubhadaṃ rāmaṃ kharvadehaṃ hutāśanam || 31.117 vaidharaṃ ṛtadhāmānaṃ nṛhariṃ mṛgavallabham | pavitramṛtadhāmānaṃ mādhavaṃ bhujagaṃ tataḥ || 31.118 caturgatiṃ tathā dṛṣṭiṃ cādidevaṃ hutāśanam | bhuvanaṃ caṇḍamatriṃ ca ūkāraṃ kamalodbhava || 31.119 krodharūpaṃ dinamaṇiṃ vighneśaṃ madhusūdanam | ekākṣaṃ mandaraṃ padmaṃ vaidharaṃ gopatiṃ tathā || 31.120 paścimaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ ca khaṅgaṃ gopanamanvataḥ | bhūdharaṃ mārutaṃ sparśaṃ tṛtīyaṃ kakubhaṃ tathā || 31.121 yāntaṃ ca vijayaṃtv agniṃ mākāraṃ śvetarociṣam | ādiṃ daraṃ tathendraṃ ca vijayaṃ jvalanaṃ tathā || 31.122 śrīdharaṃ ca gadadhvaṃsaṃ bhuvanaṃ ca hutāśanam | udayaṃ caturgatiṃ vighnanāyakaṃ tv ekacakṣuṣam || 31.123 svāhādhavaṃ gopanaṃ ca yaṣṭiṃ ca kamalālayam | vakratuṇḍaṃ cordhvalokaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ vasumastakam || 31.124 mārutaṃ varuṇaṃ cāgniṃ paścimaṃ svāntam abjaja | pavitramṛtadhāmānaṃ mārutodayasaṃjñitau || 31.125 viriñcivijayau cāgni devamandaraśrīdharau | mārutāt ṣaṣṭamantraṃ ca padmāṃ vijayamādimat || 31.126 yaṣṭiṃ lakṣmyās tṛtīyaṃ ca śikhaṇḍaṃ brahmasādhanam | kheṭakaṃ mārutaṃ pāpahananaṃ pāvakaṃ tataḥ || 31.127 śaśāṅkaṃ vikramaṃ cārtidaṇḍanaṃ vikramaṃ tathā | ardhenduśekharaṃ paścāt pañcāntamṛtadhāma ca || 31.128 nabhomaṇiṃ pavitraṃ ca pavanāntaṃ ca mandaram | gajānanaṃ ca vijayaṃ dahanaṃ binduśekharam || 31.129 nīhāradīdhitiṃ yaṣṭiṃ sāntaṃ caivāgnisaptamam | mādhavīminduyāntau ca dakṣaṃ ca madhuvidviṣam || 31.130 ardhendumindumākāraṃ mandaraṃ māyayā yutam | krodharūpaṃ hutavahaṃ bhuvanaṃ puṇyavikramau || 31.131 yāntaṃ subhadramoṅkāraṃ musalaṃ dviradānanam | dhanadaṃ vikramaṃ sparśaṃ gopanañ ca caturgatim || 31.132 vairājaṃ vāmanaṃ tārkṣyaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ śvetadīdhitim | vikramaṃ vaidharaṃ puṇyaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ kuñjarānanam || 31.133 ekanetraṃ hutavahaṃ madhusūdanasaṃjñitam | yāntodayau śuklalokau bahulaṃ brahmasādhanam || 31.134 saprārciṃ śrīdharaṃ tv indraṃ yaṣṭiṃ pañcāntakaṃ tathā | yāntaṃ cāgnidvitīyaṃ ca mandaraṃ pavanadvayam || 31.135 bhadrapāṇimathaikākṣaṃ yāntaṃ ca madhuvidviṣam | lambakṛkṣiṃ ca vijayaṃ śikhinaṃ mandaraṃ tathā || 31.136 sarvarodhaṃ bhadrabāhuṃ mādhavaṃ kamalaṃ tataḥ | nāsikyaṃ kharvadehaṃ ca vakratuṇḍaṃ saroruham || 31.137 yāntaṃ kuśeśayaṃ kumbhaṃ sumukhaṃ dvimuddharet (dvis samuddharet) | otadehaṃ tathādiṃ ca śvasanaṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 31.138 karālamagnivadanaṃ mukhaṃ pāvakagopanau | nīhāradīdhitiṃ caiva caṣakaṃ havyavāhanam || 31.139 vighneśaṃ gopanaṃ cāgniṃ madhusūdanamārutau | caṇḍaṃ hutavahaṃ rāmaṃ pulahaṃ bandhuśīrṣakam || 31.140 sudhāmayamikāraṃ ca māhendraṃ rāmaśīrṣakam | sparśāntaṃ vikramādyañ ca natyantaṃ bandhumastakam || 31.141 khaṅgaṃ < khaḍgaṃ> trivikramaṃ pītavarṇābhaṃ ca trivikramam | mādhavīṃ sarvarodhaṃ ca vaidharaṃ mandaradvayam || 31.142 yāntārṇāgnirathaṃ paścād yāntaṃ gopanamastakam | vihageśaṃ śvetarociṃ mukhaṃ hutavahaṃ tathā || 31.143 śrīdharaṃ caikanayanaṃ paścimaṃ bandhumastakam | śrīvatsaṃ cādidevāntaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ kamalābhidham || 31.144 athordhvalokaṃ śrīvatsaṃ mandaraṃ madhuvidviṣam | pracaṇḍaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ śubhadaṃ ca saroruham || 31.145 bhuvanaṃ gajamukhaṃ vandhuṃ bahulaṃ mṛgavallabham | amṛtaṃ caikanayanaṃ pañcabinduṃ sudhāmayam || 31.146 vikramaṃ kuñjaramukhaṃ gopanaṃ dhūliketanam | karālaṃ janmavidhvaṃsaṃ kuliśaṃ ca hutāśanam || 31.147 śaśāṅkamādiṃ yāntaṃ ca varuṇaṃ pulahaṃ tathā | hṛṣīkeśaṃ tathaikākṣaṃ varuṇaṃ bandhuśīrṣakam || 31.148 krodharūpaṃ gopatiṃ ca dāntaṃ mandaragopanau | śikhinaṃ sparśana cādiṃ ṣaṭkṛtvaḥ pulahaṃ kṣipet || 31.149 jayaṃ sadāgatiṃ bandhuṃ pīyūṣaṃ vikramābhidham | hiraṇyagarbhamanalaṃ mandaradvayam abjaja || 31.150 puṇḍarīkākṣamagnyantaṃ vijayaṃ rāmaśīrṣakam | nabhomaṇiṃ cādidevamamṛtaṃ māyayā yutam || 31.151 atriṃ ca dhanadaṃ kumbhaṃdvayamardhendumādimat | hastivaktraṃ ca kamalamanalaṃ ca sudhāmayam || 31.152 agniṃ ca gopanaṃ māntaṃ śrīdharaṃ subhagaṃ tathā | sparśatrayaṃ bṛhadbhānuṃ gopanaṃ sumukhaṃ tataḥ || 31.153 mādhavīṃ vāsudevaṃ ca vaidharaṃ mādhavāhvayam | subhadraṃ candradhavalaṃ musalaṃ ca dvir uccaret || 31.154 brahmannanantaraṃ tasya mārutaṃ madhuvidviṣam | kumbhaṃ savikramaṃ lakṣmīṃ sudhādīdhitivikramau || 31.155 krodharūpaṃ pracaṇḍa ca bhuvanaṃ vakratuṇḍakam | karālaṃ śikhinaṃ dakṣaṃ bhadrahastaṃ tathodaram || 31.156 oṣadhīśaṃ tathā dakṣaṃ pāvakaṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntimam | bījamaṅgaṃ yathāpūrvam ṛṣir dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 31.157 chando 'ticchanda etasya devatā ca sudarśanaḥ | saptādhikā saptatiś ca varṇānāṃ dve śate same || 31.158 japena sidhyati manur lakṣadvādaśasaṃkhyayā | kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyām upoṣya prayatātmavān || 31.159 niśīthe dṛḍhadhīrmantrī śmaśāne vā catuṣpathe | japed bhūtādayas tasya pratyakṣāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ || 31.160 mahāsudarśanaṃ mantramaparaṃ kathayāmi te | dviṣaṭkākṣaram uddhṛtya gopatiṃ mṛgavallabham || 31.161 vairājaṃ vikramaparamanalaṃ madhusūdanam | gadadhvaṃsamacāmādiṃ dakṣaṃ dinakarāhvayam || 31.162 gopanaṃ dhṛtimantaṃ ca pulahaṃ paścimānanam | ṛtadhāmā dinamaṇiṃ pāvakaṃ sumukhaṃ tataḥ || 31.163 amṛtaṃ kakubhaṃ padmanābhaṃ gopatim abjaja | subhagaṃ bandhuśirasaṃ pavitraṃ vijayaṃ tathā || 31.164 caturgatiṃ devadattaṃ paścimaṃ bandhumastakam | pracaṇḍaṃ puṇrīkākṣaṃ gopanaṃ vaidharāhvayam || 31.165 sarāmaṃ caikanetraṃ ca mārutaṃ brahmasādhanam | atriṃ caturgatiṃ śvetadīdhitiṃ ca svara dimat || 31.166 vighneśadvitayaṃ paścān māyāmastakam uddharet | subhadraṃ sūdanaṃ śaṅkhaṃ vaidharaṃ pañcabindukam || 31.167 paścimaṃ caikanayanaṃ sūdanaṃ gadinaṃ tathā | bhadrabāhuṃ sarāmaṃ ca kakubhaṃ kumbhagopanau || 31.168 māhendraṃ sūdanaṃ viśvarūpaṃ bhūdharam abjaja | śubhadaṃ vijayaṃ śuklaṃ gopanaṃ śvetadīdhitim || 31.169 ṛtaṃ ca sūdanaṃ yāntaṃ devaraṃ mandarodayau | bhṛguṃ khaḍgadharau dvau ca mādhavaṃ bhuvanāhvayam || 31.170 ākāraṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ ca vaidharaṃ śrīdharaṃ tathā | ugrātmānaṃ pavitraṃ ca padmanābhaṃ ca mādhavam || 31.171 nṛhariṃ sūdanaṃ śuklaṃ bhuvanaṃ bahuladvayam | tārkṣyaṃ jhaṣaṃ gopanaṃ ca kamalaṃ bandhumastakam || 31.172 vighneśaṃ vāmanamaparaṃ subhadraṃ suguhālayam | ekanetraṃ cādidevaṃ paścimānanam abjaja || 31.173 śuklaṃ dakṣaṃ sūdanaṃ ca yāntaṃ paścimavaktrakam | ṛtadhāmaṃ tathā dakṣaṃ sarvarodhaṃ sapaścimam || 31.174 vikramaṃ śubhadaṃ cādidevaṃ khaḍgadharaṃ tathā | caturgatiṃ vāsudevaṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ savikramam || 31.175 bhadrahastaṃ pañcabindumoṣadhīśaṃ karālakam | vighneśaṃ vaidharaṃ kumbhaṃ vikrāmamanantaram || 31.176 kuñjarānanamākāraṃ caturgatimacāṃ mukham | śikhinaṃ mānuṣeśaṃ ca nṛhariṃ sparśaṣoḍaśīm || 31.177 ṛtadhāmotadehaṃ ca bhadrabāhumanantaram | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca gadinaṃ padmanābhakam || 31.178 mārtāṇḍaṃ sūdanaṃ vighnanāyakaṃ vijayaṃ tathā | padmanābhaṃ gopanaṃ ca śuklamādiṃ darāhvayam || 31.179 tatsamaṣṭiṃ dvir uccārya somamādiṃ sayaṣṭikam | bhāskaraṃ pāvakaṃ caiva dvir vaktavyaṃ tadakṣaram || 31.180 pīyūṣaṃ vikramaṃ puṇyaṃ kalaśaṃ yaṣṭiśīrṣakam | śaśāṅkamādiṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca pūrvavat kamalodbhava || 31.181 pīyūṣaṃ rāmaśirasaṃ sparśānām api ṣoḍaśam | ṛtaṃ ca sūdanaṃ śuklamatriñ caiva yathāpuram || 31.182 tārkṣyadvayaṃ ca kamalāṃ vijayaṃ ṛtadhāma ca | hṛṣīkeśaṃ tathā bhadradvayaṃ madhuniṣūdanam || 31.183 śrīvatsaṃ cādimanalaṃ ca śriyaḥpatimanantaram | pañcāntakaṃ padmanābham ekākṣaṃ mṛgavallabham || 31.184 janmadhvaṃsaṃ śvetaraśmimeṇeśaṃ dṛṣṭivāmanau | subhadraṃ bandhuśirasaṃ sparśānāṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaram || 31.185 vikramaṃ caikaviṃśaṃ ca bandhuṃ tanmastakasthitam | sumukhaṃ pavanāhvānaṃ brahmasāvijayāhvayam || 31.186 dahanaṃ bhadramamṛtaṃ matimantaṃ ca sūdanam | vikramaṃ mādhavīm agniṃ vāsudevaṃ caturmukha || 31.187 bhallāyudhaṃ śrīdharaṃ ca musalaṃ pretanāyakam | mādhavaṃ vaidharaṃ vighnanāyakaṃ dvitayaṃ tathā || 31.188 acāṃ dvitīyaṃ pañcāntaṃ viṣkambhaṃ dviradānanam | dharitrīṃ kamalākṣaṃ ca sūkṣmadṛgbandhumastakam || 31.189 vakratuṇḍaṃ mānuṣeśam aprameyaṃ vanasrajam | pracaṇḍaṃ gopanaṃ śuklaṃ bhuvanaṃ bahulaṃ tathā || 31.190 vighneśaṃ vaidharaṃ pretanāyakaṃ māyayāyutam | hairambaṃ vaidharaṃ cādiṃ paścimaṃ ṛtadhāmakam || 31.191 vijayaṃ rāmaśirasaṃ bhāskaraṃ vijayāhvayam | atriṃ mṛgeśaṃ varuṇaṃ gopanaṃ śvetadīdhitim || 31.192 śrīdharaṃ bahulaṃ pītaṃ jṛmbhalaṃ mohanāśanam | paścimaṃ bhuvanaṃ vighnanāyakaṃ dvitayaṃ tathā || 31.193 acāṃ dvitīyaṃ kamalamādiṃ śaṅkhaṃ vināyakam | paścimaṃ bhuvanaṃ binduṃ śaśāṅkaṃ dviguṇaṃ tathā || 31.194 bhadrabāhuṃ sarāmaṃ ca sudhādīdhitigopanau | yāntaṃ samīraṇaṃ cādiṃ paścimaṃ jātavedasam || 31.195 amṛtaṃ vikramam aparaṃ vaidharaṃ cānalaṃ vasu | gopanaṃ vijaya vighnanāyakaṃ vijayāhvayam || 31.196 ṛtadhāmaṃ sarasijaṃ padmanābhaṃ pitāmaha | vairājaṃ śvasanaṃ cādidevaṃ bhallāyudhaṃ karam || 31.197 śvasanaṃ praṇavādiṃ ca vighneśaṃ sarvavikramau | karālamṛtadhāmāntaṃ vijayaṃ dhanasaṃjñitam || 31.198 svacchandamathadṛṣṭiṃ ca caturgatim anantaram | śaśāṅkaṃ phullanayanaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca kheṭakam || 31.199 śaṅkhaṃ pulahamoṅkāraṃ mārtāṇḍaṃ paścimānanam | krodhaṃ vanasrajaṃ bhūmiṃ nāsikyaṃ śvetadīdhitim || 31.200 ṣoḍaśaṃ kapilaṃ bhānuṃ caturgatim anantaram | vidhātāraṃ tathā śailaṃ vijayaṃ kamalodbhava || 31.201 acāṃ trayodaśaṃ cāgniṃ kamalaṃ candradīdhitim | vakratuṇḍaṃ cādidevaṃ śaṅkhaṃ pītam acāṃ mukham || 31.202 pūrṇacandraṃ tathā dakṣaṃ bhuvanaṃ vaidharātmakam | padmanābhaṃ dhruvaṃ lakṣmīṃ brahmasādhanasaṃjñitam || 31.203 krodharūpaṃ daraṃ cādiṃ mādhavaṃ gopatiṃ tathā | vikramaṃ mādhavaṃ bhānuṃ sarāmaṃ sūkṣmalocanam || 31.204 gadadhvaṃsaṃ ca pīyūṣaṃ vighneśaṃ paścimānanam | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ śubhadaṃ sūdanaṃ yaṣṭiśīrṣakam || 31.205 karālaṃ śrīdharaṃ lakṣmīṃ mṛgeśaṃ dviradānanam | padmapāṇiṃ bhūdharākhyaṃ dvayaṃ vaidharamādhavī || 31.206 paścimaṃ pavanaṃ lakṣmīṃ brahmasādhanasaṃjñitam | krodharūpamacāmādiṃ sparśanaṃ dakṣagopanau || 31.207 yāntaṃ caturgatiṃ pāpahananaṃ bahulaṃ tathā | vakratuṇḍaṃ karālaṃ ca kakubhaṃ ṛtadhāma ca || 31.208 bhadrabāhuṃ caladhvaṃsaṃ mṛgeśaṃ dṛṣṭimādimam | dviradānanayaṣṭiṃ cānalaṃ gopanāhvayam || 31.209 sadhruvaṃ pulahaṃ binduṃ māhendraṃ madhusūdanam | ardhacandraṃ tathā candraṃ nāsikyaṃ tadviruddharet || 31.210 śaśāṅkamṛtadhāmānaṃ sūdanaṃ yaṣṭiśīrṣakam | taddvirabhyasya śītāṃśumarpitaṃ vasumastakam || 31.211 pulahaṃ vāsudevākhyaṃ sraṣṭāraṃ dviradānanam | vikramaṃ bahulaṃ brahman gopanaṃ pulahaṃ tathā || 31.212 pracaṇḍaṃ anmavidhvaṃsaṃ vighneśaṃ ca tṛtīyakam | acāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ dvitīyāntaṃ bhadrabāhuṃ pavitrakam || 31.213 ṛtaṃ cakāradviradaṃ cānanaṃ mandarāhvayam | pradyotanaṃ gopanaṃ ca śaśāṅkaṃ ca śriyaḥpatim || 31.214 vaidharaṃ śubhadaṃ cāgniṃ śrīvatsaṃ brahmasādhanam | sumukhaṃ vikramaparaṃ vijayaṃ mukham abjaja || 31.215 atriṃ sarāmaṃ pañcāntaṃ subhagaṃ madhusūdanam | yaṣṭiṃ karālamākāraṃ caturgatim anantaram || 31.216 apāṃpatiṃ śvetaraśmiṃ śriyaḥpatim ataḥ param | stamberamānanaṃ māyāṃ kalaśaṃ dīptarociṣam || 31.217 subhagaṃ gopanaṃ yāntaṃ gopanaṃ paścimānanam | hṛṣīkeśaṃ vasuṃ śaṅkhaṃ gopanadvitayaṃ punaḥ || 31.218 yaṣṭibījaṃ dvir uccārya tigmadīdhiṃ pavitrakam | ṛtadhāmaṃ tathaikākṣaṃ vikramaṃ bahulāhvayam || 31.219 gadadhvaṃsaṃ tathaikākṣaṃ vikramaṃ bahulāhvayam | guhālayaṃ pāpahananamṛtaṃ madhuvidviṣam || 31.220 rociḥ śriyaḥpatiṃ kāntaṃ vaidharaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā | pīyūṣamādiṃ kamalamaśivaṃ dhanadāhvayam || 31.221 ṛtadhāma tathaikākṣamacāmekādaśaṃ tathā | dvir uddharet kāmabījaṃ vaidharaṃ tūdayāhvayam || 31.222 gadadhvaṃsaṃ tathaivāgnimastakasthaṃ pavitrakam | gopanaṃ vijayaṃ cādidevaṃ viṣkambhasaṃjñitam || 31.223 tridaśākāramekāraṃ śvetāṃśuṃ vikramaṃ tathā | gajavaktraṃ sūdanaṃ ca kapilākṣam anantaram || 31.224 tṛtīyaṃ kakubhaṃ dvandvamastakasthaṃ vasuṃ punaḥ | janmadhvaṃsaṃ ca jalajaṃ sudhādīdhitivikramau || 31.225 kalaśaṃ puruṣātmānaṃ gahanaṃ padmanābhakam | bhāskaraṃ sumukhaṃ brahman bhuvanaṃ vijayaṃ vasu || 31.226 druhiṇaṃ ṛtadhāmānaṃ bhūdharaṃ krodhanaṃ tataḥ | svarśānāṃ ṣoḍaśārṇañ ca kumbheśaṃ musalaṃ tataḥ || 31.227 nīhāradīdhitimacāmekādaśamataḥ param | jvalanaṃ mānuṣaghnaṃ ca vighneśaṃ gopanāhvayam || 31.228 śrīvatsaṃ jalajaṃ śuklamacāmādiṃ saroruham | caturgatiṃ bhadrahastaṃ vijayaṃ padmanābhakam || 31.229 hairambhaṃ gopanaṃ caiva gādinaṃ kaluṣāpaham | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ kamalaṃ gopanaṃ vittavardhanam || 31.230 hariṇānanamāye dve kakubhaṃ varuṇāhṇayaṃ | brahman pañcāntakamataḥ dhṛtavāsumataḥ param || 31.231 vairājam agniṃ nṛhariṃ brahmasādhanasaṃjñakam | subhadraṃ sumukhaṃ kumbhaṃ mārutaṃ cotadehakam || 31.232 dakṣaṃ dākṣāyaṇīkāntaṃ mandaraṃ pañcabindukam | dhūmadhvajaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca sūdanaṃ katṛtīyakam || 31.233 harivaktraṃ rāmasaṃjñaṃ dṛṣṭivikramam abjaja | śubhadaṃ kapilaṃ hnasbaṃ bhadrahastaṃ samīraṇam || 31.234 nīhāradīdhitimacāmādiṃ kumbhaṃ hutāśanam | śuklamoṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ subhadraṃ madhusūdanam || 31.235 sparśaṃ tṛtīyamanalaṃ vijayaṃ saptamīṃ kalām | vikramaṃ sūkṣmadṛṣṭiṃ ca śrīdharaṃ yādasāṃ patim || 31.236 herambaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca bhadrahastaṃ ca mādhavīm | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca kamalaṃ bahulaṃ tathā || 31.237 sparśāntaṃ bhuvanaṃ cakraṃ bhṛguṃ kakubhasaṃjñitam | nabhomaṇiṃ vikramaṃ ca pāṭalaṃ madhuvidviṣam || 31.238 bhallāyudhaṃ bandhuśīrṣaṃ vighneśaṃ vaidharāhvayam | vakratuṇḍamacāmādiṃ kamalaṃ pīṭhapūrvakam || 31.239 gopanaṃ mānuṣaṃ caiva pulahaṃ bandhuhastakam | otadehaṃ tathāpītaṃ janmadhvaṃsaṃ trivikramam || 31.240 gopatiṃ varuṇaṃ vighnanāyakaṃ ṛtadhāmakam | ekākṣaṃ mārutaṃ cādidevaṃ bahulamastakam || 31.241 pavanaṃ sūkṣmadṛk proktaṃ sūdanaṃ ca caturgatim | subhadraṃ ca bṛhadbhānuṃ gadinaṃ varuṇaṃ mukham || 31.242 jayaṃ kumbheśamakhilamṛtaṃ bhuvanasaṃjñitam | dṛṣṭiṃ ca dhanadaṃ dakṣaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ jayāhvayam || 31.243 śaśāṅkaṃ bhuvana cādiṃ kamalāmadrimastakam | vighneśaṃ paścimaṃ bandhuṃ nāsikyaṃ gadinaṃ tathā || 31.244 māhendraṃ śaśinaṃ devadattaṃ lakṣmīṃ śriyaḥ patim | pañcāntakaṃ padmanābhaṃ gopanaṃ vighnanāyakam || 31.245 amṛtaṃ samīraṇamacāṃ dvitīyaṃ paścimānanam | vairājaṃ mādhavīm ūrdhvalokeśaṃ vijayadvayam || 31.246 bahulaṃ samīraṇaṃ devadattaṃ mandaragopanau | gopanaṃ cauṣadhīśaṃ ca bhuvanaṃ vaidharāhvayam || 31.247 śrīvatsamagniṃ vighneśaṃ gopanaṃ ca caturgatim | humphaṭkāraṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca manum evaṃ samuddharet || 31.248 bījāṅgāni yathāpūrvam ṛṣiḥ syān nīlalohitaḥ | chandaś ca varivassaṃjñaṃ devatā ca sudarśanaḥ || 31.249 aṣṭalakṣaṃ japed brahman pātāle divi vā bhuvi | gatir na pratihanyeta mantriṇo mantravaibhavāt || 31.250 sudarśana nṛsiṃhākhyaṃ mantraṃ brūmi caturmukha | udgīthaṃ nṛhariṃ padmanābhaṃ saṅkarṣaṇāhvayam || 31.251 nāsikyaṃ śuklamādiṃ ca gopatiṃ praṇavādi ca | nīhāradīdhitiṃ padmanābhaṃ ca madhuvidviṣam || 31.252 analaṃ kakubhaṃ kumbhaṃ gopanaṃ pulahātmakam | acāṃ dvitīyaṃ sparśāntaṃ sūdanaṃ pulahāhvayam || 31.253 vikramaṃ kuñjaramukhaṃ mādhavaṃ tasya mastake | mārtāṇḍaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca dvir uccārya prabhākaram || 31.254 śrīdharaṃ kapilākṣaṃ ca phaṭkāraṃ kheṭakīṃ tataḥ | ṭhaṭhāntam evaṃ kathitaṃ dvāviṃśatyakṣarātmakam || 31.255 bījam aṅgāni coktāni chando gāyatram īritam | draṣṭā ca jamadagniḥ syād devatā ca sudarśanaḥ || 31.256 sudarśanasya hṛdaye viṣṭitaṃ nṛhariṃ harim | sphaṭikācalasaṅkāśaṃ <�saṃkāśaṃ> paraśśatasaṭākulam || 31.257 pralayāmbudanirghoṣa gambhīra gahanadhvanim | śaṅkhacakradharaṃ dvābhyāṃ karābhyām itarau punaḥ || 31.258 prasārya jānunībhīmaṃ nakhadambholi bhīṣaṇau | vyatyastacaraṇadvandvamāsīnaṃ padmaviṣṭare || 31.259 bhrukuṭīkuṭilaṃ yogapaṭṭikādṛḍhabandhanam | vyādāya vaktrakuharaṃ daṃṣṭriṇaṃ sphuritādharam || 31.260 triṇetramakhilākalpakalpitaṃ brahmagarjitam | dhyāyedvevaṃ ca tanmantraṃ mantrī tarati durgatim || 31.261 sakṛtsmaraṇamātreṇa yathābhilaṣitaṃ phalam | anyeṣu mantrakalpeṣu yad uktaṃ tat samaśnute || 31.262 vakṣyāmi pāñcajanyasya mantraṃ sarvārthasādhanam | udgīthamādau saptārṇānuddhṛtya tadanantaram || 31.263 paścimaṃ bhuvanaṃ caṇḍaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ hutāśanam | mahāmāyāṃ karālaṃ ca gopanaṃ pannagādhipam || 31.264 sūdanaṃ ca tathā śaṅkhaṃ kalaśaṃ madhusūdanam | mārutaṃ bhuvanāhvānaṃ mandaraṃ bhuvanaṃ tataḥ || 31.265 kharvadehaṃ tathā cādidevaṃ śvasanamādimat | vaidharaṃ pañcabinduṃ ca paścimaṃ vijayaṃ tataḥ || 31.266 yāntaṃ guhālayaṃ pāpahananaṃ madhuvidviṣam | śaṅkhaṃ lakṣmīṃ tathāyaṣṭiṃ kharvadehaṃ ca paścimam || 31.267 ādidevaṃ mahendraṃ ca madhusūdanaśīrṣakam | vāyuṃ ṭhaṭhāntamuditam iti prokto manur mahān || 31.268 śrīvatso yaṣṭir udgītho bījam etat prakīrtitam | amuṣya sanako draṣṭā chandaḥ syād bṛhatī manoḥ || 31.269 devatā pāñcajanyaś ca caturlakṣo japas smṛtaḥ | ato 'nyaṃ pāñcajanyasya mantraṃ śṛṇu caturmukha || 31.270 saptārṇam uddhared ādau paścimaṃ madhusūdanam | bhṛguṃ candradharaṃ khaḍgadhavalaṃ kakubhāhvayam || 31.271 gajavaktraṃ tathā vāyum ādidevasamīraṇau | paścimaṃ saptamam acāṃ sumukhaṃ nigamādikam || 31.272 pīyūṣamatriṃ subhagaṃ varuṇaṃ madhuvidviṣam | gajāsyamādidevaṃ ca śvasanaṃ śvetarociṣam || 31.273 vaidharaṃ gopanaṃ cāpi gadadhvaṃsaṃ caturmukha | vairājaṃ vikramaṃ dakṣaṃ śrīdharaṃ tārkṣyavāhanam || 31.274 gopanaṃ sparśanaṃ jamnahantāraṃ salilādhipam | māhendramādiṃ jvalanaṃ tathācāṃ ṣaṣṭhapañcamau || 31.275 gopanaṃ paścimaṃ gopaṃ pītavarṇaṃ madhudviṣam | śvasanaṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca manur ittham udāhṛtaḥ || 31.276 bījam aṅgāni vai tasya devatā cāpi pūrvavat | viṣvakseno ṛṣiś chandaḥ supratiṣṭhā pitāmaha || 31.277 pañcalakṣajapenāsya sādhako mantravaibhavāt | atalādiṣu lokeṣu caranna pratihanyate || 31.278 kiṃ punar dharmakāmārthamokṣāḥ kamalasambhava | saptārṇamagre govindaṃ gadinaṃ dṛṣṭisūdanau || 31.279 caturgatiṃ cātivīraṃ bhallāyudham acāṃ mukham | apāṃ patiṃ hutavahamākāraṃ paścimānanam || 31.280 rāmaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ govindaṃ brahmasaṅkarṣaṇāv api | mandaraṃ vāyudevāhvaṃ vaidharaṃ viṣṇumastakam || 31.281 kuśeśayadhare vīrasenaṃ humphaṭ ṭhaṭhāntimam | iti kaumodakīmantram uddhared bījamasya tu || 31.282 sparśadvitīyamardhendum etenaivāṅgakalpanā | ṛṣiḥ kṛṣṇas tathā chandaḥ paṅktiḥ kaumodakī punaḥ || 31.283 devatā lakṣamantraṃ ca japataḥ siddhido bhavet | ādāv uddhṛtya coṅkāraṃ gopanaṃ dṛṣṭivikramau || 31.284 vairājaṃ mārutaṃ pāpahananaṃ vasumastakam | vairājaṃ bandhuśirasaṃ mādhavīṃ sūdanaṃ daram || 31.285 pāṭalapriyamākāraṃ samīraṇam acāṃ mukham | yāntaṃ guhālayaṃ brahman paścimaṃ bandhumastakam || 31.286 sumukhaṃ devadattaṃ ca humphaṭkāraṃ ṭhaṭhāntimam | nādaṃ pakāramūkāramardhenduśirasaṃ punaḥ || 31.287 bījaṃ prakalpayed brahman amunaivāṅgakalpanā | draṣṭā viriñcaś chandaś ca virāṭ padmodhidevatā || 31.288 daśalakṣajapāt ṛddhimakhilāṃ prāpnuyān naraḥ | iti padmamanuḥ prokto bījenāsyāṅgakalpanā || 31.289 śuklaṃ punar viṣṇur vahni pīyūṣaṃ gopanāhvayam | saptārṇoddharaṇāt paścān mandaraṃ kamalāsana || 31.290 śaśāṅkamādiṃ pulahaṃ gopanaṃ pavanaṃ punaḥ | jvalanaṃ gopanaṃ dakṣaṃ gopanaṃ kamalodbhava || 31.291 caturgatiṃ ca bhuvanaṃ sumukhaṃ madhudviviṣam | daraṃ mukhaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca mantravin mantram uddharet || 31.292 mandaraṃ bhuvanaṃ yaṣṭiṃ iti bījam idaṃ manoḥ | mudgalaḥ syād ṛṣiś chando virāṇmantrasya devatā || 31.293 musalaḥ pañcalakṣaṃ tu mantramasya pracakṣate | uddhṛtya saptavarṇāṃś ca hairambaṃ madhusūdanam || 31.294 gajāhvamatriṃ kamalaṃ madhuśatruṃ caturgatim | viṣṇuṃ śuklaṃ punar viṣṇuṃ vahnipīyūṣagopanāḥ || 31.295 śaśāṅkaṃ bhuvanaṃ vahniṃ śrīvatsaṃ brahmasādhanam | sumukhaṃ vikramaṃ cāpi vijayaṃ vaidharaṃ tathā || 31.296 rāmaṃ pañcāntakaṃ puṇyaṃ gopanaṃ yaṣṭiśīrṣakam | pañcāntakam gopanaṃ ca śvasanaṃ huṅkṛtiṃ tathā || 31.297 phaṭkāraṃ svāhayāsārdhaṃ khaḍgasya gadito manuḥ | cakramantrasya bojaṃ syāt ṛṣiḥ śrīnidhir ucyate || 31.298 chando virāḍadhipatiḥ khaḍgāravyo hetirāḍ bhavet | lakṣatrayaṃ japen mantrī kāṅkṣitāṃ siddhim aśnute || 31.299 saptārṇaṃ kalpayitvādau śrīvatsaṃ madhusūdanam | śārṅgahastaṃ gadadhvaṃsaṃ madhusūdanaśīrṣakam || 31.300 jvalanaṃ pavanādiṃ ca vahniṃ śuklamapāṃpatim | madhusūdanapūrṇendu bhuvanaṃ havyavāhanam || 31.301 pavitraṃ saptamam acāṃ śriyaṃ mandaramādimat | vighneśaṃ gopanaṃ śaṅkhaṃ mukhaṃ paścimaśrīdharam || 31.302 bahulaṃ bhuvanaṃ krodhaṃ trayodaśam acāṃ tathā | hutāśam ekadṛṣṭī dvau mandaraṃ padmasambhava || 31.303 pavitramṛtadhāmānaṃ vāyuṃ yaṣṭiṃ madhudviṣam | caturgatiṃ huṅkṛtiṃ ca phaṭkāraṃ ca ṭhaṭhantimam || 31.304 humphaḍantaṃ manuṃ kṛtvā bījamādyarṇam uddharet | ṛṣir hutānto mantrasya chandaś chando 'dhidevadā || 31.305 pāṇau japannaṣṭalakṣaṃ samare vijayī bhavet | brahmakośaṃ natiṃ sargaṃ kalātmā kamalāhvāyam || 31.306 māhendraṃ gopanaparaṃ śubhadaṃ madhuvidviṣam | śaśāṅkaṃ śrīdharaṃ vahniṃ varuṇaṃ bandhumastakam || 31.307 vighneśamādidevaṃ ca śubhadaṃ gopanaṃ tathā | pavanaṃ kūṭamaurvaṃ ca nāsikyaṃ bhāskaro manuḥ || 31.308 yaṣṭiṃ huṅkāraphaṭkārau hutāntaṃ manum uddharet | pīyūṣamādimardhenduṃ bījaṃ cāmuṣya kalpayet || 31.309 śatadṛgdṛṣṭavān mantraṃ mācchando devatāpi ca | pañcalakṣaṃ japen mantraṃ vijayet tarasā ripūn || 31.310 udgīthaṃ pāpahananaṃ gopanaṃ sadhruvaṃ manuḥ | paścimaṃ gopanaṃ lakṣmīmādidevasamīraṇau || 31.311 natyantaṃ kalpayen mantraṃ ṛṣiḥ prācetasaḥsmṛtaḥ | chando virāḍadhipatiḥ pāśo lakṣatrayaṃ japaḥ || 31.312 brahmakośam acāmādiṃ nāsikyaṃ sarasīruham | bhuvanaṃ śubhadaṃ paścād ādidevaṃ sadāgatim || 31.313 natyantam īrayen mantraṃ draṣṭā satyo virāṭ punaḥ | chando 'ṅkuśo devatā syāl lakṣatrayam imaṃ japet || 31.314 praṇavādi caturthyantaṃ nāmadheyaṃ ṭhaṭhāntakam | anyeṣām āyudhānāṃ ca mantrabījam athādimat || 31.315 siddhayaś ca yathāpūrvaṃ bhavanti japato 'khilāḥ | ato vakṣye manuṃ brahman śrūyatāṃ kathyate 'dhunā || 31.316 vaśyākarṣaṇavidveṣamāraṇoccāṭanādiṣu | śoṣaṇastambhanāveśasarvākarṣaṇakarmasu || 31.317 naṣṭadhanaviṣakṣepa samudrataraṇādiṣu | nabholaṅghanavāyvagnijalabhūmipraveśane || 31.318 indrajālādividyāsu ṛṣīṇāṃ vijaye tathā | atītānāgatajñāne bhūtasaṃvanane tathā || 31.319 devatāsannidhānādau sphoṭamuṣyādikarmaṇi | evamādiṣu sādhyeṣu tathānyeṣv api karmasu || 31.320 iti mantraṃ prayuñjīta garutmantam anusmaret | saptārṇān pūrvam uddhṛtya gadinaṃ havyavāhanam || 31.321 bhuvanaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ gopanaṃ pavanaṃ punaḥ | paścimaṃ bhuvanaṃ vahniṃ śrīdharaṃ krodhavigraham || 31.322 brahmasādhanavairājau jayaṃ mandaramādimat | amṛtaṃ gopanaṃ cāpi gopatiṃ dviradānanat || 31.323 ādidevaṃ nabhasvantamanalaṃ ca ramādharam | pracaṇḍaṃ kamalaṃ bhadrahastaṃ vāmanamastakam || 31.324 śvasanaṃ rohiṇīśaṃ ca mṛgeśaṃ mānuṣeśvaram | gopanaṃ gadinaṃ paścāt kamalāṃ bhuvanaṃ tathā || 31.325 vāsudevaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca vikramaṃ vijayaṃ tathā | vairājaṃ rāmasahitaṃ gadinaṃ mohanāśanam || 31.326 acāṃ tṛtīyamardhenduṃ pañcāntakamadhudviṣau | mārutaṃ dhūmaketuṃ ca saptakṛtvaḥ samuddharet || 31.327 huṅkṛtiṃ phaṭkṛtiṃ svāhāmotadehaṃ dhruvaṃ tathā | pulahaṃ saptakṛtvaś ca humphaṭkāraṃ ṭhaṭhāntakam || 31.328 tāraṃ varuṇagovindau vighneśam atha mādhavam | sparśāntakamakāraṃ ca pañcakṛtvassadāgatim || 31.329 ṣaṭkṛtvo varuṇaṃ cāpi humphaṭsvāhāvasānakam | nigamaṃ paścimaṃ kūṭaṃ vikramaṃ vahnigopanau || 31.330 kakubhaṃ gopanaṃ cāpi ṣaṭkṛtvo mārutaṃ punaḥ | vyañjanārṇeṣu sarvatra sukhoccāraṇam icchatā || 31.331 svarān uddharaṇe kalpyaṃ manuśāstroktavartmanā | humphaṭsvāhāvasānaṃ ca gāruḍaṃ mantram uddharet || 31.332 pañcāntakamanusvāraṃ bījam etasya kalpayet | ādau suparṇavacanaṃ vakratuṇḍagiraṃ punaḥ || 31.333 mahāsuparṇa ity evaṃ khageśvaraśiras tathā | anantavīryavantāravyaṃ pakṣirājaṃ tathāntimam || 31.334 praṇavādi caturthyanta natyantāni caturmukha | kalpayitvāṅgamantrāṇi ṣaḍbhir etair yathākramam || 31.335 aṅgāni hṛdayādīni spṛśen mantravicakṣaṇaḥ | amuṣya kāśyapo draṣṭā chandaḥ paṅktir nigadyate || 31.336 devatā garuḍas tasya japo lakṣatrayaṃ smṛtaḥ | adhastād vaṭavṛkṣasya sādhakas sādhayen manum || 31.337 āmnāyādiṃ narahariṃ vāmanaṃ paścimānanam | vairājaṃ pāvakaṃ tāraṃ iti pañcākṣaro manuḥ || 31.338 ṛṣir marīcir etasya garuḍo devatā tathā | chandaś ca devī gāyatra ṣaḍaṅgāni punaḥsvayam || 31.339 udgīthaṃ kamalaṃ vāyuṃ vāsudevaṃ dhruvaṃ tathā | paścimaṃ bahulaṃ brahmasādhanaṃ yaṣṭimastakam || 31.340 vighneśaṃ vikramaṃ vahniṃ mahāmāyāṃ dhruvaṃ punaḥ | puṣpabhadraṃ tathā pīṭhaṃ vāmanaṃ yaṣṭikaustubhau || 31.341 binduṃ kalaśacandrārdhau sūryārdhendukalātmanaḥ | pannagādhipatiṃ bandhuṃ varuṇaṃ yādasāṃ mukham || 31.342 hutāntam uddharen mantram iti gāruḍam uttamam | syād imaṃ jagataḥ sākṣāt pratyakṣaḥ pakṣipuṅgavaḥ || 31.343 brahmakośam atho padmaṃ nāsikyaṃ bhūdharāhvayam | yaṣṭiṃ pāpasya hantāraṃ binduṃ kamalamandaram || 31.344 ardhenduṃ kalaśaṃ binduṃ paścimaṃ pannagāśanam | vikramāgnim atho śatruṃ kakubhaṃ madhusūdanam || 31.345 vāyuṃ svāhāntam ity evam anyaṃ gāruḍam īrayet | ākāśārohaṇaṃ siddhir japāt tasya bhaviṣyati || 31.346 evaṃ kṛtvādyamoṅkāramādidevaṃ svapaścimam | svacchandaṃ ca dvir uccārya gadinaṃ havyavāhanam || 31.347 bhuvanaṃ medinīñ ca dvir mandaraṃ madhusūdanam | vairājaṃ vipulaṃ paścād vāmanaṃ ca dvir īrayet || 31.348 pavitraṃ padmakañjaṃ ca nāgendraṃ vāyumādimam | etādviḥ kalpayitvātho gopanaṃ yaṣṭimantimam || 31.349 tuṣṭibījārdhaśaśinaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ kalpayanmanum | saptārṇānāditaḥ kṛtvā bhāskaraṃ havyavāhanam || 31.350 gopanaṃ yaṣṭimārtāṇḍau havyavāhanavāmanau | candrārdhaudvādaśātmānaṃ hṛṣīkeśam atho dhruvam || 31.351 varuṇaṃ hṛdayāhlādaṃ dvandvaṃ kamalamādhavau | vairājaṃ śrīdharo bhūyaḥ pīṭhas tu bhuvanadvayan || 31.352 vijayaṃ śrīdharaṃ vahniṃ bhuvanaṃ punar īrayet | lokanetrordhvanāsikyaṃ karālaṃ brahmasādhanam || 31.353 analaṃ yaṣṭimanilaṃ yaṣṭiṃ kumbhodbhavaṃ tathā | hutāntam iti sarvārthaṃ jānīyād gāruḍaṃ manum || 31.354 saptārṇam uddhṛtya punaḥ kalaśaṃ bandhumastakam | krodharūpaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca tridaśāhāramādhavau || 31.355 candraṃ svāhāpatiṃ cāpi śaśinaṃ bahulaṃ tathā | mṛgāṅkaṃ śrīdharaṃ vahniṃ bhuvanaṃ dvicatuṣṭayam || 31.356 bhānumat pulahadvandvaṃ humphaḍantaṃ hutāntimam | ity anyaṃ gāruḍaṃ mantramūhenmantravicakṣaṇaḥ || 31.357 pavanena hutāśena māhendreṇa pracetasā | etaiś caturbhiḥ pratyekaṃ kramavyastair viṣaṃ haret || 31.358 samastaiḥ prātilomyena stambhanādiṃ samācaret | vyāpinaṃ vighnarājaṃ ca dāmodaram atho dhruvam || 31.359 evamādim iti brahman tryakṣaraṃ manum uddharet | yenaiva sādhito mantro pakṣirājopalakṣitaḥ || 31.360 trīṇi tasya bhaviṣyanti bhuvanāni vidheyatām | ādidvitīyaṃ bhuvanaṃ pañcāntaṃ
