amṛtaṃ tathā || 31.361 gadinaṃ śrīdharaṃ vahnimudayaṃ bhadramambujam | vairājaṃ vikramaṃ svāhā aurvaṃ ca kamalāhvayam || 31.362 bhuvanaṃ parvataṃ bandhuṃ māhendrādiśriyaṃ tathā | vikramaṃ tārkṣyavāhaṃ ca mṛgeśaṃ mandaraṃ tathā || 31.363 ādisūryo gopanaṃ ca mandaraṃ bhuvanaṃ diśam | agniṃ mṛgādhipañcāpi svāhākārāvasānikam || 31.364 iti mudrāmanur brahman kalpayed atha maṇḍalam | vistareṣu nirīkṣantāṃ teṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate || 31.365 ātmānaṃ cintayen mantrī garutmantamananyadhīḥ | atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi pakṣirājasya padmaja || 31.366 meruśṛṅganibhākāraṃ rukmapakṣatimaṇḍalam | vaiḍūryanīlanāsāgraṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ bhayaṅkaram || 31.367 vajrakalpanakhākāraṃ kalpitotkaṭikāsanam | svana gambhīranirhrādaṃ śilādhanabhujāntaram || 31.368 anantakarṇābharaṇaṃ mūrdhni vāsukibhūṣaṇam | mahāpadmodaraṃ padma dāmaveṣṭita bhūṣaṇam || 31.369 mastake baddhakārkoṭaṃ kalābhāḥ kaṭiveṣṭitam | upavītakṛtenāpi śaṅkhapālena bhūṣitam || 31.370 jayena gulikenāpi kaplitānaghanūpuram | dhanañjayābhidhānena vijayena ca bhoginā || 31.371 vāmadakṣiṇahastābhyāṃ bibhrāṇaṃ kaṭakadvayam | bālapallavatāmreṇa vāravāṇena śobhitam || 31.372 udbhinnabhrukuṭībandhaṃ karaṇḍamukuṭaṃ tathā | pakṣavikṣepagambhīra kṛtordhvanayanabhramam || 31.373 daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ tāmravartulacakṣuṣam | itthaṃ dhyātvā garutmantam ekatānena cetasā || 31.374 sādhayet sādhanīyāni durlabhāny api nākibhiḥ | yathoktaṃ japato mantramāditye nyastacakṣuṣaḥ || 31.375 ūrdhvabāhor bhaviṣyanti dāsā iva phaṇīśvarāḥ | viṣvaksenamanur brahman kathyate sarvasiddhidaḥ || 31.376 tāraṃ sudhāmayaṃ rāmaṃ krodharūpaṃ sudhāmayam | karālaṃ śaśinaṃ paścān mādhavaṃ kuñjarānanam || 31.377 gopanaṃ mārutaṃ cāpi ṭhaṭhāntaṃ mantram uddharet | tāreṇa bindunā cāpi bījam etasya kalpayet || 31.378 etenaivāṅgamantrāṇi kalpyāni kamalāsana | viśvanātham ṛṣiṃ prāhur virāṭ chando nigadyate || 31.379 devatā ca manos tasya viṣvakseno mahābalaḥ | athānyaḥ kalpito mantro viṣvaksenasya padmaja || 31.380 udgīthaṃ bhadrapāṇiṃ ca mandaraṃ brahmasādhanam | subhadraṃ gadinaṃ kumbhaṃ sumukhāntaṃ samādhavam || 31.381 sparśādiṃ bindusahitaṃ sadhruvaṃ kamalāsana | darāntaṃ gopanaṃ brahman dhanadaṃ rājaśīrṣakam || 31.382 paścimaṃ nigamādiṃ ca vairājaṃ ca samāhvayam | khaḍgahastaṃ sarāmaṃ ca jayaṃ vasuvaraṃ tathā || 31.383 śubhadaṃ saroruhaṃ vairājaṃ vikramamastakam | padmapāṇiṃ bhadrapāṇiṃ pāśapāṇiṃ ca paścimam || 31.384 sodayaṃ śatruhananaṃ mṛgeśaṃ vakratuṇḍakam | pracaṇḍaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ madhuśatruṃ caturgatim || 31.385 khaḍgahastamacāmādiṃ pracaṇḍaṃ jhaṣamarṣitam | subhadrāntaṃ madhudveṣiṃ vairājaṃ dvir vasuṃ param || 31.386 acāṃ dvitīyaṃ subhagaṃ puṇḍarīkavidarbhitam | vaidharaṃ viṣṇusahitaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ savanālayam || 31.387 śrīvatsaṃ sadhruvaṃ khaḍgahastadharaṃ tathā | kamalaṃ tv ṛtadhāmaṃ ca subhagaṃ vasugopanau || 31.388 caturgatim acāmādiṃ vaidharaṃ gopanaṃ tathā | vijayaṃ śvasanaṃ dattaṃ sūdanaṃ mṛgalāñchanam || 31.389 samādhavaṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca kayalaṃ mādhavaṃ tataḥ | pītaṃ ca dhanadaṃ kumbhamarpitaṃ sadhruvaṃ punaḥ || 31.390 kalānidhiṃ ca puradhnimādidevaṃ caturgatim | vaidharaṃ varuṇaṃ māyāṃ kheṭakaṃ ca samuddharet || 31.391 paścimaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca māvṛtaṃ śubhamālinīm | samandaraṃ darāntaṃ ca madhudveṣiṃ sumantrajit || 31.392 aindavaṃ katṛtīyaṃ ca saṃmataṃ māṭharābhidham | sundaraṃ vaidharaṃ pañcabindukaṃ bhadrakaṃ tathā || 31.393 sparśeṣu ṣoḍaśaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca caturānana | gopanaṃ caindavam atho caturgatim anantaram || 31.394 bhāntaṃ madhudviṣaṃ yāntaṃ daraṃ ca dviḥ samuddharet | kadvitīyaṃ sūdanaṃ ca vaidharaṃ ca caturgatim || 31.395 dvir vaktavyaṃ dinakaraṃ bhadrapāṇim anantaram | vaidharaṃ bhāskaraṃ cāpi paścimaṃ vakratuṇḍakam || 31.396 mandaraṃ sarvarodhaṃ ca dvir gatīr iti saṃmitam | gopatiṃ sumukhaṃ cāpi śubhadaṃ brahmasādhanam || 31.397 krodhaṃ caturgatiṃ cāpyādibījaṃ caturmukha | ādidevaṃ tathākumbhaṃ saṃprasāraṇam akṣaram || 31.398 śrīvatsaṃ puruṣātmanaṃ mantravikramaniṣṭhitam | varuṇaṃ śaṅkham aparaṃ paścimaṃ padmanābhakam || 31.399 subhadraṃ ca madhudveṣiṃ kumbhaṃ bhadrakaraṃ tathā | vaidharaṃ śubhadaṃ cāgniṃ caturgatim anantaram || 31.400 huṅkāraṃ ca vaṣaṭkāramīrayet kamalāsana | śubhadaṃ vāmanaparaṃ krodhaṃ cāgniṃ madhudviṣam || 31.401 caturgatiṃ sūdanaṃ ca vakratuṇḍaṃ samīraṇam | mādhavaṃ vijayaṃ bhadrahastaṃ ca samataṃ punaḥ || 31.402 vidhātāraṃ mṛgeśaṃ ca bhāgaṃ yāntaṃ savikramam | saroruhaṃ madhudveṣiṃ paścimaṃ rāmaśīrṣakam || 31.403 māhendramamṛtaṃ bandhuṃ katṛtīyaṃ mṛgaṃ tathā | bhāskaraṃ sūdanam atho śaṅkhaṃ khaḍgadharaṃ punaḥ || 31.404 vairājaṃ sodayaṃ caiva katṛtīyaṃ vasuṃ param | dvitīyaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ bandhusaṃhitam || 31.405 mādhavaṃ varuṇaṃ pārśvamedharaṃ daragopanau | caturgatiṃ khaḍgadharaṃ saṛtaṃ brahmasādhanam || 31.406 sabinduṃ paścimaṃ caiva vācāṃ saptamasādhane | sadhruvaṃ cendirābījaṃ puṣṭībījaṃ sahuṅkṛtim || 31.407 sudhārasaṃ caurvaparaṃ mādhavaṃ ca caturmukha | vauṣaṭkāraṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ darāntaṃ pañcabindukam || 31.408 yāntaṃ ca sūdanaṃ māntaṃ śrīśabdaṃ bhadrapāṇinam | vikramaṃ pulahaṃ dhūmaketanaṃ sūrinandanam || 31.409 huṅkṛtiṃ vaidharaṃ bhānuṃ vighneśaṃ madhusūdanam | kharvadehaṃ sabandhuṃ ca pītaṃ bhallāyudhaṃ tathā || 31.410 mādhavaṃ varuṇaṃ bhadrahastaṃ sargiṇam abjaja | pavitraṃ sūdanam atho vairājaṃ ca samīraṇam || 31.411 oṅkārādi jayaṃ pītaṃ sūdanaṃ vidhuraṃ punaḥ | śrīdharaṃ māṇibhadraṃ ca dviradaṃ vikramaṃ tathā || 31.412 vakratuṇḍadharaṃ binduṃ pīyūṣaṃ rāmaśīrṣakam | atriṃ ca sūdanaṃ yāntaṃ mandaraṃ daravaidharau || 31.413 dvayaṃ vasuśiraś śaṅkha kumbhaṃ vikramamastakam | pūrṇaphuṭaṃ sadhruvaṃ ca vaidharaṃ ca caturgatim || 31.414 śuklaṃ phuṭaṃ vahniparaṃ vaidharaṃ ca madhudviṣam | subhadraṃ madhuvidveṣaṃ sarasīruhasambhava || 31.415 kapilākṣaṃ hutavahaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ ca samuddharet | bījāny etad dvir uccārya śuklapītāntimākṣaram || 31.416 śīrṣaṃ ca gopanaṃ caṇḍaṃ paścimaṃ jayatatparam | bhallāyudhaṃ mārutaṃ ca sargiṇaṃ caturānana || 31.417 kṛpākaraṃ śarīraṃ ca vasutacchirasaṃ tathā | subhadram ūrdhvalokeśaṃ vijayaṃ samprasāraṇam || 31.418 subhadraṃ puruṣātmānaṃ kalāntaṃ phaṭkṛtiṃ tathā | nigamādiṃ śaśadharaṃ mādhavaṃ vasumādhavam || 31.419 bhallāyudhaṃ tathā sargaṃ phaṭkṛtiṃ dakṣamakṣaram | gopatiṃ gopanaṃ kumbhaṃ vikramaṃ krodharūpiṇam || 31.420 pracaṇḍaṃ sārdham amṛtaṃ mādhavaṃ ghaṭavikramam | ugrātmānaṃ tathā kumbhaṃ kamalaṃ dvividhuntudam || 31.421 dattaṃ bhadraṃ sūdanaṃ ca dakṣāntakaṃ humphaḍantakam | svāhāvasānam ity evaṃ viṣvaksenamahāmanum || 31.422 uddhared bījamasyātha tāraṃ kumbhaṃ manuṃ dhruvam | kalpayed amunaivāṅgamantraṃ mantravicakṣaṇaḥ || 31.423 drupado dṛṣṭavān etat chando 'ticchanda ucyate | vipvakseno devatā ca japel lakṣatrayaṃ punaḥ || 31.424 etaṃ mahāmanuṃ brahman japatas siddhikāṅkṣayā | surāsurebhyas sarvebhyo bhayaṃ tasya praṇaśyati || 31.425 athedānīṃ pravakṣyāmi tasyārādhanasaṃyutam | kalpayitvā mahāpadmaṃ dalair dvādaśabhir yutam || 31.426 karṇikāyāṃ samāsīnaṃ senānyaṃ samyag arcayet | viṣvaksena namaste 'stu namo mṛtyubhayāvaha || 31.427 namaḥ pāriṣadeśāya dhuryāya jagatāṃ namaḥ | carācarāṇāmādis tvaṃ janmanāśo na vidyate || 31.428 dhuramādhāya lokānāṃ tvayy eva puruṣottamaḥ | yoganidrā sukhavaśaśśete śeṣe manohare || 31.429 ekāntināṃ tapobhaktiprakarṣakṣīṇakarmaṇām | bhagavatprāptaye dvāradṛṣṭayas tvāṃ prabhūtaye || 31.430 brahmāṇamāhuḥ kalpādau pālane taṃ madhudviṣam | patiṃ paśūnāṃ saṃhāre jagatastasthuṣām api || 31.431 pādena medinīṃ viśvaṃ madhyena paramambaram | nākaṃ mūrdhnā tvam ākramya tiṣṭhasyeko jaganmayaḥ || 31.432 tvaṃ bhūmis tvam apāṃ sthānaṃ tejaśra tvaṃ samīraṇaḥ | ākāśas tvaṃ tvāmiyante vibhūtir vyāpya tiṣṭhati || 31.433 tvam eva bhāskaro bhūtvā viśvaṃ tapasi viṣṭapam | āhlādayasi tadbhūyaḥ somo bhūtvā kṛpānidhiḥ || 31.434 sattvarūpasya te rūpe guṇāvanyo rajastamaḥ | viṣṇurūpe yathārūpe śuklarūpasya vastunaḥ || 31.435 tvāṃ sṛṣṭvā bhagavānādau bhaṅktvā taiḥ hetubhiḥ punaḥ | tvāṃ smṛtvā sattamaḥ paścāt pumāneti tvadātmavān || 31.436 vaibhavena nijenaiva vibhrāṇe tvayi viṣṭapam | pitāmahassukhaṃ śete śeṣe 'śeṣajagatpatiḥ || 31.437 ṛgbhīḥ prātaḥ stuvanti tvām yajubhir madhyame dine | sāyāhre sāmabhiḥ puṇyaiḥ sūryātmānaṃ dvijātayaḥ || 31.438 pravṛttihetuṃ viśvasya tvām eva prakṛtiṃ viduḥ | pumāṃsamapyudāsīnaṃ tatsākṣiṇamakalmabam || 31.439 na kiñcid abhirūpaṃ yadviśvaṃ te viṣṭapaṃ punaḥ | nāsti te nāmadheyaṃ ca tvannāmāgniṃ suhṛdvidaḥ || 31.440 saṃkhyā nāsti guṇānāṃ te tejasām api bhāsvataḥ | ṣaḍguṇā ity uktatvāt prameyādīn pracakṣate || 31.441 śaknoṣi budhyase viśvaṃ bibharṣi na vikārayam | īśiṣe dviṣato haṃsi tvam eva bhuvanatrayam || 31.442 hitaiṣī tvaṃ yathā svāmin bhaktānāṃ gatapāpmanām | tathā ca bāndhavās teṣāṃ sākṣād ātmāhikaṃ bahu || 31.443 jalānāmiva sindhur vai dīdhitīnāmivāṃśumān | svāminnāmnāyamūlānāṃ bidyānāṃ prabhavo bhavān || 31.444 natu tiṣṭhanti śāstrāṇi bahūni kathayann api | na ca tvadbhaktisārāṇāṃ kalyāṇāni vicintayan || 31.445 bhave 'smin duḥkhabahule tvām āhur yogināṃ gatim | apāṃ śivānāmādhāramadhvagānāṃ vivāsinām || 31.446 dhanyaṃ tava pradeśeṣu gatyantaramapaśyatām | nirvāpayasi nocec ca tvaṃ kaṭākṣasudhārasaiḥ || 31.447 duḥkhadāvāgnibhir dagdhā jantavastaṃ mahīmayāḥ | viśālavakṣasaṃ śyāmaṃ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇam || 31.448 sālākāracaturbāhuṃ tvām ahaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje | cakravākā ivādityaṃ cātakā vāridaṃ yathā || 31.449 cakorā iva śītāṃśumārtas tvām ahamāśraye | etat paṭhati yaḥstotraṃ śrutibhiḥ saṃsthitaṃ tvimam || 31.450 prīyate tasya bhagavān senānīravilambitam | dadyāc ca sampadas sarvās tasmai bhaktāya durlabhāḥ || 31.451
iti śrī pañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde ``vighnarājoptati- kirīṭādi-mantroddhāraḥ nāma" ekatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
aihikāmuṣmika sudarśana mahāmantrabaibhavaḥ brahmā aihikāmuṣmikaṃ sarvaṃ mantraṃ saudarśanaṃ param | śuśrūṣā bhagavannadya rahasyam api pāvanam || 32.1 bhaktāya mahyaṃ dātavyaṃ praṇatāya yathātatham | śrī bhagavān hanta te kathayiṣyāmi mantraṃ sarvārthasādhanam || 32.2 yathārtha nāma tenāyaṃ nākhyeyo yasya kasyacit | udgītham uddharet pūrvaṃ candramādyaṃ nabhomaṇim || 32.3 ātriṃ sitadyutiṃ vahniṃ gopanaṃ jvalanaṃ mukham | ūṣmāṇamudayaṃ vīraṃ phullākṣaṃ viṣṇumastakam || 32.4 hṛdayāhlādam ity eva mantroddhāraś caturmukha | vahnimādimanusvāraṃ bījam uddhṛtya kalpayet || 32.5 ṣaḍaṅgam anuvarṇānām uddhāraḥ kathyate kramāt | aṅgatrayaṃ caturvaktra pūrvam āviṣkṛtaṃ mayā || 32.6 caturthyantaṃ cakrapadam udgīthādi prayojayet | anantaraṃ sūryapadaṃ tadvibhakte ca tatpadam || 32.7 pañcamaṃ ṣaṣṭam apy aṅgaṃ padaṃ tattadvibhaktikamaḥ | uddhāryaṃ ca sahasrādi jvālādhārādi pūrvakam || 32.8 evam aṅgāni ṣaḍ brahman uktāni gahanāni te | ahirbudhnyo manor draṣṭā virāṭ chandaḥ sudarśanaḥ || 32.9 devatā munayaś cātra pratyakṣaram athābjaja | vyāsaḥkaṇvo nāradaś ca vasiṣṭhaḥ paramo bhṛguḥ || 32.10 atriṣṣaḍete draṣṭāraś chandāṃsyakṣaraśaḥ śṛṇu | uṣṇikbṛhatyau gāyatraṃ paṅktiś ca jagatī virāṭ || 32.11 varṇāḥ kālāgnivarṇābhāḥ kālāś caiva hi devatāḥ | karayor nyasya talayor ubhayor akṣarāṇi ṣaṭ || 32.12 prathamāntārṇaśiṣṭānām aṅguṣṭhādiṣu parvasu | aṅgulīṣu kramād evam akṣaranyāsa īritaḥ || 32.13 dehe ca mūrdhni cāsye ca hṛdaye guhyajānunoḥ | pādayor nyasanīyāni kramān mantrākṣarāṇi ṣaṭ || 32.14 śrīsudarśanagāyatrīmaparānnaparājitām | vakṣyāmi tasya coddhāraḥ padaśaḥ kathyate 'dhunā || 32.15 udgīthādi caturthyantaṃ sudarśanapadaṃ tataḥ | vettiṃ luḍantam aparaṃ bahvarthaṃ padam īrayet || 32.16 mahāpūrvaṃ cakrapadaṃ tadvibhaktir vibhūtijam | dhyāyantī padam uccārya pūrvavat tadvibhūṣitam || 32.17 tatpadaṃ cāsmadādeśaḥ naḥ padaṃ ca dviśīrṣakam | prapūrvaṃ codayāntaṃ ca padam ity uddharen manum || 32.18 asya bījaṃ tu pūrvoktaṃ veditavyaṃ caturmukha | āśāśu daśasu sthāpya mantraṃ taccakramudrayā || 32.19 tanmadhye sthitamātmānam agnijvālāparītavat | dhyāyet kṣititale śuddhe sahasradalapaṅkaje || 32.20 karṇikāyāṃ cakradharaṃ dvibhujaṃ bṛttalocanam | daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam || 32.21 mahodaraṃ mahākāyaṃ japākusumasannibham <�saṃnibham> | karaṇḍamakuṭopetaṃ raktāmbaravibhūṣitam || 32.22 dhārayantaṃ śikhāratne cakraṃ meghasamaprabham | nābhinemisamāyuktaṃ jvālāmaṇḍaladussaham || 32.23 jvalatṣaḍarasaṃyuktamayutārkasamaprabham | padmam evaṃ sthitaṃ dhyāyet tannābhau ca suvistṛte || 32.24 cakrābhimāninaṃ devaṃ dvihastaṃ puruṣaṃ sthitam | raktāmbaradharaṃ raktaṃ raktacandanapaṅkilam || 32.25 karaṇḍamakuṭopetaṃ sarvākalpapariṣkṛtam | daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanam || 32.26 udgirantaṃ hutavahaṃ karajair mārutānugam | vipphuliṅgād durviṣahādvisṛjantamanekaśaḥ || 32.27 kāmarūpasahasrebhyaḥ pralayāmbudanissvanam | tarjanaṃ vāmatarjanyā bibhrāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe kare || 32.28 nipīḍitāṅguliṃ śatruṃ praharann iva bhīṣaṇam | dahann iva ca netrābhyāṃ pibann iva mahodadhim || 32.29 dhyātvaivam arcayed bhogair ardhyādibhir atandritaḥ | siddhaye mantrarājasya puraścaryā yathoditā || 32.30 deśe kāle ca mantrasya rūpaṃ saṃkhyā ca pūrvavat | śākakandaphalakṣīrasaktupiṇḍānnabhakṣaṇaḥ || 32.31 toyais tarpaṇam agnau ca juhuyāt samidādibhiḥ | mantras sidhyati tasyaivaṃ kurvāṇasya yathāvidhi || 32.32 siddhiṃ ca sūcayatyasya svapne maṅgaladarśanam | prayuñjīta tato mantraṃ śāntikādiṣu karmasu || 32.33 ṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyuktaṃ kalpayed yāgamaṇḍapam | sthāpayet tatra vidhivat kumbhānāṃ pañcaviṃśatim || 32.34 veṣṭitān sūtravastrādyair dhānyarāśiṣu maṅgalān | eṣu dravyāṇi saṃgṛhya nyaset kamalasambhava || 32.35 ghṛtamuṣṇodakaṃ ratnaṃ phalodakam anantaram | lohatoyaṃ mārjanāmbho gandhāmbhaś cākṣatodakam || 32.36 yavodakaṃ kramād eṣu kumbheṣu navasu kṣipet | pādyaṃ gulodakaṃ caiva dadhi cekṣurasaṃ tathā || 32.37 arndhyaṃ ca nālikerāmbhaḥ kṣīraṃ ca tadanantaram | sarvauṣadhijalaṃ tadvadācāmaṃ maṅgalodakam || 32.38 madhupūrvaṃ śāntivāri pañcagavyam anantaram | mūlodakaṃ kaṣāyāmbhaḥ puṣpavāri caturmukha || 32.39 dravyāṇy eteṣu kumbheṣu bahiṣṭeṣu vinikṣipet | pratyekaṃ śatakṛtvaś ca mantreṇaivābhimantrayet || 32.40 kumbhe dravyāṇi nikṣipya cakrāvjaṃ vartayet tataḥ | tanmadhye mantrarājena yaṣṭavyaṃ tatsudarśanam || 32.41 kuṇḍe vṛtte ca juhuyāt samidannādibhiḥ kramāt | hutvā niśāyāṃ manunā prabhāte 'rdhyādibhiḥ kramāt || 32.42 arcayitvā hetirājaṃ hutvāgnau samidādibhiḥ | bhūrjapatre likhec cakraṃ nābhinemisamanvitam || 32.43 ṣaḍaraṃ tatra pūrvādikramāc caiva ṣaḍakṣaram | likhitvā chandasāmādiṃ tanmadhye sādhyanāma ca || 32.44 hemasūcyā likhed dravyair miśritaiś candanādibhiḥ | candanadvayakāśmīrarocanāgarumukhyakaiḥ || 32.45 gandhadravyaiḥ sumampiṣṭaiḥ paścāt tāṃ bhūrjapatrikām | gulikāṃ kārayet tāṃ ca śālitaṇḍularāśiṣu || 32.46 adhivāsyānvahaṃ kumbhaiḥ snāpayitvā yathāvidhi | bandhayet tāṃ māturaṅge mantreṇānena mantravit || 32.47 gulikābandhanenaiva mukto rogādibhir naraḥ | tejasvī bhavati kṣipraṃ tvacā mukto yathoragaḥ || 32.48 jvalitasya bhavec chāntiḥ prasūnaiḥ nimbasambhavaiḥ | dūrvāṅkurāṃ cūtadalaiḥ siktair madhupayoghṛtaiḥ || 32.49 manunā juhuyād agnau saptarātramatandritaḥ | pratyahaṃ daśasāhasrasaṃkhyayā rogisannidhau || 32.50 abhiṣicya tathā kumbhaiḥ rogiṇaṃ cakravidyayā | baddhvā ca gulikāṃ mantrī mocayej jvaritaṃ jvarāt || 32.51 gobhūhiraṇyavastrādyair mantriṇaṃ toṣayet tataḥ | brāhmaṇebhyo yathāśakti dadyād gokambalādikam || 32.52 bhūtagrahapiśācādi pīḍitānāṃ tathā nṛṇām | śāntaye juhuyād agnau kiṃśukotthaiḥ samiccataiḥ || 32.53 triyahaṃ trisahasraiś ca teṣāṃ baddhā śikhāṃ tataḥ | guggulūlthena dhūpena dhūpitān grahapīḍitān || 32.54 tāḍayen mantrajaptena daṇḍena latayāpi vā | piśācādis tato brūyān muñcāmīti prapīḍitaḥ || 32.55 śapathaṃ kārayitvā tu śikhābandhaṃ ca mocayet | sthāpitaiḥ kalaśaiḥ paścān mantreṇa grahapīḍitam || 32.56 snāpayed bandhayec cāpi gulikām abhimantritām | tato vimucyate rogāc cetovāgbhir upadravāt || 32.57 tejasvī śatamāyuś ca bhaven mantra prabhāvataḥ | nārī ca durbhagā cakradhāraṇāt subhagā bhavet || 32.58 vandhyā ca garbhiṇī sadyaḥ suprasūḥ syād apaprasūḥ | anṛtuḥ syād ṛtumatī vimukhā sumukhā bhavet || 32.59 virahe saṅgatā bhartrā bhaved acirakālataḥ | strīprasūḥpumprasūtiś cāstanā stanamaṇḍitā || 32.60 kumāra pakṣipīḍādau bālānāṃ ca yathoditaiḥ | vidhibhir mucyate duḥkhāt labhate śāntim uttamām || 32.61 prāsāde 'pi narendrasya brahmarakṣomukhair grahaiḥ | praveśe sati tanmadhye kumbhān ratnasamanvitān || 32.62 sthāpayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ samidādyair atandritaḥ | mantreṇa juhuyān mantrī dvādaśāhān samāhitaḥ || 32.63 pratyekaṃ daśasāhasrasaṃkhyayā kamalāsana | tāmrapatre śilāyāṃ vā cakramālikhya tatpunaḥ || 32.64 dhānyarāśiṣu saṃsthāpya niśāyāṃ prātarutthitaḥ | prāsādadvāri nikhaned dikṣu cāṣṭasu mantritam || 32.65 prokṣayet kumbhatoyena gṛhaṃ sarvam aśeṣataḥ | palāyante grahās sarve dūrataḥ sarvatomukhaḥ || 32.66 tadrāṣṭre 'pi na tiṣṭhanti sarvakālamasaṃśayam | prāsādavartinaḥ sarve jīvanti nirupadravāḥ || 32.67 dhanadhānyasamṛddhiś ca yathā dhanadaveśmani | vastraśayyāsanādīnāṃ daṃśane mūṣikādibhiḥ || 32.68 raktāsthidarśanenāpi keśānāṃ dahane tathā | akasmād gopurādīnāṃ dahane 'śanipīḍite || 32.69 niśi śakradhanur darśe nivāte caityabhūruhaḥ | bhaṅge valmīkajanane duḥsvapne 'nyatratādṛśe || 32.70 evamādau durnimitte śāntim etena kārayet | yajñavṛkṣasamidbhiś ca homaḥ pūrvoktasaṃkhyayā || 32.71 kuryāc ca śāntiṃ puṣṭyādikarmaṇā kamalāsana | kathyante tāni bahudhā nābhedaṃ yānti bhedataḥ || 32.72 sarvābhyudayakarmāṇi caturaśreṣu kārayet | pauṣṭikaṃ padmakuṇḍeṣu śāntiṃ vṛtte sukhāvahām || 32.73 trikoṇe māraṇaṃ karma kuṇḍe cāpākṛtau punaḥ | uccāṭanaṃ yakṣakanyāsādhane koṇapañcake || 32.74 ṣaḍaśre stambhanaṃ karma saptāśre mohanaṃ bhavet | vidveṣaṇaṃ navāśre syād aṣṭāśre māraṇo vidhiḥ || 32.75 ekādaśāśre brahmādi vaśīkaraṇam ācaret | kuṇḍe daśāśre paśvādi devatātoṣaṇo vidhiḥ || 32.76 dvādaśāśre tu puruṣaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ draṣṭum ācaret | yonyākāre vivāhārthaṃ kanyārthaṃ kamalāsana || 32.77 caturviśatyaṅgulaiḥ syād vistārāyāmakalpanam | khātaṃ tāvadbhir eva syāt kuṇḍeṣu niyatiṃ śṛṇu || 32.78 tadardhaṃ pādam athavā caturaṅgulam eva vā | parito dvyaṅgulaṃ hitvā bahis tisraś ca vedikā || 32.79 kāryāstāsāñ ca vistāraś caturaṅgulasaṃmitaḥ | tāvatyevonnatir brahman kuṇḍasya dhanuṣaḥ punaḥ || 32.80 aṅgulyā navatiḥ ṣaṭ ca jyā ca ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulā | śaṅkuṃ vidhāya tanmadhye daśāṅgulasamāyatam || 32.81 bhrāmayet paritaḥ sūtraṃ kuṇḍaṃ tadvalayākṛtim | caturaśrasya kuṇḍasya vibhajet pañcadhā bhujam || 32.82 dvau bhāgau bhujam ekaṃ ca triṃśat pañcāthavā punaḥ | aṅgulīnāṃ bhaved eṣāṃ trikoṇāṅke bhujaḥ smṛtaḥ || 32.83 kuṇḍe ṣaḍaśre ca bhujā aṣṭāṣṭaikādaśāṅgulāḥ | eko bhujaḥ pañcakoṇe viṃśatyaṅgulisaṃmitaḥ || 32.84 saptāśre ca bhujāyāmo yavaṣaṭkādhikāḥ punaḥ | tisraś ca daśacāṅgulyaḥ kuṇḍe tv aṣṭāśribhir yute || 32.85 dvyādhikā daśa vā bhūmau daśāṅgulam itīritam | aṅgulyos tu bhujāyāmo nalaskandāṃśakīrtitaḥ || 32.86 navāśrakuṇḍeṣu yavā pañcakoṇe bhujāyatiḥ | daśa cāṅgulayaḥ proktā daśāśre ca caturmukha || 32.87 yavāḥ pañca bhujāyāmo nava cāṅgulayaḥ | ekādaśāśre kuṇḍe tu yavair aṣṭābhir anvitaḥ || 32.88 aṣṭāv aṅgulayaḥ kuṇḍe dvādaśāśre bhujāyatiḥ | aṣṭādaśāṅgulāḥ prokto yonikuṇḍeṣu cāyatīḥ || 32.89 aṣṭau ca catvāriṃśac ca bhaved aṅgulayo 'bjaja | gajoṣṭhasannibhā yonir yadvāśvatthadalopamā || 32.90 kuṇḍāny uktāny athaidānīṃ śāntyādiḥ pratikalpyate | yatkuṇḍaṃ yasya kathitaṃ śāntyādes tasya tadbhavet || 32.91 aśvavāraṇaśālāsu cakrayantraṃ yathāvidhi | likhitvā tāmradārvādau niśāyāmadhivāsayet || 32.92 sahasrakṛtvaḥ kartavyo homaḥ kuṇḍe śubhe yataḥ | samidbhir yajñayogyābhiḥ sthāpayet kumbhamarcitam || 32.93 atha prabhāte śālāyāṃ yantraṃ khanyān mahītale | prokṣayet kumbhatoyena gajānaśvān pṛthakpṛthak || 32.94 saudarśanena mantreṇa puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tathā | naśyanti vyādhiyasteṣāṃ gajāśvānāṃ caturmukha || 32.95 balaṃ syād adhikaṃ teṣāṃ iti saptāham ācaret | brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dadyād yathāśakti ca dakṣiṇām || 32.96 ūrjasvalamatho brahman gajāśvaṃ jāyate bhṛśam | tathā ca pratyahaṃ homaḥ syāt sudarśanavidyayā || 32.97 itthaṃ gomahiṣādīnāṃ rakṣāṃ kurvīta mantravit | purarakṣāmatha brahman pravakṣyāmi yathātatham || 32.98 stambhaiṣṣoḍaśabhir yuktāṃ darbhamālāpariṣkṛtām | puramadhye prapāṃ kṛtvā juhuyāt sarpiṣā punaḥ || 32.99 pālāśābhiḥ samidbhiś ca dināny ekonaviṃśatiḥ | dikṣv aṣṭāsu tathā madhye purasya kamalāsana || 32.100 khanyāt saudarśanaṃ yantraṃ sthāpayet kumbhamañjasā | toyena prokṣayed vidvānnagaraṃ cakravidyayā || 32.101 ṛgbhiś ca pāvamānībhiḥ praśastābhir yathākramam | puradvāredhu saudheṣu maṇḍapeṣu mahībhṛtām || 32.102 sarvatra nikhanec cakraṃ juhuyāt samidādibhiḥ | maraṇavyādhi durbhikṣa jvarādi vyādhayaḥ punaḥ || 32.103 naśyanti balavantaś ca bhavanti puravāsinaḥ | grāmamadhye tathā dikṣu vidikṣu caturānana || 32.104 śṛṅgāṭakeṣu sarveṣu nikhanedāyudhādhipam | grahavetālarakṣāṃsi jyādhayaś ca jvarādayaḥ || 32.105 na bādhante puragrāmamapasmārādayas tathā | na taskarabhayaṃ kiñcid akālamaraṇaṃ tathā || 32.106 puruṣāyuṣavantaḥ syur narā dhānyadhanānvitāḥ | saubhāgyaṃ śāntirārogyaṃ tathā kulavivṛddhayaḥ || 32.107 brahmavarcasam ity etad brāhmaṇānāṃ bhaviṣyati | payasvinyo bhaviṣyanti gāvaḥ pīnapayodharāḥ || 32.108 tadrāṣṭre 'pi manuṣyāṇāṃ bhadram eva bhaviṣyati | atha vakṣyāmi te brahman pannagānāṃ nivāraṇam || 32.109 devālaye nadītīre nandanopavaneṣu vā | catuḥstambhasamāyuktaṃ catustoraṇabhūṣitam || 32.110 abhito darbhamālābhiś śobhitaṃ homamaṇḍapam | kṛtvā tasminnavān kumbhān sthāpayitvā navāparān || 32.111 prācyāṃ vedyāṃ punaḥ karyān kuṇḍaṃ pūrvoktalakṣaṇam | yajed eteṣu kumbheṣu nava mūrtī yathākramāt || 21.112 nivedya pāyasaṃ tābhyaḥ paścāt kuṇḍe hutāśanam | ādadītātha tāmreṇa tālamātraṃ bhujaṅgamam || 32.113 prakalpya śeṣamantreṇa pratiṣṭhāpya pitāmaha | tasmin cakraṃ likhet tasya madhye matsyākṛtiṃ punaḥ || 32.114 garuḍaṃ śaṅkhapālaṃ ca kṛṣṇamantraṃ ca veṣṭanam | tannāgayantraṃ kṣīreṇa ghṛtena madhunāpi ca || 32.115 dadhnā śakṛdrasenāpi snāpayec cakravidyayā | puṣpagandha pradīpādyair upacārais tathāparaiḥ || 32.116 iṣṭvā nāgaṃ svamantreṇa cakraṃ cakrasya vidyayā | kuṇḍamadhye punar nāgayantraṃ khanyādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 32.117 tasya cottānarūpasya hutāśamuparisthitam | kṛtvā dadhnā ghṛtenāpi payasā madhunāpi ca || 32.118 samidbhir brahmavṛkṣasya juhuyān mantrakovidaḥ | sahasrakṛtvaḥ pratyekam atha gopayasokṣitaiḥ || 32.119 nīvārabhāgair juhuyāt saptāhaṃ ayutair api | apānas tv iti mantreṇa juhuyāt sādhakottamaḥ || 32.120 triṣv ahassu vyatīteṣu parjanyo meghavāhanaḥ | drāvayedavanīṃ kṛtsnāṃ bhūyo 'pi salilodayaiḥ || 32.121 ativṛṣṭi praśamanaṃ pravakṣyāmi caturmukha | piṅgalākāramātmānaṃ dhyātvā pīyūṣabhāvitam || 32.122 śūlavajradharaṃ cāpi mantravin mantrabhūṣaṇam | tailājyasiktair juhuyāl lājasarṣapalāvaṇai || 32.123 juhuyāj jvalite vahnāvayutaṃ saptasāgarāt | vṛṣṭiśabdaṃ puraskṛtya stambhayeti padadvayam || 32.124 prayoktavyam idaṃ brahman mantrānte mantravedinā | atha śāmyati sā vṛṣṭir mahatī cakravidyayā || 32.125 atha rāṣṭrapurādīnāṃ kṣobhaśāntiṃ tathā śṛṇu | atha kāṣṭhagataṃ cakraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi || 32.126 pure rāṣṭre tathā khanyāt tatkāṣṭhair juhuyāt tathā | sahasā kṣobhamāyānti vājivāraṇasaṅkulam || 32.127 rāṣṭraṃ ca kṣubhitaṃ brahmannanavasthaṃ bhaviṣyati | yadi śāntau matiṃ kuryāc cakramudvāsya tatpunaḥ || 32.128 snāpayed bhagavantaṃ ca sahasrakalaśāmbubhiḥ | jhaṭityeva praśāntaṃ syād duritaṃ purarāṣṭrayoḥ || 32.129 rāṣṭrādilambhanaṃ te 'dya pravakṣyāmi caturmukha | upetaṃ dalaṣaṭkoṇe karṇikā kesarānvitam || 32.130 cakrābjaṃ kārayed bhūmau medhyāyāṃ kamalāsana | tadbahir nābhivalayaṃ ṣaḍaraṃ tadbahir likhet || 32.131 tadbahir nemivalayaṃ jvālāmālā samanvitam | tadbahiḥ kalpayet pīṭhaṃ caturdvārapariṣkṛtam || 32.132 śobhopaśobhayuktaṃ ca kṛtvā maṇḍalam īdṛśam | tasmin sudarśanaṃ brahman pūjayitvā yathāvidhi || 32.133 samidbhir annair ājyaiś ca hutvā mantraṃ prasīdatu | śṛṅge cakraṃ deharāṣṭraṃ deharāṣṭraṃ tathādhanam || 32.134 ity etāṃ pāvanīṃ gāthāṃ japānte prārthayan paṭhet | atha tasya puraṃ rāṣṭraṃ grāmaṃ cakraṃ prayacchati || 32.135 atha prabhraṣṭarājyānāṃ manujānāṃ yathāśriyaḥ | tathā vakṣyāmi te brahmann upāyaṃ cakravidyayā || 32.136 antasthitasya padmasya syāt palāśa catuṣṭayam | athāṣṭau dvādaśa brahman ṣoḍaśātha catuṣṭayam || 32.137 viṃśatiś ca tathā triṃśat dvau krameṇa bahicchadāḥ | iti ṣaḍvidha patrasya karṇikāyāṃ sudarśanam || 32.138 yeṣv atho ṣaṭprakāreṣu palāśeṣu yathākramam | mūrtīś catastraḥ prathamaṃ tathāṣṭādvyādhikā daśa || 32.139 ṣoḍaśātha sahasraṃ ca viṃśatiś ca pitāmaha | atha dvātriṃśatiṃ paścād antarāleṣu ṣaṭsv api || 32.140 yathākramaṃ bhūṣaṇāni śrīvatsaprabhṛtīnyathā | aṣṭauśaktīḥ śriyāsārdhaṃ cakrādiṃ homamaṇḍalam || 32.141 ravīn saptādhikān pañca kumudādīn anantaram | indrādīn atha dikpālān pūjayen mantrakalpavit || 32.142 samidbhir bilbarūpābhis tilaiḥ padmais tathā ghṛtaiḥ | sahasrakṛtvaḥ pratyekaṃ juhuyāc cakravidyayā || 32.143 itthaṃ gate saptarātre prātarutthāya mantravit | sthāpitaiḥ pañcaviṃśatyā kumbhaiś śālikṛtāsanaiḥ || 32.144 ghṛtādi pūritair brahman cakravidyābhimantritaiḥ | rājyabhraṣṭaṃ mantrahīnaṃ dasyubhiḥ paripīḍitam || 32.145 rājānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vaiśyaṃ tathānyaṃ duritāhatam | abhiṣiñcet smaran cakraṃ tanmantreṇa vidhānavit || 32.146 tathā prakalpayed yantraṃ dāpayed dakṣiṇāṃ guroḥ | itthaṃ kṛte caturvaktra saubhāgyaṃ rājyalambhanam || 32.147 dasyunāśo bhaved bhadraṃ syāt sudarśanatejasā | ādāv ante tadā brahman haṃsamantravatā punaḥ || 32.148 nāśayec cakramantreṇa viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam | atha saṅgrāmavijayaṃ vakṣyāmi kamalāsana || 32.149 kṛpāṇe tomare śaktau śareṣu valaye tathā | āyudheṣu tathānyeṣu lalāṭe vājihastinām || 32.150 tathā dhvajapaṭānteṣu likhitvā cakramaṇḍalam | praviśya samaraṃ bhīmaṃ ripūṇāṃ romaharṣaṇam || 32.151 heṣitena turaṅgāṇāṃ bṛṃhitena viṣāṇinām | harṣanādena yodhānāṃ rathanemi svanais tathā || 32.152 turaṅgama khurakṣuṇṇaiḥ pārthivaiḥ pāṃsumaṇḍalaiḥ | tirohitanabhas sūryaṃ kṛtāntasadanopamam || 32.153 rudhirāsravasambhrāntaṃ vaitālamithunodyatam | māṃsasaṅgrahaṇoḍḍīnasahasraśyenasaṅkulam <�saṃgrahaṇa�, �saṃkulam> || 32.154 jvālāmālāmayaṃ cakraṃ dhyāyan jitvā ripūnapi | akṣanāgapraharaṇaiḥ niṣkramet pṛtanāmukham || 32.155 athavā rājyasīmāsu śaṅkūn khadirasambhavān | sthāpayec cakramantreṇa hutaśiṣṭaghṛtokṣitān || 32.156 agniprakārarūpāste na śakyaṃ prekṣituṃ paraiḥ | praveśe kampanaṃ brahman cakravidyāprabhāvataḥ || 32.157 yatra yatra bhayaṃ puṃsāṃ tatra tatra bhayaṃ bhavet | cakramadhyasthamātmānaṃ dhyāyantaṃ kupitātmanaḥ || 32.158 parvatārohaṇe 'raṇye sāgaraplavanādiṣu | vyāghrasiṃhavarāhādi sannipātaiḥ khile pathi || 32.159 gacchanna bhayam āpnoti cakramantram imaṃ japan | taṃ na chindanti śastrāṇi na taṃ dahati pāvakaḥ || 32.160 na cainaṃ kledayanty āpo yasyaiṣa hṛdaye manuḥ | brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśo śūdrāṇām kamalāsana || 32.161 pratilomānulomānāṃ kuryāt saṃhananaṃ budhaḥ | samidbhir brahmavṛkṣāṇām aśvatthavaṭavṛkṣayoḥ || 32.162 plakṣodumbarajātīnāmapavargasya pāvake | homaṃ kuryād yathāsaṃkhyaṃ tathā tajjatiyoṣitām || 32.163 brāhmaṇaḥ śriyam āpnoti homena śvetapaṅkajaiḥ | raktapadmair narendrasya vaiśyasya śvetapāṭalaiḥ || 32.164 śrīphalair āhutiṃ kurvan rāṣṭasyādhipatir bhavet | aṅgena nyastamantreṇa yāṃ spṛśed aṅganāṃ naraḥ || 32.165 tasya sā vaśamāyāti mṛtaṃ cāpy anugacchati | apamṛtyujayaṃ vakṣye yathāvadavadhāraya || 32.166 homaśālāgate kuṇḍe samyagādāya pāvakam | tasminn āvāhya hetīśaṃ drvākāṇḍair ghṛtokṣitaiḥ || 32.167 juhuyāt koṭibhir mantrair yathāśaktyathavā punaḥ | iti māsadvayaṃ rakṣet pāvakaṃ niyatendriyaḥ || 32.168 homānte yadi bhūpālastulārohaṇam ācaret | anyac ced ātmano yatsvaṃ dadyād brāhmaṇasāt prati || 32.169 kalaśaiḥ pañcaviṃśatyā snāpayec cakravidyayā | evaṃ kṛte caturvaktra kālamṛtyuṃ jayennaraḥ || 32.170 apamṛtyuḥ kathaṃ tasya tajjaye nāsti saṃśayaḥ | athavā kālamṛtyoś ca jayopāyo 'vagamyatām || 32.171 niṣkaiḥ sahasrasaṃkhyātaiḥ pratikṛtya pitāmaha | dvibhujaṃ puruṣākāraṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam || 32.172 daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ varāharudhirekṣaṇam | yaṣṭiṃ kareṇa savyena pāśaṃ vāmena bibhratam || 32.173 prakṣālya pañcabhir gavyaiḥ pañcopaniṣadā tathā | navakair abhiṣicyātha dhānyarāśiṣu nikṣipet || 32.174 āvāhya paścād vyāhṛtyā pūjayitvā svanāmabhiḥ | homam agnau prakurvīta samiccarughṛtair api || 32.175 ṛgbhiḥ kṛtāntaliṅgābhir brahmavyāhṛtibhis tathā | tataḥ prabhāte viprāya taṃ pumāṃsaṃ hiraṇmayam || 32.176 pūtāya bhagavadbhaktyā pañcakālānuvartine | dāpayet kālamṛtyuṃ vā sa jitvā syāt prāyuṣaṃ padam || 32.177 atha māraṇametaddhi śrūyatāṃ caturānana | vivikte kalpayed deśe homaśālāṃ vidhānavit || 32.178 tanmadhye kalpayet kuṇḍamācāryo dakṣiṇāmukham | gṛhītvākṣasya phalakāṃ hastadvayasamāyatām || 32.179 tadardhavistṛtāṃ brahman ghanaṃ ca caturaṅgulām | tasyāṃ likhitvā dveṣyasya vapuḥ pratyakṣasaṃmitam || 32.180 pratikūle 'tha nakṣatre riporaṣṭamarāśiṣu | kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa prakuryān maraṇakriyām || 32.181 prācyāṃ bhāge 'tha kuṇḍasya ṣaḍaraṃ cakramālikhet | kṛṣṇasūtrair alaṅkṛtya tasmin cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 32.182 kṛṣṇagandhaiḥ kṛṣṇapuṣpaiḥ pūjayet kṛṣṇavāribhiḥ | śmaśānādvā sunilayādvalmīkānmṛdamāharet || 32.183 tāṃ ripoḥ pādadhūlībhir vyāmiśrāṃ kamalāsana | unmattarasamiśreṇa kharamūtreṇa peṣayet || 32.184 viṣṭhayā vā mṛdāvāpi dveṣyasya pratiyātanām | tasyāṃ prāṇān pratiṣṭhāpya mantreṇānena mantravit || 32.185 udgītham aprameyaṃ ca mandaraṃ bhuvanaṃ tathā | krodhānilaṃ paścimāsyaṃ hutāśaṃ madhusūdanam || 32.186 pracaṇḍagopanau rāmaṃ bhāskaraṃ paścimānanam | samadhyaṃ gopanadvandvamamuṣyeti padaṃ punaḥ || 32.187 jīvā iha sthitā śabdaṃ viṣṇudakṣodayāṃs tathā | krodharūpaṃ tapasyantaṃ sarvaśabdam anantaram || 32.188 vikramaṃ vighnarājātrivahnibandhū ca gopanam | vanamālādharaṃ rāmaṃ vāṅmanaḥ kāya ity api || 32.189 atha māyātṛtīyāntaṃ loḍantaṃ yāni yanmukham | svāhāvasānam uddhṛtya praṇavāntādikaṃ manum || 32.190 tāṃ ca prāṇavatīṃ kuṇḍe khanyāduttānaśāyinīm | phalakāsthitamākāramanulipya pitāmaha || 32.191 pūrvoktayā mṛdā paścāt prāṇinaṃ prāṇavidyayā | pādenākrāntahṛdayo śeṣalohitalocanaḥ || 32.192 sahasrakṛtvaś cakrasya mantraṃ bhāṣeta mantravit | viṣavṛkṣemarūḍhena śaṅkunā netrayor hṛdi || 32.193 hastayoḥ pādayor guhye śrotrayor nāsikodare | anyeṣv api pratīkeṣu vedhaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ || 32.194 tathākṛte ripostattadgātraṃ hīnaṃ bhaviṣyati | atha kuṇḍe śmaśānāgniṃ nidadhīta pitāmaha || 32.195 darbhaiḥ paristared vedyāṃ dakṣiṇāpaścimonmukhan | paridhīṃs tadvadākīrya kṛtvā rakṣāṃ tathātmanaḥ || 32.196 ṛtvigbhiḥ ṣoḍaśoddiṣṭair dvāreṣv adhyayane kṛte | brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dattvā hetirājam anusmaran || 32.197 akṣakāṣṭa prakḷptābhyāṃ sruksruvābhyāṃ yathāvidhi | kṛṣṇapannagarājīlakṛṣṇā tu kṣatajokṣitaiḥ || 32.198 marīcaiḥ sarṣapair yuktānaṣṭadhānyāṣṭadhānvitān | samidho 'kṣasya juhuyāt sahasraṃ prativāsaram || 32.199 ripunakṣatravṛkṣāṇāṃ samidhaś cāpi mantravit | mantrānte śatrunāmānaṃ mārayeti prakīrtayet || 32.200 hotavyaṃ cāvamānena homaṃ kṛtvā dine dine | yāvad bhavati kṛtyāyā darśanaṃ jātavedasi || 32.201 krameṇa tāvaj juhuyād vāsarānekaviṃśatim | phalakāmapi vedisthāṃ homadhūpena dhūpayet || 32.202 agaruṃ gugguluṃ cāpi dhūpārthamanale dahet | atha saptasvatīteṣu divaseṣu pitāmaha || 32.203 saptasvahassu madhye ca yathākramamī jvarāḥ | ākrośo vedanā tīvrā gātrāṇām avidheyatā || 32.204 hikkāniḥśvāsavicchedo jihvāhānistathāripoḥ | bhavanti hi prabhāveṇa cakramantrasya niścitam || 32.205 iti dvisaptake 'tīte divase 'nantare punaḥ | madhyarātre kṛte home kṛtyā tasmād vibhāvasoḥ || 32.206 triśūlabhīṣaṇair hastais saptabhis tribhir aṅghribhiḥ | jihvayā raktavarṣiṇyā lelihānā nijaṃ mukham || 32.207 udgirantī svanetrābhyāmājyasiktaṃ havirbhujam | narāsthimālāṃ bibhrāṇā nūpurīkṛtamekhalā || 32.208 kapālakuṇḍalopetā prahasantī bhayānakam | daṇḍaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ tathā śūrpaṃ mārjanīṃ pāśamaṇḍalam || 32.209 bibhratīṃ lambamānābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ muktamūrdhajām | adhirūḍhāparaskandhamandhakāranibhākṛtiḥ || 32.210 sphuliṅgamaṇḍalastheva vimuktāṭopabhīṣaṇā | utthāya prāñjalir bhūtvā kiṃ karomīti bhāṣate || 32.211 abhidhāsyatyathācāryaḥ prāṇān hara ripor iti | ādiṣṭhā sā tathety uktvā ripuṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ || 32.212 api dūrasthitaṃ hatvā guruṃ punar upaiṣyati | atha pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā hotṛbhis saha mantravit || 32.213 dvāviṃśo divase lakṣaṃ ṣaḍakṣaram imaṃ japet | tathāparājitaṃ mantrannārasiṃhamanuṃ tathā || 32.214 ghṛtādi pūritaiḥ kumbhair viṃśatyā pañcabhiḥ punaḥ | ātmābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta cakramantrābhimantritaiḥ || 32.215 enaso mucyate tasmāt tathā śāntir bhaviṣyati | uccāṭanaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvat kamalāsana || 32.216 nimbadhattūrapatrāṇāṃ śmaśānāṅgāramiśritaiḥ | rasairakṣasya kāṣṭhena dvihaste pretavānasi || 32.217 ṣaṭkoṇe nābhinemyaṅke maṇḍale kramaśo likhet | nāmadheyaṃ ripor antaḥ procya yāmye 'tha paścime || 32.218 yakāraṃ bhuvanaṃ brahman jhakāraṃ bhuvanaṃ tathā | śiṣṭeṣu triṣu koṇeṣu tathāṣṭau maṇḍalādayaḥ || 32.219 tadārūḍhaṃ ripuṃ cāpi kuṇḍe cāpākṛtau punaḥ | samidbhir nimbavṛkṣasya tathā ca viṣabhūruhaḥ || 32.220 juhuyād abhito vahnāvamṛtaṃ ploṣayan ripum | yatra dhvajaṃ taṃ badhnīyāt ucchrite caityapādape || 32.221 ahobhir ekaviṃśatyā ripus tasya mahān api | adhiṣṭhānaṃ nijaṃ hitvā bhāryāputrādibhiḥ saha || 32.222 palāyate diganteṣu na kvacil labhate sthitim | athavidveṣaṇaṃ brahmanyathāvadavadhāraya || 32.223 akṣapādapakāṣṭhena snigdhayorākṛtir dvayoḥ | kṛtvā tayor likhen mantraṃ nāmadheyaṃ tayor api || 32.224 vidveṣayapadopetamasṛjā dhvāṅkṣakākayoḥ | ākhumārjārayor brahmaṃs tathā sarpamayūrayoḥ || 32.225 tathānyeṣāṃ viruddhānāṃ tiraścāṃ pakṣiṇām api | nibadhya rajjumāyāmāṃ mūrdhajair mahiṣāśvayoḥ || 32.226 tathā te ākṛtī baddhvā vyastayos tu kṛtaṃ mukham | apidadhyāt tayorāsyaṃ japen mantraṃ ṣaḍakṣaram || 32.227 kuṇḍe 'tha homaṃ kurvīta samidbhir mṛtyubandhayoḥ | aṣṭottarasahasreṇa hūyādagnau sudarśanam || 32.228 yudhyetasnigdhayor dvandvaṃ kākolūkādi saṃmitam | itthaṃ daśasv atīteṣu divaseṣu sa mantravit || 32.229 apākṛṣyati dampatyo mamatvaṃ mitrayor api | kṣīraiḥ snāyāt tayor bhūyaḥ prītir bhavati pūrvavat || 32.230 athābhidhīyate brahman stambhanaṃ tanniśamyatām | śilātale likhitvātha catuṣkoṇacatuṣṭayam || 32.231 teṣu pratyekamālikhya patrair dravyaiḥ pitāmaha | gṛhaṃ vāmanamantraṃ tamindrakāntacatuṣṭayam || 32.232 vajrāṅkam api puṣpais tatpūjayet kanakaprabham | sthāpayitvā sthaṇḍile 'sminnāsikyā mantram īrayet || 32.233 stambhayeti padaṃ cāpi juhuyād arkakhaṇḍikāḥ | stambhanaṃ syāt jhaṭity evaṃ vivāhe garbhalābhake || 32.234 vādajalpavitaṇḍāsu kathāsv api ca vādinām | vakṣyāmi tilakaṃ brahman likhitvā pratiyātanām || 32.235 dveṣyasyāvayavaistulyair gomayāṅgāramiśritaiḥ | tadaṅgeṣu likhen mantraṃ tadbījena samanvitam || 32.236 athasyāc chaktihīnaṃ tu matidveṣasya dehinaḥ | atha te tāḍanaṃ vakṣye dhattūraṃ bhayamārayoḥ || 32.237 arkasya ca rase brahman śmaśānāṅgāramiśritaiḥ | likhet pratikṛtiṃ vilvakāṣṭhe pretasya vāsasi || 32.238 śaṅkhakīlamathādāya caturaṅgula saṃmitam | aṅgāni tāḍayet tasya tena kīlena mantravit || 32.239 ṣaḍakṣarasya kurvīta nityaṃ japamatandritaḥ | dhanādi hānis tasya syāt nyante dveṣṭi samantravit || 32.240 vaśīkāram ahaṃ brahman bhūpatīnāṃ vadāmi te | kuṣṭhakuṅkumasiddhārthakarpūrāgarucandanaiḥ || 32.241 gorocanānvitaiś cāpi kusumbharajasā saha | bhūrjapatre likhec cakraṃ ṣaḍareṣu ṣaḍakṣaram || 32.242 tadbahir dvādaśāraṃ ca nābhinemisamanvitam | dvādaśākṣaramālikhya dvādaśāraṃ tato bahiḥ || 32.243 aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa haṃsamantreṇa cānvitam | tadbahir dvādaśajvālaṃ pāśāṅkuśamanudvayam || 32.244 sādhyasya nāmadheyena praṇavenāntarāṅkitam | ābhiṣṣoḍaśabhir brahman vidarbhitam anantaram || 32.245 tad etad gulikāṃ kṛtvā padmasūtreṇa veṣṭitām | cakrābje vāsitāṃ kṛtvā pūjitāṃ kusumādibhiḥ || 32.246 homaṃ padmākṛtau kuṇḍe kṛtvā kusumasarpiṣā | dvādaśāhārni kṛtvaivaṃ maṅgalyādīni sādhayet || 32.247 rājādayo mukhaṃ tasya prekṣante vivaśā iva | tasya dūrātpalāyante kūśmāṇḍapramukhā grahāḥ || 32.248 rasātalapraveśaṃ te kathayāmi caturmukha | bilvadāruṃ samāsādya kusumbharajasā sudhīḥ || 32.249 likhitvā ṣaḍaraṃ cakraṃ bahis tasyātha mantravit | yathopadeśaṃ pātālaṃ pannagāsurasaṅkulam || 32.250 likhet kṛtvā punaḥ kuṇḍe tasminn ādhāya pāvakam | juhuyān naramāṃsena japen mantraṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 32.251 dvādaśāhena te paścāt pātālatalasaṃśrayāḥ | upasthāsyanti taṃ bhītā yuvatyaḥ kāmapīḍitāḥ || 32.252 taṃ grahīṣyanti bhartāramahampūrvaṃ śucismitāḥ | pāṇibhir lolavalayaiḥ kāmayānāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ || 32.253 rasāyanāni dāsyanti tasmai pātālavartine | tadbhakṣaṇena dīrghāyustābhis saha yathepsitam || 32.254 raṃsyate ramyadeśeṣu yatra vā jāyateruciḥ | khaṅgasya sādhanaṃ brahmann idānīṃ kathayāmi te || 32.255 aśvatthapatrāntaritaṃ khaṅgaṃ śāstroktalakṣaṇam | spṛṣṭvā ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mantraṃ japed dhyātvā sudarśanam || 32.256 atha khaṅgasya tāpaḥ syāt sa yakṣyādīni jeṣyate | tasmin dhūmāyamāne tu gandharvādhipatir bhavet || 32.257 tasmin jvālāmukhe brahman vidyādharapatir bhavet | gṛhītvā taṃ punaḥ khaṅgaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ lokam āpnuyāt || 32.258 gomayenopalitpe 'tha śūnyāgāre pitāmaha | cakraṃ likhitvā sumanassitapuṣpair alaṅkṛtam || 32.259 vraṇahīnaṃ śavaṃ tasmin brāhmaṇasya nṛpasya vā | prācīnaśirasaṃ kṛtvā māhiṣeṇa ghṛtena tam || 32.260 pādayor mantravillimpedasahāyo 'pramattadhīḥ | tadvakṣasi padaṃ kṛtvā mantrarājam idaṃ japet || 32.261 pratyahaṃ juhuyād agnau samidbhir vetrabhūruhaḥ | kṛtasaṃkhyaṃ japen mantraṃ japahomaiḥ pitāmaha || 32.262 utthāsyati śavaḥprāṇī niśīthe kalpitāñjaliḥ | sa tasmai mantrasiddhāya vakti divyaṃ rasāyanam || 32.263 pādukāmañjanaṃ khaḍgaṃ pradāsyati yathepsitam | yad idaṃ tena khaḍgena hatvā nīyāttadāmiṣam || 32.264 trailokyaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ lapsyate caturānana | valīpalitahīnatvamamaratvaṃ ca setsyati || 32.265 nidhīnanyapi gūḍhāni pratyakṣam iva paśyati | rasaṃ vimṛjya pāṣāṇe likhec cakraṃ ṣaḍakṣaram || 32.266 rasaṃ nidhāya mūṣāyāṃ baddhvā dravyair yathocitaiḥ | kṛtvābhimantritaṃ brahman cakramantreṇa kalpavit || 32.267 upayuñjīta medhāvī japec cāpi ṣaḍakṣaram | ārogyaṃ balamaiśvaryaṃ kālamṛtyuvyatikramam || 32.268 vāgmitvaṃ buddhimattvaṃ ca rūpasaṃhananaṃ vayaḥ | nabhasthale gatiś cāpi sākṣād iva garutmataḥ || 32.269 ity ādayo guṇās tasya bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | yathā na pādakhedaḥ syād dūraṃ gatvāpi tacchaṇu || 32.270 kākajaṃghām upādāya kokilekṣaṇasaṃhitām | balāṃ moṭārasais teṣāṃ śarapuṅkharasānvitaiḥ || 32.271 sarṣapasnehasaṃmiśraiś cakramantrābhimantritaiḥ | liptvā pādayutaṃ cakraṃ kṛtvāraṇyamahāpathe || 32.272 yojanānāṃ sahasre dve na khedaṃ samavāpnuyāt | yakṣisiddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi tāṃ likhet kṣaumavāsasi || 32.273 nyagrodhamūle tāṃ dhyātvā yakṣīvidyāṃ japed budhaḥ | ārādhya guggulūtthena dhūpena kamalāsana || 32.274 samidbhir vaṭavṛkṣasya tathāśokakarañjayoḥ | raktapadmais tilaiś cāpi juhuyāj jātavedasi || 32.275 ekaviṃśatirātrānte kampate sa vaṭo muhuḥ | dṛḍha buddhiḥ punaś cāpi mantram evaṃ japed budhaḥ || 32.276 atha pratyakṣarūpā sā yakṣī kalyāṇalakṣaṇā | snigdheva jananī siddhiṃ tasmai dattvā yathepsitam || 32.277 amunaiva vidhānena yakṣā vaiśravaṇādayaḥ | pratyakṣabhūtā dāsyanti sādhakena vṛtaṃ varam || 32.278 yathāyathādhiko homo japo vā kamalodbhava | amuṣya cakramantrasya pañcakoṭir yathottaram || 32.279 tathā tathā padāny etāny avadhūyeta kilbiṣam | ādityānāṃ śaśāṅkasya vasūnāṃ marutām api || 32.280 aśvino bāsavasyāpi manvādīnāṃ tapasvinām | rudrāṇāṃ brahmaṇañ cāpi cakramantrasya vaibhavāt || 32.281 sahasrakoṭisaṃkhyena homena ca japena ca | tapasā cātitīvreṇa labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 32.282 kiṃ bhūyasā pralāpena yatreṣṭaṃ tad bhaviṣyati | sa tena tena labhate pāpebhyo 'pi pramucyate || 32.283 ity etat kathito brahman ṣaḍakṣaramahāmanoḥ | kālaḥ saṅgraharūpeṇa rahasyaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 32.284
iti śrīpañcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde sudarśana mahāmantravaibhavo nāma dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
? trayastriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ?
samārādhanāṅgamantroddhāraḥ brahmā athaupacārikānmantrān śuśrūṣe bhagavann aham | prayujyamānair yaiḥ prītir mahatī te bhaviṣyati || 33.1 śrī bhagavān brahmannārādhanāṅgāni mantrāṇy avahitaḥ śṛṇu | yāni śrutyantabhāgeṣu śṛṇvanti brahmavādinaḥ || 33.2 bandhukośaṃ puraskṛtya kakubhaṃ brahmamastakam | vairājaṃ devaraṃ paścād ekanetramṛgeśvarau || 33.3 pavitrabhuvanau cāpi brahman caṇḍavanālayau | hutāśavāmanau padmagopanau vinatātmajam || 33.4 vighneśaṃ mandaraṃ kāntaṃ kalātmā ca jayājayau | pīyūṣarāmau śrīkumbhau sūkṣmaṃ gopanapaścimau || 33.5 varuṇaṃ bhadrahastāntaṃ vighneśaṃ pāṭalapriyam | aniruddhaṃ jayeṇeśau śuklaṃ jayamathodayam || 33.6 bhāsvantamṛtadhāmānaṃ śatrudāhakavāmanau | padmadidevau śrīvatsaṃ dakṣaṃ bhāskaragopanau || 33.7 pavitrabhuvanau vahnibhuvanau śatrudāhakam | paścimāsyaṃ makāraṃ ca hutāśanasudhārasau || 33.8 antimaṃ kakubhaṃ kṛtvā jitante manum īrayet | bhānuviṣṇuṃ dhruvaṃ bījaṃ brahmann etasya kalpayet || 33.9 aṅgāny apy amunā kuryād ṛṣiḥ sanaka ucyate | chando 'nuṣṭup tathaitasya devatā puruṣottamaḥ || 33.10 japo 'mbutarpaṇaṃ homaṃ kṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśalakṣavat | dharmārthakāmamokṣārthān puṃsāṃ sarvaṃ prayacchati || 33.11 pañcopaniṣadān mantrān atha te kathayāmy aham | parameṣṭhī pumānviśvo nivṛttaḥ sarva eva hi || 33.12 āmnāyādiṃ krodharūpaṃ saṅkarṣaṇagajānanau | dakṣāniruddhau pāpaghna vahnigopanamārutān || 33.13 pavitrapāvakau dakṣamādhavau padmasambhava | krodhakaustubhaśaṅkhādyair gopanaṃ jayamandarau || 33.14 vighneśamādhavau cānte parameṣṭhinam īrayet | ṛṣirādityanāmāsya chando gāyatramucyate || 33.15 devatā ca sadāviṣṇur japed dvādaśalakṣavat | prathamaṃ praṇavaṃ kṛtvā dhūliketanagopanau || 33.16 vighneśadvitayaṃ dakṣakalāntau paścimānanam | vahnyādidevau śaṅkhākhyaṃ paścimaṃ bhuvanaṃ tathā || 33.17 pāvakaṃ bhuvanaṃ paścāc chakraṃ dāhakagopanau | jayadakṣau bhadrapāṇiṃ devadattau tathāntimau || 33.18 ity evaṃ pauruṣaṃ mantram īrayen mantrakovidaḥ | ṛṣiṃ nāradamasyāhuś chando gāyatram īritam || 33.19 devatā vāsudevaś ca śṛṇu viśvamataḥ param | tārāgnigopanau dakṣabhadrapāṇī kalāntimau || 33.20 pavitravahnyādi devān śaṅkhaṃ varuṇavikramau | śrīvatsakumbhau vijayamandarau vighnamādhavau || 33.21 itīrito viśvamantraḥ punar draṣṭā bhṛgur manoḥ | chando gāyatram etasya vācyaḥ saṅkarṣaṇābhidhaḥ || 33.22 udgīthakumbhādidevau vighneśadvayamastakam | mandaraṃ varuṇaṃ pāpahananaṃ vahnigopanau || 33.23 vāyuṃ vighneśvaraṃ rāmaṃ pīyūṣaṃ vasumastakam | ekanetraṃ vāyumādiṃ devān vairājamandarau || 33.24 manuṣyeśaṃ mṛgeśānaṃ nivṛttimanumīrīritaḥ | ṛṣis tu nāradaś chando gāyatraṃ pūrvam īritam || 33.25 pradyumno devatā 'nena nivṛttiṃ labhate pumān | praṇavaṃ pītavarṇābhaṃ gopanaṃ mānuṣeśvaram || 33.26 mādhavīṃ sargiṇaṃ pāpahananaṃ vahnigopanau | caturgatiṃ kalātmānaṃ kumbhaḥ (kumbhaṃ) pāvakagopanau || 33.27 vairājamandarau syātām uddhārya caturānana | gajāsyaṃ devadattāntaṃ sarvamantraṃ prakalpayet || 33.28 uṣṇikchandaḥ punas tasya draṣṭā syān nīlalohitaḥ | aniruddho devatā ca manavaḥ pañca kīrtitāḥ || 33.29 pañcopaniṣadaḥ puṇyāstā etāś caturānana | mahāpātakanāśinyaḥ parākādiphalapradāḥ || 33.30 etās samyagadhīte yo vedāntānathavākhilān | tāv ubhau sadṛśau manye pañcabhūśśasyate 'thavā || 33.31 prāyaścitteṣu homeṣu pratiṣṭhāprokṣaṇādiṣu | prayuñjīta kramānetāḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīḥ || 33.32 ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śāntimantracatuṣṭayam | praṇavaṃ madhuhantāraṃ pavanaṃ madhusūdanam || 33.33 bhāskaraṃ puruṣātmānaṃ gadivighneśamādhavān | bhallāyudhaṃ hṛṣīkeśam agniṃ bhallāyudhodayam || 33.34 kumbhaṃ mṛgāṅkapīyūṣau kamalānanamantimam | śuklaṃ kumbhaṃ madhośśatruṃ bhāskaraṃ gopanaṃ tathā || 33.35 itīrayen manuṃ brahmat ṛṣiḥ syād devatā manoḥ | chando gāyatram etasya devatā tigmatejasaḥ || 33.36 udgīthaṃ vijayaṃ kumbhaṃ vighneśātrimṛgeśvarāḥ | pīyūṣa gopanau bhadrahastagopanayaṣṭayaḥ || 33.37 jṛmbhala padmanābhaṃ ca bhānumadvijayonayaḥ | musalī gopanaḥ paścāj jayaṃ kuṃbhañ ca mādhavam || 33.38 netrotadehau sūryaś ca śrīdharau vijayāvanau | śrīvighneśas subhadre 'tha gadīvaruṇamastakāḥ || 33.39 vairājakumbhādidevā dakṣo madhuniṣūdanaḥ | ādityarāmanāsikyacandravāmanasargiṇaḥ || 33.40 hutānta iti mantro 'yamūhanīyaś caturmukha | ṛṣir asya bhṛguṃ prāhuś chando gāyatram ity api || 33.41 hutāśano devatā ca devānāṃ prathamaṃ mukham | nigamādiṃ śriyaḥ kāntau vijayadvayavikramau || 33.42 krodhameghau pavitraṃ ca śrīdharaṃ pāvakāhṇayau | ugrātmavahnidyumaṇiranalaṃ bandhumastakam || 33.43 pavitraṃ bandhunāsikyaṃ gadinaṃ pulahaṃ tathā | dṛṣṭiṃ mṛgeśaṃ dyumaṇiṃ rāmo vaidharapāvakau || 33.44 varuṇaṃ māyayā sākaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ pāṭalapriyam | pavitradahanau vāyusvacchandau ṭhaṭha paścimau || 33.45 itthaṃ prakalpayen mantramṛṣir dhanada ucyate | chando gāyatram etasya devatā haripiṅgalaḥ || 33.46 tāraṃ pavitraṃ vijayaṃ vighneśaṃ bhṛgugopanau | bhāskaraṃ puruṣātmānaṃ gadinaṃ vighnamādhavau || 33.47 bhallāyudhahṛṣīkeśau vahniṃ bhallāyudhodayam | kumbhasampuṭitaṃ śuklaṃ candraṃ pīyūṣagopanau || 33.48 bhānumantaṃ madhoś śatrum iti mantraṃ vivecayet | ṛṣir bṛhaspatis tasya chandaḥ pūrvavad īritam || 33.49 ādityo devatā hy evamuktaṃ mantracatuṣṭayam | yatra mantraṃ kriyādravyahīnaṃ śāntyādikarmaṇi || 33.50 tasminn etat prayuñjīta tathāyaṃ sādhako vidhiḥ | mantrāṇi te pravakṣyāmi tatvānāṃ pañcaviṃśatim || 33.51 prayuktamānair yair viśvaṃ prāṇiti prāṇavarjitam | praṇavasyopari sparśānāhurvāmanamastakān || 33.52 namo 'ntān prātilomyena yojayet pañcaviṃśatim | paraśabdaṃ caturthyantaṃ nateḥ paścāt prakalpayet || 33.53 jīvaṃ dehaṃ tathā buddhiṃ garvaṃ paścān manas tathā | śabdasparśau tathā rūpaṃ raso gandhaś ca pañcamaḥ || 33.54 etān pañcāpi viṣayān tanmantravacanodarān | śrotraṃ tvakca tathā netraṃ jihvā ghrāṇaṃ tataḥ param || 33.55 vācaṃ pāṇiṃ tathā pādaṃ pāyūpasthau pitāmaha | pṛthivīṃ prathamaṃ toyaṃ tejo mārutamanvataḥ || 33.56 vyoma cānte caturthyantair ātmaśabdais tathottaraiḥ | kṛtanāmānimān śabdān mantrarūpeṇa kalpayet || 33.57 udgīthakṛtanāsikyau hutāśaṃ bindumastakam | kakubhaṃ gadinaṃ vāsudevaṃ vijayavāmanau || 33.58 tathā ca vāsudevāntavijayaṃ vāmanaṃ tathā | vahniṃ guhālayaṃ cāpi pavitramadhusūdanau || 33.59 caturgatiṃ manuṃ prāṇaṃ dīpārthaṃ manum īrayet | tāraṃ sūryahṛṣīkeśayaṣṭayaḥ puṣṭibījavān || 33.60 meghabindū śuklarāmau ṛṣiḥ puṇyatrivikramau | indur guhālayaṃ paścāj jayapāvakagopanāḥ || 33.61 iti vāyur natir matsyādakṣasūtramanur mahān | tāraṃ śrīrāma kaumāra puruṣātmamṛgeśvarau || 33.62 viṣṇuṃ pañcāntakaṃ vahniṃ dhūmadhvajaguhālayau | pavitrabandhusumukhā mādhavaṃ prathamaṃ tathā || 33.63 hutāśaṃ padmapāṇiṃ ca vāyuṃ vahniṃ guhālayam | paścimāsyaṃ maghoś śatruṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca natimastakam || 33.64 ity ardhyamantraṃ racayed atha pādyamanuṃ śṛṇu | tāraṃ gadidhruvau cāpi gadadhvaṃsī mṛgādhipau || 33.65 paścimaṃ rāmaśirasaṃ vijayaṃ vahnipaścimau | ekaviṃśaṃ padmanābhaṃ māyāṃ pavanapaṅkajau || 33.66 vahnidvitīyamanilaṃ pāpaghnaṃ madhusūdanam | vaidharaṃ mārutaṃ vahniṃ hṛṣīkeśo 'tha paścimam || 33.67 rāmaṃ sumukhasāraṅgau natyantaṃ mantram īrayet | ādau vyālaṃ śuklavahniṃ candrakumbhau jayānilau || 33.68 mandaraṃ padmanāthaṃ ca vairājāgniguhālayāḥ | pāpahantāramadveṣī vanamālī mṛgeśvarau || 33.69 gopano vakratuṇḍaś ca dakṣavighneśagopanāḥ | vairājadakṣau vighneśamādhavau natimastakau || 33.70 ity ācamanamantras syāt dhūpādīni yathā amī | prathamaṃ ced api manor dhūpānduritātmavān || 33.71 rāmaṃ dṛṣṭimanusvāraṃ gadinaṃ viṣṇumastakam | ādityagaupanau caṇḍaṃ vahnijāyāvasānakam || 33.72 ity etat kalpitaṃ mantraṃ pratibhoganivedanam | prayuñjīta prayogaṃ ca tasmāt sādhāraṇo manuḥ || 33.73 dviṣaṭkākṣaram uddhṛtya śikhaṇḍipulahaṃ dhruvam | subhadrakumbhau vijayaśrīdharau dakṣamādhavau || 33.74 pavitrabhuvanau krodhapaścimānanagopanāḥ | ṭhaṭhāntamatha natyantaṃ manum itthaṃ prakalpayet || 33.75 puṣpāñjalipradāneṣu niyuñjīta jitaṃ punaḥ | tāraśśuklaghaṭo yaṣṭiś candramā bhuvano 'nalaḥ || 33.76 subhadravāyvotadeha natyanto manur īritaḥ | tenārādhanavastraṃ syādāpyāyanam upācaret || 33.77 ittham ārādhanāṅgāni mantrāṇi kathitāni te | idānīm aihikān mantrān pravakṣyāmi manoharān || 33.78 svīkṛtya saptavarṇāni rohiṇīśamapāṃpatim | pavitramānuṣeśānau gopanaṃ puṇyavikramau || 33.79 paścimaṃ vijayaṃ vāyuṃ mādhavo varuṇānilau | vāsudevaṃ tathā dakṣaṃ gopanaṃ jayamandarau || 33.80 vighneśamādhavau pāpahananaṃ pavanaṃ tathā | guhālayam atho yaṣṭiṃ sūryam ūrdhvaṃ jagatpatim || 33.81 yaṣṭiṃ kumbhaṃ jagatprāṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ tathā dhruvam | śvetāṃśuṃ varuṇaṃ binduṃ dvisūryaṃ vāmanaṃ dhruvam || 33.82 ṭhaṭhāntikaṃ tanuṃ brahmann īrayed atha tārakam | natyantaṃ śuklavaruṇau paścimaṃ vikramaṃ jayam || 33.83 bandhumagniṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ paścimaṃ madhusūdanam | caturgatimacāmādiṃ māhendraṃ viṣṇupannagau || 33.84 mandaraṃ vāmanaṃ paścāt paścimaṃ vijayānilau | devadattaṃ śriyaṃ vahniṃ mahāmāyāṃ mahābalām || 33.85 hṛṣīkeśaṃ dhruvaṃ cāpi bījamāmreḍayed idam | pavitramanilaṃ caṇḍaṃ gopanaṃ dvivināyakam || 33.86 vaidharaṃ madhuhantāraṃ vijayaṃ mandaraṃ tathā | bhadrahastaṃ mṛgeśaṃ ca ṭhaṭhāntaṃ mantram īrayet || 33.87 sindhudvīpo manor draṣṭā virāṭ chando nigadyate | svapnādhipatir etasya devatā paramaḥ pumān || 33.88 hṛṣīkeśaṃ yaṣṭimantram īrayen mantrakovidaḥ | uṣṇik chandaḥ punas tasya devatā nṛharir hariḥ || 33.89 athāṅgirasa nāmāni teṣāṃ mantraṃ pracakṣate | abhinnaviṭapaskandhaṃ spṛṣṭvāśvattham imaṃ japet || 33.90 ahobhiḥ saptabhir mṛtyuṃ laṅghayet saṃyatendriyaḥ | athālpāyāsasādhyāni śṛṇu mantrāṇi padmaja || 33.91 vyāpinaṃ puruṣātmānaṃ vāsudevaṃ sapaścimam | rāmaṃ vighneśvaraṃ māyām udgītharahitānimān || 33.92 dakṣādīśānādi devān māyābjaṃ supratiṣṭhitam | vāyuṃ padmaṃ madhoś śatruṃ śaṅkhaṃ vahnidhruvān api || 33.93 hutāntam uddharet karṇa gobhitaṃ mantram uttamam | japel lakṣam imaṃ mantram upoṣyaikādaśa 'hani || 33.94 dvādaśyām api kuryāt strīṃ samunnatapayodharām | āvāhya tasyāṃ hutvā ca pūjayitvā ca yoginīm || 33.95 madhyarātre baliṃ dattvā chindyāt tāṃ pratiyātanām | bhūtaṃ bhavad bhaviṣyaṃ ca tasya vakṣyati yoginī || 33.96 āmnāyādiṃ vidhātāraṃ pracaṇḍaṃ vasumastakam | paścimaṃ vikramaṃ lakṣmīṃ gopanaṃ khaḍgadhāriṇam || 33.97 savikramaṃ ghaṭaṃ cāgniṃ padmaṃ tadviradānanam | paṅkajaṃ vāruṇam atho sarasīruhasambhava || 33.98 kakubhaṃ vahnimaparaṃ pīyūṣaṃ godhanaṃ tathā | jhaṣaṃ guhālayaṃ cāpi śaṅkhaṃ vahniṃ ca mandaram || 33.99 śrīdharaṃ padmavairājaṃ gopanaṃ sūkṣmalocanam | vahniṃ pracaṇḍaṃ vighneśaṃ rāmo mandarapāvakau || 33.100 pītādidevau pulahaṃ yaṣṭiṃ padmaguhāntikau | ekanetraṃ śriyaṃ vahniṃ vāmanaṃ vahnimādhavau || 33.101 mṛgeśabhāvasadbandhūnvinghopahatikaṃ tathā | svacchandaṃ vijayaṃ vahniṃ vīrasenasaroruhau || 33.102 ādidevaṃ tathā candra ravidṛṣṭiśubhapradau | vahniṃ vināyakaṃ rāmaṃ dvir dakṣaṃ caturānana || 33.103 pracaṇḍaḥ pāvako yaṣṭiḥ paścimāsyahutāśanau | pīyūṣarāmasahitau śubhadaṃ vāyugopanau || 33.104 vijayaṃ pañcabinduṃ ca vairājamadhusūdanau | gaṇeśagopanau paścād gadinaṃ vijayaṃ ghaṭam || 33.105 ekadṛṣṭiṃ tathā vahniṃ mandaraṃ madhusūdanam | kuñjarānanaviṣṇavantau vighneśaṃ bandhumastakam || 33.106 kakubhaṃ candradhavalaṃ gopanaṃ paścimānanam | caturgatiṃ ṭhaṭhopāntaṃ iti mantraṃ prakalpayet || 33.107 adhastān netravṛkṣasya japann etad atandritaḥ | naṣṭaṃ muṣṭiṃ cintanāṃc ca jānāty etat prasādataḥ || 33.108 saptākṣaraṃ prakalpyādau varuṇaṃ gopanaṃ daram | pīyūṣamādhavau dakṣaṃ dṛṣṭivahnidaradvayam || 33.109 paścimāgnimukhān etān dahanasyāntaroditān | sūryarāmau pītabandhū dviḥ prakalpya catuṣṭayam || 33.110 śuklaṃ yaṣṭivivasvantau vahniṃ svāhāvasānakam | itthambustanbhanaṃ mantraṃ kalpayet kamalāsana || 33.111 praṇavādiṃ vāsudevaṃ śubhadaṃ paṅkajadvayam | māyām abhyasya hantāraṃ pulahaṃ śaśinaṃ jayam || 33.112 yaṣṭiṃ bhallāyudhaṃ cāpi vighneśaṃ rāmamastakam | natyantam udakastambhaṃ mantraṃ mantravad īrayet || 33.113 anayoḥ pūrvamantreṇa sthitavat salile caret | uttareṇa tu sindhūnāṃ vegastambhaṃ samācaret || 33.114 agnistambhanamantraṃ te kathayāmi yathātatham | saptākṣaraṃ kumbhavahniṃ bhuvanaṃ vanamālinam || 33.115 gopanaṃ puruṣātmānaṃ trivahniṃ śaśalāñchitam | vairājabindūṃ hrasvāntaṃ caturgatim atho ṭhaṭham || 33.116 ity agnisthambhanaṃ mantraṃ sādhayed ayutaṃ naraḥ | lohaṃ tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ paraśuṃ salilaṃ tathā || 33.117 saptāny etāni saṃspṛśya śītaś cāgnir bhaviṣyati | udare paṅkajasyeva sukhamāsīta śuṣmaṇaḥ || 33.118 saptākṣaraṃ caturthyantaṃ viṣṇuśabdaṃ caturmukha | pavitraṃ śrīhṛṣīkeṣaṃ <śrīhṛṣīkeśaṃ> vighneśaṃ madhusūdanam || 33.119 pradyumnaṃ pāpahananaṃ vijayaṃ vāyumādhavau | dṛṣṭiṃ mandarapātādvir ṭhaṭhāntaṃ mantram īrayet || 33.120 gavāṃ ca mahiṣāṇāṃ ca kuryād etena vaśyatām | ādau catustrivarṇāni dhanapradaguhālayau || 33.121 pavitravahnikamalaṃ sumukhaṃ vahnigopanau | vāyuṣṭhaṭhāntaminyeṣa vyālādi damano manuḥ || 33.122 praṇave ṣaṣṭhaśabdādi sambuddhyantaṃ piśācavat | ūrdhvalokeśahananaṃ pāṣāṇeṣu ṭhaṭho manuḥ || 33.123 imaṃ hi japatomantraṃ ripumūrdhani tāḍayet | piśācarūpaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pāṣāṇair asthibhiś śavaiḥ || 33.124 vyāpinaṃ gadinaṃ bhadrahastaṃ puṇyas saritpatim | vahniṃ hutāśaṃ viṣṇvantaṃ kakubhaṃ kumbhavikramau || 33.125 śrīkumbhagopanān kumbhaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ brahmasādhanam | dvir mandaraṃ madhoś śatruṃ subhadraṃ bandhumastakam || 33.126 pītaṃ krodhanamāyāmaṃ vijayaṃ gopanaṃ dhruvam | brahmāṇaṃ mānuṣeśānaṃ vāyuṃ gopanamastakam || 33.127 binduṃ pavitramanalaṃ mārutaṃ pretanāyakam | svāhāvasānaṃ gandharvaṃ mantramitthaṃ prakalpayet || 33.128 atharvaṇam imaṃ mantraṃ pinākī śirasisthitam | adhastāt pārijātasya hemasiṃhāsanasthitam || 33.129 āyāminībhir mālābhir divyābhiś śobhivakṣasam | candanāgaruliptāṅgaṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitam || 33.130 rūpayauvanayuktābhir vālavyajanapāṇibhiḥ | nityaṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣābhir utpalasnigdhadṛṣṭibhiḥ || 33.131 mahākulaprasūtābhir madavihvalamūrtibhiḥ | adbhutabhrūvilāsābhiḥ śravaṇapriyagītibhiḥ || 33.132 īṣadvisraṃsivāsobhiraṃsavyākulamaulibhiḥ | stanāndolitahārābhiḥ kadalīsubhagorubhiḥ || 33.133 kuṭilālakamālābhiḥ kanyakābhir niṣevitam | kṛtāvadhānaṃ gīteṣu kiṃnarīṇāṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 33.134 gandharvādhipatiṃ dhyāyan lakṣaṃ mantram imaṃ japet | athainam upatiṣṭhante kulavatyo varāḥ striyaḥ || 33.135 gandharvarājavacanād rūpayauvanaśālinam | athendrajālamantrasya svarūpaṃ kathayāmi te || 33.136 brahmakumbhau vīrasenau krodhaṃ sumukhavāruṇau | rāmaṃ dakṣaṃ madhoś śatruṃ caturgatimṛgeśvarau || 33.137 mohayatyatha rūpāṇi dviḥ pradarśaya mastakam | huṅkāraṃ caturabhyastaṃ brahman kilikiliṃ tathā || 33.138 ṛtadvayaṃ kumbharāmau pavitrānalavāmanān | vijayaṃ locane kṛtvā bhadraṃ vāmanamastakam || 33.139 nānārūpāṇi māye dve dvir mantram iti kalpayet | japena lakṣasaṃkhyena māyā pratyakṣasaṅgatā || 33.140 yadyadiṣṭaṃ sādhakasya tattatkurvīta tatkṣaṇāt | brahmādyā devatāḥ sarvā gaganasthāḥ pradarśayet || 33.141 gaganaṃ medinīṃ kuryād yāminīṃ divasaṃ tathā | jīvantamapsu nihitaṃ prāṇavantaṃ tathā śavam || 33.142 marupradeśe vārīṇi śuṣyantaṃ payasāṃ nidhim | ṣaḍrasaṃ vaiparītyena deśānapyayathātatham || 33.143 pāṣāṇais tāḍayan dehaṃ netrādyutpāḍhanaṃ tathā | kharvāṭakeśasaṃrohaṃ yūnaḥ sthaviratāṃ tathā || 33.144 puṃsaḥ strītvaṃ tathā strīṇāṃ puṃstvaṃ klībasya taddvayam | tayor vā klībatāṃ citraṃ śmaśru stanaviparyayāt || 33.145 gītaṃ śuklas tathā gītām anyathā bhāvabhāginaḥ | agarbhiṇīṃ garbhiṇīṃ ca garbhiṇīṃ cāpy agarbhiṇīm || 33.146 pādādi bhaṅgasandhāne nabhaḥkusumasambhavaḥ | acintitāni śailānāṃ patanāni yathepsitam || 33.147 manuṣyādiṣu śṛṅgāṇi gaganārohaṇaṃ tathā | akāla raṇasaṃrambhān pratimārkaṣaṇaṃ tathā || 33.148 kaṭhinānāṃ dravībhāvo dravatāṃ kaṭhinātmatā | adyāpi pralayāvasthāmunmajjananimajjane || 33.149 khaḍgādibhir abhaṅgaṃ ca jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ tathā | acetaneṣu caitanyaṃ cetaneṣu vicetanām || 33.150 rūpadarśanamandhasya mūkasya madhurāṃ giram | śravaṇaṃ badhirasyāpi paṅgor gamanam adbhutam || 33.151 pradarśanaṃ vimānānāṃ bhuvi sūryendumaṇḍalam | śilāvarṣaṃ mahāghoraṃ rāhugrāsamaparvaṇi || 33.152 ekasthānapraviṣṭāni bhuvanāni caturdaśa | āsanasthasya patanaṃ tumulaṃ ca parasparam || 33.153 pratīpagamanaṃ sindhorāsanaṃ havyavāhane | tatkṣaṇe viprarūḍhānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ pallavaṃ phalam || 33.154 secanaṃ havyavāhena jvalanaṃ payasā tathā | madhyāhnasamaye jyotsnā diṅmohaṃ vātasaṃbhramam || 33.155 cittādi dhātusaṃkṣobhaṃ pratyakṣasyāpyadarśanam | śailaśṛṅgādyapatanāt gaganasya pradarśanam || 33.156 itthambhūtāni citrāṇi kuryān māyānubhāvitaḥ | idānīṃ saptayakṣīṇāṃ mantrāṇi kathayāmi te || 33.157 āgaccha sundarī svāhāvasānaṃ praṇavādimam | ity eṣa sundarīmantro mantrādeḥ kāryamācaret || 33.158 praṇavaṃ prathamaṃ sarvaṃ manohari namo ṭhaṭha | itthaṃ manohārī mantraḥ priyādiṣṭaṃ prayacchati || 33.159 udgīthaṃ kanakaṃ brahman vakṣyate maithunapriyā | ṭhaṭhaḥ kanakavatsāsyānmantraḥ kāmukasiddhidaḥ || 33.160 māmāgaś ca caturvakra kāmeśvari ṭhaṭhāntimam | iti kāmeśvarīmantraḥ sarvāṃ siddhiṃ prayacchati || 33.161 āruhya śayanaṃ naktamekākī puṣpagandhavān | dhyāyet kāmeśvarīṃ yakṣīṃ sā tasya bhavati priyā || 33.162 yadanyāṃ kāmayen mantrī sā tasya vaśamācaret | svāhāntaḥ kathito mantro brahmotpāte ratipriye || 33.163 prītā ratipriyā yakṣī sādhakasya prayacchati | divyānyodana vāsāṃsi kusumādyanulepanam || 33.164 pādukāñjana khaḍgādīn bhūṣaṇāni rasāyanam | oṃ padminī ṭhaṭho mantraṃ padminī yasya devatā || 33.165 oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ dvayamāgaccha dvayaṃ yakṣi ṭhaṭhāntimam | praṇavadvitayaṃ puṣṭibījaṃ paścān natis tathā || 33.166 vātādi devau dakṣādyaṃ bandhuṃ vighneśamārutau | vīrasenamatho śuklaṃ kumbhaṃ vahniṃ subhadrakam || 33.167 hṛṣīkeśaṃ jayaṃ kumbhaṃ śrīdhruvau kamalāsana | pañcabinduṃ ṭhaṭhāntaṃ ca yāminīmantram uddharet || 33.168 etajjapena puruṣo vibhavaṃ labhate param | dvandvāni puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ ca rahitāny api yojayet || 33.169 yadyadvastu tathānyeṣāṃ striyo vā puruṣo 'pi vā | tāmbūlaṃ kusumaṃ cāpi dattvānvaham upāsayet || 33.170 yasyaite manavas sapta siddhāḥ puṃsaś caturmukha | yakṣyas tasya bhaviṣyanti kiṃ kāryam iti devatāḥ || 33.171 merumandaravindhyādi śikhareṣu yathātatham | sādhakaṃ ramayiṣyanti kalpaṃ bhogair amānuṣaiḥ || 33.172 brahman piśācamantrāṇi śṛṇuṣva gadato mama | saptākṣarāṇi saptārka gopanāḥ kumbhavikramau || 33.173 krodhapracaṇḍau varuṇamṛgeśau vipulas tathā | dvikuṇḍa saptamī svāhā manur eṣa prakīrtitaḥ || 33.174 badhnīyād amunā brahmannāviṣṭasya śivāṃ punaḥ | saptākṣaraṃ puraskṛtya caturthī viṣṇumastakam || 33.175 gurur bandhuḥ pitā kāmo mandaraṃ vikramaṃ tathā | pulahaṃ vikramaṃ paścād bhallāyudha guhālayau || 33.176 vairājapāpahananau vijayaṃ bandhumastakam | hutāśagopanau brahman kukubhaṃ brahmasūdanau || 33.177 pavitra śaṅkhau vijayaṃ māyāṃ svāhāvasānakam | iti mantraṃ prakalpyātha balim etena dāpayet || 33.178 pūrvamantradaśārṇāni mahendro rāmamastakaḥ | pavitrapavanau pītagopanau paścimānanau || 33.179 vahnyanta sūdanau vighnagopanau pavanaṃ tathā | gadī hutavahaḥ sūryo vanamālī pitāmahaḥ || 33.180 mānaṃ śabdaṃ śiraḥ svāhā gandhamantraprakalpitam | dvādaśārṇamukhaṃ pūrvaṃ vahniṃ sumukhavikramau || 33.181 māhendravikramau bhānur dakṣaṃ vijayayor dvayam | dvir vāriśabdaṃ kamalaṃ devadattaṃ vināyakam || 33.182 svāhāntam īrayen mantraṃ tamādveṣe niyojayet | stambhe vā puruṣe vāpi payastenābhimantritam || 33.183 vikṣiped atha bhūtāni stambhamapyāviśanti tam | aṣṭākṣaramukhas sūryo vahnir dviḥ kamalāsana || 33.184 vyastau punas tayor vahnāv ubhayatra trivikramau | ādityarāmaṃ nāsikyaṃ ghaṭanaṃ pāvakapriyā || 33.185 yena sāgrahamantrasya piśācādi bhayāvaham | bhūtapratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā śālipiṣṭair mahodarīm || 33.186 bhitva 'titīkṣṇena śastreṇa bhūtaṃ sākṣād bhaviṣyati | bhūtagrahapiśācādīnapasmāramathāpi vā || 33.187 kūṣmāṇḍayakṣagandharvabrahmarakṣassurāsurān | āveśayed dhared vāpi mantrair etaiś caturmukha || 33.188 yadyad ebhir aśakyaṃ syāt tattatkuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ | saudarśanasya mantreṇa nārasiṃhena vā punaḥ || 33.189 trailokyamohanenāpi sākṣād aṣṭākṣareṇa vā | iti mantraprabhāvaste kathitaḥ padmasambhava || 33.190 caryā ca vidhivatproktā dharmakāmārthamuktidā | idaṃ hi pāvanaṃ śāstramadhīte yaḥ samāhitaḥ || 33.191 triṣv apy amīṣu lokeṣu jñeyam anyan na vidyate | padmaḥ ity uktvā brahmaṇe śāstraṃ bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ || 33.192 vāsudevaḥ paraṃ brahmā tatraivāntaradhīyata | atha vismayamānātmā brahmalokapitāmahaḥ || 33.193 ājagāma svakaṃ lokaṃ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ | kapilāya dadau brahmā śāstram etan maharṣaye || 33.194 sa cāpi bhagavān mahyaṃ , mayā te kathitaṃ punaḥ | tat pātālamito hitvā jambūdvīpamito vraja || 33.195 himavatparvate ramye samādhāya manaśśubham | ārādhaya hṛṣīkeśaṃ vidhānaiḥ pañcakālikaiḥ || 33.196 saṃvartaḥ iti brūvāṇe padmetu labdhvā hṛṣṭena cetasā | ayogyājñānatimiraṃ śāstrāñjanaśalākayā || 33.197 nivṛtya pātālatalātkṛtvā padmaṃ pradakṣiṇam | amuṣmin śailaśikhare devadārubhir āvṛte || 33.198 mahābhāgavataiḥ puṇyaiḥ pāñcarātraviśāradaiḥ | tapassvādhyāyanirataiḥ sevite paramarṣibhiḥ || 33.199 hṛdayebhyaḥ samāhṛtya hṛdayaṃ saṃyamādibhiḥ | ārādhayāmi viśveśaṃ vāsudevaṃ jagadgurum || 33.200 anyamānīya tadvācā taṃ dhyāyan manasā punaḥ | kālenārādhanaṃ kurvan bhajāmi parameśvaram || 33.201 tvam apy ārādhaya kṣipraṃ cātur vyūhamadho 'kṣajam | mayā te kathitaṃ śāstraṃ sāvadhānena kiṃ śrutam || 33.202 idaṃ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadācana | na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo 'bhyasūyati || 33.203 tantrāṇāṃ caiva ratnāni pañcāhuḥ paramarṣayaḥ | pādmaṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca tathā paramasaṃhitā || 33.204 padmodbhavaṃ ca māhendraṃ kaṇvatantrāmṛtāni ca | tadā prabhṛti ye śiṣṭās tato 'haṃ himavattaṭe || 33.205 ārādhyāhaṃ caturbāhuṃ niyataḥ puruṣottamam | bhavanto 'pi yatātmānaḥ bhaktimanto janārdane || 33.206 kena vā kathitaṃ śāstraṃ ṛṣayaḥ kalmaṣāpaham | imāṃ mahopaniṣadaṃ śraddadhānaḥ śṛṇoti yaḥ || 33.207 sa yāti śāśvataṃ sthānaṃ duṣprāpamakṛtātmabhiḥ | yena māṃ prathayāmāsa yathā padmaguror guruḥ || 33.208 tenedaṃ kriyante puṇyāmatanotpadmasaṃhitām | ṛṣayas taṃ bhavanto 'pi bhajantu puruṣottamam || 33.209 pradāsyati sa yuṣmabhyamapavargaṃ tapodhanāḥ | ity adhyāyās trayastriṃśac caryāpādaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 33.210
iti śrīpāñcarātre mahopaniṣadi pādme tantre caryāpāde samārādhanāṅga mantroddhāro nāma trayastriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
caryāpādaḥ samāptaḥ
